These outcomes arise from the distinct dimensionalities and symmetries of the hybrid constituents, underscoring the generality of our approach. Thus, our work presents an advanced framework for the design and control of nonlinear light-matter interactions in nanoscale hybrid devices, thereby paving the way for their future use in photonic and optoelectronic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了通过调节ZnO纳米线与单层WSe₂之间的相对晶向，实现纳米尺度非线性光学响应的扭转角可调控。作者在二次谐波产生中实现了相长与相消干涉，并在偏振依赖测量中获得完全的材料选择性。结果表明，不同维度与对称性的材料组合可为纳米光子和光电子器件中的非线性光—物质相互作用提供可设计的控制框架。
authors: Maximilian Tomoscheit, Benedikt Mathes, Alexander Zaunick, Moritz Willems, Edwin Eobaldt, Priyanka S. Prakash, Eva Perlt, Carsten Ronning, Giancarlo Soavi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 集成不同维度材料（0D、1D和2D）的纳米尺度器件在光子学和光电子学的先进应用中具有巨大潜力。开发此类器件的一项基本要求，是对光—物质相互作用进行工程化设计和控制，使其超越对线性与非线性光学发射的简单增强或猝灭。在本研究中，我们通过在由ZnO纳米线和单层WSe₂构成的杂化系统中实现非线性光学响应的扭转角可调性，展示了对纳米尺度光—物质相互作用的控制。通过改变ZnO极轴与WSe₂晶轴之间的相对取向，我们在二次谐波产生中实现了相长和相消干涉，并在二次谐波偏振依赖测量中实现了完全的材料选择性。这些结果源于杂化组分不同的维度和对称性，突显了我们方法的普适性。因此，我们的工作为纳米尺度杂化器件中非线性光—物质相互作用的设计与控制提出了一个先进框架，从而为其未来在光子和光电子技术中的应用铺平道路。

articles.title: Wien-Filter Hamiltonian and Transfer Matrix
articles.title_zh: 维恩滤波器的哈密顿量与传输矩阵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive the Hamiltonian and the transfer matrix of a Wien-filter with vertical magnetic field from first principles.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作从第一性原理出发推导了具有竖直磁场的维恩滤波器的哈密顿量和传输矩阵。研究内容聚焦于为该类带电粒子光学元件建立基础理论描述，详情需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从第一性原理出发，推导了具有竖直磁场的维恩滤波器的哈密顿量和传输矩阵。

articles.title: Conceptual design of a mid-energy spin rotator for continuous-wave operation based on a compact multi-pi rosetta magnet
articles.title_zh: 基于紧凑型多π罗塞塔磁体的中能自旋旋转器连续波运行概念设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-rotators in the the few-MeV range require large trajectory deflection angles in order to change the spin direction appreciably. We describe a magnet system that accumulates adequately large bending angles in a small footprint and, at the same time, supports continuous-wave operation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种用于数MeV能区自旋旋转的紧凑磁体系统概念。由于该能区需要较大的轨道偏转角才能显著改变自旋方向，作者设计的系统可在较小占地内累积足够弯转角，并支持连续波运行。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数MeV范围内的自旋旋转器需要较大的轨迹偏转角，才能显著改变自旋方向。我们描述了一种磁体系统，它能够在较小占地面积内累积足够大的弯转角，同时支持连续波运行。

articles.title: Magnetic Dynamo Driven by Inertial Waves
articles.title_zh: 由惯性波驱动的磁发电机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06086v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate, by studying precession-driven flows, that inertial wave hydrodynamic turbulence can drive a robust magnetic dynamo action. Motivated by the stronger damping of large-scale geostrophic vortices in rapidly rotating planetary and stellar interiors, we introduce a controlled damping of the vortices, which usually accompany inertial wave turbulence and feed on wave energy. It is shown that even a small vortex damping results in a significant increase of the growth rate of the dynamo due to inertial waves in the kinematic regime, allowing it to persist for magnetic Prandtl numbers as low as Pm sim 10⁻³ and Poincaré numbers Posim 0.025. These critical values of Po and Pm for the dynamo onset decrease with increasing Reynolds number. The onset and growth of the dynamo appear to correlate with the coherent fluctuations of kinetic helicity. Spectral analysis shows that magnetic energy growth is primarily due to inertial-wave-induced induction over a broad range of scales. These results establish inertial waves as an efficient mechanism for magnetic field amplification in rapidly rotating low-Pm flows relevant to planetary and stellar interiors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过考察进动驱动流动，表明惯性波流体动力湍流能够驱动稳健的磁发电机作用。作者引入对大尺度地转涡旋的受控阻尼，发现即便小阻尼也能显著提高运动学区间中的磁场增长率，并使发电机在低磁普朗特数和较低庞加莱数下维持。结果支持惯性波是快速旋转、低磁普朗特数流体中放大磁场的有效机制，具有行星和恒星内部相关性。
authors: A. Mishra, G. Mamatsashvili, M. Le Bars, A. J. Barker, F. Stefani
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过研究进动驱动流动，证明惯性波流体动力湍流能够驱动稳健的磁发电机作用。受到快速旋转的行星和恒星内部中大尺度地转涡旋阻尼更强这一事实的启发，我们引入了对这些涡旋的受控阻尼；这些涡旋通常伴随惯性波湍流出现，并从波能中获取能量。结果表明，即使很小的涡旋阻尼，也会显著提高运动学区间中由惯性波引起的发电机增长率，使其能够在低至Pm约为10⁻³的磁普朗特数和Po约为0.025的庞加莱数下持续存在。随着雷诺数增加，发电机起始所需的这些Po和Pm临界值会降低。发电机的起始和增长似乎与动能螺旋度的相干涨落相关。谱分析表明，磁能增长主要归因于惯性波诱导的感应作用，并发生在宽广尺度范围内。这些结果确立了惯性波作为快速旋转低Pm流动中磁场放大的有效机制，而此类流动与行星和恒星内部相关。

articles.title: Wave scattering around a submerged vertical permeable breakwater
articles.title_zh: 淹没式竖直透水防波堤周围的波浪散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An analytical solution for a wave velocity field scattered by a submerged permeable vertical plate-type breakwater under the linear monochromatic wave is obtained and the applications of the solution are presented. The water has an infinite depth, and the flow is assumed to be incompressible, inviscid, and irrotational, which leads to the two-dimensional potential wave theory. The permeable breakwater vertically occupies a finite interval beneath the water surface and the water flows through the breakwater. The resulting nonlinear boundary condition is resolved by the perturbation method with a small parameter representing the permeability. The solution was expanded up to the first order so that the leading-order term can represent the wave scattered by the impermeable breakwater and the first-order term can give the correction to the solution considering the wave scattered by the permeable breakwater. Each order of the wave velocity potential is determined by a reduction method and this leads to the homogeneous Riemann-Hilbert problem for the leading-order problem and the nonhomogeneous Riemann-Hilbert problem for the first-order problem. e̊vThe effects of wavelength, breakwater length, and breakwater permeability conditions on the reflection and transmission coefficients are discussed in detail as an illustrative example of the application of the solution. e̊v{An exact energy identity is also derived; it verifies the first-order solution and yields a closed-form boundary ǎrepsilonₘₐₓ(kb) of the validity range of the expansion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文给出了线性单色波作用下，淹没式透水竖直板型防波堤散射波速度场的解析解及其应用。研究在二维势波理论框架内，通过以透水性为小参数的摄动方法处理非线性边界条件，并将解展开至一阶。作者进一步讨论了波长、防波堤长度与透水条件对反射和透射系数的影响，并推导了能量恒等式以验证解的适用范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文获得了在线性单色波作用下，由淹没式透水竖直板型防波堤散射的波浪速度场的解析解，并给出了该解的应用。水体深度为无限大，流动被假定为不可压、无黏且无旋，从而导向二维势波理论。透水防波堤在水面以下沿竖直方向占据一个有限区间，水流可穿过防波堤。所得非线性边界条件通过摄动方法加以处理，其中小参数表示透水性。解被展开至一阶，使得主阶项可表示由不透水防波堤散射的波浪，而一阶项可给出考虑透水防波堤散射波时对解的修正。每一阶的波速势均通过约化方法确定，这使主阶问题归结为齐次Riemann-Hilbert问题，使一阶问题归结为非齐次Riemann-Hilbert问题。作为该解应用的示例，文中详细讨论了波长、防波堤长度和防波堤透水条件对反射系数与透射系数的影响。还推导了一个精确的能量恒等式；它验证了一阶解，并给出展开有效范围的闭式边界εₘₐₓ₍ₖb)。

articles.title: A platform for nuclear symmetry-violation searches with laser-coolable molecules carrying spinful nuclei
articles.title_zh: 利用携带有自旋原子核的可激光冷却分子搜索核对称性破缺的平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cold heavy molecules are promising systems for exploring nuclear P- and CP-violating phenomena in search of new physics beyond the Standard Model. However, most proposed experimental strategies and their early realizations to date have been limited to proof-of-principle molecular species with effectively spin-zero nuclei that are not sensitive to nuclear symmetry-violating phenomena. Here, we introduce a comprehensive experimental toolbox that integrates cooling, trapping, coherent state manipulation, and a complete precision-measurement protocol that is applicable to molecules carrying relevant nuclear spins. Using {}¹³⁷Ba{}¹⁹F and nuclear-spin-dependent parity violation (NSD-PV) as representative species and benchmark application, respectively, our approach achieves a projected statistical sensitivity roughly two orders of magnitude beyond comparable molecular beams by combining techniques already demonstrated individually in current experiments. This level of precision could provide realistic experimental access not only to the enhanced NSD-PV signals arising from the heavy {}¹³⁷Ba nucleus within this molecule but also to the contributions from the lighter {}¹⁹F nucleus, bringing direct benchmarks of nuclear ab initio theory within reach. We further identify a candidate magic wavelength as a route to second-scale rotational coherence in future experiments. The techniques developed here can be transferred to measurements of nuclear Schiff and magnetic quadrupole moments in molecules containing deformed nuclei, establishing a general platform for laboratory searches for nuclear symmetry violations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一套面向含有相关核自旋的冷重分子的实验工具箱，用于搜索核P破缺和CP破缺等标准模型之外的新物理信号。以¹³⁷Ba¹⁹F和核自旋相关宇称破缺为例，作者设计了包含冷却、俘获、相干态操控和精密测量的完整方案，预计统计灵敏度较可比分子束实验提升约两个数量级。该平台还可推广到核Schiff矩和磁四极矩测量，为实验室核对称性破缺搜索提供通用路线。
authors: Tatsam Garg, Jakob Weiß, Tesse Tiemens, Charly Beulenkamp, Andreas Schindewolf, Tim Langen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 冷重分子是探索核P破缺和CP破缺现象、寻找标准模型之外新物理的有前景系统。然而，目前提出的大多数实验策略及其早期实现，仍局限于原理验证型分子物种，其原子核等效自旋为零，因而对核对称性破缺现象不敏感。在这里，我们提出一个综合性实验工具箱，将冷却、俘获、相干态操控以及完整的精密测量方案整合起来，并适用于携带相关核自旋的分子。分别以¹³⁷Ba¹⁹F和核自旋相关宇称破缺（NSD-PV）作为代表性物种和基准应用，我们的方法通过结合当前实验中已经分别得到展示的技术，实现了预计比可比分子束高约两个数量级的统计灵敏度。这一精度水平不仅可能为该分子中重¹³⁷Ba原子核所产生的增强NSD-PV信号提供现实的实验通道，也可能接触到较轻¹⁹F原子核的贡献，从而使核从头算理论的直接基准检验变得可及。我们还确定了一个候选魔术波长，作为未来实验中实现秒量级转动相干性的一条途径。这里发展的技术可转用于含有形变原子核的分子中的核Schiff矩和磁四极矩测量，从而建立一个用于实验室搜索核对称性破缺的通用平台。

articles.title: From expansion to collapse: Bubble and continuum multiscale modeling in open-system magmas
articles.title_zh: 从膨胀到塌缩：开放系统岩浆中的气泡与连续体多尺度建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06181v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bubble growth in silicate melts drives significant volume expansion, which has a first order control on magma transport dynamics. When magmas are exposed to external environments, heat and volatile loss at free surfaces can reverse bubble growth, leading to shrinkage and complex feedbacks between diffusion, rheology, and flow. To resolve how magma flow controls, or is controlled by, bubble expansion, we couple a micro-mechanical model for volatile diffusion into individual bubbles, with a macro-scale thermal evolution and fluid flow of the surrounding magmatic suspension. This two-way coupling captures the co-evolution of bubble size, melt viscosity, and pressure gradients, allowing both growth and resorption to emerge naturally from local conditions. We identify distinct dynamical regimes governed by (i) bubble growth limited by (a) viscous resistance or (b) diffusion at the bubble scale, (ii) viscous transport of the suspension, (iii) outgassing through permeable porous networks and exposed magma-fluid interfaces, and (iv) thermal quenching. Across these regimes, thin, high-viscosity boundary layers arising from temperature and volatile concentration gradients play a central role in modulating flow and bubble evolution. The model is implemented in a flexible, modular numerical framework (Multiscale Vesiculation, Fluid flow, Failure, and Interaction Nonlinear model: MVFFIN) enabling extension to a wide range of systems and applications, including conduit flow and pyroclast evolution. By resolving the interplay between internal bubble dynamics and external boundary conditions, this approach provides a unified framework for understanding multiscale degassing and its impact on magmatic transport and fragmentation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了一个双向耦合的多尺度模型，将单个气泡中挥发分扩散的微观力学模型与周围岩浆悬浮体的宏观热演化和流体流动相结合。模型可自然描述气泡生长与再吸收、熔体黏度和压力梯度的共同演化，并识别出由黏性阻力、扩散、排气和热淬冷控制的不同动力学机制。作者将该方法实现为模块化数值框架MVFFIN，为理解岩浆脱气、输运和破碎提供统一工具。
authors: Janine Birnbaum, Fabian B. Wadsworth, Anthony Lamur, Jackie E. Kendrick, Yan Lavallee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硅酸盐熔体中的气泡生长驱动显著的体积膨胀，这对岩浆输运动力学具有一阶控制作用。当岩浆暴露于外部环境时，自由表面上的热量和挥发分损失会逆转气泡生长，导致收缩，并在扩散、流变和流动之间产生复杂反馈。为解析岩浆流动如何控制气泡膨胀，或如何受气泡膨胀控制，我们将描述挥发分向单个气泡中扩散的微观力学模型，与周围岩浆悬浮体的宏观尺度热演化和流体流动耦合起来。这种双向耦合捕捉了气泡尺寸、熔体黏度和压力梯度的共同演化，使生长和再吸收都能从局部条件中自然产生。我们识别出若干不同的动力学机制，它们分别受以下因素支配：（i）气泡生长在气泡尺度上受（a）黏性阻力或（b）扩散限制，（ii）悬浮体的黏性输运，（iii）通过透水多孔网络和暴露的岩浆—流体界面排气，以及（iv）热淬冷。在这些机制中，由温度和挥发分浓度梯度产生的薄而高黏度边界层，在调制流动和气泡演化方面起着核心作用。该模型被实现在一个灵活的模块化数值框架中，即多尺度囊泡化、流体流动、破坏与相互作用非线性模型（Multiscale Vesiculation, Fluid flow, Failure, and Interaction Nonlinear model: MVFFIN），从而能够扩展到广泛的系统和应用，包括火山通道流和火山碎屑演化。通过解析内部气泡动力学与外部边界条件之间的相互作用，该方法为理解多尺度脱气及其对岩浆输运和破碎的影响提供了统一框架。

articles.title: Three-layer water flows: Dirichlet-Neumann operators and approximations
articles.title_zh: 三层水流：Dirichlet-Neumann算子与近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The object of investigation in this paper are the nonlinear equations of motion for two-dimensional inviscid water flows with piecewise constant density stratification in a three-layer fluid with a flat bottom, a free surface and two interfaces. We establish a Hamiltonian formulation for the nonlinear governing equations in this setup. The Hamiltonian of the system and the equations of motion of the surface and of the interfaces are expressed with the help of the Dirichlet-Neumann (DN) operators, which are introduced for each of the layers. Then, the linear equations for small amplitudes of the elevation of the surface and of the interfaces in the leading order are derived from which a bi-cubic equation for the dispersion relation is obtained, whose solutions are analysed. The six real solutions for the possible propagation speeds (three positive, related to right-moving waves and three negative, related to left-moving waves) have magnitudes of different order. Upper and lower bounds for the previously mentioned roots are also given in terms of the coefficients of the equation. Subsequently, approximate formulae for the propagation speeds are derived. The importance of the DN operators is further illustrated in a separate analysis of the three-layer model with flat surface (rigid lid). The full nonlinear evolution equations are expressed again in terms of the DN operators, and the equations in the linear regime and the weakly nonlinear propagation regime (the Boussinesq approximation) are derived by a proper expansion of the DN operators. Limits to the two-layer free surface model are obtained as well. The obtained results are applicable to internal waves in lakes and in the ocean as well as to laboratory experiments with three superimposed fluid layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究具有分段常密度分层的三层二维无黏水流，其几何包括平底、自由表面和两个界面。作者建立了非线性控制方程的哈密顿形式，并用各层的Dirichlet-Neumann算子表示哈密顿量及界面和自由表面运动方程。文中进一步推导小振幅线性色散关系、传播速度近似公式，并分析刚盖三层模型、Boussinesq近似及向两层自由表面模型的极限，适用于湖泊、海洋和实验室内波研究。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究的对象是二维无黏水流的非线性运动方程，该水流具有分段常密度分层，处于一个三层流体中，具有平坦底部、一个自由表面和两个界面。我们为这一设置下的非线性控制方程建立了哈密顿表述。系统的哈密顿量以及表面和界面的运动方程，借助为每一层引入的Dirichlet-Neumann（DN）算子来表示。随后，从中推导出表面和界面隆起小振幅情形下主阶的线性方程，并得到一个关于色散关系的双三次方程，对其解进行了分析。可能传播速度的六个实解（三个为正，对应右行波；三个为负，对应左行波）具有不同量级的大小。文中还根据方程系数给出了上述根的上界和下界。随后，推导了传播速度的近似公式。DN算子的重要性还在对具有平坦表面（刚盖）的三层模型的单独分析中得到进一步说明。完整非线性演化方程再次用DN算子表示，并通过对DN算子的适当展开，推导出线性区间和弱非线性传播区间（Boussinesq近似）中的方程。还获得了向两层自由表面模型的极限。所得结果适用于湖泊和海洋中的内波，也适用于具有三层叠置流体的实验室实验。

articles.title: Machine learning for sample-based quantum diagonalization: generative configuration recovery and the classical-simulability frontier
articles.title_zh: 面向基于采样的量子对角化的机器学习：生成式组态恢复与经典可模拟性前沿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05314v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), equivalently quantum-selected configuration interaction (QSCI), has in two years become a pragmatic centre of gravity of pre-fault-tolerant quantum chemistry: a quantum processor samples electronic configurations, and the many-electron Hamiltonian is diagonalized classically in the resulting determinant subspace. Its accuracy is set entirely by which configurations enter that subspace, a selection problem for machine learning made acute by a coupon-collector bottleneck. We critically review the ecosystem of generative and learned selectors, organizing it by the object each method generates and the importance signal it exploits, and expose one conspicuous gap: a reward-proportional generative-flow-network proposer built for tail discovery. We then confront the field's central question -- whether the quantum sampler beats classical selected configuration interaction -- and report a carefully scoped negative: across published same-active-space comparisons, strong classical selected CI matches or beats the quantum-sampled subspace, and the flagship single-layer circuits now admit polynomial-time classical energy estimation. We distil a benchmarking standard and turn the negative into a regime map, then test it with FCI-exact experiments that confirm one prediction and refute another: the cheap prior's rank correlation with the exact weights declines with multireference character (a usable coordinate), but a controlled single-molecule noise sweep shows the one generative advantage we find, robustness to valid-shot starvation, to be generic rather than the multireference-specific effect a confounded contrast first suggested. Finally, we flag learning from quantum experiments, whose classical sample-complexity lower bound is an unconditional theorem, as the one adjacent frontier where a quantum advantage is provable but not yet bridged to chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述评估了基于采样的量子对角化（SQD/QSCI）中生成式和学习型组态选择方法，并指出当前缺少面向尾部分布发现的奖励比例生成流网络提议器。作者审视量子采样器是否优于经典选择组态相互作用，并在已发表的相同活性空间比较中给出范围明确的负面结论：强经典选择CI可匹配或优于量子采样子空间，且一些代表性浅层线路已可用多项式时间经典估计能量。文章进一步提出基准标准和适用区间图，并指出从量子实验中学习仍是一个具有可证明量子优势但尚未与化学应用衔接的相邻前沿。
authors: Nicolás Bonilla Vargas (Universidad Nacional de Colombia, SRH University München, Daita AI)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于采样的量子对角化（SQD），等价地称为量子选择组态相互作用（QSCI），在两年内已成为容错前量子化学中一个务实的重心：量子处理器对电子组态进行采样，而多电子哈密顿量则在所得行列式子空间中进行经典对角化。其精度完全由哪些组态进入该子空间决定，这是一个适合机器学习的选择问题，并因集券者瓶颈而变得尤为突出。我们批判性地回顾了生成式和学习型选择器的生态系统，按照每种方法生成的对象以及其利用的重要性信号加以组织，并揭示了一个显著缺口：一种为尾部发现而构建的、按奖励成比例的生成流网络提议器。随后，我们直面该领域的核心问题——量子采样器是否优于经典选择组态相互作用——并报告一个经过谨慎限定范围的否定结论：在已发表的相同活性空间比较中，强经典选择CI能够匹配或优于量子采样子空间，而旗舰式单层电路如今也允许用多项式时间进行经典能量估计。我们提炼出一套基准测试标准，并将这一否定结论转化为一个区间图；随后用FCI精确实验对其进行检验，确认了一个预测并否定了另一个预测：廉价先验与精确权重之间的秩相关性会随多参考特征增强而下降（这是一个可用坐标），但受控的单分子噪声扫描表明，我们发现的一项生成式优势，即对有效采样数匮乏的鲁棒性，是一种普遍效应，而非最初由混杂对比所暗示的多参考特异性效应。最后，我们强调从量子实验中学习这一方向；其经典样本复杂度下界是一个无条件定理，因此它是一个相邻前沿，在那里量子优势可被证明，但尚未与化学相衔接。

articles.title: A Symplectic Map Approach to Magnetic Field-Line Dynamics in Tokamaks
articles.title_zh: 托卡马克中磁力线动力学的辛映射方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05414v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic field-line transport in tokamaks is governed by the interplay between chaotic dynamics and invariant phase-space structures that act as partial transport barriers. We investigate the conservative Tokamap, an exact symplectic mapping for magnetic field-line dynamics, using a unified geometrical, dynamical, and statistical framework. Phase-space portraits and Lyapunov exponents characterize the mixed Hamiltonian dynamics, while ensemble-averaged transport exhibits universal dynamic scaling with growth, crossover, and saturation regimes connected through a homogeneous scaling theory. Poincaré recurrence statistics reveal that decreasing the magnetic-shear parameter systematically slows transport, with the characteristic transport time following the algebraic scaling τ_cpropto x_q⁻⁰.²¹³. This behavior reflects increasingly dominant stickiness associated with KAM islands, resonance chains, and cantori. Our results establish a direct connection between the geometrical organization of Hamiltonian phase space and macroscopic transport properties, providing a comprehensive framework for understanding long-time magnetic field-line transport in tokamaks and other Hamiltonian systems with mixed phase space.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用保守Tokamap这一精确辛映射，分析托卡马克中由混沌动力学和相空间不变结构共同控制的磁力线输运。作者结合相空间图、Lyapunov指数、系综平均输运和Poincaré复现统计，揭示输运的普适动态标度以及磁剪切参数降低导致输运变慢的代数规律。结果将哈密顿相空间几何组织与宏观输运性质直接联系起来，可用于理解托卡马克及其他混合相空间哈密顿系统中的长时输运。
authors: Diego F. M. Oliveira, Edson D. Leonel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 托卡马克中的磁力线输运受混沌动力学与相空间不变结构之间相互作用支配，后者充当部分输运屏障。我们使用统一的几何、动力学和统计框架，研究保守Tokamap；它是用于磁力线动力学的一个精确辛映射。相空间图像和Lyapunov指数刻画了混合哈密顿动力学，而系综平均输运表现出普适的动态标度，其增长、交叉和饱和区间通过齐次标度理论相互连接。Poincaré复现统计显示，降低磁剪切参数会系统性地减慢输运，其特征输运时间服从代数标度τ_c ∝ x_q⁻⁰.²¹³。这一行为反映了与KAM岛、共振链和cantori相关的黏滞性日益占主导。我们的结果建立了哈密顿相空间的几何组织与宏观输运性质之间的直接联系，为理解托卡马克以及其他具有混合相空间的哈密顿系统中的长时磁力线输运提供了一个综合框架。

articles.title: Net electron spin rotation in a plane-wave pulse: Holonomy set by the anomalous magnetic moment
articles.title_zh: 平面波脉冲中的净电子自旋旋转：由反常磁矩设定的和乐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05698v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We compute the spin rotation that survives after a relativistic electron has crossed a plane-wave laser pulse of finite duration. In the interaction picture built on the exact g=2 evolution, the Thomas-Bargmann-Michel-Telegdi equation becomes parallel transport by a connection with constant coefficients on the polarization plane, and the pulse enters only through the closed curve that the transverse vector potential traces there. The net rotation is the holonomy of that connection: an angle -frac12aₑ²A about the propagation direction, with aₑ₌₍g-2)/2 the anomaly and A twice the signed area enclosed by the curve. That area is the spin angular momentum the pulse carries per unit area, so the rotation measures the helicity of the light. Reduction of the residual dynamics to a rotation coupled through the anomaly alone is an exact result of the 1960s [Ternov, Bagrov, and Klimenko, Sov. Phys. J. 11, 29 (1968); Bagrov and Gitman, The Dirac Equation and its Solutions (De Gruyter, Berlin, 2014), Sec. 5.3], which yields two closed-form cases; the area law is the general second order that those two cases bound. The same area governs the orientation memory of a neutral magnetic dipole [Oblak and Seraj, Phys. Rev. D 109, 044037 (2024)] with a coupling of order unity. For a charged electron on a Volkov orbit the coupling g/2 cancels identically, which suppresses the rotation by 1.3×10⁻⁶ and leaves a channel with no g-independent part. We verify the cancellation at g=2 over 180 pulse configurations and the area law over 89 more. Finite focusing restores that part at second order in 1/kw₀, and it exceeds the anomalous signal unless w₀gtrsim16łambda at γ=10, or 270łambda at γ=1.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究计算了相对论电子穿过有限持续时间平面波激光脉冲后保留下来的自旋旋转。作者表明，在基于精确g=2演化的相互作用绘景中，净旋转可理解为由横向矢势在偏振平面中描绘的闭合曲线所决定的联络和乐，旋转角与电子反常磁矩平方及曲线有向面积相关。研究验证了g=2时的抵消和面积定律，并指出有限聚焦会恢复与g无关的部分，在许多条件下可超过反常信号。
authors: N. S. Akintsov, A. P. Nevecheria, S. N. Andreev, Qing-Hua Qin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们计算了相对论电子穿过有限持续时间的平面波激光脉冲后仍然保留下来的自旋旋转。在建立于精确g=2演化之上的相互作用绘景中，Thomas-Bargmann-Michel-Telegdi方程变成了由偏振平面上具有常系数的联络所定义的平行输运，而脉冲只通过横向矢势在该平面中描绘的闭合曲线进入。净旋转是该联络的和乐：其角度为 -1/2 aₑ² A，旋转轴为传播方向，其中aₑ₌₍g-2)/2为反常项，A为该曲线所围有向面积的两倍。该面积就是脉冲单位面积携带的自旋角动量，因此该旋转测量的是光的螺旋性。残余动力学约化为仅通过反常项耦合的旋转，是20世纪60年代的一个精确结果[Ternov, Bagrov, and Klimenko, Sov. Phys. J. 11, 29 (1968); Bagrov and Gitman, The Dirac Equation and its Solutions (De Gruyter, Berlin, 2014), Sec. 5.3]，它给出了两个闭式情形；面积定律是由这两个情形所界定的一般二阶结果。同一面积也支配中性磁偶极子的取向记忆[Oblak and Seraj, Phys. Rev. D 109, 044037 (2024)]，其耦合量级为一。对于位于Volkov轨道上的带电电子，耦合g/2会完全抵消，这使旋转被抑制了1.3×10⁻⁶，并留下一个不含g无关部分的通道。我们在180种脉冲构型中验证了g=2时的抵消，并在另外89种构型中验证了面积定律。有限聚焦会在1/kw₀的二阶恢复该部分，并且除非在γ=10时w₀≳16λ，或在γ=1时w₀≳270λ，否则它会超过反常信号。

articles.title: Prandtl--Batchelor and flux-expulsion selection for steady MHD flows in a disk
articles.title_zh: 圆盘中稳态MHD流的Prandtl-Batchelor选择与磁通排斥选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05994v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the simultaneous vanishing-viscosity and vanishing-resistivity limit of steady incompressible MHD flows in a disk. The boundary velocity is a small nonaxisymmetric perturbation of a rigid rotation with mean angular speed (α), while the prescribed tangential magnetic trace has mean (β). Assuming (α≠0) and the non-Alfvénic condition (|α|≠|β|), we construct solutions converging on compact interior subdisks to a rigidly rotating ideal MHD core with constant vorticity and out-of-plane current density. A new MHD--Wood law determines the two core rotations from the boundary data: the velocity core is selected by a coupled kinetic--magnetic balance, whereas the magnetic core is fixed by the imposed mean circulation. Consequently, zero circulation gives complete interior magnetic expulsion, while nonzero circulation leaves a uniform magnetic rotation after the nonaxisymmetric modes are confined to a thin boundary layer. This provides a fully coupled realization of Prandtl--Batchelor selection and flux expulsion; unlike classical kinematic models, the magnetic field actively changes the flow and need not be weak. The proof combines a non-Alfvénic coercive theory for a periodic MHD boundary layer, global matching of the two fields, and a coupled stability estimate adapted to the magnetic boundary condition. A separate conditional rigidity argument, using exact viscous identities and local convergence but no interior asymptotic expansion, explains the same core structure for a broader single-eddy family.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察圆盘内稳态不可压MHD流在黏性和电阻同时趋零时的极限。对于边界速度为刚体旋转的小非轴对称扰动且满足非Alfvén条件的情形，作者构造出在内部紧子圆盘上收敛到刚体旋转理想MHD核心的解。新的MHD-Wood定律给出核心旋转的选择机制，并说明零环流导致内部磁场完全排斥，而非零环流则留下均匀磁旋转，从而实现Prandtl-Batchelor选择与磁通排斥的全耦合描述。
authors: Chen Gao, Zhiwu Lin, Jianfeng Zhao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究圆盘中稳态不可压MHD流在黏性消失和电阻消失同时发生时的极限。边界速度是平均角速度为α的刚体旋转的一个小的非轴对称扰动，而给定的切向磁迹具有平均值β。假设α≠0并满足非Alfvén条件|α|≠|β|，我们构造了若干解，它们在内部紧子圆盘上收敛到具有常涡量和面外电流密度的刚体旋转理想MHD核心。一个新的MHD-Wood定律由边界数据决定两个核心旋转：速度核心由耦合的动能—磁能平衡选择，而磁核心由施加的平均环流固定。因此，零环流给出完全的内部磁排斥，而非零环流在非轴对称模被限制于薄边界层之后留下均匀磁旋转。这提供了Prandtl-Batchelor选择和磁通排斥的一个全耦合实现；不同于经典运动学模型，磁场会主动改变流动，并且不必很弱。证明结合了用于周期MHD边界层的非Alfvén强制性理论、两个场的全局匹配，以及适配于磁边界条件的耦合稳定性估计。一个独立的条件刚性论证使用精确黏性恒等式和局部收敛，而不使用内部渐近展开，解释了更广泛单涡族的相同核心结构。

articles.title: NestyNet. II. Coherent Function-Space Posteriors from Scientific Neural Surrogates (or How to Avoid Expensive MCMC)
articles.title_zh: NestyNet II：来自科学神经网络替代模型的相干函数空间后验（或如何避免昂贵的 MCMC）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06274v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scientific analyses increasingly use flexible neural networks, but their thousands of correlated parameters make it challenging to interpret the associated uncertainties. Here we develop a low-dimensional posterior for the fitted function itself, for scientific neural surrogates trained with second-order optimization. Linearizing the fitting procedure with respect to the randomized residual rows gives a measurement-to-function transport, the linear map, assembled from the converged Jacobians and Gauss--Newton curvature, that carries measurement perturbations into the function perturbations that refitting would produce. Its leading singular functions define coherent deformation modes. Independent Gaussian coefficients then generate smooth function draws, so that any derived quantity, including those requiring derivatives or integrals of the draw, inherits the posterior. The construction distinguishes repeated-experiment covariance from the local Gauss--Newton/Laplace posterior and propagates both to correlated quantities of scientific interest. The result is conditional on the fit's declared choices (architecture, hyperparameters, active set, and optimization branch), and every fit is certified as converged by checking that a further optimization step would change the fitted predictions by less than a chosen small fraction of the measurement errors. Our primary example is an 800-parameter phase-space distribution function fit for a mock stellar disk. Four uncertainty coordinates, two orders of magnitude fewer than the fitted parameters and stable under refinement of the force basis, capture 99% of the vertical-force posterior variance, and 4000 coherent draws propagate through the force, total-density, surface-density, and frequency calculations in 0.8s. The method provides a highly efficient route to uncertainty propagation for derivative-dependent scientific inference.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为采用二阶优化训练的科学神经网络替代模型构建了低维的函数空间后验，用以替代难以解释的高维参数不确定性。方法通过由收敛雅可比矩阵和 Gauss–Newton 曲率组装的线性映射，将测量扰动传播为函数扰动，并以少量奇异函数模式生成相干函数抽样。恒星盘相空间分布函数示例表明，极少数不确定性坐标即可捕获主要后验方差，并能高效传播到力、密度和频率等导出量。
authors: Rodrigo Ibata, Wassim Tenachi, Foivos Diakogiannis, Neil Ibata, Anirudh Shankar
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.06274v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：科学分析越来越多地使用灵活的神经网络，但其数千个相互关联的参数使得解释相关不确定性具有挑战性。本文针对使用二阶优化训练的科学神经替代模型，为拟合函数本身建立了一个低维后验。通过相对于随机化残差行对拟合过程进行线性化，可以得到一种从测量到函数的传输，即由收敛后的雅可比矩阵和 Gauss--Newton 曲率组装而成的线性映射，它将测量扰动传送为重新拟合将产生的函数扰动。其主导奇异函数定义了相干形变模式。随后，独立的高斯系数生成平滑的函数抽样，因此任何导出量，包括那些需要抽样的导数或积分的量，都继承该后验。该构造区分了重复实验协方差与局部 Gauss--Newton/Laplace 后验，并将二者传播到具有相关性的科学关注量。所得结果以拟合所声明的选择为条件，包括架构、超参数、活动集和优化分支，并且每个拟合都通过检查进一步优化步骤会使拟合预测改变的幅度是否小于测量误差的某个选定小比例来认证其已收敛。我们的主要示例是一个用于模拟恒星盘的、含 800 个参数的相空间分布函数拟合。四个不确定性坐标，比拟合参数少两个数量级，并且在力基底细化下保持稳定，捕获了垂直力后验方差的 99%；4000 个相干抽样在 0.8 秒内通过力、总密度、面密度和频率计算完成传播。该方法为依赖导数的科学推断中的不确定性传播提供了一条高效途径。

articles.title: Mapping surface height dynamics to subsurface flow physics in free-surface turbulent flow using a shallow recurrent decoder
articles.title_zh: 使用浅层循环解码器将自由表面湍流中的表面高度动力学映射到次表面流动物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.06202v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Near-surface turbulent flows beneath a free surface are reconstructed from sparse measurements of the surface height variation, by a neural network algorithm known as the SHallow REcurrent Decoder (SHRED). The reconstruction of turbulent flow fields from limited, partial, or indirect measurements remains a grand challenge in science and engineering. The central goal in such applications is to leverage easy-to-measure proxy variables in order to estimate quantities which have not been, and perhaps cannot in practice be, measured. In the application considered here, the aim is to use a sparse number of surface height point measurements of a flow field, or drone video footage of surface features, in order to infer the turbulent flow field beneath the surface. SHRED is a deep learning architecture that learns a delay-coordinate embedding from a few surface height (point) sensors and maps it, via a shallow decoder trained in a compressed basis, to full subsurface fields, enabling fast, robust training from minimal data. We demonstrate the SHRED sensing architecture on two types of turbulent data from recent studies [Aarnes et al. J. Fluid Mech. 1007, A38 (2025) and Babiker et al. Phys. Rev. Fluids 11, 054802 (2026), respectively]: fully resolved DNS data and PIV laboratory data from a turbulent water tank. SHRED is capable of robustly mapping surface height fluctuations to full-state flow fields up to about one integral length scale deep, with as few as three surface measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文使用浅层循环解码器 SHRED，从稀疏表面高度测量重建自由表面下方的近表面湍流。该架构从少量表面高度传感器学习延迟坐标嵌入，并在压缩基中映射到完整次表面流场。基于 DNS 数据和水槽 PIV 实验数据的结果显示，仅用少至三个表面测量点，SHRED 即可稳健恢复深度约达一个积分长度尺度的完整流动状态。
authors: Kristoffer S. Moen, Jørgen R. Aarnes, Simen Å. Ellingsen, J. Nathan Kutz
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2510.06202v3，公告类型：替换。摘要：本文通过一种称为浅层循环解码器（SHallow REcurrent Decoder，SHRED）的神经网络算法，从表面高度变化的稀疏测量中重建自由表面下方的近表面湍流。由有限、部分或间接测量重建湍流流场仍然是科学与工程中的重大挑战。此类应用的核心目标是利用易于测量的代理变量来估计尚未测量、并且在实践中也许无法测量的量。在本文考虑的应用中，目标是使用流场中少量表面高度点测量，或使用无人机拍摄的表面特征视频，以推断表面下方的湍流流场。SHRED 是一种深度学习架构，它从少量表面高度点传感器学习延迟坐标嵌入，并通过在压缩基中训练的浅层解码器将其映射到完整的次表面场，从而能够用极少数据实现快速而稳健的训练。我们在近期研究的两类湍流数据上展示了 SHRED 传感架构，分别为完全解析的 DNS 数据以及来自湍流水槽的 PIV 实验数据。SHRED 能够以少至三个表面测量点，将表面高度涨落稳健地映射到深度约达一个积分长度尺度的全状态流场。

articles.title: Coherent Control of Wave Scattering via Minimal-Parameter Tuning of Complex Spectra
articles.title_zh: 通过复杂谱的最少参数调谐实现波散射的相干控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.13035v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce and validate a theoretical framework for coherent control of multichannel linear scattering to route waves through complex geometries with multiple scattering. We show that steady-state perfect routing solutions are achievable at any frequency via tuning geometric parameters so that multiple complex eigenfrequencies coincide on the real axis. The relevant complex spectra describe critically constrained scattering processes (CCONs), where a specific number of generically accessible outgoing channels are inaccessible due to destructive interference. Focusing on electromagnetic waves, we demonstrate in simulations routing and demultiplexing with high discrimination of signals in a multiport chaotic cavity with a small number of tunable scatterers and free-space signal routing in a grating coupler with a similar number of tunable elements in its unit cell. The minimal number of tuning parameters required is predicted by codimension arguments and validated in simulations. A special class of perfect reflection processes are found to be enhanced in the presence of time-reversal symmetry. A similar approach can be used to implement other interesting functionalities, such as isolation, power division, mode conversion and filtering. The method can be applied to other classical waves and also to quantum matter waves.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并验证了一个用于多通道线性散射相干控制的理论框架，可在复杂多重散射几何中路由波。作者表明，通过调谐少量几何参数使多个复本征频率在实轴上重合，可在任意频率实现稳态完美路由。电磁仿真验证了多端口混沌腔和光栅耦合器中的高判别路由与解复用，并指出该方法也可推广到其他经典波和量子物质波。
authors: Ali H. Alhulaymi, Nazar Pyvovar, Philipp del Hougne, Owen D. Miller, A. Douglas Stone
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2510.13035v2，公告类型：替换。摘要：我们提出并验证了一个用于多通道线性散射相干控制的理论框架，以便在具有多重散射的复杂几何结构中路由波。我们表明，通过调谐几何参数使多个复本征频率在实轴上重合，可以在任意频率实现稳态完美路由解。相关的复谱描述了临界约束散射过程（CCONs），其中由于相消干涉，特定数量的通常可访问出射通道变得不可访问。以电磁波为重点，我们通过仿真展示了在带有少量可调散射体的多端口混沌腔中实现信号的高判别路由与解复用，以及在其晶胞中具有类似数量可调元件的光栅耦合器中实现自由空间信号路由。所需调谐参数的最小数量由余维论证预测，并在仿真中得到验证。我们发现一类特殊的完美反射过程在存在时间反演对称性时会得到增强。类似方法可用于实现其他有意义的功能，例如隔离、功率分配、模式转换和滤波。该方法可应用于其他经典波，也可应用于量子物质波。

articles.title: Integrated polarization-entangled photon source for wavelength-multiplexed quantum networks
articles.title_zh: 用于波长复用量子网络的集成偏振纠缠光子源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.22680v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Entangled photons are fundamental resources for quantum communication, computing, and networking. Among them, polarization-entangled photon pairs play an important role due to their straightforward state manipulation and direct use in quantum key distribution, teleportation, and network protocols. However, realizing compact, efficient, and scalable polarization-entangled sources that meet the requirements of practical deployment remains a major challenge. Here, we present a simple yet high-performance on-chip polarization-entangled photon-pair source on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN). Our device employs dual quasi-phase matching (D-QPM) that sequentially supports type-0 and type-I spontaneous parametric down-conversion in a single nanophotonic waveguide, eliminating the need for interferometers, polarization rotators, or other complex circuits. The source directly produces high-fidelity Bell states with broad bandwidth, high brightness, and low noise. Using this integrated platform, we realize wavelength-multiplexed entanglement distribution in a four-user quantum network deployed over metropolitan fiber links up to 50 km. These results establish a robust and scalable pathway toward practical quantum communication systems and multi-user quantum mesh networks based on integrated photonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种基于薄膜铌酸锂的片上偏振纠缠光子对源，结构简单且性能较高。器件在单根纳米光子波导中利用双准相位匹配顺序支持 type-0 和 type-I 自发参量下转换，无需干涉仪或偏振旋转器等复杂电路。该平台实现了面向四用户城域光纤量子网络的波长复用纠缠分发，为集成光子学量子通信系统提供了可扩展路径。
authors: Xiaodong Shi, Yue Li, Jinyi Du, Lin Zhou, Ran Yang, En Teng Lim, Sakthi Sanjeev Mohanraj, Mengyao Zhao, Xu Chen, Xiaojie Wang, Guangxing Wu, Hao Hao, Veerendra Dhyani, Sihao Wang, Alexander Ling, Di Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2511.22680v2，公告类型：替换。摘要：纠缠光子是量子通信、量子计算和量子网络的基本资源。其中，偏振纠缠光子对因其状态操控直接，并可直接用于量子密钥分发、量子隐形传态和网络协议，而发挥着重要作用。然而，实现满足实际部署要求的紧凑、高效且可扩展的偏振纠缠源仍然是一项重大挑战。本文在薄膜铌酸锂（TFLN）上展示了一种简单而高性能的片上偏振纠缠光子对源。我们的器件采用双准相位匹配（D-QPM），在单个纳米光子波导中顺序支持 type-0 和 type-I 自发参量下转换，从而无需干涉仪、偏振旋转器或其他复杂电路。该光源可直接产生高保真度 Bell 态，并具有宽带宽、高亮度和低噪声。利用这一集成平台，我们在通过最长 50 km 城域光纤链路部署的四用户量子网络中实现了波长复用纠缠分发。这些结果为基于集成光子学的实用量子通信系统和多用户量子网状网络建立了一条稳健且可扩展的路径。

articles.title: Geodesic extended modes in low magnetic shear tokamaks and stellarators
articles.title_zh: 低磁剪切托卡马克与仿星器中的测地扩展模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.21813v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Theories of ion-scale microinstabilities in tokamaks and stellarators typically assume that the passing electrons respond adiabatically due to their fast propagation speed. However, when the magnetic shear becomes sufficiently small, ion-scale modes can extend far along the magnetic field and the non-adiabatic response of passing electrons becomes important. We derive a theory of extended modes at low magnetic shear through a multiscale expansion of the gyrokinetic equation. The theory elucidates the physics of the geodesic extended mode, a new type of microinstability. The new mode couples the non-adiabatic physics of both electrons and ions, unlike extended modes at magnetic shear of order unity. The theory is validated against gyrokinetic simulations and the parameter dependences of the new mode are studied.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究低磁剪切条件下离子尺度微不稳定性中的扩展模，并指出此时通行电子的非绝热响应会变得重要。作者通过回旋动理学方程的多尺度展开建立理论，阐明了一种新的微不稳定性——测地扩展模的物理机制。该理论经回旋动理学模拟验证，并分析了该新模式对参数的依赖关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2603.21813v2，公告类型：替换。摘要：托卡马克和仿星器中离子尺度微不稳定性的理论通常假定，由于通行电子传播速度很快，它们作绝热响应。然而，当磁剪切变得足够小时，离子尺度模式可沿磁场延伸很远，通行电子的非绝热响应变得重要。我们通过对回旋动理学方程进行多尺度展开，推导了低磁剪切下扩展模的理论。该理论阐明了测地扩展模这一新型微不稳定性的物理。与磁剪切为一阶量时的扩展模不同，这一新模式耦合了电子和离子二者的非绝热物理。该理论通过回旋动理学模拟得到验证，并研究了新模式的参数依赖性。

articles.title: Physics-Guided Concentration Inference from Resistance Transients in a Mixed-Phase SnO-SnO₂ Carbon Monoxide Sensor with p-n Switching
articles.title_zh: 具有 p-n 转换的混相 SnO-SnO₂ 一氧化碳传感器中基于电阻瞬态的物理引导浓度推断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.23971v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work presents a physics-guided machine-learning framework for carbon monoxide concentration inference from experimentally measured resistance transients of a mixed-phase SnO-SnO₂ material gas sensor exhibiting temperature-dependent p-n switching behavior. Cycle-level transient responses are represented through physically interpretable descriptors and complemented by compact fast Fourier transform (FFT) and discrete wavelet transform (DWT)-based summaries. Using leakage-aware grouped cross-validation, we study both multi-class concentration classification and continuous concentration regression for the p-type and n-type sensing regimes separately. Across both regimes, fused features provide the strongest overall performance, while the physics-guided descriptor block remains highly competitive, indicating that the dominant concentration information is already encoded in physically meaningful transient dynamics. The p-type branch shows the best concentration-class discrimination, with the fused Random Forest classifier reaching approximately 96.5% accuracy, whereas the n-type branch yields the best quantitative concentration estimation, with the fused Random Forest regressor achieving an MAEapprox 1.48 ppm and an R² approx 0.992. These results reveal a clear dual-regime behavior: p-type sensing is particularly favorable for classification, whereas n-type sensing is more favorable for high-fidelity regression. More broadly, the study demonstrates that leakage-aware, cycle-level, physics-guided machine learning can extend conventional gas-sensing analysis beyond single-response metrics while preserving physical interpretability
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种物理引导机器学习框架，用于从混相 SnO-SnO₂ 气体传感器的实验电阻瞬态中推断一氧化碳浓度。研究分别针对 p 型和 n 型传感区间进行多类浓度分类与连续浓度回归，并采用防泄漏的分组交叉验证。结果显示，融合特征整体性能最佳，p 型更适合分类，n 型更适合高精度回归，同时物理可解释瞬态描述符已包含主要浓度信息。
authors: Sani Biswas, Preetam Singh, Amit Kumar Gangwar
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2605.23971v2，公告类型：替换。摘要：本工作提出了一种物理引导的机器学习框架，用于从表现出温度依赖 p-n 转换行为的混相 SnO-SnO₂ 材料气体传感器的实验测量电阻瞬态中推断一氧化碳浓度。循环级瞬态响应由具有物理可解释性的描述符表示，并辅以紧凑的快速傅里叶变换（FFT）和离散小波变换（DWT）摘要。通过采用防止数据泄漏的分组交叉验证，我们分别研究了 p 型和 n 型传感区间中的多类浓度分类和连续浓度回归。在两个区间中，融合特征均提供了最强的总体性能，而物理引导描述符模块仍具有很强竞争力，表明主要浓度信息已经编码在具有物理意义的瞬态动力学中。p 型分支表现出最佳的浓度类别区分能力，融合随机森林分类器达到约 96.5% 的准确率；而 n 型分支给出最佳的定量浓度估计，融合随机森林回归器实现约 1.48 ppm 的平均绝对误差和约 0.992 的 R²。这些结果揭示了清晰的双区间行为：p 型传感特别有利于分类，而 n 型传感更有利于高保真回归。更广泛地说，本研究表明，防泄漏、循环级、物理引导的机器学习能够在保持物理可解释性的同时，将传统气体传感分析拓展到单一响应指标之外。

articles.title: Domain-Gated Latent Diffusion: Generative Inverse Design of HMX-Class Energetic Materials with First-Principles Validation
articles.title_zh: 域门控潜在扩散：HMX 类含能材料的生成式逆向设计与第一性原理验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.26540v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Energetic materials power mining, demolition, propulsion and airbags, yet today's compounds were designed decades ago. A successor must combine high energy release, low sensitivity to accidental initiation and a practical synthesis route, found within an astronomically large molecular space. Generative models are the natural search tool, but their training data are mostly untrustworthy: of approximately 66,000 molecules with recorded properties, only approximately 3,000 were measured or computed from first principles. Models trained on all of them imitate the rough estimates and propose molecules that collapse under real physics. We introduce Domain-Gated Latent Diffusion (DGLD), a diffusion model that treats data reliability as an explicit design parameter: labels are sorted into four trust tiers, and only trustworthy ones steer generation, while the unreliable majority still teaches the model what a plausible molecule looks like. Learned controls tune performance, safety and viability independently, and every proposal passes a four-stage screen ending in a quantum-chemical DFT audit. DGLD proposes 10 molecules unknown to PubChem that survive this screen. The best, 3,4,5-trinitro-1,2-isoxazole, matches the benchmark explosives HMX and PETN in calculated detonation performance, is unlike molecules in its training set, and has a four-step synthesis route. Trust gating is chemistry-independent and can be applied wherever abundant weak data surround a reliable core.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出域门控潜在扩散模型 DGLD，用于在可靠数据稀少、弱标注数据众多的含能材料空间中进行分子逆向设计。该方法将数据可靠性作为显式设计参数，只让可信标签引导生成，同时利用不可靠数据学习分子合理性，并通过多阶段筛选和 DFT 审核验证候选物。模型提出了 10 个 PubChem 未收录且通过筛选的分子，其中最佳候选在计算爆轰性能上可比 HMX 和 PETN，并具有可行合成路线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2605.26540v2，公告类型：替换。摘要：含能材料为采矿、爆破、推进和安全气囊提供动力，但今天使用的化合物大多是在数十年前设计的。后继材料必须在天文规模的分子空间中，同时具备高能量释放、对意外起爆的低敏感性以及可行的合成路线。生成模型是天然的搜索工具，但其训练数据大多不可信：在约 66,000 个记录有性质的分子中，只有约 3,000 个是经实验测量或由第一性原理计算得到的。用全部数据训练的模型会模仿粗略估计，并提出在真实物理约束下会崩溃的分子。我们提出域门控潜在扩散（Domain-Gated Latent Diffusion，DGLD），这是一种将数据可靠性作为显式设计参数的扩散模型：标签被分为四个可信等级，只有可信标签用于引导生成，而数量占多数的不可靠数据仍用于教会模型什么是合理的分子。学习得到的控制变量可分别调节性能、安全性和可行性，并且每个候选方案都要通过四阶段筛选，最后以量子化学 DFT 审核结束。DGLD 提出了 10 个 PubChem 未知且通过该筛选的分子。其中最佳分子 3,4,5-三硝基-1,2-异噁唑在计算爆轰性能上与基准炸药 HMX 和 PETN 相当，与其训练集中的分子不同，并具有一条四步合成路线。信任门控与具体化学领域无关，可应用于任何大量弱数据包围可靠核心数据的场景。

articles.title: Convergence and efficiency proof of quantum imaginary time evolution for bounded order systems
articles.title_zh: 有界阶系统量子虚时演化的收敛性与效率证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.03014v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Many current and near-future applications of quantum computing utilise parametric families of quantum circuits and variational methods that can suffer from obstacles including non-convergence to the global minimum due to local minima, critical slowing down, or exponential resource scaling. Here we show that quantum imaginary time evolution can overcome these obstacles if the underlying physical system satisfies a set of conditions. This includes many relevant applications such as ground state preparation for local theories in physics or chemistry, combinatorial optimisation problems, or quantum machine learning. In particular, we analyse the quantum imaginary time evolution showing convergence guarantees to the global minimum without critical slowing down and providing a priori estimates on the required evolution time which scale linearly in system size and inverse energy gap. Furthermore, a provided complexity analysis shows that quantum imaginary time evolution can be efficiently compiled into a parametric quantum circuit, finding the optimal parameters included, for a large class of physically relevant problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明，在底层物理系统满足一组条件时，量子虚时演化可克服变分量子方法中的局部极小、临界慢化和指数资源扩展等障碍。分析给出了收敛到全局最小值的保证，以及所需演化时间关于系统规模和逆能隙线性缩放的先验估计。复杂度分析还表明，对于大量物理相关问题，量子虚时演化可高效编译为参数化量子线路并求得最优参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2506.03014v3，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：当前和近期的许多量子计算应用使用参数化量子线路族和变分方法，而这些方法可能遭遇一些障碍，包括由于局部极小值而无法收敛到全局最小值、临界慢化，或资源呈指数缩放。本文表明，如果底层物理系统满足一组条件，量子虚时演化可以克服这些障碍。这包括许多相关应用，例如物理或化学中局域理论的基态制备、组合优化问题，或量子机器学习。具体而言，我们分析了量子虚时演化，给出了无临界慢化地收敛到全局最小值的保证，并提供了所需演化时间的先验估计，其随系统大小和逆能隙线性缩放。此外，所提供的复杂度分析表明，对于一大类具有物理相关性的问题，量子虚时演化可以高效编译为参数化量子线路，并且包括最优参数的寻找。

articles.title: Broadband Spatio-Spectral Mode Conversion via Four-Wave Mixing
articles.title_zh: 通过四波混频实现宽带时空-光谱模式转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.10045v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a framework for scalable and broadband free-space phase-matched four-wave mixing in ring resonators. This method for four-wave mixing reduces the complexity of coupling an emitter to a quantum network by combining the spatial and spectral interfaces between them into one nonlinear optical process. The device is compliant with current heterogeneous integration capabilities and has a bandwidth of 165 nm for efficient spatio-spectral conversion. We outline a fabrication-ready diamond-on-insulator pathway towards modular unit cells that natively bridge visible color centers to the infrared spectrum for scalable quantum networks. We also present and analyze an end-to-end framework for considering single-photon coupling efficiency from a color center to a quantum network. This framework represents a step forwards in analyzing and reducing system-scale losses in a spin-photon interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种在环形谐振器中实现可扩展、宽带、自由空间相位匹配四波混频的框架。该方法将发射体与量子网络之间的空间接口和光谱接口合并为一个非线性光学过程，可降低耦合复杂度。作者给出与现有异质集成兼容、带宽达 165 nm 的器件方案，并提出面向色心到量子网络单光子耦合效率的端到端分析框架。
authors: Helaman Flores, Mahmoud Jalali Mehrabad, Siavash Mirzaei-Ghormish, Ryan M. Camacho, Dirk Englund
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2512.10045v3，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：我们提出一种用于在环形谐振器中实现可扩展、宽带、自由空间相位匹配四波混频的框架。这种四波混频方法通过将发射体与量子网络之间的空间接口和光谱接口合并到一个非线性光学过程中，降低了将发射体耦合到量子网络的复杂性。该器件符合当前异质集成能力，并具有 165 nm 的带宽，可实现高效的时空-光谱转换。我们概述了一条可制造的绝缘体上金刚石路径，通向模块化单元，这些单元能够天然地将可见光色心桥接到红外光谱，用于可扩展量子网络。我们还提出并分析了一个端到端框架，用于考虑从色心到量子网络的单光子耦合效率。该框架代表了在分析并降低自旋-光子接口中系统级损耗方面向前迈出的一步。

articles.title: Four- and six-photon stimulated Raman transitions for coherent qubit and qudit operations
articles.title_zh: 用于相干量子比特与量子多能级操作的四光子和六光子受激拉曼跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.18567v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum computers are typically composed of an array of two-level systems, or qubits, encoded in some information carrier, such as an electron, photon, or quantized circuit. The size of this array is restricted by finite access to resources like laser power, cooling capacity, and control lines for trapping and manipulation. Under these constraints, the system's processing power can be increased by using more energy levels per information carrier, but common techniques for qubit control provide only limited connectivity between these additional states. We experimentally demonstrate transitions between electronic angular momentum states with a difference in magnetic quantum numbers Δ m_J =  3, 4, and 5 via resonant four- and six-photon stimulated Raman transitions in a single trapped atom. Derivation of the corresponding Rabi frequencies, which are verified experimentally, follows the standard treatment of two-photon transitions including the adiabatic elimination of intermediate states. Finally, we discuss pathways to increase the observed multi-photon transition fidelities to >99.99%, providing a tool for efficient, high-fidelity control of qudits and single-atom logical qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文实验演示了单个俘获原子中通过共振四光子和六光子受激拉曼跃迁，实现磁量子数差 Δm_J = 3、4 和 5 的电子角动量态跃迁。作者推导并实验验证了相应的 Rabi 频率，该推导沿用二光子跃迁的标准处理并绝热消去中间态。研究还讨论了将多光子跃迁保真度提高到 99.99% 以上的路径，为量子多能级和单原子逻辑量子比特的高效高保真控制提供工具。
authors: Gabriel J. Gregory, Evan R. Ritchie, Alex Quinn, Sean Brudney, David J. Wineland, David T. C. Allcock, Jameson O'Reilly
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2602.18567v2，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：量子计算机通常由二能级系统或量子比特阵列组成，这些量子比特编码在某种信息载体中，例如电子、光子或量子化电路。该阵列的规模受到有限资源获取能力的限制，例如激光功率、冷却能力，以及用于俘获和操控的控制线。在这些约束下，可以通过在每个信息载体中使用更多能级来提高系统的处理能力，但常见的量子比特控制技术在这些额外态之间只提供有限的连通性。我们在单个俘获原子中，通过共振四光子和六光子受激拉曼跃迁，实验演示了磁量子数差 Δm_J = 3、4 和 5 的电子角动量态之间的跃迁。相应 Rabi 频率的推导遵循二光子跃迁的标准处理方法，包括对中间态进行绝热消去，并通过实验得到验证。最后，我们讨论了将观测到的多光子跃迁保真度提高到 >99.99% 的途径，从而为量子多能级和单原子逻辑量子比特的高效、高保真控制提供一种工具。

articles.title: Fundamental Limits of Quantum Sensors for Gravitational Wave Detection
articles.title_zh: 用于引力波探测的量子传感器基本极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.06772v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent advances in quantum sensing---optical clocks, frequency-dependent squeezing below the standard quantum limit, and quantum magnetometers---raise a natural question: can these technologies detect gravitational waves directly, or enhance existing detectors? We show that the answer is set primarily by the emphcoupling mechanism between wave and sensor. From the tidal Hamiltonian in Fermi normal coordinates we identify three physically distinct mechanisms by which a gravitational wave couples directly to a quantum system, and derive their transducer gains within linearized general relativity and non-relativistic quantum mechanics. Internal atomic coupling yields a transducer gain G_A = 2.4× 10⁻²⁰, with vanishing first-order energy shifts for all J=0 clock states---a sim!10³⁵ deficit relative to laser interferometry. Center-of-mass (Doppler) coupling reaches strain sensitivities of sim!10⁻¹⁸, still 10⁴ above LISA requirements. Only light-propagation coupling provides the enormous transducer gain that makes laser and atom interferometry viable. For detectors of this third kind we quantify the quantum enhancement accessible through the noise architecture: LISA's noise budget is predominantly classical, capping the combined enhancement at Eapprox 1.04, while ground-based detectors in the shot-noise-dominated regime achieve E=1.6--2.1. Atom interferometers exploit the same mechanism to target the 0.01--10~Hz band.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究光钟、频率依赖压缩和量子磁强计等量子传感技术能否直接探测引力波或增强现有探测器。作者指出关键限制主要来自引力波与传感器的耦合机制，并区分了三类直接耦合方式及其换能增益。结果表明，只有光传播耦合能够提供足够大的增益，使激光和原子干涉测量可行；对 LISA 和地基探测器的量子增强幅度也受其噪声结构限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2603.06772v2，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：量子传感方面的近期进展——光钟、低于标准量子极限的频率依赖压缩，以及量子磁强计——引出了一个自然问题：这些技术能否直接探测引力波，或增强现有探测器？我们表明，答案主要由波与传感器之间的耦合机制决定。基于 Fermi 正规坐标中的潮汐哈密顿量，我们识别出引力波直接耦合到量子系统的三种物理上不同的机制，并在线性化广义相对论和非相对论量子力学内推导出它们的换能增益。内部原子耦合给出换能增益 G_A = 2.4×10⁻²⁰，并且所有 J=0 钟态的一阶能移均为零——相对于激光干涉测量存在约 10³⁵ 的缺口。质心（多普勒）耦合达到约 10⁻¹⁸ 的应变灵敏度，仍比 LISA 要求高 10⁴。只有光传播耦合提供了使激光和原子干涉测量可行的巨大换能增益。对于第三类探测器，我们量化了可通过噪声架构获得的量子增强：LISA 的噪声预算主要是经典的，将综合增强限制在 E 约为 1.04；而处于散粒噪声主导区间的地基探测器实现 E=1.6--2.1。原子干涉仪利用同一机制瞄准 0.01--10 Hz 频段。

articles.title: Compression-Driven Kinetic Instabilities in Magnetically Arrested Disks
articles.title_zh: 磁ically arrested disks 中由压缩驱动的动理学不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.08296v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Event horizon-scale observations of low-luminosity black hole accretion flows favor magnetically arrested disks, characterized by dynamically important magnetic fields (βłesssim1, where β is the ratio of plasma thermal pressure to magnetic pressure) and a two-temperature transrelativistic plasma. Motivated by plasma conditions in the synchrotron-emitting regions of these models, we perform 2D particle-in-cell simulations of electron-ion plasmas with a realistic mass ratio, subject to continuous compression perpendicular to the mean magnetic field boldsymbolB₀. Conservation of particle magnetic moments drives pressure anisotropy Pₚₑᵣₚ>Pₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ, triggering anisotropy-driven instabilities. For ion plasma beta βᵢ₀=0.5 and ion temperature kBTᵢ₀/mᵢ c²⁼⁰.05, the ion pressure anisotropy is regulated by the ion cyclotron instability, while the mirror mode influences the late-time electron anisotropy. Both species develop nonthermal components at high energies, consistent with stochastic acceleration by cyclotron-scale fluctuations. We characterize how the onset and time evolution of the plasma instabilities, as well as the resulting ion and electron anisotropies and energy spectra, vary with βᵢ₀, kBTᵢ₀/mᵢ c², electron-to-ion temperature ratio Tₑ₀/Tᵢ₀, and the compression rate. Increasing the thermal energy toward relativistic values raises the anisotropy thresholds for all instabilities observed in our simulations, allowing larger anisotropies to develop. For Tₑ₀/Tᵢ₀<1, as expected in collisionless two-temperature accretion flows, the growth of mirror and whistler instabilities is delayed or suppressed, leading to increasingly adiabatic evolution of the electrons. Our findings can be used to inform global fluid models of black hole accretion.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于事件视界尺度观测所支持的低光度黑洞吸积流模型，研究磁ically arrested disks 中压缩驱动的电子-离子等离子体动理学不稳定性。作者进行二维粒子模拟，考察垂直于平均磁场的连续压缩如何通过磁矩守恒产生压强各向异性并触发离子回旋、镜像和哨声等不稳定性。结果刻画了不同等离子体参数和压缩率下不稳定性的演化、各向异性与能谱，并可为黑洞吸积的全局流体模型提供依据。
authors: Vedant Dhruv, Lorenzo Sironi, Jordy Davelaar, Aaron Tran
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2603.08296v2，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：低光度黑洞吸积流的事件视界尺度观测倾向于支持磁ically arrested disks 模型，其特征是具有动力学上重要的磁场（β≲1，其中 β 是等离子体热压与磁压之比）以及双温度跨相对论等离子体。受这些模型中同步辐射发射区域的等离子体条件启发，我们对具有真实质量比的电子-离子等离子体进行了二维粒子模拟，使其经受垂直于平均磁场 B₀ 的连续压缩。粒子磁矩守恒驱动压强各向异性 P_⊥>P_∥，从而触发由各向异性驱动的不稳定性。对于离子等离子体 beta βᵢ₀₌₀.5 和离子温度 kBTᵢ₀/mᵢ c²=0.05，离子压强各向异性受到离子回旋不稳定性的调节，而镜像模影响后期电子各向异性。两个物种都在高能端形成非热成分，这与回旋尺度涨落导致的随机加速一致。我们刻画了等离子体不稳定性的起始和时间演化，以及所得离子和电子各向异性与能谱，如何随 βᵢ₀、kBTᵢ₀/mᵢ c²、电子-离子温度比 Tₑ₀/Tᵢ₀ 以及压缩率变化。将热能提高到接近相对论值会提高我们模拟中观察到的所有不稳定性的各向异性阈值，从而允许形成更大的各向异性。对于无碰撞双温度吸积流中预期的 Tₑ₀/Tᵢ₀<1，镜像和哨声不稳定性的增长被延迟或抑制，导致电子演化越来越接近绝热。我们的发现可用于指导黑洞吸积的全局流体模型。

articles.title: Non-uniform particle injection into black hole jets by radiative magnetic reconnection
articles.title_zh: 辐射磁重联导致黑洞喷流中的非均匀粒子注入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.01002v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Active galactic nuclei often exhibit highly collimated relativistic plasma outflows launched from the vicinity of their central black holes. One of the key theoretical challenges in understanding black hole jet formation is the origin of the plasma that feeds the jet, which remains poorly understood, particularly in explaining the observed jet emission. In this study, we focus on electron positron pair production generated by high energy photons from non axisymmetric magnetic reconnection near the black hole, as suggested by recent three dimensional general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics simulations. By employing general relativistic ray tracing, we calculate the spatial distribution of the pair production rate in the jet, taking into account photon propagation and collision angles in curved spacetime. We find that our scenario can naturally supply a sufficient amount of plasma to explain the observed radio emission from the M87 jet, even when photon anisotropy is considered. Furthermore, we show that a spinning black hole plays a crucial role in shaping the spartial dsitribution of the pairs, which in turn affects jet acceleration and very high energy emission from the jet base.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究黑洞附近非轴对称磁重联产生的高能光子如何通过电子—正电子对产生为黑洞喷流供给等离子体。作者采用广义相对论射线追踪，计算弯曲时空中考虑光子传播和碰撞角后的喷流内成对产生率空间分布。结果表明该机制可自然提供足够等离子体解释 M87 喷流射电辐射，并且自旋黑洞对粒子对的空间分布、喷流加速和喷流底部甚高能辐射具有重要影响。
authors: Rin Oikawa, Kenji Toma, Shigeo S. Kimura
articles.abstract_zh_full: 活动星系核常常表现出从其中心黑洞附近发射出的高度准直相对论等离子体外流。理解黑洞喷流形成的一个关键理论挑战是供给喷流的等离子体来源，这一点仍然认识不足，特别是在解释观测到的喷流辐射方面。在本研究中，我们关注由黑洞附近非轴对称磁重联产生的高能光子所引发的电子—正电子对产生，正如近期三维广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟所提示的那样。通过采用广义相对论射线追踪，我们在考虑弯曲时空中的光子传播和碰撞角的情况下，计算喷流中成对产生率的空间分布。我们发现，即使考虑光子各向异性，我们的情景也能够自然地供给足够数量的等离子体，以解释 M87 喷流观测到的射电辐射。此外，我们表明，自旋黑洞在塑造成对粒子的空间分布方面起关键作用，而这反过来会影响喷流加速以及来自喷流底部的甚高能辐射。

articles.title: Quantum-Structured World Models (QSWMs) for Predictive Latent Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于预测性潜在动力学的量子结构世界模型（QSWMs）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05371v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World models learn latent states that summarize interaction histories, evolve over time, and support prediction, simulation, or planning. Most existing world models represent these states using classical vectors, probability distributions, recurrent hidden states, or transformer activations. In this paper, we introduce Quantum-Structured World Models (QSWMs), a quantum-inspired framework for predictive world modeling with structured latent states, latent transition operators, and measurement-inspired decoding maps. We study whether mathematical structures inspired by quantum theory, such as complex-valued representations and density-matrix-like latents, provide useful inductive biases for world modeling. We establish three foundational properties: classical inclusion, predictive sufficiency, and structured compactness. We then instantiate complex-valued and density-matrix-like QSWM variants and evaluate them on elementary cellular automata against strong classical baselines. Results show promising local predictive potential for complex-valued QSWMs, while also revealing limitations in long-horizon rollout, density-matrix variants
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出量子结构世界模型（QSWMs），一种受量子理论启发的预测性世界建模框架，包含结构化潜在状态、潜在转移算子和受测量启发的解码映射。作者研究复值表示和类密度矩阵潜变量等量子数学结构是否能为世界建模提供有用归纳偏置，并建立经典包含性、预测充分性和结构紧致性三项基础性质。在基本元胞自动机上的实验显示复值 QSWMs 具有有前景的局部预测能力，同时也暴露出长时域展开和类密度矩阵变体的局限。
authors: Hailong Jiang, Emran Hossain, Feng Yu, Jianfeng Zhu, Guilin Zhang, Wulan Guo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 世界模型学习潜在状态，这些状态概括交互历史、随时间演化，并支持预测、模拟或规划。现有大多数世界模型使用经典向量、概率分布、循环隐藏状态或 transformer 激活来表示这些状态。本文中，我们引入量子结构世界模型（QSWMs），这是一个受量子启发的框架，用于具有结构化潜在状态、潜在转移算子和受测量启发的解码映射的预测性世界建模。我们研究受量子理论启发的数学结构，例如复值表示和类密度矩阵潜变量，是否为世界建模提供有用的归纳偏置。我们建立了三项基础性质：经典包含性、预测充分性和结构紧致性。随后，我们实例化复值和类密度矩阵 QSWM 变体，并在基本元胞自动机上将其与强经典基线进行评估。结果显示复值 QSWMs 具有有前景的局部预测潜力，同时也揭示了长时域展开和类密度矩阵变体方面的局限。

articles.title: IFlowNets: Extending Generative Samplers to Learn Strategies in Incomplete Information Games
articles.title_zh: IFlowNets：将生成式采样器扩展到不完全信息博弈中的策略学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05422v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While many algorithms blend reinforcement learning (RL) with counterfactual regret (CFR) methods to leverage tradeoffs in computational speed and performance, there are fewer investigations into generative sampling frameworks in game theoretic applications in incomplete information games. We extend a generative flow network framework, Adversarial Flow Networks (AFlowNets), to incomplete information games, called Information Flow Networks (IFNs). We prove that previously established constraints for generative flow networks in complete information games are inadmissible for obtaining valid densities (corresponding to player strategies) and a valid training objective. We show that our proposed generalization, IFlowNets, alleviates this issue and strictly generalizes AFlowNets. In preliminary results for three standard game environments, IFlowNets perform comparably to or better than Outcome Sampling Monte Carlo Counterfactual Regret (OSMCCFR) and standard RL-based methods in performance and speed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将生成流网络框架 Adversarial Flow Networks 扩展到不完全信息博弈，提出 Information Flow Networks（IFNs）及其实现 IFlowNets。作者证明，先前针对完全信息博弈的生成流网络约束不适用于获得有效密度和有效训练目标，而 IFlowNets 可以缓解这一问题并严格泛化 AFlowNets。在三个标准博弈环境的初步结果中，IFlowNets 在性能和速度上达到或优于 OSMCCFR 与常规强化学习方法。
authors: Conor M. Artman, Nicholas Di, Scott Perkins
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管许多算法将强化学习（RL）与反事实遗憾（CFR）方法结合起来，以利用计算速度和性能之间的权衡，但关于生成式采样框架在不完全信息博弈的博弈论应用中的研究较少。我们将一种生成流网络框架 Adversarial Flow Networks（AFlowNets）扩展到不完全信息博弈，称为 Information Flow Networks（IFNs）。我们证明，先前为完全信息博弈中的生成流网络建立的约束，对于获得有效密度（对应于玩家策略）和有效训练目标而言是不可采纳的。我们表明，我们提出的泛化 IFlowNets 缓解了这一问题，并严格泛化了 AFlowNets。在三个标准博弈环境的初步结果中，IFlowNets 在性能和速度上与 Outcome Sampling Monte Carlo Counterfactual Regret（OSMCCFR）以及标准基于 RL 的方法相当或更优。

articles.title: KV-Skill: Forging Expertise in the Model's Native Language
articles.title_zh: KV-Skill：以模型原生语言锻造专门能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05475v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Task knowledge is commonly stored either as text in the prompt or as an update to model weights. Text is modular but must be interpreted on every use, while weight adaptation makes the resulting capability difficult to load, remove, or share independently. We introduce KV-Skill, a design space of external factorized operators that a frozen language model reads through a lightweight interface. KV-Skill supports two complementary paths. Registration converts an authored text skill into a text-derived operator and trains a shared per-backbone interface. Reward learning develops a compact latent operator directly from task outcomes, with or without an authored skill. Neither path adds positions to the prompt. Across ten benchmarks and four backbones from three model families, converting text to a KV-Skill consistently makes the same procedural knowledge more effective. On Qwen3.5-4B LiveMath, registration reaches 77.2 accuracy, compared with 23.4 for the source text skill, 52.0 for SkillOpt, and 64.5 for SoftSkill. Under matched reward training and parameter budgets, KV-Skill gives the best result in seven of eight matched settings against soft prefixes, prefix tuning, and LoRA. A post-hoc rank analysis further shows that text-derived operators retain nearly all of their benefit with one task-aligned direction per injection layer, while matched random directions fail. Finally, one shared interface retains three independently loadable KV-Skills without measurable forgetting. These results show that task knowledge can be acquired from text or experience, compressed into an external operator, and deployed separately from the backbone. Code is available at: https://github.com/shawnzhg/KV-Skill
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 KV-Skill，一种外部因子化算子设计空间，使冻结语言模型可通过轻量接口读取任务知识，从而避免将知识仅存为提示文本或权重更新的局限。KV-Skill 支持从人工编写文本技能注册为文本派生算子，也支持通过奖励学习从任务结果直接发展紧凑潜在算子，且不会增加提示位置。跨十个基准和四个骨干模型的实验表明，KV-Skill 能更有效地部署程序性知识，并支持多个可独立加载技能共存而无明显遗忘。
authors: Zhaowei Han, Xiang Zhang, Bing Han, Kai Liu, Danqi Hu, Jie Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 任务知识通常要么以文本形式存储在提示中，要么作为模型权重的更新来存储。文本具有模块化特性，但每次使用时都必须被解释；而权重适配则使所得能力难以独立加载、移除或共享。我们引入 KV-Skill，这是一个外部因子化算子的设计空间，冻结的语言模型通过轻量接口读取它。KV-Skill 支持两条互补路径。注册将人工编写的文本技能转换为文本派生算子，并训练一个按骨干模型共享的接口。奖励学习则直接从任务结果中发展紧凑潜在算子，可以有或没有人工编写的技能。两条路径都不会向提示中添加位置。跨十个基准以及来自三个模型家族的四个骨干模型，将文本转换为 KV-Skill 始终使相同的程序性知识更加有效。在 Qwen3.5-4B LiveMath 上，注册达到 77.2 的准确率，而源文本技能为 23.4，SkillOpt 为 52.0，SoftSkill 为 64.5。在匹配奖励训练和参数预算下，与软前缀、前缀调优和 LoRA 相比，KV-Skill 在八个匹配设置中的七个取得最佳结果。事后秩分析进一步表明，文本派生算子在每个注入层仅使用一个任务对齐方向时仍保留几乎全部收益，而匹配的随机方向则失败。最后，一个共享接口可以保留三个可独立加载的 KV-Skills，且没有可测量的遗忘。这些结果表明，任务知识可以从文本或经验中获得，被压缩为外部算子，并与骨干模型分离部署。代码已公开。

articles.title: Equipment-centric workpiece localization in near real-time using deep learning-based vision and event-driven finite state machines
articles.title_zh: 基于深度学习视觉与事件驱动有限状态机的近实时设备中心化工件定位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous workpiece localization is essential for traceability and process coordination in hot forging, but direct tracking is unreliable because of extreme temperatures, surface degradation, and irregular routing. This study presents an equipment-centric framework that infers workpiece locations from handling equipment observed by multiple static 2D cameras. The framework estimates floorplan-space 3D equipment coordinates and recognizes grasp and release activities. Event-driven finite state machines validate these activities as discrete handling events and continuously update workpiece states and locations. A keypoint-guided attention mechanism integrated into a 3D convolutional neural network improves activity recognition by focusing on functionally relevant equipment regions. Evaluation in an operational hot forging factory achieved 100% event detection accuracy within a 33-second tolerance window, a mean localization error of 317.8 mm, and a mean system latency of 21 seconds. The framework connects vision-based perception with interpretable event-driven reasoning and supports visualization of workpiece transfers and quantitative analysis of equipment operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向热锻过程中的可追溯性与工艺协调，提出一种以搬运设备为中心的工件定位框架，用多台静态二维相机观测设备而非直接跟踪工件。框架估计设备在平面布局空间中的三维坐标，识别抓取与释放动作，并通过事件驱动有限状态机更新工件状态和位置。工厂评估表明，该方法在33秒容差窗口内达到100%事件检测准确率，平均定位误差为317.8毫米，平均系统延迟为21秒。
authors: Dohyeon Kong, Jaebong Cho, Hyunbo Cho
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在热锻中，连续工件定位对于可追溯性和工艺协调至关重要，但由于极端温度、表面退化和不规则路径，直接跟踪并不可靠。本研究提出了一种以设备为中心的框架，通过多台静态二维相机观测搬运设备来推断工件位置。该框架估计平面布局空间中的三维设备坐标，并识别抓取和释放活动。事件驱动有限状态机将这些活动验证为离散搬运事件，并持续更新工件状态和位置。集成到三维卷积神经网络中的关键点引导注意力机制通过聚焦于功能相关的设备区域，提高了活动识别效果。在一家运行中的热锻工厂进行的评估在33秒容差窗口内实现了100%的事件检测准确率，平均定位误差为317.8毫米，平均系统延迟为21秒。该框架将基于视觉的感知与可解释的事件驱动推理连接起来，并支持工件转移的可视化以及设备操作的定量分析。

articles.title: Neuro-Symbolic Closed-Loop Control of Laser Powder Bed Fusion with an In-Loop Ontology
articles.title_zh: 带有环内本体的激光粉末床熔融神经符号闭环控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A geometry-conditioned, neuro-symbolic closed-loop architecture is proposed for laser powder bed fusion, in which a standards-aligned ontology operates inside the control loop and couples symbolic reasoning with statistical learning to set the targets of a constraint-aware predictive controller. The ontology links the process objectives and constraints to the signals a controller can observe, and a description-logic reasoner converts them into the references and bounds enforced on each scan. The demonstrated case is overhang dross, a quality limit on the melt pool depth, which governs quality yet cannot be measured during the build, is mapped through a geometry- and power-dependent depth-to-width ratio onto a bound on the observable width, with the ratio and its calibrated uncertainty supplied by a Gaussian process. The reasoner classifies each upcoming feature and selects the active constraints-adding a lack-of-fusion floor at overhangs, a monotone guard beyond the calibrated range, and an energy-density cap where a process window is declared while running only on changes of geometric context and otherwise leaving a single small quadratic program on the per-scan path. In an Eagar-Tsai surrogate calibrated to the NIST AM-Bench benchmark for IN625, the architecture eliminates the dross produced by a geometry-blind controller, holds dross at zero with only a small residual lack-of-fusion under dual scoring, degrades gracefully under deliberate plant mismatch, and retargets to new alloys and constraints by editing ontology data rather than code. The results establish architectural feasibility, experimental calibration of the ratio is the principal next step.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向激光粉末床熔融的几何条件化神经符号闭环架构，将与标准对齐的本体置于控制回路内部，以耦合符号推理和统计学习。该方法把不可在线测量的悬垂熔渣质量约束映射为可观测熔池宽度约束，并由高斯过程提供深宽比及不确定性。基于IN625的NIST AM-Bench校准代理模型结果显示，该架构可消除几何盲控制器产生的熔渣，并能通过编辑本体数据而非代码适配新合金和约束。
authors: Gisuk Hong, Jaebong Cho, Hyunbo Cho
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种面向激光粉末床熔融的几何条件化神经符号闭环架构，其中一个与标准对齐的本体在控制回路内部运行，并将符号推理与统计学习相耦合，以设定约束感知预测控制器的目标。本体将工艺目标和约束与控制器可观测的信号相连接，而描述逻辑推理器将其转换为在每次扫描中强制执行的参考值和边界。所展示的案例是悬垂熔渣，即对熔池深度的质量限制；该限制支配质量但在构建过程中无法测量，它通过依赖几何和功率的深宽比被映射到可观测宽度的边界上，而该比值及其经校准的不确定性由高斯过程提供。推理器对每个即将到来的特征进行分类并选择活动约束——在悬垂处加入未熔合下限，在超出校准范围时加入单调保护，并在声明工艺窗口处加入能量密度上限；同时它仅在几何上下文发生变化时运行，否则在每条扫描路径上只留下一个小型二次规划问题。在针对IN625并校准到NIST AM-Bench基准的Eagar-Tsai代理模型中，该架构消除了几何盲控制器产生的熔渣，在双重评分下使熔渣保持为零且仅有少量残余未熔合，在有意设置的被控对象失配下表现出平缓退化，并通过编辑本体数据而非代码重新定位到新合金和新约束。结果确立了该架构的可行性，而该比值的实验校准是下一步的主要工作。

articles.title: Learning to Rank Tensor Network Contraction Plans for GPU-Accelerated Quantum Circuit Simulation
articles.title_zh: 面向GPU加速量子线路模拟的张量网络收缩方案学习排序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05819v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical simulation remains essential for developing and validating quantum algorithms, but its cost grows rapidly with circuit size. Tensor-network contraction can reduce this cost by exploiting circuit structure, although its efficiency depends strongly on the chosen contraction plan. On GPUs, plans with similar theoretical complexity may perform very differently because execution also depends on parallelism, reduction structure, memory traffic, and contraction geometry. We present a learning-to-rank framework for selecting efficient contraction plans before executing them. Each plan is represented by structural features derived directly from its sequence of pairwise contractions, and gradient-boosted rankers are trained from GPU measurements using listwise and pairwise objectives. We evaluate the resulting models on diverse circuit families, using separate in-distribution and circuit-family-shift test sets, and compare them with random and MinFill-based baselines. The learned rankers generally identify better plans, with the listwise model providing the strongest overall decision quality. We also study backend shift by comparing empirical plan orderings on two GPU architectures and evaluating the source-trained models on the second device without retraining. The rankings remain substantially, though not perfectly, stable across GPUs, and the models retain useful decision quality. These results support Learning to Rank as a practical way to reduce contraction-plan search, while showing that performance remains partly backend dependent.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种学习排序框架，用于在执行前选择高效的张量网络收缩方案，以降低量子线路经典模拟成本。每个方案由其两两收缩序列中的结构特征表示，并使用GPU实测数据训练梯度提升排序器。实验表明，学习排序器通常能找到更优方案，其中列表式模型整体决策质量最佳；跨GPU后端时排序虽不完全稳定，但仍保持有用的决策能力。
authors: Alfred M. Pastor, Maribel Castillo, Jose M. Badia
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典模拟对于开发和验证量子算法仍然至关重要，但其成本随线路规模迅速增长。张量网络收缩可以通过利用线路结构来降低这一成本，尽管其效率强烈依赖于所选择的收缩方案。在GPU上，理论复杂度相近的方案可能表现非常不同，因为执行还取决于并行性、归约结构、内存流量和收缩几何。我们提出了一种学习排序框架，用于在执行收缩方案之前选择高效方案。每个方案由直接从其两两收缩序列中导出的结构特征表示，并使用列表式和成对式目标、基于GPU测量结果训练梯度提升排序器。我们在多样化的线路族上评估所得模型，使用分布内测试集和线路族迁移测试集，并将其与随机基线和基于MinFill的基线进行比较。学习得到的排序器通常能够识别更好的方案，其中列表式模型提供了最强的总体决策质量。我们还通过比较两种GPU架构上的经验方案排序，并在第二个设备上不经重新训练评估源设备训练的模型，研究了后端迁移。跨GPU的排序在很大程度上保持稳定，尽管并不完美，且模型保留了有用的决策质量。这些结果支持将学习排序作为减少收缩方案搜索的一种实用途径，同时表明性能仍在一定程度上依赖后端。

articles.title: Alternating Levenberg-Marquardt Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Fourier-Enhanced Features
articles.title_zh: 具有傅里叶增强特征的物理信息神经网络交替Levenberg-Marquardt训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often fail to accurately resolve partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-frequency or multi-scale solutions, as well as strongly nonlinear problems. Two factors underlie this difficulty: spectral bias, the tendency of neural networks to underfit high-frequency features; and representation-coefficient coupling, the entanglement of representation learning and coefficient fitting within a single nonconvex optimization objective. In this work, we propose the Fourier-enhanced alternating Levenberg--Marquardt PINN (FALM-PINN), an optimization framework that decouples representation learning from coefficient fitting. The upper-level problem learns a Fourier-enhanced basis that enriches the latent space with high-frequency components, while the lower-level problem resolves the coupling by fitting the projection coefficients on this basis, solving a nonlinear least-squares problem with the Levenberg--Marquardt algorithm. The framework applies to general nonlinear and coupled PDE systems, and reduces to a single-step convex optimization problem for linear PDEs. We prove global convergence of the alternating training scheme in both cases. Numerical examples on multiple challenging high-frequency and nonlinear PDEs show that FALM-PINN achieves relative L² errors up to two orders of magnitude lower than state-of-the-art baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出FALM-PINN优化框架，旨在缓解PINN在高频、多尺度和强非线性偏微分方程上的求解困难。该方法将表示学习与系数拟合解耦，上层学习傅里叶增强基，下层用Levenberg-Marquardt算法拟合投影系数。作者证明了交替训练在相关情形下的全局收敛性，数值实验显示其相对L²误差可比先进基线低最多两个数量级。
authors: Yulun Wu, Matthieu Barreau, Miguel Aguiar, Karl H. Johansson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）在准确解析具有高频或多尺度解以及强非线性问题的偏微分方程（PDE）时常常失败。这一困难源于两个因素：谱偏置，即神经网络倾向于欠拟合高频特征；以及表示—系数耦合，即表示学习和系数拟合在同一个非凸优化目标中相互纠缠。在本文中，我们提出了傅里叶增强交替Levenberg--Marquardt PINN（FALM-PINN），这是一种将表示学习与系数拟合解耦的优化框架。上层问题学习一个傅里叶增强基，通过高频分量丰富潜在空间，而下层问题通过在该基上拟合投影系数来解除耦合，并使用Levenberg--Marquardt算法求解非线性最小二乘问题。该框架适用于一般的非线性和耦合PDE系统，并且对于线性PDE可化简为单步凸优化问题。我们证明了交替训练方案在两种情况下的全局收敛性。在多个具有挑战性的高频和非线性PDE上的数值示例表明，FALM-PINN取得的相对L²误差最高比最先进基线低两个数量级。

articles.title: Hybrid-Adaptive Thread Tuning to Mitigate Simulation Execution Bottlenecks in High-Performance Reinforcement Learning Inference
articles.title_zh: 用于缓解高性能强化学习推理中仿真执行瓶颈的混合自适应线程调优
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In simulation-in-the-loop decision-making systems, reinforcement learning (RL) inference is often constrained by simulator-side execution overhead, where workloads are highly dynamic and sensitive to runtime thread configurations. Existing multithreaded strategies struggle to match thread resources before or during execution, causing resource contention, scheduling overhead, and reduced throughput. Through empirical analysis, we identify the ratio of task execution time to scheduling time as the key factor determining the optimal thread count. Building on this insight, we propose AutoThread, a hybrid adaptive thread-tuning method for mitigating simulation bottlenecks in RL inference. AutoThread employs a Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) as a thread-count predictor and incorporates a finite-source M/M/1 queueing model to constrain and guide prediction, enabling fast and accurate estimation under dynamic workloads. It further performs load-aware online fine-tuning to compensate for prediction errors and refine resource allocation. Experiments show that AutoThread improves average speedup by 18.4% over static strategies, achieves average throughput of 1.7x and 1.8x that of XGBoost and Reinforcer, respectively, and reduces execution time by up to 83.8% compared with state-of-the-art methods. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/suchenjm/AutoThread.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对仿真在环决策系统中强化学习推理受仿真器执行开销限制的问题，提出混合自适应线程调优方法AutoThread。该方法利用物理信息神经算子预测线程数，并结合有限源M/M/1排队模型约束和指导预测，同时进行负载感知在线微调。实验显示，AutoThread相较静态策略平均加速提升18.4%，吞吐量优于XGBoost和Reinforcer，并相较先进方法最多减少83.8%的执行时间。
authors: Jiming Su, Hantao Hua, Lujia Yin, Yiping Yao, Feng Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在仿真在环决策系统中，强化学习（RL）推理常常受到仿真器侧执行开销的限制，其中工作负载高度动态，并且对运行时线程配置敏感。现有多线程策略难以在执行前或执行期间匹配线程资源，导致资源争用、调度开销和吞吐量下降。通过实证分析，我们确定任务执行时间与调度时间之比是决定最优线程数的关键因素。基于这一认识，我们提出了AutoThread，一种用于缓解RL推理中仿真瓶颈的混合自适应线程调优方法。AutoThread采用物理信息神经算子（PINO）作为线程数预测器，并结合有限源M/M/1排队模型来约束和指导预测，从而在动态工作负载下实现快速且准确的估计。它进一步执行负载感知在线微调，以补偿预测误差并细化资源分配。实验表明，与静态策略相比，AutoThread将平均加速比提高了18.4%，其平均吞吐量分别达到XGBoost和Reinforcer的1.7倍和1.8倍，并且与最先进方法相比最多减少83.8%的执行时间。我们的代码和数据集已公开可用。

articles.title: SCP-NL2TL: Selective Conformal Prediction with Semantic Verification for Natural Language to Temporal Logic Specifications
articles.title_zh: SCP-NL2TL：面向自然语言到时序逻辑规约的带语义验证选择性保形预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05439v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Translating natural language instructions into machine-interpretable formal specifications enables robots and autonomous systems to plan, reason, and formally verify their behavior. However, existing translation models typically generate a specification for every input, even when the result is unreliable or fails to capture the user's intent, creating risks in safety-critical applications. Inspired by selective conformal prediction, we propose a selective translation framework that not only generates formal specifications but also determines when they can be trusted. Reliability is scored by two complementary black-box signals, the fidelity of the specification back-translated into natural language and the dispersion of repeated translations under exact semantic equivalence, which fail on different errors and jointly separate incorrect translations more sharply than either alone. Conformal risk control calibrates this score into a decision that accepts a specification or abstains, with a distribution-free bound on the rate at which incorrect specifications are accepted for execution, and a conformal anomaly detector on instruction embeddings screens out-of-distribution inputs before any translation is attempted. The proposed framework is general across formal specification languages, with experiments on Signal Temporal Logic (STL), Linear Temporal Logic (LTL), and geometric Spatio-Temporal Logic (SpaTiaL) demonstrating improved translation reliability, robustness under the evaluated cross-tier shifts, and effective uncertainty-aware abstention. This work establishes a foundation for trustworthy natural language interfaces by enabling AI systems to recognize when generated specifications may not be reliable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种选择性翻译框架，用于将自然语言指令转换为形式规约，并判断生成结果是否可信。框架利用回译保真度和语义等价重复翻译的离散度作为互补黑箱可靠性信号，并通过保形风险控制决定接受或拒绝执行。实验覆盖STL、LTL和SpaTiaL，显示该方法提高了翻译可靠性、跨层级迁移鲁棒性和不确定性感知拒答能力。
authors: Yixuan Wang, Licheng Luo, Yu Fu, Kaidi Xu, Yue Dong, Mingyu Cai
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将自然语言指令翻译为机器可解释的形式规约，使机器人和自主系统能够规划、推理并形式化验证其行为。然而，现有翻译模型通常会为每个输入生成一个规约，即使结果不可靠或未能捕捉用户意图也是如此，这在安全关键应用中会带来风险。受选择性保形预测启发，我们提出一种选择性翻译框架，它不仅生成形式规约，还判断何时可以信任这些规约。可靠性由两个互补的黑箱信号评分，即规约回译为自然语言后的保真度，以及在精确语义等价下重复翻译的离散度；这两个信号会在不同错误上失效，并且联合起来比任一单独信号都能更清晰地区分错误翻译。保形风险控制将该评分校准为接受规约或拒绝的决策，并对被接受执行的错误规约比例给出分布无关的界限；同时，针对指令嵌入的保形异常检测器会在尝试任何翻译之前筛除分布外输入。所提出的框架可推广到多种形式规约语言，在信号时序逻辑（STL）、线性时序逻辑（LTL）和几何时空逻辑（SpaTiaL）上的实验表明，它提高了翻译可靠性、在所评估跨层级迁移下的鲁棒性，以及有效的不确定性感知拒答能力。该工作通过使AI系统能够识别所生成规约何时可能不可靠，为可信自然语言接口奠定了基础。

articles.title: LILAC: An Idempotent Neural Speech Codec
articles.title_zh: LILAC：一种幂等神经语音编解码器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05727v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural Audio Codecs are widely adopted in speech generation and editing. However, existing neural audio codecs are not idempotent: across the paper's twelve baseline systems, every configuration tested rewrites, on average, at least 15% of its tokens in a single decode-re-encode pass. This poses a problem for utilizing Neural Audio Codecs as token interfaces in pipelines where re-encoding decoded outputs can occur. We present LILAC, a fully convolutional 24 kHz speech codec at 9.375 Hz and 0.75 kbit/s that is codec idempotent by construction; re-encoding the decoded audio of any valid token stream returns the identical stream. LILAC achieves idempotency while maintaining competitive quality, reaching UTMOS 4.14 and 4.24 on LibriSpeech and LibriTTS-R test sets, comparable to SOTA sub-1 kbit/s Neural Audio Codecs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出现有神经音频编解码器通常不具备幂等性，在解码后再编码时会改写相当比例的标记，从而影响将其作为语音生成与编辑管线中标记接口的可靠性。作者提出LILAC，一种全卷积24 kHz语音编解码器，在9.375 Hz和0.75 kbit/s下按构造保证编解码幂等。LILAC在保持幂等性的同时取得了具有竞争力的语音质量，UTMOS结果可与低于1 kbit/s的先进神经音频编解码器相当。
authors: June Young Yi, Dongwook Lee, Jiheum Yeom, Sungroh Yoon
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经音频编解码器被广泛用于语音生成和编辑。然而，现有神经音频编解码器并非幂等：在论文的十二个基线系统中，所测试的每一种配置在一次解码—再编码过程中平均至少会改写其15%的标记。这对在可能发生对解码输出再编码的流程中将神经音频编解码器用作标记接口构成了问题。我们提出LILAC，这是一种全卷积的24 kHz语音编解码器，工作在9.375 Hz和0.75 kbit/s，并且按构造具有编解码器幂等性；对任何有效标记流的解码音频进行再编码都会返回完全相同的标记流。LILAC在保持幂等性的同时维持了具有竞争力的质量，在LibriSpeech和LibriTTS-R测试集上分别达到UTMOS 4.14和4.24，可与最先进的低于1 kbit/s神经音频编解码器相媲美。

articles.title: Robot Learning from Human Demonstrations: Handwritten Alphabet Trajectories and Human-Likeness Evaluation
articles.title_zh: 机器人从人类示范中学习：手写字母轨迹与类人性评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06221v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning from demonstration (LfD) provides a developmental framework through which robots can develop motor skills by observing and imitating human dynamics, reducing reliance on explicit programming to teach a skill to a robot. The resulting human-like robot motion is recognised as a key factor in building trust and enabling natural collaboration in human-robot interaction. This paper presents a framework for learning human-like robot motion from demonstration, including data collection, probabilistic trajectory learning, and perceptual user evaluation. A dataset of 3,142 handwriting demonstrations was collected from 22 participants across all 52 Latin alphabet character-case combinations via a touchscreen teleoperation interface, capturing planar position, contact force, and timing. Building on the widely used Gaussian Mixture Model and Gaussian Mixture Regression approach for learning from demonstration, the framework is extended in this work by incorporating force and normalised time dimensions to enable richer representation of human dynamics, and adapting it to handle non-continuous, multi-segment trajectories, enabling generalisation across demonstrations.
