articles.abstract_zh_full: 多重 Q 磁有序将连续自旋旋转与同平移和点群变换相关的离散晶体扇区结合起来，产生了比传统单 Q 磁体更丰富的缺陷结构。我们在具有 (V₄×D₃)×O(N) 对称性的 M 点 triple-Q Ginzburg–Landau 理论中，对 N=2 和 3 的全部七种稳定相的体缺陷进行分类，其中 V₄ 是由平移生成的 Klein 四元群。原子晶格被视为一个预先给定的背景，排除晶格位错和位向错，并且三个 Fourier 场保留其物理 M 点标记。与恒等元连续相连的母群变换构成 G₀=e×SO(N)。对于参考态稳定子 H，包含参考态的连通分支是 G₀/(H∩G₀)，而不是通过将 H 投影到自旋空间所得到的商空间。这一区别使正交 triple-Q 相具有完整流形 O(3)，并产生手性畴壁和 Abel 型 Z₂ 标架涡旋，而不是非 Abel 型二元多面体涡旋。O(2) 相的每一个连通分支都支持一个整数 2π 涡旋，而分数绕转只有在附着于离散畴壁时才能闭合，并且在非零畴壁张力下受到线性禁闭。平移对称性进一步禁止交叉梯度双线性项，将二次弹性部分约化为一种各向同性刚度和一种锁定于 M 点的各向异性刚度。该分类区分了 triple-Q 磁体中的自由内部缺陷、晶体畴壁和壁束缚复合缺陷。

articles.title: Diodes and capacitors for the transport of monopoles in fragmented spin ice
articles.title_zh: 碎片化自旋冰中用于磁单极子输运的二极管与电容器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-ice materials are famous for their quasi-particle excitations that behave like magnetic monopoles. Magnetricity is the concept that these monopoles can conduct an AC magnetic current, in analogy with conduction electrons. While monopole dynamics has been intensively studied and is reasonably well understood, very little has been done to design devices in order to control magnetricity. Here we develop a theoretical proof of concept for the design of diodes and capacitors for the transport of monopoles. We use the property of systems with magnetic fragmentation, where spin-ice physics co-exists with long-range antiferromagnetic order. The key point is that magnetic order allows for the existence of domain walls. Under certain conditions of preparation, this domain wall is equivalent to an asymmetric filter for monopoles. In a given direction, positive charges can go through while negative ones are repelled; the opposite applies in the opposite direction. This asymmetry effectively functions like a diode for monopole current. Successive domain walls separate positive from negative charges with a vacuum of charge in between, producing a capacitor for monopoles. Once the capacitor is charged, it can in principle be used as a battery for monopoles. All microscopic mechanisms are explained and our proof of concept is validated by simulations of more than a million spins. Application to experiments are discussed for rare-earth pyrochlore oxides and artificial spin ice. Finally, we discuss in general terms how a domain wall in fragmented spin ice can also be seen as an emergent boundary separating two mirror "worlds" separated by time-reversal symmetry. Beyond spin ice, our work opens a promising direction of investigation for the dynamics of emergent quasi-particles crossing domain walls in chiral and nematic spin liquids, which also possess a broken symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出利用磁碎片化自旋冰中的畴壁来控制磁单极子输运的理论概念。特定制备条件下，畴壁可作为对正负单极子不对称的过滤器，从而实现类似二极管的单极子电流整流；连续畴壁还能分离正负电荷并形成单极子电容器。大规模模拟验证了该构想，并讨论了在稀土烧绿石氧化物和人工自旋冰中的实验可能性。
authors: Anoop Raj, Sumiran Pujari, Ludovic D. C. Jaubert
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋冰材料因其表现得像磁单极子的准粒子激发而闻名。磁电流学是这样一种概念：这些单极子可以传导交流磁电流，类似于导电电子。虽然单极子动力学已被深入研究并得到相当好的理解，但在设计器件以控制磁电流方面所做的工作很少。在这里，我们发展了一个用于设计单极子输运二极管和电容器的理论概念验证。我们利用具有磁碎片化的体系性质，在这类体系中，自旋冰物理与长程反铁磁有序共存。关键点在于，磁有序允许畴壁存在。在某些制备条件下，该畴壁等价于一个针对单极子的不对称过滤器。在给定方向上，正电荷可以通过，而负电荷被排斥；在相反方向上则相反。这种不对称性实际上起到单极子电流二极管的作用。连续的畴壁将正电荷与负电荷分开，中间形成无电荷真空，从而产生单极子电容器。一旦电容器被充电，原则上就可以用作单极子的电池。文中解释了所有微观机制，并通过超过一百万个自旋的模拟验证了我们的概念验证。我们讨论了其在稀土烧绿石氧化物和人工自旋冰实验中的应用。最后，我们从一般角度讨论了碎片化自旋冰中的畴壁也可被视为一条涌现边界，它分隔由时间反演对称性区分开的两个镜像“世界”。除自旋冰之外，我们的工作为研究穿越畴壁的涌现准粒子动力学开辟了一个有前景的方向，这同样适用于也具有破缺对称性的手性和向列自旋液体。

articles.title: Microscopic magnetic phase evolution in the Weyl semimetal Mn₃Sn revealed by μ⁺SR
articles.title_zh: μ⁺SR 揭示 Weyl 半金属 Mn₃Sn 中的微观磁相演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a comprehensive muon spin relaxation (μ⁺SR) and bulk magnetization study of the antiferromagnetic (AFM) Weyl semimetal Mn₃Sn (composition Mn₂.₉₉Sn). Mn₃Sn is reported to exhibit a commensurate inverse triangular (IT) AFM phase, an incommensurate (IC) helical AFM phase, and a proposed low-temperature spin-glass-like state. In our sample, we establish the respective transition temperatures for these phases to be T_N = 418 K, Tₜ approx 275 K, and T_f = 21 K. Investigating the low-temperature regime below T_f, we find no evidence of a static spin-glass state. Instead, the sample exhibits an increasing ferromagnetic (FM) component accompanied by a localized slowing of spin fluctuations, indicating that these phenomena may be decoupled. In the IC helical AFM phase, fitting the zero-field (ZF) spectra reveals an asymmetric internal magnetic-field distribution, indicating that the magnetic structure is heavily modified by anharmonicity. Upon warming above 150 K, a continuous redistribution of muon spectral weight reveals a broad regime of coexisting local magnetic environments associated with the IC helical and IT-AFM phases. In the commensurate IT-AFM phase above Tₜ, a persistent missing fraction in the initial asymmetry indicates that a subset of implanted muons, corresponding to roughly 20% of the sample-related asymmetry, undergoes unresolved ultrafast depolarization. Finally, we observe temperature-driven shifts in muon site populations above 325 K. Ultimately, our results show a highly dynamic magnetic landscape in Mn₃Sn, demonstrating how its complex magnetic orders often coexist and evolve continuously with temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对反铁磁 Weyl 半金属 Mn₃Sn 进行了 μ⁺SR 和体磁化综合研究，确定了样品中反三角、非公度螺旋及低温异常相关转变温度。研究未发现低温静态自旋玻璃证据，而是观察到铁磁分量增强和局域自旋涨落变慢。μ⁺SR 结果显示 Mn₃Sn 的磁结构高度动态，不同局域磁环境常随温度连续共存和演化。
authors: U. Miniotaite, O. K. Forslund, H. Luetkens, V. Rai, J. Persson, G. D. Morris, D. Zuhair, D. W. Tam, S. Nandi, Y. Sassa, M. Månsson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了对反铁磁（AFM）Weyl 半金属 Mn₃Sn（组成为 Mn₂.₉₉Sn）的全面 μ⁺SR 和体磁化研究。据报道，Mn₃Sn 表现出公度反三角（IT）反铁磁相、非公度（IC）螺旋反铁磁相以及一个被提出的低温类自旋玻璃态。在我们的样品中，我们确定这些相各自的转变温度为 T_N=418 K、Tₜ≈275 K 和 T_f=21 K。通过研究 T_f 以下的低温区域，我们没有发现静态自旋玻璃态的证据。相反，样品表现出不断增强的铁磁（FM）分量，并伴随局域自旋涨落变慢，表明这些现象可能是解耦的。在 IC 螺旋 AFM 相中，对零场（ZF）谱的拟合揭示出不对称的内部磁场分布，表明磁结构受到非谐性的强烈修饰。在升温至 150 K 以上时，μ 子谱权重的连续重新分布揭示出一个宽广的局域磁环境共存区域，这些环境与 IC 螺旋相和 IT-AFM 相相关。在 Tₜ 以上的公度 IT-AFM 相中，初始不对称性中持续存在的缺失部分表明，一部分植入 μ 子发生了无法分辨的超快退极化，其对应于约 20% 的样品相关不对称性。最后，我们在 325 K 以上观察到温度驱动的 μ 子位点布居变化。最终，我们的结果显示 Mn₃Sn 中存在高度动态的磁性景观，证明其复杂磁有序常常共存并随温度连续演化。

articles.title: Wannier-Stark localization, confinement and edge states
articles.title_zh: Wannier-Stark 局域化、限域与边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01902v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The boundary between a system's bulk and the vacuum can be modeled by a potential which confines the electrons to the bulk. Here we present the example of the Wannier-Stark linear potential, generated by an electric field along one axis of a two-dimensional lattice. Along that axis, the potential generates electronic states which are localized around each lattice site, with eigenenergies which form the Wannier-Stark ladder. In the transverse direction, the states are governed by a tight binding model with free Bloch states. In the ground state, filling these states under the Pauli principle generates an insulating bulk and an edge which can be metallic in the transverse direction. This paper explains the concepts of localization, localization length, filling and confinement. The paper also acquaints the readers with the use of Bessel functions in the solution of a simple physical model. These topics can be easily included in courses on solid state physics, and only require prior knowledge of quantum mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以二维晶格中由沿一轴电场产生的 Wannier-Stark 线性势为例，解释体-真空边界如何通过限域势建模。沿电场方向电子态局域并形成 Wannier-Stark 梯，而横向仍由紧束缚 Bloch 态描述；按 Pauli 原理填充后可形成绝缘体体相和横向金属性边缘。文章兼具教学性质，介绍局域化、局域长度、填充、限域及 Bessel 函数在简单模型中的应用。
authors: N. Aucar Boidi, A. Aharony, O. Entin-Wohlman, C. Proetto
articles.abstract_zh_full: 系统体相与真空之间的边界可以用一个将电子限制在体相中的势来建模。这里我们给出 Wannier-Stark 线性势的例子，该势由二维晶格中沿一个轴向的电场产生。沿该轴向，该势产生围绕每个晶格位点局域的电子态，其本征能量形成 Wannier-Stark 梯。在横向方向上，这些态由具有自由 Bloch 态的紧束缚模型支配。在基态中，按照 Pauli 原理填充这些态会产生绝缘体体相以及在横向方向上可能呈金属性的边缘。本文解释了局域化、局域长度、填充和限域等概念。本文还使读者熟悉在求解一个简单物理模型时 Bessel 函数的使用。这些主题可以很容易地纳入固体物理课程，并且只需要预先具备量子力学知识。

articles.title: Machine Learning Assisted Design of Complex and High Entropy Alloys by Hybrid HiPIMS/Pulsed-DC PVD Process for Low Carbon Energy Applications in Extreme Environments
articles.title_zh: 面向极端环境低碳能源应用的混合 HiPIMS/脉冲直流 PVD 工艺中机器学习辅助复杂合金与高熵合金设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Complex and high entropy alloys are attracting much attention currently thanks to their mechanical and corrosion resistance properties in harsh environments, in particular needed for carbon-free energy applications. However, their elaboration in bulk and in thin film form in a trial-and-error approach is impractical due to their complexity and the cocktail effect. The recent development of artificial intelligence brings a new possibility for their elaboration and adjustment of their properties. Firstly, we present an overview of Materials and data science research. Then we describe how DIADEM - French initiative for Materials and Data science convergence - tackles the development of innovative coatings for carbon-free energy applications (nuclear, high temperature electrolysis, ...) thanks to the development of a nationwide network of synthesis and characterization platforms - the DIADEM discovery hub. We describe in particular DIADEM-2D, an AI-driven Hybrid HiPIMS/Pulsed-DC PVD process using 4 cathodes in confocal combinatorial configuration. We present the high entropy alloy determination using data from the literature for corrosion resistance in molten salt media and nuclear accidental conditions. An element-independent model gathering deposition parameters and coating properties has been implemented allowing the design of protective coatings with a particular composition. We demonstrate the feasibility of this process and its accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍利用人工智能和混合 HiPIMS/脉冲直流 PVD 工艺设计复杂合金与高熵合金涂层，以服务核能、高温电解等低碳能源极端环境应用。作者概述了法国 DIADEM 材料与数据科学融合计划及其 DIADEM-2D 组合沉积平台，并基于文献数据与沉积参数—涂层性质模型进行耐腐蚀保护涂层设计。研究展示了该工艺的可行性和精度。
authors: Paul Foulquier, Ryma Haddad, Ali Mahmoud, Eric Monsifrot, Fanny Balbaud-Celerier, Jean-Philippe Poli, Frederic Schuster
articles.abstract_zh_full: 复杂合金和高熵合金目前因其在严苛环境中的机械性能和耐腐蚀性能而受到广泛关注，特别是无碳能源应用需要这些性能。然而，由于其复杂性和鸡尾酒效应，采用试错方法制备块体和薄膜形式的这些合金并不实际。人工智能的最新发展为其制备及性能调控带来了新的可能性。首先，我们概述材料科学与数据科学研究。随后，我们描述 DIADEM——法国材料科学与数据科学融合倡议——如何通过发展一个覆盖全国的合成与表征平台网络，即 DIADEM 发现中心，来应对面向无碳能源应用（核能、高温电解等）的创新涂层开发。我们特别描述了 DIADEM-2D，这是一种由人工智能驱动的混合 HiPIMS/脉冲直流 PVD 工艺，使用 4 个阴极并采用共焦组合构型。我们利用文献中关于熔盐介质和核事故条件下耐腐蚀性的数据，介绍高熵合金的确定方法。我们实现了一个元素无关模型，该模型汇集沉积参数和涂层性质，从而能够设计具有特定组成的保护涂层。我们证明了该工艺的可行性及其精度。

articles.title: Spin Josephson diode effect induced by higher-harmonic spin Josephson currents in a diffusive Josephson junction
articles.title_zh: 扩散型约瑟夫森结中由高次谐波自旋约瑟夫森电流诱导的自旋约瑟夫森二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01991v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate the spin Josephson diode effect (SJDE) in a diffusive Josephson junction with a Rashba metal layer under a ferromagnetic exchange field. Within the quasiclassical Green's function framework, we derive analytical expressions for the first- and second-harmonic spin Josephson currents. The interplay between Rashba spin-orbit interaction and the exchange field breaks inversion and time-reversal symmetries, generating additional cosine terms in the spin current-phase relations and a finite phi0 phase shift. This phase shift induces an intrinsic asymmetry between forward and backward spin currents, leading to the SJDE without an external magnetic field. Numerical results show that the efficiency decreases with increasing metal thickness due to suppression of the second-harmonic component, while its dependence on spin-orbit interaction strength reflects competing effects between phase shift enhancement and harmonic suppression. These findings demonstrate that the interplay between harmonic components provides a mechanism for nonreciprocal spin transport without requiring suppression of spin-singlet correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上研究了含 Rashba 金属层并受铁磁交换场作用的扩散型约瑟夫森结中的自旋约瑟夫森二极管效应。作者在准经典格林函数框架下推导了自旋约瑟夫森电流的一、二次谐波解析式，并指出 Rashba 自旋轨道相互作用与交换场共同破坏反演和时间反演对称性，产生有限的 phi0 相移和非互易自旋输运。数值结果表明，该效应效率随金属厚度增加而降低，并受自旋轨道耦合强度对相移增强与谐波抑制的竞争影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了在铁磁交换场作用下、具有 Rashba 金属层的扩散型约瑟夫森结中的自旋约瑟夫森二极管效应（SJDE）。在准经典格林函数框架内，我们推导了一次和二次谐波自旋约瑟夫森电流的解析表达式。Rashba 自旋轨道相互作用与交换场之间的相互作用破坏了反演对称性和时间反演对称性，在自旋电流-相位关系中产生额外的余弦项以及有限的 phi0 相位偏移。该相位偏移在正向和反向自旋电流之间诱导出内禀不对称性，从而在无需外加磁场的情况下导致 SJDE。数值结果表明，由于二次谐波分量受到抑制，效率随金属厚度增加而降低；而其对自旋轨道相互作用强度的依赖反映了相位偏移增强与谐波抑制之间的竞争效应。这些发现表明，谐波分量之间的相互作用为非互易自旋输运提供了一种机制，且不需要抑制自旋单态关联。

articles.title: Exciton-induced magnons carrying orbital angular momentum in CrI3
articles.title_zh: CrI3 中由激子诱导并携带轨道角动量的磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnons are collective spin excitations that contain and transport spin angular momentum in magnetic materials. It has been suggested that they can also carry orbital angular momentum in analogy to the electronic motion around the nucleus. We explore the real-space topology of magnon wave-packets emanating from atomic-like excitons in the ferromagnetic insulator CrI3 and demonstrate the existence of orbital angular momentum in such wave-packets. We reveal that orbital angular momentum of magnons is nearly equal to their spin angular momentum and compensates the latter. This illustrates the existence of an unexplored internal angular momentum balance and demonstrates that the magnetization can be quenched without the need of angular momentum exchange with the lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了铁磁绝缘体 CrI3 中由类原子激子产生的磁振子波包的实空间拓扑，并证明这类波包可携带轨道角动量。研究发现，磁振子的轨道角动量几乎等于其自旋角动量并对其进行补偿。该结果揭示了此前未充分探索的内部角动量平衡机制，表明磁化可在无需与晶格交换角动量的情况下被淬灭。
authors: Martin Pavelka, Vishal Shokeen, Ruslan Chulkov, Soma Dutta, David Muradas Belinchón, Ulrich Noumbe, Mahmoud Abdel-Hafiez, M. Venkata Kamalakar, Mathias Augustin, Vitaliy Goryashko, Torstein Hegstad, Johan H. Mentink, Jamal Berakdar, Oscar Grånäs, Anders Bergman, Olle Eriksson, Anna Delin, Hermann A. Durr
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁振子是磁性材料中的集体自旋激发，包含并传输自旋角动量。有人提出，类比于电子围绕原子核运动的情形，磁振子也可以携带轨道角动量。我们探索了铁磁绝缘体 CrI3 中由类原子激子发出的磁振子波包的实空间拓扑，并证明了这类波包中存在轨道角动量。我们揭示，磁振子的轨道角动量几乎等于其自旋角动量，并补偿后者。这说明存在一种尚未被探索的内部角动量平衡，并表明磁化可以在不需要与晶格交换角动量的情况下被淬灭。

articles.title: Emission dynamics in zincblende InAsxP1-x quantum dots in InP nanowires: influence of quantum dot size, composition and nanowire geometry
articles.title_zh: InP 纳米线中闪锌矿 InAsxP1-x 量子点的发射动力学：量子点尺寸、组分与纳米线几何结构的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hereby, we present an experimental and theoretical investigation of emission dynamics in zincblende InAsxP1-x quantum dots (QDs) embedded in InP nanowires (NWs) grown via vapour-liquid-solid mechanism by chemical beam epitaxy, using Au nanoparticles as a nucleation catalyst. By measuring time-resolved photoluminescence from an ensemble of QD-NWs it was possible to determine the exciton lifetime dependence on QD composition and height. Changes in the InP shell thickness surrounding the InP NW stem with a QD, brought additional insight into the influence of photonic environment on the carrier dynamics. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy, combined with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy, provided actual structural parameters. The experimentally obtained lifetimes were interpreted in the light of results of 8 band kp calculations combined with configuration-interaction model to take into account the Coulomb interactions and finite-difference time domain photonic simulations to include the effect of optical confinement. The full understanding of the experimental results required considering both, the changes in the QD potential and the Purcell effect, the latter leading to spontaneous emission inhibition in the case of NWs with thin InP shell.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对嵌入 InP 纳米线中的闪锌矿 InAsxP1-x 量子点发射动力学进行了实验与理论研究。通过量子点-纳米线系综的时间分辨光致发光测量，作者获得了激子寿命对量子点组分和高度的依赖，并考察了 InP 壳层厚度所改变的光子环境对载流子动力学的影响。结合结构表征、8 带 k·p 计算、组态相互作用模型和时域有限差分光子模拟，研究指出必须同时考虑量子点势阱变化和 Purcell 效应才能解释实验寿命。
authors: Tomasz Gzyl, Giada Bucci, Krzysztof Gawarecki, Elisa García-Tabarés, Anna Musiał, Valentina Zannier, Ylea Vlamidis, Fabio Beltram, Julian V. Montero, Beatriz Galiana, Lucia Sorba, Wojciech Rudno-Rudziński, Grzegorz Skek
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在此，我们对嵌入 InP 纳米线（NWs）中的闪锌矿 InAsxP1-x 量子点（QDs）的发射动力学进行了实验和理论研究；这些纳米线通过化学束外延中的气-液-固机制生长，并使用 Au 纳米颗粒作为成核催化剂。通过测量量子点-纳米线系综的时间分辨光致发光，可以确定激子寿命对量子点组分和高度的依赖关系。围绕带有量子点的 InP 纳米线主干的 InP 壳层厚度变化，为理解光子环境对载流子动力学的影响提供了额外信息。高分辨透射电子显微镜结合能量色散 X 射线谱提供了实际结构参数。实验获得的寿命根据 8 带 k·p 计算结果进行解释，并结合组态相互作用模型以考虑库仑相互作用，同时结合时域有限差分光子模拟以纳入光学限域效应。要完整理解实验结果，需要同时考虑量子点势能的变化和 Purcell 效应；后者在具有较薄 InP 壳层的纳米线中会导致自发辐射抑制。

articles.title: Transient Ferromagnetism in Ultrafast Phase Transitions in Perovskites under XUV Irradiation: A Comparative Study of SrTiO3 and KTaO3
articles.title_zh: XUV 辐照下钙钛矿超快相变中的瞬态铁磁性：SrTiO3 与 KTaO3 的比较研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02106v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study ultrafast structural and electronic responses of strontium titanate and potassium tantalate to intense femtosecond irradiation using the XTANT3 multiscale code. It is found that at threshold doses of 0.7 eVatom in STO and 0.9 eVatom in KTO, a superionic state thermally forms with selective melting of the oxygen subsystem while metallic sublattices remain ordered. This state persists up to 1.6 eVatom STO and 1.5 eVatom KTO, above which complete disorder occurs. Analysis of the transient electronic density of states suggests that the B site d orbitals govern the divergent behaviour of the two materials: the compact Ti 3d orbitals in STO produce a narrow conduction band and large intraatomic exchange parameter, driving a transient ferromagnetic instability on 1 ps timescales, whereas the more spatially extended Ta 5d orbitals in KTO yield a broader conduction band and smaller exchange parameter, keeping KTO paramagnetic. These results suggest d orbital spatial extent as a structural parameter that influences phase transition sequences, and magnetic response under extreme electronic excitation, with implications for the ultrafast optical control of electronic and magnetic properties in perovskite based optoelectronic devices. Landau Devonshire analysis shows that irradiation at 0.3 eVatom transiently deepens the polar potential well in unstrained and strained STO and KTO, with the effect amplified approximately 2 fold in strained STO and 6 fold in strained KTO with respect to the unstrained cases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 XTANT3 多尺度代码研究了钛酸锶和钽酸钾在强飞秒辐照下的超快结构与电子响应。结果显示，两种材料在阈值剂量附近会形成氧子系统选择性熔化而金属子晶格保持有序的超离子态，并在更高剂量下完全无序化。瞬态电子态密度分析表明，B 位 d 轨道空间延展性决定了 STO 与 KTO 在磁性响应上的差异：STO 可在皮秒尺度产生瞬态铁磁不稳定性，而 KTO 保持顺磁性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用 XTANT3 多尺度代码研究了钛酸锶和钽酸钾对强飞秒辐照的超快结构和电子响应。研究发现，在 STO 中 0.7 eV/atom、KTO 中 0.9 eV/atom 的阈值剂量下，会热形成一种超离子态，其中氧子系统发生选择性熔化，而金属子晶格保持有序。该状态在 STO 中可持续到 1.6 eV/atom、在 KTO 中可持续到 1.5 eV/atom，超过这些剂量后会发生完全无序化。对瞬态电子态密度的分析表明，B 位 d 轨道支配了两种材料的分化行为：STO 中紧凑的 Ti 3d 轨道产生窄导带和较大的原子内交换参数，从而在 1 ps 时间尺度上驱动瞬态铁磁不稳定性；而 KTO 中空间上更延展的 Ta 5d 轨道产生更宽的导带和更小的交换参数，使 KTO 保持顺磁性。这些结果表明，d 轨道空间延展性是一种影响相变序列以及极端电子激发下磁响应的结构参数，并对基于钙钛矿的光电子器件中电子和磁性质的超快光学控制具有意义。Landau-Devonshire 分析表明，在 0.3 eV/atom 辐照下，未应变和应变 STO 与 KTO 中的极化势阱会瞬态加深；相对于未应变情形，该效应在应变 STO 中约增强 2 倍，在应变 KTO 中约增强 6 倍。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文利用XTANT3多尺度模拟研究SrTiO3和KTaO3在强飞秒XUV辐照下的超快结构与电子响应。结果显示两者在阈值剂量下形成氧子晶格选择性熔化的超离子态，并指出SrTiO3中较局域的Ti 3d轨道可诱发皮秒尺度瞬态铁磁不稳定，而KTaO3保持顺磁。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的钙钛矿氧化物、超快动力学、磁性响应、电子结构和相变研究有一定关联，尤其涉及激发态下d轨道、交换作用和瞬态磁性的关系。直接方法和材料主题与团队核心方向不是完全重合。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步关注其瞬态磁性判据和电子激发下相变路径分析，考虑用第一性原理分子动力学或非绝热动力学研究铁电/多铁氧化物中的光诱导磁电响应。

articles.title: Complete Structural Determination of Mesostructural Dodecagonal Quasicrystalline Particles
articles.title_zh: 介观结构十二重准晶颗粒的完整结构测定
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quasicrystals have revolutionized our understanding of order in solids by demonstrating exotic structural and physicochemical properties with diverse potential applications. Despite the development of various theoretical models and experimental techniques to describe quasicrystal structures, the precise determination of local three dimensional (3D) arrangements of constituent atoms, or of secondary building units such as clusters or micelles, remains elusive. This challenge is particularly acute in self assembled soft matter quasicrystalline systems, where the complex assembly of molecular groups introduces additional defects and structural modulations. Herein, we report the first complete structural determination of self-assembled mesostructural dodecagonal quasicrystalline particles. Employing advanced electron tomography, combined with dedicated structural tracing and processing workflows, the 3D coordinates of all nodal sites were extracted. This approach reveals that the actual structure deviates from the conventionally assumed tetrahedral close packing geometry, exhibiting diverse coordination environments and displacive fluctuations. We identified and quantified rotational intergrowths arising from node exchange, as well as various defects and disorder, with these features discernible only through 3D analysis. Additionally, we propose a simplified two-layer stacking of isomorphic hexagonal model to form dodecagonal quasicrystal. This work advances our understanding of soft-matter dodecagonal quasicrystals and paves the way for detailed structural elucidation of self-assembled systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了自组装介观结构十二重准晶颗粒的首次完整结构测定。作者利用先进电子断层成像及专门的结构追踪与处理流程，提取了所有节点位点的三维坐标，发现实际结构偏离传统假设的四面体密堆积几何。研究还识别并量化了由节点交换产生的旋转互生以及多种缺陷和无序，并提出了由同构六角模型双层堆垛形成十二重准晶的简化模型。
authors: Xueliang Zhang, Xi Wang, Nobuhisa Fujita, Osamu Terasaki, Lu Han
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准晶通过展示奇异的结构和物理化学性质以及多样的潜在应用，革新了我们对固体中有序性的理解。尽管已经发展出多种理论模型和实验技术来描述准晶结构，但对组成原子的局部三维（3D）排列，或对簇、胶束等二级构筑单元的局部三维排列进行精确测定，仍然难以实现。在自组装软物质准晶体系中，这一挑战尤为突出，因为分子基团的复杂组装会引入额外的缺陷和结构调制。在此，我们报道了自组装介观结构十二重准晶颗粒的首次完整结构测定。通过采用先进电子断层成像，并结合专门的结构追踪和处理工作流程，我们提取了所有节点位点的 3D 坐标。该方法揭示，实际结构偏离了通常假定的四面体密堆积几何，表现出多样的配位环境和位移涨落。我们识别并量化了由节点交换产生的旋转互生，以及各种缺陷和无序，而这些特征只有通过 3D 分析才能辨识。此外，我们提出了一种由同构六角模型的简化双层堆垛来形成十二重准晶的模型。这项工作推进了我们对软物质十二重准晶的理解，并为自组装体系的详细结构阐明铺平了道路。

articles.title: Time reversal symmetry broken quantum spin hall effect in pseudospin-1 Dirac-Rashba system
articles.title_zh: 赝自旋-1 Dirac-Rashba 体系中破缺时间反演对称性的量子自旋霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Quantum spin Hall (QSH) phase is conventionally understood to be protected by time-reversal symmetry (TRS). Here, we theoretically investigated the fate of the QSH phase in a pseudospin-1 fermionic α-T₃ system in the presence of a TRS-breaking ferromagnetic exchange field and spin-nonconserving Rashba spin-orbit coupling. Despite broken TRS, the QSH phase survives over a finite parameter regime and is characterised by a non-zero projected spin-Chern number C_σ (σ = p̆arrow, downarrow), protected by a spin-spectral gap. In the absence of Rashba coupling, the QSH phase remains robust up to an α-dependent critical exchange field. Rashba SOC qualitatively reshapes the phase diagram by driving transitions into two distinct quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) phases: a C=2 phase, irrespective of α-values, and a C=1 phase for α ≠ 0,1, which is further identified as a valley-polarized QAH phase arising from a single valley. Rotating the magnetization to in-plane gaps out the first-order helical edge states and gives rise to second-order topological insulator (SOTI) phases that host localized corner states in suitable finite geometry. We further identify a topological phase transition between two different SOTI phases, mediated by nanoribbon edge states at an exchange field equal to α. These results establish spin-resolved topology in a higher pseudospin system as well as the α-T₃ lattice as a versatile platform for engineering and controlling multiple topological phases through magnetic exchange and spin-orbit coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了赝自旋-1 α-T3 体系在破坏时间反演对称性的铁磁交换场和 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合作用下量子自旋霍尔相的命运。结果表明，尽管时间反演对称性被破坏，QSH 相仍可在有限参数区域内存在，并由非零投影自旋陈数和自旋谱隙表征。Rashba 耦合会重塑相图，诱导不同量子反常霍尔相；当磁化转至面内方向时，还可产生具有角态的二阶拓扑绝缘体相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子自旋霍尔（QSH）相通常被理解为受时间反演对称性（TRS）保护。在这里，我们从理论上研究了赝自旋-1 费米子 α-T3 体系中，在破坏 TRS 的铁磁交换场以及不守恒自旋的 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合存在时，QSH 相的命运。尽管 TRS 被破坏，QSH 相仍在有限参数区域内存活，并由非零投影自旋陈数 C_σ（σ = 上、下）表征，且受自旋谱隙保护。在没有 Rashba 耦合时，QSH 相在达到依赖于 α 的临界交换场之前保持稳健。Rashba SOC 通过驱动体系转变为两种不同的量子反常霍尔（QAH）相而定性地重塑相图：一种是不依赖 α 取值的 C=2 相，另一种是在 α ≠ 0,1 时出现的 C=1 相，后者进一步被识别为源自单个谷的谷极化 QAH 相。将磁化旋转到面内方向会使一阶螺旋边缘态开隙，并产生二阶拓扑绝缘体（SOTI）相，在合适的有限几何中承载局域角态。我们还识别出两个不同 SOTI 相之间的拓扑相变，该相变在交换场等于 α 时由纳米带边缘态介导。这些结果确立了高赝自旋体系中的自旋分辨拓扑，并表明 α-T3 晶格是一个可通过磁交换和自旋轨道耦合来设计和控制多种拓扑相的多功能平台。

articles.title: Band topology and symmetry-driven magneto-optical response in two-dimensional d-wave altermagnets with staggered spin-orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: 具有交错自旋轨道耦合的二维 d 波交替磁体中的能带拓扑与对称性驱动磁光响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated collinear magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, providing a route to transverse electronic and optical responses without a net ferromagnetic moment. We develop a strictly periodic four-band tight-binding model for a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet and distinguish the roles of three spin orbit coupling (SOC) channels: uniform Rashba SOC, a sublattice-staggered Rashba interaction, and bond-staggered SOC. In the absence of SOC, the d-wave kinetic anisotropy produces spin-polarized Dirac points on orthogonal Brillouin-zone boundaries, related by the altermagnetic fourfold spin-group symmetry. Uniform Rashba SOC mixes the spin sectors and shifts these nodes but preserves the antiunitary symmetry that forbids an integrated Hall response. The sublattice-staggered Rashba term breaks this symmetry and activates transverse optical response, whereas the bond-staggered SOC provides the mass that gaps the boundary nodes. Their combined action generates strong Berry-curvature hot spots and, within a narrow parameter window, an isolated lower two-band manifold with Chern number C=-2. For the representative parameters considered here it is possible to stabilize a Chern insulator phase. Using covariant-velocity Kubo calculations, we show that large optical Hall conductivity and circular dichroism extend well beyond the nonzero-Chern region and are controlled by SOC-induced avoided crossings and symmetry breaking. We further find that carrier doping strongly modifies the resonant and dc Hall responses through Pauli blocking and the occupation of Berry-curvature hot spots, enabling gate-controlled sign reversals. These results identify the complementary roles of distinct interfacial SOC mechanisms in producing topology and tunable magneto-optical activity in compensated two-dimensional magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了二维 d 波交替磁体的严格周期四带紧束缚模型，并区分了均匀 Rashba、自晶格交错 Rashba 和键交错自旋轨道耦合三种通道的作用。研究表明，不同 SOC 机制分别影响节点移动、对称性破缺和能隙打开，联合产生强 Berry 曲率热点，并可在窄参数窗口中稳定 C=-2 的陈绝缘体相。Kubo 计算显示，大的光学霍尔电导和圆二色性可超出非零陈数区域存在，并能通过载流子掺杂实现显著调控甚至符号反转。
authors: Meysam Bagheri Tagani Carmine Autieri, Wojciech Brzezicki
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体将补偿的共线磁有序与动量依赖的自旋劈裂结合起来，为在没有净铁磁矩的情况下实现横向电子和光学响应提供了一条路径。我们为二维 d 波交替磁体发展了一个严格周期性的四带紧束缚模型，并区分了三种自旋轨道耦合（SOC）通道的作用：均匀 Rashba SOC、自晶格交错 Rashba 相互作用以及键交错 SOC。在没有 SOC 时，d 波动能各向异性会在正交的布里渊区边界上产生自旋极化 Dirac 点，这些点由交替磁四重自旋群对称性联系起来。均匀 Rashba SOC 混合自旋扇区并移动这些节点，但保持禁止积分霍尔响应的反幺正对称性。自晶格交错 Rashba 项破坏这种对称性并激活横向光学响应，而键交错 SOC 提供质量项，使边界节点开隙。它们的联合作用产生强 Berry 曲率热点，并在一个狭窄参数窗口内形成具有陈数 C=-2 的孤立下方双带流形。对于本文考虑的代表性参数，可以稳定陈绝缘体相。利用协变速度 Kubo 计算，我们表明大的光学霍尔电导和圆二色性远远超出非零陈数区域，并由 SOC 诱导的避免交叉和对称性破缺控制。我们进一步发现，载流子掺杂通过 Pauli 阻塞和 Berry 曲率热点占据，强烈改变共振和直流霍尔响应，从而实现栅控符号反转。这些结果揭示了不同界面 SOC 机制在补偿二维磁体中产生拓扑和可调磁光活性方面的互补作用。

articles.title: Inhomogeneous Ising Model on 2D kagomé Lattice: Fermionic field approach
articles.title_zh: 二维 kagomé 晶格上的非均匀 Ising 模型：费米子场方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the two-dimensional inhomogeneous Ising model (2DIM) on the kagom'e lattice by mapping it onto a particular non-symmetric eight-vertex model and constructing the corresponding R-matrix. Using a fermionic representation, we evaluate the partition function and derive explicit expressions for the main thermodynamic quantities. In the thermodynamic limit, we obtain an exact equation for the critical surface determining the phase transition of the model. We also calculate the free energy, specific heat, and spontaneous magnetization in the ferromagnetic case. Furthermore, we show that when one or two coupling constants vanish, the model reduces, respectively, to the square-lattice and one-dimensional Ising models. In both limits, our results reproduce the corresponding exact critical couplings and free energies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了二维 kagomé 晶格上的非均匀 Ising 模型，通过将其映射为特定非对称八顶点模型并构造相应 R 矩阵来求解。作者采用费米子表示计算配分函数，并推导主要热力学量的显式表达式。热力学极限下得到临界面的精确方程，并在铁磁情形下计算自由能、比热和自发磁化；在耦合常数退化极限中结果可还原平方晶格和一维 Ising 模型。
authors: Shahane A. Khachatryan, Zhidong Zhang, Ara G. Sedrakyan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过将二维 kagomé 晶格上的非均匀 Ising 模型（2DIM）映射到一个特定的非对称八顶点模型，并构造相应的 R 矩阵，对其进行了研究。利用费米子表示，我们计算了配分函数，并推导了主要热力学量的显式表达式。在热力学极限中，我们得到一个精确方程，用于确定该模型相变的临界面。我们还计算了铁磁情形下的自由能、比热和自发磁化。此外，我们表明，当一个或两个耦合常数为零时，该模型分别约化为平方晶格 Ising 模型和一维 Ising 模型。在这两个极限中，我们的结果再现了相应的精确临界耦合和自由能。

articles.title: Direct visualization of local electric fields in a layer of a ferroelectric nematic liquid
articles.title_zh: 铁电向列液体层中局域电场的直接可视化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric nematic liquids exhibit complex ferroelectric domains shaped by competing elastic and electrostatic interactions. Using fluorescence and polarizing optical microscopy, we investigate domain formation and evolution under different anchoring conditions. Charged fluorescent ions map the electrostatic potential, revealing that electric fields are localized near domain walls and material surfaces. Upon cooling, domain walls transform from Ising- to Néel-type configurations, lowering the electrostatic potential, and reversibly recover upon heating.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用荧光显微和偏振光学显微方法研究铁电向列液体中在不同锚定条件下的畴形成与演化。带电荧光离子被用于映射静电势，显示电场主要局域在畴壁和材料表面附近。降温时，畴壁由 Ising 型转变为 Néel 型并降低静电势，加热后可逆恢复。
authors: Anej Sterle, Natan Osterman, Calum J. Gibb, Jordan Hobbs, Richard J. Mandle, Nerea Sebastián, Alenka Mertelj
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电向列液体表现出复杂的铁电畴，这些畴由相互竞争的弹性和静电相互作用塑造。利用荧光显微镜和偏振光学显微镜，我们研究了不同锚定条件下畴的形成和演化。带电荧光离子用于映射静电势，揭示电场局域在畴壁和材料表面附近。冷却时，畴壁从 Ising 型构型转变为 Néel 型构型，从而降低静电势，并在加热时可逆地恢复。

articles.title: Proximity effects of chiral magnetization on transition metal dichalcogenides monolayers
articles.title_zh: 手性磁化对过渡金属二硫属化物单层的邻近效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02241v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the proximity effects of a commensurate chiral 120ⁱ̧rc Néel magnetic structure on the transport and optical properties of a transition metal dichalcogenide monolayer (TMD ML). The enlarged magnetic unit cell leads to the folding of the Brillouin zone and enables efficient intervalley spin-flip scattering. Starting from a six band tight binding model, we develop an effective kḑot p model, which describes the coupling between charge carriers in the TMD ML and the chiral magnetization. We predict the anomalous antiferromagnetic Hall effect (AHE) for conduction electrons and describe it accounting for the interplay between anomalous velocity, side jump, and skew scattering contributions. The proximity of the chiral magnetization also leads to the mixing and splitting of the exciton resonances in the two valleys which are related by the time reversal symmetry despite zero net magnetization. Finally, we demonstrate the possibility to measure the distribution of in-plane orientation of the chiral magnetization through Faraday rotation and the ellipticity of incident linearly polarized light.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了共格手性 120° Néel 磁结构对过渡金属二硫属化物单层输运和光学性质的邻近效应。增大的磁性元胞导致布里渊区折叠，并允许有效的谷间自旋翻转散射；作者从六带紧束缚模型出发建立了描述载流子与手性磁化耦合的有效 k·p 模型。研究预言了导带电子的反常反铁磁霍尔效应，并指出手性磁化邻近还会混合和劈裂两谷激子共振，可通过 Faraday 旋转和椭圆率探测面内手性磁化取向分布。
authors: Vladimir N. Mantsevich, Igor S. Krivenko, Dmitry S. Smirnov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们考虑了共格手性 120° Néel 磁结构对过渡金属二硫属化物单层（TMD ML）输运和光学性质的邻近效应。增大的磁性晶胞导致布里渊区折叠，并使有效的谷间自旋翻转散射成为可能。从六带紧束缚模型出发，我们发展了一个有效 k·p 模型，用以描述 TMD 单层中的电荷载流子与手性磁化之间的耦合。我们预言了导带电子的反常反铁磁霍尔效应（AHE），并在考虑反常速度、侧跳和偏斜散射贡献之间相互作用的基础上对其进行了描述。手性磁化的邻近还会导致两个谷中激子共振的混合和劈裂，尽管净磁化为零，这两个谷仍由时间反演对称性联系。最后，我们展示了通过入射线偏振光的 Faraday 旋转和椭圆率来测量手性磁化面内取向分布的可能性。

articles.title: Valley-controlled chiral magnetism in transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers
articles.title_zh: 过渡金属二硫属化物单层中的谷控手性磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We put forward the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction in transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers as a tool to create and control a chiral magnetic texture. We show that in the spin-valley locking regime, the RKKY interaction acts as a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya coupling with an effective spin rotation period exactly equal to the tripled lattice constant. Using mean field theory and classical Monte Carlo simulations, we demonstrate that this interaction qualitatively reshapes the phase diagram of atomically thin antiferromagnets. It destroys the chirality-related phase transition by selecting a single chirality value even when the RKKY interaction is small. At the same time, it shifts the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition associated with spins orientation to higher temperatures. We argue that the valley degree of freedom of electrons mediating the RKKY interaction provides a powerful control knob for exploring non-universal phase transitions and quantum spin liquid states in two-dimensional van der Waals heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出利用过渡金属二硫属化物单层中的 RKKY 相互作用来产生并控制手性磁织构。在自旋-谷锁定区域，RKKY 相互作用表现为 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 型耦合，其有效自旋旋转周期正好等于三倍晶格常数。平均场理论和经典 Monte Carlo 模拟表明，该相互作用会重塑原子级薄反铁磁体的相图，选择单一手性并提高与自旋取向相关的 BKT 转变温度。
authors: Igor S. Krivenko, Vladimir N. Mantsevich, Dmitry S. Smirnov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出，将过渡金属二硫属化物单层中的 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida（RKKY）相互作用作为一种产生和控制手性磁织构的工具。我们表明，在自旋-谷锁定区域，RKKY 相互作用起到 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 耦合的作用，其有效自旋旋转周期精确等于三倍晶格常数。利用平均场理论和经典 Monte Carlo 模拟，我们证明这种相互作用会定性地重塑原子级薄反铁磁体的相图。即使 RKKY 相互作用很小，它也会通过选择单一手性值而破坏与手性相关的相变。同时，它会将与自旋取向相关的 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 转变推向更高温度。我们认为，介导 RKKY 相互作用的电子谷自由度为探索二维范德华异质结构中的非普适相变和量子自旋液体态提供了一个强有力的控制旋钮。

articles.title: Pressure-Driven Evolution of Electronic and Magnetic Correlations in Bilayer Nickelate La3Ni2O7
articles.title_zh: 双层镍酸盐 La3Ni2O7 中电子与磁关联的压力驱动演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02261v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent discovery of high-temperature superconductivity in pressurized bilayer La3Ni2O7 has sparked intense research interest, yet the microscopic mechanism governing its pressure-dependent superconducting transition temperature (Tc) remains elusive. In this work, we investigate the electronic and magnetic correlations of La3Ni2O7 under high pressure using a combination of density-functional theory (DFT), constrained random phase approximation (cRPA), and dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). We find that while hydrostatic pressure enhances the interlayer hopping and the bare superexchange energy scale (4t2/U), it simultaneously drives the system toward a more itinerant regime by reducing the relative correlation strength (U/W). Crucially, our results reveal a distinct orbital-selective evolution: the Ni dx2-y2 states become increasingly itinerant, whereas the Ni dz2 orbitals retain a more localized character. This pressure-induced itinerancy significantly enhances the hybridization between the two, leading to a dramatic amplification of the Kondo-like screening of the local dz2 moments by the itinerant dx2-y2 electrons. Consequently, the effective magnetic exchange coupling (Jeff), which serves as the pairing glue, is suppressed in the high-pressure regime. Our findings suggest that the monotonic decrease of Tc at high pressures is driven by the dominance of Kondo screening over superexchange interactions, providing a coherent microscopic explanation for the dome-shaped superconducting phase diagram in La3Ni2O7.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合 DFT、cRPA 和 DMFT 研究了高压下双层 La3Ni2O7 的电子与磁关联，以解释其压力依赖的超导转变温度。研究发现，压力增强层间跃迁和裸超交换能标的同时，也通过降低 U/W 将体系推向更巡游的区域，并导致 Ni dx2-y2 与 dz2 轨道出现轨道选择性演化。高压下增强的轨道杂化放大了巡游 dx2-y2 电子对局域 dz2 磁矩的 Kondo 类屏蔽，从而抑制作为配对胶的有效磁交换，解释了高压下 Tc 单调下降和拱形超导相图。
authors: Jian Zhou, Rui Song, Haiyan Lu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期在加压双层 La3Ni2O7 中发现高温超导性激发了强烈的研究兴趣，但支配其压力依赖超导转变温度（Tc）的微观机制仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、约束随机相位近似（cRPA）和动力学平均场理论（DMFT），研究了 La3Ni2O7 在高压下的电子和磁关联。我们发现，虽然静水压力增强了层间跃迁和裸超交换能标（4t2/U），但它同时通过降低相对关联强度（U/W）将体系推向更巡游的区域。关键的是，我们的结果揭示了一种显著的轨道选择性演化：Ni dx2-y2 态变得越来越巡游，而 Ni dz2 轨道保留了更局域的特征。这种压力诱导的巡游性显著增强了两者之间的杂化，导致巡游 dx2-y2 电子对局域 dz2 磁矩的 Kondo 类屏蔽被大幅放大。因此，作为配对胶的有效磁交换耦合（Jeff）在高压区域受到抑制。我们的发现表明，高压下 Tc 的单调降低由 Kondo 屏蔽相对于超交换相互作用占据主导所驱动，从而为 La3Ni2O7 中拱形超导相图提供了一个连贯的微观解释。

articles.title: Second-Harmonic Imaging of Magnetic Domains in Thin Film Hematite
articles.title_zh: 薄膜赤铁矿中磁畴的二次谐波成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hematite is an antiferromagnetic oxide and candidate altermagnetic insulator whose Néel order reorients from an easy-axis to an easy-plane phase at the Morin transition. Interpreting altermagnetic transport and symmetry sensitive optical responses requires knowledge of the Néel vector orientation relative to the crystal axes and of the domain structure within the probed device. Here, we show that polarization-resolved second-harmonic generation (SHG) microscopy resolves magnetic symmetry and domains in epitaxial (0001)-oriented hematite films. Across the Morin temperature, the SHG polarization anisotropy evolves from an approximately sixfold pattern consistent with the easy-axis orientation to pronounced twofold patterns consistent with the easy-plane orientation. A symmetry analysis based on magnetic-dipole and electric-quadrupole contributions reproduces this evolution. Importantly, the interference between SHG amplitudes that are odd and even under reversal of the magnetic order renders opposite Néel-vector orientations optically distinguishable. Consistently, opposite directions of an applied in-plane magnetic field produce distinct SHG responses in our experiments. Using this magnetic contrast, we image micrometer-scale domains, their reorganization across the Morin transition, and their reconfiguration under magnetic and thermal cycling, including a remanent change after cycling through the spin-flop transition. These results establish SHG microscopy as a local probe of magnetic symmetry, Néel-vector orientation, and domain evolution in hematite films.
articles.abstract_zh: 赤铁矿是一种反铁磁氧化物，也是候选交替磁性绝缘体，其尼尔序在莫林转变处发生从易轴到易面的重取向。本文表明，偏振分辨二次谐波产生显微术可在外延(0001)取向赤铁矿薄膜中解析磁对称性与磁畴，并能区分相反的尼尔矢量取向。研究进一步成像了微米尺度磁畴及其在莫林转变、磁场循环和热循环下的重组，确立了该技术作为赤铁矿薄膜局域磁性探针的作用。
authors: Holger Mirkes (Walter Schottky Institute and Physics Department, Technical University of Munich, Am Coulombwall 4a, 85748 Garching, Germany, Munich Center of Quantum Science and Technology), Johannes Schmuck (Walter Schottky Institute and Physics Department, Technical University of Munich, Am Coulombwall 4a, 85748 Garching, Germany, Munich Center of Quantum Science and Technology), Katharina Müller (Walther-Meißner-Institut, Bayerische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Walther-Meißner-Straße 8, 85748 Garching, Germany, Physics Department, TUM School of Natural Sciences, Technical University of Munich, 85748 Garching, Germany), János Papp (Institute of Physics and Center for Integrated Sensor Systems), Paul Seifert (Institute of Physics and Center for Integrated Sensor Systems), Matthias Althammer (Walther-Meißner-Institut, Bayerische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Walther-Meißner-Straße 8, 85748 Garching, Germany, Physics Department, TUM School of Natural Sciences, Technical University of Munich, 85748 Garching, Germany), Hans Huebl (Walther-Meißner-Institut, Bayerische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Walther-Meißner-Straße 8, 85748 Garching, Germany, Physics Department, TUM School of Natural Sciences, Technical University of Munich, 85748 Garching, Germany, Munich Center of Quantum Science and Technology), Stephan Geprägs (Walther-Meißner-Institut, Bayerische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Walther-Meißner-Straße 8, 85748 Garching, Germany), Alexander W. Holleitner (Walter Schottky Institute and Physics Department, Technical University of Munich, Am Coulombwall 4a, 85748 Garching, Germany, Munich Center of Quantum Science and Technology), Christoph Kastl (Walter Schottky Institute and Physics Department, Technical University of Munich, Am Coulombwall 4a, 85748 Garching, Germany, Munich Center of Quantum Science and Technology)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 赤铁矿是一种反铁磁氧化物，也是候选的交替磁性绝缘体，其尼尔序在莫林转变处从易轴相重新取向为易面相。解释交替磁性输运和对称性敏感的光学响应，需要了解尼尔矢量相对于晶轴的取向，以及被探测器件内部的畴结构。在这里，我们表明，偏振分辨二次谐波产生（SHG）显微术能够解析外延(0001)取向赤铁矿薄膜中的磁对称性和磁畴。跨越莫林温度时，SHG偏振各向异性从与易轴取向一致的近似六重图案演化为与易面取向一致的显著二重图案。基于磁偶极和电四极贡献的对称性分析再现了这种演化。重要的是，在磁有序反转下为奇和为偶的SHG振幅之间的干涉，使相反的尼尔矢量取向在光学上可区分。与此一致，在我们的实验中，施加的面内磁场的相反方向产生了不同的SHG响应。利用这种磁对比度，我们成像了微米尺度磁畴、它们跨越莫林转变时的重组，以及它们在磁循环和热循环下的重构，其中包括经过自旋翻转转变循环后的剩余变化。这些结果确立了SHG显微术作为赤铁矿薄膜中磁对称性、尼尔矢量取向和磁畴演化的局域探针。

articles.title: Quantum resetting with memory
articles.title_zh: 具有记忆的量子重置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02297v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a quantum stochastic resetting protocol with uniform memory, in which each resetting event returns the system to a state visited at a time chosen uniformly from its entire history. The resulting dynamics is nonunitary, non-Markovian and a direct quantum generalization of the classical preferential relocation model. Working in the energy eigenbasis, we derive the exact evolution of every density-matrix element for an arbitrary time-independent Hamiltonian and show that the Hamiltonian enters the dynamics only through the corresponding Bohr frequencies. This leads to a natural distinction between two classes of quantum systems: gapped and gapless. In emphgapped systems (systems with a discrete energy spectrum), while the diagonal elements remain unchanged, the off-diagonal elements of the density matrix in the energy eigenbasis decay algebraically with a continuously varying exponent and with an amplitude that oscillates periodically in łog t. The system therefore approaches a stationary state that is independent of the resetting rate and retains a strong memory of the initial state. In emphgapless systems (systems with a continuous energy spectrum), arbitrarily small Bohr frequencies prevent stationarity. Instead, the position distribution spreads on the universal (ultra-slow) scale łog(rt)/r, independently of the initial state and of the details of the Hamiltonian. We illustrate these results with a two-level system, a harmonic oscillator, and a free quantum particle, and contrast them with their classical counterparts.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种具有均匀记忆的量子随机重置协议：每次重置都将系统返回到其整个历史中均匀随机选取的某一曾访问状态。作者在能量本征基中精确求解任意时间无关哈密顿量下密度矩阵元的演化，并区分了有能隙与无能隙系统的不同长期行为。结果显示，有能隙系统趋于保留初态强记忆的定态，而无能隙系统不达到定态，位置分布以普适超慢尺度扩展。
authors: Gabriele de Mauro, Manas Kulkarni, Satya N. Majumdar
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入一种具有均匀记忆的量子随机重置协议，其中每一次重置事件都使系统返回到一个在其整个历史中均匀选取的时刻曾访问过的状态。由此产生的动力学是非幺正、非马尔可夫的，并且是经典偏好重定位模型的直接量子推广。在能量本征基中，我们推导了任意时间无关哈密顿量下每一个密度矩阵元的精确演化，并表明哈密顿量仅通过相应的玻尔频率进入动力学。这导致了对两类量子系统的自然区分：有能隙系统和无能隙系统。在有能隙系统（具有离散能谱的系统）中，虽然密度矩阵在能量本征基中的对角元保持不变，非对角元则以连续变化的指数按代数形式衰减，并且其振幅在log t中周期性振荡。因此，系统趋近于一个与重置率无关并强烈保留初始态记忆的定态。在无能隙系统（具有连续能谱的系统）中，任意小的玻尔频率都会阻止定态形成。相反，位置分布在普适的超慢尺度log(rt)/r上扩展，并且与初始态以及哈密顿量的细节无关。我们用二能级系统、谐振子和自由量子粒子说明这些结果，并将其与经典对应物进行对比。

articles.title: Colloidal Systems
articles.title_zh: 胶体系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02313v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This book has one primary goal: To get you moving quickly from learning basic principles of colloid science, to designing colloidal systems for function or motion in the lab. It is not intended to provide encyclopedic knowledge about all aspects of colloid and surface science; rather, I have chosen not to include many topics of genuine importance. In reaching the intended goal, I use two parallel strategies. First, I give practical results that can be used immediately. If there is a cumbersome calculation, I have worked to reframe it into a table or figure. This is the case for Hamaker constants and hydrodynamics of spheroids, for instance. Second, I describe the physics of various colloidal phenomena, so that you as a researcher can think about alternative strategies. In balancing algorithms with explanations, I provide plug-and-chug example problems to familiarize you with units, constants, and typical values. The practice problems provide extensions to the most basic theory that open new possibilities, while also giving results that are useful in practical and research studies. Throughout the book, I provide data we commonly use for viscosities, zeta potentials, ionic phenomena, and other parameters. Rather than providing every reference and every technique, I have provided those references and techniques that we most often use in our lab. In the end, this book aims not to be an exhaustive study of colloids, but rather to be a doorway to producing desired colloidal systems as quickly as possible.
articles.abstract_zh: 这本书旨在帮助读者从胶体科学基本原理快速过渡到在实验室中设计具有功能或运动能力的胶体系统。作者强调实用结果和物理解释并重，将复杂计算尽量转化为表格或图示，并提供示例与练习以帮助研究者掌握常用参数和设计思路。该书并非胶体与表面科学的百科全书，而是通向快速构建目标胶体系统的入门路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这本书有一个主要目标：让你能够从学习胶体科学的基本原理，快速进入在实验室中为功能或运动而设计胶体系统的阶段。它并不意在提供关于胶体和表面科学所有方面的百科全书式知识；相反，我选择不纳入许多确实重要的主题。为实现预期目标，我采用两条并行策略。首先，我给出可以立即使用的实用结果。如果存在繁琐的计算，我会努力将其重新表述为表格或图形。例如，哈马克常数和椭球体流体动力学就是这种情况。其次，我描述各种胶体现象的物理学，使你作为研究者能够思考替代策略。在平衡算法与解释时，我提供了可直接套用的例题，以帮助你熟悉单位、常数和典型数值。练习题提供了对最基本理论的扩展，开启新的可能性，同时也给出对实际研究和科研工作有用的结果。全书中，我提供了我们常用的关于黏度、ζ电位、离子现象和其他参数的数据。与其提供每一条参考文献和每一种技术，我提供的是我们实验室最常使用的那些参考文献和技术。最终，这本书的目标不是对胶体进行穷尽式研究，而是成为尽可能快速地产生所需胶体系统的一扇门。

articles.title: Optical switching of magnetic order in few-layer CrSBr
articles.title_zh: 少层CrSBr中磁有序的光学切换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Manipulating magnetism with light is crucial for both fundamental understanding and technological advancements of information storage devices. The layered antiferromagnet CrSBr, part of the recently emerging class of two-dimensional van der Waals magnets, offers a unique path towards optical control of magnetism via magneto-excitons, which allow optical readout of the spin alignment and also provide a strong absorption channel. Here, we use exciton absorption and photoluminescence to demonstrate optical switching of the magnetic order in bi- and trilayer CrSBr. Using a continuous-wave laser with a power as low as a few microwatts at near-critical external magnetic fields, we demonstrate both local and remote switching of the magnetic configuration in extended lateral domains and further employ this mechanism to deterministically prepare the zero-field magnetic configuration. Our results establish optical switching as a useful means of controlling magnetism in CrSBr, with potential applications in magneto-optoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维范德华层状反铁磁体CrSBr中利用光操控磁性的机制。作者通过激子吸收和光致发光，在双层和三层CrSBr中展示了磁有序的光学切换，并在近临界外磁场下用微瓦级连续波激光实现局域和远程切换。该机制还可用于确定性制备零场磁构型，显示出磁光电子器件应用潜力。
authors: Lukas Husel, Julian Trapp, Moritz Würf, Anna Rupp, Tim Wedl, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Iva Plutnarova, Zdenek Sofer, Alexander Högele
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用光操控磁性对于信息存储器件的基础理解和技术进步都至关重要。层状反铁磁体CrSBr属于近来兴起的二维范德华磁体类别，它通过磁激子提供了一条通向磁性光学控制的独特路径；磁激子允许对自旋排列进行光学读出，同时也提供强吸收通道。在这里，我们利用激子吸收和光致发光，展示了双层和三层CrSBr中磁有序的光学切换。在接近临界的外加磁场下，我们使用功率低至几微瓦的连续波激光，在扩展的横向畴中展示了磁构型的局域和远程切换，并进一步利用这一机制确定性地制备零场磁构型。我们的结果确立了光学切换作为控制CrSBr中磁性的一种有用手段，并具有在磁光电子器件中的潜在应用。

articles.title: Superconducting ternary compounds Li-X-B (X=Mo, W) within the mild pressure range: First-principles predictions
articles.title_zh: 温和压力范围内Li-X-B（X=Mo, W）三元超导化合物：第一性原理预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02362v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Among the superconducting hydrides under high pressure, a number of studies concentrate on the ternary compounds to explore unique superconductors, which are capable of reducing the stable pressure and maintain superconductivity. In this work, to verify our proposed strategy of ternary composition lines (TCLs) to explore ternary compounds, we combined the first-principles calculations and crystal structure predictions to study the ternary compounds Li-X-B (X=Mo, W) under high pressure. After calculations along five and four TCLs in Li-W-B and Li-Mo-B, respectively, five Li-W-B compounds and four Li-Mo-B compounds were predicted. The compositions of LiWB4, Li4MoB2 and LiMo2B2 could be thermodynamically stable under high pressure, and Li2WB6 is around 0.02 eV/atom above the convex hull at 0 GPa, which has potential for synthesizing. Both of the predicted Li2WB6 P6/mmm and Li2WB4 R-3m are superconducting and their Tc are around 11 K, which are similar to the Tc of WB2 P6/mmm around 100 GPa. An anomalous increase of Tc was found in Li4MoB2 C2/m upon compression. We carried out full ternary search (FTS) to evaluate the validity of the TCLs strategy in Li-W-B system at 0 GPa. Our results are helpful for understanding the phase diagram of Li-X-B (X=Mo, W) under high pressure and the introducing of Li atoms provide candidate structures to reduce the measured stable pressure from ~100 GPa in WB2 P6/mmm to 0 GPa. Meanwhile, we preliminary validate the strategy of TCLs in structure predictions and we expect to improve this strategy in the future, shedding light on the studies of ternary compounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用第一性原理计算和晶体结构预测，研究高压下Li-W-B与Li-Mo-B三元化合物，并检验三元组成线策略。作者预测了多种Li-W-B和Li-Mo-B化合物，其中若干组成在高压下热力学稳定，部分结构表现出约11 K的超导转变温度。研究有助于理解Li-X-B体系高压相图，并提出通过引入Li降低稳定压力的候选结构。
authors: Bangshuai Zhu, Juefei Wu, Dexi Shao, Junjie Wang, Yu Han, Cuiying Pei, Qi Wang, Jian Sun, Yanpeng Qi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在高压超导氢化物中，许多研究集中于三元化合物，以探索能够降低稳定压力并保持超导性的独特超导体。在这项工作中，为了验证我们提出的用于探索三元化合物的三元组成线（TCLs）策略，我们结合第一性原理计算和晶体结构预测，研究了高压下的三元化合物Li-X-B（X=Mo, W）。在分别沿Li-W-B中的五条TCL和Li-Mo-B中的四条TCL进行计算之后，我们预测了五种Li-W-B化合物和四种Li-Mo-B化合物。LiWB4、Li4MoB2和LiMo2B2的组成在高压下可能热力学稳定，而Li2WB6在0 GPa时位于凸包以上约0.02 eV/原子，具有合成潜力。预测得到的Li2WB6 P6/mmm和Li2WB4 R-3m均为超导体，其Tc约为11 K，与约100 GPa下WB2 P6/mmm的Tc相近。在Li4MoB2 C2/m中发现了压缩时Tc的异常升高。我们进行了完整三元搜索（FTS），以评估TCLs策略在0 GPa下Li-W-B体系中的有效性。我们的结果有助于理解高压下Li-X-B（X=Mo, W）的相图，并且Li原子的引入提供了候选结构，可将WB2 P6/mmm中约100 GPa的实测稳定压力降低到0 GPa。同时，我们初步验证了TCLs策略在结构预测中的作用，并期望未来改进这一策略，从而为三元化合物研究提供启示。

articles.title: Bayesian Inference with Structured Signal: Static Replica Symmetry Breaking on the Nishimori Line in the Planted Spin Glass
articles.title_zh: 结构化信号的贝叶斯推断：植入自旋玻璃中西森线上的静态副本对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A common assumption in theoretical models of Bayesian inference is that the signal has i.i.d. components. To study the effect of correlations in the signal prior, we consider a minimal model: the planted spin glass on random regular graphs, where the signal is sampled from an Ising model with coupling κ. Depending on the phase of the prior, we find that adding structure in the signal can either help or hinder inference. In the paramagnetic regime, correlations in the signal lower the reconstruction threshold, so that weaker signal strength is sufficient for recovery. In the ferromagnetic regime, the prior alone already enables partial recovery, and we identify the threshold above which the observations provide additional information. When the prior itself is in a replica symmetry breaking (RSB) phase, we detect a static RSB transition in the posterior under Nishimori conditions. This provides an example where a non-separable, correlated prior leads to static RSB in a Bayes-optimal inference problem. We discuss the consequences of this glassy phase for algorithmic performance, in particular for Belief Propagation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究贝叶斯推断中信号先验具有相关性时的影响，采用随机正则图上的植入自旋玻璃作为最小模型。结果表明，信号结构可能帮助也可能阻碍推断：顺磁先验中相关性降低重构阈值，铁磁先验中先验本身已支持部分恢复，而观测何时提供额外信息存在明确阈值。当前验处于副本对称性破缺相时，作者在满足西森条件的后验中发现静态副本对称性破缺，并讨论其对置信传播等算法的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 贝叶斯推断理论模型中的一个常见假设是信号具有独立同分布的分量。为研究信号先验中的相关性影响，我们考虑一个最小模型：随机正则图上的植入自旋玻璃，其中信号从耦合为κ的伊辛模型中采样。根据信号先验所处的相，我们发现向信号中加入结构既可能帮助推断，也可能阻碍推断。在顺磁区域，信号中的相关性降低了重构阈值，因此较弱的信号强度也足以实现恢复。在铁磁区域，先验本身已经能够实现部分恢复，并且我们确定了观测提供额外信息所需超过的阈值。当前验本身处于副本对称性破缺（RSB）相时，我们在西森条件下的后验中检测到静态RSB转变。这提供了一个例子，说明非可分离的相关先验会在贝叶斯最优推断问题中导致静态RSB。我们讨论了这一玻璃态相对算法性能的后果，特别是对置信传播的影响。

articles.title: Second-harmonic generation in twisted double bilayer graphene: Double-resonant enhancement from moiré flat bands
articles.title_zh: 扭转双双层石墨烯中的二次谐波产生：来自莫尔平带的双共振增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate second-harmonic generation (SHG) in twisted double bilayer graphene (TDBG) with AB--AB and AB--BA stacking configurations using a perturbative approach based on an effective continuum Hamiltonian. We present a systematic analysis of the SHG response as a function of twist angle, vertical bias voltage, Fermi energy, and stacking configuration. We find that the SHG signal is strongly enhanced at small twist angles due to the emergence of moiré flat bands and the associated increase in the joint density of states. Beyond this conventional enhancement mechanism, we demonstrate that the reduced bandwidth enables a pronounced double-resonant process, in which optical transitions at both ømega and 2ømega are simultaneously satisfied over extended regions of the moiré Brillouin zone. This mechanism leads to a substantial amplification of the SHG response, analogous to the enhancement observed in systems with discrete energy levels, but realised here in a tuneable moiré band structure. Furthermore, we show that the AB--AB and AB--BA configurations exhibit a systematic π phase shift in the SHG response at large bias voltages, reflecting their distinct symmetry and electronic structure. Our results identify double-resonance effects as a generic mechanism for enhancing SHG in moiré systems and provide a unified framework for understanding and controlling nonlinear optical responses in tuneable flat-band materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上研究AB-AB和AB-BA堆垛扭转双双层石墨烯中的二次谐波产生响应。结果显示，小扭角下莫尔平带和联合态密度增加会强烈增强SHG信号，而窄带宽还允许在ω和2ω处同时满足光学跃迁的双共振过程，进一步显著放大响应。研究还发现两种堆垛在大偏压下SHG响应存在系统性π相移，为调控平带材料非线性光学响应提供了统一框架。
authors: Takaaki V. Joya, Takuto Kawakami, Mikito Koshino
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用基于有效连续哈密顿量的微扰方法，从理论上研究了具有AB--AB和AB--BA堆垛构型的扭转双双层石墨烯（TDBG）中的二次谐波产生（SHG）。我们系统分析了SHG响应随扭转角、垂直偏置电压、费米能和堆垛构型的变化。我们发现，由于莫尔平带的出现以及相关的联合态密度增加，小扭转角下SHG信号得到强烈增强。除了这种常规增强机制之外，我们还证明，减小的带宽使一种显著的双共振过程成为可能，其中在ω和2ω处的光学跃迁可在莫尔布里渊区的扩展区域内同时得到满足。这一机制导致SHG响应大幅放大，类似于离散能级系统中观察到的增强，但在这里是在可调谐的莫尔能带结构中实现的。此外，我们表明，AB--AB和AB--BA构型在大偏置电压下的SHG响应表现出系统性的π相位移动，反映了它们不同的对称性和电子结构。我们的结果将双共振效应确定为增强莫尔体系中SHG的一种普适机制，并为理解和控制可调谐平带材料中的非线性光学响应提供了统一框架。

articles.title: Floquet spin-group framework and its application to light-tailored spin splitting in collinear magnets
articles.title_zh: Floquet自旋群框架及其在共线磁体中光调控自旋劈裂的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02393v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine momentum-dependent spin splitting with vanishing net magnetization, opening new opportunities for spintronics. Recent studies have shown that periodic driving by linearly or circularly polarized light, as well as by multicolor light fields, can control spin splitting in altermagnets and conventional antiferromagnets, and can even generate spin splitting patterns absent in equilibrium. Despite this progress, a unified principle connecting the dynamical symmetry of light to the symmetry of spin-split bands remains lacking, limiting the systematic design of light-induced spin structures. Here, by combining the spin group of crystals with the dynamical group of light, we establish a unified Floquet spin group framework for the study of periodically driven collinear magnets with negligible spin-orbit coupling. This framework systematically determines the allowed parity, momentum dependence, and nodal structure of spin splitting under different driving protocols. Guided by this symmetry classification, we show that odd-parity, even-parity, and mixed-parity spin splittings can be switched within the same material by tailoring the driving field. We further uncover higher-order h-wave and k-wave spin splittings in three-dimensional systems. Our work establishes a unified symmetry framework for light-controlled spin splitting and provides general principles for engineering nonequilibrium spin-band structures in altermagnets and related magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出将晶体自旋群与光的动力学群相结合的Floquet自旋群框架，用于研究周期驱动、弱自旋轨道耦合共线磁体中的自旋劈裂。该框架可系统确定不同驱动方案下自旋劈裂允许的宇称、动量依赖和节点结构。作者展示了同一材料中可通过定制光场切换奇宇称、偶宇称和混合宇称自旋劈裂，并揭示三维体系中的高阶h波和k波自旋劈裂。
authors: Tongshuai Zhu, Zixuan Li, Huaiqiang Wang, Su-Huai Wei, Jiawei Ruan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体将动量依赖的自旋劈裂与净磁化为零相结合，为自旋电子学开辟了新机遇。近期研究表明，线偏振光或圆偏振光以及多色光场的周期驱动，可以控制交替磁体和常规反铁磁体中的自旋劈裂，甚至能够产生平衡态中不存在的自旋劈裂图案。尽管已有这些进展，仍缺乏将光的动力学对称性与自旋劈裂能带的对称性联系起来的统一原则，这限制了光诱导自旋结构的系统设计。在这里，通过将晶体的自旋群与光的动力学群相结合，我们建立了一个统一的Floquet自旋群框架，用于研究具有可忽略自旋轨道耦合的周期驱动共线磁体。该框架系统地确定了不同驱动方案下自旋劈裂所允许的宇称、动量依赖性和节点结构。在这一对称性分类的指导下，我们表明，通过定制驱动场，可以在同一种材料中切换奇宇称、偶宇称和混合宇称自旋劈裂。我们进一步揭示了三维体系中的高阶h波和k波自旋劈裂。我们的工作建立了一个用于光控自旋劈裂的统一对称性框架，并为在交替磁体及相关磁性材料中工程化非平衡自旋能带结构提供了普适原则。

articles.title: Magnetically tunable symmetry-enforced nodal lines producing huge anomalous Hall conductivity in altermagnetic α-MnTe
articles.title_zh: 交替磁性α-MnTe中产生巨大反常霍尔电导的磁可调对称性强制节点线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetic α-MnTe exhibits huge anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) up to room-temperature together with weak ferromagnetism arising from spin and orbital polarizations. We clarify the origin of the large value of the AHC by identifying two sets of distinct symmetry-enforced nodal lines in the valence bands with Mn character, located at k_z=0 and k_z=fracπc, protected by mirror symmetry M_z and glide symmetry G_z = M_z,|,0,0,tfracc2, respectively. Both nodal lines are energy-dependent with an approximate C₆ symmetry, which is reduced to an exact C₂ symmetry due to the presence of the Néel vector. The highest valence band exhibits a Mexican-hat dispersion, whereas the second-highest valence band exhibits an inverted Mexican-hat dispersion, with nodal lines at the crossing between the two bands. Within first-principles accuracy, we demonstrate that these nodal lines give rise to the large AHC observed experimentally and exhibit a strong interplay with the weak ferromagnetism. We further show that even a small spin canting strongly modifies the nodal lines and the AHC, making them both magnetically tunable. By disentangling the altermagnetic and ferromagnetic contributions to the AHC, the altermagnetic contribution dominates at small canting angles, while the ferromagnetic contribution becomes sizeable for larger values. Using linear dichroism in angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we show a signature of the nodal line at the border of the Brillouin zone.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文阐明交替磁性α-MnTe中室温附近巨大反常霍尔电导的起源，指出其来自价带中两组由对称性保护的节点线。作者表明，这些位于kz=0和kz=π/c的节点线分别受镜面对称性和滑移对称性保护，并与弱铁磁性强烈耦合。小的自旋倾斜即可显著改变节点线和反常霍尔电导，使二者具备磁可调性，角分辨光电子能谱线二色性也显示出节点线迹象。
authors: Mathews Benny, Xujia Gong, Amar Fakhredine, Raphaël Salazar, Ashutosh S. Wadge, Juraj Krempaský, Gunther Springholz, Sarath Sasi, Dawid Wutke, Rafał Kurleto, Natalia Olszowska, Sahar Izadi Vishkayi, Asiyeh Shokri, Ján Minár, Carmine Ortix, Jeroen van den Brink, Jakub Schusser, Carmine Autieri
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁性α-MnTe表现出可达室温的巨大反常霍尔电导（AHC），同时具有由自旋和轨道极化产生的弱铁磁性。我们通过识别价带中具有Mn特征的两组不同的对称性强制节点线，阐明了AHC大数值的起源；这些节点线分别位于k_z=0和k_z=π/c，并分别受到镜面对称性M_z和滑移对称性G_z = M_z | 0,0,c/2的保护。两种节点线都是能量依赖的，并具有近似C6对称性，而由于尼尔矢量的存在，该对称性降低为精确的C2对称性。最高价带表现出墨西哥帽色散，而次高价带表现出反转的墨西哥帽色散，节点线位于两条能带的交叉处。在第一性原理精度范围内，我们证明这些节点线产生了实验中观察到的大AHC，并且与弱铁磁性表现出强烈相互作用。我们进一步表明，即使很小的自旋倾斜也会强烈改变节点线和AHC，使二者都具有磁可调性。通过解缠AHC中的交替磁性贡献和铁磁性贡献，我们发现小倾斜角下交替磁性贡献占主导，而在较大倾斜角下铁磁性贡献变得可观。利用角分辨光电子能谱中的线二色性，我们展示了布里渊区边界处节点线的一个特征信号。

articles.title: Screening phonon-mediated superconductors from static orbital Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 从静态轨道哈密顿量筛选声子介导超导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The first-principles search for superconductors is severely limited by the high cost of electron-phonon coupling (EPC) calculations. Here we develop a low-cost, physically transparent framework that identifies strong-EPC materials directly from static orbital-based Hamiltonians without explicit phonon perturbation calculations. Verification using density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) for representative superconductors shows that the framework captures semi-quantitatively the EPC scale at substantially lower computational cost. Applied to more than 36,000 compounds in the MattKeyBond database, it identifies 34 dynamically stable superconducting candidates with calculated T_c > 10 K after DFPT verification. These candidates reveal two distinct routes to relatively high-T_c superconductivity: a metallized covalent σ-bond route that is more favorable for achieving high-T_c superconductors, and a Fermi-level density-of-states accumulation route that can enhance T_c but usually to a more limited extent.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种低成本、物理图像清晰的框架，可在不进行显式声子微扰计算的情况下，从静态轨道基哈密顿量中识别强电子-声子耦合材料。通过密度泛函微扰理论验证，该框架能以更低计算成本半定量捕捉电子-声子耦合尺度。应用于MattKeyBond数据库中超过36000种化合物后，作者筛选并验证出34种动力学稳定且计算Tc大于10 K的候选超导体，并总结了两条相对高Tc路径。
authors: Jian-Feng Zhang, Ze-Feng Gao, Xiao-Qi Han, Dingshun Lv, Miao Gao, Kai Liu, Xinguo Ren, Zhong-Yi Lu, Tao Xiang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于第一性原理寻找超导体受到电子-声子耦合（EPC）计算高成本的严重限制。在这里，我们发展了一个低成本、物理上透明的框架，它无需显式的声子微扰计算，即可直接从静态的轨道基哈密顿量中识别强EPC材料。利用密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）对代表性超导体进行验证表明，该框架能够以显著更低的计算成本半定量地捕捉EPC尺度。将其应用于MattKeyBond数据库中超过36,000种化合物后，经DFPT验证，它识别出34种动力学稳定且计算T_c > 10 K的超导候选材料。这些候选材料揭示了通向相对高T_c超导性的两条不同路径：一条是金属化共价σ键路径，它更有利于实现高T_c超导体；另一条是费米能级态密度积累路径，它可以提高T_c，但通常提升幅度更为有限。

articles.title: Discrete states and ballistic interference in quantum wires approaching macroscopic lengths
articles.title_zh: 接近宏观长度的量子线中的离散态与弹道干涉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Increasing the size of a system showing quantum effects is a difficult task limited by decoherence, a diminishing quantum level spacing, and the effects of disorder spoiling the quantum behavior when growing in size. Systems in 1D offer very strong confinement in the transverse directions, thus generally enhancing quantum effects, but are notoriously sensitive to disorder. In this work, we present a system of 1D electrons exhibiting discrete quantum levels and fully ballistic coherent quantum interference with lengths of up to 18,μm. Tunneling spectroscopy between two parallel quantum wires with a central gated segment shows intricate interference patterns exhibiting several different periods in magnetic field and density. An analysis over three different wire lengths and a comparison with single particle numerical simulations without any free parameters remarkably explains the full pattern including the observed periods. Therefore, these wires are essentially ideal 1D systems with aspect ratios approaching 1'000. In addition, at low bias, we also observe not only the Coulomb charging energies but can clearly resolve the discrete orbital and spin states in up to 10,μm long wires when filling 100 electrons with the center gate. This is made visible by a state-of-the-art low temperature and low noise measurement system. The spin filling sequence is completely regular, strictly alternating spin up and down, avoiding high spin states, while the peak conductance is modulated in accordance with the previously discussed interference patterns. These striking results show that single particle Schrödinger quantum mechanics such as ballistic quantum interference and discrete quantum states may be observed, under the right conditions, in systems of up to 18,μm length, thus approaching macroscopic sizes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一维电子系统在长度最高达18微米时仍表现出离散量子能级和完全弹道相干量子干涉。通过两条平行量子线间的隧穿谱，作者观察到随磁场和密度变化的复杂干涉图案，并用无自由参数的单粒子数值模拟解释了不同长度样品的完整图案。低偏压下还可在最长10微米量子线中解析库仑充电能、离散轨道态和自旋态，表明在合适条件下单粒子薛定谔量子力学可扩展到接近宏观尺寸的系统。
authors: Henok Weldeyesus, Taras Patlatiuk, Christian P. Scheller, Amir Yacoby, Loren N. Pfeiffer, Ken W. West, Dominik M. Zumbühl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 增大表现出量子效应的系统尺寸是一项困难任务，受到退相干、量子能级间距减小以及尺寸增大时破坏量子行为的无序效应的限制。一维系统在横向方向上提供非常强的限制，因此通常会增强量子效应，但它们也以对无序极其敏感而著称。在这项工作中，我们展示了一个一维电子系统，其在长度最高达18 μm时表现出离散量子能级和完全弹道的相干量子干涉。带有中心栅控段的两条平行量子线之间的隧穿谱显示出复杂的干涉图案，在磁场和密度上表现出几个不同的周期。对三种不同线长的分析，以及与不含任何自由参数的单粒子数值模拟的比较，令人瞩目地解释了包括观测周期在内的完整图案。因此，这些量子线本质上是理想的一维系统，其长宽比接近1000。此外，在低偏压下，当用中心栅填充100个电子时，我们不仅观察到库仑充电能，而且能够在最长达10 μm的量子线中清晰分辨离散的轨道态和自旋态。这得益于最先进的低温低噪声测量系统。自旋填充序列完全规则，严格交替为自旋向上和自旋向下，避免了高自旋态，而峰值电导则按照前述干涉图案受到调制。这些惊人的结果表明，在合适条件下，诸如弹道量子干涉和离散量子态这样的单粒子薛定谔量子力学现象，可以在长度最高达18 μm、从而接近宏观尺寸的系统中被观察到。

articles.title: Real-time dynamics of the two-step charge-density-wave transition in bulk 1T-TaS₂
articles.title_zh: 块体1T-TaS₂中两步电荷密度波转变的实时动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02456v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The charge-density wave (CDW) of bulk 1T-TaS2 is built from Star-of-David (SoD) clusters tiling a sqrt13 x sqrt13 superlattice, and it melts through a two-step sequence accompanied by order-of-magnitude changes in resistivity. Whether these steps proceed by collapse of the SoD amplitude or by rearrangement of the SoD lattice has remained unresolved, because the relevant dynamics occur on length and time scales beyond the reach of ab initio molecular dynamics. Here we follow the CDW transitions in real time using a machine-learning force field trained on first-principles data, giving access to 1404-atom supercells over 5 ns. The two steps are mechanistically distinct. Above 200 K, SoD clusters translate coherently by transiently dissolving and re-forming about shifted centers, a deformation-formation process that preserves the local SoD amplitude while randomizing the interlayer stacking order and nucleating domain walls. Only near 350 K does the SoD distortion itself collapse. These results provide microscopic support for the recently proposed two-step model of the CDW transition and offer a framework for interpreting light-induced hidden phases and cavity-modified transition temperatures in 1T-TaS2.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用以第一性原理数据训练的机器学习力场，实时跟踪块体1T-TaS2中电荷密度波转变，覆盖1404原子超胞和5纳秒时间尺度。结果表明，两步转变机制不同：200 K以上星形大卫簇通过暂时溶解并在平移中心重组实现相干平移，而局域畸变幅度基本保留；接近350 K时星形大卫畸变本身才坍塌。研究为1T-TaS2电荷密度波两步转变模型提供微观支持，并有助于理解光诱导隐藏相和腔调控转变温度。
authors: Daeheon Kim, Jinseok Oh, Kahyeon Koh, Yejun Cho, Angel Rubio, Noejung Park, Dongbin Shin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 块体1T-TaS2的电荷密度波（CDW）由星形大卫（SoD）团簇构成，这些团簇铺排成sqrt13 × sqrt13超晶格，并且它通过一个两步序列熔化，同时伴随电阻率数量级的变化。这些步骤究竟是通过SoD振幅的坍塌进行，还是通过SoD晶格的重排进行，一直未得到解决，因为相关动力学发生在从头算分子动力学难以达到的长度和时间尺度上。在这里，我们使用以第一性原理数据训练的机器学习力场，实时跟踪CDW转变，从而能够研究包含1404个原子的超胞并持续5 ns。两步转变在机制上截然不同。在200 K以上，SoD团簇通过围绕平移后的中心暂时溶解并重新形成而发生相干平移，这一变形-形成过程保留了局域SoD振幅，同时使层间堆垛有序随机化并成核畴壁。只有在接近350 K时，SoD畸变本身才会坍塌。这些结果为近期提出的CDW转变两步模型提供了微观支持，并为解释1T-TaS2中的光诱导隐藏相和腔调控转变温度提供了框架。

articles.title: Optimized Tensor-Network Renormalization for Quantum Dynamics: Resolving the Spectral Function of K₂Co(SeO₃₎₂
articles.title_zh: 用于量子动力学的优化张量网络重整化：解析 K₂Co(SeO₃)₂ 的谱函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tensor-network methods have opened a powerful route for the study of dynamical spectral functions in two-dimensional quantum systems. However, existing approaches within the framework of infinite projected entangled-pair states construct the required renormalization tensors solely from the ground-state environment and can suffer from severe numerical instability. We identify the origin of this instability and introduce an excitation-tailored corner-transfer-matrix renormalization-group (ET-CTMRG) method to resolve it. By incorporating excitation tensors into the renormalization procedure, the method constructs a substantially more accurate effective Hamiltonian matrix and thereby yields reliable and well-converged excitation spectra. For Heisenberg antiferromagnets, it reduces truncation errors by orders of magnitude and for the particularly complex case of the supersolid phase in the triangular-lattice XXZ magnet K₂Co(SeO₃₎₂, it achieves excellent quantitative agreement with inelastic neutron-scattering measurements. ET-CTMRG therefore provides a robust framework for investigating the dynamical properties of strongly correlated quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向激发的角转移矩阵重整化群（ET-CTMRG）方法，以解决无限投影纠缠对态框架中动力学谱函数计算的数值不稳定问题。该方法将激发张量纳入重整化过程，从而构造更准确的有效哈密顿量并获得可靠收敛的激发谱。其在海森堡反铁磁体和三角晶格 XXZ 磁体 K₂Co(SeO₃)₂ 的超固相中显著降低误差，并与非弹性中子散射实验取得良好一致。
authors: Jiahang Hu, Runze Chi, B. Normand, Hai-Jun Liao, T. Xiang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 张量网络方法为研究二维量子系统中的动力学谱函数开辟了一条强有力的途径。然而，现有的无限投影纠缠对态框架内的方法仅从基态环境构造所需的重整化张量，因而可能遭受严重的数值不稳定性。我们确定了这种不稳定性的来源，并引入一种面向激发的角转移矩阵重整化群（ET-CTMRG）方法来解决这一问题。通过将激发张量纳入重整化过程，该方法构造出显著更精确的有效哈密顿量矩阵，从而给出可靠且良好收敛的激发谱。对于海森堡反铁磁体，它将截断误差降低了数个数量级；对于三角晶格 XXZ 磁体 K₂Co(SeO₃)₂ 中特别复杂的超固相情形，它与非弹性中子散射测量实现了极佳的定量一致。因此，ET-CTMRG 为研究强关联量子系统的动力学性质提供了一个稳健框架。

articles.title: Superconducting dome due to the Fano-Feshbach shape resonance in artificial high-Tc superlattices
articles.title_zh: 人工高 Tc 超晶格中由 Fano-Feshbach 形状共振导致的超导穹顶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we provide compelling experimental validation of the Bianconi Perali Valletta (BPV) theory predicting a superconducting dome based on a quantum material design of Artificial High TC Superlattices (AHTS) made with a selected nanoscale heterostructure geometry. These AHTS are SNSN superlattices of quantum wells of period d, composed of first units, superconducting doped Mott insulator layers with Rashba spin orbit coupling (S) of thickness L, intercalated by second units, normal metal spacers (N). In these superlattices, grown by molecular beam epitaxy (MBE), the experimental superconducting dome is obtained by material quantum design changing the chemical potential via the quantum geometrical factor L/d which tunes the Fano-Feshbach shape resonance in the pair transfer between superconducting gaps in the BCS regime and different gaps in the BEC-BCS crossover. Here we present a systematic magneto-transport study of AHTS artificial superlattices across the full doping range of the superconducting dome, from the deeply underdoped to the overdoped regime, using pulsed magnetic fields up to 72 T. By varying the L/d ratio, we tune the effective hole concentration delta=0.45(1-L/d) and map the evolution of the resistive transitions, the upper critical magnetic field and the Ginzburg-Landau coherence length
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为 Bianconi–Perali–Valletta（BPV）理论提供实验验证，该理论预言可通过人工高 Tc 超晶格的量子材料设计形成超导穹顶。研究对象为由超导掺杂莫特绝缘层与正常金属间隔层构成的 SNSN 超晶格，其化学势可通过几何因子 L/d 调控。作者在最高 72 T 脉冲磁场下系统研究了整个超导穹顶掺杂范围内的磁输运行为，考察电阻转变、上临界场和 Ginzburg-Landau 相干长度的演化。
authors: Gaetano Campi, Andrea Alimenti, Danielle Villa, G. Alexander Smith, Fedor F. Balakirev, Luis Balicas, Andrea Perali, Sergio Caprara, Gennady Logvenov, Antonio Bianconi1
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本工作中，我们为 Bianconi Perali Valletta（BPV）理论提供了有力的实验验证；该理论预言，基于由特定纳米尺度异质结构几何构型制成的人工高 TC 超晶格（AHTS）的量子材料设计，可以产生一个超导穹顶。这些 AHTS 是周期为 d 的量子阱 SNSN 超晶格，由第一类单元——具有 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的超导掺杂莫特绝缘体层（S），其厚度为 L——与第二类单元——正常金属间隔层（N）——相互插层组成。在这些通过分子束外延（MBE）生长的超晶格中，实验上的超导穹顶是通过材料量子设计获得的，即通过量子几何因子 L/d 改变化学势；该因子调控 BCS 区域中的超导能隙与 BEC-BCS 交叉区域中的不同能隙之间配对转移的 Fano-Feshbach 形状共振。这里，我们利用最高达 72 T 的脉冲磁场，对跨越超导穹顶完整掺杂范围——从深度欠掺杂到过掺杂区域——的 AHTS 人工超晶格进行了系统的磁输运研究。通过改变 L/d 比值，我们调控有效空穴浓度 δ=0.45(1-L/d)，并绘制电阻转变、上临界磁场以及 Ginzburg-Landau 相干长度的演化图景。

articles.title: Revealing Intrinsic Anisotropy of Collective Magnetic Excitations in Twinned Crystals of a Kitaev-Heisenberg Quantum Magnet
articles.title_zh: 揭示 Kitaev-Heisenberg 量子磁体孪晶晶体中集体磁激发的本征各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02531v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum magnets with competing interactions often emerge from delicate balances among microscopic parameters, making it essential to disentangle intrinsic spin dynamics from extrinsic disorder effects. Here, we introduce a multimodal optical approach combining magneto-infrared spectroscopy with domain-resolved micro-Raman spectroscopy at high magnetic fields to reconstruct the intrinsic magnetic excitation spectrum of twinned crystals of the Kitaev-Heisenberg quantum magnet Na₃Co₂SbO₆. Far-infrared spectroscopy reveals multiple field-tunable magnetic excitations, but the intrinsic response is obscured by replica features arising from twin domains. By correlating magneto-infrared and domain-resolved Raman spectra, we isolate the single-domain magnon response and uncover a pronounced twofold in-plane magnon anisotropy. This anisotropy far exceeds that expected from the measured in-plane g-factor anisotropy and is instead dominated by anisotropic bond-dependent exchange interactions. By unifying high-field, high-resolution and spatially selective optical probes, our work establishes a broadly applicable framework for revealing intrinsic spin dynamics and constraining the spin Hamiltonian in multidomain quantum magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种结合高磁场磁红外光谱与畴分辨微拉曼光谱的多模态光学方法，用于重构孪晶 Na₃Co₂SbO₆ 的本征磁激发谱。远红外谱显示多个随磁场可调的磁激发，但孪晶畴产生的复制特征会掩盖本征响应。通过关联两类光谱，作者分离出单畴磁振子响应，并发现显著的面内二重磁振子各向异性，其主要来源于各向异性、键依赖的交换相互作用。
authors: Naipeng Zhang, Nikolai Simonov, Mykhaylo Ozerov, Sumedh Rathi, Nolan Heffner, Sara Huszar, Long Chen, Haidong Zhou, Guangxin Ni, Chaebin Kim, Martin Mourigal, Stephen M. Winter, Zhigang Jiang, Dmitry Smirnov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有竞争相互作用的量子磁体往往源自微观参数之间的精细平衡，因此有必要将本征自旋动力学与外在无序效应区分开来。在这里，我们引入一种多模态光学方法，将高磁场下的磁红外光谱与畴分辨微拉曼光谱相结合，以重构 Kitaev-Heisenberg 量子磁体 Na₃Co₂SbO₆ 的孪晶晶体中的本征磁激发谱。远红外光谱揭示了多个可随磁场调谐的磁激发，但本征响应被来自孪晶畴的复制特征所遮蔽。通过关联磁红外谱和畴分辨拉曼谱，我们分离出单畴磁振子响应，并揭示出显著的面内二重磁振子各向异性。这种各向异性远超由测得的面内 g 因子各向异性所预期的程度，而是主要由各向异性的键依赖交换相互作用主导。通过统一高磁场、高分辨率和空间选择性光学探针，我们的工作建立了一个可广泛应用的框架，用于揭示多畴量子磁体中的本征自旋动力学并约束其自旋哈密顿量。

articles.title: Magnetic Skyrmion Interacting with Optical Skyrmion
articles.title_zh: 磁斯格明子与光学斯格明子的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions (MSks) and optical skyrmions (OSks) embody topology in matter and in light, respectively. Here we investigate the interaction between a single MSk and an OSk beam. Three distinct nonlinear dynamical modes are identified: rotation, skipping, and trochoidal motion. By decomposing the optical driving force into gradient, orbital-angular-momentum, and spin-angular-momentum contributions, we clarify their respective roles of radial confinement, azimuthal drift, and precessional modulation. The skipping motion arises from the azimuthal asymmetry of the OSk beam and exhibits spatial selectivity originating from the magnetization-polarization coupling between the MSk and OSk. In three dimensions, the coupling acquires a propagation-dependent phase dominated by the differential Gouy phase, which yields z-asymmetric skipping trajectories. These results bridge topological particles and topological fields within a unified framework, offering helicity-selective and phase-programmable routes to optomagnonic control.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究单个磁斯格明子与光学斯格明子光束之间的相互作用，识别出旋转、跳跃和次摆线运动三种非线性动力学模式。作者将光学驱动力分解为梯度、轨道角动量和自旋角动量贡献，阐明其在径向束缚、方位漂移和进动调制中的作用。研究还指出三维传播中的差分 Gouy 相位会导致 z 方向不对称的跳跃轨迹，为光磁调控提供可按螺旋性选择和相位编程的途径。
authors: Lan Bo, Jian Chen, Xichao Zhang, Yan Zhou, Chengwei Qiu, Masahito Mochizuki
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁斯格明子（MSks）和光学斯格明子（OSks）分别体现了物质和光中的拓扑。在这里，我们研究单个 MSk 与一束 OSk 光束之间的相互作用。我们识别出三种不同的非线性动力学模式：旋转、跳跃和次摆线运动。通过将光学驱动力分解为梯度、轨道角动量和自旋角动量贡献，我们阐明了它们分别在径向束缚、方位漂移和进动调制中的作用。跳跃运动源于 OSk 光束的方位不对称性，并表现出由 MSk 与 OSk 之间磁化-偏振耦合所产生的空间选择性。在三维中，该耦合获得一个依赖传播的相位，该相位主要由差分 Gouy 相位支配，从而产生 z 方向不对称的跳跃轨迹。这些结果在统一框架内连接了拓扑粒子与拓扑场，为光磁控制提供了螺旋性选择和相位可编程的路径。

articles.title: Optimal Decoding for Measurement-Based GHZ State Preparation: The Maximum-Utility Decoder
articles.title_zh: 基于测量的 GHZ 态制备的最优解码：最大效用解码器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The meticulous preparation of macroscopic Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states provides a foundational resource for quantum technologies such as metrology, cryptography, and fault-tolerant codes. While state-of-the-art measurement-based protocols offer efficient low-depth execution, their performance can be bottlenecked by conventional decoders, such as minimum weight perfect matching (MWPM) or even maximum-likelihood decoding (MLD), which optimize for binary logical recovery and fail to maximize the continuous long-range order characteristic of a GHZ state for two-dimensional geometries. Here we overcome this limitation by framing the decoding problem as minimum Bayesian risk inference, introducing a general paradigm that maximizes the expected utility of the decoded state. Implementing this maximum-utility approach, we construct an algorithm that achieves the highest possible per-shot decoded quantum order and thereby establish an optimal decoding strategy for measurement-based GHZ state preparation. To improve its computational efficiency, we design a scalable two-stage decoder, which first encodes the syndromes into the edge weights of MWPM and then refines the result with a convolutional neural network trained to maximize the expected utility, at a fraction of the cost of the optimal decoder. Remarkably, we find that the first stage alonen̆icodex2014which makes the matching aware of the gauge choice at no cost beyond bare MWPMn̆icodex2014already performs near-optimally up to the largest sizes we study, N=256×256, closing up to 87% of the gap between the bare-MWPM and optimal decoding thresholds. Generalizing MWPM and MLD, the maximum-utility decoder (MUD) establishes a versatile framework that can be explicitly tailored to the operational demands of specific experiments by redefining the utility function.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将基于测量的 GHZ 态制备中的解码问题表述为最小贝叶斯风险推断，并提出最大效用解码器，以直接最大化解码态的期望效用和长程量子有序。作者构建了最优算法，并进一步设计两阶段可扩展解码器，将 MWPM 与卷积神经网络结合以降低计算成本。结果显示，改进后的匹配阶段在大系统尺寸上已接近最优，并且最大效用框架可根据实验需求通过效用函数进行定制。
authors: Misha Yutushui, Theo Haas, Simon Trebst
articles.abstract_zh_full: 宏观 Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger（GHZ）态的精细制备为计量学、密码学和容错编码等量子技术提供了基础性资源。尽管最先进的基于测量的协议能够实现高效、低深度的执行，但其性能可能受到传统解码器的瓶颈限制，例如最小权完美匹配（MWPM），甚至最大似然解码（MLD）；这些解码器针对二元逻辑恢复进行优化，因而未能在二维几何中最大化 GHZ 态所特有的连续长程有序。在这里，我们通过将解码问题表述为最小贝叶斯风险推断来克服这一限制，并引入一种最大化解码态期望效用的一般范式。通过实现这种最大效用方法，我们构造了一种算法，它能够达到逐次实验中已解码量子有序的最高可能值，从而为基于测量的 GHZ 态制备建立最优解码策略。为提高其计算效率，我们设计了一种可扩展的两阶段解码器：第一阶段将综合征编码进 MWPM 的边权重，第二阶段使用为最大化期望效用而训练的卷积神经网络对结果进行细化，其成本仅为最优解码器的一小部分。值得注意的是，我们发现仅第一阶段——它使匹配在除裸 MWPM 之外无需额外成本的情况下感知规范选择——在我们研究的最大尺寸 N=256×256 以内已表现得接近最优，并弥合了裸 MWPM 与最优解码阈值之间差距的最高 87%。作为 MWPM 和 MLD 的推广，最大效用解码器（MUD）建立了一个通用框架，可通过重新定义效用函数而明确地针对特定实验的操作需求进行定制。

articles.title: Phase transitions in quantum-circuit compilation
articles.title_zh: 量子线路编译中的相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00189v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum-circuit compilation aims at finding an optimized realization of a target circuit under given constraints, e.g., the minimization of hardware-induced errors and the unitary-equivalence of the circuit. We connect the compilation process with the thermodynamics of a many-body spin system: circuit infidelity plays the role of the energy function and low-temperature states correspond to compiled circuits. In the paradigmatic case where crosstalk between parallel gates is present, we find a phase transition between a disordered phase and an antiferromagnetic brick-wall phase, compatible with the Ising universality class. At larger crosstalk, we observe a Z₃₋ₒᵣdered regime, suggesting that increasingly serial compiled circuits are associated with emergent Zₙ₋ₒᵣdered phases. When the unitary-equivalence constraint is removed, these phases disappear, showing that the equivalence between circuits underlies the emergent criticality and constitutes a source of complexity in quantum-circuit compilation and, more generally, in equivalence-constrained optimization. Finally, we observe that the Kolmogorov complexity of the circuit enhances the emergence of ordered phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将量子线路编译与多体自旋系统的热力学联系起来，把线路失真度视为能量函数，低温态对应编译后的线路。在线路存在并行门串扰的典型情形中，作者发现从无序相到反铁磁砖墙相的相变，并观察到更强串扰下的 Z₃ 有序区域。研究表明，线路幺正等价约束是涌现临界性和编译复杂性的来源之一，而线路的 Kolmogorov 复杂性会增强有序相的出现。
