The maximum compressive residual stress was mainly distributed within approximately 5–13 µm below the surface. With increasing cutting speed, the maximum compressive residual stress generally decreased, whereas the specimens treated at ultrasonic frequencies of 20 and 40 kHz exhibited higher compressive residual stress levels than those treated at 0 kHz. Surface quality analysis shows that the machined surface roughness generally decreased with increasing ultrasonic frequency, with the lowest roughness obtained at 40 kHz. When the cutting speed was 1200 mm/s, the surface roughness decreased to 0.411 µm. Moreover, under the coupled effect of high-frequency ultrasonic rolling and higher cutting speed, surface defects such as grooves, material accumulation, and local tearing were significantly reduced, and the machined surface texture became finer and more uniform.

articles.title: YOLOv11-AHFE:Adaptive High-Frequency Signal Enhancement Mechanism for Surface detection
articles.abstract: Metal surface defect detection faces significant hurdles in modern intelligent manufacturing. Traditional image processing algorithms often struggle to identify complex and irregular defects, while relying solely on artificial intelligence algorithms face difficulties in achieving effective image preprocessing. This paper aims to explore an algorithm that integrates wavelet transform into deep vision to enhance detail features. Through the frequency domain decomposition of wavelet transform and attention mechanisms, high-frequency details are explicitly preserved and enhanced, making this approach particularly suitable for tasks requiring fine boundaries, such as object detection and image segmentation. The Haar wavelet achieves low computational complexity by using only integer addition and subtraction and can effectively improve model accuracy without sacrificing efficiency. The “dual-stream wavelet” is an important extension of the aforementioned Haar wavelet module, primarily reflected in two aspects: network architecture design and frequency-spatial feature fusion. While traditional wavelet modules only use Discrete Wavelet Transform Module (DWT) as a fixed preprocessing or down-sampling tool, the dual-stream wavelet significantly enhances feature representation capability through parallel architecture and learnable fusion. The Wavelet-Conv path effectively preserves details such as edges and textures by explicitly decomposing the image into LL, LH, HL, and HH sub-bands and using learnable weights to boost high-frequency components. Moreover, the standard down-sampling path learns abstract semantic features and fuses them with the former via concatenation, enabling complementary information exchange. In the dual-stream framework, the transformation from fixed wavelet bases and simple learnable weights to end-to-end adaptive fusion of two streams results in a frequency-aware, multi-receptive-field down-sampling module. Particularly, the High-Freq-Enhance module enhances high-frequency details in feature maps through residual learning. The residual connection ensures the fidelity of the original information, while the attention mechanism determines, based on global information, which channels require high-frequency enhancement. Placed in the deeper layers of the backbone, it compensates for high-frequency details attenuated by repeated down-sampling. The core insight of this architecture is that down-sampling in traditional CNNs is "discard-based", whereas wavelet-enabled down-sampling is "encoding-based" and "recoverable". Compared to standard YOLO, this approach proposes three key improvements: (1) High‑frequency information retention: Conventional down-sampling discards high‑frequency details, whereas the dual‑stream wavelet transform encodes and preserves them.(2) Multi‑path feature fusion: Standard CNNs rely solely on single‑path spatial features, while the dual‑stream design achieves effective multi‑path information integration.(3) Small‑target enhancement: After repeated down-sampling, small‑target signals are prone to being overwhelmed by noise; the proposed high‑frequency enhancement module selectively restores detailed responses to mitigate this issue.

articles.title: Numerical Modelling of High-Temperature Methane Pyrolysis Under Plasma-Inspired Thermal Gradients
articles.abstract: Methane conversion in an atmospheric-pressure reactor environment has been numerically modelled using a thermal pyrolysis kinetic framework under extreme temperature profiles representative of microwave plasma cores and exit jet. Concentration profiles along the reactor's central axis were simulated using an expanded detailed reaction mechanism. Rather than capturing explicit electron kinetics, this work focuses on the neutral radical network and chemical mechanism reduction under aggressive thermal quenching. The model predicts a net methane conversion of 98.7%, primarily yielding hydrogen, acetylene, ethylene, and butadiene. Using Principal Component Analysis (PCA), the chemical scheme was systematically reduced to 102 irreversible steps involving 26 species. The reduced model predicts critical species concentrations within 0.1% of the complete mechanism while accelerating computation time by a factor of 61, offering a computationally efficient framework for future multi-dimensional fluid dynamics coupling.

articles.title: Design of An Energy Efficient Toggled MRAM Bit-Cell
articles.title_zh: 一种节能型翻转式 MRAM 位单元的设计
articles.abstract: Spin-based, non-volatile memory bit-cells have been proposed for applications ranging from logic-in-memory computing to quantum computing. This paper deals with the toggle spin torque magnetic random-access memory (TST-MRAM) bit-cells by micromagnetic simulations. The concept of voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA) is utilized to model and simulate the designed cells. In this paper, the TST magnetization precession is studied in a nanopillar spin-valve. The magnetization switching is considered under an external magnetic field, and it is simulated with the micromagnetic simulation (MMS) toolkit to evaluate the designed toggled MRAM bit-cell parameters. The present work utilizes different material interfaces (i.e., HM-CoFeB-NM-MgO) to minimize the switching error rates during the MRAM design process. The interfacial perpendicular magnetic anisotropy-based toggled MRAM bit-cell obtains less polarization factor, more anisotropic constant, and less saturated magnetization than classical magnetic RAM models. The factors related to the designed bit cell are explained theoretically and graphically in this work. Finally, the parameters have been evaluated for the proposed toggled MRAM bit-cell and will take part in the design process.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过微磁学模拟研究了翻转自旋转矩磁随机存取存储器（TST-MRAM）位单元，并利用电压控制磁各向异性（VCMA）对所设计单元进行建模与仿真。研究在纳米柱自旋阀中考察了 TST 磁化进动，并在外磁场下模拟磁化翻转，以评估所设计翻转式 MRAM 位单元的参数。结果表明，采用 HM-CoFeB-NM-MgO 等不同材料界面可降低存储器设计过程中的翻转错误率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于自旋的非易失性存储位单元已被提出用于从存内计算到量子计算等多种应用。本文通过微磁学模拟研究了翻转自旋转矩磁随机存取存储器（TST-MRAM）位单元。设计与仿真中采用了电压控制磁各向异性（VCMA）概念。本文在纳米柱自旋阀中研究了 TST 磁化进动。磁化翻转在外加磁场下进行考虑，并利用微磁学模拟（MMS）工具包进行仿真，以评估所设计翻转式 MRAM 位单元的参数。本工作采用不同材料界面（即 HM-CoFeB-NM-MgO），以在 MRAM 设计过程中尽量降低翻转错误率。基于界面垂直磁各向异性的翻转式 MRAM 位单元相比经典磁性随机存取存储器模型，具有更低的极化因子、更大的各向异性常数以及更低的饱和磁化强度。与所设计位单元相关的各项因素在本文中通过理论和图示方式加以说明。最后，对所提出的翻转式 MRAM 位单元参数进行了评估，并将参与后续设计过程。

articles.title: An SO(3)-equivariant reciprocal space neural potential for long-range interactions
articles.title_zh: 面向长程相互作用的 SO(3) 等变倒易空间神经势
articles.abstract: Long-range electrostatic and polarization interactions play an essential role in molecular and condensed-phase systems but remain challenging for machine-learning interatomic potentials based on local atomic environments. Although SO(3)-equivariant neural potentials can learn rich representations of local geometry, atoms or molecular fragments separated by more than the real-space cutoff do not communicate directly. We introduce EquiEwald, a neural interatomic potential that extends Ewald summation to operate directly on SO(3)-equivariant tensor features rather than scalar, charge-like information. This allows reciprocal-space communication to preserve orientation-dependent information across arbitrary distances while maintaining rotational symmetry. Across periodic and aperiodic benchmarks, EquiEwald captures long-range electrostatic behavior consistent with ab initio reference data and consistently improves energy and force accuracy, data efficiency, and long-range extrapolation. These results establish EquiEwald as a physically motivated framework for incorporating long-range interactions in machine-learning interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 长程静电与极化相互作用在分子和凝聚态体系中至关重要，但对于基于局域原子环境的机器学习原子势而言仍然难以处理。本文提出 EquiEwald，一种将 Ewald 求和直接扩展到 SO(3) 等变张量特征而非标量、类电荷信息的神经原子间势。该方法使倒易空间通信能够在保持旋转对称性的同时，在任意距离上传递具有取向依赖的信息，并在周期性与非周期性基准测试中显著提升能量和力的预测精度、数据效率与长程外推能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长程静电与极化相互作用在分子和凝聚相体系中发挥着重要作用，但对于基于局域原子环境的机器学习原子间势而言，这类相互作用仍然具有挑战性。尽管 SO(3) 等变神经势能够学习丰富的局域几何表示，但相隔超过实空间截断半径的原子或分子片段无法直接通信。我们提出 EquiEwald，这是一种神经原子间势，它将 Ewald 求和直接扩展到 SO(3) 等变张量特征，而不是标量或类似电荷的信息。这使得倒易空间中的通信能够在保持旋转对称性的同时，在任意距离上传递与取向相关的信息。通过周期性和非周期性基准测试，EquiEwald 能够捕捉与从头算参考数据一致的长程静电行为，并且在能量与力的精度、数据效率以及长程外推能力方面都获得了一致改进。这些结果确立了 EquiEwald 作为一种将长程相互作用纳入机器学习原子间势的物理动机框架。

articles.title: AI-Driven Nanostructured Electrocatalysts for Efficient Green Hydrogen Production and Sustainable Fuel Generation
articles.title_zh: 用于高效绿氢生产与可持续燃料生成的 AI 驱动纳米结构电催化剂
articles.abstract: Green hydrogen is gaining importance as one of the most potential clean energy carriers in achieving carbon neutrality, and this will help reduce dependence on fossil fuels. Unfortunately, most of the state-of-art electrocatalysts for water splitting exhibit relatively low electrochemical activity and high cost, which restricts their commercial application. We propose an AI-Driven Nanostructured Electrocatalyst Optimization Framework (AINEOF) for efficient green hydrogen production and sustainable fuel generation. The proposed framework combines artificial intelligence and nanoscale material design to optimize the composition, morphology, electronic structure, and kinetic reaction parameters for HER and OER catalysts. We employ Bayesian optimization with a hybrid deep neural network to predict the optimal nanostructure parameters by minimizing computational and experimental resources. Designed transition-metal-based nanostructures with built-in defect sites and heterostructure interfaces are the most effective catalysts that greatly facilitate catalytic reaction activity and charge transfer efficiency. The simulation results show that the HER overpotential of the proposed framework is merely 41 mV when current density increases to 10 mA cm0(2)(-1), which is much lower than that of conventional catalysts(78 mV); and meanwhile, it leads to a reduction of OER overpotential to 236 mV (32.8% relative improvement). AI optimization illustrated a 67.4% reduction in catalyst discovery time and an enhancement of hydrogen production activity from 86.1% to 96.8%, while its Faradaic efficiency improved from 92.82% to over 99.2%. In addition, this nanostructured electrocatalyst shows good long-term durability with 95.6% of activity retention after continuous electrolysis for 100 h. The total water-splitting system can reach an energy conversion efficiency of 84.9%, a current density of 1.62 A cm⁻² and a hydrogen production rate of 8.84 mmol h⁻¹ cm⁻², surpassing all state-of-art methods available to date. Results show that the combination of artificial intelligence and nanostructured catalyst engineering is a powerful and sustainable route toward next-generation green hydrogen and renewable fuel technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种 AI 驱动的纳米结构电催化剂优化框架，用于提升析氢反应和析氧反应催化剂的性能。该方法结合贝叶斯优化与混合深度神经网络，联合优化组成、形貌、电子结构与反应动力学参数。结果显示，优化后的纳米结构催化剂可显著降低过电位、提高法拉第效率与稳定性，并将制氢与整体水分解效率提升到较高水平，体现了人工智能与纳米材料工程结合在绿色氢能中的应用潜力。
authors: Challaraj Emmanuel E S E S
articles.abstract_zh_full: 绿氢作为实现碳中和最具潜力的清洁能源载体之一，正日益受到重视，这将有助于减少对化石燃料的依赖。不幸的是，现有大多数先进电催化剂在水分解中表现出相对较低的电化学活性和较高成本，这限制了其商业应用。我们提出一种用于高效绿氢生产与可持续燃料生成的 AI 驱动纳米结构电催化剂优化框架（AINEOF）。所提出的框架将人工智能与纳米尺度材料设计相结合，以优化 HER 和 OER 催化剂的组成、形貌、电子结构以及动力学反应参数。我们采用贝叶斯优化与混合深度神经网络，通过最小化计算和实验资源来预测最佳纳米结构参数。所设计的具有内建缺陷位点和异质结构界面的过渡金属基纳米结构是最有效的催化剂，可显著促进催化反应活性和电荷传输效率。模拟结果表明，在电流密度增至 10 mA cm⁻² 时，所提出框架的 HER 过电位仅为 41 mV，远低于传统催化剂的 78 mV；同时，OER 过电位降低至 236 mV，获得 32.8% 的相对改进。AI 优化使催化剂发现时间减少了 67.4%，氢产生活性从 86.1% 提升到 96.8%，法拉第效率也从 92.82% 提高到 99.2% 以上。此外，该纳米结构电催化剂在连续电解 100 小时后仍保持 95.6% 的活性，表现出良好的长期耐久性。整个水分解系统可达到 84.9% 的能量转换效率、1.62 A cm⁻² 的电流密度以及 8.84 mmol h⁻¹ cm⁻² 的产氢速率，优于迄今可获得的所有先进方法。结果表明，将人工智能与纳米结构催化剂工程相结合，是迈向下一代绿氢和可再生燃料技术的一条强大且可持续的路径。

articles.title: Rigorous Validation of a Trigger Based Variable Fidelity Co Simulation Scheduler for Reinforcement Learning Controlled Power Electronic Systems
articles.title_zh: 面向强化学习控制功率电子系统的基于触发的变保真协同仿真调度器的严格验证
articles.abstract: Reinforcement-learning (RL) controllers for power-electronic systems are typically trained against simulators whose fidelity is fixed throughout the study. We present a trigger-based scheduler that switches a power-distribution co-simulation between three fidelity levels using an online, provably bounded estimate of divergence from the high-fidelity trajectory. Developing this scheduler surfaced three issues whose correction is as much the contribution as the scheduler itself. First, the conventional low-fidelity power-flow approximation ignores the voltage response to reactive power — exactly what our capacitor banks act on — carrying a 0.09 p.u. mean error; we replace it with a warm-started fast-decoupled power flow, cutting error by over 4×. Second, profiling the medium-fidelity solve showed its cost comes from rebuilding the Jacobian every iteration; a cached-Jacobian variant cuts cost roughly 3× at negligible accuracy loss. Third, validating the error bound against ground truth — rather than the scheduler's own bookkeeping — revealed violations on most low-fidelity steps, traced to a model-gap constant under-calibrated by roughly 450×; correcting it brings violations near zero. Evaluated over 10 seeds with confidence intervals against periodic switching, two independent baseline schedulers, and a trigger-signal ablation, the corrected scheduler achieves 1.3–1.5× speedups over always-high fidelity at a 6–12% accuracy cost relative to periodic switching, cutting training time roughly 30%; it does not dominate periodic switching on both axes despite an extensive search. We report this, and the bound-validation finding, as central results.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于触发的调度器，可依据与高保真轨迹偏差的在线有界估计，在三种保真度之间切换电力分配协同仿真。研究同时修正了三个关键问题：低保真潮流近似未考虑无功功率对电压的影响，因此用预热式快速解耦潮流替代；中保真求解的主要成本来自反复重建雅可比矩阵，因此采用缓存雅可比方案降低开销；此外，基于真实基准而非调度器自身记账进行误差界验证，发现低保真步长上存在大量界限违例，并将模型差距常数修正为更合理的数值。综合评估表明，该调度器可在保持一定精度损失的同时显著加速训练，但并未在所有指标上同时优于周期切换基线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 面向功率电子系统的强化学习（RL）控制器通常在固定保真度的仿真器上训练，而这些仿真器在整个研究过程中保真度保持不变。我们提出一种基于触发器的调度器，它利用对高保真轨迹偏差的在线、可证明有界估计，在三种保真度级别之间切换电力分配协同仿真。在开发该调度器的过程中，我们发现了三个问题，而对这些问题的修正与调度器本身同样构成了本文的贡献。首先，传统的低保真潮流近似忽略了无功功率对电压响应的影响——而这正是我们的电容器组所作用的对象——其平均误差达到 0.09 p.u.；我们用一种预热式快速解耦潮流替代它，使误差降低了 4 倍以上。其次，对中保真求解器的性能分析表明，其成本主要来自每次迭代都要重建雅可比矩阵；采用缓存雅可比的变体后，在几乎不损失精度的情况下，成本约降低 3 倍。第三，将误差界与真实基准进行验证——而不是与调度器自身的记账结果比较——发现大多数低保真步骤都违反了误差界，原因可追溯到一个被低估了约 450 倍的模型差距常数；修正后，违例几乎降为零。我们在 10 个随机种子下进行了评估，并给出置信区间，与周期切换、两个独立基线调度器以及触发信号消融实验进行比较。修正后的调度器相较始终使用高保真仿真可获得 1.3–1.5 倍加速，但相对于周期切换在精度上有 6–12% 的代价，从而将训练时间大致缩短 30%；尽管进行了广泛搜索，它并未在两个维度上同时优于周期切换。我们将这一点，以及误差界验证的发现，作为核心结果进行报告。

articles.title: Modeling and Simulation of Magnetized Casson–Micropolar Hybrid Nanofluid Due to Curved Surface with Viscous Dissipation and Thermal Slip Effects
articles.title_zh: 考虑黏性耗散与热滑移效应的曲面磁化 Casson–微极复合纳米流体建模与模拟
articles.abstract: This study investigates the magnetized Casson–micropolar hybrid nanofluid flow over a curved elastic surface considering viscous dissipation and thermal slip effects. The hybrid nanofluid is formed by dispersing silver (Ag) and titanium oxide (TiO2) nanoparticles in hexanol base fluid to enhance thermal transport. The governing nonlinear equations for momentum, microrotation, and heat transfer are transformed into dimensionless form and solved numerically using the shooting method with Runge–Kutta integration. Results show that increasing the Hartmann number from 0 to 1 reduces velocity by nearly 25–30%, while the Casson parameter increases temperature by 12–16%. The Eckert number enhances temperature by 15–20%, and the heat source parameter increases thermal distribution by 20–25%. The hybrid nanofluid demonstrates superior heat transfer compared to mono nanofluid systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在曲面弹性表面上的磁化 Casson–微极复合纳米流体流动，并考虑黏性耗散与热滑移效应。研究将银和二氧化钛纳米颗粒分散于己醇基流体中，以增强传热性能，并采用打靶法结合 Runge–Kutta 积分求解控制方程。结果表明，Hartmann 数增大将显著降低速度，而 Casson 参数、Eckert 数和热源参数则会提高温度分布；复合纳米流体的传热性能优于单一纳米流体体系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究考察了考虑黏性耗散和热滑移效应时，磁化 Casson–微极复合纳米流体在曲面弹性表面上的流动。该复合纳米流体通过将银（Ag）和二氧化钛（TiO2）纳米颗粒分散于己醇基流体中形成，以增强热传输。描述动量、微旋转和传热的控制非线性方程被转换为无量纲形式，并使用打靶法结合 Runge–Kutta 积分进行数值求解。结果表明，将 Hartmann 数从 0 增加到 1 会使速度降低近 25–30%，而 Casson 参数会使温度升高 12–16%。Eckert 数使温度增加 15–20%，热源参数则使热分布增加 20–25%。与单一纳米流体系统相比，复合纳米流体表现出更优越的传热性能。

articles.title: Machine learning-enabled discovery of refractory high entropy alloys on curated data
articles.abstract: Refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) exhibit outstanding potential for high-temperature structural applications, yet their rational design remains challenging because of the enormous compositional space and inconsistent literature data. Herein, we develop a machine-learning framework for predicting phase stability using a carefully curated RHEA dataset that combines secondary phase-inspired descriptors, refined synthesis metadata, and reassessed phase labels. The resulting ML model achieves a high predictive performance (F1 score = 0.89) in identifying single-phase solid solution RHEAs. Model interpretation reveals a key finding: RHEAs with a mismatch in the most stable oxidation state among constituent elements (MSO_dv) substantially exceeding 15 are prone to forming ordered intermetallic phases, thereby compromising single-phase stability. Theoretical analysis further links MSO to the itinerant electron characteristics of elements, elucidating the electronic origin of its impact on phase formation. Additionally, factors such as annealing temperature and first ionization energy are also shown to govern phase formation by modulating multiphase solid solution formation. Guided by ML predictions, several RHEAs were successfully synthesized and validated experimentally. This study establishes a robust predictive framework and unveils previously unrecognized electronic mechanisms, offering a new paradigm for the rational discovery of high-performance RHEAs.

articles.title: Metaheuristic-Optimized Machine Learning Models for Predicting Shear Strength of Circular Concrete-Filled Steel Tubes with SHAP-Based and PDP Interpretability
articles.abstract: Shear strength is a critical parameter for CFSTs, as shear failure occurs abruptly and can compromise structural safety. Accurate prediction of the shear strength of circular concrete-filled steel tubes (CFSTs) is crucial for the safe and economical design of composite structural systems. Traditional empirical and analytical approaches often struggle to capture the nonlinear interactions between geometric, material, and loading parameters. This study introduces innovative metaheuristic-optimization-based machine learning models, particle swarm optimization (PSO) and Bayesian optimization (BO), enhanced by random forest (PSO-RF), category boosting (PSO-Cat), and random forest (BO-RF) and (BO-Cat), with a focus on the shear strength prediction of circular CFSTs. Hence, to assess the model performance, we used the R2, RMSE, MAPE, and MAE metrics. A comprehensive experimental database was compiled from published literature and was divided into training (70%) and testing (30%) phases. The results demonstrate that the (PSO-Cat) and (BO-Cat) algorithms achieve excellent predictive accuracy among all the evaluation metrics, with (R2 = 0.999, RMSE = 19.6455) in the training stage and (R2 = 0.9874, RMSE = 65.0769) in the testing stage (BO-Cat: R2 = 0.999, 0.9817), which exceeds those of the (PSO-RF) and (BO-RF) models. Additionally, SHapley additive exPlanations (SHAPs) and partial dependence plot (PDP) analyses were employed to identify significant input characteristics and the influence of input parameters on shear strength outcomes. The results demonstrate that the metaheuristic-optimized models significantly outperform conventional approaches in terms of prediction accuracy, whereas SHAP analysis highlights the dominant role of the concrete area (Ac), steel reinforcement area (As), and shear span-to-depth ratio (a/D) as the most impactful parameters in governing shear capacity. Furthermore, a graphical user interface (GUI) was developed to make the predictive models accessible for practical engineering use, allowing users to input design variables and obtain shear‒strength predictions with interpretability features. This research provides a reliable, interpretable, and deployable framework for predicting the shear strength of CFSTs.

articles.title: Deriving the second law of thermodynamics and exploring its boundaries
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The second law of thermodynamics still lacks a general proof applicable to both classical and quantum systems across broad ranges of time scales, interactions, and degrees of nonequilibrium. In this paper, we show that when the macrostate-level probability f of an isolated system increases monotonically with the number of possible microstates Ømega (i.e., partial f/partial Ømega > 0), the second law emerges naturally from the continuity equation of f in phase space; a special case of partial f/partial Ømega > 0 is Boltzmann's assumption of equal a priori equilibrium probabilities. Based on this finding, the second law can be readily derived for fully chaotic systems. The derivation does not rely on dynamical details, highlighting the statistical nature of entropy increase. In contrast, for a locally nonchaotic system, the positive correlation between f and Ømega may break down (i.e., partial f/partial Ømega łeq 0). Consequently, the conventional framework of thermodynamics does not apply, and entropy can decrease spontaneously without any energetic penalty.

articles.title: Exact Results for the Symmetric Dyson Exclusion Process
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The symmetric Dyson exclusion process (SDEP) is an exclusion process on the lattice with a long-range logarithmic Coulomb-type interaction. It appears in several equivalent forms: as symmetric random walkers conditioned, in the Doob-transform sense, not to collide; as the maximal-activity limit of a conditioned SSEP; and as a ground-state transform of the spin- 1/2 XX chain. In this work, we exploit this latter representation to obtain exact evolution formulas from deterministic initial configurations. The resulting determinantal kernel is expressed through a finite interpolation expression in terms of Lagrange polynomials, leading to explicit density evolution in finite and infinite lattices. For the melting of a densely packed block, we show that the full hierarchy of density moments is governed by a finite-dimensional polynomial algebra, and we identify Catalan numbers in the leading time coefficients. We also derive the Euler-scale density profile and the arctic curve separating frozen and liquid regions, and show that they coincide with conjectured hydrodynamic results obtained in a previous work.
authors: Ali Zahra, Jerome Dubail, Gunter M. Schutz

articles.title: Symmetry selection rule for the band-edge shift current in two dimensions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28927v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The shift current is the intrinsic bulk photovoltaic response of a crystal without an inversion center. In graphene multilayers, recent calculations report large band-edge shift currents that reverse sign under a gate or displacement field, a behavior that neither the quantum metric nor the Berry curvature captures. We show that this behavior follows from a symmetry principle: at the absorption edge of an inversion-broken, two-dimensional gapped Dirac-like system, an emergent low-energy rotational symmetry forbids the response, and the trigonal warping, which reduces this emergent symmetry to the lattice's three-fold rotation, switches the current on linearly in its strength. We formulate this as an exact angular selection rule that unifies the band-edge responses of multilayer graphene and of the kagome lattice. In the multiband structures, the released current is governed by a signed, detuning-weighted three-point Bargmann invariant of the Bloch states: the optical amplitude remains fixed while the sign alignment of the Bargmann triangles grows with the warping, a phase-coherence effect captured by a bounded coherence factor and invisible to any positive-definite figure of merit, the quantum metric included. In bilayer and trilayer graphene, a gate voltage alone drives the sign reversal, making the band-edge shift current a parameter-free, gate-switchable bulk photovoltaic response.
authors: Felipe Pérez Riffo, Matías Castro, Leonor Chico, L. E. F. Foa Torres. Eric Suárez Morell

articles.title: Covariance-Driven Momentum Rectification at Liquid-Vapor Interfaces Near Wetting Transitions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Zero-mean forcing can generate directed transport when a medium responds in a spatially structured way and the relevant symmetries are broken. Liquid-vapor interfaces are a useful setting for this problem because surface-tension gradients, wetting dynamics, vapor exchange, capillary and acoustic waves, electro-ionic screening, thermal noise, and boundary compliance can all carry momentum. We develop a conservative continuum model in which the central object is the covariance between a local response field and a zero-mean tangential drive, łangle Mfångle-łangle Månglełangle fångle, embedded in an explicit momentum ledger. In a minimal diffuse-interface realization, this covariance gives the phase-selective drift law UproptoϵₕΘsinǎrphi for a Marangoni-driven liquid-vapor interface above a structured wall, with exact nulls when the symmetry is restored. Wetting susceptibility then acts as a bounded gain factor: first-order spinodal conditions provide the useful amplification regime, critical wetting saturates because interfacial unbinding removes the short-range drive, and bulk criticality suppresses the channel as the interface disappears. Additional reservoirs - phase change, waves, thermal transport, electro-ionic coupling, compliance, and fluctuations - are treated as compensating channels to be isolated by sign reversals, scaling laws, and budget closure. The result is neither a new microscopic force nor an apparatus-level claim, but a symmetry-constrained accounting scheme for rectified momentum transfer in water-based interfacial systems. Reduced numerical calculations illustrate the phase-selection rules, bounded spinodal gain, momentum-budget closure, transverse chirality, and grid convergence.
authors: Nelson Bolívar, Gabriel Abellán, Ivaylo Vasilev

articles.title: Charge-Density-Wave Phase Selection by Janus-Induced Intrinsic Strain in Monolayer NbSSiAs₂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29084v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling phase selection among competing charge-density-wave (CDW) instabilities remains challenging in two-dimensional materials. Here, first-principles calculations show that Janus-induced intrinsic tensile strain redirects the off-M soft-mode tendency of NbS₂ to the M point in NbSSiAs₂, selecting a 2×2 CDW reconstruction. Electron-phonon coupling analysis identifies momentum-selective coupling between Nb-derived states and a longitudinal acoustic mode as the origin of the M-point instability. The reconstructed phase hosts two nearly degenerate Nb-trimerized configurations whose relative stability is tuned by biaxial strain. Both configurations retain phonon-mediated superconductivity on the 6-7 K scale, indicating the coexistence of CDW order and superconductivity. Compressive strain favors the 1+3-hollow configuration and induces a band-inverted, Z₂₋ₙₒₙₜᵣᵢᵥᵢₐₗ state while preserving superconductivity. Together, these results identify Janus-induced intrinsic strain as an internal structural route for CDW phase selection, whereas external strain provides access to a regime in which CDW order, topology, and superconductivity coexist.
authors: Chun-Jie Zhang, Bing Zhang, Dongliang Mao, Yapeng Wu, Xiao-Ping Li, Lei Wang
articles.focus_summary: 本文研究了Janus诱导内禀应变如何选择单层NbSSiAs₂中的电荷密度波相。结果显示，应变可驱动不同CDW构型、超导共存以及拓扑非平庸态的出现。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们关注的二维材料、电子-声子耦合、超导和拓扑功能材料有较强关联。虽然不属于团队最核心的铁电或磁性体系，但在低维量子材料与相竞争问题上较契合。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合第一性原理和有效模型研究CDW、超导与拓扑相之间的竞争机制。若引入层间耦合、缺陷或外场调控，将更适合我们团队的低维材料研究方向。

articles.title: A low-temperature ultra-high-vacuum scanning probe microscope with in situ electronic transport capabilities: from macro to nano in 10 minutes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have developed a low temperature (LT), ultra-high-vacuum (UHV) system that combines two complementary techniques, scanning probe microscopy (SPM) and electrical transport measurements, within a single platform. By providing simultaneous access to the atomic-scale surface landscape and the macroscopic device response of the same sample, the setup enables direct correlations between local structural/spectroscopic signatures and global electronic transport behavior in two-dimensional (2D) devices. The system allows experiments where atomic-scale modifications or controlled manipulations are performed while continuously monitoring their impact on device-scale performance. The setup consists of two interconnected UHV chambers: a dedicated preparation chamber and a separate measurement chamber that houses a liquid-helium cryostat and the SPM/transport stage. Base pressure is 1x10⁻¹¹ Torr. A key feature is direct optical access to the sample, enabling rapid and reliable tip positioning with an accuracy of 5 microns x 5 microns within 10 minutes. The SPM, operated using custom-built electronics, can track the exact same sample region across a temperature range from 2.9 K to 400 K, with mechanical stability below 1 pm. System performance is demonstrated on graphene devices, and bulk Pb is used to determine energy resolution. Using superconducting tips, scanning tunneling spectroscopy measures the superconducting gap with an energy resolution of 30 microV. Transport measurements track the temperature dependence of both resistivity and critical current across the superconducting transition of an in-situ prepared Pb nanowire.
authors: Diego Exposito (Departamento de Fisica de la Materia Condensada, Universidad Autonoma de Madrid, Instituto Nicolas Cabrera), Oscar Custance (National Institute for Materials Science), Ivan Brihuega (Departamento de Fisica de la Materia Condensada, Universidad Autonoma de Madrid, Instituto Nicolas Cabrera)

articles.title: Origins of microwave losses in superconducting circuits made with silicon-on-insulator substrates
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon-on-insulator technology is widely used to fabricate silicon based devices, from advanced transistors to photonic circuits or nanomechanical systems. Integrating low loss superconducting quantum circuits with silicon-on-insulator substrates enables to couple the advantages offered by the mature silicon technology to the exquisite sensitivity of superconducting circuits. The natural approach, inherited from research in superconducting microwave devices, is to use a substrate made with highly resistive silicon, known for its low level of microwave losses. In this work, using superconducting microwave resonators, we show that counterintuitively, standard resistivity silicon-on-insulator substrates perform better than high resistivity silicon-on-insulator substrates at cryogenic temperatures. In the latter case, the presence of a parasitic sheet conduction at the interface between bulk silicon and silicon oxide acts as the dominant loss mechanism. This parasitic sheet can be suppressed using substrates with intentionally induced traps. In such substrates, losses are ultimately limited by the dielectric losses of the silicon oxide layer. These substrates offer interesting perspectives for the development of superconducting nanoelectromechanical systems. First, the release, i.e. the removal of the silicon oxide, could be limited to the moving parts, thereby maintaining the mechanical integrity of the rest of the device. Additionally, such structure would enhance heat evacuation into the bulk of the substrate which is an issue in current devices such as microwave-to-optics converters.
authors: Simon Messelot, Nicolas Aparicio, Kazi Rafsanjani Amin, Eric Eyraud, Bruno Fain, Mikaël Cassé, Guillaume Jourdan, Fabrice Nemouchi, Sébastien Hentz, Frédéric Gustavo, François Lefloch, Nicolas Roch, Jérémie J. Viennot, Julien Renard

articles.title: Polariton-Assisted Inelastic Tunneling through a Quantum Well
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29171v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate electronic transport through a doped quantum well strongly interacting with a photonic mode confined in a double-metal cavity. Using a nonequilibrium Green's function formalism, we derive compact expressions for the current valid for arbitrary collective light--matter coupling strengths exceeding the relevant loss rates. We show that cavity polaritons leave observable transport signatures when the carrier injection rate is smaller than the cavity-induced electronic broadening. In this regime, the current--voltage characteristics exhibit inelastic sidebands associated with resonant and anti-resonant polariton emission, which are strongly enhanced under resonant illumination. Our results provide a realistic route to detecting cavity-induced modifications of charge transport in semiconductor heterostructures.
authors: Théophile Seck, Yanko Todorov, Guido Pupillo, David Hagenmüller

articles.title: Unwithered Majorana fermions in the bulk of a quantum chain
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The proposal is to probe Majorana modes in the system when its parameters are tuned to bring it into a disentangled ground state, which occur on the parametric curves known as disorder lines (DL). In such state certain correlation functions do not depend on separation. The exact results are presented for the XY spin chain in transverse field, also called the Kitaev chain in the Majorana representation. The single Majorana modes are shown to be localized near the ends of the chain, as in the states off the DL, while the disentangled n-particle Majorana modes (n ≥ 2) penetrate into the bulk without attenuation. The predicted bulk-edge effects can be detected in the specially engineered optical chains and lattices.

articles.title: Continuous Tuning of the Charge-Phase Uncertainty in a Josephson Junction
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29636v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum mechanics constrains conjugate observables from being simultaneously measurable with arbitrary precision. In a Josephson junction, these are the transferred electric charge and the quantum-mechanical phase difference between the superconducting domains. Which of them fluctuates determines the supercurrent: a dissipative trickle of single Cooper pairs in one limit, a coherent dissipationless flow in the other. Bridging both regimes in one device remained elusive because the Josephson and charging energies are fixed at fabrication. Here, we use the tunable tunnel junction of a scanning tunneling microscope at millikelvin temperature to vary their ratio continuously over many orders of magnitude. In this way, we monitor the smooth transition between incoherent and coherent Cooper pair flow in a single junction, revealing the quantum-to-classical transition in a controlled way.
authors: Irena Padniuk, Xianzhe Zeng, Juan Carlos Cuevas, Joachim Ankerhold, Klaus Kern, Christian R. Ast

articles.title: Quantum Resources in Disorder-Free Localization Dynamics of Gauge Theories
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28730v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum-state complexity diagnostics provide valuable insight into many-body dynamics, information scrambling, and quantum computation. Here, we investigate the real-time dynamics of quantum complexity in 1+1-dimensional Abelian U(1) and non-Abelian SU(2) lattice gauge theories (LGTs), focusing on the disorder-free localization (DFL) regime. Using stabilizer Rényi entropy, participation Rényi entropy, and fermionic non-Gaussianity as measures of complexity, we observe, for both theories, two main behaviors as a function of the gauge coupling: at intermediate values, a power-law relaxation towards saturation, consistent with observations in many-body localization, and, at sufficiently large values, an ultraslow double-logarithmic growth, which we substantiate with a configuration-space bound verified by exact counting. Our results not only provide deeper insight into the dynamics of DFL but also highlight the role of gauge invariance in constraining quantum resources and are relevant to recent quantum simulations of LGTs.
authors: Devendra Singh Bhakuni, Giovanni Cataldi, Jad C. Halimeh, Emanuele Tirrito

articles.title: Release-free phononic crystal with strong microwave coupling
articles.title_zh: 无需释放的声子晶体及其强微波耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29666v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Phonons hold promise for storing and transferring quantum information, including in mechanically-mediated quantum interconnects between superconducting qubits and light. Phononic crystal cavities confine gigahertz sound to micron-scale volumes well matched to near-infrared light. So far, these devices have typically been suspended to suppress phononic radiation loss into the substrate, but suspension limits thermal anchoring leading to excess noise. Release-free phononic crystals have emerged as a way to address this challenge -- but had yet to be shown compatible with strong electromechanical interactions. Here, we demonstrate a release-free phononic crystal cavity strongly coupled to a high-impedance microwave resonator, with an electromechanical coupling rate gₑₘ/(2π) approx 30,MHz that exceeds both the mechanical and microwave loss rates, leading to a cooperativity up to C approx 180 on resonance. In addition, our lithium niobate phononic crystals reach quality factors above 10⁴ at millikelvin temperature on both silicon and sapphire substrates. Our results establish release-free phononic crystals as compact, scalable interfaces between microwaves and gigahertz sound for emerging sensing, communication, and computing systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种无需悬空释放的声子晶体腔，可与高阻抗微波谐振器实现强电机械耦合。器件在毫开尔文温度下于硅和蓝宝石衬底上均达到超过10⁴的机械品质因数，并实现约30 MHz的耦合率与最高约180的协同系数。结果表明，无需释放的声子晶体可作为紧凑、可扩展的微波—吉赫兹声学接口，用于传感、通信和计算系统。
authors: Joey Frey, Paul Burger, Trond Hjerpekjøn Haug, Johan Kolvik, Raphaël Van Laer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 声子有望用于存储和传输量子信息，包括在超导量子比特与光之间由机械介导的量子互连中。声子晶体腔将吉赫兹声波限制在微米尺度体积中，与近红外光具有良好匹配。迄今为止，这类器件通常被制成悬空结构，以抑制声子向衬底的辐射损耗，但悬空会限制热锚定，从而导致额外噪声。无需释放的声子晶体已成为应对这一挑战的一种途径——但此前尚未证明其与强电机械相互作用兼容。在这里，我们展示了一种无需释放的声子晶体腔，它与高阻抗微波谐振器强耦合，其电机械耦合率 gₑₘ/(2π) 约为30 MHz，超过机械损耗率和微波损耗率，从而在共振时实现最高约 C≈180 的协同系数。此外，我们的铌酸锂声子晶体在毫开尔文温度下于硅和蓝宝石衬底上均达到超过10⁴的品质因数。我们的结果确立了无需释放的声子晶体作为微波与吉赫兹声波之间紧凑、可扩展接口的地位，可用于新兴的传感、通信和计算系统。

articles.title: Universality and weak-ergodicity breaking in quantum quenches
articles.title_zh: 量子淬火中的普适性与弱遍历性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.08687v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding equilibration and universality after sudden quantum quenches remains a central challenge in isolated many-body systems. Persistent oscillations and anomalous scaling reported in lattice models appear to challenge the standard picture based on integrability and quantum-to-classical correspondence. Focusing on the quantum O(n) model in the large-n limit, we show that these apparent anomalies originate from lattice effects and an underlying integrable structure. In particular, we map the post-quench dynamics onto an integrable Neumann system and we derive a new action-angle description valid in the thermodynamic limit. This framework explains both the convergence of long-time averages to the generalized Gibbs ensemble and the emergence of persistent oscillations associated with an isolated mode at the upper edge of the phonon spectrum. We further show that the expected thermal universality class is recovered in the appropriate scaling regime, while the oscillations disappear in the quantum field theory limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究孤立多体系统在突然量子淬火后的平衡化与普适性问题。作者在大 n 极限下分析量子 O(n) 模型，指出晶格模型中报告的持续振荡和异常标度源于晶格效应及潜在的可积结构。研究将淬火后的动力学映射到可积 Neumann 系统，并解释长时间平均向广义 Gibbs 系综的收敛以及声子谱上边缘孤立模导致的持续振荡。
authors: Guido Giachetti, Andrea Solfanelli, Nicolò Defenu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解突然量子淬火之后的平衡化和普适性，仍然是孤立多体系统中的一个核心挑战。在晶格模型中报道的持续振荡和异常标度似乎对基于可积性以及量子—经典对应的标准图像提出了挑战。我们聚焦于大 n 极限下的量子 O(n) 模型，表明这些表观异常源于晶格效应和一个潜在的可积结构。特别地，我们将淬火后的动力学映射到一个可积的 Neumann 系统，并推导出一种在热力学极限下有效的新作用量—角变量描述。该框架解释了长时间平均向广义 Gibbs 系综的收敛，以及与声子谱上边缘处的一个孤立模相关的持续振荡的出现。我们进一步表明，在适当的标度区域中会恢复预期的热普适类，而这些振荡会在量子场论极限中消失。

articles.title: Closed-Form Generators for Perturbative Transformations in Static and Periodically Driven Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 静态和周期驱动量子系统中微扰变换生成元的闭式形式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.11535v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a unified framework for the practical implementation of perturbative transformations that overcomes the limitations of existing construction methods. The central result is a closed-form operator expression for the generator of a broad class of perturbative transformations in systems composed of finite-dimensional and bosonic subspaces. We further generalize the construction to time-dependent systems with periodic perturbations, obtaining a solution that remains valid across low-, intermediate-, and high-frequency regimes, provided that the transition channels eliminated by the transformation remain sufficiently detuned. The derived framework remains independent of the particular perturbative scheme and therefore applies to a large class of perturbative approaches for both time independent and time dependent transformations. We demonstrate the scope and accuracy of the method by deriving effective dispersive interactions in exemplary anharmonic and periodically driven light--matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个统一框架，用于实际实现微扰变换，并克服现有构造方法的局限。核心结果是针对由有限维子空间和玻色子子空间组成的系统，给出一大类微扰变换生成元的闭式算符表达式。作者还将该构造推广到具有周期微扰的含时系统，并在多个频率区域中验证了其适用性。
authors: Leander Reascos, Giovanni Francesco Diotallevi, Mónica Benito
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了一个用于实际实现微扰变换的统一框架，该框架克服了现有构造方法的局限性。核心结果是，对于由有限维子空间和玻色子子空间组成的系统中一大类微扰变换的生成元，给出了一个闭式算符表达式。我们进一步将该构造推广到具有周期性微扰的含时系统，得到的解在低频、中频和高频区域均保持有效，前提是由该变换消去的跃迁通道仍然足够失谐。所推导的框架不依赖于特定的微扰方案，因此适用于时间无关和时间相关变换中的一大类微扰方法。我们通过在示例性的非谐和周期驱动光—物质系统中推导有效色散相互作用，展示了该方法的适用范围和精度。

articles.title: Many-body localization for the random XXZ spin chain in fixed energy intervals
articles.title_zh: 固定能量区间中随机 XXZ 自旋链的多体局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.01441v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: It is shown that the infinite random Heisenberg XXZ spin-frac12 chain exhibits slow propagation of information (logarithmic light cone), a key signature of many-body localization (MBL), in any fixed energy interval at the bottom of the spectrum. The relevant parameter regime, which covers both weak interaction and strong disorder, is determined solely by the energy interval.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文证明，无限随机 Heisenberg XXZ 自旋 1/2 链在谱底任意固定能量区间内表现出信息传播缓慢，即对数光锥。这是多体局域化的重要特征。相关参数区域同时覆盖弱相互作用和强无序情形，并且仅由能量区间决定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文证明，无限随机 Heisenberg XXZ 自旋 1/2 链在谱底的任意固定能量区间中表现出信息的缓慢传播（对数光锥），这是多体局域化（MBL）的一个关键标志。相关的参数区域覆盖弱相互作用和强无序两种情形，并且仅由该能量区间决定。

articles.title: Comment on "Quantum mechanics based on real numbers: a consistent description"
articles.title_zh: 关于“基于实数的量子力学：一种一致描述”的评论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28668v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this comment on arXiv:2503.17307 (PRL, 136, 240202, 2026), a novel idea using flag states to transform complex state vector and operators to real ones is argued to effectively lead to a quantum mechanics that is complex in the disguised form of real. The claim that real-valued quantum mechanics cannot be falsified is conceptually flawed.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇评论针对 arXiv:2503.17307（PRL, 136, 240202, 2026）提出批评。作者认为，利用标志态将复态矢量和算符变换为实形式的新想法，实际上只是以实数伪装的复数量子力学。文章指出，关于实值量子力学不可证伪的主张在概念上存在缺陷。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这篇针对 arXiv:2503.17307（PRL, 136, 240202, 2026）的评论中，作者认为，利用标志态将复态矢量和算符变换为实矢量和实算符这一新颖想法，实际上导致的是一种以实数形式伪装的复数量子力学。关于实值量子力学不能被证伪的主张在概念上是有缺陷的。

articles.title: Metric--Measure Geometry and Geometric Analogues of Holographic Extremal Surfaces
articles.title_zh: 度量—测度几何与全息极值曲面的几何类似物
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28690v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a geometric framework based on metric--measure spaces (M,g,f), where the function f defines a deformation of the Riemannian measure motivated by Perelman's formulation of Ricci flow. Within this setting, we introduce measure-weighted hypersurfaces and associated geometric functionals, and derive modified extremality conditions for codimension-one and codimension-two submanifolds. These conditions provide intrinsic geometric analogues of extremal surface equations, arising solely from the metric--measure structure and independent of holographic duality or quantum field theoretic input. We further define a generalized functional combining a measure-weighted geometric term with an effective bulk contribution and analyze its variational properties. The resulting Euler--Lagrange equation exhibits a structural correspondence with semiclassical generalized entropy functionals, while maintaining a purely geometric interpretation distinct from thermodynamic entropy in the sense of Perelman's W-functional. Applications to Schwarzschild and Anti-de Sitter geometries illustrate the emergence of preferred geometric scales and the modification of ultraviolet scaling behavior induced by the function f. These results suggest that metric--measure geometry provides a minimal framework in which key structural features of extremal surface constructions can arise from intrinsic geometric principles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了基于度量—测度空间的几何框架，其中函数 f 以受 Perelman 的 Ricci 流表述启发的方式改变 Riemann 测度。作者引入测度加权超曲面及相关几何泛函，并推导余维一和余维二子流形的修正极值条件。该框架在不依赖全息对偶或量子场论输入的情况下，从内禀几何原则中再现极值曲面构造的若干结构特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们发展了一个基于度量—测度空间 (M,g,f) 的几何框架，其中函数 f 定义了对 Riemann 测度的一种变形，其动机来自 Perelman 对 Ricci 流的表述。在这一设定中，我们引入测度加权超曲面及相关几何泛函，并推导余维一和余维二子流形的修正极值条件。这些条件提供了极值曲面方程的内禀几何类似物，它们完全源于度量—测度结构，并且独立于全息对偶或量子场论输入。我们进一步定义了一个广义泛函，它将一个测度加权几何项与一个有效体贡献相结合，并分析其变分性质。所得 Euler—Lagrange 方程与半经典广义熵泛函在结构上相对应，同时保持一种纯粹几何的解释，该解释不同于 Perelman 的 W 泛函意义下的热力学熵。对 Schwarzschild 和反 de Sitter 几何的应用展示了优选几何尺度的出现，以及由函数 f 引起的紫外标度行为的改变。这些结果表明，度量—测度几何提供了一个最小框架，在其中极值曲面构造的关键结构特征可以从内禀几何原则中产生。

articles.title: The Ponderomotive Effects of Narrow-band, Superconducting Resonators in Open and Closed Loop
articles.title_zh: 窄带超导谐振器在开环与闭环中的有质动力效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we present measurements of ponderomotive instabilities in narrow-band, coaxial resonators in open and closed control loop systems. We show an analytical scheme we will use in future studies to examine the dependency of open loop stability on mechanical parameters. Analytical and simulation models are used to predict the onset of the oscillatory instability in half wave resonators with active disturbance rejection control for amplitude and phase stabilization. We demonstrate that for high amplitude controller bandwidths, ponderomotive oscillations can couple with the controller frequency response via higher harmonics and lower the threshold for the oscillatory instability. We reaffirm the superiority of in-phase/quadrature (I/Q) component control in regards to preventing the oscillatory instability, and show how the phase controller can amplify the crosstalk of disturbances in amplitude and phase control. In cases with large disturbances, this effect can lead to instabilities not present in I/Q control.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了窄带同轴谐振器在开环和闭环控制系统中的有质动力不稳定性测量。作者结合解析与仿真模型，预测带有主动扰动抑制控制的半波谐振器中振荡不稳定性的出现。研究表明，高幅度控制器带宽可能通过高次谐波与控制器频率响应耦合，从而降低不稳定性阈值；同时再次确认 I/Q 分量控制在抑制振荡不稳定性方面更具优势。
authors: Jacob Brown (Facility for Rare Isotope Beams), Alexander Sukhanov (Fermilab), Crispin Contreras-Martinez (Fermilab), Vyacheslav Yakokvlev (Fermilab), Sang-hoon Kim (Facility for Rare Isotope Beams), Shen Zhao (Facility for Rare Isotope Beams), Ting Xu (Facility for Rare Isotope Beams), Walter Hartung (Facility for Rare Isotope Beams), Wei Chang (Facility for Rare Isotope Beams)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们给出了窄带同轴谐振器在开环和闭环控制系统中的有质动力不稳定性的测量结果。我们展示了一种解析方案，将在未来研究中用于考察开环稳定性对机械参数的依赖性。解析模型和仿真模型被用于预测带有主动扰动抑制控制以实现幅度和相位稳定的半波谐振器中振荡不稳定性的起始。我们证明，对于较高的幅度控制器带宽，有质动力振荡可以通过高次谐波与控制器频率响应耦合，并降低振荡不稳定性的阈值。我们再次确认，同相/正交（I/Q）分量控制在防止振荡不稳定性方面具有优越性，并展示了相位控制器如何放大幅度和相位控制中扰动的串扰。在存在大扰动的情况下，这种效应可能导致在 I/Q 控制中并不存在的不稳定性。

articles.title: Collimation of dense atomic beams by Swept Velocity Shelving
articles.title_zh: 通过扫掠速度搁置实现高密度原子束准直
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Engineering continuous, high-flux, and collimated atomic beams is a useful resource for metrology and material deposition. Developments in this area have been essential for the evolution of cold-atom based quantum experiments, yet the ubiquitous balanced-force methods such as transverse molasses cooling degrade at high atomic flux due to absorption-induced force imbalance. We introduce a collimation scheme that combines the use of a broadband transition for velocity shifting with a narrowband transition for velocity selection, enabling velocity-selective beam collimation without relying on balanced-power counter-propagating beams. Collimated atoms are shelved in a long-lived internal state, reducing the total light scattering and providing a state-heralded collimated beam. Simulations using strontium as a model system show a highly effective collimation process that does not suffer from absorption-induced force-imbalance and experimental results agree well with these predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种原子束准直方案，将宽带跃迁用于速度位移，并将窄带跃迁用于速度选择。该方法不依赖平衡功率的反向传播光束，因此可避免高原子通量下由吸收导致的力不平衡问题。以锶为模型系统的模拟和实验结果显示，该方法能有效准直原子束，并将准直原子搁置到长寿命内态中以减少散射。
authors: Francesca Famà, Benedikt Heizenreder, Ananya Sitaram, Camila Beli, Robert J. C. Spreeuw, Stefan A. Schäffer, Florian Schreck
articles.abstract_zh_full: 构造连续、高通量且准直的原子束，是计量学和材料沉积中的一种有用资源。该领域的发展对于基于冷原子的量子实验的演进至关重要，然而普遍使用的平衡力方法，例如横向光学粘团冷却，会在高原子通量下由于吸收诱导的力不平衡而退化。我们引入一种准直方案，它结合使用宽带跃迁进行速度移位和窄带跃迁进行速度选择，从而实现速度选择性束准直，而不依赖平衡功率的反向传播光束。被准直的原子被搁置在一个长寿命内态中，从而减少总的光散射，并提供一个由态标记的准直束。以锶作为模型系统的模拟显示出一种非常有效的准直过程，该过程不受吸收诱导的力不平衡影响，并且实验结果与这些预测符合良好。

articles.title: Cryogenic nonlinear processes in thin-film lithium niobate
articles.title_zh: 薄膜铌酸锂中的低温非线性过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29176v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photonic integrated circuits operating at cryogenic temperatures are necessary for many quantum technologies such as quantum transduction, integrated single-photon emitters and detectors, as well as deep-space communication and sensing devices. Thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) is an emerging platform that is a strong candidate for fully integrated quantum photonics, offering low loss, fast electro-optic reconfigurability, nonlinear quantum light sources, and the ability to host quantum emitters and single-photon detectors. To interface TFLN with technologies that require cryogenic operation, like superconducting single-photon detectors, microwave-to-optical transducers, and solid-state quantum emitters, it is important to study its optical and electrical properties from room temperature down to cryogenic temperatures. Here, we investigate linear and nonlinear photonic devices, including racetrack resonators, Mach-Zehnder modulators and periodically poled waveguides in TFLN using a cryogenic fiber probe station with full temperature control down to 5 K. We quantify a shift in resonances, a 22% increase in electro-optic modulator half-wave voltage, a blue shift of 18 nm for Type-0 phase-matching as well as a red shift of 64 nm for Type-II phase-matching as the sample temperature decreases. Our study of nonlinear processes in a cryogenic environment will contribute towards developing novel devices for inter-platform quantum information processing, secure communication, and enhanced sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究薄膜铌酸锂光子器件在从室温到5 K低温范围内的线性和非线性光学行为。作者测试了跑道谐振器、Mach-Zehnder 调制器和周期极化波导等器件，量化了谐振位移、调制器半波电压增加以及不同相位匹配过程的波长漂移。该研究有助于发展用于跨平台量子信息处理、安全通信和增强传感的低温集成光子器件。
authors: Tristan Kuttner, Ulrich Sauter, Robert J. Chapman, Myriam Rihani, Jost Kellner, Alessandra Sabatti, Giovanni Finco, Andreas Maeder, Rachel Grange
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在低温下工作的光子集成电路对于许多量子技术是必要的，例如量子转导、集成单光子发射器和探测器，以及深空通信和传感器件。薄膜铌酸锂（TFLN）是一个新兴平台，是完全一体化量子光子学的有力候选者，它提供低损耗、快速电光可重构性、非线性量子光源，以及承载量子发射器和单光子探测器的能力。为了将 TFLN 与需要低温运行的技术相接口，例如超导单光子探测器、微波到光学转导器以及固态量子发射器，研究其从室温到低温的光学和电学性质十分重要。在这里，我们使用具有完整温度控制、可降至5 K的低温光纤探针台，研究了 TFLN 中的线性和非线性光子器件，包括跑道谐振器、Mach-Zehnder 调制器和周期极化波导。我们量化了随着样品温度降低而出现的谐振位移、电光调制器半波电压增加22%、Type-0 相位匹配蓝移18 nm，以及 Type-II 相位匹配红移64 nm。我们对低温环境中非线性过程的研究，将有助于开发用于跨平台量子信息处理、安全通信和增强传感的新型器件。

articles.title: Quantum Optimal Control at Intermediate Times: Controlling Revivals in Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: 中间时刻的量子最优控制：自旋链中复现的控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28783v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Standard Quantum Optimal Control (QOC) protocols typically maximize a physical objective just at a final target time. However, tracking or measuring the quantum state during the time evolution requires the control at intermediate stages of their evolution. In this work, we extend QOC to accommodate the simultaneous optimization of observables at arbitrary intermediate times. Using a variational approach, we show that intermediate observations induce discontinuities in the costate trajectory, which can be handled with a Krotov algorithm leading to monotonic optimization and convergent results in the limit of zero temporal measurement windows. We apply this multi-time formulation to a Heisenberg XXX spin chain to control the propagation, including field-free revivals, of a Dicke state excitation. Our results demonstrate that simultaneous optimization of the same observable reshapes the driving field to balance intermediate targets with final populations. Finally, we show how this framework enables dynamic tracking of spin excitations and the active manipulation of post-pulse quantum state revivals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将标准量子最优控制从仅优化最终时刻目标扩展到同时优化任意中间时刻的观测量。作者通过变分方法表明，中间观测会在协态轨迹中引入不连续性，并可用 Krotov 算法处理以获得单调优化和收敛结果。该方法应用于 Heisenberg XXX 自旋链，实现了 Dicke 态激发传播、无场复现及脉冲后量子态复现的主动操控。
authors: Juan J. Omiste, Ignacio R. Solá
articles.abstract_zh_full: 标准量子最优控制（QOC）方案通常只在最终目标时刻最大化一个物理目标。然而，在时间演化过程中跟踪或测量量子态需要在其演化的中间阶段进行控制。在这项工作中，我们扩展 QOC，使其能够同时优化任意中间时刻的观测量。利用变分方法，我们表明中间观测会在协态轨迹中引入不连续性，这些不连续性可以通过 Krotov 算法处理，从而在时间测量窗口趋于零的极限中实现单调优化和收敛结果。我们将这种多时间形式应用于 Heisenberg XXX 自旋链，以控制 Dicke 态激发的传播，包括无外场复现。我们的结果表明，对同一观测量的同时优化会重塑驱动场，以平衡中间目标与最终布居。最后，我们展示了该框架如何实现自旋激发的动态跟踪，以及对脉冲后量子态复现的主动操控。

articles.title: Information limits of photonic lantern wavefront sensing: a Fisher- and quantum-Fisher-information framework and its relation to Fourier-filtering sensitivity limits
articles.title_zh: 光子灯笼波前传感的信息极限：Fisher 信息和量子 Fisher 信息框架及其与 Fourier 滤波灵敏度极限的关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29342v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The photonic lantern is an all-photonic wavefront sensor native to single-mode-fibre-fed instruments, but its performance is almost always quoted through a specific reconstruction algorithm, obscuring how much wavefront information the device itself encodes. We develop, from first principles, the Fisher-information and Cramer-Rao theory of the photonic-lantern wavefront sensor, benchmark it against the quantum Cramer-Rao bound via an explicit multi-parameter quantum-Fisher-information calculation, and relate it to two established frameworks: the Fourier-filtering noise-propagation model of Chambouleyron et al (2023) and the classical/quantum sensitivity limit of Haffert et al (2023). Treating the lantern as a deterministic map from aberration coefficients to N output intensities, we derive the Poisson and read-noise Fisher information matrices (FIM), the per-mode CRLB, the per- photon Fisher-Rao geometry on the intensity simplex, and a flux- and estimator-independent sensitivity metric beta with quantum ceiling beta = 2. The lantern CRLB scales as Nₚₕ⁽⁻¹/2) and is bounded, mode by mode, by the quantum limit of 1/2 rad rms per photon. That multi-parameter bound is jointly saturable: the phase generators are real and commuting, so the mean Uhlmann curvature vanishes and wavefront sensing carries no quantum incompatibility between simultaneously estimated modes, extending Haffert et al's single-mode ceiling to all low-order modes at once. We further show that the photon-noise sensitivity s_gamma of Chambouleyron et al is exactly the diagonal of our per- photon FIM, whereas the CRLB uses the diagonal of its inverse; the two coincide only for a diagonal FIM, so s_gamma is optimistic for a mode-mixing lantern. The framework is device-agnostic: it returns estimator-independent sensitivities comparable on a common beta <= 2 scale with pyramid, Zernike and PIAA-ZWFS sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从第一性原理建立了光子灯笼波前传感器的 Fisher 信息与 Cramer-Rao 理论，并与量子 Cramer-Rao 界以及已有 Fourier 滤波噪声传播模型相联系。作者将光子灯笼视为从像差系数到输出强度的确定性映射，推导了多种噪声条件下的信息矩阵、CRLB 和无关估计器的灵敏度指标。结果表明，该框架可在统一的量子极限尺度下比较光子灯笼与其他波前传感器，并指出某些传统灵敏度指标在模式混合时可能过于乐观。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光子灯笼是一种全光子波前传感器，天然适用于单模光纤馈入的仪器，但其性能几乎总是通过某个特定重建算法来表述，这掩盖了该器件本身编码了多少波前信息。我们从第一性原理出发，发展了光子灯笼波前传感器的 Fisher 信息和 Cramer-Rao 理论，通过显式的多参数量子 Fisher 信息计算将其与量子 Cramer-Rao 界进行基准比较，并将其与两个既有框架联系起来：Chambouleyron 等人（2023）的 Fourier 滤波噪声传播模型，以及 Haffert 等人（2023）的经典/量子灵敏度极限。将光子灯笼视为从像差系数到 N 个输出强度的确定性映射，我们推导了 Poisson 噪声和读出噪声的 Fisher 信息矩阵（FIM）、逐模式 CRLB、强度单纯形上的逐光子 Fisher-Rao 几何，以及一个与通量和估计器无关的灵敏度度量 beta，其量子上限为 beta = 2。光子灯笼的 CRLB 按 Nₚₕ⁽⁻¹/2) 标度，并且在逐模式意义上受限于每光子 1/2 rad rms 的量子极限。该多参数界可以联合饱和：相位生成元是实的并且相互对易，因此平均 Uhlmann 曲率为零，波前传感在同时估计的模式之间不存在量子不相容性，从而将 Haffert 等人的单模式上限扩展到所有低阶模式的同时估计。我们进一步表明，Chambouleyron 等人的光子噪声灵敏度 s_gamma 正是我们逐光子 FIM 的对角线，而 CRLB 使用的是其逆矩阵的对角线；二者只有在 FIM 为对角矩阵时才一致，因此对于模式混合的光子灯笼，s_gamma 是偏乐观的。该框架与器件无关：它给出了与估计器无关的灵敏度，可在共同的 beta <= 2 尺度上与金字塔、Zernike 和 PIAA-ZWFS 传感器进行比较。

articles.title: Light-induced spin-polarized desorption of Rb atoms from Co surfaces
articles.title_zh: Rb 原子从 Co 表面的光诱导自旋极化脱附
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.08442v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The spin polarization of Rb atoms undergoing light-induced desorption from a spin-polarized Co (110) surface was investigated. Desorption induced by pulsed UV-light irradiation was driven by a non-thermal mechanism and the spins of the desorbed Rb atoms were polarized. This implies spin transfer between the surface and the adsorbate during desorption.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了 Rb 原子从自旋极化 Co(110) 表面发生光诱导脱附时的自旋极化。脉冲紫外光诱导的脱附由非热机制驱动，且脱附出的 Rb 原子自旋发生极化。这表明脱附过程中表面与吸附物之间存在自旋转移。
authors: Kanta Asakawa, Naoki Tanabe, Oki Watanabe, Shuji Kamada, Keisuke Hara, Kaori Niki, Atsushi Hatakeyama
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究了 Rb 原子从自旋极化 Co(110) 表面发生光诱导脱附时的自旋极化。由脉冲紫外光照射诱导的脱附由非热机制驱动，并且脱附的 Rb 原子的自旋被极化。这意味着在脱附过程中表面与吸附物之间发生了自旋转移。

articles.title: Quantum Interference and the Limits of Separability
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.21015v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum theory implies, and empirical evidence confirms, that while particles can exhibit wave-like behavior in interferometric experiments, this behavior is so limited as not to allow for third- and higher-order interference. The article at hand shows that this possibility-impossibility structure suggests the universal validity of a principle that regulates statistical correlations between spatiotemporally localized events, independently of the nature of the objects that may or may not partake in these events. Roughly, the said principle mandates that any joint influence of m mutually spacelike separated events on another event, be such, that it can be separated by at least łceil fracm2 c̊eil mediating events, and in some cases, by no more than łceil fracm2 c̊eil mediating events. The structure of quantum interference thus teaches us that events can influence each other in a non-separable fashion, but that this non-separability has a certain exactly quantifiable limit.

articles.title: NeSyFS: A Neuro-symbolic Fast-Slow Thinking Framework for LLM Agent under Partial Observability
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in applications such as self-reflection, retrieval-augmented generation, and scientific discovery. In these settings, agents must act based on limited observations rather than full environmental states, leading to partial observability. This introduces several key challenges: belief state inference, task objective misalignment, and planning under uncertainty. Prior approaches typically condition actions on full or summarized action-observation histories whose redundant and irrelevant information can mislead the decision making of LLM agent. Inspired by human cognition, we propose a novel neuro-symbolic fast-slow thinking (NeSyFS) framework for LLM agent, addressing the challenges introduced by partial observability in a unified approach. We use a knowledge graph (KG) to represent the belief state, providing triplets as context for every module of NeSyFS. The fast-thinking module performs reactive action, while slow-thinking conducts a new uncertainty-aware planning by following the high-level structure of twisted sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC) algorithm. To mitigate the misalignment of task objective, a reflection module is used to reflect fast-thinking actions, and also switches to the slow-thinking module whenever reactive actions repeatedly fail. Experiments on three representative benchmarks, i.e. ALFWorld, Webshop, and ScienceWorld, demonstrate significant advantages over previous methods.

Within the framework of spin-current density functional theory (SCDFT), the authors present here the development and implementation—in the Vienna a b i n i t i o simulation package—of a functional that addresses these fundamental issues. articles.title: Dynamical arrest in colloidal monolayers induced by energy landscape
articles.abstract: Using video microscopy, we experimentally investigate how a periodic potential landscape influences the dynamics of colloidal monolayers. The potential is generated by a layer of densely packed particles immobilized on the substrate, creating a spatially periodic gravitational field. In the absence of this external landscape, the monolayer behaves as a supercooled liquid: particles are temporarily confined by cages formed by neighboring particles but can escape over long time scales, allowing diffusive motion and structural rearrangement. As the strength of the imposed potential increases, the system undergoes a dynamical arrest. Particles become increasingly trapped in local minima of the external potential, leading to a dramatic slowdown of particle dynamics and a suppression of structural rearrangements. This strong spatial localization also hinders the cooperative motion of particles. As a result, dynamical heterogeneity is significantly reduced during the dynamical arrest. Our results show the critical role of the energy landscape in tuning colloidal dynamics and offer insight into dynamical arrest processes in complex environments.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Liquid crystal theory of biomembranes
articles.abstract: Biomembranes, which are primarily composed of lipid bilayers, are not merely passive barriers, but dynamic, complex materials whose shapes are governed by the principles of soft-matter physics. This review examines the shape problem in biomembranes from the perspectives of materials science and liquid-crystal theory. We apply the Helfrich elastic model to the biomembrane shape in an electromagnetic field, and we extend the Helfrich free energy to multilayer systems, drawing parallels between the focal-conic structures of smectic liquid crystals and the geometries of fullerenes, carbon nanotubes, and the icosahedral virus. The review concludes by highlighting the unifying power of continuum elastic theories in describing a wide range of membrane morphologies across biological and synthetic systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Projected-interacting full configuration interaction plus regularized perturbation theory: DFT-inspired wavefunction theory for huge active spaces
articles.abstract: The computational design of molecular quantum devices requires methods that capture “the quantum and the chemistry,” approaching chemical accuracy for large numbers of entangled and/or strongly correlated electrons. Projected-interacting full configuration interaction (PiFCI) is a candidate for such simulations, providing a formally exact and systematically improvable approximation for correlation in large active spaces. PiFCI extends Kohn–Sham density functional theory by introducing multiple reference systems, each experiencing an electron–electron interaction projected onto one or more one-electron states. Compact CI expansions yield near-exact reference system wavefunctions, and projected exchange–correlation (XC) density functionals enable formally exact combinations of reference system correlation energies. This work presents a general treatment of the projected interactions in PiFCI and introduces regularized second-order many-body perturbation theory (MP2) as an approximate projected XC functional. Numerical results show that PiFCI plus regularized MP2 can accurately treat dynamical and nondynamical correlation in relatively large active spaces, including stacks of entangled singlet-coupled tetrathiafulvalene and phenalenyl organic radicals modeling molecular quantum devices.

articles.abstract: Ruthenium dioxide (RuO2) is a metal oxide that commonly serves as an important metallic conductor, quantum material and industrial electrocatalyst. While there have been debates surrounding the magnetic properties of RuO2, it is generally thought to be nonmagnetic in its bulk form. articles.title: Systematic screening of brain neurotransmitter enzymes for radical pair mechanism competence reveals quantitative constraints on magnetic field sensitivity
articles.title_zh: 脑内神经递质酶自由基对机制适用性的系统筛查揭示磁场敏感性的定量约束
articles.abstract: The radical pair mechanism (RPM) is experimentally validated in avian magnetoreception via cryptochrometextsuperscripte̊fref:Xu2021,e̊fref:Hore2016, but whether RPM-competent sites exist more broadly among brain enzymes remains unknown. Here we screen nine phosphorus-containing human brain proteins computationally, assigning cofactor-specific ³¹P hyperfine coupling constants, and find that eight satisfy all seven necessary emphspin-parameter conditions for RPM operation under physiological conditions (50~simicrotesla, 310~K), though these conditions are necessary but not sufficient---the exchange coupling J and radical pair generation mechanism impose additional, often prohibitive, constraints. The dominant discriminant is the ³¹P nuclear spin coherence time, which scales as the sixth power of the electron--phosphorus distance, creating a 64-fold gap between FAD enzymes (160~simicrosecond) and PLP enzymes (2.5~simicrosecond). We identify a complementary trade-off: enzymes with strong hyperfine coupling exhibit fast singlet--triplet mixing but short electron coherence, and vice versa. Density matrix simulation of an 8-spin model predicts a magnetic field effect of -4.4% on the singlet yield of MAO-A-catalysed serotonin oxidation at J = 0 (an upper bound; the 8-spin truncation itself overestimates MFE by sim20--40%); the actual magnitude is negligible at the crystallographic radical pair distance (|J| sim 500--1000~MHz). These findings establish that spin-parameter prerequisites for RPM are broadly distributed across brain enzymes, but simultaneously reveal that the exchange coupling constraint (|J| < 10~MHz required), homeostatic attenuation (7-fold; Table~e̊ftab:extₕₒₘₑₒₛₜₐₛᵢₛ), and CASSCF evidence against SET in MAO-A (Fig.~e̊ffig:casscf_diradical) collectively impose severe quantitative barriers. Cryptochrome---the only enzyme with a confirmed, spatially separated radical pair---emerges as the sole currently defensible RPM host, with a predicted circadian period shift of 2.7--8.2~minutes at Earth's field. The primary contribution is a falsifiable framework with experimentally testable predictions, not a claim that RPM operates in neurotransmitter-metabolising enzymes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以计算方式筛查九种含磷的人脑蛋白，评估其是否满足自由基对机制在生理条件下运行所需的自旋参数条件。结果显示，多数蛋白满足必要但非充分条件，但交换耦合、自由基对生成机制以及稳态调节等因素构成严苛限制。作者认为，目前只有隐花色素作为已确认具有空间分离自由基对的酶，仍是较可辩护的自由基对机制宿主；本文主要贡献是提出可证伪且可实验检验的框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自由基对机制（RPM）已在鸟类磁感受中的隐花色素中得到实验验证，但在脑酶中是否更广泛地存在具备 RPM 能力的位点仍属未知。本文对九种含磷的人脑蛋白进行了计算筛查，赋予其辅因子特异性的 ³¹P 超精细耦合常数，并发现其中八种在生理条件（50 微特斯拉，310 K）下满足 RPM 运行所需的全部七项必要自旋参数条件；不过这些条件只是必要而非充分条件——交换耦合 J 和自由基对生成机制会施加额外且往往是限制性的约束。主要判别因素是 ³¹P 核自旋相干时间，该时间按电子—磷距离的六次方缩放，从而在 FAD 酶（160 微秒）和 PLP 酶（2.5 微秒）之间形成 64 倍差距。我们识别出一种互补权衡：具有强超精细耦合的酶表现出快速的单重态—三重态混合，但电子相干时间较短；反之亦然。一个 8 自旋模型的密度矩阵模拟预测，在 J = 0 时，MAO-A 催化的血清素氧化的单重态产率存在 -4.4% 的磁场效应（这是上限；8 自旋截断本身会将 MFE 高估约 20–40%）；而在晶体学自由基对距离下，实际幅度可忽略不计（|J| 约为 500–1000 MHz）。这些发现表明，RPM 的自旋参数先决条件广泛分布于脑酶之中，但同时也揭示出交换耦合约束（要求 |J| < 10 MHz）、稳态衰减（7 倍；表 tab:homeostasis）以及反对 MAO-A 中发生 SET 的 CASSCF 证据（图 fig:casscf_diradical）共同构成了严峻的定量障碍。隐花色素——唯一已确认具有空间分离自由基对的酶——成为目前唯一可辩护的 RPM 宿主，预测其在地球磁场下可产生 2.7–8.2 分钟的昼夜节律周期偏移。本文的主要贡献是一个可证伪且具有可实验检验预测的框架，而不是声称 RPM 在神经递质代谢酶中运行。

articles.title: Ab initio study of Structural, Electronic, Optical, Magnetic, and Thermoelectric properties of Ba 2 HoXO 6 (X = Rh, Os, Ru) for spintronics application
articles.title_zh: 面向自旋电子学应用的 Ba₂HoXO₆（X = Rh、Os、Ru）结构、电子、光学、磁性和热电性质的从头算研究
articles.abstract: In this article, we explore the Ba2HoXO6 (X = Rh, Ru, and Os) double perovskite for its physical properties i.e. structural, electronical, optical, magnetic, and thermoelectric properties of theoretically investigated cubic compounds under PBE-GGA approximation by quantum-based density functional theory (DFT) within WIEN2K software. The structural, electronical, optical, magnetic, and thermoelectric properties of studied materials have been investigated for the energy renewable devices. Electronic properties of studied materials are explained by describing the band gap and density of states under study PBE-GGA approximation and the results abundantly evident that the studied material have indirect band gap and half metallic semiconductor. For optical behavior of studied materials, we analyzed complex dielectric functions, optical conductivity σ(ω), Absorbance α(ω), Reflectivity R(ω), and Loss parameter L(ω). Also, we analyze the thermal behavior of studied materials by calculating charge carrier concentration (n), electrical conductivity σ/τ, Seebeck coefficient (S), thermal conductivity K/τ, specific heat capacity Cv, magnetic susceptibility χ, and power factor theoretically which predict the materials are eco-friendly and could be used in energy renewable devices. These properties are calculated by Boltz-Trap code under Wien2K code. All these properties are studied though first-Principle calculation and leads to new renewable devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 WIEN2K 中基于密度泛函理论的第一性原理计算，在 PBE-GGA 近似下研究 Ba₂HoXO₆（X = Rh、Ru、Os）双钙钛矿的结构、电子、光学、磁性和热电性质。结果表明，这些材料具有间接带隙和半金属性半导体特征，并展示出与可再生能源器件相关的光学与热输运性质。作者认为这些环境友好材料有望用于新型能源与自旋电子学器件。
articles.focus_summary: 该文采用 WIEN2K 中的 PBE-GGA 密度泛函计算，研究 Ba2HoXO6 双钙钛矿的结构、电子、光学、磁性和热电性质。结果显示这些材料具有间接带隙和半金属性特征，并讨论了其在自旋电子学和能源器件中的潜在应用。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们工作的第一性原理计算、磁性材料、双钙钛矿、光电和自旋电子学方向有一定关联，但研究层次较偏常规性质计算，方法创新和核心物理问题关联度中等。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可选择性阅读其磁性基态、半金属性和自旋极化结果；若跟进，建议采用更高精度泛函、SOC、磁交换参数和输运计算来验证其自旋电子学应用潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们利用 WIEN2K 软件中基于量子力学的密度泛函理论（DFT），在 PBE-GGA 近似下，从理论上研究立方化合物 Ba₂HoXO₆（X = Rh、Ru 和 Os）双钙钛矿的物理性质，即结构、电子、光学、磁性和热电性质。研究材料的结构、电子、光学、磁性和热电性质已针对可再生能源器件进行了考察。研究材料的电子性质通过在 PBE-GGA 近似下描述带隙和态密度来解释，结果充分表明所研究材料具有间接带隙并呈现半金属性半导体特征。对于研究材料的光学行为，我们分析了复介电函数、光电导率 σ(ω)、吸收率 α(ω)、反射率 R(ω) 和损耗参数 L(ω)。此外，我们通过理论计算载流子浓度（n）、电导率 σ/τ、塞贝克系数（S）、热导率 K/τ、比热容 Cv、磁化率 χ 和功率因子来分析研究材料的热行为，这些结果预测该材料是环境友好的，并可用于可再生能源器件。这些性质是在 Wien2K 代码下通过 Boltz-Trap 程序计算得到的。所有这些性质均通过第一性原理计算加以研究，并有助于发展新的可再生能源器件。

articles.title: Phase-synchronized chorus-driven electron precipitation and diffuse aurora during geomagnetic pulsations
articles.title_zh: 地磁脉动期间相位同步的合声波驱动电子沉降与弥散极光
articles.abstract: Auroral emissions modulated at geomagnetic pulsation periods signal magnetospheric wave–particle interactions, yet how pulsations synchronize chorus waves, electron scattering, precipitation, and aurora has not been fully understood. Here we analyze a well-conjugated event observed by the Arase satellite, the EISCAT radar, and auroral imaging, combining high-time-, energy-, and pitch-angle-resolution satellite measurements with high-energy-resolution ionospheric precipitation measurements. These observations reveal synchronization among chorus waves, electron pitch-angle scattering, precipitating electron fluxes, and diffuse aurora at the pulsation period, linking chorus-driven scattering to periodic precipitation. We further suggest that geomagnetic pulsations regulate chorus waves not only by modulating source electrons but also by facilitating chorus-wave propagation. The westward propagation of the modulated diffuse aurora was consistent with that of the geomagnetic pulsations, indicating that the spatial propagation of precipitation reflected the geomagnetic pulsation structure. These results show that geomagnetic pulsations can organize chorus-driven precipitation in both time and space, revealing multiscale magnetosphere–ionosphere coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了 Arase 卫星、EISCAT 雷达和极光成像的磁共轭观测事件，揭示地磁脉动周期内合声波、电子投掷角散射、沉降电子通量和弥散极光之间的同步关系。结果表明，合声波驱动的电子散射可导致周期性沉降，并且地磁脉动可能通过调制源电子和促进合声波传播来调控这一过程。研究显示地磁脉动能够在时间和空间上组织合声波驱动的沉降，体现多尺度磁层—电离层耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在地磁脉动周期上受到调制的极光发射表明存在磁层波—粒相互作用，然而脉动如何使合声波、电子散射、沉降和极光同步尚未得到充分理解。本文分析了由 Arase 卫星、EISCAT 雷达和极光成像观测到的一个良好磁共轭事件，将高时间分辨率、高能量分辨率和高投掷角分辨率的卫星测量与高能量分辨率的电离层沉降测量相结合。这些观测揭示了合声波、电子投掷角散射、沉降电子通量和弥散极光在脉动周期上的同步性，将合声波驱动的散射与周期性沉降联系起来。我们进一步提出，地磁脉动不仅通过调制源电子来调节合声波，也通过促进合声波传播来调节合声波。受调制弥散极光的向西传播与地磁脉动的传播一致，表明沉降的空间传播反映了地磁脉动结构。这些结果表明，地磁脉动能够在时间和空间两个方面组织合声波驱动的沉降，揭示了多尺度磁层—电离层耦合。

articles.title_zh: 量子自旋效应可能增强手性磁体中的单向电输运
articles.abstract: Quantum fluctuations influence direction-dependent electrical transport in chiral magnets, researchers from Science Tokyo report. In chiral magnetic systems, electric current flows differently depending on its direction, but the role of quantum effects in this behavior has remained unclear. Through theoretical analysis, the researchers showed that chiral magnetic systems exhibit logarithmic temperature dependence at low temperatures, offering new insights into electron transport in magnetic materials. These findings are expected to play a crucial role in spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: Science Tokyo 的研究人员报告称，量子涨落会影响手性磁体中的方向依赖电输运。在这类手性磁性体系中，电流沿不同方向流动时表现不同，但量子效应在其中所起的作用此前并不清楚。通过理论分析，研究者表明这类体系在低温下呈现对数温度依赖，为磁性材料中的电子输运提供了新认识，并有望对自旋电子学发挥重要作用。

articles.title: Cesium atoms and quantum dots generate indistinguishable photons for modular quantum networks
articles.title_zh: 铯原子与量子点为模块化量子网络生成不可区分光子
articles.abstract: Large-scale quantum communication networks require both reliable quantum memories and coherent single-photon sources that can exchange quantum information efficiently. A coherent source of single photons with narrow linewidth, high brightness, spectral uniformity and compatibility with quantum memories is necessary. While a variety of single-photon sources, such as quantum dots (QDs) and atoms in warm vapor cells, have been developed in recent years, each has inherent limitations, making a scalable and functional quantum network challenging to achieve.
articles.abstract_zh: 大规模量子通信网络既需要可靠的量子存储，也需要能够高效交换量子信息的相干单光子源。要实现这一目标，必须具备线宽窄、亮度高、光谱一致性好且与量子存储兼容的相干单光子源。尽管近年来已开发出量子点和温热气室原子等多种单光子源，但各自都存在固有局限，使得可扩展、可运行的量子网络仍然难以实现。

articles.title: Electrically controlled magnetic switching shows promise for next-gen cryogenic devices

articles.abstract: Researchers at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) have demonstrated a new way of switching a material between two fundamentally different magnetic states using an electric current. The discovery could pave the way for compact, energy-efficient electronic devices that store information, perform logic operations and even interface with future quantum computers.
