articles.title: Integrated Gravity–Magnetic Interpretation for Litho-Structural Mapping and Mineralisation Targeting in the Eastern Part of Son Valley Region, Central India
articles.title_zh: 印度中部东部索恩河谷地区岩性—构造制图与成矿靶区圈定的重力—磁法综合解释
articles.abstract: The Eastern Son Valley of Central India represents a tectonically complex region comprising the Archean basement, Proterozoic Mahakoshal Belt, Vindhyan Supergroup, and Gondwana sediments. This study integrates gravity and magnetic data to delineate lithological boundaries, subsurface structures, and prospective mineralisation zones. Magnetic data were processed using reduction to the pole (RTP), analytic signal, first vertical derivative, and tilt derivative, while gravity data were analysed through regional–residual separation, upward continuation, and derivative techniques. The Bouguer gravity and RTP magnetic anomaly maps reveal prominent ENE–WSW to E–W trending structural features associated with basement heterogeneity, major fault systems, and mafic intrusions. Derivative maps delineate the Son–Narmada North Fault (SNNF), Son–Narmada South Fault (SNSF), and associated structural corridors controlling lithological contacts and intrusive emplacement. Depth estimation using spectral analysis, Euler deconvolution, and PDepth indicates source depths ranging from shallow (<1 km) to deep crustal levels (~8 km). Integrated 2D GM-SYS modelling successfully constrains the subsurface geometry, identifying dense and highly magnetic metabasic, ultramafic, and BIF bodies emplaced within the granitic basement. The structurally disturbed corridor between the SNNF and SNSF is interpreted as the most favourable zone for concealed mineralisation. Seven prospective target blocks (A–G) were delineated, demonstrating the effectiveness of integrated potential-field analysis for litho-structural mapping and mineral exploration in Precambrian shield terrains.
articles.abstract_zh: 印度中部东部索恩河谷地区是一个构造复杂的区域，由太古宙基底、元古宙 Mahakoshal 带、Vindhyan 超群和 Gondwana 沉积物组成。本研究综合重力和磁力数据，用以圈定岩性边界、地下构造和潜在成矿带。分析结果显示，研究区存在与基底非均一性、主要断裂系统和镁铁质侵入体相关的显著构造特征，并识别出多处有利于隐伏矿化的远景靶区。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 印度中部东部索恩河谷地区代表了一个构造复杂的区域，由太古宙基底、元古宙 Mahakoshal 带、Vindhyan 超群和 Gondwana 沉积物组成。本研究综合重力和磁力数据，用以圈定岩性边界、地下构造和潜在成矿带。磁力数据采用化极（RTP）、解析信号、一次垂向导数和倾斜导数处理，而重力数据则通过区域—剩余分离、向上延拓和导数技术进行分析。布格重力和 RTP 磁异常图显示出显著的 ENE–WSW 至 E–W 向构造特征，这些特征与基底非均一性、主要断裂系统和镁铁质侵入体有关。导数图圈定了 Son–Narmada 北断裂（SNNF）、Son–Narmada 南断裂（SNSF）及相关构造走廊，这些构造控制着岩性接触和侵入体的就位。通过频谱分析、Euler 反褶积和 PDepth 进行的深度估算表明，源体深度从浅部（<1 km）到深部地壳层位（约 8 km）不等。综合二维 GM-SYS 建模成功约束了地下几何形态，识别出侵入于花岗质基底中的致密且高磁性的变基性、超基性和层状铁建造（BIF）体。SNNF 与 SNSF 之间受构造扰动的走廊被解释为隐伏矿化最有利的区域。研究圈定了七个远景靶区（A–G），表明综合位场分析在前寒武纪盾区的岩性—构造制图和矿产勘查中十分有效。

articles.title: S-Modified Graphene Nanosheet for Selective Adsorptive Desulfurization: Experimental Characterization, Extractive Metallurgy, and DFT Investigation
articles.title_zh: 用于选择性吸附脱硫的硫修饰石墨烯纳米片：实验表征、萃取冶金与 DFT 研究
articles.abstract: This work presents thermodynamic studies of the adsorptive separation mechanism and the properties of S-modified graphene nanosheets (S-GNS) using density functional theory (DFT). The B97-3c composite method and the COSMO solvent model (normal hexane) are used to determine adsorption geometry, binding energies, and thermodynamic parameters. The molecules interact with S-GNS active sites through π–π stacking and donor–acceptor interactions involving S–S and S–H bonds. Neither π–π stacking nor donor–acceptor interactions alone provide substantial binding to S compounds. However, their combined effect retains diphenyl sulfide, diphenyl disulfide, and thiophenol. Experimental characterization of S-GNS using SEM, XRD, and FTIR confirms successful incorporation of S into the graphene structure, transforming it from an inert carbon surface into a chemically active adsorbent. The proposed adsorbent shows high selectivity for aromatic sulfides, disulfides, and thiophenols, along with excellent reusability. The adsorption equilibrium constant for diphenyl sulfide is 833.423 in the liquid phase (normal hexane) and 1.22 × 10⁻² in the gaseous phase at 298 K. For diphenyl disulfide, these values are 458.705 and 6.44 × 10⁻³, respectively, and for thiophenol, they are 3.646 and 8.58 × 10⁻³. In the gas phase, all equilibrium constants are less than 0.01, indicating easy regeneration. Thus, S-GNS shows potential for the adsorptive removal of S compounds and remains suitable for the desulfurization of petroleum.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用密度泛函理论对硫修饰石墨烯纳米片（S-GNS）的吸附分离机理及热力学性质进行了分析。理论结果表明，π–π 堆叠与供体—受体相互作用协同作用，才能对芳香族硫化物、二硫化物和苯硫酚形成有效吸附。实验表征进一步证实，S 已成功引入石墨烯结构，使其由惰性碳表面转变为化学活性吸附剂，并具有良好的选择性与可重复使用性。

articles.title: Accelerating Two-Dimensional Computational Fluid Dynamics via Hybrid Spectral-Geometric Neural Architectures
articles.title_zh: 通过混合谱-几何神经架构加速二维计算流体动力学
articles.abstract: Computationally resolving fluid dynamics around complex, irregular boundaries remains a central challenge in computational physics due to the multi-scale nature of complex fluid interactions. Fully resolving these dynamics through traditional projection solvers is computationally prohibitive for real-time applications, motivating data-driven machine learning alternatives. In this work, we propose a novel hybrid neural architecture for large-scale fluid simulation that combines the localized feature extraction capabilities of convolutional networks with the global wave-resolution efficiency of spectral methods. We introduce a dual-engine bottleneck that disentangles the problem space: a Geometric Soft Attention Routing mechanism captures high-frequency boundary friction, while a 2D Spectral Fourier Convolution resolves macroscopic pressure gradients in the frequency domain. Furthermore, the network is constrained during training via Deep Supervision and a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) divergence penalty that penalizes violations of incompressibility. Evaluated on zero-shot, randomly generated complex geometries, the proposed architecture achieves a baseline 414.9× acceleration over traditional Navier–Stokes solvers. Under extreme geometric stress testing (up to 10,000 discontinuous boundary elements), the model maintains constant inference time with respect to geometric complexity, scaling up to a 330,693.9× acceleration while preserving high physical fidelity.
articles.abstract_zh: 在复杂不规则边界周围精确求解流体动力学仍是计算物理中的核心难题，传统投影求解器在实时应用中往往代价过高。为此，本文提出一种混合神经架构，将卷积网络的局部特征提取能力与谱方法的全局波动解析效率相结合。该模型通过几何软注意路由捕捉高频边界摩擦，并以二维谱傅里叶卷积在频域中求解宏观压力梯度，同时借助深度监督和不可压缩性惩罚项提升物理一致性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在复杂、不规则边界周围对流体动力学进行计算求解，仍然是计算物理中的一项核心挑战，这是由于复杂流体相互作用具有多尺度特征。通过传统投影求解器对这些动力学进行完全解析在计算上代价高昂，难以满足实时应用需求，这促使人们转向数据驱动的机器学习替代方案。在本工作中，我们提出一种用于大规模流体模拟的新型混合神经架构，它将卷积网络的局部特征提取能力与谱方法的全局波动解析效率相结合。我们引入一个双引擎瓶颈结构来解耦问题空间：几何软注意路由机制用于捕捉高频边界摩擦，而二维谱傅里叶卷积则在频域中求解宏观压力梯度。此外，网络在训练过程中通过深度监督以及物理信息神经网络（PINN）散度惩罚项进行约束，以惩罚对不可压缩性条件的违反。在针对零样本、随机生成的复杂几何进行评估时，所提出的架构相较于传统 Navier–Stokes 求解器实现了 414.9 倍的基线加速。在极端几何压力测试下（边界不连续单元最多达 10,000 个），模型相对于几何复杂度保持恒定的推理时间，最高可实现 330,693.9 倍的加速，同时保持较高的物理保真度。

articles.title: Interpretable Ensemble Machine Learning for Process-Parameter-Driven Prediction of TiO₂–PVP Electrospun Nanofiber Diameter
articles.title_zh: 面向工艺参数驱动的 TiO₂–PVP 静电纺纳米纤维直径预测的可解释集成机器学习
articles.abstract: Electrospinning is the most popular method to obtain nanofibers with specific morphologic and functional features. Titanium dioxide–polyvinylpyrrolidone (TiO₂–PVP) nanofibers in particular have gained widespread research interest among different electro-spun material systems because of their excellent photocatalytic property, chemical stability and environment friendly usage. The diameter of electrospun nano fibers represents a key quality parameter that is directly responsible for surface area, porosity, mechanical properties and application specific functions of such fibers. But exact diameter control of these nanofibers coming out of the process is difficult due to the multiparameter and highly nonlinear relationship in the electrospinning process, such as polymer concentration, applied voltage, flow rate of the polymer solution and distance between tip to collector. Traditional experimental optimization techniques, mostly from the field of Design of Experiments, have drawbacks in being time consuming, intensive, and lack modelling of higher order interactions of the parameters. However, this drawback can be overcome by using the machine learning-based predictive framework, which is developed in this study for estimating the nanofiber diameter of TiO₂–PVP. Five regression algorithms – XGBoost, LightGBM, Extra Trees Regression, Gradient Boosting Regression and Linear Regression were trained and evaluated using a structured data extracted from Taguchi L9 orthogonal array experiments. To verify the integrity of the data, and to prevent data leakage, very careful data-preprocessing, such as Pearson correlation analysis, latter VIF multicollinearity analysis and train-test partitioning process from a group perspective was performed. The Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Coefficient of Determination (R²) were used to measure the model's predictive accuracy. Results from experiments show that all the models tested in this study have obtained a good prediction accuracy. In particular, Extra Trees Regression gives the best overall measure in nonlinear techniques with RMSE of 0.510 nm, MAE 0.420 nm and R² 0.99997. These results demonstrate that ensemble learning approaches are valid, high performing, and efficient surrogate models for electrospinning process prediction, and can effectively decrease experimental test efforts, while providing a high level of accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 静电纺丝是制备具有特定形貌和功能特征纳米纤维的最常用方法之一，而 TiO₂–PVP 纳米纤维因其优异的光催化性能、化学稳定性和环境友好性而受到广泛关注。本文基于正交实验数据构建机器学习预测框架，用于估计该体系纳米纤维直径，并比较了多种回归算法的性能。结果表明，集成学习方法能够作为高效且准确的代理模型，减少实验优化成本，其中 Extra Trees Regression 表现最佳。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 静电纺丝是获得具有特定形貌和功能特征的纳米纤维最流行的方法。尤其是二氧化钛—聚乙烯吡咯烷酮（TiO₂–PVP）纳米纤维，因其优异的光催化性能、化学稳定性以及环境友好用途，在不同的静电纺材料体系中引起了广泛研究兴趣。静电纺纳米纤维的直径是一个关键质量参数，它直接决定了此类纤维的比表面积、孔隙率、力学性能以及面向特定应用的功能。然而，由于静电纺过程中存在多参数且高度非线性的关系，例如聚合物浓度、施加电压、聚合物溶液流速以及针尖到收集器的距离，因此对这些纳米纤维最终直径的精确控制是困难的。传统实验优化技术，主要来自试验设计（Design of Experiments）领域，存在耗时、耗力以及缺乏对参数高阶相互作用建模等缺点。不过，这一不足可以通过机器学习驱动的预测框架加以克服；本研究即开发了该框架，用于估计 TiO₂–PVP 纳米纤维直径。研究训练并评估了五种回归算法——XGBoost、LightGBM、Extra Trees Regression、Gradient Boosting Regression 和 Linear Regression——所用数据来自 Taguchi L9 正交表实验提取的结构化数据。为验证数据完整性并防止数据泄漏，研究进行了非常谨慎的数据预处理，如 Pearson 相关性分析、随后进行的 VIF 多重共线性分析，以及基于组视角的训练—测试划分过程。采用均方根误差（RMSE）、平均绝对误差（MAE）和决定系数（R²）来衡量模型预测准确性。实验结果表明，本研究测试的所有模型都获得了良好的预测精度。尤其是 Extra Trees Regression 在非线性方法中表现最佳，其 RMSE 为 0.510 nm，MAE 为 0.420 nm，R² 为 0.99997。这些结果表明，集成学习方法是静电纺过程预测中有效、高性能且高效率的代理模型，能够有效减少实验测试工作量，同时提供很高的准确度。

articles.title: Extensible universal photonic quantum computing with nonlinearity
articles.title_zh: 具有非线性的可扩展通用光子量子计算
articles.abstract: Nature Photonics, Published online: 31 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01962-8 An extensible photonic quantum computing architecture based on a fully programmable, scalable linear-optical network has been realized, and is enhanced by two addressable modules: an inline squeezing module for injecting nonlinear resources as input states and a Kerr interaction module for implementing effective nonlinear operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种可扩展的光子量子计算架构，其基础是一个完全可编程且可扩展的线性光学网络。该架构通过两个可寻址模块增强：一个内联压缩模块用于将非线性资源作为输入态注入，另一个 Kerr 相互作用模块用于实现有效的非线性操作。该工作围绕光子量子计算中引入非线性资源与实现可扩展性的方案展开，具体性能与实现细节需参见原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Nature Photonics，在线发表：2026 年 7 月 31 日；doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01962-8。本文实现了一种基于完全可编程、可扩展线性光学网络的可扩展光子量子计算架构，并通过两个可寻址模块加以增强：一个内联压缩模块用于将非线性资源作为输入态注入，另一个 Kerr 相互作用模块用于实现有效的非线性操作。

articles.title: High‐Spin Defect Clustering and Emergent Magnetism in TiS2
articles.title_zh: TiS₂ 中的高自旋缺陷团簇与涌现磁性
articles.abstract: Advanced Functional Materials, Volume 36, Issue 61, 30 July 2026.

articles.title: Engineering Cu4Mo6Se8/Ti3C2 Hetero‐Interfaces to Boost Magnesium Storage Kinetics of Bimetallic MOF‐Derived Selenide Cathode Material for Multilayer Magnesium Metal Pouch Cell
articles.title_zh: 通过工程化 Cu₄Mo₆Se₈/Ti₃C₂ 异质界面提升双金属 MOF 衍生硒化物正极材料的镁储存动力学用于多层镁金属软包电池

articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕双金属 MOF 衍生硒化物正极材料的界面工程与镁储存动力学优化展开，目标是提升多层镁金属软包电池的性能。由于目前只有题目和期刊信息，具体材料设计、界面作用和电化学结果需查阅原文。

articles.title: MatCreatioNN: Machine learning-guided computational discovery of photocatalysts for environmental applications
articles.title_zh: MatCreatioNN：机器学习引导的环境应用光催化剂计算发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rational design of photocatalysts for environmental remediation and CO2 conversion remains limited by the high computational cost and sparse experimental data describing multi-parameter photocatalytic behavior. This work presents an integrated machine-learning framework that couples reinforcement learning-based metal-organic framework (MOF) generation with a multi-stage Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Network (CGCNN) prediction funnel to identify photocatalysts optimized across multiple electronic and structural features. 120,000 MOF candidates were generated and screened using 13 key descriptors, including band-gap suitability, CO2/H2O selectivity, adsorption energy, and structural stability. The funnel approach reduced computational cost by 4.13-fold while maintaining predictive robustness. Two top candidates, a Cr-based and a Zn-based MOF, exhibited predicted photocatalytic fitness values of 1.70 +/- 0.25 and 1.20 +/- 0.05 fold higher respectively than benchmark materials such as PCN-224(Zr), demonstrating simultaneous improvements in light absorption, redox energetics, and framework durability. Simulated X-ray diffraction patterns confirmed strong structural agreement with experimentally synthesized MOFs, indicating high synthesizability. Post-hoc analysis revealed recurring structural motifs, such as the N262 metal cluster, that correlated strongly with high predicted photocatalytic activity. These results highlight the potential of data-driven methods to accelerate discovery of efficient and durable photocatalysts for environmental and energy-related transformations, providing a foundation for experimental realization and large-scale implementation of computationally designed MOFs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个用于环境修复与 CO2 转化光催化剂发现的集成机器学习框架，将强化学习驱动的 MOF 生成与多阶段 CGCNN 预测流程相结合。该方法在大规模候选筛选中同时考虑带隙、选择性、吸附能与结构稳定性等多种描述符，并在保持预测稳健性的同时降低计算成本。结果显示，该框架有助于加速高效、耐久光催化剂的发现与后续实验实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于环境修复和 CO2 转化用光催化剂的合理设计，仍然受到高昂计算成本以及描述多参数光催化行为的实验数据稀缺的限制。本文提出一个集成机器学习框架，将基于强化学习的金属有机框架（MOF）生成与多阶段晶体图卷积神经网络（CGCNN）预测筛选流程相结合，以识别在多种电子与结构特征上优化的光催化剂。研究生成并筛选了 120,000 个 MOF 候选体，使用了 13 个关键描述符，包括带隙适配性、CO2/H2O 选择性、吸附能和结构稳定性。该筛选流程在保持预测稳健性的同时，将计算成本降低了 4.13 倍。两个最优候选体——一个基于 Cr、一个基于 Zn 的 MOF——其预测光催化适应度值分别比基准材料（如 PCN-224(Zr)）高 1.70 ± 0.25 倍和 1.20 ± 0.05 倍，表明它们在光吸收、氧化还原能级以及框架耐久性方面均有同步提升。模拟 X 射线衍射图样证实，这些结构与实验合成的 MOF 具有较强的一致性，说明其可合成性较高。后验分析揭示出若干反复出现的结构基元，例如 N262 金属簇，它们与较高的预测光催化活性呈强相关。这些结果凸显了数据驱动方法在加速高效且耐久的环境与能源相关光催化剂发现方面的潜力，并为计算设计 MOF 的实验实现与规模化应用奠定了基础。

articles.title: Harnessing Native Chromium Oxidation for Giant Orbital Torque and Field-Free Magnetization Switching in NiFe/Cr Bilayers
articles.title_zh: 利用铬的天然氧化实现 NiFe/Cr 双层中的巨大轨道力矩与无场磁化翻转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbital currents offer charge-to-spin conversion beyond the efficiency limit of conventional heavy-metal Spin Hall sources. However, harnessing them has so far required either thick orbital-Hall materials or additional heavy-metal conversion layers. Here, we show that the native oxide of chromium, typically regarded as parasitic, transforms a simple NiFeCr bilayer into a self-contained dual-channel orbital-current source without the need for any conversion layer. First-principles calculations predict a nearly threefold enhancement of the orbital Hall conductivity upon surface oxygenation, driven by Cr(3d)-O(2p) hybridization. Experimentally, naturally oxidized NiFeCr heterostructures exhibit a giant damping-like torque efficiency of 3.9 × 10⁶ Ømega⁻¹ m⁻¹, exceeding Pt (Ta) by one (two) orders of magnitude. The torque depicts a non-monotonic Cr-thickness dependence which cannot be explained by a conventional model. We have developed a drift-diffusion model with an oxidation-gated interfacial source which quantitatively reproduces the data, revealing that the Cr-CrOₓ interface generates orbital currents over an order of magnitude stronger than the bulk orbital Hall channel with an orbital transport length of approx 4 nm. The enhanced torque enables field-free magnetization switching at 1.58 × 10¹¹ A m⁻², outperforming heavy-metal and CuOₓ benchmarks. These results establish native oxidation as a scalable strategy for realizing efficient orbital-torque devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了铬天然氧化层对 NiFe/Cr 双层中轨道电流与轨道力矩的增强作用，并将其用于无外场磁化翻转。作者指出，原本被视为不利因素的氧化层可形成自包含的双通道轨道电流源，从而显著提升器件性能。相关的理论模型与实验机制在摘要中均有涉及，体现了轨道电子学在自旋器件中的应用潜力。
authors: Chirag Kalouni, Abhishek Kumar, Manish Kumar Mohanta, Kanupriya, Athira Ravindran K, Damanpreet Kaur, Preet Kamal, Puru Jena, Debangsu Roy
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轨道电流提供了一种超越传统重金属自旋霍尔源效率极限的电荷到自旋转换方式。然而，迄今为止实现这一点通常需要厚的轨道霍尔材料或额外的重金属转换层。本文表明，通常被视为寄生效应的铬天然氧化层，可将简单的 NiFeCr 双层转变为一个无需转换层的自包含双通道轨道电流源。第一性原理计算预测，表面氧化使轨道霍尔电导几乎增强三倍，这源于 Cr(3d)-O(2p) 杂化。实验上，自然氧化的 NiFeCr 异质结构表现出巨大的阻尼型力矩效率，达 3.9 × 10⁶ Ω⁻¹ m⁻¹，分别超过 Pt（Ta）一个数量级和两个数量级。该力矩表现出对 Cr 厚度的非单调依赖关系，无法用传统模型解释。我们建立了一个带有氧化门控界面源的漂移-扩散模型，能够定量重现实验数据，并揭示 Cr-CrOₓ 界面产生的轨道电流比体相轨道霍尔通道强一个数量级以上，其轨道输运长度约为 4 nm。增强后的力矩使得磁化可在 1.58 × 10¹¹ A m⁻² 下实现无场翻转，优于重金属和 CuOₓ 基准体系。这些结果确立了天然氧化作为实现高效轨道力矩器件的可扩展策略。

articles.title: Spin-incoherent Mott-Thouless pumps
articles.title_zh: 自旋不相干的莫特-汤勒斯泵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Thouless pump describes a system in which a quantized amount of charge is transported by one lattice spacing per cycle when the parameters of a Hamiltonian are varied slowly and periodically. In the standard case, this quantization requires the system to remain in its ground state with vanishing thermodynamic entropy throughout the pumping process. Here, we introduce a class of Mott-Thouless pumps, which operate in highly entropic, spin-incoherent Mott states. We show analytically that these states exhibit exponentially protected quantized transport despite their extensive entropy, because the pumped charge resides in a gapped sector that remains dynamically decoupled from the hot spin degrees of freedom. By contrast, motivated by a recent experimental realization, we identify other classes of Mott-Thouless pumps that lack this protection. In these systems, spin excitations can efficiently generate charge excitations, leading to a rapid breakdown of quantized transport. Our analytical results are supported by numerically exact real-time simulations of finite systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一类莫特-汤勒斯泵，可在具有高熵的自旋不相干莫特态中实现量子化输运。作者表明，即使体系具有广延熵，只要泵浦电荷所在的有能隙扇区与高温自旋自由度动力学解耦，量子化输运仍可获得指数保护。与此同时，文中也指出了若干缺乏这种保护的泵浦类型，并通过精确数值实时间演化予以验证。
authors: Ajesh Kumar, Urban F. P. Seifert, Erez Berg, Achim Rosch
articles.abstract_zh_full: 汤勒斯泵描述的是这样一种系统：当哈密顿量参数缓慢且周期性变化时，每个周期会以一个晶格间距传输一个量子化的电荷量。在标准情形下，这种量子化要求系统在整个泵浦过程中始终保持在其基态，并且热力学熵为零。本文提出一类莫特-汤勒斯泵，它们运行于高度熵化的自旋不相干莫特态中。我们解析地证明，这些态尽管具有广延熵，仍表现出指数保护的量子化输运，因为被泵浦的电荷位于一个具有能隙的扇区中，并在动力学上与高温自旋自由度解耦。与此相对，受最近一次实验实现的启发，我们识别出其他几类缺乏这种保护的莫特-汤勒斯泵。在这些系统中，自旋激发可以有效地产生电荷激发，从而导致量子化输运迅速失效。我们的解析结果还得到了有限系统数值精确实时间模拟的支持。

articles.title: Altermagnetism from a Cu-Fe Lieb Lattice in FeSe/Cuprate Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: FeSe/铜酸盐异质结构中来自 Cu-Fe Lieb 晶格的交替磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27331v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Realizing altermagnetism in high-T_c cuprate-based systems would provide a direct route for studying spin-split electronic bands in the absence of net magnetization and investigate their interplay with unconventional superconductivity. Here, we propose that FeSe/cuprate heterostructures offer such a platform, where a 45ⁱ̧rc twist of Cu and Fe layers creates an effective CuFe₂ Lieb lattice in which Fe magnetic order and Cu-Fe hybridization through the ligands induces altermagnetic d-wave spin splitting. A minimal tight-binding model shows that this mechanism is generic. Furthermore, a substrate-induced inequivalence of the two Se sites in FeSe provides a second route in which altermagnetism originates in the Fe layer and is transferred to the cuprate layer by proximity. Density functional theory calculations for FeSe/Bi₂Sr₂CuO₆ heterostructures confirm the viability of both mechanisms and reveal ways to enhance the spin splitting. These results establish superconducting cuprate/transition metal chalcogenide heterostructures as a promising setting for engineering altermagnetism and studying its coupling to unconventional superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出在 FeSe/铜酸盐异质结构中实现交替磁性的一种可能途径，旨在研究无净磁化情况下的自旋分裂能带及其与非常规超导性的相互作用。作者给出了基于晶格耦合与杂化的模型分析，并辅以密度泛函理论计算，说明这类异质结构是研究交替磁性的平台。该研究为超导铜酸盐与过渡金属硫族化物耦合中的磁性工程提供了思路。
authors: Ying Li, Augustin Davignon, Peng Rao, Runhan Li, Maia G. Vergniory, Roser Valentí, Johannes Knolle
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在高 T_c 铜酸盐体系中实现交替磁性，将为研究在无净磁化情况下的自旋分裂电子能带，以及探究其与非常规超导性的相互作用，提供一条直接途径。本文提出 FeSe/铜酸盐异质结构可以提供这样一个平台，其中 Cu 和 Fe 层以 45° 扭转形成一个有效的 CuFe₂ Lieb 晶格，Fe 的磁序以及通过配体产生的 Cu-Fe 杂化共同诱导出交替磁性的 d 波自旋分裂。一个最简紧束缚模型表明，这一机制具有普适性。此外，FeSe 中两个 Se 位点在基底作用下的不等价性提供了第二条途径：此时交替磁性起源于 Fe 层，并通过近邻效应传递到铜酸盐层。针对 FeSe/Bi₂Sr₂CuO₆ 异质结构的密度泛函理论计算验证了这两种机制的可行性，并揭示了增强自旋分裂的方式。这些结果确立了超导铜酸盐/过渡金属硫族化物异质结构作为工程化交替磁性以及研究其与非常规超导耦合的有前景体系。
articles.focus_summary: 该文提出在FeSe/铜氧化物异质结构中实现altermagnetism的两种机制，并通过紧束缚模型与密度泛函计算验证其可行性。结果表明，这类异质结构可产生无净磁矩的自旋劈裂，并与非常规超导性相互作用。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们关注的altermagnetism、磁性异质结构、界面耦合及第一性原理计算高度相关，也涉及超导与拓扑磁性相关方向。对理解界面诱导磁性和自旋分裂机制很有借鉴意义。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步比较其有效模型和DFT证据链，关注异质结扭转、界面杂化与自旋劈裂的对应关系。若团队后续做超导/磁性异质结构或altermagnet材料设计，可作为重要参考。

articles.title: Parity-selective spin splitting in coplanar antiferromagnets via bichromatic driving
articles.title_zh: 通过双色驱动实现共面反铁磁体中的宇称选择性自旋分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parity is a central characteristic of momentum-dependent spin splitting in antiferromagnets (AFMs). Yet, intrinsic crystal symmetries typically restrict the splitting to either even or odd parity, preventing flexible spin control. Using a coplanar AFM, we demonstrate that bichromatic (ømega--nømega) Floquet driving offers a natural way to bypass this constraint. This mechanism generates asymmetric spin textures unattainable in static AFMs or under monochromatic driving. For the specific AFM considered here, we reveal an elegant relation between spin-splitting parity and harmonic hierarchy: ømega--2ømega fields generate highly tunable odd- and mixed-parity spin splittings, whereas higher-order harmonics (n ge 3) exclusively produce even-parity states. The macroscopic magnetization can also be toggled via the specific driving protocol and harmonic n. These distinct spin splitting states manifest in qualitatively different macroscopic spin currents generated after an optical quench---a definitive transport signature complementing direct visualization via spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了共面反铁磁体中的动量依赖自旋分裂宇称控制问题，并提出利用双色 Floquet 驱动来突破静态晶体对偶/奇宇称的限制。作者指出，不同谐波组合会产生不同的自旋分裂宇称与宏观磁化响应，并在光学猝灭后的自旋电流中留下可区分的输运特征。该工作为反铁磁体系中的可调自旋操控提供了新的动力学路径。
authors: Di Zhu, Zhongbo Yan, Mohsen Yarmohammadi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 宇称是反铁磁体（AFM）中动量依赖自旋分裂的一个核心特征。然而，固有晶体对称性通常会将该分裂限制为偶宇称或奇宇称，从而阻碍灵活的自旋控制。利用一种共面反铁磁体，我们证明双色（ω–nω）Floquet 驱动提供了一种自然方式来绕开这一限制。该机制生成了在静态反铁磁体或单色驱动条件下无法获得的不对称自旋纹理。对于本文所考虑的特定反铁磁体，我们揭示了自旋分裂宇称与谐波层级之间的一种优雅关系：ω–2ω 场可产生高度可调的奇宇称和混合宇称自旋分裂，而更高阶谐波（n ≥ 3）则仅产生偶宇称态。宏观磁化也可通过特定的驱动方案和谐波 n 来切换。这些不同的自旋分裂态在光学猝灭后会表现为定性不同的宏观自旋电流，这一输运特征可与自旋分辨和角分辨光电子能谱的直接观测相互补充。

articles.title: From pink to brown: Interaction-driven noise color shift in the Aubry-André Model
articles.title_zh: 从粉红噪声到棕色噪声：Aubry-André 模型中相互作用驱动的噪声颜色转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We revisit the metal-insulator transition in a one-dimensional lattice subjected to an on-site quasiperiodic potential, modeled using spin-1/2 particles with tunable nearest-neighbor interactions. To characterize the transition, we examine the power-spectrum, defined as the squared modulus of the Fourier transform of consecutive level spacings. In the absence of interactions, the power-spectrum fails to capture clear signatures of the transition, consistently exhibiting brown-noise-like behavior across regimes. In contrast, the interacting case reveals a marked change: the metallic phase displays spectral fluctuations consistent with pink noise, while the insulating phase is characterized by brown noise. These results are supported by analyses of the level spacing distribution and the level number variance. Additionally, we demonstrate that both statistics and the structure of energy eigenstates provide reliable indicators of the transition, in both interacting and non-interacting scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究重新考察了一维准周期势晶格中的金属—绝缘体转变，并用相邻能级间距傅里叶变换的功率谱来表征谱涨落。无相互作用时，该功率谱难以清晰识别转变，各区域均呈棕色噪声特征；加入相互作用后，金属相呈粉红噪声，而绝缘相呈棕色噪声。能级间距分布、能级数方差和能量本征态结构进一步支持这些结论。
authors: M. Jiménez-Valdez, S. A. Montes-Camacho, E. J. Torres-Herrera
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们重新考察了一维晶格中由在位准周期势导致的金属—绝缘体转变，该体系用具有可调最近邻相互作用的自旋 1/2 粒子建模。为表征该转变，我们考察功率谱，即连续能级间距的傅里叶变换模平方。在不存在相互作用的情况下，功率谱未能捕捉到该转变的清晰特征，而是在不同区域中始终表现出类似棕色噪声的行为。相比之下，有相互作用的情形显示出显著变化：金属相呈现与粉红噪声一致的谱涨落，而绝缘相则以棕色噪声为特征。这些结果得到能级间距分布和能级数方差分析的支持。此外，我们证明，在有相互作用和无相互作用两种情形下，统计量以及能量本征态结构都能为该转变提供可靠指标。

articles.title: Anomalous Microwave Response in YBCO Resonators beyond the Two-Level-System Model
articles.title_zh: YBCO 谐振器中超越二能级系统模型的异常微波响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the microwave response of coplanar-waveguide (CPW) resonators fabricated from mathrmYBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ (YBCO) thin films over temperatures from approximately 70~mK to 40~K. The resonators exhibit internal quality factors Qᵢ in the range of 4×10³ to 10⁴ at 70 mK, which increase to a maximum of approximately 8×10³ to 1.2×10⁴ near 6~K. At low temperatures, both Qᵢ and the fractional shift of the resonance frequency Δ fᵣ/fᵣ increases with temperature, qualitatively resembling behavior commonly associated with two-level-system (TLS) defects. However, neither response saturates on the temperature scale set by the resonator frequency, and the loss exhibits no observable microwave-power dependence. We show that low-temperature frequency upturn may be better described by an additional paramagnetic response associated with defect-induced local moments or Andreev bound states, while the low-temperature loss follows an approximately logarithmic temperature dependence whose microscopic origin remains unresolved. These measurements establish the millikelvin performance of patterned YBCO resonators and show that their low-temperature response cannot be understood within the conventional TLS framework alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了由 YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ 薄膜制备的共面波导谐振器在约 70 mK 至 40 K 温区内的微波响应。低温下，内禀品质因数和谐振频率相对偏移随温度升高而增加，表面上类似二能级系统缺陷行为，但并不符合传统 TLS 模型的饱和和功率依赖预期。作者提出低温频率上翘可能与缺陷诱导局域磁矩或 Andreev 束缚态的顺磁响应有关，而低温损耗的微观起源仍未解决。
authors: Kaiwen Zheng, Nathan J. Johnson, Nathan T. Thobaben, Sidharth Duthaluru, Haochen Shen, Denae T. Cherry, David S. Wisbey, Kater W. Murch
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了由 YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ（YBCO）薄膜制备的共面波导（CPW）谐振器在约 70 mK 至 40 K 温度范围内的微波响应。这些谐振器在 70 mK 下表现出 4×10³ 至 10⁴ 范围内的内禀品质因数 Qi，并在约 6 K 附近增加到约 8×10³ 至 1.2×10⁴ 的最大值。在低温下，Qi 和谐振频率的相对偏移 Δfr/fr 均随温度升高而增加，在定性上类似于通常与二能级系统（TLS）缺陷相关的行为。然而，两种响应都未在由谐振器频率设定的温度尺度上达到饱和，并且损耗未表现出可观测的微波功率依赖性。我们表明，低温频率上翘可能更好地由一种额外的顺磁响应描述，该响应与缺陷诱导的局域磁矩或 Andreev 束缚态有关；而低温损耗则遵循近似对数型温度依赖，其微观起源仍未解决。这些测量确立了图案化 YBCO 谐振器在毫开尔文温区的性能，并表明其低温响应无法仅用传统 TLS 框架来理解。

articles.title: Universality of Energy-Space Entanglement in Quantum Impurity Models
articles.title_zh: 量子杂质模型中能量空间纠缠的普适性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement entropy (EE) is commonly studied using real-space bipartitions. We show that, in quantum impurity models, an energy-space bipartition, equivalent to the momentum-space bipartition of the bath, can display universal behavior. Motivated by poor man's scaling, we logarithmically discretize the bath and partition it into high- and low-energy sectors. For models with Fermi-liquid fixed points, including the Anderson model and fully screened or underscreened Kondo models, the low-energy EE flows to constants independent of model parameters. These constants are integer multiples of łn 2 plus corrections that depend only on the logarithmic discretization parameter Łambda. We show that scale invariance of the fixed-point wavefunction in energy space maps to effective translation invariance along a one-dimensional chain, allowing the fixed points to be classified by one-dimensional topological band theory. With low-energy chiral symmetry, each łn 2 contribution originates from a topological edge mode. We also study transitions between distinct Fermi-liquid fixed points using the local-singlet--Kondo-singlet transition in a two-orbital Anderson model driven by an inter-orbital antiferromagnetic coupling. The local-singlet phase has an effectively decoupled impurity and nearly vanishing EE, whereas the Kondo-singlet phase has finite EE larger than łn 2 per spin and orbital. When chiral symmetry holds at low energies, this distinction corresponds to a topological transition of the effective bath chain. At the non-Fermi-liquid critical point, the EE develops an unstable plateau. Its Łambda dependence resembles that of the overscreened two-channel Kondo model, supporting universality within the same non-Fermi-liquid universality class.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出，在量子杂质模型中，按能量空间对浴自由度进行二分可表现出普适的纠缠熵行为。对于具有费米液体不动点的模型，低能纠缠熵流向与模型参数无关的常数，并可与一维拓扑能带理论联系起来。作者还研究了局域单重态—近藤单重态转变以及非费米液体临界点，发现纠缠熵平台及其离散化参数依赖性支持同一普适类内的普适性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠熵（EE）通常利用实空间二分来研究。我们表明，在量子杂质模型中，能量空间二分——等价于浴的动量空间二分——可以表现出普适行为。受 poor man's scaling 启发，我们对浴进行对数离散化，并将其划分为高能和低能部分。对于具有费米液体不动点的模型，包括 Anderson 模型以及完全屏蔽或欠屏蔽 Kondo 模型，低能 EE 流向与模型参数无关的常数。这些常数是 ln 2 的整数倍，再加上只依赖于对数离散化参数 Λ 的修正。我们表明，不动点波函数在能量空间中的尺度不变性可映射为一维链上的有效平移不变性，从而使不动点能够由一维拓扑能带理论分类。在具有低能手征对称性的情况下，每一个 ln 2 贡献都源自一个拓扑边缘模。我们还利用双轨道 Anderson 模型中由轨道间反铁磁耦合驱动的局域单重态—Kondo 单重态转变，研究了不同费米液体不动点之间的转变。局域单重态相具有有效解耦的杂质和几乎为零的 EE，而 Kondo 单重态相具有有限 EE，且每个自旋和轨道的 EE 大于 ln 2。当低能处存在手征对称性时，这一区别对应于有效浴链的拓扑转变。在非费米液体临界点处，EE 形成一个不稳定平台。其对 Λ 的依赖性类似于过屏蔽双通道 Kondo 模型，支持同一非费米液体普适类内的普适性。

articles.title: PEDOT:PSS-Coated Magnetoelastic Sensors for Highly Sensitive Wireless Humidity Sensing
articles.title_zh: 用于高灵敏无线湿度传感的 PEDOT:PSS 涂覆磁弹性传感器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetoelastic (ME) resonators provide an attractive platform for passive and wireless sensing, particularly for monitoring relative humidity (RH) in sealed or hard-to-access environments. In this work, we introduce ME humidity sensors functionalized with poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) sulfonate (PEDOT), marking the first application of this conductive polymer in ME-based humidity sensing. PEDOT films were deposited onto Metglas resonators via a simple drop-casting process, producing uniform and mechanically stable coatings. Comprehensive structural and morphological characterization by SEM, EDX, Raman spectroscopy, AFM/KPFM, and XRD confirmed the structural integrity of the polymer and revealed humidity-induced swelling of the PSS-rich domains, accompanied by enhanced polymer-chain mobility and an increase in the lamellar spacing from 23.5 Å to 24.2 Å at 95% RH. These structural changes directly affected the dynamic response of the resonators, leading to a systematic resonance-frequency downshift driven by the combined effects of water adsorption, mass loading, and viscoelastic damping. The optimized device achieved a sensitivity of 155 Hz/% RH in the 20 - 70% RH range, outperforming previously reported ME humidity sensors, while exhibiting a resolution better than 0.1% RH together with excellent response and recovery times. These results establish PEDOT as a highly effective functional coating for magnetoelastic humidity sensors and demonstrate a simple, low-cost, wireless sensing platform with high sensitivity and strong potential for practical environmental and industrial monitoring applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究首次将导电聚合物 PEDOT 用于磁弹性湿度传感，并通过滴涂在 Metglas 谐振器上形成稳定涂层。结构与形貌表征显示，湿度会引起 PSS 富集区域膨胀、链运动增强和层状间距增大，从而导致谐振频率系统性下移。优化器件在 20–70% 相对湿度范围内达到 155 Hz/%RH 的灵敏度，分辨率优于 0.1%RH，显示出低成本无线环境与工业监测潜力。
authors: Wenderson R. F. Silva, Robson C. O. Guedes, Gilberto Rodrigues-Junior, Eduarda P. M. Campos, Angelo Malachias, Joaquim B. S. Mendes
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁弹性（ME）谐振器为无源和无线传感提供了有吸引力的平台，尤其适用于密封或难以进入环境中的相对湿度（RH）监测。在本工作中，我们引入了用聚(3,4-乙撑二氧噻吩)磺酸盐（PEDOT）功能化的 ME 湿度传感器，这是该导电聚合物在基于 ME 的湿度传感中的首次应用。PEDOT 薄膜通过简单的滴涂工艺沉积在 Metglas 谐振器上，形成均匀且机械稳定的涂层。通过 SEM、EDX、拉曼光谱、AFM/KPFM 和 XRD 进行的全面结构和形貌表征证实了聚合物的结构完整性，并揭示出湿度诱导的 PSS 富集区域膨胀，同时伴随聚合物链迁移率增强，以及在 95% RH 下层状间距从 23.5 Å 增加到 24.2 Å。这些结构变化直接影响了谐振器的动态响应，在水吸附、质量负载和黏弹阻尼的共同作用下导致谐振频率系统性下移。优化后的器件在 20–70% RH 范围内实现了 155 Hz/% RH 的灵敏度，优于此前报道的 ME 湿度传感器，同时表现出优于 0.1% RH 的分辨率以及出色的响应和恢复时间。这些结果确立了 PEDOT 作为磁弹性湿度传感器高效功能涂层的地位，并展示了一种简单、低成本、无线的传感平台，具有高灵敏度以及在实际环境和工业监测应用中的强大潜力。

articles.title: Optimization of Epitaxial Mn4N Thin Films Grown by Sputtering for Spintronic Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向自旋电子学应用的溅射外延 Mn₄N 薄膜优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferrimagnetic Mn4N has recently emerged as a promising rare-earth-free platform for spintronic devices due to its low magnetization, high domain wall mobility, and strong anomalous Hall response. However, the realization of thin films with robust perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA) and spin-orbit torque (SOT) functionality through scalable deposition techniques remains a significant challenge. In this work, we systematically investigate the growth of Mn4N thin films by reactive magnetron sputtering and determine the conditions required to achieve high-quality films suitable for SOT applications. We demonstrate that epitaxial, single-crystalline Mn4N films with strong PMA can be obtained on MgO(100), whereas films deposited on SrTiO3(100) exhibit a textured structure. The optimized films show square-shaped hysteresis loops with high remanence, large and tunable coercivity, and a pronounced anomalous Hall effect. By combining structural, magnetic, and magnetotransport characterization with density functional theory calculations, we reveal that epitaxial strain plays a key role in tuning magnetic anisotropy, while also showing that it is not the only contributing factor. In particular, our results emphasize the importance of interfacial effects in stabilizing PMA. Finally, we demonstrate efficient current-induced magnetization switching in Mn4N/Pt bilayers, confirming strong interfacial spin transparency. These findings establish sputtered Mn4N as a promising and versatile material platform for energy-efficient spin-orbitronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察了通过反应磁控溅射生长 Mn₄N 薄膜的条件，以获得适用于自旋轨道转矩器件的高质量薄膜。结果表明，在 MgO(100) 上可获得具有强垂直磁各向异性的外延单晶 Mn₄N，而在 SrTiO₃(100) 上则形成织构结构。研究还展示了 Mn₄N/Pt 双层中的高效电流诱导磁化翻转，证明溅射 Mn₄N 是有前景的低能耗自旋轨道电子学材料平台。
authors: Teodor Apetrei, Emre Demiroglu, Caner Deger, Can Onur Avci, Silvia Damerio
articles.abstract_zh_full: 亚铁磁 Mn₄N 近来已成为一种有前景的无稀土自旋电子器件平台，因为它具有低磁化强度、高畴壁迁移率和强反常霍尔响应。然而，通过可扩展沉积技术实现具有稳健垂直磁各向异性（PMA）和自旋轨道转矩（SOT）功能的薄膜仍是一项重大挑战。在本工作中，我们系统研究了通过反应磁控溅射生长 Mn₄N 薄膜，并确定了获得适用于 SOT 应用的高质量薄膜所需的条件。我们证明，在 MgO(100) 上可以获得具有强 PMA 的外延单晶 Mn₄N 薄膜，而沉积在 SrTiO₃(100) 上的薄膜则表现为织构结构。优化后的薄膜显示出方形磁滞回线，具有高剩磁、大且可调的矫顽力，以及显著的反常霍尔效应。通过将结构、磁性和磁输运表征与密度泛函理论计算相结合，我们揭示了外延应变在调控磁各向异性中起关键作用，同时也表明它并非唯一贡献因素。特别是，我们的结果强调了界面效应在稳定 PMA 中的重要性。最后，我们展示了 Mn₄N/Pt 双层中高效的电流诱导磁化翻转，证实了强界面自旋透明性。这些发现确立了溅射 Mn₄N 作为一种有前景且多用途的材料平台，可用于高能效自旋轨道电子器件。

articles.title: Structure and thermodynamic stability of β-Ga₂O₃ surfaces
articles.title_zh: β-Ga₂O₃ 表面的结构与热力学稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a comprehensive first-principles investigation of all symmetrically inequivalent low-index surfaces of β-Ga₂O₃, examining their structural properties and thermodynamic stability across experimentally relevant growth conditions. Using density-functional theory with both semi-local (PBEsol) and hybrid (PBE0) functionals, we calculate surface free energies for the (010), (100), (001), (bar201), (110), (111), and (11bar1) orientations, including the effects of harmonic vibrational contributions and varying oxygen chemical potentials. We demonstrate that the energetic ordering remains consistent across computational approaches and that the vibrational contributions remain below 0.2 J/m² up to temperatures of 1000 K. A coordination-based model that correlates surface stability with the density of under-coordinated atoms reveals that under-coordinated oxygen atoms and tetrahedral Ga sites substantially destabilize surfaces, while exposed under-coordinated octahedral Ga atoms serve as indicators of surface stability. Our thermodynamic analysis shows that stoichiometric terminations dominate over nearly the entire range of chemical potentials relevant for β-Ga₂O₃ stability, while non-stoichiometric terminations emerge only under extreme reducing or oxidizing conditions. Notably, we predict the formation of stable Ga-rich terminations resembling Ga adlayers for the (100) and (bar201) surfaces under highly reducing conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用第一性原理方法系统考察 β-Ga₂O₃ 所有对称不等价低指数表面的结构性质和热力学稳定性。作者比较了 PBEsol 和 PBE0 泛函结果，并考虑谐振振动贡献和氧化学势变化，发现表面能排序在不同计算方法下保持一致。研究表明，近乎整个稳定化学势范围内化学计量终止占主导，而非化学计量终止仅在极端还原或氧化条件下出现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对 β-Ga₂O₃ 的所有对称不等价低指数表面进行了全面的第一性原理研究，考察了它们在实验相关生长条件下的结构性质和热力学稳定性。利用密度泛函理论中的半局域（PBEsol）和杂化（PBE0）泛函，我们计算了 (010)、(100)、(001)、(bar201)、(110)、(111) 和 (11bar1) 取向的表面自由能，并纳入了谐振振动贡献和变化的氧化学势的影响。我们证明，能量排序在不同计算方法下保持一致，并且在高达 1000 K 的温度下，振动贡献仍低于 0.2 J/m²。一个基于配位的模型将表面稳定性与欠配位原子密度相关联，该模型揭示，欠配位氧原子和四面体 Ga 位点会显著降低表面稳定性，而暴露的欠配位八面体 Ga 原子则可作为表面稳定性的指标。我们的热力学分析表明，在与 β-Ga₂O₃ 稳定性相关的几乎整个化学势范围内，化学计量终止占主导，而非化学计量终止仅在极端还原或氧化条件下出现。值得注意的是，我们预测在高度还原条件下，(100) 和 (bar201) 表面会形成类似 Ga 吸附层的稳定富 Ga 终止。

articles.title: Decoding the Micromagnetic Hamiltonian from Magnetic Fingerprints
articles.title_zh: 从磁性指纹解码微磁哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extracting intrinsic magnetic Hamiltonians directly from magnetometry is challenging due to the high dimensionality of the parameter space and the degeneracy induced by ensemble averaging. Here, we introduce a collection of deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to extract the full phenomenological micromagnetic Hamiltonian directly from the magnetic fingerprints encoded within First-Order Reversal Curves (FORCs). We validate this approach via closed-loop verification, re-creating the input magnetometry for both simulated and experimental FORCs. To mitigate false positives, we deploy an `Alice--Bob' parallel network that quantifies prediction uncertainty based on solely the information in FORCs without any additional ground-truth knowledge. This framework provides a robust, machine-learning-assisted approach to unravel the underlying spin behaviors in complex magnetic systems
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一组深度卷积神经网络，直接从一阶反转曲线（FORC）中编码的磁性指纹提取完整的唯象微磁哈密顿量。作者通过闭环验证在模拟和实验 FORC 上重建输入磁测数据，并引入“Alice--Bob”并行网络仅基于 FORC 信息量化预测不确定性，以降低误报。该框架为解析复杂磁性系统中的自旋行为提供了稳健的机器学习辅助方法。
authors: Bradley J. Fugetta, Anqi Liu, Kai Liu, Amy Y. Liu, Gen Yin
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27430v1 公告类型：新稿。摘要：由于参数空间的高维性以及系综平均所诱导的简并性，直接从磁测量中提取内禀磁哈密顿量具有挑战性。在这里，我们引入一组深度卷积神经网络（CNN），以直接从一阶反转曲线（FORC）中编码的磁性指纹提取完整的唯象微磁哈密顿量。我们通过闭环验证来验证该方法，即针对模拟和实验 FORC 重新生成输入磁测数据。为减轻假阳性，我们部署了一个“Alice--Bob”并行网络，该网络仅基于 FORC 中的信息、无需任何额外的真实值知识来量化预测不确定性。该框架提供了一种稳健的、机器学习辅助的方法，用于揭示复杂磁性系统中潜在的自旋行为。

articles.title: Extended s-wave superconductivity in M-point twisted bilayer SnSe2
articles.title_zh: M点扭转双层SnSe2中的扩展s波超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the emergence of electronic order and unconventional superconductivity in M-valley moiré materials. Starting from a first-principles Wannier model of AB-stacked twisted SnSe2, we tackle the (gate-screened) long-ranged Coulomb interaction with functional renormalization group simulations resolving the momentum structure and energy scales of the leading Fermi surface instabilities. Upon doping an antiferromagnetic stripe state at half-filling (ν=3 electrons per moiré unit cell) of the moiré flat bands, magnetic order gives way to unconventional superconductivity mediated by valley-selective spin fluctuations: Large hole doping (νapprox1) leads to weak-coupling superconductors with various pairing symmetries, while slight electron- and hole-doping (νapprox2,4) stabilizes a spin-singlet, extended s-wave state that benefits from scattering between virtual particle and hole states that are detuned from the Fermi level. These findings establish M-point moiré materials as a quantum simulation platform with phenomenological parallels to the class of iron pnictide superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了M谷 moiré 材料中电子有序与非常规超导的形成机制。基于AB堆垛扭转SnSe2的第一性原理Wannier模型，并结合功能重整化群模拟，作者解析了长程库仑相互作用下主要费米面不稳定性的动量结构与能量尺度。结果表明，在掺杂半填充反铁磁条纹态后，磁有序会通过谷选择性自旋涨落介导的机制转变为非常规超导；其中轻微电子或空穴掺杂时稳定出现自旋单态的扩展s波态。该工作将M点 moiré 材料确立为与铁基超导体具有现象学相似性的量子模拟平台。
authors: Lennart Klebl, Ammon Fischer, Salahudin V. Smailagić, Ming-Rui Li, Henning Schlömer, Haoyu Hu, B. Andrei Bernevig, Dante M. Kennes, Ronny Thomale
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了M谷 moiré 材料中电子有序和非常规超导的出现。我们从AB堆垛扭转SnSe2的第一性原理Wannier模型出发，借助功能重整化群模拟处理（栅控屏蔽的）长程库仑相互作用，从而解析主导费米面不稳定性的动量结构和能量尺度。当在moiré平带半填充（ν=3个电子/每个moiré晶胞）的反铁磁条纹态上进行掺杂时，磁有序会让位于由谷选择性自旋涨落介导的非常规超导：较大的空穴掺杂（ν约为1）会导致具有多种配对对称性的弱耦合超导体，而轻微的电子与空穴掺杂（ν约为2、4）则稳定出一种自旋单态的扩展s波态，该态受益于发生在费米能级之外、失谐的虚粒子与虚空穴态之间的散射。上述发现将M点 moiré 材料确立为一种量子模拟平台，并与铁基超导体这一类材料在现象学上具有相似性。

articles.title: Topology of Shape and Data in Material Microstructures
articles.title_zh: 材料微结构中形状与数据的拓扑学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One of the challenges in microstructure analysis is the rigorous quantification of the shape, size, and spatial arrangement of the microstructure beyond comparison of average values. We expound on formal principles combining Topological Data Analysis (TDA) and non-Euclidean distances between curves to motivate novel perspectives on the form and nature of pattern and shape in images. Specifically, TDA descriptors extracting persistent topological structures are combined with product submanifold learning of separable shape tensors (SST) to offer unique insights about electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) images of material microstructures through the lens of a dual-parameter filtration. Beyond standard approaches, our methodology highlights how different choices or permutations of shape distances can lead to distinct notions of topological persistence, thereby broadening the interpretive scope of TDA. The resulting visualizations of feature extraction are designed to be both principled and explanatory, offering novel tools for modern imaging science with applications to material metrology. More broadly, this framework has strong potential to impact domains where precise quantification of topology and shape is critical for uncovering fundamental image patterns and features, and enables additional data-driven tools for microstructure analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对微结构分析中如何超越平均值，对形状、尺寸及空间排布进行严格量化这一难题展开讨论。作者将拓扑数据分析与曲线之间的非欧氏距离结合，并提出以双参数过滤为核心、用于EBSD图像分析的形状张量分离子流形学习框架。该方法不仅能提取持久拓扑结构，还强调不同形状距离选择会导向不同的拓扑持久性概念，从而拓展TDA的解释范围。
authors: Jeanie Schreiber, Zachary Grey, Adam Creuziger
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微结构分析中的一个挑战，是要严格量化微结构的形状、尺寸以及空间排列，而不能仅仅停留在平均值的比较上。本文阐述了结合拓扑数据分析（TDA）与曲线之间非欧氏距离的形式化原理，以此激发对图像中模式与形状之形式及本质的新视角。具体而言，作者将提取持久拓扑结构的TDA描述子与可分形状张量（SST）的乘积子流形学习相结合，通过双参数过滤的视角，为材料微结构的电子背散射衍射（EBSD）图像提供独特见解。不同于标准方法，本文方法强调，形状距离的不同选择或排列会导向不同的拓扑持久性概念，从而拓宽TDA的解释范围。由此得到的特征提取可视化旨在兼具原则性与解释性，为现代成像科学提供新的工具，并可应用于材料计量学。更广义地说，这一框架在需要精确量化拓扑与形状以揭示图像基本模式和特征的领域具有很大潜力，并可为微结构分析提供更多数据驱动工具。

articles.title: Temperature-doping phase diagram and endurance in Ce-doped HfO2
articles.title_zh: Ce掺杂HfO2的温度-掺杂相图与耐久性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The structural and ferroelectric properties of epitaxial Hf1-xCexO2 (CHO) thin films in the ultrathin regime are investigated as a function of Ce concentration (5% <= x <= 20%) and temperature. A temperature-doping phase diagram is established for 10 nm films, showing a systematic evolution from the ferroelectric orthorhombic phase to tetragonal and cubic phases with increasing Ce content. The orthorhombic-tetragonal transition temperature decreases from ~800degC at x = 5% to ~300degC at x = 15%, indicating strong stabilization of higher-symmetry phases with doping. Consistently, the remanent polarization decreases from ~15 to 3.8 μC/cm2 as x increases from 5% to 20%. In contrast, the endurance improves significantly, with higher Ce concentrations exhibiting markedly enhanced cycling stability up to 108 cycles. The opposing trends of polarization and endurance are correlated with reduced orthorhombic distortion, suggesting that fatigue mitigation in Ce-doped HfO2 is linked to structural evolution. These results provide a framework for optimizing composition and reliability in ultrathin ferroelectric HfO2 devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了超薄外延Hf1-xCexO2薄膜的结构与铁电性质随Ce浓度和温度的变化规律。作者建立了10 nm薄膜的温度-掺杂相图，发现随着Ce含量增加，铁电正交相逐步转变为四方相和立方相。与此同时，剩余极化随掺杂增加而下降，但循环耐久性显著提升，且这种反向趋势与正交畸变减小有关。
authors: Amit Kumar Shah, Haidong Lu, Kawshan Hathurusingha, Alexei Gruverman, Xiaoshan Xu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了超薄区外延Hf1-xCexO2（CHO）薄膜的结构和铁电性质随Ce浓度（5%≤x≤20%）及温度的变化。对于10 nm薄膜，作者建立了温度-掺杂相图，显示随着Ce含量增加，体系会系统地从铁电正交相演化到四方相和立方相。正交相到四方相的转变温度随着x从5%时约800℃下降到x为15%时约300℃，这表明掺杂显著稳定了高对称性相。与此一致，剩余极化随着x从5%增加到20%而从约15 μC/cm2降至3.8 μC/cm2。相反，耐久性则显著改善，更高Ce浓度样品的循环稳定性明显增强，最高可达10⁸次循环。极化与耐久性的相反变化趋势与正交畸变的减小相关，说明Ce掺杂HfO2中的抗疲劳提升与结构演化有关。上述结果为优化超薄铁电HfO2器件的组分与可靠性提供了一个框架。

articles.title: Beyond Hexagonal Boron Nitride: First-Principles Study of Pentaoctite-BN and Pop-BN Monolayers
articles.title_zh: 超越六方氮化硼：Pentaoctite-BN与Pop-BN单层的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27554v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate two novel non-hexagonal boron nitride monolayers, pentaoctite-BN (PO-BN) and pop-BN (PP-BN), using first-principles calculations. Their structural, electronic, mechanical, vibrational, thermal, and optical properties are systematically analyzed to assess their stability and potential applications. Despite being metastable with respect to hexagonal BN, both polymorphs satisfy the criteria for dynamical, mechanical, and thermal stability, indicating that they are viable two-dimensional materials. Both systems are indirect-gap semiconductors whose electronic states near the band edges are dominated by out-of-plane pz orbitals. Their distinct pentagon-octagon ring networks also give rise to different in-plane elastic anisotropies. Many-body optical calculations reveal strong excitonic effects and pronounced polarization-dependent optical absorption, with lattice engineering shifting the optical response from the ultraviolet toward the visible and infrared regions. These findings demonstrate that engineering non-hexagonal lattice architectures provides an effective strategy for tuning the electronic and optical properties of two-dimensional BN, highlighting PO-BN and PP-BN as promising candidates for future optoelectronic and photonic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用第一性原理计算研究了两种新型非六方氮化硼单层，即pentaoctite-BN和pop-BN。结果表明，尽管它们相对于六方BN是亚稳态，但在动力学、力学和热稳定性上均满足二维材料可行性的要求。两者均为间接带隙半导体，并表现出显著的激子效应和偏振依赖光吸收，说明通过非六方晶格工程可有效调控BN的电子与光学性质。
authors: Victor M. S. da Conceição, Erika N. Lima, Roberto H. Miwa, Igor S. S. de Oliveira
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用第一性原理计算研究了两种新型非六方氮化硼单层：pentaoctite-BN（PO-BN）和pop-BN（PP-BN）。我们系统分析了它们的结构、电子、力学、振动、热学和光学性质，以评估其稳定性和潜在应用。尽管它们相对于六方BN是亚稳态，但两种多晶型都满足动力学稳定、力学稳定和热稳定的判据，表明它们是可行的二维材料。两种体系都是间接带隙半导体，其带边附近的电子态主要由面外pz轨道主导。它们不同的五边形-八边形环网络也导致了不同的面内弹性各向异性。多体光学计算表明，它们具有强烈的激子效应和显著的偏振依赖吸收，而晶格工程可将光学响应从紫外区调节到可见光和红外区域。上述发现表明，构建非六方晶格架构是调控二维BN电子与光学性质的一种有效策略，并突出PO-BN和PP-BN作为未来光电与光子应用候选材料的潜力。

articles.title: Anisotropic Tensile Strength and Fracture Mechanism of θ-TaN: A Machine-Learning Potential Molecular Dynamics Study
articles.title_zh: θ-TaN的各向异性拉伸强度与断裂机制：一种机器学习势分子动力学研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27608v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: theta-phase tantalum nitride (theta-TaN) combines metallic conductivity with exceptionally high thermal conductivity, making it a potential material for device thermal management and interconnect applications. However, its tensile strength and fracture behavior remain unclear. Here, we investigate the anisotropic tensile response and fracture mechanism of theta-TaN using neuroevolution-potential molecular dynamics simulations. Size-convergence tests show that a 20 nm long model is sufficient for reliable prediction, and the mechanical parameters vary by less than 3.5% over the strain-rate range of 10⁷ to 10⁹ s⁻¹. The results reveal strong tensile anisotropy. The c-axis direction ([0001]) shows a higher strength of 80.10 GPa and modulus of 748.63 GPa, but a lower fracture strain of 15.02%. In contrast, the a-axis direction ([2-1-10]) shows a lower strength of 56.87 GPa and modulus of 570.74 GPa, but a higher fracture strain of 17.71%. From 300 to 900 K, the mechanical properties decrease nearly linearly, while more than 73% of the 300 K strength is retained at 900 K. Fracture occurs without observable dislocation activity and is governed by cleavage-plane selection: 10-10 prismatic planes under a-axis tension and the (0001) basal plane under c-axis tension. Atomic displacement analysis shows that local separation and microvoid formation precede macroscopic crack growth, indicating a brittle fracture process driven by local bond-network instability. These results provide atomic-scale mechanical data for assessing the reliability of theta-TaN in thermal management applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用基于神经进化势的分子动力学模拟，研究了θ相氮化钽的拉伸响应与断裂行为。结果显示，该材料具有显著的拉伸各向异性：c轴方向强度和模量更高，但断裂应变较低；a轴方向则相反。温度升高会使力学性能近似线性下降，但在900 K时仍能保留300 K强度的73%以上。断裂过程不伴随可观测位错活动，而是由特定解理面选择和局部键网络失稳主导。
authors: Chenyang Cao, Hongfei Li, Shuo Cao
articles.abstract_zh_full: θ相氮化钽（θ-TaN）兼具金属导电性和异常高的热导率，因此有望用于器件热管理和互连应用。然而，其拉伸强度和断裂行为仍不明确。本文采用神经进化势分子动力学模拟，研究了θ-TaN的各向异性拉伸响应与断裂机制。尺寸收敛测试表明，长度为20 nm的模型已足以给出可靠预测，并且在10⁷到10⁹ s⁻¹的应变率范围内，力学参数变化小于3.5%。结果显示出强烈的拉伸各向异性。c轴方向（[0001]）具有更高的强度80.10 GPa和模量748.63 GPa，但断裂应变较低，为15.02%。相比之下，a轴方向（[2-1-10]）具有较低的强度56.87 GPa和模量570.74 GPa，但断裂应变更高，为17.71%。在300到900 K之间，力学性质近似线性下降，但在900 K时仍保留了300 K强度的73%以上。断裂在没有可观测位错活动的情况下发生，其过程由解理面的选择所控制：a轴拉伸时为10-10柱面，c轴拉伸时为(0001)基面。原子位移分析表明，在宏观裂纹扩展之前，会先出现局部分离和微孔形成，这说明断裂是由局部键网络失稳驱动的脆性断裂过程。上述结果为评估θ-TaN在热管理应用中的可靠性提供了原子尺度力学数据。

articles.title: Iterative minimization in reduced density matrix functional theory for periodic systems
articles.title_zh: 周期体系约化密度矩阵泛函理论中的迭代最小化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27679v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reduced density matrix functional theory (RDMFT) offers a route beyond Kohn-Sham density functional theory for strongly correlated systems, yet practical calculations for periodic solids are still out of reach. We formulate RDMFT for extended systems in a basis-independent way and present a planewave implementation using iterative minimization for periodic solids, evaluating nonlocal exchange-correlation functionals through the existing adaptive compressed exchange machinery. Natural occupations are optimized under N-representability constraints with a spectral projected gradient (SPG) method or an first-order explicit-by-implicit (EBI) map, while natural orbitals are updated by Riemannian optimization on the complex Stiefel manifolds. Benchmarks on typical systems of ȩH2, silicon, and sodium with the Hartree-Fock functional show that SPG reproduces converged hybrid references, whereas EBI can stall when occupations approach 0 or 1. With the power and Müller functionals, SPG yields lower energies and more stable convergence than EBI. Applications to fractionally charged ȩLiH, dissociating ȩH2 and ȩN2 molecules, and equation of state of silicon show that the algorithm presented in this implementation is reliable and robust.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向周期性固体，提出了基于平面波的约化密度矩阵泛函理论实现，并采用迭代最小化优化自然占据数和自然轨道。作者比较了谱投影梯度方法和显式-隐式一阶映射，发现前者在多种泛函和体系中收敛更稳定、能量更低。对分数带电 LiH、解离 H2/N2 以及硅状态方程的应用表明该算法可靠且稳健。
authors: Kai Luo, Jingang Han, Peize Lin, Daye Zheng, Mohan Chen, Xinguo Ren
articles.abstract_zh_full: 约化密度矩阵泛函理论（RDMFT）为强关联体系提供了一条超越 Kohn-Sham 密度泛函理论的途径，然而用于周期性固体的实际计算仍然难以实现。我们以基组无关的方式表述了扩展体系的 RDMFT，并提出了一种用于周期性固体的平面波实现，其中采用迭代最小化，并通过现有的自适应压缩交换机制来评估非局域交换-相关泛函。自然占据数在 N-可表示性约束下通过谱投影梯度（SPG）方法或一阶显式-隐式（EBI）映射进行优化，而自然轨道则通过复 Stiefel 流形上的黎曼优化进行更新。对典型体系 H2、硅和钠采用 Hartree-Fock 泛函进行的基准测试表明，SPG 能够复现收敛的杂化泛函参考结果，而当占据数接近 0 或 1 时，EBI 可能停滞。对于 power 泛函和 Müller 泛函，SPG 相比 EBI 给出更低的能量和更稳定的收敛。对分数带电 LiH、解离 H2 和 N2 分子以及硅状态方程的应用表明，本实现中提出的算法可靠且稳健。

articles.title: A Universal Crystal-Field Design Principle for Orbital-Order-Driven Altermagnetism
articles.title_zh: 面向轨道有序驱动交变磁性的通用晶体场设计原则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine collinear antiferromagnetic order with nonrelativistic spin splitting, enabling spintronic functionalities without relying on spin--orbit coupling. While staggered orbital ordering has recently emerged as an alternative route to altermagnetism, its generality has remained unexplored. Here, we establish a universal crystal-field design principle for orbital-order-driven altermagnetism. We show that structural relaxation consistently reconstructs the crystal-field landscape, activating a common dₓz/dyz orbital manifold that drives spontaneous staggered orbital ordering and robust d-wave nonrelativistic spin splitting across transition-metal compounds spanning electron fillings from d¹ to d⁷. By introducing a unified symmetry framework based on layer-dependent magnetic and orbital order parameters, we demonstrate how interlayer stacking determines whether the system realizes a bulk altermagnetic state or a globally compensated antialtermagnetic phase. Furthermore, we reveal that this symmetry-protected spin-split texture gives rise to highly anisotropic spin-polarized conductivities. Our results establish crystal-field engineering as a predictive design strategy for discovering and engineering orbital-order-driven altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一种通过晶体场工程设计轨道有序驱动交变磁性的通用原则。作者指出，结构弛豫会重构晶体场并激活共同的 dxz/dyz 轨道流形，从而在多种过渡金属化合物中诱发交错轨道有序和稳健的 d 波非相对论自旋劈裂。研究还建立了层依赖磁序和轨道序参量的统一对称性框架，用以区分体相交变磁态和全局补偿的反交变磁相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁体将共线反铁磁有序与非相对论自旋劈裂结合起来，从而能够在不依赖自旋--轨道耦合的情况下实现自旋电子学功能。尽管交错轨道有序最近已成为通向交变磁性的另一条途径，但其普适性仍未得到探索。在这里，我们建立了一种用于轨道有序驱动交变磁性的通用晶体场设计原则。我们表明，结构弛豫会持续重构晶体场景观，激活一个共同的 dₓz/dyz 轨道流形，该流形在电子填充从 d¹ 到 d⁷ 的过渡金属化合物中驱动自发交错轨道有序和稳健的 d 波非相对论自旋劈裂。通过引入一个基于层依赖磁序参量和轨道序参量的统一对称性框架，我们展示了层间堆垛如何决定体系实现体相交变磁态还是全局补偿的反交变磁相。此外，我们揭示这种受对称性保护的自旋劈裂织构会产生高度各向异性的自旋极化电导率。我们的结果确立了晶体场工程作为发现和工程化轨道有序驱动交变磁体的预测性设计策略。
articles.focus_summary: 本文提出一种用于反铁磁替代磁体（altermagnet）的普适晶场设计原则，说明结构弛豫会重构晶场环境，激活特定轨道简并并诱发交错轨道有序，从而产生稳定的非相对论自旋劈裂。作者还给出层间堆垛与磁/轨道序参数的统一对称性框架，并预测了各向异性的自旋极化电导。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在磁性材料、自旋相关物理和磁拓扑性质方面的工作高度相关，尤其契合 altermagnetism、非共线磁性和自旋劈裂输运等方向。其对称性分析与晶场设计思路也可借鉴到我们对磁超结构和自旋哈密顿量的建模中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步关注其晶场-轨道序-自旋劈裂之间的判据是否能推广到二维范德华磁体或界面体系。也可结合第一性原理与自旋哈密顿量，筛选具有类似替代磁性特征的候选材料。

articles.title: Unconventional and Fragile Magnetic Exciton in a van der Waals Quantum Magnet
articles.title_zh: 范德华量子磁体中的非常规且脆弱的磁激子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recently discovered magnetic exciton in the van der Waals (vdW) antiferromagnet NiPS3 exemplifies these phenomena, exhibiting several distinctive characteristics. Despite extensive investigation, much of its physics remains unresolved, with key questions about why the NiPS3 magnetic exciton is so sharp and optically bright despite the nominally spin-forbidden transition, posing significant challenges to a proper understanding and practical manipulation of the exciton. An urgent question is to what extent it is due to chemical disorder, magnetic weakening, lattice modification, or intrinsic instability of the bright exciton itself: answers to which will put stringent constraints on possible theoretical models. Here we address these questions using hydrostatic pressure as a clean, continuous, reversible, and in-situ tuning parameter. We find that the sharp photoluminescence peak is drastically suppressed by as little as 0.4 GPa and completely quenched by 1.5 GPa, with demonstrating its reversibility. Crucially, this bright-to-dark conversion occurs without magnetic, crystallographic, or electronic reconstruction despite an increase in the Neel temperature, as established by Raman, X-ray absorption, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, and first-principles many-body calculations. Our results demonstrate that the optical brightness of the magnetic exciton is independent of chemical disorder, lattice expansion, and weakening of magnetic order, indicating that a higher-order correlated mechanism governs the bright exciton. We further propose experimentally constrained microscopic scenarios involving exciton pairing, crystal-field-controlled spin-orbit mixing, and symmetry breaking, providing a framework for future tests of entangled magnetic exciton in correlated quantum magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用静水压力作为清洁、连续、可逆的原位调控手段，考察 NiPS3 中磁激子的明亮光学响应来源。结果显示，尖锐光致发光峰在低至 0.4 GPa 时显著减弱、1.5 GPa 时完全猝灭，但这一明暗转变并不伴随磁、晶体或电子结构重构。作者认为其亮度不由化学无序、晶格膨胀或磁序削弱主导，而可能涉及更高阶关联机制。
authors: Kai-Xuan Zhang, Min Zhang, Minjae Kim, Yong-Hyun Kim, Junghyun Kim, Heejun Yang, Pyeongjae Park, Chaebin Kim, Mangesh Diware, Junik Hwang, Youjin Lee, Byeong-Gwan Cho, Hyeong-Do Kim, Tae-Yeong Koo, Chunhua Chen, Mingtao Li, Xujie Lü, Wenge Yang, Kee-Hoon Kim, Seung-Ho Baek, Hyeonsik Cheong, Sung-Keun Lee, Beom Hyun Kim, Christopher Lane, Jian-Xin Zhu, Zhaorong Yang, Young-Woo Son, Je-Geun Park
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近在范德华（vdW）反铁磁体 NiPS3 中发现的磁激子体现了这些现象，并表现出若干独特特征。尽管已有广泛研究，其许多物理仍未解决，其中关键问题包括：为何 NiPS3 磁激子尽管名义上属于自旋禁戒跃迁，却如此尖锐且具有光学亮度；这些问题对正确理解和实际操控该激子构成了重大挑战。一个紧迫的问题是，它在多大程度上源于化学无序、磁性削弱、晶格改性，或明亮激子本身的内禀不稳定性；这些答案将对可能的理论模型施加严格约束。在这里，我们使用静水压力作为一种清洁、连续、可逆且原位的调控参数来回答这些问题。我们发现，尖锐的光致发光峰在低至 0.4 GPa 的压力下就被急剧抑制，并在 1.5 GPa 时完全猝灭，同时证明了其可逆性。关键的是，正如拉曼、X 射线吸收、核磁共振谱以及第一性原理多体计算所确立的那样，这种由亮到暗的转变并未发生磁性、晶体学或电子结构重构，尽管 Néel 温度有所升高。我们的结果表明，磁激子的光学亮度独立于化学无序、晶格膨胀和磁有序削弱，说明一种高阶关联机制支配着明亮激子。我们进一步提出了受实验约束的微观情景，涉及激子配对、晶体场控制的自旋-轨道混合以及对称性破缺，为未来检验关联量子磁体中的纠缠磁激子提供了框架。

articles.title: Optimization of magneto-electric properties in Lead-free (x)Co1.2Ti0.2Fe1.6O4 - (100-x)BaTiO3 based composites
articles.title_zh: 无铅 (x)Co1.2Ti0.2Fe1.6O4–(100-x)BaTiO3 基复合材料磁电性能的优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work presents a systematic study of lead-free multiferroic composites of (x)Co1.2Ti0.2Fe1.6O4 - (100-x)BaTiO3 (x = 10, 20, 30), which were synthesized by a solid-state reaction method to investigate the effects of composition and sintering temperature on their structural , electrical, magnetic, and magnetoelectric (ME) properties. X-ray diffraction along with Rietveld refinement confirms the coexistence of tetragonal BaTiO3 (BTO) and cubic spinel Co1.2Ti0.2Fe1.6O4 (CTFO) phases. Microstructural analysis shows that densification and grain growth are better at higher sintering temperatures, leading to better coupling between the two phases. Dielectric and ferroelectric studies indicate lossy polarization-electric field (P-E) behaviour due to leakage from the conductive phase, while magnetic properties show increased magnetization with increasing ferrite content. All composites exhibit ME coefficients, which depend on the composition and sintering conditions; the highest ME coefficient (~1.28 mV/cm.Oe) was observed for the 30CTFO - 70BTO composite sintered at 1200 degC. This improvement is due to the optimal balance between magnetostrictive and piezoelectric responses and improved interfacial strain transfer. These results demonstrate that simultaneous optimization of dopant-modified composition and sintering conditions is essential for achieving improved magnetoelectric coupling in bulk multiferroic composites. Moreover, the results demonstrate the potential of lead-free composites for multifunctional device applications in next-generation, low-power technologies, including high-density non-volatile memory (e.g. FeRAM/MRAM), magnetic field sensors, spintronic devices, and actuators.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作系统研究了无铅多铁复合材料 (x)Co1.2Ti0.2Fe1.6O4–(100-x)BaTiO3 在不同组成和烧结温度下的结构、电学、磁学及磁电性能。结果表明，提高铁氧体含量和优化烧结条件可改善磁化强度与界面应变传递，其中 30CTFO–70BTO 在 1200°C 烧结时获得最高磁电系数。研究强调，掺杂改性组成与烧结工艺的协同优化对提升块体多铁复合材料磁电耦合至关重要。
authors: Rajeev Dwivedi, Samanway Mohanta, Ashutosh Anand, Abhinash Tripathy, Najnin Bano, Dharmendra Kumar, Hemant Singh, R. Venkatesh, Sachin Gupta, Dinesh Kumar Shukla
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本工作对无铅多铁复合材料 (x)Co1.2Ti0.2Fe1.6O4 - (100-x)BaTiO3（x = 10、20、30）进行了系统研究，这些材料通过固相反应法合成，以考察组成和烧结温度对其结构、电学、磁学和磁电（ME）性能的影响。X 射线衍射结合 Rietveld 精修证实了四方 BaTiO3（BTO）相与立方尖晶石 Co1.2Ti0.2Fe1.6O4（CTFO）相的共存。微结构分析表明，在更高烧结温度下致密化和晶粒长大更好，从而使两相之间的耦合更佳。介电和铁电研究表明，由于导电相引起的漏电，极化-电场（P-E）行为具有损耗特征，而磁性能显示磁化强度随铁氧体含量增加而增强。所有复合材料均表现出磁电系数，其大小取决于组成和烧结条件；在 1200 degC 烧结的 30CTFO - 70BTO 复合材料中观察到最高磁电系数（约 1.28 mV/cm.Oe）。这种提升归因于磁致伸缩响应和压电响应之间的最佳平衡以及界面应变传递的改善。这些结果表明，同时优化掺杂改性组成和烧结条件对于在块体多铁复合材料中实现增强的磁电耦合至关重要。此外，结果证明了无铅复合材料在下一代低功耗技术中的多功能器件应用潜力，包括高密度非易失性存储器（例如 FeRAM/MRAM）、磁场传感器、自旋电子器件和致动器。

articles.title: Tilt-driven ferrielectricity in PbZrO₃
articles.title_zh: PbZrO₃ 中由倾斜驱动的亚铁电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We reveal a tilt-driven mechanism for ferrielectricity in prototypical antiferroelectric PbZrO₃. Specifically, introducing an additional octahedral tilt into the antiferroelectric Pbam phase breaks the symmetry constraint that enforces equal antiparallel dipoles, converting the compensated ``p̆arrow p̆arrow downarrow downarrow'' nonpolar configuration into an uncompensated ``p̆arrow p̆arrow downarrow downarrow'' polar Pmc2₁ phase. First-principles calculations show that the Pmc2₁ phase becomes stabilized under lattice contraction and gains increasing free-energy advantage over competing phases at finite temperatures. Atomic-scale imaging directly confirms the presence of Pmc2₁₋ₗᵢₖₑ structures in thin films and single crystals. This work identifies a symmetry-governed, kinetically easily accessible pathway to ferrielectricity and establishes a form of ``competitive'' improper ferroelectricity, with broad implications for antiferroelectrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究揭示了原型反铁电体 PbZrO₃ 中一种由八面体倾斜驱动的亚铁电机制。额外八面体倾斜打破了反平行偶极等量补偿的对称性约束，使非极性构型转变为未补偿的极性 Pmc2₁ 相。第一性原理与原子尺度成像共同支持该相在晶格收缩和有限温度下的稳定性及其在薄膜和单晶中的存在。
authors: Huazhang Zhang, Ying Liu, Carson Carroll, Saptam Ganguly, Bin Xu, Xiaozhou Liao, Gustau Catalan, Philippe Ghosez, Nicholas C. Bristowe
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们揭示了原型反铁电体 PbZrO₃ 中一种由倾斜驱动的亚铁电机制。具体而言，在反铁电 Pbam 相中引入额外的八面体倾斜，会打破强制等量反平行偶极的对称性约束，将补偿的“p̆arrow p̆arrow downarrow downarrow”非极性构型转化为未补偿的“p̆arrow p̆arrow downarrow downarrow”极性 Pmc2₁ 相。第一性原理计算表明，Pmc2₁ 相在晶格收缩下变得稳定，并且在有限温度下相对于竞争相获得越来越大的自由能优势。原子尺度成像直接证实了薄膜和单晶中存在类似 Pmc2₁ 的结构。本工作确定了一条由对称性支配、动力学上易于到达的亚铁电路径，并建立了一种“竞争性”非本征铁电性形式，对反铁电体具有广泛意义。

articles.title: Finite-temperature bulk moduli from an EOS-based Grüneisen function
articles.title_zh: 基于状态方程的 Grüneisen 函数预测有限温度体模量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27803v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An equation-of-state (EOS)-based construction of the Grüneisen function is developed and assessed through predictions of finite-temperature bulk moduli. In this approach, the volume dependence of the Grüneisen function is expressed analytically in terms of static EOS information, anchored by Debye temperatures obtained from elastic data sampled near equilibrium, and constrained by the infinite-compression limit. The resulting form requires as material-specific input only static energy-volume data and near-equilibrium elastic properties, with no parameters adjusted to thermal data. Within a Mie--Grüneisen--Debye framework, the approach is examined for diamond, magnesium oxide, silicon, and sodium chloride, chosen to span a broad range of stiffness, using machine-learning interatomic potentials from the Universal Models for Atoms (UMA) and Universal Point Edge Transformer (UPET) families, together with a dispersion-corrected variant of UMA. The calculated bulk moduli reproduce the expected experimental softening trends and capture the overall scale of the bulk-modulus temperature derivatives, although the level of quantitative agreement depends on the material, the underlying interatomic potential, and the selected analytic EOS form. These results show that an EOS-based construction of the Grüneisen function can capture the leading thermal-softening behavior of bulk moduli without fitting to thermal data. The observed sensitivity to the underlying static description further suggests that the framework may help identify deficiencies relevant to thermoelastic transferability and thereby inform future training and validation strategies for universal machine-learning interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出并评估了一种基于状态方程构造 Grüneisen 函数的方法，用于预测有限温度体模量。该方法仅依赖静态能量-体积数据和近乎平衡的弹性性质，不对热数据拟合参数。对金刚石、氧化镁、硅和氯化钠的测试表明，该框架能捕捉主要热软化趋势，但定量精度受材料、势函数和解析状态方程形式影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文发展了一种基于状态方程（EOS）构造 Grüneisen 函数的方法，并通过预测有限温度体模量对其进行了评估。在这种方法中，Grüneisen 函数的体积依赖性以静态 EOS 信息的解析形式表示，以由近乎平衡区域采样的弹性数据得到的 Debye 温度为锚定，并受无限压缩极限约束。所得形式所需的材料特异性输入仅包括静态能量-体积数据和近乎平衡的弹性性质，没有任何参数根据热数据进行调整。在 Mie--Grüneisen--Debye 框架内，该方法针对金刚石、氧化镁、硅和氯化钠进行了考察，这些材料被选择用于覆盖较宽的刚度范围；所用势函数包括来自 Universal Models for Atoms（UMA）和 Universal Point Edge Transformer（UPET）系列的机器学习原子间势，以及一种加入色散校正的 UMA 变体。计算得到的体模量再现了预期的实验软化趋势，并捕捉了体模量温度导数的整体尺度，尽管定量符合程度取决于材料、所用原子间势以及所选解析 EOS 形式。这些结果表明，基于 EOS 构造 Grüneisen 函数能够在不拟合热数据的情况下捕捉体模量的主要热软化行为。观察到的对底层静态描述的敏感性进一步表明，该框架可能有助于识别与热弹性可迁移性相关的缺陷，从而为通用机器学习原子间势的未来训练和验证策略提供参考。

articles.title: Significant ordinary Nernst effect contribution to spin-orbit torque harmonic Hall measurements in metallic structures
articles.title_zh: 金属结构中普通 Nernst 效应对自旋轨道力矩谐波霍尔测量的显著贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27813v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The harmonic Hall measurements are commonly used to quantify the spin-orbit torque in ferromagnet/normal metal bilayers. The contribution from ordinary Nernst effect to the second harmonic voltages is usually assumed to be negligible and omitted in the data analysis. We show that in Cr/Co bilayers the ordinary Nernst effect cannot be neglected and can lead to largely exaggerated values of spin-orbit torque efficiency. Conducting additional experiments, we estimate the Nernst coefficient of Cr and find it comparable to the values reported for other metals. Consequently, the ordinary Nernst effect should be carefully considered when employing the harmonic Hall technique to quantify spin-orbit torque in metals, while the results of some previous works might need to be re-examined.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，在铁磁/普通金属双层膜中用谐波霍尔方法定量自旋轨道力矩时，普通 Nernst 效应对二次谐波电压的贡献可能不可忽略。作者以 Cr/Co 双层膜为例表明，忽略该贡献会显著高估自旋轨道力矩效率。研究建议在金属体系中应用谐波霍尔技术时应仔细考虑普通 Nernst 效应，并重新审视部分既有结果。
authors: Igor Lyalin, C. C. Chiang, C. L. Chien
articles.abstract_zh_full: 谐波霍尔测量通常用于定量铁磁体/普通金属双层膜中的自旋轨道力矩。普通 Nernst 效应对二次谐波电压的贡献通常被假定为可以忽略，并在数据分析中被省略。我们表明，在 Cr/Co 双层膜中，普通 Nernst 效应不能被忽略，并且可能导致自旋轨道力矩效率的数值被大幅夸大。通过开展额外实验，我们估计了 Cr 的 Nernst 系数，发现其与其他金属已报道的数值相当。因此，在采用谐波霍尔技术定量金属中的自旋轨道力矩时，应仔细考虑普通 Nernst 效应，而此前一些工作的结果可能需要重新检验。

articles.title: Deep Learning for Accelerated Long-Horizon Forecasting of Multicomponent Multiphase Microstructure Evolution in High-Entropy Alloys
articles.title_zh: 用于高熵合金多组元多相微结构演化长时程快速预测的深度学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27820v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase-field modeling provides a powerful approach for predicting microstructure evolution but becomes computationally prohibitive for multicomponent and multiphase systems over large spatial and temporal scales. This work presents an AE-GCN-LSTM surrogate framework for long-horizon forecasting of microstructure evolution in the multicomponent AlCrFeNi high-entropy alloy system containing coexisting BCC and FCC phases. A multi-head autoencoder compresses the four elemental concentration fields and phase-field order parameter into latent representations, which are formulated as graphs for learning their spatial and temporal evolution. The framework accurately forecasts microstructure evolution over horizons extending to 3,000,000 simulation timesteps. Its robustness is systematically evaluated under previously unseen conditions without retraining, fine-tuning, or parameter adaptation. These evaluations include variations in FCC precipitate size and initial position, microstructures containing one, two, and five FCC precipitates, and complex phase interactions involving precipitate merging and splitting. Although trained only on 100 x 100 computational domains containing a single nominal alloy composition, the framework is successfully transferred to larger 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 systems and to previously unseen AlCrFeNi compositions. Across the evaluated configurations, the model preserves the dominant phase morphology and compositional evolution while providing computational speedups ranging from approximately 7200 to 62300 relative to conventional phase-field simulations. These results demonstrate that latent graph-based AE-GCN-LSTM forecasting provides a scalable and computationally efficient surrogate for long-horizon simulation of multicomponent, multiphase microstructures and offers a promising foundation for high-throughput alloy design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 AE-GCN-LSTM 替代模型，用于快速预测含 BCC 和 FCC 共存相的 AlCrFeNi 高熵合金微结构长时程演化。模型将元素浓度场和相场序参量压缩为潜在表示并构建图结构学习时空演化，可在未重新训练的情况下推广到不同析出物形貌、更大计算域和新合金组成。结果显示，该方法在保持主要相形貌和成分演化的同时，相比传统相场模拟实现数千到数万倍加速。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相场建模为预测微结构演化提供了一种强有力的方法，但对于大空间和时间尺度上的多组元、多相体系而言，其计算成本高到难以承受。本工作提出了一种 AE-GCN-LSTM 替代框架，用于对含有共存 BCC 和 FCC 相的多组元 AlCrFeNi 高熵合金体系中的微结构演化进行长时程预测。一个多头自编码器将四个元素浓度场和相场序参量压缩为潜在表示，并将这些表示构造成图以学习其空间和时间演化。该框架能够准确预测延伸至 3,000,000 个模拟时间步的微结构演化。其稳健性在此前未见条件下进行了系统评估，且无需重新训练、微调或参数自适应。这些评估包括 FCC 析出物尺寸和初始位置的变化，包含一个、两个和五个 FCC 析出物的微结构，以及涉及析出物合并和分裂的复杂相互作用。尽管该框架仅在含单一名义合金组成的 100 x 100 计算域上训练，但它成功迁移到更大的 256 x 256 和 512 x 512 体系，以及此前未见的 AlCrFeNi 组成。在所评估的各种构型中，模型保持了主要相形貌和成分演化，同时相对于传统相场模拟提供了约 7200 到 62300 倍的计算加速。这些结果表明，基于潜在图的 AE-GCN-LSTM 预测为多组元、多相微结构的长时程模拟提供了一种可扩展且计算高效的替代模型，并为高通量合金设计提供了有前景的基础。

articles.title: Scalar-spin-chirality-driven fractional Chern insulator on a kagome lattice
articles.title_zh: Kagome 晶格上由标量自旋手性驱动的分数量子 Chern 绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) are the lattice analogs of the fractional quantum Hall states, emerging even without an external magnetic field. In this work, we demonstrate the emergence of the FCI states in a kagome magnet with a noncoplanar magnetic order that induces a finite scalar spin chirality. By incorporating in our model both electron-electron interactions and the effect of band dispersion, we find that stronger interactions relative to the band dispersion stabilize the FCI state over a broader range of scalar spin chirality. We characterize the emergent FCI state by calculating overlap with representative states, identifying the ground-state degeneracy and the finite energy gap in the thermodynamic limit, and tracking the spectral flow under multiple flux-quantum insertions. Our results suggest that kagome magnets with scalar spin chirality can be promising platforms for realizing FCIs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了在具有非共面磁序的 kagome 磁体中，有限标量自旋手性可诱导分数量子 Chern 绝缘体态。作者在模型中同时考虑电子-电子相互作用和能带色散效应，发现相互作用相对色散越强，FCI 态在更宽的标量自旋手性范围内越稳定。通过重叠、基态简并、能隙和通量插入谱流等分析，研究确认了该拓扑态特征。
authors: Shinnosuke Tsutsumi, Koji Kudo, Kentaro Nomura
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数量子 Chern 绝缘体（FCI）是分数量子霍尔态的晶格类似物，即使没有外加磁场也能出现。在本工作中，我们证明了 FCI 态可在具有非共面磁序的 kagome 磁体中出现，该磁序诱导有限的标量自旋手性。通过在模型中同时纳入电子-电子相互作用和能带色散效应，我们发现，相对于能带色散更强的相互作用会在更宽的标量自旋手性范围内稳定 FCI 态。我们通过计算其与代表性态的重叠、识别热力学极限下的基态简并和有限能隙，以及跟踪多个磁通量子插入下的谱流，来表征出现的 FCI 态。我们的结果表明，具有标量自旋手性的 kagome 磁体可能是实现 FCI 的有前景平台。

articles.title: Giant nonlinear Hall effect in a Pt/ferrimagnetic insulator bilayer under Zeeman-exchange frustration
articles.title_zh: Zeeman-交换阻挫下 Pt/亚铁磁绝缘体双层中的巨非线性霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competing magnetic interactions can create metastable or unstable states and render magnetic systems highly susceptible to external perturbations. Here we show that Zeeman-exchange frustration in an Al-substituted terbium iron garnet with a compositional gradient across its thickness gives rise to a giant nonlinear Hall response in an adjacent Pt layer. Near magnetic compensation, a field-induced spin-flip transition is accompanied by unusually large higher-order odd harmonic voltages, with the third, fifth, and seventh harmonics reaching amplitudes comparable to that of the first harmonic. The field, temperature, and current dependences collectively identify Joule heating as the parametric drive of the harmonic response. Macrospin-chain simulations further show that current-induced thermal modulation periodically switches the interfacial Fe magnetization between exchange- and Zeeman-dominated states and reproduces the observed harmonic signals. These results demonstrate how frustration can convert a weak thermal perturbation into a large nonlinear electrical response, providing a route to nonlinear magnetotransport in compensated ferrimagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究发现，在具有厚度方向成分梯度的 Al 掺杂铽铁石榴石中，Zeeman-交换阻挫会在相邻 Pt 层中诱发巨大的非线性霍尔响应。接近磁补偿时，场诱导自旋翻转伴随异常强的高阶奇次谐波电压，其三、五、七次谐波幅度可接近一次谐波。实验依赖关系和宏自旋链模拟表明，焦耳热驱动界面 Fe 磁化在不同主导状态间周期切换，从而产生该非线性响应。
authors: Takayuki Shiino, Matteo Fettizio, Weronika Janus, Can Onur Avci
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相互竞争的磁相互作用可以产生亚稳态或不稳定态，并使磁性体系对外部扰动高度敏感。在这里，我们表明，在厚度方向具有成分梯度的 Al 取代铽铁石榴石中，Zeeman-交换阻挫会在相邻 Pt 层中产生巨大的非线性霍尔响应。在磁补偿附近，场诱导的自旋翻转转变伴随着异常大的高阶奇次谐波电压，其中第三、第五和第七谐波的幅度达到与第一谐波相当的水平。场、温度和电流依赖性共同表明，焦耳热是谐波响应的参数驱动。宏自旋链模拟进一步表明，电流诱导的热调制会周期性地将界面 Fe 磁化在交换主导态和 Zeeman 主导态之间切换，并再现实验观察到的谐波信号。这些结果展示了阻挫如何将微弱热扰动转化为巨大的非线性电响应，为补偿亚铁磁体中的非线性磁输运提供了一条途径。

articles.title: High-Field EPR/ENDOR of N/Be Centers for Defect Engineering in 6H-SiC
articles.title_zh: 用于 6H-SiC 缺陷工程的 N/Be 中心高场 EPR/ENDOR 研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon carbide (SiC) in its various structural modifications is widely used in power semiconductor electronics, operating under extreme conditions of high temperature, high voltage, and intense radiation. The discovery of spin defects (S>0) with unique optical and coherent properties has further positioned SiC as a promising platform for quantum technologies. Here, we investigate a 6H-SiC single crystal co-doped with nitrogen and beryllium at concentrations of 1018 cm-3, using continuous-wave and pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) and electron-nuclear double resonance (ENDOR). To enhance spectral resolution, experiments were conducted in the W-band (94 GHz; B = 3.4 T). Pulsed EPR identified nitrogen donors and beryllium acceptors in various lattice positions, allowing for the determination of their phase coherence and spin-lattice relaxation times. ENDOR measurements elucidated the electron-nuclear interactions with the local silicon and carbon environment, including distant coordination spheres. The observed hyperfine structures indicated highly delocalized spin density within the supercell. The TRIPLE resonance spectra verify coupled nuclear spin subspaces from different coordination spheres due to defect spin density. These results demonstrate the feasibility of incorporating dual impurities with distinct functional roles while preserving the crystal lattice`s structural features.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用 W 波段连续波和脉冲 EPR 以及 ENDOR 技术研究了氮、铍共掺 6H-SiC 单晶中的缺陷中心。实验识别了不同晶格位置的氮施主和铍受主，并测定了相干和自旋-晶格弛豫时间。ENDOR 与 TRIPLE 共振结果揭示了电子与局域硅、碳环境及更远配位壳层的相互作用，表明自旋密度高度离域。
authors: Yuliya Ermakova, Ekaterina Dmitrieva, Margarita Sadovnikova, Fadis Murzakhanov, George Mamin, Sergey Nagalyuk, Evgeny Mokhov, Marat Gafurov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 碳化硅（SiC）在其各种结构改型中广泛用于功率半导体电子学，并可在高温、高电压和强辐射等极端条件下工作。具有独特光学和相干性质的自旋缺陷（S>0）的发现，进一步使 SiC 成为量子技术的有前景平台。在这里，我们使用连续波和脉冲电子顺磁共振（EPR）以及电子-核双共振（ENDOR），研究了一种氮和铍共掺、浓度为 1018 cm-3 的 6H-SiC 单晶。为提高谱分辨率，实验在 W 波段（94 GHz；B = 3.4 T）进行。脉冲 EPR 识别了不同晶格位置的氮施主和铍受主，从而能够确定它们的相位相干时间和自旋-晶格弛豫时间。ENDOR 测量阐明了与局域硅和碳环境的电子-核相互作用，包括较远的配位壳层。观察到的超精细结构表明超晶胞内存在高度离域的自旋密度。TRIPLE 共振谱验证了由缺陷自旋密度导致的、来自不同配位壳层的耦合核自旋子空间。这些结果证明，在保持晶体晶格结构特征的同时，引入具有不同功能角色的双重杂质是可行的。

articles.title: Hyperchaos in a Magnetic Nanodisk Driven by Ferromagnetic Resonance
articles.title_zh: 铁磁共振驱动的磁性纳米盘中的超混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27884v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the chaotic dynamics driven in the nonlinear regime of ferromagnetic resonance of an out-of-plane magnetized nanodisk in detail. By combining extensive micromagnetic simulations with time-series analysis across the control parameter space, we map the topological transitions from stable periodic orbits to strange attractors and quantify the dynamical complexity. Despite the simplicity of our nanoscale system, we evidence that it can exhibit hyperchaotic dynamics with up to three positive Lyapunov exponents in vast regions of the control plane accessible to experimental studies. Using a mode projection technique, we unveil that the generated complexity is related to the number of quantized spin-wave modes participating in the dynamics. Our findings establish magnon-spintronic nanodevices as versatile entropy sources for unconventional processing of information.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察了垂直磁化纳米盘在铁磁共振非线性区间中的混沌动力学。通过微磁模拟和时间序列分析，作者绘制了从稳定周期轨道到奇异吸引子的拓扑转变，并发现该纳米体系可在实验可达参数区域表现出最多三个正 Lyapunov 指数的超混沌。模投影分析表明，复杂性与参与动力学的量子化自旋波模数量有关。
authors: A Kolli (SPEC - UMR3680), Hugo Merbouche (SPEC - UMR3680), Salvatore Perna (DIETI), Claudio Serpico (DIETI), Damien Rontani (LMOPS), Grégoire de Loubens (SPEC - UMR3680)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们详细研究了在面外磁化纳米盘的铁磁共振非线性区域中被驱动产生的混沌动力学。通过将广泛的微磁模拟与跨控制参数空间的时间序列分析相结合，我们绘制了从稳定周期轨道到奇异吸引子的拓扑转变，并量化了动力学复杂性。尽管我们的纳米尺度体系十分简单，但我们证明它能够在实验研究可及的控制平面广阔区域中表现出具有多达三个正 Lyapunov 指数的超混沌动力学。利用模投影技术，我们揭示了所产生的复杂性与参与动力学的量子化自旋波模数量有关。我们的发现确立了磁振子-自旋电子纳米器件作为用于非常规信息处理的多功能熵源的地位。

articles.title: Finite-size effects and interaction-driven crossovers in quarter-filled attractive Hubbard model: Exact diagonalization, DMRG and machine-learning analysis
articles.title_zh: 四分之一填充吸引性 Hubbard 模型中的有限尺寸效应与相互作用驱动交叉：精确对角化、DMRG 与机器学习分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the quarter-filled attractive Hubbard model on finite-width cylindrical lattices using exact diagonalization (ED), density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and unsupervised machine-learning-based techniques. Analysis of the ground-state energetics, local observables and correlation functions reveals a continuous interaction-driven crossover from weakly correlated fermions to a regime dominated by tightly bound singlet pairs. This crossover originates from the competition between kinetic-energy-driven fermionic itinerancy and interaction-driven onsite pair formation and exhibits behavior consistent with the BCS--BEC crossover in the thermodynamic limit. Hole-binding-energy calculations provide direct energetic evidence for pair formation: the two-hole binding energy remains negative throughout the attractive regime whereas three-hole binding emerges only at sufficiently strong attraction and exhibits pronounced finite-size dependence. To obtain an unbiased characterization of the correlation landscape, we apply principal component analysis (PCA) and uniform manifold approximation and projection (UMAP) to the real-space correlation matrices. PCA reveals a systematic redistribution of correlation variance whereas UMAP identifies a clear separation between weak- and strong-pairing regimes. Both machine-learning-based approaches independently identify the same crossover region inferred from conventional observables while providing an order-parameter-independent characterization of the underlying reorganization of many-body correlations. Finite-size scaling analyses of the pairing structure factor and the leading PCA variance ratio demonstrate that these signatures remain robust with increasing system size.
