articles.title: Cutting Condition Monitoring in Milling within Enclosed Environments Using a Microphone Array and Random Forest
articles.title_zh: 使用麦克风阵列与随机森林在封闭环境中监测铣削切削条件
articles.abstract: In modern industry, monitoring systems have become essential for detecting process deviations and enabling preventive adjustments before defective parts are manufactured, thereby reducing production costs. Acoustic emission is an attractive source of information for monitoring machining processes. However, acoustic signals can be contaminated by background noise and, within the enclosed environment of a machine tool, by reverberation caused by the reflective metallic surfaces of the enclosure. This study evaluates the feasibility of monitoring cutting conditions in end milling using a microphone array positioned inside this highly reverberant environment, which exhibits acoustic behavior close to that of a diffuse field. Experiments were conducted on a machining center during end-milling operations using a four-microphone array mounted close to the spindle. The results showed that the enclosure produced a diffuse acoustic field without completely masking the acoustic signature of the cutting process. To mitigate the influence of the diffuse sound field, the proposed signal-processing strategy combined octave-band decomposition with Wiener filtering. Its effectiveness was assessed by comparing two feature extraction strategies. The first employed conventional broadband time- and frequency-domain features commonly reported in the literature, whereas the second extracted root-mean-square (RMS) descriptors from octave-band signals after Wiener filtering. The results demonstrated that the conventional broadband descriptors were highly susceptible to the homogenizing effects of reverberation. In contrast, the octave-band RMS descriptors preserved significantly greater sensitivity to variations in the machining parameters, demonstrating that frequency-selective analysis retains process-related information that is largely lost when global broadband metrics are employed. The Random Forest algorithm was subsequently used to further validate the proposed feature extraction strategies by classifying cutting conditions across six independent experimental trials. Whereas the conventional broadband strategy achieved an average classification accuracy of 64.7% with a standard deviation of 26.5%, the proposed frequency-selective strategy achieved an average accuracy of 95.5% with a standard deviation of only 8.1%. These findings indicate that the proposed frequency-selective methodology provides substantially greater robustness against reverberation and background noise typically encountered in enclosed industrial machining environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究在机床封闭、强混响环境中，利用安装在主轴附近的四麦克风阵列监测端铣切削条件的可行性。研究提出将倍频程频带分解与维纳滤波结合的频率选择性特征提取方法，并与传统宽带时域和频域特征进行比较。结果表明，倍频程 RMS 特征显著提高了对加工参数变化的敏感性，并使随机森林分类准确率由传统方法的平均 64.7% 提升至 95.5%，显示出更强的抗混响和抗背景噪声能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在现代工业中，监测系统对于检测过程偏差并在制造出缺陷零件之前实现预防性调整已变得至关重要，从而能够降低生产成本。声发射是监测机械加工过程的一种有吸引力的信息来源。然而，声学信号可能受到背景噪声污染，并且在机床的封闭环境中，还会受到由封闭罩反射性金属表面引起的混响影响。本研究评估了在这种高度混响环境中使用布置于内部的麦克风阵列监测端铣切削条件的可行性，该环境表现出接近扩散声场的声学行为。实验在一台加工中心上进行，过程中执行端铣操作，并使用安装在主轴附近的四麦克风阵列。结果表明，封闭罩产生了扩散声场，但并未完全掩盖切削过程的声学特征。为减轻扩散声场的影响，所提出的信号处理策略结合了倍频程频带分解与维纳滤波。通过比较两种特征提取策略来评估其有效性。第一种策略采用文献中常见的传统宽带时域和频域特征，而第二种策略则从经过维纳滤波后的倍频程频带信号中提取均方根（RMS）描述符。结果表明，传统宽带描述符高度易受混响均质化效应的影响。相比之下，倍频程频带 RMS 描述符对加工参数变化保持了显著更高的敏感性，表明频率选择性分析保留了与过程相关的信息，而这些信息在使用全局宽带指标时很大程度上会丢失。随后使用随机森林算法，通过在六次独立实验试验中对切削条件进行分类，进一步验证所提出的特征提取策略。传统宽带策略的平均分类准确率为 64.7%，标准差为 26.5%；而所提出的频率选择性策略的平均准确率为 95.5%，标准差仅为 8.1%。这些发现表明，所提出的频率选择性方法对于封闭工业加工环境中通常遇到的混响和背景噪声具有显著更高的鲁棒性。

articles.title: Synthetic Phenotype Assisted Linear Mixed Models Improve Proteome-Wide Genetic Discovery in Incomplete Biobank Data
articles.title_zh: 合成表型辅助线性混合模型提升不完整生物样本库数据中的蛋白质组范围遗传发现能力
articles.abstract: The UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP) generated plasma proteomic data for 54,219 participants. However, proteomic measurements remain unavailable for approximately 90% of the UK Biobank participants. This substantial missingness significantly limits the power for proteome-wide genetic discovery, and downstream genome-wide association studies (GWAS) using traditional imputation methods can yield spurious associations if prediction models are misspecified. We propose the Synthetic Phenotype Assisted Linear Mixed models (Syn-PALM), a robust and computationally scalable synthetic data-assisted framework for GWAS in the presence of partially observed measurements. Syn-PALM jointly analyzes partially observed proteomic measurements and complete synthetic data predicted for all samples using machine learning models, while accounting for cryptic relatedness and population structure using mixed models. Syn-PALM is robust to prediction model misspecification and increases statistical power as prediction accuracy improves. Through simulations, ablation analyses, and GWAS analysis of the UKB-PPP data, Syn-PALM improves power over existing methods and boosts proteome-wide genetic discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对 UK Biobank 中蛋白质组测量大量缺失导致遗传发现能力受限的问题，提出合成表型辅助线性混合模型 Syn-PALM。该框架联合分析部分观测到的蛋白质组数据与机器学习预测得到的全样本合成数据，并通过混合模型控制隐含亲缘关系和群体结构。模拟、消融分析和 UKB-PPP 数据的 GWAS 结果表明，Syn-PALM 相比现有方法具有更高统计功效，并能增强蛋白质组范围遗传发现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 英国生物样本库制药蛋白质组学项目（UKB-PPP）为 54,219 名参与者生成了血浆蛋白质组数据。然而，约 90% 的英国生物样本库参与者仍缺乏蛋白质组测量。这种大量缺失显著限制了蛋白质组范围遗传发现的统计功效，并且如果预测模型设定错误，使用传统插补方法进行的下游全基因组关联研究（GWAS）可能产生虚假关联。我们提出合成表型辅助线性混合模型（Syn-PALM），这是一种稳健且计算上可扩展的合成数据辅助框架，用于在存在部分观测测量值的情况下开展 GWAS。Syn-PALM 联合分析部分观测到的蛋白质组测量值和利用机器学习模型为所有样本预测得到的完整合成数据，同时使用混合模型控制隐含亲缘关系和群体结构。Syn-PALM 对预测模型设定错误具有稳健性，并且随着预测准确性的提高而增加统计功效。通过模拟、消融分析以及对 UKB-PPP 数据的 GWAS 分析，Syn-PALM 相比现有方法提高了统计功效，并增强了蛋白质组范围的遗传发现。

articles.title: Physicists create Bose–Einstein condensate from ultracold polar molecules
articles.title_zh: 物理学家利用超冷极性分子制备出玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体
articles.abstract: Bose–Einstein condensates are states of matter that form when particles called bosons are cooled to temperatures that are only a fraction of a degree above absolute zero (i.e., 0 Kelvin [-460°F]). In these states, particles occupy the same quantum state and exhibit interesting collective behaviors, essentially behaving as if they were a single "super-particle."
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了物理学家利用超冷极性分子制备玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体的进展。玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体是在玻色子被冷却到接近绝对零度时形成的物质状态，其中粒子占据同一量子态并表现出集体行为。该工作围绕超冷分子体系中的量子凝聚展开，具体实验细节需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体是一种物质状态，当被称为玻色子的粒子被冷却到仅比绝对零度高出几分之一度的温度时形成，即 0 开尔文（-460°F）。在这些状态中，粒子占据相同的量子态并表现出有趣的集体行为，本质上就像一个单一的“超级粒子”那样运动。

articles.title: 2D quantum memory device reaches single-electron limit of information storage
articles.title_zh: 二维量子存储器件达到信息存储的单电子极限
articles.abstract: Most electronic memory storage devices require the ability to trap large numbers of electrons for each bit of memory. In an ideal world, however, it would take only one electron. This would reduce space requirements and power consumption for devices. Now, a team in China has realized this goal with an ultrathin device capable of minimizing the stray capacitance that plagued earlier attempts. The new study, published in Science, describes how this novel device has overcome challenges in implementing the single-electron design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了一种由中国团队实现的超薄二维量子存储器件，其信息存储能力接近单电子极限。传统电子存储器通常需要为每个比特俘获大量电子，而单电子存储有望降低器件尺寸和功耗。新研究称，该器件通过降低以往方案中的杂散电容，克服了单电子存储设计中的关键挑战。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大多数电子存储器件要求能够为每一位存储信息俘获大量电子。然而，在理想情况下，只需要一个电子即可。这将降低器件的空间需求和功耗。现在，中国的一个研究团队利用一种能够最小化困扰早期尝试的杂散电容的超薄器件实现了这一目标。这项发表于《Science》的新研究描述了这种新型器件如何克服实现单电子设计中的挑战。

articles.title: Dirac Fermion Scattering and Pseudospin Polarization in Structurally Asymmetric Graphene Wormholes
articles.title_zh: 结构非对称石墨烯虫洞中的狄拉克费米子散射与赝自旋极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26162v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the quantum transport of massless Dirac fermions through two asymptotically flat graphene sheets connected by a structurally asymmetric catenoid wormhole in (2+1)-dimensional curved spacetime. Analytic scattering basis functions are derived: Hankel functions of integer order (in the half-flux sector) in the flat sheets and Gauss hypergeometric functions in the curved throat. We construct a transfer matrix via piecewise numerical matching, verifying unitarity up to numerical precision. The transmission probability rises monotonically to unity at high energies. Global transmission exhibits mirror degeneracy under inversion of structural asymmetry, but local observables depend on incidence direction. The manifold's spin connection acts as a Hermitian coupling inducing an A/B sublattice imbalance at the throat. Structural asymmetry induces a local pseudospin imbalance. A larger curvature radius enhances P_z polarization via a larger geometric phase; abrupt incidence suppresses it. Sub-barrier modes exhibit a negative transmission phase time, compatible with Hartman-type wave-packet reshaping.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究无质量狄拉克费米子在两个渐近平坦石墨烯片之间、经由结构非对称悬链面虫洞的量子输运。作者构造了解析散射基函数和传输矩阵，并验证数值幺正性。结果显示，高能下透射趋于一，整体透射对结构非对称反演具有镜像简并，但局域观测量依赖入射方向；自旋联络和结构非对称性会在喉部诱导亚晶格和赝自旋不平衡。
authors: Arián Gorza, Facundo Arreyes, Juan Sebastián Ardenghi
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26162v1 宣告类型：新稿 摘要：我们研究无质量狄拉克费米子通过两个渐近平坦石墨烯片的量子输运，这两个石墨烯片由一个处于（2+1）维弯曲时空中的结构非对称悬链面虫洞连接。文中推导了解析散射基函数：在平坦石墨烯片中为整数阶汉克尔函数（半通量扇区），在弯曲喉部中为高斯超几何函数。我们通过分段数值匹配构造传输矩阵，并将幺正性验证到数值精度范围内。透射概率随能量升高单调增加，并在高能时趋于一。整体透射在结构非对称性反演下表现出镜像简并，但局域观测量依赖于入射方向。流形的自旋联络作为厄米耦合起作用，在喉部诱导 A/B 亚晶格不平衡。结构非对称性诱导局域赝自旋不平衡。更大的曲率半径通过更大的几何相位增强 P_z 极化；陡直入射会抑制该极化。亚势垒模式表现出负的透射相位时间，这与哈特曼型波包重塑相容。

articles.title: Gaps in unconventional superconductors
articles.title_zh: 非常规超导体中的能隙
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The energy gap is one of the defining properties of a superconductor and appears because the quasiparticle excitations radically change once a metallic system enters the superconducting state. Unconventional superconductors typically exhibit a non-uniform gapping and therefore show physical effects that are subject to intense research. In this review, we provide an overview of concepts needed to understand how unconventional superconductors are different from conventional ones, where the gapping comes from and how it expresses itself in experimentally accessible quantities. This should give the basis to understand current open research questions and navigate the recent literature that tend to contain contradictory conclusions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文是一篇关于非常规超导体能隙的综述。作者概述了理解非常规超导与常规超导差异、能隙起源及其在可实验观测量中表现所需的关键概念。该综述旨在帮助读者理解当前开放问题，并辨析近期文献中可能相互矛盾的结论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26251v1 宣告类型：新稿 摘要：能隙是超导体的定义性性质之一，它之所以出现，是因为当金属体系进入超导态时，准粒子激发会发生根本改变。非常规超导体通常表现出非均匀的能隙打开，因此呈现出受到深入研究的物理效应。在这篇综述中，我们概述了理解非常规超导体如何不同于常规超导体、能隙从何而来以及它如何体现在实验可获得量中的相关概念。这应当为理解当前开放的研究问题以及梳理近期文献奠定基础，而这些近期文献往往包含相互矛盾的结论。

articles.title: Asymmetric Floquet-Engineered Mode Coupling in Hybrid Magnonics
articles.title_zh: 混合磁振子学中 Floquet 工程化的非对称模式耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In hybrid magnonic systems, linear magnon--photon hybridization inherently produces symmetric, reciprocal interactions, precluding asymmetric mode coupling. Floquet driving can tailor mode coupling strengths but, with single-tone modulation, inevitably generates a symmetric interaction that preserves this reciprocity. Here we introduce dual-tone Floquet modulation to unlock a new degree of freedom in hybrid magnonic systems, where the relative phase θ of two commensurate drives continuously controls the asymmetry of the Floquet-engineered interaction, enabling asymmetric mode coupling absent in existing hybrid magnonic systems. We demonstrate this in a strongly coupled cavity magnonic device, where tuning θ reversibly switches single-sided Autler--Townes splitting between the two hybrid modes---a direct spectroscopic signature of phase-programmable asymmetric coupling. This approach opens a new path toward controllable nonreciprocal and topological functionalities in hybrid magnonic systems, with broad implications for advanced quantum and classical signal processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出利用双音 Floquet 调制在混合磁振子系统中实现相位可编程的非对称模式耦合。不同于传统线性磁振子–光子杂化和单音调制所产生的对称互易相互作用，双音调制的相对相位可连续控制耦合非对称性。作者在强耦合腔磁振子器件中展示了可逆切换的单侧 Autler–Townes 分裂，为非互易和拓扑功能提供了新途径。
authors: Amin Pishehvar, Jayakrishnan M. P. Nair, Zixin Yan, Yu Jiang, Benedetta Flebus, Xufeng Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26453v1 宣告类型：新稿 摘要：在混合磁振子系统中，线性磁振子–光子杂化本质上产生对称、互易的相互作用，从而排除了非对称模式耦合。Floquet 驱动可以调控模式耦合强度，但在单音调制下不可避免地产生保持这种互易性的对称相互作用。在这里，我们引入双音 Floquet 调制，以在混合磁振子系统中开启一个新的自由度，其中两个公度驱动的相对相位 θ 连续控制 Floquet 工程化相互作用的非对称性，从而实现现有混合磁振子系统中不存在的非对称模式耦合。我们在一个强耦合腔磁振子器件中展示了这一点，其中调节 θ 可在两个杂化模式之间可逆地切换单侧 Autler–Townes 分裂——这是相位可编程非对称耦合的直接光谱学特征。该方法为混合磁振子系统中可控的非互易和拓扑功能开辟了一条新路径，并对先进量子和经典信号处理具有广泛意义。

articles.title: Same-spin Andreev reflections in the quantum Hall regime: the role of loss
articles.title_zh: 量子霍尔体系中的同自旋安德烈耶夫反射：损耗的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26487v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interfaces of superconductors and topological materials hold promise for realizing exotic states and excitations. An important example is provided by the chiral Andreev edge states (CAES), which are formed at interfaces between quantum Hall (QH) states and superconductors (SC). CAES combine electron and hole amplitudes which are hybridized via Andreev reflections. This study explores the spin properties of the CAES through selective spin filtering of the QH edge channels. We find robust evidence of spin-flips accompanying the Andreev processes: electrons can be reflected from the superconductor as holes in the same spin channel. We demonstrate that the distribution of the reflection probabilities is exponential and then use random matrix theory to account for this observation. Finally, we observe Andreev reflections in the spin-polarized ν = 1 case, which is enabled by particle loss. Our findings shed light on the mechanism underlying Andreev reflections of spin-polarized chiral states. They also demonstrate the importance of considering non-Hermiticity when constructing topological superconductors in hybrid materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究量子霍尔态与超导体界面形成的手性安德烈耶夫边缘态的自旋性质。通过对量子霍尔边缘通道进行选择性自旋过滤，作者发现安德烈耶夫过程伴随自旋翻转的有力证据，即电子可在同一自旋通道中从超导体反射为空穴。研究还指出，在自旋极化的 ν=1 情形中，粒子损耗使安德烈耶夫反射成为可能，并强调构建混合材料拓扑超导体时考虑非厄米性的必要性。
authors: Chun-Chia Chen, Jordan T. McCourt, John Chiles, Lingfei Zhao, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, François Amet, Antonio L. R. Manesco, Harold U. Baranger, Gleb Finkelstein
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26487v1 宣告类型：新稿 摘要：超导体与拓扑材料的界面有望实现奇异态和激发。一个重要例子是手性安德烈耶夫边缘态（CAES），它形成于量子霍尔（QH）态与超导体（SC）的界面。CAES 结合了通过安德烈耶夫反射杂化的电子和空穴振幅。本研究通过对 QH 边缘通道进行选择性自旋过滤，探究 CAES 的自旋性质。我们发现了安德烈耶夫过程伴随自旋翻转的稳健证据：电子可以在同一自旋通道中从超导体反射为空穴。我们证明反射概率的分布是指数型的，并随后使用随机矩阵理论解释这一观察结果。最后，我们在自旋极化的 ν = 1 情形中观察到安德烈耶夫反射，而这是由粒子损耗所促成的。我们的发现阐明了自旋极化手性态的安德烈耶夫反射背后的机制。它们还表明，在混合材料中构建拓扑超导体时，考虑非厄米性具有重要意义。

articles.title: Critical non-thermal fixed point and the dynamical condensation phase transition
articles.title_zh: 临界非热固定点与动力学凝聚相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26620v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using a non-perturbative quantum kinetic framework, we develop a unified description of the far-from-equilibrium dynamics of three-dimensional Bose gases following cooling quenches across the Bose-Einstein condensation transition. By tracking the spatio-temporal evolution of the momentum distribution, we show that the equilibrium condensation threshold simultaneously acts as a dynamical critical point, separating distinct far-from-equilibrium universality classes governed by different non-equilibrium attractors. While quenches above the transition exhibit a single-timescale relaxation toward a thermal fixed point, quenches below the transition display a crossover from a transient weak-turbulence regime to a coarsening fixed point governed by the diffusive recombination of vortex lines. Quenches directly to the condensation threshold, finally, are controlled by a previously unidentified critical fixed point characterized by the superdiffusive spreading of critical fluctuations and a distinct set of dynamical exponents. Together, these dynamical scaling laws establish a far-from-equilibrium counterpart of the condensation phase transition, in which the equilibrium critical point also organizes the long-time non-equilibrium dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用非微扰量子动力学框架，统一描述三维玻色气体在跨越玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚转变的冷却淬火后的远离平衡动力学。研究发现，平衡凝聚阈值同时作为动力学临界点，区分由不同非平衡吸引子支配的远离平衡普适类。尤其是在临界阈值处淬火时，系统受此前未识别的临界固定点控制，表现出临界涨落的超扩散传播和独特动力学指数。
authors: Anne-Solène Bornens, Elisabeth Gliott, Nicolas Cherroret
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26620v1 宣告类型：新稿 摘要：利用非微扰量子动力学框架，我们对三维玻色气体在跨越玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚转变的冷却淬火之后的远离平衡动力学提出统一描述。通过追踪动量分布的时空演化，我们表明平衡凝聚阈值同时充当动力学临界点，分隔由不同非平衡吸引子支配的不同远离平衡普适类。高于转变点的淬火表现出向热固定点的单一时间尺度弛豫，而低于转变点的淬火则表现出从瞬态弱湍流区到由涡线扩散复合支配的粗化固定点的交叉。最后，直接淬火到凝聚阈值时，系统受一个此前未被识别的临界固定点控制，其特征是临界涨落的超扩散传播以及一组不同的动力学指数。总体而言，这些动力学标度律建立了凝聚相变的远离平衡对应物，其中平衡临界点也组织了长时间非平衡动力学。

articles.title: Interface evolution in the two-dimensional quantum Ising model
articles.title_zh: 二维量子伊辛模型中的界面演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the unitary time evolution of an interface in the regime of spontaneously broken symmetry of the two-dimensional quantum Ising model. The interface is induced by an initial condition interpolating between the two degenerate ground states in one of the spatial dimensions. The interpolation is left generic in order to investigate the dependence of the late time dynamics on the initial condition. Exploiting the basis of asymptotic quasiparticle states of the bulk theory, the order parameter is analytically determined at large times in the rough phase. The mechanism allowing the breakdown of this phase as the distance from criticality increases emerges from the theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维量子伊辛模型在自发对称性破缺区域中界面的幺正时间演化。界面由初始条件诱导，该条件在一个空间维度上连接两个简并基态，并保持一般形式以考察长时间动力学对初态的依赖。作者利用体理论的渐近准粒子态基，在粗糙相的大时间极限下解析确定了序参量，并揭示了远离临界点时该相发生破缺的机制。
authors: Georgios Kampanis, Marianna Sorba, Gesualdo Delfino
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26662v1 宣告类型：新稿 摘要：我们考虑二维量子伊辛模型在自发对称性破缺区域中界面的幺正时间演化。该界面由一个初始条件诱导，该初始条件在一个空间维度上在两个简并基态之间进行插值。该插值保持一般形式，以研究晚期时间动力学对初始条件的依赖。利用体理论的渐近准粒子态基，在粗糙相中于大时间下解析确定了序参量。随着离临界性的距离增加而使该相破缺的机制从理论中显现出来。

articles.title: Quantum Brownian transport in a correlated Gaussian force
articles.title_zh: 相关高斯力作用下的量子布朗输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a classical system-bath model in which a system particle is linearly coupled to a bath of harmonic oscillators. In a system subject to white and correlated Gaussian noises, we derive an expression for the joint probability density, and the mean squared values of the system-bath particles are calculated. For white noise, the mean squared values of the system-bath particles exhibit an anomalous time dependence, which is different from that of normal diffusion. In particular, for a correlated Gaussian noise, the mean squared displacement and mean squared velocity of the bath particle show superspreading growths of t⁵ and t³ in tłlτ, respectively. When τ=0, the mean squared velocity of a quantum particle under random noise is proportional to t, while the mean squared velocity of a bath particle in the presence of correlated Gaussian noise increases in proportion to t². This anomalous transport phenomenon results from the mixed derivative structure of the master equation, which couples with the transport coordinates in the diffusion dynamics of the relative coordinates. This result shows that the removal of dissipation in the Caldeira-Leggett framework leads to fundamentally different transport mechanisms characterized by non-diffusive quantum diffusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一个经典系统–浴模型，其中系统粒子与谐振子热浴线性耦合，并在白噪声和相关高斯噪声作用下推导联合概率密度。结果显示，系统和浴粒子的均方量表现出不同于正常扩散的反常时间依赖。作者指出，在去除 Caldeira–Leggett 框架中的耗散后，系统呈现由非扩散量子扩散表征的根本不同输运机制。
authors: Yun Jeong Kang, Seungsik Min, Sung Kyu Seo, Kyungsik Kim
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26678v1 宣告类型：新稿 摘要：我们研究一个经典系统–浴模型，其中一个系统粒子与一组谐振子热浴线性耦合。在受到白噪声和相关高斯噪声作用的系统中，我们推导出联合概率密度的表达式，并计算系统–浴粒子的均方量。对于白噪声，系统–浴粒子的均方量表现出反常的时间依赖性，这不同于正常扩散。特别地，对于相关高斯噪声，在 t≪τ 时，浴粒子的均方位移和均方速度分别表现出 t⁵ 和 t³ 的超扩展增长。当 τ=0 时，随机噪声下量子粒子的均方速度正比于 t，而在存在相关高斯噪声时，浴粒子的均方速度按 t² 增长。这种反常输运现象源自主方程的混合导数结构，该结构在相对坐标的扩散动力学中与输运坐标耦合。该结果表明，在 Caldeira-Leggett 框架中去除耗散会导致根本不同的输运机制，其特征是非扩散量子扩散。

articles.title: High-dimensional theory of the glass transition revisited: hopping and local defects
articles.title_zh: 重新审视玻璃转变的高维理论：跳跃与局域缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26793v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The replicated liquid theory provides a microscopic mean-field description of the glass transition by combining the density functional theory of liquids with the replica method originally developed for spin glasses. In the conventional replica liquid theory, a glassy state is described by assuming that particles in different replicas undergo vibrational motion around common centers of mass, thereby forming molecules that contain one particle from every replica. Here we revisit this assumption by allowing each molecule to contain only a subset of replicas. This generalized formulation describes particle-level replica mismatches, which may be associated with non-vibrational motions such as particle hopping. We apply the theory to high-dimensional hard and harmonic spheres, where the mean-field description is expected to become exact. For hard spheres, replica mismatches destabilize the glassy metastable state and shift the dynamical transition to a significantly higher packing fraction, while leaving the leading thermodynamic glass transition unchanged. The resulting transition density agrees, at leading order in high dimensions, with the recent rigorous lower bound for random sphere packings obtained by Campos, Jenssen, Michelen, and Sahasrabudhe by using a discretized version of greedy Random Sequential Absorption, suggesting an algorithmic interpretation of the transition: grandcanonical dynamics is more efficient in high dimensional spaces than canonical one. For harmonic spheres at finite temperature, the glassy state contains a finite replica-mismatch fraction even at the thermodynamic ideal-glass transition, thereby shifting the transition point from that predicted by the conventional replica ansatz.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视复制液体理论中关于玻璃态分子由所有复制中的粒子共同组成的传统假设，允许每个分子只包含部分复制，以描述粒子层面的复制失配。该推广可关联于粒子跳跃等非振动运动，并被应用于高维硬球和谐和球体系。结果表明，复制失配会显著影响动力学转变和有限温度下理想玻璃转变的位置，同时对硬球体系的主导热力学玻璃转变保持不变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26793v1 宣告类型：新稿 摘要：复制液体理论通过将液体的密度泛函理论与最初为自旋玻璃发展出的复制方法相结合，为玻璃转变提供了一个微观平均场描述。在传统复制液体理论中，玻璃态通过假设不同复制中的粒子围绕共同质心进行振动运动来描述，由此形成包含来自每一个复制的一个粒子的分子。在这里，我们通过允许每个分子只包含复制的一个子集来重新审视这一假设。这种广义表述描述了粒子层面的复制失配，这可能与粒子跳跃等非振动运动相关。我们将该理论应用于高维硬球和谐和球，在这些体系中平均场描述预期会变得精确。对于硬球，复制失配使玻璃亚稳态失稳，并将动力学转变移动到显著更高的堆积分数，同时保持主导的热力学玻璃转变不变。所得转变密度在高维主阶上与 Campos、Jenssen、Michelen 和 Sahasrabudhe 最近利用贪婪随机顺序吸附的离散化版本得到的随机球堆积严格下界一致，这暗示了该转变的一种算法解释：在高维空间中，巨正则动力学比正则动力学更有效。对于有限温度下的谐和球，即使在热力学理想玻璃转变处，玻璃态也包含有限的复制失配分数，从而使转变点偏离传统复制假设所预测的位置。

articles.title: Disentangling bulk and surface states in the electronic structure of PtBi₂₍₀₀₀₁₎
articles.title_zh: 解析 PtBi₂(0001) 电子结构中的体态与表面态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent reports of surface-localized topological superconductivity in trigonal PtBi₂ highlight the importance of understanding its surface electronic structure. We investigate the bulk and surface band structure of PtBi₂ using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and first-principles calculations. Through photon-energy- and polarization-dependent measurements, we disentangle bulk dispersions from surface states on the two distinct surface terminations of PtBi₂₍₀₀₀₁₎. For both terminations, we assign several different surface states and find good agreement between experiment and calculations. Based on our calculations, we analyze the orbital composition in the surface and bulk bands and compare the results to polarization-dependent ARPES measurements. Together, our results provide a coherent picture of the surface electronic structure of PtBi₂ across both surface terminations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对三方 PtBi₂ 中近期报道的表面局域拓扑超导现象，系统考察其表面电子结构。作者结合角分辨光电子能谱与第一性原理计算，通过光子能量和偏振依赖测量区分 PtBi₂(0001) 两种表面终止上的体能带与表面态。结果为两种终止面的表面电子结构提供了统一且与计算相符的图像。
authors: Stefanie Suzanne Brinkman, Xin Liang Tan, Anders Christian Mathisen, Fabian Göhler, Øyvind Finnseth, Chul-Hee Min, Grigory Shipunov, Falk Pabst, Manuel Alonso Lemos, Balasubramanian Thiagarajan, Craig Polley, Masashi Arita, Kenya Shimada, Anna Isaeva, Jorge I. Facio, Hendrik Bentmann
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26804v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：近期关于三方 PtBi₂ 中表面局域拓扑超导性的报道凸显了理解其表面电子结构的重要性。我们利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和第一性原理计算研究了 PtBi₂ 的体能带结构和表面能带结构。通过依赖光子能量和偏振的测量，我们将 PtBi₂(0001) 两种不同表面终止上的体色散与表面态区分开来。对于两种终止面，我们都指认了若干不同的表面态，并发现实验与计算之间具有良好一致性。基于我们的计算，我们分析了表面能带和体能带中的轨道组成，并将结果与偏振依赖的 ARPES 测量进行了比较。总体而言，我们的结果为 PtBi₂ 在两种表面终止上的表面电子结构提供了一个连贯的图像。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作结合 ARPES 和第一性原理计算，区分了 PtBi2(0001) 的体态与表面态，并解析了不同表面终止的能带结构。作者给出了表面与体态轨道成分的清晰图像。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们关注的拓扑材料和表面电子结构有一定关系，但更偏向实验主导的表面谱学研究。可借鉴其对表面态识别和体表态分离的分析框架。
articles.focus_suggestion: 若后续研究拓扑磁性或表面相关输运，可参考其第一性原理与实验对照思路。也可进一步比较其表面态特征与我们关注的界面拓扑态。

articles.title: Microscopic Emergence of Ancilla Lattice Physics in the Emery Model
articles.title_zh: Emery 模型中辅助晶格物理的微观涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive a controlled low-energy effective theory for the three-band Emery model on the Lieb lattice near (n=2) filling. Starting from the positive charge-transfer regime, a sequence of Schrieffer--Wolff transformations rigorously establishes a direct microscopic mapping onto an ancillary lattice structure. For realistic cuprate-like parameters, this framework naturally reproduces the conventional Fermi-liquid (FL) phase at a filling shifted by one electron per site. Our analysis identifies the precise microscopic conditions required to access the exotic fractionalized Fermi-liquid (FL^*) phase. We show that realizing FL^* requires nonstandard cuprate parameter regimes together with additional interactions that stabilize a quantum spin liquid in the background ancilla layer. These results establish a microscopic foundation for ancilla physics in multiorbital materials and clarify the conditions for realizing FL^*. We discuss the possibility to replicate ancilla model physics in Lieb lattice cold atom simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文为 Lieb 晶格上接近 n=2 填充的三带 Emery 模型推导了受控低能有效理论。作者通过一系列 Schrieffer-Wolff 变换建立了到辅助晶格结构的微观映射，并说明现实铜氧化物参数下可自然得到传统费米液体相。研究进一步明确了实现分数化费米液体 FL* 所需的非标准参数与额外相互作用条件，并讨论了冷原子模拟的可能性。
authors: Mikołaj Walicki, Johannes Knolle, Krzysztof Wohlfeld
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26869v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：我们为 Lieb 晶格上接近 n=2 填充的三带 Emery 模型推导了一个受控的低能有效理论。从正电荷转移区域出发，一系列 Schrieffer-Wolff 变换严格建立了到一种辅助晶格结构的直接微观映射。对于类似现实铜氧化物的参数，该框架自然再现了在每个格点填充数平移一个电子时的常规费米液体（FL）相。我们的分析确定了进入奇异分数化费米液体（FL*）相所需的精确微观条件。我们表明，实现 FL* 需要非标准的铜氧化物参数区域，以及能够在背景辅助层中稳定量子自旋液体的额外相互作用。这些结果为多轨道材料中的辅助晶格物理建立了微观基础，并阐明了实现 FL* 的条件。我们讨论了在 Lieb 晶格冷原子模拟中复现辅助模型物理的可能性。

articles.title: Depth-Resolved Lattice Distortions in a Silicon-Germanium Qubit Host
articles.title_zh: 硅锗量子比特宿主中的深度分辨晶格畸变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26962v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor qubits, promising for quantum computation, inherit properties from their host lattice. Quantum dot spins, occupying the local lowest energy states in the conduction band, necessarily couple to structural disorder and interfaces. While silicon-based systems promise low noise alongside industrially compatible manufacturing, the growth of SiGe---a leading platform---unavoidably introduces lattice dislocations, inhomogeneous strain, and crosshatch patterns, expected to cause fluctuations between devices, qubit failure, and subsequently higher operational overhead. Through X-ray nano-structural mapping of an Intel Si/SiGe chip, we reveal, with 30~nm lateral and 200~nm functional depth resolution, how extended lattice defects introduced during growth propagate through the heterostructure, creating permanently distorted lattice planes and strain. We correlate these at the approx1~μm scale of a quantum dot device and calculate the impact on qubit energy spectra. We observe crosshatch fine structure and find that substrate miscut and growth correlate with the final crosshatch pattern.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 X 射线纳米结构成像分析 Intel Si/SiGe 芯片中量子点自旋量子比特宿主晶格的结构缺陷。作者以纳米级横向和深度分辨率揭示了生长过程中形成的扩展晶格缺陷如何穿过异质结构并造成永久晶格畸变与应变。研究还将这些结构特征与量子点器件尺度相关联，并评估其对量子比特能谱的影响。
authors: Jonathan C. Marcks, E. S. Joseph, J. Reily, Talise Oh, Abigail Postlewaite, Tao Zhou, M. A. Eriksson, Mark Friesen, Martin V. Holt
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26962v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：半导体量子比特作为量子计算的有前景平台，会继承其宿主晶格的性质。量子点自旋占据导带中的局域最低能态，因而必然与结构无序和界面发生耦合。虽然硅基系统有望兼具低噪声和与工业兼容的制造工艺，但作为领先平台的 SiGe 的生长不可避免地引入晶格位错、非均匀应变和交叉网纹图案，预计会导致器件之间的波动、量子比特失效，并继而增加运行开销。通过对一块 Intel Si/SiGe 芯片进行 X 射线纳米结构映射，我们以 30 nm 横向分辨率和 200 nm 功能深度分辨率揭示了生长过程中引入的扩展晶格缺陷如何在异质结构中传播，从而形成永久畸变的晶格面和应变。我们在约 1 μm 的量子点器件尺度上关联这些效应，并计算其对量子比特能谱的影响。我们观察到交叉网纹的精细结构，并发现衬底偏切和生长过程与最终的交叉网纹图案相关。

articles.title: Density-wave phases, anisotropic transport, and Planckian dissipation in single crystals of the superconductor La3Ni2O7
articles.title_zh: 超导体 La3Ni2O7 单晶中的密度波相、各向异性输运与普朗克耗散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26990v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pressure-induced superconductivity in bilayer nickelates provides a platform for investigating intertwined roles of charge/spin orders and electric transport in unconventional superconductivity. However, important quantitative information on the transport, such as the absolute value of the resistivity, the anisotropy, and the scattering rate of carriers, remains insufficient due to the lack of accurate measurements using large single crystals. Here we establish a high-precision pressure-temperature phase diagram of high-quality La3Ni2O7 single crystals, by measuring the in-plane and out-of-plane resistivities. We resolve two distinct anomalies associated with density-wave formation with contrasting pressure dependences. The pressure-induced structural transition enhances not only the resistivity values for both directions, but also its anisotropy at low temperatures, demonstrating a pronounced effect of density-wave order on the charge dynamics. Superconductivity with zero-resistance emerges near the boundary where the density-wave phases are fully suppressed, and above Tc, the resistivity exhibits a temperature-linear dependence over a wide temperature range while the scattering rate falls within a regime of the Planckian limit. Our results show that pressure dramatically changes the anisotropic charge transport via modifying density-wave orders, and eventually produces a pronounced strange-metal state with strong scatterings, from which superconductivity develops. This establishes robust density-wave correlations and Planckian dissipation as remarkable features of La3Ni2O7.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过高质量 La3Ni2O7 单晶的面内与面外电阻率测量，建立了精确的压力—温度相图。作者分辨出两个与密度波形成相关且压力依赖性不同的异常，并发现压力诱导结构转变显著增强低温电阻率及其各向异性。零电阻超导出现在密度波相被完全压制的边界附近，正常态表现出宽温区线性电阻和接近普朗克极限的散射率。
authors: Zhehong Liu, Masamichi Nakajima, Markus Kriener, Shunsuke Kitou, Xiaowei Lyu, Chieko Terakura, Kosuke Karube, Ka Man Yip, Sorin Lazar, Nobuto Nakanishi, Keiko Shimada, Akiko Kikkawa, Yukako Fujishiro, Xiuzhen Yu, Taka-hisa Arima, Yoshinori Tokura, Yasujiro Taguchi
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26990v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：双层镍酸盐中的压力诱导超导性为研究非常规超导中电荷/自旋序与电输运的交织作用提供了平台。然而，由于缺乏使用大尺寸单晶进行的精确测量，关于输运的重要定量信息，如电阻率的绝对值、各向异性以及载流子散射率，仍然不足。在这里，我们通过测量高质量 La3Ni2O7 单晶的面内和面外电阻率，建立了高精度的压力—温度相图。我们分辨出两个与密度波形成相关的不同异常，它们具有相反的压力依赖性。压力诱导的结构转变不仅增强了两个方向上的电阻率数值，也增强了低温下的电阻率各向异性，表明密度波序对电荷动力学具有显著影响。零电阻超导性在密度波相被完全压制的边界附近出现，而在 Tc 以上，电阻率在宽温度范围内呈现温度线性依赖，同时散射率落在普朗克极限的区域内。我们的结果表明，压力通过改变密度波序显著改变各向异性电荷输运，并最终产生具有强散射的显著奇异金属态，超导性正是从这一状态中发展出来的。这确立了强健的密度波关联和普朗克耗散是 La3Ni2O7 的显著特征。

articles.title: Temporal Interference from Topological Transitions in Monitored Quantum Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 受监测量子动力学中拓扑跃迁产生的时间干涉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27045v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Temporal interference patterns can be detected with stroboscopic monitoring that treats the back action of measurements and the unitary dynamics. Previous work established that the mean detected recurrence time is integer-quantized and given by a topological invariant, a winding number w. When measurement periods are at resonance with the system's timescales, the winding number can abruptly change. We focus on a generic quantum system and the transition w→ w-2, signified by the creation of two dark states in Hilbert space, whose corresponding modes are responsible for the interference pattern. Close to the transition an extremely slow decay of the amplitude of first detection is found, superimposed by oscillations, in contrast to the monotonically exponential decay close to the case w→ w-1. We show how these oscillations are obtained from the symmetry of the system and find the conditions for optimal observations of the phenomenon.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究了频闪监测量子动力学中由拓扑不变量变化引发的时间干涉现象。作者聚焦绕数从 w 到 w-2 的跃迁，此过程对应希尔伯特空间中两个暗态的产生，并导致首次探测振幅出现缓慢衰减叠加振荡。研究给出了这些振荡的对称性来源及优化观测条件。
authors: Qingyuan Wang, Ruoyu Yin, Eli Barkai
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27045v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：通过频闪监测可以探测时间干涉图样，这种监测同时考虑测量的反作用和幺正动力学。此前的工作已经确定，平均探测回归时间是整数量子化的，并由一个拓扑不变量即绕数 w 给出。当测量周期与系统的时间尺度共振时，绕数可能发生突变。我们关注一个一般量子系统以及 w→w-2 的跃迁，该跃迁以希尔伯特空间中两个暗态的产生为标志，而相应的模式负责形成干涉图样。在接近该跃迁时，我们发现首次探测振幅出现极其缓慢的衰减，并叠加有振荡，这与接近 w→w-1 情形时的单调指数衰减形成对比。我们说明了这些振荡如何由系统的对称性得到，并找到了最优观测该现象的条件。

articles.title: Dual Enhancement of Superconductivity in FeSe/SrTiO3 via Orbital and Correlation Synergy
articles.title_zh: FeSe/SrTiO3 中轨道与关联协同作用对超导性的双重增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In iron-based superconductors, the dz2 orbital band typically resides far below the Fermi level and has not been considered to participate in Cooper pairing. Here, using monolayer FeSe/SrTiO3 as a model system, we demonstrate that tip-induced tensile strain controllably shifts the dz2 band toward the Fermi level, driving a two-stage enhancement of superconductivity. In-plane lattice expansion first enhances electronic correlation, amplifying superconductivity in the initial stage. As strain further increases, the upward-shifted dz2 band hybridizes with the dxy band, reconstructing the pairing-active d-orbital bands and inducing a secondary, stronger gap enhancement. Collectively, these two stages enlarge the superconducting gap from 17.8 to 23.6 meV. Throughout this process, invariant Fermi wave vectors confirm that the enhancement originates from band renormalization and reconstruction rather than carrier doping. Our work establishes a route to tailor superconducting states via strain-activated electronic correlations and band engineering, and reveals a previously unrecognized orbital-selective pairing mechanism with broad implications for correlated multiband superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以单层 FeSe/SrTiO3 为模型，展示针尖诱导的拉伸应变可将 dz2 轨道能带推向费米能级，并分两阶段增强超导性。初始阶段，面内晶格膨胀增强电子关联；进一步应变下，dz2 与 dxy 能带杂化并重构参与配对的 d 轨道能带，从而带来更强的能隙增强。费米波矢不变表明增强源于能带重整化与重构，而非载流子掺杂。
authors: Guihao Jia, Jingming Yan, Yucong Peng, Shendong Su, Pei Ouyang, Xiaopeng Hu, Qi-Kun Xue, Wei Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27104v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：在铁基超导体中，dz2 轨道能带通常位于远低于费米能级的位置，因此未被认为参与库珀配对。在这里，我们以单层 FeSe/SrTiO3 为模型体系，证明针尖诱导的拉伸应变能够可控地将 dz2 能带推向费米能级，从而驱动超导性的两阶段增强。面内晶格膨胀首先增强电子关联，并在初始阶段放大超导性。随着应变进一步增大，向上移动的 dz2 能带与 dxy 能带杂化，重构参与配对的 d 轨道能带，并诱导第二阶段且更强的能隙增强。综合来看，这两个阶段将超导能隙从 17.8 meV 扩大到 23.6 meV。在整个过程中，不变的费米波矢证实该增强源于能带重整化和重构，而不是载流子掺杂。我们的工作建立了一条通过应变激活的电子关联和能带工程来调控超导态的途径，并揭示了一种此前未被认识到的轨道选择性配对机制，这对关联多带超导体具有广泛意义。

articles.title: Engineering SU(N)-Symmetric Hubbard Models with Microwave-Shielded Dipolar Molecules
articles.title_zh: 利用微波屏蔽偶极分子构造 SU(N) 对称 Hubbard 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultracold polar molecules provide strong, long-range interactions that microwave shielding makes tunable and nearly nuclear-spin independent, giving an emergent SU(N) symmetry. However, extended Hubbard models of polar molecules in optical lattices lack, so far, controllable finite on-site interactions, a key ingredient of strong correlated physics. We show that tuning the Rabi frequency of the microwave coupling can bring two individual molecules (monomers) on neighboring lattice sites into resonance with a field-linked dimer (doublon) on one of the sites, enabling coherent doublon--monomer-pair conversion. In this model, we characterize the key Hubbard parameters and the dimer lifetime, demonstrating that the on-site and off-site interactions can be tuned nearly independently through the microwave amplitude and orientation, respectively. Our results provide a roadmap for implementing SU(N)-symmetric extended Hubbard models with controllable doublon fluctuations, providing access to quantum-simulation in the strongly dipolar regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出利用微波屏蔽的超冷极性分子在光晶格中实现具有可控双占据涨落的 SU(N) 对称扩展 Hubbard 模型。作者表明，调节微波耦合的 Rabi 频率可使相邻格点上的两个单分子与同一格点上的场联结二聚体发生共振，实现相干转换。研究刻画了 Hubbard 参数和二聚体寿命，并指出在位与非在位相互作用可通过微波振幅与取向近乎独立地调控。
authors: Jing-Lun Li, Ragheed Alhyder, Andreas Schindewolf, Kaden R. A. Hazzard, Mikhail Lemeshko, Georgios M. Koutentakis
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27107v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：超冷极性分子提供强的长程相互作用，而微波屏蔽使这种相互作用可调并且几乎与核自旋无关，从而产生涌现的 SU(N) 对称性。然而，到目前为止，光晶格中极性分子的扩展 Hubbard 模型仍缺乏可控的有限在位相互作用，而这是强关联物理的关键要素。我们表明，调节微波耦合的 Rabi 频率可以使相邻晶格格点上的两个单个分子（单体）与其中一个格点上的场联结二聚体（双占据体）发生共振，从而实现相干的双占据体—单体对转换。在该模型中，我们表征了关键 Hubbard 参数和二聚体寿命，证明在位和非在位相互作用可分别通过微波振幅和取向近乎独立地调节。我们的结果为实现具有可控双占据涨落的 SU(N) 对称扩展 Hubbard 模型提供了路线图，从而为在强偶极区域进行量子模拟提供了途径。

articles.title: Momentum Structure of Superconductivity and Sublattice Effects from Quasiparticle Interference in CsV₃Sb₅
articles.title_zh: CsV₃Sb₅ 中由准粒子干涉揭示的超导动量结构与子晶格效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum interference encoded in the sublattice texture of kagome Bloch wavefunctions has been widely invoked as a route to correlated states, including chiral charge order, unconventional superconductivity, and their possible intertwining in pair-density-wave (PDW) states. Using sub-Kelvin scanning tunneling microscopy, we conducted spectroscopic mapping of the kagome material CsV₃Sb₅ with high energy resolution and dense energy sampling through the superconducting gap. Quasiparticle interference (QPI) analysis, aided by ab initio and symmetry calculations, reveals an isotropic superconducting gap on the Fermi surfaces derived from V M_z-even (M_z⁺⁾ d orbitals, thereby constraining possible gap symmetries and limiting any gap anisotropy to the remaining V M_z-odd (M_z⁻⁾ and Sb p_z bands. Meanwhile, the CDW-peak-selected dI/dV spectra closely track the spatially averaged density of states and show no distinct enhancement restricted to subgap energies, which do not support an additional PDW modulation within our sensitivity. Finally, the selective absence of specific QPI scattering vectors points to a spectroscopic sensitivity to sublattice character on the Fermi surface. Together, these results provide a clearer experimental picture of the low-energy electronic structure relevant to kagome superconductivity in CsV₃Sb₅.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用亚开尔文扫描隧道显微谱对 kagome 材料 CsV₃Sb₅ 的超导能隙进行高分辨率谱成像。结合第一性原理和对称性计算的准粒子干涉分析显示，来源于 V 的 Mz 偶 d 轨道的费米面上具有各向同性超导能隙，从而约束了可能的能隙对称性。研究未在灵敏度范围内发现支持额外配对密度波调制的证据，并揭示 QPI 对费米面子晶格特征具有选择性敏感性。
authors: Aaron G. Greenberg, Xinze Yang, Junze Deng, Pranab Kumar Nag, Kirsty Scott, Yi Jiang, Haoyu Hu, Chandra Shekhar, Dong Chen, Claudia Felser, Santiago Blanco-Canosa, Päivi Törmä, B. Andrei Bernevig, Eduardo H. da Silva Neto
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27148v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：编码在 kagome Bloch 波函数子晶格纹理中的量子干涉被广泛认为是产生关联态的一条途径，包括手性电荷序、非常规超导性，以及它们在配对密度波（PDW）态中可能的交织。利用亚开尔文扫描隧道显微镜，我们对 kagome 材料 CsV₃Sb₅ 进行了穿越超导能隙的谱学成像，具有高能量分辨率和密集的能量采样。在从头算和对称性计算辅助下的准粒子干涉（QPI）分析揭示，在来源于 V 的 Mz 偶（Mz+）d 轨道的费米面上存在各向同性超导能隙，从而约束了可能的能隙对称性，并将任何能隙各向异性限制在剩余的 V 的 Mz 奇（Mz-）以及 Sb pz 能带上。同时，按 CDW 峰选择的 dI/dV 谱与空间平均态密度密切一致，并未显示出局限于能隙内能量的独特增强，这在我们的灵敏度范围内不支持额外的 PDW 调制。最后，特定 QPI 散射矢量的选择性缺失表明谱学对费米面上的子晶格特征具有敏感性。综上，这些结果为理解 CsV₃Sb₅ 中与 kagome 超导相关的低能电子结构提供了更清晰的实验图像。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作利用低温扫描隧道显微和准粒子干涉，结合第一性原理与对称性分析，研究了 kagome 材料 CsV₃Sb₅ 中超导能隙的动量结构与子晶格效应。结果表明超导能隙在相关费米面上近似各向同性，并且未发现实验敏感度范围内支持额外的 PDW 调制。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在量子功能材料、kagome 金属和超导相关方向有一定交叉，也涉及第一性原理与对称性约束分析。可为我们研究拓扑/相关超导中的能隙对称性、QPI 解析和子晶格选择规则提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步关注 CsV₃Sb₅ 及相关 kagome 体系中的电荷序、超导与拓扑响应的耦合机制。若后续开展相关方向，可结合第一性原理、有效模型和输运计算系统比较不同配对对称性。

articles.title: Quantum-Geometric Raman Response in Multiorbital Flat-Band Systems
articles.title_zh: 多轨道平带系统中的量子几何拉曼响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flat-band materials host rich collective phenomena, yet a complete theory of their signatures in inelastic light scattering remains lacking. While naive theories of interacting flat bands would predict that Raman scattering vertices vanish identically in the limit of vanishing dispersion, we show that this picture is incomplete upon including the multiorbital character of such systems. We show that virtual interband processes generate a finite subgap Raman vertex controlled by the quantum geometric tensor even in the strict flat-band limit. We develop a systematic perturbative theory for Raman scattering from flat bands in the limit where the photon energy is far from resonance with interband transitions. Treating interband Coulomb scattering and light-matter coupling on equal footing, we decompose the Raman scattering vertices into an interaction-independent geometric term expressible directly in terms of the quantum geometric tensor, together with effective resonant and non-resonant pieces generated by virtual interband Coulomb scattering. We then study the polarization-resolved Raman response from collective excitations of an interacting flat band with nontrivial quantum geometry, and demonstrate quantitative agreement of our framework with a full multi-orbital calculation at large photon detuning from interband transitions. These results establish quantum geometry as an intrinsic contribution to inelastic light scattering in flat-band systems, and suggest polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy as a quantum geometry-sensitive probe of the collective excitations of correlated flat-band platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文建立了多轨道平带系统中非弹性光散射的理论，指出即使在严格平带极限下，虚拟带间过程也会产生由量子几何张量控制的有限亚能隙拉曼顶角。作者在光子能量远离带间跃迁共振的条件下发展了系统微扰理论，并将拉曼顶角分解为几何项以及由虚拟带间库仑散射产生的有效共振和非共振项。结果表明，偏振分辨拉曼谱可作为探测关联平带体系集体激发中量子几何的工具。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27200v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：平带材料承载着丰富的集体现象，但关于它们在非弹性光散射中的特征，目前仍缺乏完整理论。虽然相互作用平带的朴素理论会预言，在色散趋于消失的极限中，拉曼散射顶角恒等为零，但我们表明，一旦纳入此类系统的多轨道特征，这一图像就是不完整的。我们表明，即使在严格平带极限中，虚拟带间过程也会产生有限的亚能隙拉曼顶角，该顶角受量子几何张量控制。我们在光子能量远离带间跃迁共振的极限下，发展了平带拉曼散射的系统微扰理论。在同等处理带间库仑散射和光—物质耦合的基础上，我们将拉曼散射顶角分解为一个与相互作用无关且可直接用量子几何张量表示的几何项，以及由虚拟带间库仑散射产生的有效共振项和非共振项。随后，我们研究了具有非平庸量子几何的相互作用平带中集体激发的偏振分辨拉曼响应，并证明在光子相对带间跃迁具有大失谐时，我们的框架与完整多轨道计算在定量上相符。这些结果确立了量子几何是平带系统非弹性光散射的内禀贡献，并表明偏振分辨拉曼光谱可作为一种对量子几何敏感的探针，用于研究关联平带平台的集体激发。

articles.title: Quantum Turing Patterns
articles.title_zh: 量子图灵图案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26331v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct quantum Turing patterns in Lindblad lattice dynamics and establish a rigorous theory of their nonlinear order and quantum fluctuations. For an explicit completely positive family with finite-range couplings, the first-moment equations undergo a supercritical instability at a nonzero wave number and admit analytic site- and bond-centered commensurate stripe branches. These branches are locally asymptotically stable in their reflection-fixed period-cell spaces, and projected coherent states exhibit extensive Bragg order on every bounded time interval in the semiclassical limit. We prove O(N⁻¹/²) convergence of microscopic covariances to a nonautonomous Gaussian Lyapunov flow, transferring strict partial-transpose uncertainty violations to sufficiently large N. In the homogeneous Gaussian sector, a single dimensionless ratio controls both the Turing stability determinant and the logarithmic negativity of opposite momenta, relating wavelength selection directly to quantum entanglement. Differential transport shifts the strongest opposite-momentum correlations from the infrared to the selected Turing scale. Numerical continuation and two-dimensional simulations display stripe, spot, and labyrinth morphologies whose Fourier modes and fluctuation spectra concentrate at the same selected wave numbers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在 Lindblad 晶格动力学中构造量子图灵图案，并建立其非线性有序和量子涨落的严格理论。作者给出具有有限程耦合的完全正映射族，证明一阶矩方程在非零波数处发生超临界不稳定并产生条纹分支。研究还将波长选择与量子纠缠联系起来，并通过数值延拓与二维模拟展示条纹、斑点和迷宫形貌。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26331v1 发布类型：交叉稿 摘要：我们在 Lindblad 晶格动力学中构造量子图灵图案，并建立关于其非线性有序和量子涨落的严格理论。对于一个具有有限程耦合的显式完全正映射族，一阶矩方程在非零波数处发生超临界不稳定，并允许解析的格点中心和键中心相称条纹分支。这些分支在其反射固定的周期胞空间中是局部渐近稳定的，并且在半经典极限下，投影相干态在每一个有界时间区间上表现出广延的 Bragg 有序。我们证明微观协方差以 O(N⁻¹/2) 收敛到一个非自治高斯 Lyapunov 流，从而将严格的部分转置不确定性违背传递到足够大的 N。在均匀高斯扇区中，一个单一的无量纲比值同时控制图灵稳定性行列式和相反动量的对数负性，将波长选择直接与量子纠缠联系起来。差分输运将最强的相反动量关联从红外区域移向所选择的图灵尺度。数值延拓和二维模拟显示出条纹、斑点和迷宫形貌，其傅里叶模和涨落谱集中在相同的被选择波数处。

articles.title: On R-parastatistics I: Foundation
articles.title_zh: 论 R-副统计 I：基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26351v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Parastatistics is an exotic type of exchange statistics beyond fermions and bosons. Paraparticles transform in higher dimensional representations of the exchange symmetry group, analogous to non-Abelian anyons, yet consistently defined in any dimension. Although paraparticles have long been proposed, they were widely believed to be physically equivalent to fermions or bosons. Nevertheless, a recent paper proposed a different theory, called R-parastatistics, and demonstrated that nontrivial R-paraparticles can emerge as quasiparticles in condensed matter systems, and are observably distinct from both fermions and bosons. This paper develops the theoretical foundation and several extensions of R-parastatistics, with particular emphasis on its observable consequences. Central to this paper is a general theory of local observables extending the basic family introduced before. First, we define local observables that distinguish particle types. Second, we formulate local observables at special point defects that probe the internal indices of R-paraparticles, crucial for observing R-parastatistics and for the proposed applications in quantum information. Third, we introduce local observables that create or annihilate particle-antiparticle pairs, important for building a relativistic quantum field theory for R-paraparticles. We further introduce generalized hidden symmetries that act on internal indices of R-paraparticles while preserving the local observable algebra, providing a basis for proving local indistinguishability and for connecting to a categorical description of R-paraparticles. This work sets a solid theoretical foundation for understanding the fundamental physical properties of R-paraparticles and pave the way for finding them in nature.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文为 R-副统计建立理论基础并扩展其可观测后果。作者提出更一般的局域可观测量理论，用于区分粒子类型、探测 R-副粒子的内部指标，以及产生或湮灭粒子—反粒子对。研究还引入广义隐藏对称性，为局域不可区分性证明和范畴化描述奠定基础。
authors: Zhiyuan Wang, Kaden R. A. Hazzard
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26351v1 发布类型：交叉稿 摘要：副统计是一种超越费米子和玻色子的奇异交换统计。副粒子在交换对称群的高维表示中变换，类似于非阿贝尔任意子，但可以在任意维度中一致地定义。尽管副粒子早已被提出，但人们普遍认为它们在物理上等价于费米子或玻色子。然而，最近一篇论文提出了一种不同的理论，称为 R-副统计，并证明非平庸的 R-副粒子可以作为凝聚态系统中的准粒子涌现，且在可观测上不同于费米子和玻色子。本文发展了 R-副统计的理论基础和若干扩展，特别强调其可观测后果。本文的核心是局域可观测量的一般理论，它扩展了此前引入的基本族。首先，我们定义了能够区分粒子类型的局域可观测量。其次，我们在特殊点缺陷处构造局域可观测量，用以探测 R-副粒子的内部指标，这对于观测 R-副统计以及其在量子信息中的拟议应用至关重要。第三，我们引入能够产生或湮灭粒子—反粒子对的局域可观测量，这对于构建 R-副粒子的相对论量子场论很重要。我们进一步引入作用于 R-副粒子内部指标、同时保持局域可观测代数不变的广义隐藏对称性，为证明局域不可区分性以及连接到 R-副粒子的范畴化描述提供基础。本工作为理解 R-副粒子的基本物理性质奠定了坚实理论基础，并为在自然界中寻找它们铺平道路。

articles.title: Molecular triplets and other metastable states for excitonic quantum batteries
articles.title_zh: 用于激子量子电池的分子三重态及其他亚稳态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26436v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Excitonic quantum batteries, based on organic fluorescent molecules embedded in optical microcavities, offer a room-temperature platform for studying collective effects in energy storage and developing applications. Recent experiments have offered evidence of superabsorption, a collective enhancement to the light absorption rate of organic molecules which leads to a scalable power density. However, they have also highlighted the challenge posed by rapid radiative decay of fluorescent molecules, which limits the energy storage lifetime. Current strategies to overcome this trade-off focus on controlling the coupling between the absorbing manifold and that used for energy storage. In this chapter, we review three implementations of this design principle: transferring energy from optically excited states to long-lived dark triplet states, generating triplet pairs and higher-spin states through singlet exciton fission, and forming charge-separated states. We discuss each mechanism from both theoretical and experimental perspectives, with particular emphasis on recent device implementations that have extended storage times by several orders of magnitude. We conclude with a cross-platform outlook on the role of metastable states across coherent and room-temperature implementations, from neutral atom arrays to masers and colour centres.
articles.abstract_zh: 该章节综述了基于嵌入光学微腔的有机荧光分子的激子量子电池，重点关注如何利用亚稳态延长储能寿命。作者讨论了三种策略：将能量转移到长寿命暗三重态、通过单重态激子裂变产生三重态对和高自旋态，以及形成电荷分离态。综述从理论和实验角度评述这些机制，并展望亚稳态在不同量子平台中的作用。
authors: Daniel Tibben, Gian Marcello Andolina, Daniel E. Gómez, Francesco Campaioli
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.26436v1 发布类型：交叉稿 摘要：基于嵌入光学微腔中的有机荧光分子的激子量子电池，为研究能量存储中的集体效应和发展应用提供了一个室温平台。近期实验提供了超吸收的证据，即有机分子光吸收速率的集体增强，这会导致可扩展的功率密度。然而，这些实验也凸显了荧光分子快速辐射衰减所带来的挑战，因为这种衰减限制了能量存储寿命。目前克服这一权衡的策略集中于控制吸收流形与用于能量存储的流形之间的耦合。在本章中，我们综述了这一设计原则的三种实现方式：将能量从光学激发态转移到长寿命暗三重态；通过单重态激子裂变产生三重态对和更高自旋态；以及形成电荷分离态。我们从理论和实验两个角度讨论每一种机制，特别强调近期将存储时间延长数个数量级的器件实现。最后，我们从跨平台角度展望亚稳态在相干和室温实现中的作用，涵盖从中性原子阵列到微波激射器和色心等平台。

articles.title: Revival of transport reciprocity via quantum interference in asymmetric nonlinear devices
articles.title_zh: 通过量子干涉在非对称非线性器件中恢复输运互易性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26898v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Structural asymmetry combined with optical nonlinearity often leads to nonreciprocal light transport. We explore the mechanism by which 1-photon interference effects can revive reciprocity in such nonlinear models. To this end, we study correlated 2-photon scattering where an artificial atom is asymmetrically (a) side-coupled to an infinite waveguide at two spatially separated points, and (b) direct-coupled to two semi-infinite waveguides. The setup (a) gives robust reciprocal transport for the two photons. However, the setup (b) shows a transition from a nonreciprocal to a reciprocal regime by tuning the interference effect via an additional tunneling path for photons between the two waveguides.
articles.abstract_zh: 结构非对称性与光学非线性结合通常会导致非互易光输运。本文研究单光子干涉如何在此类非线性模型中恢复互易性，并比较了两种非对称耦合人工原子的双光子散射装置。结果表明，侧耦合方案可实现稳健的双光子互易输运，而直接耦合方案可通过调节额外隧穿路径诱导从非互易到互易的转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构非对称性与光学非线性的结合通常会导致非互易的光传输。我们探索单光子干涉效应能够在此类非线性模型中恢复互易性的机制。为此，我们研究了关联双光子散射，其中一个人工原子以非对称方式：（a）在两个空间分离的位置侧耦合到一条无限波导；以及（b）直接耦合到两条半无限波导。装置（a）为两个光子提供了稳健的互易输运。然而，装置（b）通过两条波导之间用于光子的额外隧穿路径来调节干涉效应，从而表现出从非互易 regime 到互易 regime 的转变。

articles.title: Conductance measurements cannot distinguish crossed Andreev reflection from elastic co-tunneling in normal--superconductor--normal junctions
articles.title_zh: 在正常金属—超导体—正常金属结中，电导测量无法区分交叉安德烈夫反射与弹性共隧穿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.23490v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We argue that the interpretation of the experiment [Nature Physics 21, 708-715 (2025)] is misleading in two respects. First, the bias voltages impact the non-local differential conductance randomly, rather than systematically, and the bias symmetry of the non-local conductance in Fig. 3 can be explained by a fine tuned self-gating effect. Second, the full knowledge of the conductance matrix is insufficient to conclude on the relative values of the crossed-Andreev and elastic cotunneling probabilities, in particular on the dominance of one of them.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者认为，近期一项关于正常金属—超导体—正常金属结的实验解释在两个方面具有误导性。其一，偏置电压对非局域微分电导的影响更像是随机的，而非系统性的，且观测到的偏置对称性可由精细调谐的自栅控效应解释。其二，即便完全掌握电导矩阵，也不足以判断交叉安德烈夫反射与弹性共隧穿概率的相对大小或哪一种机制占优。
authors: E. S. Tikhonov, V. S. Khrapai
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们认为，对实验[Nature Physics 21, 708-715 (2025)]的解释在两个方面具有误导性。首先，偏置电压对非局域微分电导的影响是随机的，而不是系统性的，并且图3中非局域电导的偏置对称性可以由一种精细调谐的自栅控效应来解释。其次，即使完全了解电导矩阵，也不足以得出关于交叉安德烈夫反射概率和弹性共隧穿概率相对数值的结论，特别是不足以判断其中一种是否占主导。

articles.title: Inductive van der Waals Force between Two Quantum Loops
articles.title_zh: 两个量子环之间的感应范德华力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.01263v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the van der Waals-London force, which is typically associated with fluctuating electric dipoles in atoms, in a mesoscopic circuit consisting of two inductively coupled superconducting loops. We investigate the em inductive van der Waals-London interaction using both semiclassical and quantum electrodynamic (QED) approaches. The semiclassical model predicts a repulsive interaction due to anticorrelated current fluctuations. In contrast, the QED framework, which incorporates virtual photon exchange, reveals a predominantly attractive force. A key contribution comes from a state-independent two-photon exchange, which is absent in the semiclassical description and undetectable by spectroscopy. Our study introduces a theoretical framework for exploring the van der Waals force between individual artificial atoms via controlled mesoscopic circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究由两个电感耦合超导环组成的介观电路中的范德华—伦敦力，并分别采用半经典和量子电动力学方法分析。半经典模型因反相关电流涨落预言排斥相互作用，而包含虚光子交换的量子电动力学框架则显示主要为吸引力。研究强调了一种与状态无关的双光子交换贡献，并提出了利用可控介观电路探索人工原子间范德华力的理论框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究范德华—伦敦力；这种力通常与原子中的涨落电偶极子相关，而这里是在一个由两个电感耦合超导环组成的介观电路中进行研究。我们采用半经典方法和量子电动力学（QED）方法研究电磁感应范德华—伦敦相互作用。半经典模型由于反相关的电流涨落而预言一种排斥相互作用。相比之下，纳入虚光子交换的QED框架揭示出一种以吸引为主的力。一个关键贡献来自一种与状态无关的双光子交换；该贡献在半经典描述中不存在，并且无法通过光谱学探测到。我们的研究为通过受控介观电路探索单个人工原子之间的范德华力引入了一个理论框架。

articles.title: Complex nonlinear sigma model
articles.title_zh: 复非线性σ模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.20166v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by the recent interest in the criticality of open quantum many-body systems, we study nonlinear sigma models with complexified couplings as a general framework for nonunitary field theory. Applying the perturbative renormalization-group analysis to the tenfold symmetric spaces, we demonstrate that fixed points with complex scaling dimensions and critical exponents arise generically, without counterparts in conventional nonlinear sigma models with real couplings. We further clarify the global phase diagrams in the complex-coupling plane and identify both continuous and discontinuous phase transitions. Our work thus identifies nonlinear sigma models as a representative setting for studying complex critical points and elucidates universal aspects of critical phenomena in complexified field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 受开放量子多体系统临界性研究的启发，本文将具有复化耦合的非线性σ模型作为非幺正场论的一般框架进行研究。通过对十重对称空间进行微扰重整化群分析，作者表明具有复标度维数和复临界指数的不动点会普遍出现，且在传统实耦合非线性σ模型中没有对应物。研究还给出复耦合平面中的全局相图，并识别连续与不连续相变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受近期对开放量子多体系统临界性的兴趣所激励，我们研究具有复化耦合的非线性σ模型，将其作为非幺正场论的一般框架。通过将微扰重整化群分析应用于十重对称空间，我们证明，具有复标度维数和复临界指数的不动点会普遍出现，而它们在具有实耦合的传统非线性σ模型中没有对应物。我们进一步阐明了复耦合平面中的全局相图，并识别出连续相变和不连续相变。因此，我们的工作将非线性σ模型确定为研究复临界点的代表性场景，并阐明了复化场论中临界现象的普适方面。

articles.title: Unconventional superconductivity from lattice quantum disorder
articles.title_zh: 由晶格量子无序产生的非常规超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.03576v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity presents a defining and enduring challenge in condensed matter physics. Prevailing theoretical frameworks have predominantly emphasized electronic degrees of freedom, largely neglecting the rich physics inherent in the lattice. Although conventional phonon theory offers an elegant description of structural phase diagrams and lattice dynamics, its omission of nuclear quantum many-body effects results in misleading phase diagram interpretations and, consequently, an unsound foundation for superconducting theory. Here, by incorporating nuclear quantum many-body effects within first-principles calculations, we discover a lattice quantum disordered phase in superconductors H3S and La3Ni2O7. This phase occupies a triangular region in the pressure-temperature phase diagram, whose left boundary aligns precisely with Tc of the left flank of the superconducting dome. The Tcmax of this quantum disordered phase coincides with the maximum of superconducting Tc, indicating this phase as both the origin of superconductivity on the dome's left flank and a key ingredient of its pairing mechanism. Our findings advance the understanding of high-temperature superconductivity and establish the lattice quantum disordered phase as a unifying framework, both for predicting new superconductors and for elucidating phenomena in a broader context of condensed matter physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，非常规超导理论长期偏重电子自由度，而忽视晶格中的核量子多体效应。作者在第一性原理计算中纳入这些效应后，在H3S和La3Ni2O7中发现晶格量子无序相，其在压力—温度相图中占据三角形区域，并与超导穹顶左侧的Tc边界及最高Tc相关联。研究提出晶格量子无序相可能是理解和预测高温超导的重要统一框架。
authors: Yu-Cheng Zhu, Jia-Xi Zeng, Xin-Zheng Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非常规超导性是凝聚态物理中一个具有定义性且持久存在的挑战。现行理论框架主要强调电子自由度，在很大程度上忽视了晶格中固有的丰富物理。尽管传统声子理论为结构相图和晶格动力学提供了优雅的描述，但它遗漏了核量子多体效应，从而导致对相图的误导性解释，并因此为超导理论提供了不稳固的基础。在这里，通过在第一性原理计算中纳入核量子多体效应，我们在超导体H3S和La3Ni2O7中发现了一种晶格量子无序相。该相在压力—温度相图中占据一个三角形区域，其左边界与超导穹顶左侧翼的Tc精确一致。该量子无序相的Tcmax与超导Tc的最大值相吻合，表明该相既是超导穹顶左侧翼上超导性的起源，也是其配对机制的关键组成部分。我们的发现推进了对高温超导性的理解，并将晶格量子无序相确立为一个统一框架，既可用于预测新的超导体，也可用于阐明更广泛凝聚态物理背景下的现象。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作将核量子多体效应纳入第一性原理计算，提出 H3S 和 La3Ni2O7 中存在一种晶格量子无序相，并将其与超导穹顶的左右边界和最高 Tc 联系起来。作者强调仅靠传统声子理论可能会误判相图结构，而核量子涨落对超导机理具有关键作用。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们关注的超导材料、第一性原理计算以及核量子效应/非简谐晶格动力学有一定相关性。虽然不属于我们最核心的铁电或磁性方向，但对理解高压超导和电子-晶格耦合具有借鉴意义。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步阅读其处理核量子效应的计算框架，并思考能否迁移到卤化物钙钛矿、低维超导或其他强耦合晶格体系。若做相关方向，建议比较路径积分分子动力学、量子嵌入或有效哈密顿量方法的适用性。

articles.title: Matrix-product operator dualities in integrable lattice models
articles.title_zh: 可积晶格模型中的矩阵乘积算符对偶性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.17436v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Matrix-product operators (MPOs) appear throughout the study of integrable lattice models, notably as the transfer matrices. They can also be used as transformations to construct dualities between such models, both invertible (including unitary) and non-invertible (including discrete gauging). We analyse how the local Yang--Baxter integrable structures are modified under such dualities. We see that the ḩeckR-matrix, that appears in the baxterization approach to integrability, transforms in a simple manner. We further argue for a broad class of MPO dualities that the usual Yang--Baxter R-matrix should be extended. This extended R-matrix satisfies modified algebraic relations, including a modified Yang--Baxter algebra previously identified in the unitary case, that altogether give a local integrable structure underlying the commuting transfer matrices of the dual model. We illustrate these results with two case studies, analysing an invertible unitary MPO and a non-invertible MPO both applied to the canonical XXZ spin chain. The former is the cluster entangler, arising in the study of symmetry-protected topological phases, while the latter is the Kramers--Wannier duality. We show several results for MPOs with exact MPO inverses that are of independent interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究矩阵乘积算符在可积晶格模型中作为对偶变换时如何改变局域杨—巴克斯特可积结构。作者发现，在Baxter化可积性方法中出现的Hecke R矩阵具有简单的变换规律，并主张对一大类MPO对偶性应扩展通常的杨—巴克斯特R矩阵。文章以XXZ自旋链上的可逆幺正MPO和不可逆MPO为例，分别分析了cluster entangler与Kramers—Wannier对偶性。
authors: Yuan Miao, Andras Molnar, Nick G. Jones
articles.abstract_zh_full: 矩阵乘积算符（MPO）广泛出现在可积晶格模型的研究中，尤其是作为转移矩阵。它们也可以作为变换，用于在此类模型之间构造对偶性，包括可逆的对偶性（包括幺正对偶性）和不可逆的对偶性（包括离散规范化）。我们分析了在这种对偶性下，局域杨—巴克斯特可积结构如何被修改。我们看到，在通向可积性的Baxter化方法中出现的Hecke R矩阵以一种简单的方式发生变换。我们进一步论证，对于一大类MPO对偶性，通常的杨—巴克斯特R矩阵应当被扩展。这个扩展的R矩阵满足修改后的代数关系，包括此前在幺正情形中识别出的修改杨—巴克斯特代数；这些关系共同给出了对偶模型中对易转移矩阵背后的局域可积结构。我们通过两个案例研究来说明这些结果，分析一个可逆幺正MPO和一个不可逆MPO，它们都作用于标准XXZ自旋链。前者是cluster entangler，出现在对称保护拓扑相的研究中；后者是Kramers—Wannier对偶性。我们展示了若干关于具有精确MPO逆的MPO的结果，这些结果本身也具有独立意义。

articles.title: Deterministic single-photon source over the terahertz regime
articles.title_zh: 太赫兹频段的确定性单光子源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.26486v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The terahertz (THz) regime still lacks a source capable of emitting single photons deterministically. Here, we propose an on-demand THz single-photon source, triggered by a sequence of coherent optical pulses used to dress a polar quantum emitter. The permanent dipole moment of the emitter activates THz transitions within its Rabi-split doublets, which are enhanced through resonant coupling to a THz cavity. We identify a challenge unique to this platform: spontaneous emission of visible photons competes with the THz process, degrading performance in two distinct ways depending on the sign of the drive detuning---either increasing the vacuum component, reducing brightness, or increasing multiphoton contributions, reducing purity. We demonstrate how to overcome those challenges through optimized pulse areas and a sufficiently high Purcell rate. A hybrid resonator-nanoparticle design for a cavity satisfying the latter requirement is presented, yielding efficiencies of 65-92% and purities of 88-100%, comparable to the best visible single-photon sources, while providing broad tunability across the THz range. Finally, we exploit the visible emission itself, using its detection to fully reconstruct the THz photon-number distribution and herald a single THz photon, boosting efficiency to 90-95%. All these capabilities illustrate the new technological opportunities unlocked by the unique integration of terahertz and visible frequencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种按需触发的太赫兹单光子源，通过相干光脉冲序列修饰极性量子发射体来实现。发射体的永久偶极矩激活Rabi分裂双重态内的太赫兹跃迁，并通过与太赫兹腔共振耦合得到增强。作者分析了可见光自发辐射带来的竞争机制，提出通过优化脉冲面积和提高Purcell速率来克服限制，并进一步利用可见光探测重构太赫兹光子数分布和预示单个太赫兹光子。
authors: Caspar Groiseau, Miguel Á. Martínez-García, Diego Martín-Cano, Carlos Sánchez Muñoz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 太赫兹（THz）频段仍然缺乏一种能够确定性发射单光子的光源。在这里，我们提出一种按需工作的THz单光子源，它由一系列相干光脉冲触发，这些脉冲用于修饰一个极性量子发射体。该发射体的永久偶极矩激活其Rabi分裂双重态内部的THz跃迁，而这些跃迁通过与THz腔的共振耦合得到增强。我们指出了该平台特有的一个挑战：可见光子的自发辐射会与THz过程竞争，并以两种不同方式降低性能，具体取决于驱动失谐的符号——要么增加真空分量、降低亮度，要么增加多光子贡献、降低纯度。我们展示了如何通过优化脉冲面积和足够高的Purcell速率来克服这些挑战。我们提出了一种满足后一要求的混合谐振器—纳米颗粒腔设计，可获得65–92%的效率和88–100%的纯度，堪比最佳可见光单光子源，同时在整个THz范围内提供宽范围可调性。最后，我们利用可见光发射本身，通过探测它来完整重构THz光子数分布，并预示一个单个THz光子，从而将效率提升到90–95%。所有这些能力展示了太赫兹频率与可见光频率的独特集成所开启的新技术机遇。

articles.title: Kicked-Ising Quantum Battery
articles.title_zh: 踢动Ising量子电池
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.17835v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Entanglement has been identified as a key resource for enhancing charging performance in quantum batteries. We show that the kicked-Ising model at the self-dual point provides an explicit charging mechanism, where maximal entanglement growth yields maximal energy injection. Identifying the Floquet dynamics as a Clifford quantum cellular automata and considering exact diagonalization in momentum space, we analytically characterize the charging process, featuring a stable performance while achieving maximal charging. We further propose a fixed time window protocol that accelerates charging toward the continuously driven transverse-field limit. Spin-correlator analysis reveals that scrambling and light-cone spreading govern charging performance. The protocols remain compatible with diverse platforms, underscoring their scalability and practical feasibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在自对偶点处的踢动Ising模型可作为一种明确的量子电池充电机制，其中最大纠缠增长对应最大能量注入。作者将Floquet动力学识别为Clifford量子元胞自动机，并结合动量空间精确对角化，对稳定且最大化的充电过程进行解析刻画。进一步的固定时间窗口协议可加速充电，相关分析表明扰乱和光锥传播控制充电性能。
authors: Sebastián V. Romero, Xi Chen, Yue Ban
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠已被确定为增强量子电池充电性能的关键资源。我们表明，自对偶点处的踢动Ising模型提供了一种明确的充电机制，其中最大纠缠增长产生最大能量注入。通过将Floquet动力学识别为Clifford量子元胞自动机，并考虑动量空间中的精确对角化，我们解析刻画了充电过程，其特点是在实现最大充电的同时具有稳定性能。我们进一步提出一种固定时间窗口协议，将充电加速推向连续驱动的横场极限。自旋关联函数分析揭示，扰乱和光锥传播支配着充电性能。这些协议仍然与多种平台兼容，突出了其可扩展性和实际可行性。

articles.title: Sideband-Resolved 4H-SiC Optomechanical Resonators with Interference-Engineered Anchor-Loss Suppression
articles.title_zh: 具有干涉工程化锚定损耗抑制的边带分辨4H-SiC光机械谐振器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sideband-resolved cavity optomechanical resonators provide a powerful platform for coherent photon--phonon interactions, enabling applications ranging from quantum state transduction and optomechanically induced transparency to precision sensing and microwave photonics. Achieving this regime in integrated microresonators, however, requires simultaneously realizing a narrow optical cavity linewidth, a high-frequency mechanical mode, and low mechanical dissipation. Here, we report the first sideband-resolved optomechanical resonators based on the 4H silicon carbide (4H-SiC) platform. By combining compact microdisk geometries with interference-engineered anchor-loss suppression, we simultaneously achieve intrinsic optical quality factors exceeding 1×10⁶, room-temperature mechanical quality factors up to 1.51×10⁴, and a sideband-resolution factor greater than seven. Systematic numerical and experimental studies reveal that a local minimum in anchor loss enables high mechanical quality factors without requiring aggressive undercutting, substantially improving fabrication yield and device robustness. We further demonstrate the first observation of optomechanically induced transparency in integrated 4H-SiC resonators, confirming coherent cavity optomechanical interactions in this material platform. These results establish 4H-SiC as a promising platform for integrated cavity optomechanics and provide a practical route toward scalable photon--phonon devices for classical and quantum photonic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了首个基于4H碳化硅平台的边带分辨光机械谐振器。通过紧凑微盘结构与干涉工程化锚定损耗抑制相结合，作者同时实现了高光学品质因子、较高室温机械品质因子以及大于7的边带分辨因子。研究还首次在集成4H-SiC谐振器中观察到光机械诱导透明，确立了4H-SiC作为集成腔光机械平台的潜力。
authors: Xirui Gou, William Privratsky, Wenhan Sun, Yuncong Liu, Hamed Abiri, Philip X. -L. Feng, Qing Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 边带分辨腔光机械谐振器为相干光子—声子相互作用提供了强大平台，可支持从量子态转导、光机械诱导透明到精密传感和微波光子学等应用。然而，在集成微谐振器中实现这一 regime，需要同时实现窄光学腔线宽、高频机械模式和低机械耗散。在这里，我们报道首个基于4H碳化硅（4H-SiC）平台的边带分辨光机械谐振器。通过将紧凑微盘几何结构与干涉工程化锚定损耗抑制相结合，我们同时实现了超过1×10⁶的本征光学品质因子、最高达1.51×10⁴的室温机械品质因子，以及大于7的边带分辨因子。系统的数值和实验研究表明，锚定损耗中的一个局域极小值使得无需激进的底切即可获得高机械品质因子，从而显著提高了制造良率和器件稳健性。我们进一步首次在集成4H-SiC谐振器中观察到光机械诱导透明，证实了该材料平台中的相干腔光机械相互作用。这些结果确立了4H-SiC作为集成腔光机械学有前景的平台，并为面向经典和量子光子技术的可扩展光子—声子器件提供了一条实用途径。

articles.title: A novel class of σ/π-separating orbital localization functionals
articles.title_zh: 一类新的σ/π分离轨道局域化泛函
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbital localization methods have a long history in quantum chemistry, as they provide a convenient way to describe individual chemical bonds and local properties. However, only a handful of localization functionals are known up to date, and most localization methods do not separate σ- and π-orbitals, which is important to describe chemical bonding patterns and reactivity. In this work, we present a new class of localization functionals, based on nucleus-electron physical observables, that preserve σ- and π-orbitals separation in molecular systems. We also present a general mechanism behind σ/π-separating variational localization which can be used for constructing a broader class of σ/π-separating localization functionals from other local physical quantities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一类新的轨道局域化泛函，旨在在分子体系中保持σ轨道与π轨道的分离。该方法基于核—电子物理可观测量，回应了现有多数轨道局域化方法不能有效区分σ/π轨道的问题。作者还给出σ/π分离变分局域化的一般机制，可用于从其他局域物理量构造更广泛的相关泛函。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轨道局域化方法在量子化学中具有悠久历史，因为它们提供了一种方便的方式来描述单个化学键和局域性质。然而，迄今为止已知的局域化泛函只有少数几种，并且大多数局域化方法并不分离σ轨道和π轨道，而这种分离对于描述化学成键模式和反应性很重要。在这项工作中，我们提出一类新的局域化泛函，它们基于核—电子物理可观测量，并在分子体系中保持σ轨道和π轨道的分离。我们还提出了σ/π分离变分局域化背后的一般机制，该机制可用于从其他局域物理量构造更广泛类别的σ/π分离局域化泛函。

articles.title: Phase control of multi-photon electron-positron pair creation from vacuum
articles.title_zh: 真空中多光子电子—正电子对产生的相位控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26408v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the creation of electron-positron pairs by two spatiotemporally inhomogeneous electric fields with a relative phase, employing computational quantum field theory. We find that, when the two fields are closely spaced, the pair yield exhibits a cosine-like dependence on the relative phase. This suggests that the relative phase provides an effective way to enhance multi-photon transition channels. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that the response of pair-creation channels to the relative phase changes substantially with the photon order of the transition. For one-photon transitions, the rate exhibits a 2π periodicity, whereas a reduced periodicity of π is observed for two-photon transitions. To clarify the underlying mechanism, we map the quantum field-theoretical framework onto a time-dependent perturbation approach. By extending this approach to n-photon processes, we show that the transition probability is periodic in the relative phase with period 2π/n. This observation suggests that the relative phase offers an effective means of identifying the order of multi-photon transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用计算量子场论研究了具有相对相位的两个时空非均匀电场诱导电子—正电子对产生的过程。当两个场相距较近时，对产生率对相对相位呈余弦型依赖，说明相对相位可有效增强多光子跃迁通道。进一步分析显示，不同光子阶数的产生通道具有不同相位周期性，n光子过程的跃迁概率周期为2π/n。
authors: C. K. Li, X. X. Zhou, B. An, Y. J. Li, N. S. Lina, Y. Wan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用计算量子场论，研究由两个具有相对相位的时空非均匀电场产生电子—正电子对的过程。我们发现，当两个场间距很近时，成对产额对相对相位表现出类似余弦的依赖关系。这表明，相对相位提供了一种增强多光子跃迁通道的有效方式。此外，我们的分析揭示，对产生通道对相对相位的响应会随跃迁的光子阶数而发生显著变化。对于单光子跃迁，速率表现出2π周期性，而对于双光子跃迁，则观察到减小为π的周期性。为阐明其内在机制，我们将量子场论框架映射到一种含时微扰方法。通过将该方法推广到n光子过程，我们表明跃迁概率关于相对相位具有周期2π/n。这一观察表明，相对相位提供了一种识别多光子跃迁阶数的有效手段。

articles.title: Spiking Photonic Neurons Based on Two-Section InP Quantum-Well Lasers Integrated on Silicon
articles.title_zh: 基于硅上集成双段InP量子阱激光器的尖峰光子神经元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26950v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we experimentally investigate the spiking dynamics of two-section InP quantum-well lasers monolithically integrated on silicon. By appropriately tuning the electrical bias conditions, we realize multiple neuronal-like operating regimes, such as integrate-and-fire and resonate-and-fire, highlighting the device's versatility as a high-speed photonic neuron. A systematic investigation of laser design parameters, including cavity length and gain/saturable absorber ratio, elucidates their impact on spiking-related properties (such as pulse repetition frequency) and traces the operational parameter space that unlocks stable spiking. Finally, these findings pave the way toward scalable neuromorphic photonic integrated circuits, where low-loss silicon synapses coexist with versatile laser neurons.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文实验研究了单片集成在硅上的双段InP量子阱激光器的尖峰动力学。通过调节电偏置条件，器件可实现积分—发放、共振—发放等多种类神经元工作模式，体现出作为高速光子神经元的多功能性。作者还系统分析了腔长和增益/可饱和吸收体比例等设计参数对尖峰特性的影响，为可扩展神经形态光子集成电路奠定基础。
authors: Menelaos Skontranis, Benoit Charbonnier, Olivier Girard, Adonis Bogris, Charis Mesaritakis
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们实验研究了单片集成在硅上的双段InP量子阱激光器的尖峰动力学。通过适当调节电偏置条件，我们实现了多种类神经元工作 regime，例如积分—发放和共振—发放，突出了该器件作为高速光子神经元的多功能性。对激光器设计参数的系统研究，包括腔长以及增益/可饱和吸收体比例，阐明了它们对尖峰相关性质（如脉冲重复频率）的影响，并描绘出能够解锁稳定尖峰的工作参数空间。最后，这些发现为可扩展神经形态光子集成电路铺平了道路，其中低损耗硅突触与多功能激光神经元共存。

articles.title: Quantum random number generation using spatial quantum noise of light
articles.title_zh: 利用光的空间量子噪声实现量子随机数生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26486v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generating high-speed, verifiable random numbers is a fundamental requirement for cryptography, large-scale stochastic simulations, and secure quantum communication. Here, we present a robust quantum random number generator that utilizes the spatial distribution of quantum fluctuations captured by an electron-multiplying charge-coupled device operated in high-speed kinetic mode. Through rigorous detector calibration and shot-noise analysis, we characterize the spatial quantum noise obtained from the spatial intensity fluctuations of the coherent states of light. Such quantum noise serves as a high-entropy source, enabling an instantaneous random bit generation rate of 5.92 Gbps without algorithmic randomness extraction in the present configuration. The sustained output rate is, however, limited to 7.5 Mbps by the bandwidth of the serial electronic readout. The generated sequences successfully pass the NIST SP 800-22 and Marsaglia Diehard statistical test suites, confirming the high quality and unpredictability of the entropy source.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种稳健的量子随机数发生器，利用在高速动力学模式下工作的电子倍增电荷耦合器件所捕获的光场空间量子涨落分布。通过严格的探测器标定和散粒噪声分析，作者表征了来自相干光强度空间涨落的空间量子噪声。该噪声可作为高熵源，在当前配置下无需算法随机性提取即可实现 5.92 Gbps 的瞬时随机比特生成率；生成序列通过了 NIST SP 800-22 和 Marsaglia Diehard 统计检验。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生成高速、可验证的随机数是密码学、大规模随机模拟以及安全量子通信的基本需求。本文提出一种稳健的量子随机数发生器，利用在高速动力学模式下工作的电子倍增电荷耦合器件所捕获的光场空间量子涨落分布。通过严格的探测器标定和散粒噪声分析，我们表征了由相干态光的空间强度涨落获得的空间量子噪声。此类量子噪声可作为高熵源，在当前配置下无需算法随机性提取即可实现 5.92 Gbps 的瞬时随机比特生成率。然而，由于串行电子读出的带宽限制，持续输出速率仅为 7.5 Mbps。生成的序列成功通过了 NIST SP 800-22 和 Marsaglia Diehard 统计测试套件，证实了该熵源的高质量与不可预测性。

articles.title: Mean-field Pulse Adaptation for the Circularization of Interacting Rydberg Atoms
articles.title_zh: 相互作用里德堡原子的平均场脉冲自适应圆化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26978v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Arrays of circular Rydberg atoms provide a promising platform for quantum simulation and computation; however, their preparation in the presence of interatomic interactions remains a major challenge. While optimal control methods have enabled the design of fast and accurate radio-frequency pulses for the circularization of a single atom and of an atom pair, the extension to more atoms is fundamentally limited by the exponential growth of the Hilbert space, which renders numerical simulations computationally infeasible. Here, we introduce an effective model that treats interactions within a mean-field approximation, thereby enabling the simulation of large atomic systems. Our model further enables the adaptation of pulses optimized for non-interacting atoms to interacting systems, based on the computation of a single time evolution. For two interacting ⁸⁷Rb atoms, we demonstrate that the error of our method remains below 1 , % and that our adapted pulses recover the initial performance of optimal pulses in the regime of weak to moderate interaction strengths.
articles.abstract_zh: 圆里德堡原子阵列是量子模拟与量子计算的有前景平台，但在存在原子间相互作用时的制备仍然困难。本文提出一种有效模型，以平均场近似处理相互作用，从而能够模拟更大规模的原子系统，并据此将针对无相互作用原子优化的射频脉冲自适应到相互作用体系。对于两个相互作用的 87Rb 原子，该方法误差保持在 1% 以下，并在弱到中等相互作用强度下恢复了最优脉冲的初始性能。
authors: Matthias Hüls, Felix Motzoi, Tommaso Calarco, Eloisa Cuestas
articles.abstract_zh_full: 圆里德堡原子阵列为量子模拟和量子计算提供了一个很有前景的平台；然而，在存在原子间相互作用的情况下制备这些原子仍然是一项重大挑战。尽管最优控制方法已经能够为单原子和原子对设计快速且精确的射频脉冲，但将其扩展到更多原子在根本上受限于希尔伯特空间的指数增长，这使得数值模拟在计算上不可行。本文提出一种有效模型，以平均场近似处理相互作用，从而能够模拟大规模原子系统。我们的模型还允许通过计算一次时间演化，将针对无相互作用原子优化的脉冲自适应到相互作用体系。对于两个相互作用的 87Rb 原子，我们证明该方法的误差保持在 1% 以下，并且在弱到中等相互作用强度区域内，自适应后的脉冲恢复了最优脉冲的初始性能。

articles.title: Angular Geometry of Atomic Multipole Transitions
articles.title_zh: 原子多极跃迁的角几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.07451v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A simple way to calculate Rabi frequencies is outlined for interactions of atomic or nuclear multipole moments with laser fields that focuses on their relative geometry. The resulting expression takes the form of a dot product between the laser polarization and a vector spherical harmonic, thereby naturally connecting to the multipole's far-field spontaneous-emission pattern and providing a way to visualize the interaction. Since the vector spherical harmonics are not yet a standard tool in quantum science, their relevant properties are reviewed. This approach is illustrated in the calculation of a variety of beam effects, yielding both perturbative corrections and some nontrivial cases with non-vanishing coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文给出一种简洁的方式来计算原子或核多极矩与激光场相互作用时的拉比频率，重点强调二者之间的相对几何关系。所得表达式可写成激光偏振与向量球谐函数之间的点积，从而自然联系到多极跃迁的远场自发辐射图样，并提供可视化相互作用的方法。文中还回顾了向量球谐函数的相关性质，并以若干光束效应的计算为例，展示了该方法可给出微扰修正以及一些具有非零耦合的非平凡情形。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文概述了一种简洁的方法，用于计算原子或核多极矩与激光场相互作用时的拉比频率，重点关注它们的相对几何关系。所得表达式的形式为激光偏振与一个向量球谐函数之间的点积，因此自然地将该相互作用与多极辐射的远场自发辐射图样联系起来，并提供了一种可视化相互作用的方式。由于向量球谐函数尚未成为量子科学中的标准工具，文中回顾了其相关性质。文中还通过计算多种光束效应来说明这一方法，得到既包括微扰修正、也包括一些具有非零耦合的非平凡情形。

articles.title: Data Fusion and Contrastive Alignment for Unconstrained IR Molecular Structure Elucidation
articles.title_zh: 面向无约束红外分子结构解析的数据融合与对比对齐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated molecular structure elucidation from infrared (IR) spectroscopy data has seen significant advancements in recent years, but its broad applicability is limited by a reliance on pre-determined chemical formulas provided as auxiliary model inputs. This limits model predictions to isomer identification rather than full molecular structure prediction. Although transformer models have been shown to identify molecular isomers with high accuracy, their reliability for unconstrained structure elucidation is comparatively low and poorly understood. In this work, we propose and evaluate key modifications to the traditional encoder-decoder transformer. To better address the vast chemical space of the unconstrained problem, we implement a novel Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) decoder module that utilizes non-additive aggregation via linear-order statistics and the Choquet integral. We further modify the transformer to utilize these non-additive operators when aggregating spectral representations as well. Together with an auxiliary contrastive alignment loss term, these enhancements improve Top-K prediction accuracy by over 10 percentage points compared to baseline IR-only models. Through sub-structure fragment analysis of molecular predictions, we further confirm that infrared spectra encode the vast majority of relevant chemical information, implying that the higher performance of isomer-ranking models is largely due to underrepresented or overlapping absorption bands for molecules in the explored chemical space. Ultimately, by demonstrating the efficacy of automated molecular structure elucidation from measured IR spectra, this work serves to significantly broaden the utility of AI in analytical chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究如何利用红外光谱数据实现自动化分子结构解析，并指出传统方法通常依赖预先给定的化学式，因此只能进行同分异构体识别而非完整结构预测。作者提出对编码器-解码器 Transformer 的若干关键改造，包括基于线性阶统计与 Choquet 积分的 Mixture-of-Experts 解码器、用于谱表示聚合的非加性算子，以及辅助的对比对齐损失。实验表明，这些改进使 Top-K 预测准确率较基线仅使用 IR 的模型提升超过 10 个百分点，并说明红外光谱已编码了大部分相关化学信息。
authors: Ethan J. Mick, Campbell A. Sweet, Matthias J. Young, Derek T. Anderson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，基于红外（IR）光谱数据的自动化分子结构解析取得了显著进展，但其广泛适用性受到对预先确定的化学式作为辅助模型输入的依赖所限制。这种限制使得模型预测只能停留在同分异构体识别，而无法进行完整的分子结构预测。尽管已有研究表明 Transformer 模型能够高精度识别分子同分异构体，但它们在无约束结构解析中的可靠性相对较低，而且人们对其机制的理解也较少。本文提出并评估了对传统编码器-解码器 Transformer 的若干关键改造。为更好地应对无约束问题中巨大的化学空间，我们实现了一种新的 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）解码器模块，采用基于线性阶统计和 Choquet 积分的非加性聚合。我们还修改了 Transformer，使其在聚合光谱表示时同样使用这些非加性算子。结合一个辅助的对比对齐损失项，这些增强使得 Top-K 预测准确率相比基线仅使用 IR 的模型提高了 10 个百分点以上。通过对分子预测进行子结构片段分析，我们进一步证实红外光谱编码了与化学相关的绝大多数信息，这意味着同分异构体排序模型表现更高，主要是由于所探索化学空间中的吸收带存在欠表征或重叠。最终，通过展示从实测 IR 光谱自动解析分子结构的有效性，这项工作显著拓展了人工智能在分析化学中的应用范围。

articles.title: Energy-Dependent Shifts of Medium-Scale Anisotropies in Very-High-Energy Cosmic Rays Observed by LHAASO-KM2A
articles.title_zh: LHAASO-KM2A 观测到的甚高能宇宙线中等尺度各向异性的能量依赖位移
