articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出将SU(3)对称自旋液体掺杂作为通向6e电荷超导性的路径。这推广了从掺杂SU(4)对称相构造4e电荷超导性的思想。作为一个具体平台，我们研究了具有SU(3)自旋对称性和层间反铁磁交换的双层三角晶格Hubbard模型。利用互补的部分子构造，我们分析了掺杂Z₃量子自旋液体以及与SU(3)相关的手征自旋液体。掺杂Z₃量子自旋液体可以产生一种正交金属，其具有由电荷为3e的费米三聚体构成的规范不变费米面。这些三聚体配对会产生时间反演对称的6e电荷超导体。掺杂Abelian SU(3)₁和SU(6)₁手征自旋液体分别产生有残余Abelian拓扑序和无残余Abelian拓扑序的手征6e电荷超导体。掺杂非Abelian SU(3)₂手征自旋液体会导致一种非Abelian手征6e电荷超导体，它与SO(3)₋₃拓扑序交织，并支持非Abelian的h/(6e)超导涡旋。我们还识别出若干其他相，包括Z₃正交金属、由Z₃或Z₂拓扑序丰富的量子反常霍尔（晶体）相、SU(3)破缺的2e电荷超导体、耦合到非Abelian规范场的复合费米液体，以及后代手征自旋液体。我们的结果表明，掺杂SU(3)自旋液体是一个自然场景，其中对称性、分数化和拓扑协同产生6e电荷超导性。

articles.title: Element-Specific Visualization of Layer-Parity and Twist-Dependent Magnetism in CrSBr
articles.title_zh: CrSBr中层奇偶性与扭转依赖磁性的元素特异性可视化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Van der Waals (vdW) based antiferromagnets (AFMs) are an ideal platform for probing and understanding thickness- and twist-angle-dependent emergent spin phenomena. However, element-specific nanoscale characterization of the spin structure in atomically thin vdW-based AFMs systems and layer-parity effects remain elusive, making them crucial for both fundamental insight into low-dimensional magnetism and the rational design of spintronic devices based on these materials. Here, we utilize X-ray magnetic circular and linear dichroisms paired with photoemission electron microscopy to resolve the magnetic order in atomically thin CrSBr. Our comprehensive measurements reveal CrSBr magnetic structure at the nanoscale and its dependence on the layer number, surface encapsulation, temperature, and applied field. Moreover, in the orthogonally twisted bilayer configuration, obtained by twisting two CrSBr ferromagnetic monolayers by 90ⁱ̧rc, the magnetic easy axis fundamentally differs from the individual monolayers, unlocking a new pathway for moiré magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对范德华反铁磁体中厚度、扭转角依赖的磁序问题展开研究，聚焦原子级薄层体系中磁结构的元素特异性表征。作者结合X射线磁圆二色性、线二色性与光电子显微技术，分辨出CrSBr在不同层数、表面封装、温度和外场下的磁有序行为。结果还表明，90°扭转双层构型中的磁易轴与单层显著不同，为莫尔磁性提供了新的实现路径。
authors: Aalok Tiwari, Shubhada Patil, Ravi Kumar Bandapelli, Alevtina Smekhova, Abhishek Kumar, Wenhao Liu, I-Hsuan Kao, Zhenhong Cui, Raghvendra Posti, Brandon Tran, Zixin Zhai, Priti Yadav, Sandy Adhitia Ekahana, Alexander X. Gray, Bing Lv, Vivekanand Shukla, Florian Kronast, Simranjeet Singh, Jyoti Katoch
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于范德华力（vdW）的反铁磁体是探究和理解厚度依赖与扭转角依赖的涌现自旋现象的理想平台。然而，在原子级薄的基于 vdW 的反铁磁体系中，元素特异的纳米尺度自旋结构表征以及层奇偶效应仍然难以实现，而这些因素对于理解低维磁性基础物理以及合理设计基于这些材料的自旋电子器件都至关重要。本文将 X 射线磁圆二色性和线性二色性与光电子显微镜结合，用于解析原子级薄 CrSBr 中的磁有序。我们的全面测量揭示了 CrSBr 的纳米尺度磁结构及其对层数、表面封装、温度和外加磁场的依赖。此外，在正交扭转的双层构型中，即将两层 CrSBr 铁磁单层相互扭转 90° 所得到的结构，其磁易轴与单层材料本身有本质差异，从而为莫尔磁性开辟了新的路径。

articles.title: Extracting Atomic Environments for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 用于机器学习原子间势的原子环境提取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26018v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In order to appropriately capture large-scale material features and emergent phenomena via atomistic simulations, such as Molecular Dynamics (MD), the system scale can range up to hundreds of millions of atoms. However, the force-field models that drive those simulations are generally trained with Density Functional Theory (DFT) reference data, limited to relatively small configurations on the order of 100s or 1000s of atoms. To compute DFT forces on atoms in regions of interest, for example for active-learning or on-the-fly training of interatomic potentials, one needs to extract a small set of atoms from the larger simulation box, and typical work with periodic boundary conditions for DFT; however, methods to select the shape and size of this extracted set of atoms, as well as to generate a potentially necessary passivating envelope, have not been systematically analyzed. In this work, we present a benchmark of various techniques to extract atomic environments from large, bulk configurations and embed them into smaller configurations suitable for DFT calculations with periodic boundary conditions. We test with a diverse set of material systems, which includes amorphous SiO₂, Ta with screw dislocations, and molten C. We demonstrated a notably simple procedure, a method we refer to as deletions, yields superior performance over an array of alternative extraction methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文关注如何从大规模原子模拟中提取适合DFT计算的局域原子环境，以支持主动学习或在线训练原子间势。作者系统比较了多种从大体积体相构型中截取原子集合并在周期边界条件下嵌入小体系的技术，同时讨论了所需钝化包层的构造问题。工作通过基准测试评估不同方法在多类材料体系中的适用性，为高效生成参考数据提供了方法学依据。
authors: Jared C. Stimac, Fei Zhou, Kyle Bushick, Bo Lei, Sebastien Hamel, Amit Samanta, Vincenzo Lordi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为了通过原子级模拟（例如分子动力学，MD）恰当地捕捉大尺度材料特征和涌现现象，体系规模可能需要达到数亿个原子。然而，驱动这些模拟的力场模型通常使用密度泛函理论（DFT）参考数据进行训练，而这些数据仅限于数量大致为数百或数千原子的相对较小构型。为了计算感兴趣区域中原子的 DFT 力，例如用于主动学习或原子间势的在线训练，人们需要从更大的模拟盒中提取一小组原子，并且通常需要结合周期性边界条件进行 DFT 处理；然而，如何选择所提取原子集合的形状和尺寸，以及如何生成可能必需的钝化外层，尚未得到系统分析。本文对从大规模体相构型中提取原子环境并将其嵌入到适合具有周期性边界条件的 DFT 计算的较小构型中的多种技术进行了基准测试。我们在多种材料体系上进行了测试，其中包括非晶 SiO₂、具有螺位错的 Ta 和熔融 C。我们证明了一种非常简单的程序，即我们称之为“删除（deletions）”的方法，在多种替代提取方法中表现最佳。

articles.title: Predicting the Slow Drift of Nuclear Spin Noise in Semiconductor Spin Qubits
articles.title_zh: 预测半导体自旋量子比特中核自旋噪声的缓慢漂移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26019v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dynamics of a nuclear spin bath generates magnetic noise that is a key contributor to the decoherence of electron spin qubits in electrostatically-defined quantum dots. In this paper, we extend the cluster correlation expansion (CCE) technique, which has proven useful for predicting solid-state qubit coherence times across various settings but is limited to shorter time scales, to incorporate stochastic treatments of cluster dynamics in order to efficiently predict slow drifting Overhauser fields over longer time scales. This approach combines quantum evolution with classical rate matrices to enable simulation across a wide range of temporal regimes required to simulate, for example, the long-time convergence of the ergodic T₂^* from Ramsey experiments. Our methodology is validated against experimental data from various silicon spin qubit systems, demonstrating a strong agreement between simulation and measurement of Ramsey experiments presented in the form of T₂^* versus averaging time, autocorrelation functions, as well as power spectral densities. Furthermore, we demonstrate significant back-action effects through modeling and experiment; specifically, the dynamics of the nuclear spin bath depends upon the electron spin occupation schedule. Finally, our modeling quantitatively predicts the benefits from compensating for the slow drift of Overhauser fields in qubit operations. Our findings indicate that compensating for an Overhauser rotation measured Δ t in the past results in an effective T₂^*, which we denote tildeT₂^*(Δ t) for clarity, under certain scenarios of interest, can be one or two orders of magnitude larger than the ergodic T₂^* if the Overhauser rotation is re-characterized every 100 milliseconds; that is, tildeT₂^*(Δ t = 100~m̊ ms) can be 10 to 100 times larger than T₂^*.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究电静定义量子点中核自旋浴引起的慢变磁噪声及其对电子自旋量子比特退相干的影响。作者在cluster correlation expansion框架中引入随机簇动力学处理，以更高效率模拟长时间尺度上的Overhauser场漂移。该方法与硅自旋量子比特实验数据在Ramsey实验、互相关函数和功率谱密度等方面表现出良好一致性，并揭示了显著的反馈作用。
authors: Wayne M. Witzel, Jesse J. Lutz, Matthew D. Grace, Natalie D. Foster, Ryan M. Jock, Dwight R. Luhman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 核自旋浴的动力学会产生磁噪声，而这正是电静定义量子点中电子自旋量子比特退相干的一个关键来源。本文扩展了簇相关展开（CCE）技术；该技术已被证明可用于预测多种固态量子比特的相干时间，但其适用时间尺度通常较短。我们将其与簇动力学的随机处理结合起来，以高效预测更长时间尺度上缓慢漂移的 Overhauser 场。该方法将量子演化与经典速率矩阵结合，使得能够跨越模拟长时间尺度所需的广泛时间区间，例如 Ramsey 实验中遍历态 T2* 的长时间收敛。我们的方法通过来自多种硅自旋量子比特系统的实验数据得到了验证，证明了模拟与测量在 Ramsey 实验的 T2* 随平均时间变化、自相关函数以及功率谱密度等方面具有很强的一致性。此外，我们还通过建模和实验展示了显著的反作用效应；具体而言，核自旋浴的动力学依赖于电子自旋占据时序。最后，我们的模型对补偿量子比特操作中 Overhauser 场缓慢漂移的收益给出了定量预测。我们的结果表明，在某些感兴趣的情形下，如果对 Δt 之前测得的 Overhauser 旋转进行补偿，则得到的有效 T2*（为清晰起见记为 ẼT2*(Δt)）在每 100 毫秒重新表征一次 Overhauser 旋转时，可比遍历态 T2* 大一到两个数量级；也就是说，当 Δt = 100 ms 时，ẼT2*(Δt) 可比 T2* 大 10 到 100 倍。

articles.title: The interplay of crystal-field transitions and exchange spin dynamics in a ferrimagnet
articles.title_zh: 铁磁体中晶场跃迁与交换自旋动力学的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26026v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth iron garnets offer an ideal platform for exploring the interplay of low-energy excitations and the complex temperature-dependent magnetization dynamics. In these systems, exchange coupling between rare-earth and iron sublattices generates high-frequency collective spin excitations. In addition, the robust spin-orbit coupling of localized 4f electrons triggers the crystal-electric-field (CEF) transitions at THz frequencies. Despite extensive research into the garnet spin dynamics, the interplay between CEF excitations and exchange modes has remained largely unmapped. Using temperature-dependent THz time-domain spectroscopy, we demonstrate a hybridization between the Yb-ion CEF excitation and the Yb-Fe exchange mode in Gd₃/₂Yb₁/₂BiFe₅O₁₂. This coupling is characterized by a significant redistribution of spectral and temporal weights as the material approaches its magnetization compensation temperature. Notably, the Yb-Fe exchange mode exhibits an anomalous redshift upon cooling -- a reversal of the conventional blue shift typically driven by increased exchange coupling. We trace this phenomenon to a modification of Yb-Fe exchange anisotropy, driven by the interplay of the Fe exchange field and Yb CEF excitations. These findings highlight the critical role of CEF-mediated exchange coupling in shaping low-energy spin dynamics, positioning rare-earth garnets as a cornerstone for future THz spintronic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以稀土铁石榴石为平台，研究低能激发与温度依赖磁化动力学之间的耦合关系。作者利用温度依赖的太赫兹时域光谱，观察到Yb离子晶体电场激发与Yb-Fe交换模之间的杂化，并发现其在磁化补偿温度附近伴随谱权重和时间权重的重分布。研究还指出，Yb-Fe交换模在降温时出现异常红移，反映出交换耦合机制的变化。
authors: Arpita Dutta, Pratyay Mukherjee, Ritwik Mondal, Shovon Pal
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土铁石榴石为探索低能激发与复杂的温度依赖磁化动力学之间的相互作用提供了理想平台。在这些体系中，稀土亚晶格与铁亚晶格之间的交换耦合会产生高频集体自旋激发。此外，局域 4f 电子的强自旋轨道耦合会在太赫兹频率下引发晶体电场（CEF）跃迁。尽管针对石榴石自旋动力学已经开展了大量研究，CEF 激发与交换模之间的相互作用仍然基本未被绘制清楚。我们利用温度依赖的太赫兹时域光谱，证明了 Gd3/2Yb1/2BiFe5O12 中 Yb 离子的 CEF 激发与 Yb-Fe 交换模之间存在杂化。这种耦合表现为当材料接近磁化补偿温度时，谱权重和时间权重出现显著重分配。值得注意的是，Yb-Fe 交换模在冷却过程中表现出异常红移——这与通常由交换耦合增强所驱动的常规蓝移相反。我们将这一现象追溯到由 Fe 交换场与 Yb CEF 激发相互作用所驱动的 Yb-Fe 交换各向异性改变。这些结果强调了 CEF 介导的交换耦合在塑造低能自旋动力学中的关键作用，并使稀土石榴石成为未来太赫兹自旋电子技术的基石。

articles.title: Soft-mode nonlinearities away from ferroelectric phase transition
articles.title_zh: 远离铁电相变的软模非线性行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between ionic and electronic subsystems dictates the behavior of structural phase transitions in polar dielectrics, a coupling mediated by soft optical phonon modes. In incipient ferroelectrics such as SrTiO₃ (STO), strong local-field effects can drive the lattice into a non-perturbative regime near the phase boundary. However, disentangling the distinct contributions of local fields from those of spontaneous macroscopic polarization remains an experimental challenge. Here, we isolate these mechanisms by probing paraelectric STO deep within its symmetric phase, where macroscopic spontaneous polarization is suppressed. Linear terahertz (THz) spectroscopy reveals that the soft mode exhibits a hybrid character, predominantly driven by electronic polarizability. Utilizing two-dimensional THz spectroscopy, we map the underlying nonlinear signals, demonstrating that the system persists in a perturbative regime characterized by robust local-field coherence. By implementing a microscopic model of coupled electronic and lattice degrees of freedom mediated by local fields, we qualitatively reproduce these multidimensional coherent signatures. Our findings highlight that while local fields are necessary to initiate non-perturbative lattice dynamics, they are insufficient on their own. This reveals that spontaneous polarization plays a deterministic role in dictating soft-mode nonlinearities in strongly correlated polar dielectrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究接近铁电临界但仍处于顺电相的SrTiO₃中软光学声子模的非线性响应，以区分局域场效应与自发宏观极化的作用。线性太赫兹光谱表明软模具有混合特征，并主要受电子极化率驱动。二维太赫兹光谱进一步揭示了体系仍处于微扰区间，且局域场相干性较强；作者建立的微观模型能够定性再现观测到的多维相干信号。
authors: Payel Shee, Ipek Efe, Jingwen Li, Kshitij V. Goyal, Morgan Trassin, Shovon Pal
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离子子系统与电子子系统之间的相互作用决定了极性介电体中结构相变的行为，而这种耦合是通过软光学声子模介导的。在 SrTiO3（STO）等临界铁电体中，强局域场效应可在接近相边界时将晶格驱动到非微扰区。然而，将局域场的贡献与自发宏观极化的贡献区分开来，在实验上仍然是一项挑战。本文通过探测深处于对称相中的顺电 STO 来分离这些机制，在该状态下宏观自发极化被抑制。线性太赫兹（THz）光谱表明，软模具有杂化性质，并主要由电子极化率驱动。利用二维太赫兹光谱，我们绘制了底层的非线性信号，证明系统仍处于由稳健局域场相干性所特征化的微扰区间。通过实现一个由局域场介导的、电子与晶格自由度耦合的微观模型，我们定性再现了这些多维相干特征。我们的发现强调，虽然局域场对于引发非微扰晶格动力学是必要的，但其本身并不足够。这表明，自发极化在决定强关联极性介电体中软模非线性方面起着决定性作用。

articles.title: Beyond mean-field dynamics of the Dicke model with non-Markovian dephasing
articles.title_zh: 具有非马尔可夫退相干的Dicke模型超越平均场的动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.23028v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a density matrix-based time dependent projection operator formalism to calculate the beyond mean-field dynamics of systems with non-Markovian local baths and one-to-all interactions. Such models encapsulate the physics of condensed phase systems immersed in optical cavities. We use this method, combined with tensor network influence functionals, to study the dynamics of the Dicke model coupled to non-Markovian local dephasing baths at zero temperature, which has a superradiant phase transition in the mean-field limit. The method corrects a spurious initial state dependence found in the mean-field dynamics and describes the emergence of new time scales which are absent in the mean-field dynamics. Our formalism, based on density matrices, is applicable to other quantum optical systems with one-to-all interactions at finite temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于密度矩阵的时间依赖投影算符形式，用于描述带有非马尔可夫局域浴和全对全相互作用系统的超越平均场动力学。作者将该方法与张量网络影响泛函结合，研究了零温下与非马尔可夫去相干浴耦合的Dicke模型动力学。结果表明，该方法能够修正平均场中的伪初态依赖，并捕捉平均场中缺失的新时间尺度，适用于更广泛的量子光学体系。
authors: Anqi Mu, Nathan Ng, Andrew J. Millis, David R. Reichman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种基于密度矩阵的时间依赖投影算符形式主义，用于计算具有非马尔可夫局域浴和一对全相互作用体系的超越平均场动力学。这类模型概括了浸没在光学腔中的凝聚态系统的物理。我们将该方法与张量网络影响泛函结合，研究了零温下与非马尔可夫局域退相干浴耦合的 Dicke 模型动力学；在平均场极限下，该模型会发生超辐射相变。该方法修正了平均场动力学中出现的一个虚假的初态依赖性，并描述了平均场动力学中不存在的新时间尺度的出现。我们的形式主义基于密度矩阵，因此也适用于其他具有一对全相互作用、且处于有限温度下的量子光学系统。

articles.title: Steering topology distributions for unified generative design of architected metamaterials
articles.title_zh: 用于架构化超材料统一生成式设计的拓扑分布调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24777v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Architected metamaterials derive their functions from structure, creating vast opportunities to program physical responses through topology design. However, existing design methods are often tailored to individual design problems, making limited use of topology knowledge for effective and broadly applicable design as objectives, constraints, and physical functions change. Here we introduce Generative Topology Optimization (GenTO), a unified framework that turns a learned topology prior into a reusable design engine. GenTO trains a diffusion model on a large full-order topology dataset and then iteratively steers the resulting topology distribution toward task-specific high-performing regions using user-defined physical objectives and constraints. This shifts the object of optimization from a single structure to a task-adapted topology distribution. Across topology design problems spanning thermal extremization, multi-objective morphology control, property-targeted auxetic design, and vibration transmission design, GenTO reuses pretrained topology priors for heterogeneous tasks, preserves structural diversity, and reaches high-performing solutions supported by numerical benchmarks and experimental validation. These results establish reusable topology knowledge as a unified principle for effective and scalable architected metamaterial design.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出生成式拓扑优化框架GenTO，将学习得到的拓扑先验转化为可复用的设计引擎，用于架构化超材料的统一生成式设计。该方法先在大规模全阶拓扑数据集上训练扩散模型，再依据用户定义的物理目标与约束迭代调控拓扑分布，使优化对象从单一结构转向任务自适应的拓扑分布。作者在热学极值、多目标形貌控制、目标化负泊松比设计和振动传输设计等问题上验证了该框架的通用性与多样性保持能力。
authors: Haolin Li, Yuyang Miao, Menglei Li, Jinshuai Bai, Liyuan Wang, Xin Liu, Bo Gao, Jiantao Liu, Danilo Mandic, Zahra Sharif Khodaei, M. H. Aliabadi, Weiqiu Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 架构超材料的功能来源于其结构，这为通过拓扑设计来编程物理响应提供了广阔机会。然而，现有设计方法往往针对单一设计问题量身定制，难以在目标、约束和物理功能变化时有效而广泛地利用拓扑知识。本文提出生成式拓扑优化（GenTO），这是一个统一框架，可将学习到的拓扑先验转化为可复用的设计引擎。GenTO 首先在一个大规模全阶拓扑数据集上训练扩散模型，然后利用用户定义的物理目标和约束，迭代地将生成的拓扑分布引导到特定任务中的高性能区域。这将优化对象从单一结构转变为一个适应任务的拓扑分布。在涵盖热学极值、多目标形态控制、面向性质目标的负泊松比设计以及振动传递设计等一系列拓扑设计问题中，GenTO 复用了预训练的拓扑先验，保留了结构多样性，并在数值基准测试和实验验证支持下达到了高性能解。这些结果确立了可复用拓扑知识作为架构超材料高效且可扩展设计的统一原则。

articles.title: Dual-Level Atomic and Coordination Geometry Learning for Crystal Property Prediction Using Graph Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 用于晶体性质预测的双层次原子与配位几何学习图神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24818v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate prediction of crystal properties remains a key challenge in computational materials science. While graph neural networks (GNNs) such as CGCNN, MEGNet, ALIGNN, and SchNet have shown strong performance, they primarily represent crystals at the atomic level and implicitly learn local chemical environments through message passing. However, many material properties are governed by coordination polyhedra, the fundamental structural units formed by atoms and their neighboring atoms. To address this limitation, we propose the Coordination Polyhedron Graph Network (CPGN), a multi-scale GNN that jointly learns atomic, bond, and coordination-polyhedron representations. CPGN constructs three coupled graphs: an atom graph encoding elemental and bonding information, a line graph capturing angular interactions, and a coordination polyhedron graph describing Voronoi-derived local environments through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing relationships. Physically meaningful geometric descriptors are incorporated for each polyhedron, while an interleaved message-passing mechanism with bidirectional cross-attention enables effective information exchange across structural levels. Extensive evaluations on the Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, and QM9 benchmark datasets demonstrate that CPGN outperforms existing state-of-the-art GNN models. It achieves a formation-energy MAE of 0.060 eV/atom and a band-gap MAE of 0.292 eV on the Materials Project, while providing competitive multi-property prediction on JARVIS-DFT and superior HOMO prediction on QM9. The results highlight that explicit modeling of coordination polyhedra improves crystal representation learning and enables accurate, physically interpretable prediction of material properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对晶体性质预测中仅依赖原子级表示的局限，提出协调多尺度信息的图神经网络模型CPGN。该模型同时学习原子图、线图以及由Voronoi构造的配位多面体图，从而联合表征元素信息、键合关系、角度相互作用与局域配位环境。通过交错消息传递与双向交叉注意力机制，模型能够更有效地融合不同尺度的结构信息，以提升晶体性质预测能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体性质的准确预测仍然是计算材料科学中的一项关键挑战。尽管CGCNN、MEGNet、ALIGNN和SchNet等图神经网络（GNN）表现强劲，但它们主要在原子层级表征晶体，并通过消息传递隐式学习局部化学环境。然而，许多材料性质由配位多面体所支配，配位多面体是由原子及其邻近原子构成的基本结构单元。为解决这一局限，我们提出配位多面体图网络（Coordination Polyhedron Graph Network, CPGN），这是一种多尺度GNN，可联合学习原子、键和配位多面体表征。CPGN构建了三个耦合图：编码元素与成键信息的原子图、捕捉角度相互作用的线图，以及通过顶点共享、边共享和面共享关系描述基于Voronoi划分的局域环境的配位多面体图。我们为每个多面体引入了具有物理意义的几何描述符，并采用交错式消息传递机制与双向交叉注意力，以实现不同结构层级之间的有效信息交换。在Materials Project、JARVIS-DFT和QM9基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，CPGN优于现有最先进的GNN模型。在Materials Project上，它实现了0.060 eV/atom的形成能MAE和0.292 eV的带隙MAE；在JARVIS-DFT上表现出有竞争力的多性质预测能力，并在QM9上实现了更优的HOMO预测。结果表明，对配位多面体进行显式建模能够改进晶体表征学习，并实现准确且具有物理可解释性的材料性质预测。

articles.title: Resolving Structure in Prethermal Floquet Dynamics with Precision Quantum Computation
articles.title_zh: 借助精密量子计算解析预热Floquet动力学中的结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24937v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Periodically driven interacting quantum many-body systems can exhibit long-lived prethermal dynamics, where local observables retain coherent structure even as entanglement and operator complexity grow. Accessing this regime at the system sizes and times needed to determine physical properties of the prethermal state remains a central challenge: state-of-the-art classical methods become unreliable, while noise in quantum hardware degrades observable expectation values. Here we overcome these limitations for a Floquet Ising magnet realized on a heavy-hex lattice. Using the advanced error mitigation software QESEM on an IBM Heron r3 superconducting quantum processor, we measure magnetization dynamics with percent-level precision and resolve long-lived subharmonic prethermal oscillations in systems of up to 74 qubits. These experiments reach regimes for which leading tensor-network simulations fail to converge, while sparse Pauli-path simulations remain strongly truncation dependent despite extensive computations on advanced GPUs and the Fugaku supercomputer. Leveraging this quantum-accessible regime, we extend finite-size scaling to larger systems and find an unexpectedly slow decrease of the oscillation amplitude with system size, providing strong evidence that this oscillatory response persists in the thermodynamic limit of heavy-hex ladders. A hierarchy of mitigation and validation tests, including unbiased error mitigation, agreement between independent mitigation estimators, noise-model validation on the superconducting hardware, and cross-platform corroboration at selected Floquet cycles on Quantinuum System Model H2 and Quantinuum Helios trapped-ion hardware, supports the reliability of these findings. Our work establishes error-mitigated quantum processors as quantitative scientific instruments for discovering new physics in non-equilibrium quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用超导量子处理器研究周期驱动多体系统中的预热动力学结构，旨在克服经典模拟在大系统与长时间尺度上的失效问题。作者借助先进误差缓解软件，在最多74个量子比特的Floquet Ising磁体中实现了高精度磁化测量，并解析出长期存在的次谐波预热振荡。结果表明，这一量子可达区域超出了前沿张量网络与稀疏Pauli路径方法的可靠范围，为预热线态的有限尺寸标度分析提供了实验基础。
authors: Eyal Leviatan, Tasneem Watad, Roy Perry, Lukas Broers, Mohammed Zuhair Mullath, Ori Alberton, Itai Arad, Yosi Atia, Eyal Bairey, Shaul Barkan, Matan Ben Dov, Asaf Berkovitch, Ewout van den Berg, Itsik Cohen, Omri Golan, Ilya Gurwich, Avieli Haber, Barak A. Katzir, Oded Kenneth, Roei Levi, Yotam Y. Lifshitz, Yaron Lukovsky, Ron Melcer, Adiel Meyer, Boris Muratov, Aviad Panahi, Gili Schul, Tali Shnaider, Maor Shutman, Alireza Seif, Tomonori Shirakawa, Asif Sinay, Vincent P. Su, Hayk Tepanyan, Omri Trebitch, Assaf Zubida, Dorit Aharonov, Hrant Gharibyan, Abhinav Kandala, Seiji Yunoki, Netanel H. Lindner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 周期驱动的相互作用量子多体系统可以展现长寿命的预热动力学，在该过程中，局域可观测量即使在纠缠和算符复杂度增长时仍保留相干结构。要在所需的系统尺度和时间尺度上获取预热态的物理性质，仍然是一个核心挑战：最先进的经典方法会变得不可靠，而量子硬件上的噪声会降低可观测量期望值的精度。这里，我们在由heavy-hex晶格实现的Floquet Ising磁体中克服了这些限制。借助IBM Heron r3超导量子处理器上的先进误差缓解软件QESEM，我们以百分比量级精度测量了磁化动力学，并在多达74个量子比特的系统中解析出长寿命的次谐波预热振荡。这些实验达到的参数区域，是领先的张量网络模拟无法收敛的区域，而稀疏Pauli-path模拟即便在先进GPU和Fugaku超级计算机上进行了大量计算，仍对截断极为敏感。利用这一量子可访问区域，我们将有限尺度标度分析扩展到更大的系统，并发现振荡幅度随系统尺寸增长而异常缓慢地减小，这为该振荡响应在heavy-hex梯形系统的热力学极限中仍将持续提供了强有力的证据。一套分层的误差缓解与验证测试，包括无偏误差缓解、不同缓解估计量之间的一致性、超导硬件上的噪声模型验证，以及在Quantinuum System Model H2和Quantinuum Helios离子阱硬件上对若干Floquet周期的跨平台相互印证，支持了这些发现的可靠性。我们的工作确立了经误差缓解的量子处理器作为发现非平衡量子物质中新物理的定量科学仪器。

articles.title: Interaction-Endowed PT-Symmetry and its Effects on Decoherence, Einselection, and Non-Markovianity in a Central Spin Model
articles.title_zh: 具有相互作用赋予的PT对称性及其对中心自旋模型中退相干、环境选择与非马尔可夫性的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25561v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We have introduced PT-symmetry to a central spin model by adding a PT-symmetric interaction with a tunable hermiticity parameter γ. Using the pseudo-Hermitian formalism, we applied a Dyson map to transform the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian to its Hermitian representation. We have found that the decoherence slows down as γ increases, eventually ceasing at γ=1. We define a pseudo-Hermitian observable that commutes with the metric operator to add as the self-Hamiltonian. Einselection gradually forced the system to select the eigenstates of the self-Hamiltonian as γi̊ghtarrow1. The steady-state purity of the central spin states in the strong environment regime exhibits a paradoxical decrease as γ increases. However, a turning point (minimum) corresponding to a maximum information dissipation to the spin bath is found. Finally, the Breuer-Laine-Piilo (BLP) measure, which is used to quantify the non-Markovianity of a quantum system, was evaluated for a finite time. The BLP measure in the strong environment regime exhibited similar turning point behavior, which means that the information backflow reaches a saturation point before declining. This decline signifies the point where PT-symmetry starts shielding the central spin from the environment.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在中心自旋模型中引入具有可调厄米参数的PT对称相互作用，并利用伪厄米形式主义及Dyson映射将非厄米哈密顿量转化为其厄米表象。作者发现，随着参数变化，退相干会减慢并在特定极限下趋于停止，同时环境选择过程逐渐偏向自哈密顿量的本征态。研究还考察了稳态纯度与BLP非马尔可夫性度量，表明信息耗散与信息回流都呈现出临界转折行为。
authors: Leoj Phoebe M. Esquierdo, Lemuel John F. Sese, Rayda P. Gammag
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过加入具有可调幺正性参数γ的PT对称相互作用，将PT对称性引入了中心自旋模型。采用伪厄米形式主义，我们应用Dyson映射将非厄米哈密顿量变换为其厄米表示。我们发现，随着γ增大，退相干速度变慢，并最终在γ=1时停止。我们定义了一个与度量算符对易的伪厄米可观测量，并将其作为自哈密顿量加入。随着γ趋近1，环境选择逐渐迫使系统选择该自哈密顿量的本征态。在强环境作用下，中心自旋态的稳态纯度随γ增大反而下降。尽管如此，我们发现了一个转折点（极小值），对应于向自旋浴最大的信息耗散。最后，我们在有限时间内评估了Breuer-Laine-Piilo（BLP）度量，该量用于量化量子系统的非马尔可夫性。在强环境作用下，BLP度量也表现出类似的转折行为，这意味着信息回流在下降之前达到了饱和点。该下降表明PT对称性开始屏蔽中心自旋与环境的相互作用。

articles.title: Discrete power-law decay of subsystem distance after a quantum quench
articles.title_zh: 量子淬火后子系统距离的离散幂律衰减
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25661v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a numerical study of subsystem distance decay following a global quantum quench in the infinite one-dimensional transverse-field Ising chain, using the mathematically rigorous Bures distance B_A(t) to quantify the deviation of the time-evolved reduced density matrix from its stationary generalized Gibbs ensemble state. We show that the late-time decay follows a discrete power law B_A(t) sim t⁻łambda, with the exponent łambda confined to discrete values: 1, 5/4, 3/2, 7/4, 2, 5/2, and potentially further values. The specific exponent is jointly determined by the pre- and post-quench transverse fields, as well as by properties of the symmetric excitation-fraction function m_S(ǎrphi), defined on ǎrphiin[0,π] to characterize the pre-quench Hamiltonian eigenstates, including continuity, boundary values, and first-derivative boundary values, among others. The previously established t⁻³/² decay for the initial ground state of the pre-quench Hamiltonian is naturally recovered as a special case of this general classification. Our results reveal a universal discrete structure governing local equilibration dynamics in integrable quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究无限长一维横场Ising链在全局量子淬火后的局域热化过程，使用Bures距离刻画时变约化密度矩阵与稳态广义Gibbs系综之间的偏离。数值结果显示，长时间极限下子系统距离遵循离散幂律衰减，指数仅取若干离散值。该指数由淬火前后横场参数以及激发分数函数的边界与光滑性性质共同决定，从而揭示了可积量子系统局域平衡动力学中的普适离散结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过数值研究了在无限一维横场伊辛链中进行全局量子淬火后，子系统距离的衰减。我们使用数学上严格的Bures距离B_A(t)来量化时间演化后的约化密度矩阵相对于其稳态广义Gibbs系综态的偏离。我们表明，长时间的衰减遵循离散幂律B_A(t)~t⁻λ，其中指数λ被限制在离散取值：1、5/4、3/2、7/4、2、5/2，以及可能还有更多取值。具体指数由淬火前后横场以及对称激发分数函数m_S(φ)的性质共同决定；m_S(φ)定义在φ∈[0,π]上，用于刻画淬火前哈密顿量的本征态，其相关性质包括连续性、边界值以及一阶导数的边界值等。对于淬火前哈密顿量的初始基态，先前已建立的t⁻³/²衰减可自然作为这一一般分类中的特例被恢复。我们的结果揭示了可积量子系统中局域平衡化动力学所遵循的一种普适离散结构。

articles.title: Landau Levels on the Surface of a Cube
articles.title_zh: 立方体表面的朗道能级
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25684v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the quantum mechanics of a charged particle confined to the surface of a cube enclosing a magnetic monopole. The magnetic field is chosen to have a constant magnitude on each face and to point along the outward normal, preserving the rotational symmetry of the cube. We formulate the continuum problem using two gauge patches on the cube surface and show that consistency of the wavefunction gives the Dirac quantization condition. Since an explicit vector potential does not remain invariant under ordinary rotations, we construct gauge-modified rotation operators and use them to classify the eigenstates. Even monopole charges are described by the irreducible representations of the cubic rotation group O, while odd monopole charges require the spinorial representations of the binary octahedral group 2O. We compute the spectrum with a gauge-covariant finite-difference discretization and find Landau-level-like manifolds whose degeneracies are split by the discrete cubic symmetry. We also study the corresponding tight-binding Hofstadter problem on the discretized cube. The resulting spectrum contains the usual magnetic subband structure together with additional gap states localized near the cube corners.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究带电粒子受限于包围磁单极子的立方体表面上的量子动力学。作者构造了立方体表面的双规范区描述，并证明波函数一致性导出Dirac量子化条件；同时通过引入规范修正的旋转算符，对本征态进行群论分类。数值结果显示，能谱呈现类似朗道能级的简并结构，但会因离散立方对称性而劈裂；此外，作者还考察了离散化立方体上的Hofstadter紧束缚问题。
authors: Almila Kura, Bayram Tekin, Mehmet Özgür Oktel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一个带电粒子被限制在包围一个磁单极子的立方体表面上的量子力学问题。磁场在每个面上被选取为具有恒定模长，并沿外法线方向指向，从而保持立方体的旋转对称性。我们使用立方体表面上的两个规范补丁来建立连续模型，并表明波函数的一致性给出了Dirac量子化条件。由于显式的矢势在普通旋转下并不保持不变，我们构造了带规范修正的旋转算符，并用它们对本征态进行分类。偶数磁单极荷由立方旋转群O的不可约表示描述，而奇数磁单极荷则需要二重八面体群2O的自旋表示。我们通过规范协变的有限差分离散化计算了能谱，并发现了类似朗道能级的能级群，其简并性被离散的立方对称性劈裂。我们还研究了在离散化立方体上的相应紧束缚Hofstadter问题。所得能谱包含通常的磁性子带结构，以及局域在立方体角附近的额外能隙态。

articles.title: Fractional diffusion without disorder in two dimensions
articles.title_zh: 二维无无序体系中的分数扩散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.00074v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyse how simple local constraints in two dimensions lead a defect to exhibit robust, non-transient, and tunable, subdiffusion. We uncover a rich dynamical phenomenology realised in ice- and dimer-type models. On the microscopic scale the path of a single defect exhibits anomalously long retractions, amounting to dynamical caging in a continuous-time random-walk framework, culminating in an effective fractional diffusion equation. Mapping to a height field yields an effective random walk subject to an emergent (entropic) logarithmic potential, whose strength is tunable, related to the exponent of algebraic ground-state correlations. The defect's path, viewed as non-equilibrium growth process, yields a frontier of fractal dimension of 5/4, the value for a loop-erased random walk, rather than 4/3 for simple and self-avoiding random walks. Such frustration/constraint-induced subdiffusion is expected to be relevant to platforms such as artificial spin ice and quantum simulators aiming to realize discrete link models and emergent gauge theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了二维体系中的简单局域约束如何使缺陷表现出稳健、非瞬态且可调的亚扩散行为。作者在冰模型和二聚体模型中揭示了丰富的动力学现象：在微观上，单个缺陷轨迹出现异常长的回撤，可在连续时间随机游走框架下理解为动力学笼困，并进一步导出有效的分数扩散方程。将其映射为高度场后，可得到受涌现的熵学对数势约束的随机游走，其强度与代数型基态关联函数的指数相关；同时，缺陷轨迹作为非平衡生长过程，其前沿分形维数为 5/4，符合环消除随机游走而非简单随机游走的特征。
authors: Nilotpal Chakraborty, Markus Heyl, Roderich Moessner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们分析了二维中的简单局域约束如何使一个缺陷表现出稳健、非瞬态且可调的亚扩散。我们在冰模型和二聚体模型中揭示了丰富的动力学现象。在微观尺度上，单个缺陷的路径表现出异常长的回撤，在连续时间随机游走框架下相当于动力学笼困，最终导致一个有效的分数扩散方程。将其映射到高度场后，可得到一个受涌现的（熵驱动的）对数势约束的有效随机游走，其强度是可调的，并与代数型基态关联函数的指数相关。将缺陷轨迹视为一个非平衡增长过程时，其前沿的分形维数为5/4，这一数值对应于消环随机游走，而不是简单随机游走和自避随机游走的4/3。预计这种由挫折/约束诱导的亚扩散与人工自旋冰以及旨在实现离散链模型和涌现规范理论的量子模拟器等平台相关。

articles.title: Searching for superconductivity in doped triangular lattice Kitaev magnets
articles.title_zh: 掺杂三角晶格 Kitaev 磁体中的超导性探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.16720v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by exploring correlated metals with frustrating bond-dependent exchange interactions, we study hole and electron doped Kitaev Mott insulators on the triangular lattice. Using homogeneous parton mean field theory, we find that the stripe antiferromagnetic (AFM) order for Kitaev coupling K>0 and the ferromagnetic (FM) order for K<0, both vanish at sufficiently large doping, beyond which we find regimes with chiral d± i d singlet pairing and p± ip triplet pairing respectively. Our tensor network computations however reveal that the superconducting correlations are strongly suppressed; while FM order stubbornly persists for the doped K<0 model, the doped K>0 model features emergent spin-charge modulated stripe orders. At higher hole doping for K > 0, where AFM order is more strongly suppressed than for the electron doped case, incorporating a sufficiently strong nearest-neighbor attraction yields evidence for singlet d-wave superconductivity with Luttinger parameter Kₘ̊ ₛc < 1. Our work sets the stage for a broader exploration of doping effects in triangular lattice magnets such as NaRuO₂ which feature bond-dependent exchange interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了三角晶格上 Kitaev 莫特绝缘体在空穴和电子掺杂下的配对不稳定性，动机在于探索具有挫折性、键依赖交换作用的相关金属。基于均匀 parton 平均场理论，作者发现当 Kitaev 耦合 K>0 时条纹反铁磁序、当 K<0 时铁磁序都会在足够高掺杂下消失，随后分别进入手性 d+id 单态配对和 p+ip 三重态配对区间。
authors: Andrew Hardy, Ryan Levy, Arun Paramekanti
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受探索具有挫折性键依赖交换相互作用的关联金属的动机启发，我们研究了三角晶格上的Kitaev Mott绝缘体在空穴和电子掺杂下的性质。使用均匀部分子平均场理论，我们发现，对于Kitaev耦合K>0时的条纹反铁磁（AFM）序，以及K<0时的铁磁（FM）序，它们都会在足够大的掺杂下消失；在此之后，我们分别在这些情形下找到了手性d±id单态配对和p±ip三重态配对的区间。然而，我们的张量网络计算表明超导关联被强烈抑制；尽管如此，掺杂后的K<0模型中的FM序顽固地持续存在，而掺杂后的K>0模型则表现出涌现的自旋-电荷调制条纹序。在更高的空穴掺杂下，对于K>0，反铁磁序相较于电子掺杂情形被更强烈地抑制；若引入足够强的最近邻吸引，则有证据支持单态d波超导，并且Luttinger参数Kₛc<1。我们的工作为更广泛地探索三角晶格磁体中的掺杂效应奠定了基础，例如具有键依赖交换相互作用的NaRuO₂等材料。

articles.title: Signatures of field-induced multi-color kagome spin liquids in the dipole-octupole pyrochlore Ce₂Hf₂O₇
articles.title_zh: Ce₂Hf₂O₇ 中场诱导多色 kagome 自旋液的信号
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.09189v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report low-temperature magnetization and magnetostriction measurements on the dipole-octupole pyrochlore Ce₂Hf₂O₇, revealing an unconventional field response for mathbf Bparallel[111]. The magnetization shows no kagome-ice plateau; instead it evolves continuously and exhibits two rapid changes in slope near 0.35~T and 1.2~T, accompanied by magnetostriction features at the same field scales. Classical Monte Carlo simulations, exact diagonalization, and ground-state analysis of the Hamiltonian show that a representative QSI-compatible parameter set captures the data. For this parameter set, the lower-field anomaly marks a closely spaced transition sequence from a two-color kagome spin liquid (KSL) through a narrow three-color KSL into a mixed two-/three-color KSL, while the upper-field anomaly marks the transition from the mixed KSL into a nearly polarized state. These results identify Ce₂Hf₂O₇, and dipole-octupole pyrochlore magnets more broadly, as promising platforms for exotic KSLs beyond conventional spin ice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对偶极-八极型 pyrochlore 磁体 Ce₂Hf₂O₇ 进行了低温磁化与磁致伸缩测量，揭示了当磁场沿 [111] 方向时异常的场响应。实验中未出现 kagome-ice 平台，而是表现为连续演化，并在约 0.35 T 和 1.2 T 附近出现两个明显的斜率变化，同时磁致伸缩也在相同磁场尺度上出现特征。经典蒙特卡洛、精确对角化和基态分析表明，一组与量子自旋冰相容的参数可很好解释数据：低场异常对应从双色 kagome 自旋液经窄三色 kagome 自旋液到双色/三色混合自旋液的连续转变，高场异常则对应混合态向近乎极化态的转变。
authors: Edwin Kermarrec, Daniel Lozano-Gómez, Chun-Jiong Huang, Guanyue Chen, Hiromu Okamoto, Jian Yan, Hikaru Takeda, Yusei Shimizu, Evan M. Smith, Avner Fitterman, Andrea D. Bianchi, Bruce D. Gaulin, Han Yan, Minoru Yamashita
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对偶极-八极型烧绿石Ce₂Hf₂O₇进行了低温磁化和磁致伸缩测量，揭示了当磁场沿mathbf B || [111]方向时一种非常规的场响应。磁化没有出现kagome-ice平台；相反，它是连续演化的，并在约0.35 T和1.2 T附近出现两个快速的斜率变化，同时磁致伸缩在相同的磁场尺度上也表现出特征。经典蒙特卡洛模拟、精确对角化以及哈密顿量的基态分析表明，一个代表性的、与量子自旋冰（QSI）相兼容的参数组能够刻画这些数据。对于这一参数组，较低场的异常标志着一个紧密相邻的转变序列：从两色kagome自旋液体（KSL）经过一个狭窄的三色KSL，再进入混合的二色/三色KSL；而较高场的异常则标志着从混合KSL到近乎极化态的转变。这些结果表明，Ce₂Hf₂O₇，以及更广泛的偶极-八极型烧绿石磁体，都是探索超越传统自旋冰的非常规KSL的有前景平台。

articles.title: Intrinsic Nernst Effect from Berry Curvature in Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 超导体中由贝里曲率产生的本征能斯特效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.26638v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Nernst effect in superconductors is typically linked to fluctuating Cooper pairs above T_c or vortex motion below T_c. We show instead that Berry curvature of Bogoliubov quasiparticles can generate an intrinsic Nernst response in a clean, vortex-free superconducting state. Focusing on two-dimensional systems with Ising spin-orbit coupling, relevant to transition-metal dichalcogenides, we identify two regimes: an intervalley s-wave paired state where a weak magnetic field activates the effect, and an intravalley chiral p-wave paired state that exhibits a spontaneous charge or spin Nernst response without a field. We propose an experimental setup that circumvents screening and provide estimates of the signal magnitude. Our results establish the Nernst effect as a direct probe of Berry curvature and pairing symmetry in two-dimensional spin-orbit-coupled superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 通常认为超导体中的能斯特效应来自临界温度以上的库珀对涨落或临界温度以下的涡旋运动。本文指出，在洁净、无涡旋的超导态中，Bogoliubov 准粒子的贝里曲率本身就可以产生本征能斯特响应。作者聚焦于具有伊辛自旋轨道耦合的二维体系：在谷间 s 波配对情形下，弱磁场即可激活该效应；在谷内手性 p 波配对情形下，则可在无外磁场时出现自发的电荷或自旋能斯特响应。
authors: Tzu-Chi Hsieh, Cong Xiao, Yi-Ting Hsu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导体中的能斯特效应通常与临界温度T_c以上的涨落库珀对，或T_c以下的涡旋运动相关。我们则表明，Bogoliubov准粒子的贝里曲率能够在干净、无涡旋的超导态中产生本征能斯特响应。我们聚焦于具有Ising自旋轨道耦合的二维体系，这类体系与过渡金属二硫族化物相关，并识别出两种情形：一种是谷间s波配对态，在弱磁场下会激活该效应；另一种是谷内手性p波配对态，可在无外场条件下表现出自发的电或自旋能斯特响应。我们提出了一个绕开屏蔽效应的实验方案，并估计了信号强度的量级。我们的结果将能斯特效应确立为探测二维自旋轨道耦合超导体中贝里曲率与配对对称性的直接手段。

articles.title: Conservation laws and chaos propagation in a non-reciprocal classical magnet
articles.title_zh: 非互易经典磁体中的守恒律与混沌传播
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.13873v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study a nonreciprocal generalization [EPL 60, 418 (2002)] of the classical Heisenberg spin chain, in which the exchange coupling is nonsymmetric, and show that it displays a ballistic spreading of chaos as measured by the decorrelator. We show that the interactions are reciprocal in terms of transformed variables, with conserved quantities that can be identified as magnetization and energy, with a Poisson-bracket algebra and Hamiltonian dynamics. For strictly antisymmetric couplings in the original model the conserved quantities diffuse, the decorrelator spreads symmetrically, and a simple hydrodynamic theory emerges. The general case in which the interaction has symmetric and antisymmetric parts presents complexities in the limit of large scales. Ballistic propagation of chaos survives the inclusion of interactions beyond nearest neighbours, but the conservation laws in general do not.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了经典海森堡自旋链的非互易推广模型，其中交换耦合是非对称的，并发现其通过混沌失相关函数表现出弹道式混沌传播。作者表明，在变换后的变量下该相互作用可写成互易形式，并可识别出磁化强度与能量等守恒量，同时满足泊松括号代数和哈密顿动力学。对于原模型中严格反对称的耦合，守恒量表现为扩散，失相关函数对称展开，从而可得到简洁的流体力学描述；而包含对称与反对称分量的一般情形在大尺度极限下则更为复杂。
authors: Nisarg Bhatt, Purnendu Das, Subroto Mukerjee, Sriram Ramaswamy
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了经典Heisenberg自旋链的一个非互易推广[European Physics Letters 60, 418 (2002)]，其中交换耦合是非对称的，并表明该模型表现出由decorrelator测量的混沌弹道传播。我们证明，在变换后的变量下，相互作用是互易的，并且可以识别出守恒量，即磁化和能量，它们满足泊松括号代数并具有哈密顿动力学。对于原始模型中严格反对称的耦合，这些守恒量表现为扩散，decorrelator对称地传播，并由此导出一个简单的流体动力学理论。一般情形下，若相互作用同时包含对称和反对称部分，在大尺度极限中会呈现复杂性。即使加入最近邻以外的相互作用，混沌的弹道传播仍然存在，但一般来说守恒律不再成立。

articles.title: Approaching Kasteleyn transition in frustrated quantum Heisenberg antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 挫折量子海森堡反铁磁体中趋近卡斯特莱因转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.14382v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that the Kasteleyn transition, the abrupt proliferation of infinite strings of defects in classical dimer and related models, can also be relevant for frustrated 2d quantum magnets. This is explicitly demonstrated in a phase of the spin-1/2 Heisenberg diamond-decorated honeycomb lattice where a family of exact eigenstates built as products of dimer and plaquette singlets can be mapped onto the dimer coverings of the honeycomb lattice. The low-temperature properties of this phase are accurately described by an effective dimer model with anisotropic activities and a small, tunable density of monomers, leading to an arbitrarily sharp crossover version of the Kasteleyn transition. The generalization to other geometries and the possibility to realize this model in organo-metallic compounds are briefly discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，经典二聚体模型及相关体系中的卡斯特莱因转变，即缺陷无限长串的突发增殖，也可在挫折二维量子磁体中发挥重要作用。作者以自旋 1/2 海森堡菱形装饰蜂窝晶格为例，展示了一类由二聚体与plaquette单态乘积构成的精确本征态，可映射到蜂窝晶格的二聚体覆盖问题。该相的低温性质可由具有各向异性活度和少量、可调单体缺陷的有效二聚体模型准确描述，从而实现一种可任意变尖锐的卡斯特莱因转变式交叉行为。
authors: Katarina Karlova, Afonso Rufino, Taras Verkholyak, Nils Caci, Stefan Wessel, Jozef Strecka, Frederic Mila, Andreas Honecker
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，Kasteleyn转变——即经典二聚体和相关模型中缺陷无限长条纹的突发式增殖——也可以与受挫二维量子磁体相关。这一点在自旋1/2 Heisenberg金刚石装饰蜂窝晶格的一个相中得到了明确展示：其中一族由二聚单态和plaquette单态构成乘积态的精确本征态，可以映射到蜂窝晶格的二聚体覆盖。该相的低温性质可以由一个具有各向异性活动度并带有少量、可调单体密度的有效二聚体模型准确描述，从而得到一个可以任意尖锐化的Kasteleyn转变交叉版本。文末简要讨论了这一模型向其他几何结构的推广，以及在有机金属化合物中实现该模型的可能性。

articles.title: Noise-Assisted Metastability: From Lévy Flights to Memristors, Quantum Escape, and Josephson-based Axion Searches
articles.title_zh: 噪声辅助的亚稳性：从 Lévy 飞行到忆阻器、量子逃逸与基于约瑟夫森的轴子搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.22635v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many-body and complex systems, both classical and quantum, often exhibit slow, nonlinear relaxation toward stationary states due to the presence of metastable configurations and environmental fluctuations. Nonlinear relaxation in a wide variety of natural systems proceeds through metastable states, which arise in condensed-matter physics as well as in fields ranging from cosmology and biology to high-energy physics. Moreover, noise-induced phenomena play a central role in shaping the dynamics of such systems far from equilibrium. This review develops a unifying perspective centered on noise-assisted stabilization and the statistical properties of metastable dynamics. We first discuss escape processes driven by Lévy flights in smooth metastable potentials, emphasizing the emergence of nonmonotonic residence-time behavior. We then connect these concepts to stochastic resistive switching in memristive devices, where noise-induced effects can enhance stability and reproducibility. We further examine driven dissipative quantum bistability, showing how the interplay between external driving and system-environment coupling reshapes escape pathways and lifetimes. Finally, we outline how switching-time statistics in current-biased Josephson junctions can provide an experimentally accessible strategy for axion detection, based on an axion-induced resonant-activation signature.
articles.abstract_zh: 这是一篇综述，旨在从统一视角讨论噪声辅助稳定与亚稳态动力学的统计性质。作者首先回顾了由 Lévy 飞行驱动的势阱逃逸过程，强调其驻留时间呈现的非单调行为；随后将这些思想联系到忆阻器中的随机电阻开关，说明噪声诱导效应可提升器件稳定性与可重复性。文章还进一步讨论受驱耗散量子双稳态及其逃逸机制，并将相关框架延伸到更广泛的噪声驱动复杂系统与应用场景。
authors: Claudio Guarcello, Alexander A. Dubkov, Davide Valenti, Bernardo Spagnolo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多体和复杂系统，无论经典还是量子，常常由于亚稳态构型和环境涨落的存在而表现出缓慢、非线性的向稳态弛豫。自然界中广泛存在的非线性弛豫往往通过亚稳态来进行，这些亚稳态既出现在凝聚态物理中，也出现在从宇宙学和生物学到高能物理的诸多领域。此外，噪声诱导现象在塑造这些系统远离平衡时的动力学中起着核心作用。本文综述以噪声辅助稳定及亚稳态动力学的统计性质为中心，发展了一个统一视角。我们首先讨论由Lévy飞行驱动的、发生在光滑亚稳势中的逃逸过程，强调驻留时间行为中出现的非单调性。随后，我们将这些概念联系到忆阻器件中的随机电阻开关，其中噪声诱导效应可以增强稳定性和可重复性。我们进一步考察受驱耗散量子双稳态，说明外部驱动与系统-环境耦合之间的相互作用如何重塑逃逸路径和寿命。最后，我们概述了电流偏置约瑟夫森结中的切换时间统计如何为轴子探测提供一种实验上可实现的策略，其依据是由轴子诱导的共振激活信号特征。

articles.title: In situ Gas-Cell Electron Microscopy Reveals Pressure-Selected Restructuring Pathways in AuRu Ammonia Catalysts
articles.title_zh: 原位气体池电子显微镜揭示 AuRu 氨合成催化剂中压力选择性的重构路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.00433v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bimetallic catalysts provide new routes toward sustainable ammonia synthesis, but the nanoscale structural dynamics under reaction-relevant conditions remain poorly understood. Here, we combine in situ gas-cell and multimodal electron microscopy to determine how temperature, gas pressure, and chemistry select among distinct restructuring pathways in AuRu nanocrystal catalysts. Initially, the AuRu nanocrystals form polycrystalline face-centered cubic (FCC) alloys with Au/Ru intermixing. Elevated temperature (≥ 350~ⁱ̧rcC) induces intraparticle phase segregation into distinct Au-rich (FCC) and Ru-rich hexagonal close-packed (HCP) domains that exhibit localized plasmonic modes. Atmospheric-pressure 3:1 H₂:N₂ gas unlocks a distinct restructuring regime absent at lower pressures, characterized by pronounced faceting and nanovoid formation. Systematic gas variation identifies hydrogen as the dominant driver. Density functional theory-trained machine-learning interatomic potentials and grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations reveal that H-Ru interactions enhance the Au/Ru diffusivity mismatch, promoting vacancy accumulation and nanovoid formation. Together, these results show that, rather than simply accelerating the thermally driven phase segregation observed at lower pressures, atmospheric-pressure H₂:N₂ gas redirects restructuring toward faceting and nanovoid formation through a gas-mediated Kirkendall-type mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合原位气体池电子显微镜和多模态电子显微镜，研究了温度、气体压力与气氛化学如何选择 AuRu 纳米晶催化剂在反应条件下的不同重构路径。初始样品为 Au/Ru 互混的多晶面心立方合金；当温度升高到约 350°C 以上时，体系发生颗粒内部相分离，形成 Au 富集的 FCC 相与 Ru 富集的 HCP 相，并伴随局域等离激元模态。进一步在常压 3:1 H₂:N₂ 条件下，样品进入不同于低压条件的重构机制，表现出明显的晶面化与纳米空洞形成；理论计算则表明，氢与 Ru 的相互作用会放大 Au/Ru 扩散率失配，从而促进空位积累和纳米空洞生成。
authors: Amy S. McKeown-Green, Parivash Moradifar, Zisheng Zhang, Cedric Lim, Andrew Barnum, Lin Yuan, Robert Sinclair, Frank Abild-Pedersen, Colin Ophus, Jennifer A. Dionne
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双金属催化剂为可持续氨合成提供了新的途径，但在反应相关条件下其纳米尺度结构动力学仍知之甚少。在这里，我们结合原位气体池和多模态电子显微术，以确定温度、气体压力和化学环境如何在 AuRu 纳米晶催化剂中选择不同的重构路径。最初，AuRu 纳米晶形成具有 Au/Ru 互混的多晶面心立方（FCC）合金。升高温度（≥350 °C）会诱导颗粒内部相分离，形成不同的富 Au（FCC）和富 Ru 六方密堆积（HCP）畴，这些畴表现出局域等离激元模式。常压 3:1 H₂:N₂ 气体开启了一种在较低压力下不存在的独特重构机制，其特征是显著的晶面化和纳米空洞形成。系统的气体变化实验确定氢是主导驱动因素。由密度泛函理论训练的机器学习原子间势和巨正则蒙特卡洛模拟表明，H-Ru 相互作用增强了 Au/Ru 扩散率失配，促进空位积累和纳米空洞形成。总之，这些结果表明，常压 H₂:N₂ 气体并非仅仅加速较低压力下观察到的热驱动相分离，而是通过气体介导的 Kirkendall 型机制，将重构路径转向晶面化和纳米空洞形成。

articles.title: Region-Resolved Interface Descriptors in III-nitride-nanocluster photocatalysts
articles.title_zh: III族氮化物-纳米团簇光催化体系中的区域分辨界面描述符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.08113v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding how nanocluster cocatalysts modify the electronic structure of III-nitride surfaces is central to the rational design of efficient photocatalytic interfaces. Here, we introduce a region-resolved first-principles framework for analyzing GaN-, InGaN-, and ScGaN-based slabs decorated with six-atom elemental nanoclusters. Using a region-resolved projected local density of states (PLDOS) analysis, we separate electronic response of nanocluster-covered regions from that of uncovered semiconductor surface regions, revealing that semiconductor--nanocluster interfaces behave as laterally heterogeneous systems. In this picture, nanocluster-covered regions are associated with local band bending, charge injection, and nanocluster-induced gap states, whereas uncovered nitride regions retain surface-localized states and in-plane dipoles that may influence adsorbate interactions and water-activation pathways. These distinct regional responses motivate the definition of region-resolved interface descriptors, which are further integrated into an Interface Score: a physics-informed comparative metric that combines injection, activation, and interfacial-coupling contributions to rank heterogeneous model interfaces on a common descriptor basis. Machine-learning models trained on global and region-resolved descriptors are used primarily as interpretability tools to assess their correlation with single-H adsorption energetics. The results show that spatially averaged descriptors capture broad adsorption-energy trends, while region-resolved descriptors expose complementary local information related to interfacial electrostatics and charge separation. Together, this work establishes a descriptor framework for moving beyond spatially averaged electronic-structure analysis and for bridging first-principles calculations with experimental interpretation of heterogeneous photocatalytic interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种区域分辨的第一性原理分析框架，用于研究负载六原子元素纳米团簇的 GaN、InGaN 和 ScGaN 薄片中的电子结构调制。通过区域分辨的投影局域态密度分析，作者将纳米团簇覆盖区域与未覆盖半导体表面的电子响应区分开来，揭示半导体—纳米团簇界面具有明显的横向非均匀性。结果表明，覆盖区域主要表现为局域能带弯曲、电荷注入和纳米团簇诱导的带隙态，而未覆盖区域则保留表面局域态及面内偶极，这些特征可能影响吸附体相互作用与水活化过程。
authors: Shuaishuai Yuan, Gunther G. Andersson, Gregory F. Metha, Zetian Mi, Hong Guo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解纳米团簇助催化剂如何改变 III 族氮化物表面的电子结构，是合理设计高效光催化界面的核心。在这里，我们引入一种区域分辨的第一性原理框架，用于分析装饰有六原子元素纳米团簇的 GaN、InGaN 和 ScGaN 基薄片。利用区域分辨的投影局域态密度（PLDOS）分析，我们将纳米团簇覆盖区域的电子响应与未覆盖半导体表面区域的电子响应分离开来，揭示出半导体—纳米团簇界面表现为横向非均匀系统。在这一图像中，纳米团簇覆盖区域与局域能带弯曲、电荷注入和纳米团簇诱导的带隙态相关，而未覆盖的氮化物区域则保留表面局域态和平面内偶极，这些可能影响吸附物相互作用和水活化路径。这些不同的区域响应促使我们定义区域分辨界面描述符，并进一步将其整合为 Interface Score：这是一种基于物理的比较性度量，将注入、活化和界面耦合贡献结合起来，以在共同的描述符基础上对异质模型界面进行排序。基于全局和区域分辨描述符训练的机器学习模型主要被用作可解释性工具，以评估它们与单氢吸附能量学之间的相关性。结果表明，空间平均描述符能够捕捉吸附能的总体趋势，而区域分辨描述符揭示了与界面静电和电荷分离有关的互补局域信息。总体而言，这项工作建立了一种描述符框架，用于超越空间平均的电子结构分析，并在第一性原理计算与异质光催化界面的实验解释之间架起桥梁。

articles.title: Anisotropic magnons in a layered honeycomb ferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 层状蜂窝铁磁体中的各向异性磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.19935v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent experimental and theoretical studies have suggested a possible Dirac magnon gap in the two-dimensional ferromagnetic semiconductor CrSiTe₃. Detailed neutron scattering measurements were performed to shed light on the existence of the magnon gap, and suggest that the gap is very small or non-existent, with previous measurements being complicated by experimental factors. During these measurements, it was found that the out-of-plane couplings could explain the usual property of the increase in the magnetic transition temperature when CrSiTe₃ is exfoliated to monolayers. Furthermore, the material was shown to have anisotropic magnons along the out-of-plane direction, through the proposed Dirac point. We speculate that this is due to an exchange anisotropy, though Kitaev-like interactions alone cannot explain the spectra.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过详细的中子散射测量，重新审视二维铁磁半导体 CrSiTe₃ 中可能存在的 Dirac 磁振子能隙。结果表明，该能隙极小甚至可能不存在，先前相关测量中的异常很可能由实验因素所致。作者还发现，面外方向的耦合可以解释该材料在剥离成单层后磁相变温度升高的常见现象，并且磁振子在穿过所提出的 Dirac 点时沿面外方向呈现各向异性。
authors: Travis J. Williams, Douglas L. Abernathy, Mark D. Lumsden, Jiaqiang Yan, Andrew D. Christianson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期实验和理论研究提出，二维铁磁半导体 CrSiTe₃ 中可能存在 Dirac 磁振子能隙。为阐明该磁振子能隙是否存在，研究人员进行了详细的中子散射测量，并指出该能隙非常小或并不存在，先前测量受到实验因素的复杂影响。在这些测量过程中发现，面外耦合可以解释 CrSiTe₃ 被剥离为单层时磁转变温度升高这一通常特性。此外，通过所提出的 Dirac 点，该材料被证明沿面外方向具有各向异性磁振子。我们推测这是由于交换各向异性所致，尽管仅靠 Kitaev 型相互作用无法解释这些谱。

articles.title: Finite-momentum superconductivity with singlet-triplet mixing in an altermagnetic metal: A pairing instability analysis
articles.title_zh: 交替磁金属中具有单重-三重混合的有限动量超导：配对不稳定性分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.12897v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyze the pairing instability of an altermagnetic metal on a square lattice driven by an attractive nearest-neighbor interaction. This interaction enables multiple pairing channels, including even-parity extended s-wave and d-wave states, as well as two odd-parity p-wave channels. We verify that altermagnetic spin-splitting in the single-particle dispersion gives rise to finite-momentum pairing between electrons with unlike spins, in agreement with earlier predictions. Quite unexpectedly, this pairing typically emerges across multiple channels with mixed parity. Consequently, the resulting finite-momentum Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) superconducting phase is expected to exhibit a multi-component order parameter featuring singlet-triplet mixing. We examine several forms of altermagnetism, specifically dₓy-wave and dₓ²-y²-wave altermagnetic couplings, and present the corresponding phase diagrams. Additionally, we study triplet pairing between electrons with identical spins and find that it always occurs at zero center-of-mass momentum. Although it is unfavorable in the regime of weak altermagnetic coupling and low electron filling, it can dominate the phase diagram when the altermagnetic coupling is sufficiently strong. The influence of on-site attractive interactions on mixed-parity pairing is also explored.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了方格子上交替磁金属在最近邻吸引相互作用驱动下的配对不稳定性。该相互作用允许多种配对通道，包括偶宇称的扩展 s 波与 d 波态，以及两种奇宇称 p 波通道；作者验证了交替磁的单粒子能谱劈裂会导致不同自旋电子之间的有限动量配对。更出人意料的是，这种配对往往跨越多个通道并伴随宇称混合，因此所得有限动量 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov 超导态预计具有多分量序参量，并体现单重态与三重态混合。
authors: Hui Hu, Zhao Liu, Jia Wang, Xia-Ji Liu, Yoji Ohashi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们分析了平方晶格上由吸引性最近邻相互作用驱动的交替磁性金属的配对不稳定性。这种相互作用允许多个配对通道，包括偶宇称的扩展 s 波和 d 波态，以及两个奇宇称 p 波通道。我们验证了单粒子色散中的交替磁自旋劈裂会在自旋不同的电子之间产生有限动量配对，这与早期预测一致。相当出人意料的是，这种配对通常会在具有混合宇称的多个通道中出现。因此，所得有限动量 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov（FFLO）超导相预计将表现出具有单重态—三重态混合的多分量序参量。我们考察了几种交替磁性的形式，特别是 dₓy 波和 dₓ²-y² 波交替磁耦合，并给出了相应的相图。此外，我们研究了自旋相同电子之间的三重态配对，发现其总是在零质心动量下发生。尽管在弱交替磁耦合和低电子填充区域它是不利的，但当交替磁耦合足够强时，它可以主导相图。我们还探讨了在位吸引相互作用对混合宇称配对的影响。

articles.title: Anomalous transport in U(1)-symmetric quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: U(1) 对称量子电路中的反常输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.14357v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this work we investigate discrete-time transport in a generic U(1)-symmetric disordered model tuned across an array of different dynamical regimes. We develop an aggregate quantity, a circular statistical moment, which is a simple function of the magnetization profile and which elegantly captures transport properties of the system. From this quantity we extract transport exponents, revealing behaviors across the phase diagram consistent with localized, diffusive, and - most interestingly for a disordered system - superdiffusive regimes. Investigation of this superdiffusive regime reveals the existence of a prethermal "swappy" regime unique to discrete-time systems in which excitations propagate coherently; even in the presence of strong disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个具有 U(1) 对称性的无序离散时间模型中的输运行为，并跨越多种动力学区间进行分析。作者构造了一个圆统计矩作为汇总量，它是磁化分布的简单函数，却能有效表征系统的输运性质，并据此提取输运指数。结果显示，该模型在相图中呈现局域、扩散以及尤其值得注意的超扩散行为；进一步分析表明，这种超扩散对应于离散时间系统中特有的预热化“swappy”区间，其中即便在强无序下激发仍可相干传播。
authors: Alessandro Summer, Alex Nico-Katz, Shane Dooley, John Goold
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们研究了一种通用 U(1) 对称无序模型中的离散时间输运，该模型被调控跨越一系列不同的动力学区域。我们发展了一个聚合量，即一个圆统计矩；它是磁化强度分布的简单函数，并能优雅地捕捉系统的输运性质。我们从该量中提取输运指数，揭示出整个相图中与局域化、扩散以及——对于无序系统而言最有趣的——超扩散区域相一致的行为。对这一超扩散区域的研究揭示了离散时间系统所特有的预热化“swappy”区域的存在，在该区域中，即使存在强无序，激发也会相干传播。

articles.title: Towards real-time surrogate-free Bayesian inversion for neutron reflectometry
articles.title_zh: 面向中子反射率测量的实时无替代模型贝叶斯反演
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.06924v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Neutron reflectometry (NR) is a key enabling technology for many areas of scientific development. Although the forward reflectivity model is well-known, inferring the physical properties of a sample from NR data requires the solution of an inverse problem. Increasingly, beamline scientists are using NR in fast kinetic configurations and probing highly-complex structures and interfaces, introducing significant uncertainty. Existing uncertainty quantification (UQ) approaches in NR, such as Markov-Chain Monte-Carlo (MCMC), suffer from poor sample efficiency and slow convergence times. Recently, surrogate machine learning models have been proposed as an alternative. However, physical intuition is lost when replacing governing equations with fast surrogates. Instead, we propose a rapid, surrogate-free Bayesian inversion for NR. Our approach offers a step-change in inference speed and efficiency. For the first time in NR, exact gradients through the reflectivity are computed, enabling highly performant gradient-based inference schemes: Hamiltonian Monte-Carlo offers significant advances in sample efficiency compared to MCMC. Variational inference enables approximate UQ on the order of seconds rather than hours. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on a thick oxide quartz film, and robust co-fitting performance in the high complexity regime of organic LED multilayer devices. Additionally, we provide an open-source library of reflectometry kernels in the python language.
articles.abstract_zh: 中子反射率的正问题模型虽已成熟，但从实验数据反推出样品物理参数仍是一个困难的逆问题。本文提出一种不依赖机器学习替代模型的快速贝叶斯反演方法，并首次在该领域实现了通过反射率的精确梯度计算，从而支持高效的梯度型推断。与传统 MCMC 相比，Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 在采样效率和速度上都有明显提升。
authors: Max D. Champneys, Andrew J. Parnell, Philipp Gutfreund, Maximilian W. A. Skoda, Patrick A. Fairclough, Timothy J. Rogers, Stephanie L. Burg
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中子反射ometry（NR）是许多科学发展领域的一项关键使能技术。尽管正向反射率模型已广为人知，但从 NR 数据推断样品的物理性质需要求解一个反问题。越来越多的束线科学家正在快速动力学配置中使用 NR，并探测高度复杂的结构和界面，从而引入显著不确定性。NR 中现有的不确定性量化（UQ）方法，如马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC），存在采样效率低和收敛时间长的问题。近来，替代机器学习模型被提出作为一种替代方案。然而，当用快速替代模型取代支配方程时，物理直觉会丧失。相反，我们提出一种用于 NR 的快速、无替代模型贝叶斯反演方法。我们的方法在推断速度和效率方面带来了阶跃式提升。首次在 NR 中计算穿过反射率的精确梯度，从而实现高性能的基于梯度的推断方案：与 MCMC 相比，哈密顿蒙特卡洛在采样效率方面取得显著进展。变分推断使近似 UQ 能够在数秒量级而非数小时量级完成。我们在厚氧化石英薄膜上展示了最先进的性能，并在有机 LED 多层器件的高复杂度区域中展示了稳健的共拟合性能。此外，我们提供了一个用 Python 语言编写的开源反射ometry核库。

articles.title: Enhancement of Weak Interactions in Phase Transitions in Condensed Matter and Early Universe
articles.title_zh: 凝聚态与早期宇宙相变中弱相互作用的增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.14701v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Parity-violating weak interactions produce extremely small energy differences between left- and right-handed chiral systems. We show that these microscopic effects may be strongly amplified during collective phenomena such as phase transitions. The enhancement factor is proportional to the critical number of atoms, N_c, in the nucleus of the new phase. After the nucleus reaches its critical size, it grows until it fills the entire system. Measurement of the ratio of produced left and right chiral structures may provide a way to measure this critical number N_c. Experiments where definite spin-chiral structures are formed during a phase transition in crossed electric and magnetic fields, indicate N_c sim 10⁹ - 10¹⁰. An open question is whether a similar enhancement could operate during cosmological phase transitions - thereby boosting CP-violating effects sufficiently to contribute to the observed baryon-to-photon ratio.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，宇称破坏的弱相互作用虽然在微观尺度上极弱，但在相变等集体过程里可能被显著放大。其增强因子与新相核的临界原子数有关，达到临界后结构会继续增长并充满整个系统。作者还讨论了在电磁场交叉条件下的实验结果及其对早期宇宙 CP 破坏和重子不对称起源的潜在意义。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 宇称破缺弱相互作用会在左手和右手手性体系之间产生极其微小的能量差。我们表明，这些微观效应可能在相变等集体现象中被强烈放大。增强因子与新相核心中的临界原子数 Nc 成正比。在核心达到其临界尺寸之后，它会继续生长，直到充满整个系统。测量所产生的左手和右手手性结构的比例，可能提供一种测量该临界数 Nc 的方法。在交叉电场和磁场中于相变期间形成确定自旋—手性结构的实验表明，Nc 约为 10⁹–10¹⁰。一个开放问题是，类似的增强是否可能在宇宙学相变期间起作用，从而将 CP 破缺效应提升到足以对观测到的重子—光子比作出贡献的程度。

articles.title: Establishing the Magnetoelastic Origin of Spin-Wave Routing through Focused Ion Beam Patterning
articles.title_zh: 通过聚焦离子束图案化确立自旋波导向的磁弹性起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.10797v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Spin waves are promising information carriers for analog and wave-based computing, where functionality relies on compact and precisely engineered scattering landscapes. Focused ion beam (FIB) irradiation enables such control by locally tailoring the spin-wave dispersion in yttrium iron garnet (YIG). However, a non-monotonic dependence of the spin-wave wavelength on increasing ion dose hinders predictive landscape design. Here, we present an experimentally validated framework that explains this non-monotonic spin-wave steering by linking phenomenological strain-induced anisotropy to its magnetoelastic origin. Irradiation-induced lattice dislocations drive elastic and plastic deformation, which evolve into partial amorphization, each stage contributing distinctly to the dispersion behavior. We combine post-irradiation wet-chemical etching and atomic force microscopy (AFM) to quantify thickness changes, and track the dispersion in etched regions using time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr effect (trMOKE) microscopy. Fitting the data to the Kalinikos--Slavin formalism with an added effective magnetoelastic field isolates contributions from elastic and plastic deformation. Validation is achieved by mapping the deformation evolution onto a three-phase scenario based on SRIM simulations, reproducing the extracted field trends, and by consistent strain tensor and micromagnetic analyses. These results establish a physical basis for FIB-engineered graded-index (GRIN) spin-wave landscapes and magnetoelastically programmable magnonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚焦离子束照射可在钇铁石榴石中局域调控自旋波色散，但自旋波波长随剂量呈非单调变化，限制了可预测设计。本文提出并实验验证了一个将应变诱导各向异性与磁弹性起源联系起来的框架，解释了这种非单调的传播调控。作者结合腐蚀、原子力显微镜和时序磁光克尔显微镜测量，分离了离子辐照引起的不同结构演化阶段对色散的贡献。
authors: Felix Naunheimer, Johannes Greil, Valentin Ahrens, Levente Maucha, Ádám Papp, György Csaba, Markus Becherer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋波是模拟计算和基于波的计算中有前景的信息载体，其功能依赖于紧凑且精确工程化的散射景观。聚焦离子束（FIB）辐照能够通过在钇铁石榴石（YIG）中局域调控自旋波色散来实现这种控制。然而，自旋波波长随离子剂量增加呈非单调依赖关系，这阻碍了可预测的景观设计。在这里，我们提出一个经实验验证的框架，通过将现象学的应变诱导各向异性与其磁弹性起源相联系，来解释这种非单调自旋波转向。辐照诱导的晶格位错驱动弹性和塑性形变，并进一步演化为部分非晶化，每一阶段都对色散行为作出不同贡献。我们结合辐照后的湿化学蚀刻和原子力显微镜（AFM）来量化厚度变化，并利用时间分辨磁光 Kerr 效应（trMOKE）显微术跟踪蚀刻区域中的色散。通过将数据拟合到加入有效磁弹性场的 Kalinikos–Slavin 形式，我们分离出弹性和塑性形变的贡献。验证工作通过以下方式实现：基于 SRIM 模拟将形变演化映射到三相情景，重现实验提取的场趋势，并通过一致的应变张量和微磁分析加以支持。这些结果为 FIB 工程化梯度折射率（GRIN）自旋波景观和磁弹性可编程磁振子器件建立了物理基础。

articles.title: Long-Lived Mechanically-Detected Molecular Spins for Quantum Sensing
articles.title_zh: 用于量子传感的长寿命机械探测分子自旋
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.04708v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum sensors based on individual spins provide unprecedented access to local magnetic fields in condensed matter, chemistry, and biology, with solid-state defect spins emerging as the leading platform. However, their molecular-sensing capabilities are limited by confinement to a host lattice, which prevents placement in close proximity to a target molecule. Molecular spins offer an alternative, enabling chemical tunability and flexible positioning relative to the target system. Here we present a nanoscale sensing platform that combines molecular electron spins, ultrasensitive mechanical readout, and Hamiltonian engineering. Using a modified XYXY dipolar decoupling sequence, we suppress electron-electron dipolar interactions across a broad distribution of control fields, extending coherence times to sim 400~μs in an attoliter-scale droplet containing sim100 trityl-OX063 radicals. Leveraging this sequence, we demonstrate frequency-selective detection of nanotesla-scale AC fields and perform sensing and spectroscopy of small, local nuclear-spin ensembles. Collectively, these results establish SQUINT (Spin-based QUantum Integrated Nanomechanical Transduction) as a framework for quantum sensing that affords molecular-level control over sensor properties and enables direct integration into complex molecular targets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种结合分子电子自旋、超灵敏机械读出和哈密顿量工程的纳米级传感平台。通过改进的 XYXY 偶极去耦序列，作者抑制了宽分布控制场下的电子-电子偶极相互作用，将含约百个三苯基自由基的飞升级液滴中的相干时间延长到约 400 微秒。借助该序列，系统可选择性探测纳特斯拉级交流磁场，并实现对局域核自旋小系综的传感与谱学分析。
authors: Sahand Tabatabaei, Pritam Priyadarsi, Daniel Tay, Namanish Singh, Pardis Sahafi, Andrew Jordan, Raffi Budakian
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于单个自旋的量子传感器为凝聚态物质、化学和生物学中的局域磁场提供了前所未有的访问能力，其中固态缺陷自旋正成为领先平台。然而，它们的分子传感能力受到其被限制在宿主晶格中的制约，这阻止了它们被放置到与目标分子非常接近的位置。分子自旋提供了一种替代方案，能够实现化学可调性，并可相对于目标系统进行灵活定位。在这里，我们提出一种纳米尺度传感平台，它结合了分子电子自旋、超灵敏机械读出和哈密顿量工程。利用一种改进的 XYXY 偶极去耦序列，我们在广泛的控制场分布下抑制电子—电子偶极相互作用，将含有约 100 个 trityl-OX063 自由基的阿升级液滴中的相干时间延长到约 400 μs。借助这一序列，我们展示了对纳特斯拉量级交流场的频率选择性探测，并对小型局域核自旋系综进行了传感和光谱测量。总体而言，这些结果确立了 SQUINT（基于自旋的量子集成纳米机械换能）作为一种量子传感框架，该框架能够对传感器性质进行分子层面的控制，并可直接集成到复杂分子目标中。

articles.title: Collective attention under digital exposure: A dynamical systems approach
articles.title_zh: 数字暴露下的集体注意力：一种动力系统方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.02059v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The widespread use of digital devices has raised growing concerns about its impact on sustained attention at the population level. In this work, we propose a minimal dynamical framework to describe the collective evolution of attention under continuous exposure to screen-mediated environments. We introduce a macroscopic variable representing the population-level sustained attention and model its dynamics as the result of competing mechanisms: intrinsic cognitive recovery and degradation induced by digital stimulation. The digital environment is treated as an external control parameter that continuously perturbs the system, leading to a relaxational dynamics. The proposed mechanisms are consistent with empirical findings on attentional dynamics under digital exposure. We first analyze a linear formulation, which provides an analytically tractable baseline, and then extend the model by incorporating a nonlinear degradation term that captures amplification effects under high-intensity stimulation. We derive an explicit expression for the stationary state and show that the equilibrium attention level decreases monotonically with increasing exposure. An effective potential formulation is introduced, revealing that digital overstimulation progressively deforms the dynamical landscape, shifting the stable state toward regimes of reduced attention without generating multiple equilibria. Importantly, the model does not rely on social contagion or interaction-driven bistability, but instead describes a continuous displacement of the collective cognitive regime under environmental pressure. Our results suggest that the impact of digital technologies on attention may be understood as a gradual macroscopic effect emerging from persistent external stimulation, rather than as a transition between competing behavioral states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文用一个简洁的动力系统框架描述持续数字暴露下群体层面的注意力演化。模型将持续注意力视为宏观变量，并把内在恢复与数字刺激导致的退化机制纳入竞争关系中。作者推导了稳态表达式，表明随着数字刺激强度增加，平衡注意力水平单调下降。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数字设备的广泛使用引发了人们对其在群体层面影响持续注意力的日益关注。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个最小动力学框架，用于描述在持续暴露于屏幕媒介环境下注意力的集体演化。我们引入一个表示群体层面持续注意力的宏观变量，并将其动力学建模为相互竞争机制的结果：内在认知恢复以及由数字刺激诱发的退化。数字环境被视为一个外部控制参数，它持续扰动系统，从而导致弛豫动力学。所提出的机制与关于数字暴露下注意力动力学的经验发现相一致。我们首先分析一个线性形式，它提供了一个解析上可处理的基准，然后通过引入一个非线性退化项来扩展该模型，以捕捉高强度刺激下的放大效应。我们推导出稳态的显式表达式，并表明平衡注意力水平随着暴露增加而单调降低。我们引入了有效势表述，揭示数字过度刺激会逐步改变动力学景观，将稳定态推向注意力降低的区域，而不会产生多个平衡态。重要的是，该模型不依赖社会传染或相互作用驱动的双稳态，而是描述了在环境压力下集体认知状态的连续位移。我们的结果表明，数字技术对注意力的影响可以被理解为由持续外部刺激产生的渐进宏观效应，而不是竞争性行为状态之间的转变。

articles.title: Symmetry-Induced Relaxation Comb and Strong Quantum Mpemba Effect in Long-Range XXZ Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: 长程 XXZ 自旋链中的对称性诱导弛豫梳与强量子姆佩巴效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.20930v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We uncover a symmetry-filtered mechanism for anomalous dissipative relaxation in a long-range XXZ spin chain subject to local dephasing. At the isotropic point, the coherent Hamiltonian has global SU(2) symmetry, whereas the full Liouvillian retains only the U(1) symmetry associated with total magnetization. This structure pins a family of spatially uniform zero-U(1)-charge left eigenoperators with exact eigenvalues łambda=-2q, forming a Liouvillian relaxation comb. For the ferromagnetic Dicke ground state, the overlap envelope on this comb is known exactly at finite size and becomes Gaussian in the large-S limit. Since higher-q components decay rapidly, the q=1 comb tooth controls the long-time dynamics and yields universal D(t)sim e⁻²t relaxation independent of system size and interaction range. This mode-accessibility filtering realizes a spectral strong quantum Mpemba effect: an initially farther state relaxes faster than closer thermal states because slow non-steady Liouvillian modes are inaccessible. Weak breaking of the Hamiltonian SU(2) symmetry restores slow-mode overlap and suppresses this acceleration.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在局域退相干作用下的长程 XXZ 自旋链，揭示了一种由对称性筛选引起的异常耗散弛豫机制。由于哈密顿量具有全局 SU(2) 对称性而 Liouvillian 仅保留 U(1) 对称性，体系出现一组满足特定本征值结构的弛豫“梳状”模。对于铁磁 Dicke 基态，长时间动力学由最低阶可达模式主导，导致与系统规模和相互作用范围无关的普适指数弛豫，并体现出强量子 Mpemba 效应。
authors: Zijun Wei, Mingdi Xu, Yefeng Song, Xiang-Ping Jiang, Yangqian Yan, Lei Pan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们揭示了在局域退相干作用下长程 XXZ 自旋链中异常耗散弛豫的一种对称性筛选机制。在各向同性点，相干哈密顿量具有全局 SU(2) 对称性，而完整的 Liouvillian 仅保留与总磁化强度相关的 U(1) 对称性。这一结构固定了一族空间均匀、零 U(1) 荷的左本征算符，它们具有精确本征值 λ=-2q，形成一个 Liouvillian 弛豫梳。对于铁磁 Dicke 基态，该弛豫梳上的重叠包络在有限尺寸下可以精确给出，并在大 S 极限下变为高斯形式。由于更高 q 分量快速衰减，q=1 的梳齿控制长时间动力学，并给出与系统尺寸和相互作用范围无关的普适 D(t)～e⁻²t 弛豫。这种模式可达性筛选实现了一种谱意义上的强量子 Mpemba 效应：一个初始上更远的状态比更接近的热态弛豫得更快，因为慢的非稳态 Liouvillian 模式不可达。哈密顿量 SU(2) 对称性的弱破缺会恢复与慢模式的重叠，并抑制这种加速。

articles.title: Topological Codes from Space Groups: A Route beyond Translation Invariance
articles.title_zh: 基于空间群的拓扑编码：通向超越平移不变性的一条路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20548v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Translation invariance underlies all algebraic constructions of topological codes with geometrical locality. It has remained an open question whether codes that generically break this invariance can still be topological and simultaneously possess geometrical locality. Resolving this question is important both fundamentally---deepening our understanding of topological phases---and practically, as relaxing translation invariance could vastly expand the design space and potentially reduce resource overhead in fault-tolerant architectures. Here we introduce space-group codes, in which crystallographic point-group operations enter the bulk stabilizer algebra; bivariate bicycle (BB) codes arise as the translation-only limit. The key insight is that the point-group orbit resolves topology and locality together: it yields a computable algebraic criterion for topological order and a folded geometry in which point-group operations become local. We identify space-group codes whose code parameters exceed the reported same-blocklength, same-check-weight BB benchmarks. In five parameter-matched neutral-atom comparisons, reflection codes reduce the optimized movement cost in every case, by up to 60%, while folded placements also enable lower-overhead multilayer superconducting layouts. Treating spatial operations as a code-design variable therefore opens a route to topological codes jointly optimized for information protection and hardware geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出空间群码，将晶体学点群操作引入体稳定子代数，从而突破传统上依赖平移不变性的拓扑编码构造。该框架中，二元自行车码可视为仅含平移对称性的极限情形，而点群轨道同时实现了拓扑性判定与几何局域性的统一。文中还给出了可计算的代数判据，并展示了若干参数优于已报道同规模基准的空间群码实例。
authors: Chong-Yuan Xu, Ze-Chuan Liu, Yong Xu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平移不变性是所有具有几何局域性的拓扑码代数构造的基础。一个悬而未决的问题是，通常破缺这种不变性的码是否仍然可以是拓扑的，并且同时具有几何局域性。解决这一问题在基础层面和实践层面都很重要：前者可加深我们对拓扑相的理解，后者则因为放宽平移不变性可能极大扩展设计空间，并有望降低容错架构中的资源开销。在这里，我们引入空间群码，其中晶体学点群操作进入体稳定子代数；双变量 bicycle（BB）码则作为仅含平移的极限出现。关键洞见是，点群轨道同时解决了拓扑与局域性问题：它给出了拓扑序的可计算代数判据，并给出一种折叠几何，在其中点群操作变为局域的。我们识别出一些空间群码，其码参数超过了已报道的相同块长、相同校验权重的 BB 基准。在五组参数匹配的中性原子比较中，反射码在每一种情况下都降低了优化后的移动成本，最高降低 60%，同时折叠放置也使低开销的多层超导布局成为可能。因此，将空间操作视为一种码设计变量，为联合优化信息保护和硬件几何的拓扑码开辟了一条路径。

articles.title: DDSNet: Dual-domain Symmetry-aware Network for PCSEL Property Prediction
articles.title_zh: DDSNet：用于 PCSEL 性能预测的双域对称感知网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24785v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient exploration of the photonic crystal (PhC) lattice design space is essential for developing photonic crystal surface-emitting lasers. While coupled-wave theory (CWT) provides an effective physical framework, its computational cost remains prohibitive for large-scale exploration, driving the demand for neural surrogates. However, existing AI models underexploit two key factors of PhC unit-cell dielectric patterns indicated by CWT: spectral components and asymmetric structures, which largely govern devices' physical properties. This mismatch weakens surrogate accuracy and screening reliability, especially in structure-sensitive regions. To address this, we propose the Dual-Domain Symmetry-Aware Network (DDSNet). It integrates translation-equivariant spectral filtering with a symmetry-induced structural prior. The spectral filtering injects a spectral inductive bias into vision model while preserving translation equivariance on lattices. Meanwhile, the structural prior decomposes lattice features into irreducible representation-associated, symmetry-resolved components and processes them in separate branches. Experiments demonstrate that DDSNet significantly outperforms existing AI baselines in property prediction and high-throughput screening, exhibiting superior reliability in structure-sensitive regions. Crucially, component masking analyses reveal that the network successfully learns property-specific dependencies aligned with physical priors. These results indicate that DDSNet effectively captures physically meaningful structure-property relationships, establishing a highly reliable neural surrogate for PhC design space exploration.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对光子晶体表面发射激光器的设计空间探索效率低下问题，本文提出了双域对称感知网络 DDSNet。该方法将满足平移等变性的频谱过滤与基于对称性的结构先验结合起来，以更好捕捉光子晶体单元胞中的频谱分量和非对称结构特征。实验表明，该模型在结构敏感区域具有更高的预测精度与筛选可靠性。
authors: Cen Chen, Haitao Huang, Jiazhi Mao, Feifan Xu, Zhe Zhuang, Yuxiang Ren
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高效探索用于光子晶体面发射激光器的光子晶体（PhC）晶格设计空间至关重要。虽然耦合波理论（CWT）提供了有效的物理框架，但其计算成本对于大规模探索而言仍然高得难以承受，这推动了对神经替代模型的需求。然而，现有人工智能模型对由 CWT 指出的 PhC 单元胞介电模式中的两个关键因素——频谱分量和非对称结构——利用不足，而这些因素在很大程度上决定了器件的物理性质。这种不匹配削弱了替代模型的准确性和筛选可靠性，尤其是在对结构敏感的区域。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了双域对称感知网络（DDSNet）。该网络将具有平移等变性的频谱滤波与由对称性诱导的结构先验相结合。频谱滤波在保持晶格上平移等变性的同时，将频谱归纳偏置注入视觉模型。与此同时，结构先验将晶格特征分解为与不可约表示相关、按对称性分解的分量，并在不同分支中分别处理。实验表明，DDSNet 在性质预测和高通量筛选方面显著优于现有人工智能基线模型，并在结构敏感区域表现出更优的可靠性。更重要的是，分量遮蔽分析表明，该网络成功学习到了与物理先验一致的、特定性质相关的依赖关系。这些结果表明，DDSNet 能够有效捕捉具有物理意义的结构—性质关系，从而为光子晶体设计空间探索建立了一个高度可靠的神经替代模型。

articles.title: Contribution of cosmic alphas to generation of albedo neutrons and gammas in lunar regolith: A computational study based on GEANT4 simulations
articles.title_zh: 宇宙α粒子对月壤中反照中子与γ射线生成的贡献：基于 GEANT4 模拟的计算研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24816v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The lunar surface is constantly and directly exposed to Galactic Cosmic Rays (GCRs) due to the lack of the atmosphere and the magnetic field around it. The high-energetic alpha particles subsequently contribute to the generation of the secondary neutrons through either the spallation reaction or the low-energetic (α, n) process along with the cosmic protons. In this study, the contribution of the alpha particles to the production of the albedo neutrons as well as the albedo gamma rays in the lunar regolith is studied by using the Monte Carlo simulations based on the GEANT4 toolkit. The incident alpha particles are referenced from the PAMELA spectrometer over the interval between 0.14 and 52 GeV and executed as a probability-based primary particle source. The present simulations demonstrate the production of the albedo neutrons and gamma rays upon the process of cosmic alpha irradiation in the lunar regolith. The albedo neutron production is predominantly situated within the near-surface region of the lunar regolith and progressively diminishes with the increasing depth. The population of the secondary neutrons is primarily distributed over the low-energy region and reduces towards the high energies. These results imply that the cosmic alpha particles have also quantifiable contribution in the generation of the secondary radiation at the lunar surface together with the cosmic protons, and this study demonstrates a computational framework in the evaluation of the lunar albedo, the radiation transport, the surface composition, and the radiation environment for the further lunar exploration missions.
articles.abstract_zh: 月球表面缺乏大气和磁场屏蔽，持续受到银河宇宙线直接轰击，其中高能 α 粒子可通过剥离反应和低能 (α,n) 过程参与次级中子与伽马射线的产生。本文基于 GEANT4 蒙特卡洛模拟，研究了宇宙 α 粒子在月壤中生成反照中子和反照 γ 射线的贡献。结果表明，这些二次粒子主要产生于近表层区域，并随深度增加而逐渐减弱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于月球周围缺乏大气和磁场，月球表面持续而直接地暴露于银河宇宙射线（GCRs）之下。随后，高能 α 粒子与宇宙质子一起，通过碎裂反应或低能（α，n）过程，对二次中子的生成作出贡献。在本研究中，作者使用基于 GEANT4 工具包的蒙特卡洛模拟，研究了 α 粒子对月壤中反照中子和反照伽马射线产生的贡献。入射 α 粒子取自 PAMELA 光谱仪在 0.14 至 52 GeV 区间内的观测，并作为基于概率的初级粒子源来执行。当前模拟表明，在月壤中发生宇宙 α 辐照过程后，会产生反照中子和伽马射线。反照中子的产生主要位于月壤近表层区域，并随着深度增加而逐渐减弱。二次中子的群体主要分布在低能区域，并向高能区域递减。这些结果表明，宇宙 α 粒子与宇宙质子一起，也对月表二次辐射的产生具有可量化贡献；本研究还展示了一个用于评估月球反照、辐射输运、表面成分以及进一步月球探测任务辐射环境的计算框架。

articles.title: Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction and Query for Earthquake Catalogs
articles.title_zh: 地震目录的自动知识图谱构建与查询
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In recent years, the number of events in earthquake catalogs has significantly increased due to the utilization of more effective deep learning based detectors and phase pickers but answering open ended questions such as what characterizes this sequence? remains constrained by rigid spatiotemporal windowing and subjective expert interpretation. We present the first systematic application of graph based retrieval augmented generation GraphRAG directly to raw, tabular catalog records across three independently featured catalogs, a reservoir adjacent swarm, the 2019 Ridgecrest tectonic sequence, and the 2021 Maduo Mw7.4 aftershock sequence. Without the need for manual data structuring, the pipeline builds structurally complete, queryable knowledge graphs for all three. Rigorous evaluation individually verified against catalog derived ground truth and a rule based reference graph exposes failure modes, and four seismology informed prompt fixes eliminate all targeted fabrications while sharply improving mechanism reasoning. A vector RAG baseline demonstrates the graph layers distinctive value, catalog wide summarization and temporal stage comparison. In addition, we have identified two main pitfalls that need attention. GraphRAG thus offers a practical, transferable, near zero cost query interface for earthquake catalogs, where careful prompting ensures the results are consistently accurate and trustworthy.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着深度学习地震检测器与拾相器的发展，地震目录事件数迅速增长，但对序列特征的开放式提问仍受限于固定时空窗口与主观解释。本文首次将图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）系统性应用于原始表格式地震目录，并在多个独立目录上自动构建出可查询的结构化知识图谱。实验评估显示，结合地震学先验的提示修正可显著减少幻觉并提升机制推理能力，且图结构在目录级总结与时序阶段识别方面优于纯向量检索基线。
authors: Yuxin Zhou, Huai Zhang, S. Mostafa Mousavi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，随着更有效的基于深度学习的探测器和震相拾取器的使用，地震目录中的事件数量显著增加，但回答诸如“这一序列的特征是什么？”这样的开放式问题，仍然受到严格的时空窗口划分和主观的专家解释的限制。我们将图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）首次系统性地直接应用于原始的表格式目录记录，并在三个具有不同特征的目录上进行验证：一个邻近水库的震群、2019 年 Ridgecrest 构造序列，以及 2021 年玛多 Mw7.4 余震序列。在不需要人工数据结构化的情况下，该流程为这三个目录都构建了结构完整、可查询的知识图谱。经过严格评估，并分别与目录派生的真实标注和基于规则的参考图谱进行核验后，暴露了若干失败模式；而四项地震学启发式提示修正则消除了所有目标幻觉，并显著提升了机制推理能力。向量 RAG 基线进一步表明图层具有独特价值，尤其体现在目录级概括和时间阶段比较方面。此外，我们还识别出两个需要关注的主要陷阱。因此，GraphRAG 为地震目录提供了一种实用、可迁移、近乎零成本的查询接口，而谨慎的提示设计可确保结果始终准确且可信。

articles.title: Anisotropic optical chirality and Lipkin's zilch tensor
articles.title_zh: 各向异性光学手性与 Lipkin 的 zilch 张量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical chirality density is widely used as a scalar measure for describing the chiral properties of electromagnetic fields and their interaction with isotropic chiral media. However, in anisotropic optically-active media, a single scalar quantity is generally insufficient to capture the full complexity of chiral field-matter coupling. In this work, we go beyond the conventional optical chirality density and introduce a tensor of electromagnetic chirality based on the Lipkin formalism. This tensor provides a richer and more physically transparent description of chiral electromagnetic fields, particularly in the context of their interaction with general magneto-electric media. We discuss the physical meaning of the individual tensor components and provide an expression for the excitation rate of small anisotropically chiral molecules in the presence anisotropically chiral fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统光学手性密度通常以标量刻画电磁场的手性特征，但在各向异性光学活性介质中，这种描述往往不够充分。本文基于 Lipkin 形式引入电磁手性张量，用以更完整、更直观地描述手性电磁场及其与一般磁电介质的相互作用。作者还讨论了张量各分量的物理含义，并给出了各向异性手性分子在相关电磁场中的激发速率表达式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光学手性密度被广泛用作描述电磁场手性性质以及其与各向同性手性介质相互作用的标量度量。然而，在各向异性光活性介质中，单一标量量通常不足以捕捉手性场—物质耦合的全部复杂性。在这项工作中，我们超越了传统的光学手性密度，引入了一种基于 Lipkin 形式主义的电磁手性张量。该张量为手性电磁场提供了更丰富且更具物理透明性的描述，尤其适用于其与一般磁电介质相互作用的情形。我们讨论了张量各个分量的物理含义，并给出了在各向异性手性场存在时，小型各向异性手性分子的激发速率表达式。

articles.title: Economic Complexity as a Determinant of Regional Human Development in Brazil: Evidence across Aggregation Scales
articles.title_zh: 经济复杂度作为巴西区域人类发展指标的决定因素：跨聚合尺度的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study investigates the predictive capacity of models based on Economic Complexity and Complex Network Theory when applied to Brazil's Municipal Human Development Index (IDHM). For this purpose, the Economic Complexity Index was adapted to the Brazilian context. The main objective is to assess the extent to which different approaches to regional development analysis, such as local productive sophistication and structural integration into the national transportation network, determine socioeconomic development. The methodology compares linear regression models (Ridge, LASSO, and Elastic Net) and nonlinear models (Decision Trees and the Explainable Boosting Machine), evaluated through 5-fold cross-validation with grid search.
