We derive this master relation from an explicit SU(4)cB model, prove the anomaly cancellation of the discrete remnant, construct the vortex solution and its core operator, recast existing searches as bounds on a cosmic defect ux, and identify the decisive falsiable signatures that separate this picture from every mass-scale theory of nucleon decay: the permanent absence of all ∆B = 1 modes; a dominant clustered, collinear ∆B = 3 channel; an environment-dependent rate; and a correlation with the  ravitational-wave background of a cosmic-string network.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出，质子衰变不一定对应一个内禀寿命常数，而可能由局域重子缺陷密度、截面和速度决定的反应率表征。作者认为若重子数是与颜色 Z3 中心锁定的精确离散规范对称性，则单核子衰变和中子—反中子振荡在所有尺度上被禁止，最小允许的重子数破坏为 ΔB=3。该机制通过 Z3 重子涡旋核心中的催化过程实现，并给出可与传统质量尺度核子衰变理论区分的实验特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 每一个关于质子衰变的限制都被报告为质子寿命的下限——一个自然界的内禀常数。我们认为，质子可能并不具有这样的常数。如果重子数是一个精确的离散规范对称性，并且通过将重子数嵌入为第四种颜色而与颜色的 Z3 中心锁定，那么单核子衰变（∆B = 1）和中子—反中子振荡（∆B = 2）在所有尺度上都被禁止，包括被量子引力所禁止。最小的真正允许的破坏是 ∆B = 3，这是电弱 sphaleron 已经遵守的选择定则，并且它不能由任何局域算符有效承载。相反，它在 U(1)B → Z3 破缺必然产生的 Z3 重子涡旋核心内部实现，通过具有强相互作用截面的 Callan–Rubakov / Alford–March-Russell–Wilczek 催化实现。因此，可观测量不是寿命，而是由局域重子缺陷密度决定的速率 Γp = ndef σv。我们从一个显式的 SU(4)cB 模型推导出这一主关系，证明离散剩余对称性的反常相消，构造涡旋解及其核心算符，将现有搜索重新表述为对宇宙缺陷通量的约束，并识别出将该图景与每一种质量尺度核子衰变理论区分开来的决定性可证伪特征：所有 ∆B = 1 模式的永久缺失；占主导的成簇、共线 ∆B = 3 通道；依赖环境的速率；以及与宇宙弦网络引力波背景的相关性。

articles.title: Parameter optimization, shaking table test, and intelligent response prediction of adjacent structures connected by viscous dampers
articles.title_zh: 由黏滞阻尼器连接的相邻结构的参数优化、振动台试验与智能响应预测
articles.abstract: To improve the vibration control performance of adjacent structures connected by viscous dampers under seismic excitation, this study proposes a damper parameter optimization method that integrates the MATLAB genetic algorithm with the SAP2000-OAPI. The effectiveness of the method is systematically verified through shaking table tests and an intelligent prediction model. First, a dynamic analytical model of adjacent asymmetric twin-tower structures was established. The installation locations and damping coefficients of viscous dampers were selected as optimization variables. Based on these variables, a GA-SAP2000 integrated optimization framework was developed to determine the optimal parameters for both single-damper and double-damper connection systems under different earthquake records. Subsequently, a shaking table test involving a 15-story main structure and a 7-story substructure was conducted to validate the finite element model and the optimized schemes. The results show that the discrepancies between the natural frequencies of the numerical and experimental models for the first two modes are within 5%. In addition, the errors in floor dynamic responses are less than 10%, indicating that the proposed finite element model is reliable. Compared with the uncontrolled adjacent structure system, the optimized viscous damper-connected system significantly reduces the displacement and acceleration responses of both the main and substructures. Moreover, the double-damper configuration provides better overall control performance than the single-damper configuration. This result indicates that multi-location collaborative deployment can further enhance vibration mitigation effectiveness. Based on these findings, an SSA-BP neural network model was established to rapidly predict the maximum displacement and acceleration responses of both the main and substructures. The results indicate that the proposed model achieves high prediction accuracy for both the training and testing datasets, with coefficients of determination greater than 0.92.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种结合 MATLAB 遗传算法与 SAP2000-OAPI 的阻尼器参数优化方法，以提升地震作用下黏滞阻尼器连接相邻结构的减振性能。研究通过非对称双塔结构动力模型、振动台试验和智能预测模型系统验证了该方法。结果表明优化阻尼器显著降低位移和加速度响应，双阻尼器方案优于单阻尼器方案，SSA-BP 神经网络可高精度预测结构最大响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为提高地震激励下由黏滞阻尼器连接的相邻结构的振动控制性能，本研究提出了一种将 MATLAB 遗传算法与 SAP2000-OAPI 相结合的阻尼器参数优化方法。该方法的有效性通过振动台试验和智能预测模型得到了系统验证。首先，建立了相邻非对称双塔结构的动力分析模型。将黏滞阻尼器的安装位置和阻尼系数选为优化变量。基于这些变量，开发了 GA-SAP2000 集成优化框架，以确定不同地震记录下单阻尼器和双阻尼器连接系统的最优参数。随后，开展了包含 15 层主结构和 7 层子结构的振动台试验，以验证有限元模型和优化方案。结果表明，数值模型和实验模型前两阶振型的固有频率差异均在 5% 以内。此外，楼层动力响应误差小于 10%，表明所提出的有限元模型是可靠的。与未控制的相邻结构体系相比，优化后的黏滞阻尼器连接体系显著降低了主结构和子结构的位移及加速度响应。此外，双阻尼器构型比单阻尼器构型提供了更好的整体控制性能。该结果表明，多位置协同布置能够进一步增强减振效果。基于这些发现，建立了 SSA-BP 神经网络模型，用于快速预测主结构和子结构的最大位移及加速度响应。结果表明，所提出的模型在训练数据集和测试数据集上均实现了较高预测精度，决定系数均大于 0.92。

articles.title: Tensor Network Machine Learning for Wildfire Susceptibility Mapping: from Grokking Dynamics to Quantum Mixedness of Class Representations
articles.title_zh: 用于野火易发性制图的张量网络机器学习：从 Grokking 动力学到类别表征的量子混合性
articles.abstract: A quantum-inspired tensor network framework for wildfire susceptibility classification in the Gargano region is introduced, leveraging AlphaEarth embeddings and Matrix Product State models. The approach combines scalable geospatial representations with an interpretable quantum mask, enabling both binary and multiclass classification of wildfire susceptibility. Beyond predictive performance, the study reveals a pronounced grokking transition in the binary case and provides a detailed analysis of inter-class confusion in the multiclass setting. By introducing level-resolved mixedness diagnostics based on reduced density matrices, we show that the MPS classifier naturally encodes a hierarchy of class distinguishability, with non-adjacent categories becoming more separable than neighboring ones. These results demonstrate that tensor network models not only achieve competitive classification accuracy but also offer a physically grounded framework to quantify and interpret class separability in complex environmental datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种受量子启发的张量网络框架，用于意大利 Gargano 地区野火易发性分类，结合 AlphaEarth 嵌入和矩阵乘积态模型。该方法支持二分类和多分类，并通过可解释的量子掩码分析类别可分性。研究发现二分类中存在明显的 grokking 转变，多分类中矩阵乘积态分类器自然编码了类别可区分性的层级结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文引入了一种受量子启发的张量网络框架，用于 Gargano 地区的野火易发性分类，该框架利用 AlphaEarth 嵌入和矩阵乘积态模型。该方法将可扩展的地理空间表征与可解释的量子掩码相结合，从而能够进行野火易发性的二分类和多分类。除了预测性能之外，本研究揭示了二分类情形中显著的 grokking 转变，并对多分类设置中的类别间混淆进行了详细分析。通过引入基于约化密度矩阵的逐级混合性诊断，我们表明 MPS 分类器自然地编码了类别可区分性的层级结构，其中非相邻类别比相邻类别变得更加可分。这些结果表明，张量网络模型不仅能够达到具有竞争力的分类准确率，而且提供了一个具有物理基础的框架，用于量化和解释复杂环境数据集中的类别可分性。

articles.title: The Objectivity of Subjectivity: A Model of the Brain’s Valuation System
articles.title_zh: 主观性的客观性：脑价值评估系统的一个模型
articles.abstract: Philosophers like Plato, Hume, Kant, and others have been debating objectivity versus subjectivity for millenia1. Over time, the trivialization of subjectivity took hold, culminating in artists disdaining it during the twentieth century. Here, we show that subjectivity is not arbitrary because the brain adapts its learning mechanisms to fit each person's unique life context. We performed computer simulations of value learning in a computational model2,3 of the valuation system of the brain4–7. These simulations began with equations, methods, initial conditions, and parameters described elsewhere2,3, but we varied the latter two to probe the model. The results of the simulations showed that the valuation system implemented a stochastic-learning process with intrinsic propensity for value diversity. This propensity was magnified by the stable fixed points of the system forming a multidimensional surface, thus having multiple possible convergence targets. Furthermore, after the system reached the convergence surface, a stochastic-resonance process8,9 pushed the value parameters to different convergence points. Two other forces that boosted value diversity were internal motivations and external social forces. These results are significant because they mean that the value difference between people, that is, their perceived inter-person subjectivity may be evolutionarily designed. Therefore, subjectivity may be objective.
articles.abstract_zh: 从柏拉图、休谟、康德等哲学家到当代，客观性与主观性的争论已持续数千年。本文指出，主观性并非任意的，因为大脑会将学习机制调整为适应每个人独特的生活情境。通过对大脑价值评估系统计算模型的数值模拟，作者发现该系统具有内禀的价值多样性倾向，并会在随机共振、内部动机和外部社会力量的共同作用下分化到不同的收敛点。由此可见，人与人之间的价值差异，乃至相互感知到的主观性，可能具有进化设计基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 柏拉图、休谟、康德以及其他哲学家已就客观性与主观性争论了数千年。随着时间推移，主观性逐渐被轻视，并在二十世纪达到顶点，艺术家们甚至对此表示不屑。本文表明，主观性并非任意的，因为大脑会调整其学习机制，以适应每个人独特的生活情境。我们在大脑价值评估系统的一个计算模型中，对价值学习进行了计算机模拟。这些模拟基于文献中已给出的方程、方法、初始条件和参数，但我们改变了后两者以探查该模型。模拟结果显示，该价值评估系统实现了一种随机学习过程，且天然具有产生价值多样性的倾向。该倾向又因系统的稳定固定点形成一个多维曲面而被放大，因此具有多个可能的收敛目标。此外，在系统到达收敛曲面之后，一种随机共振过程会将价值参数推向不同的收敛点。进一步增强价值多样性的另外两种力量是内部动机和外部社会力量。上述结果具有重要意义，因为这意味着人与人之间的价值差异，即他们所感知到的个体间主观性，可能是进化上经过设计的。因此，主观性或许是客观的。

articles.title: Proton-Coupled Charge Transfer Induces a Magnetic Phase Transition in Layered Metal-Organic Frameworks
articles.title_zh: 质子耦合电荷转移诱导层状金属有机框架中的磁相变
articles.abstract: Proton-coupled charge transfer (PCCT), a fundamental principle underlying biological electron transport, has rarely been realized in crystalline materials, where the charge, proton, and spin degrees of freedom can be cooperatively controlled. Herein, we report a redox-active layered donor (D)–acceptor (A) metal-organic framework (D2A-MOF), in which modulation of the intramolecular hydrogen bonds (HBs) acts as a decisive trigger for intralattice charge transfer and a concomitant magnetic phase transformation. The framework is constructed from an o-hydroxybenzoate-bridged paddlewheel-type diruthenium(II,II) complex as the D unit and bis[1,2,5]dithiazolotetracyanoquinodimethane (BTDA-TCNQ) as the A unit. Systematic solvent desorption selectively disrupts the intramolecular HB between the o-hydroxy group and the carboxylate oxygen, effectively converting the D unit into a D* state at a higher potential. This HB-mediated electronic reorganization induces a one-electron transfer from [Ru2] to BTDA-TCNQ, generating a [–Ru2+–(BTDA-TCNQ)•––Ru20–] state that converts the material from a paramagnet to an antiferromagnet with a Néel temperature of 58 K. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations corroborate the decisive role of HB mode switching in tuning the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) level of the donor and enabling charge transfer. This study establishes modulation of intramolecular HBs as a powerful design principle for PCCT in MOFs and demonstrates a chemically triggered magnetic phase transition driven by guest-controlled proton dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 质子耦合电荷转移是生物电子传递中的基本原理，但在可协同调控电荷、质子与自旋自由度的晶体材料中却少有实现。本文报道了一种具有氧化还原活性的层状供体—受体金属有机框架，其中分子内氢键的调控可触发层内电荷转移并伴随磁相转变。去溶剂化通过选择性破坏分子内氢键，使材料发生一电子转移并由顺磁体转变为反铁磁体。该研究表明，调控分子内氢键可作为MOF中实现质子耦合电荷转移的有效设计策略。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 质子耦合电荷转移（PCCT）是生物电子传输所依据的一项基本原理，但在晶体材料中这一过程却很少被实现，而在这类材料中电荷、质子和自旋自由度可以被协同调控。本文报道了一种具有氧化还原活性的层状供体（D）—受体（A）金属有机框架（D2A-MOF），其中分子内氢键（HBs）的调控充当了层内电荷转移及其伴随磁相转变的决定性触发因素。该框架由一种以邻羟基苯甲酸桥联的桨轮型二钌(II,II)配合物作为D单元，以及双[1,2,5]二噻唑四氰基醌二甲烷（BTDA-TCNQ）作为A单元构成。系统性的溶剂脱附可选择性破坏邻羟基与羧酸根氧之间的分子内氢键，从而有效地将D单元转化为更高电位的D*状态。由该氢键介导的电子重组引发了从[Ru2]向BTDA-TCNQ的一电子转移，生成[–Ru2+–(BTDA-TCNQ)•––Ru20–]状态，使材料由顺磁体转变为具有58 K奈尔温度的反铁磁体。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算证实了氢键模式切换在调控供体最高占据分子轨道（HOMO）能级并促进电荷转移中的决定性作用。该研究确立了调控分子内氢键作为MOF中实现PCCT的一种强有力设计原则，并展示了一种由客体控制的质子动力学驱动、可通过化学触发的磁相变。

articles.title: Hidden liquid-crystalline order in a non-collinear antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 非共线反铁磁体中的隐含液晶序
articles.abstract: Liquid crystals (LCs) provide a canonical framework to understand intermediate phases between liquids and crystals, such as nematic and smectic order, and the rich phenomenology that emerges when such orders are subjected to boundaries, confinement, and elastic frustration. Here, we reveal a hidden mesoscale liquid-crystal-like organization of spin cycloids in a room-temperature magnetoelectric antiferromagnet BiFeO3. It is observed that ferroelectric domain walls act as anchoring surfaces, locally selecting cycloid propagation vectors analogous to surface induced alignment in LCs. Interestingly, confinement imposed by multiple domain walls stabilizes coherent smectic-like cycloidal order in between domain walls through “order by confinement”, while geometrical frustration at domain boundaries induces non-local Helfrich-Hurault–type elastic instabilities in cycloid smectics. Building on these insights, we show that surface-energy engineering dramatically enhances the long range orientational coherence of spin cycloids, enabling robust non-local magnon transport in the ultra-thin limit. These findings establish self-organization as a guiding principle for engineering novel magnetic textures and emergent spin functionalities, opening new opportunities for spintronic and magnonic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 液晶为理解液体与晶体之间的中间相提供了经典框架。本文揭示了室温磁电反铁磁材料 BiFeO3 中自旋旋摆在介观尺度上的隐含液晶式组织：铁电畴壁充当类似液晶表面配向的锚定界面，局域选择旋摆传播矢量。多个畴壁形成的约束可通过“约束致有序”稳定类层状的旋摆有序，而畴边界的几何挫折则会诱发非局域的弹性失稳。基于这些机制，作者进一步表明通过界面能工程可显著提升自旋旋摆的长程取向相干性，并增强超薄极限下的非局域磁振子输运。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 液晶（LC）为理解液体与晶体之间的中间相提供了经典框架，例如向列相和层列相有序，以及当这些有序受到边界、限域和弹性挫折作用时所出现的丰富现象。在这里，我们揭示了室温磁电反铁磁体 BiFeO3 中自旋旋涡在介观尺度上隐藏的类液晶组织。实验观察表明，铁电畴壁充当锚定表面，局域地选择旋涡传播矢量，这类似于液晶中的表面诱导取向。值得注意的是，多重畴壁施加的限域通过“约束诱导有序”稳定了畴壁之间相干的类 smectic 自旋旋涡有序，而畴边界处的几何挫折则在旋涡 smectic 中诱导出非局域的 Helfrich-Hurault 型弹性不稳定性。基于这些认识，我们表明，表面能工程能够显著增强自旋旋涡的长程取向相干性，从而在超薄极限下实现稳健的非局域磁振子输运。这些发现将自组织确立为工程化新型磁纹理和涌现自旋功能的指导原则，为自旋电子学和磁振子学技术开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: Accurate prediction of the α→β phase transformation temperature in tin via full anharmonic treatment
articles.title_zh: 通过完整非谐处理准确预测锡中 α→β 相变温度
articles.abstract: Predicting the α→β (grey-to-white) transition temperature in tin presents a longstanding challenge for atomistic simulations, existing theoretical approaches over- or underestimating the experimental boundary (286 K) by up to several hundred Kelvin. In this work, we construct an Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) potential trained on density functional theory data to evaluate the finite-temperature free energies of both phases. Evaluated on the same potential energy surface, the quasi-harmonic approximation predicts a transformation temperature of 377 K, whereas full thermodynamic integration, which accounts for explicit vibrational anharmonicity, yields 288 K. This shift directly quantifies the explicit anharmonic free energy, which is substantial for metallic beta-Sn but negligible for semiconducting alpha-Sn. The anisotropic anharmonicity in beta-Sn is corroborated by its excess heat capacity, temperature-driven renormalization of its vibrational spectrum, and deviations of its atomic forces and displacements from the harmonic reference. Our results demonstrate that capturing full lattice anharmonicity is essential for predicting the phase stability of tin, while the absolute transition temperature remains limited by the accuracy of the underlying 0 K energetics.
articles.abstract_zh: 锡的 α→β（灰锡到白锡）相变温度一直难以被原子尺度模拟准确预测，现有理论方法往往与实验值 286 K 相差数百开尔文。本文基于密度泛函理论数据训练原子簇展开势函数，并在同一势能面上计算两相的有限温自由能。结果显示，准谐近似给出的相变温度为 377 K，而考虑显式振动非谐性的完整热力学积分得到 288 K，与实验高度一致。研究还表明，β-Sn 的各向异性非谐性显著，而 α-Sn 的非谐效应较弱，说明预测锡的相稳定性必须纳入完整晶格非谐性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测锡中 α→β（灰锡到白锡）转变温度一直是原子尺度模拟中的长期挑战，现有理论方法对实验边界（286 K）的高估或低估可达数百开尔文。在本工作中，我们构建了一种基于密度泛函理论数据训练的原子簇展开（ACE）势，用于评估两种相在有限温度下的自由能。在同一势能面上进行评估时，准谐近似预测的相变温度为 377 K，而考虑显式振动非谐性的完整热力学积分给出的结果为 288 K。该温度位移直接量化了显式非谐自由能；这种贡献对于金属性 β-Sn 相当显著，而对于半导体性 α-Sn 则可以忽略。β-Sn 中各向异性的非谐性还通过其过量热容、随温度驱动的振动谱重整化，以及其原子力和位移相对于谐参考的偏离得到佐证。我们的结果表明，捕捉完整的晶格非谐性对于预测锡的相稳定性至关重要，而绝对相变温度仍受限于底层 0 K 能量学的准确性。

articles.title: Effects of directional TOR interfaces on takeover performance: A protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
articles.title_zh: 方向性接管请求界面对接管表现的影响：系统综述与荟萃分析方案
articles.abstract: According to the Society of Automotive Engineers (SOA), intermediate levels of vehicle automation (Levels 2 and 3) are designed to operate only within a limited set of predefined Operational Design Domain (ODD). Outside these conditions, the driving system may no longer be able to safely manage the driving task and therefore requires the human driver to intervene through a Takeover Request (TOR) warning. TORs are designed to support drivers in regaining vehicle control; however, conventional warnings may not effectively guide attention towards relevant areas of the driving environment. Directional TORs have been proposed as a promising approach by providing spatial information about hazards or safe manoeuvring areas. Nevertheless, existing studies have reported inconsistent findings regarding their effects on takeover performance, including takeover time and quality. This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to synthesise empirical evidence on the effectiveness of directional TORs compared with non-directional TORs and to examine whether different directional strategies (towards-free-lane vs. towards-hazard) influence takeover outcomes. Furthermore, potential sources of heterogeneity across studies will be explored to clarify these inconsistent findings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出了一项关于方向性 TOR（接管请求）界面效果的系统综述与荟萃分析方案。研究背景是：在 L2/L3 自动驾驶条件超出设计运行域时，驾驶员需要及时接管，而传统警示未必能有效引导注意力。作者拟综合比较方向性 TOR 与非方向性 TOR 在接管时间、接管质量等指标上的差异，并进一步考察“指向自由车道”和“指向危险源”等不同方向策略的作用。该方案还计划分析异质性来源，以澄清现有研究结论不一致的问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 根据汽车工程师学会（SOA）的定义，中间级别的车辆自动化（2 级和 3 级）被设计为仅在一组有限的预定义运行设计域（ODD）内运行。在这些条件之外，驾驶系统可能不再能够安全地管理驾驶任务，因此需要通过接管请求（TOR）警告要求人类驾驶员介入。接管请求旨在支持驾驶员重新获得车辆控制；然而，传统警告可能无法有效地将注意力引导到驾驶环境中的相关区域。方向性接管请求被提出作为一种有前景的方法，因为它能够提供关于危险或安全机动区域的空间信息。尽管如此，现有研究对于其对接管表现的影响报告了不一致的发现，包括接管时间和接管质量。本系统综述与荟萃分析旨在综合关于方向性接管请求相较于非方向性接管请求有效性的实证证据，并考察不同方向策略（指向空闲车道与指向危险源）是否会影响接管结果。此外，研究还将探索各研究之间潜在的异质性来源，以澄清这些不一致的发现。

articles.title: Multi-Path Quantum Key Distribution Transport: A Four-Order Mathematical Framework with Provable Zero-Interruption Under Stated Provisioning Conditions
articles.title_zh: 多路径量子密钥分发传输：一种四阶数学框架及在既定配置条件下可证明的零中断机制
articles.abstract: Metropolitan QKD networks—the Beijing–Shanghai backbone, the Tokyo QKD testbed,and SECOQC—span hundreds of kilometers, yet lack a formally defined, mathematically rigorous transport layer: every deployed network still relies on ad-hoc single-path key management with unpredictable generation rates, unsecured standby pools, and architectures designed for point-to-point links that cannot support multi-hop trusted-relay topologies. This paper provides the first complete transport layer for multi-path QKD networks,built as a four-order progressive mathematical framework: (1) per-path security decou-pling with rigorous Jensen-bound proof; (2) shadow-price optimal multi-path traffic allocation; (3) large-deviation hot-buffer dimensioning with subexponential heavy-tail extension; (4) One Pass Erasable Storage (OPES) cold pools that provably yield zero service interruption under stated provisioning and read-latency axioms. A composable security chain—from Shor–Preskill reduction through multi-path composition to end-to-end εtotal ≤ 10−8—is established via a formal Security Theorem. A discrete-event simulation on K = 4 paths across three hops validates the framework across four 3,600-second attack scenarios (baseline, DoS jamming, delay intercept-resend, and combined), with zero service interruptions and address-rotation DoS hit rate matching the theoretical 1/N bound. The framework is compatible with any QKD protocol satisfying Assumptions A1–A4 and deployable on existing metropolitan fibre infrastructure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对现有多路径量子密钥分发网络缺乏形式化传输层的问题，提出了一套四阶递进的数学框架。该框架依次涵盖路径安全解耦、多路径流量优化、热缓冲区规模设计以及冷池存储机制，并声称在给定配置与读取时延假设下可实现零服务中断。作者还构建了从 Shor–Preskill 归约到多路径组合的可组合安全链，给出端到端安全界。仿真部分则在多跳、四路径场景下验证了该框架的运行表现，展示了其在量子密钥传输中的系统化建模思路。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 城域量子密钥分发（QKD）网络——包括京沪干线、东京 QKD 试验床和 SECOQC——跨越数百公里，但仍缺乏形式化定义且数学上严格的传输层：每一个已部署网络仍然依赖临时性的单路径密钥管理，存在不可预测的生成速率、不安全的备用池，以及为点到点链路设计、无法支持多跳可信中继拓扑的架构。本文提供了第一个面向多路径 QKD 网络的完整传输层，该传输层构建为一个四阶递进式数学框架：（1）具有严格 Jensen 界证明的逐路径安全解耦；（2）影子价格最优的多路径流量分配；（3）带有次指数重尾扩展的大偏差热缓冲区定容；（4）在既定配置和读取延迟公理下可证明实现零服务中断的一次通过可擦除存储（OPES）冷池。论文通过一个形式化安全定理，建立了从 Shor–Preskill 归约，经由多路径组合，到端到端 εtotal ≤ 10−8 的可组合安全链。在 K = 4 条路径、跨三跳的离散事件仿真中，该框架在四个 3,600 秒攻击场景（基线、DoS 干扰、延迟型截获-重发以及组合攻击）下得到验证，实现了零服务中断，并且地址轮换 DoS 命中率与理论 1/N 界相匹配。该框架兼容任何满足假设 A1–A4 的 QKD 协议，并可部署于现有城域光纤基础设施之上。

articles.title: Switching characteristics of electrically connected stochastically actuated magnetic tunnel junction nanopillars
articles.title_zh: 电连接的随机激发磁隧道结纳米柱的开关特性
articles.abstract: Author(s): Dairong Chen, Ahmed Sidi El Valli, Jonathan Z. Sun, Flaviano Morone, Dries Sels, and Andrew D. Kent Magnetic tunnel junctions driven by stochastic spin-transfer switching can be coupled through simple electrical circuits to realize tunable Ising-like interactions. A Markov-chain model predicts the collective behavior of coupled junctions from single-device measurements, providing a foundation for probabilistic spintronic hardware. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 014426] Published Wed Jul 29, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 磁隧道结在随机自旋转移开关驱动下，可通过简单电路相互耦合，从而实现可调的类 Ising 相互作用。本文基于单器件测量建立了一个马尔可夫链模型，用以预测耦合结阵列的集体行为。该结果为构建概率型自旋电子硬件提供了理论与实验基础。
authors: Dairong Chen, Ahmed Sidi El Valli, Jonathan Z. Sun, Flaviano Morone, Dries Sels, and Andrew D. Kent
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作者：Dairong Chen、Ahmed Sidi El Valli、Jonathan Z. Sun、Flaviano Morone、Dries Sels 和 Andrew D. Kent。由随机自旋转移开关驱动的磁隧道结可以通过简单电路耦合，以实现可调的类伊辛相互作用。一个马尔可夫链模型能够从单器件测量预测耦合结的集体行为，从而为概率自旋电子硬件奠定基础。发表于《Physical Review B》114, 014426，发布日期为 2026 年 7 月 29 日星期三。

articles.title: The piezochiral effect
articles.title_zh: 压电手性效应
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 29 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10845-5 The piezochiral effect, a new member of the family of strain-responsive functionalities alongside piezoelectricity and piezomagnetism, is introduced, enabling control of chirality through mechanical strain, with future applications in photonics, spintronics, biosensing and quantum information.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新的应变响应功能——压电手性效应，它可通过机械应变来调控材料的手性。该效应与压电性、压磁性一样，属于外场耦合功能家族的新成员。研究表明，这一机制有望用于光子学、自旋电子学、生物传感以及量子信息等方向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 《Nature》，在线发表于 2026 年 7 月 29 日；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10845-5。压手性效应作为应变响应功能家族中的新成员被提出，该家族还包括压电性和压磁性；该效应能够通过机械应变控制手性，并在未来有望应用于光子学、自旋电子学、生物传感和量子信息。

articles.title: Perpendicular switching of polarization in layered ferroelectrics
articles.title_zh: 层状铁电体中的垂直极化翻转
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 29 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10839-3 Perpendicular switching of the polarization state in the layered ferroelectric Bi4Ti3O12 is demonstrated by means of trilinear coupling, allowing manipulation of the in-plane polarization component with an out-of-plane electric field.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在层状铁电体 Bi4Ti3O12 中实现了极化状态的垂直翻转。该过程依赖三线性耦合，使得可以通过垂直电场调控面内极化分量。研究表明，这为层状铁电材料中的极化操控提供了新的电场驱动机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 《Nature》，在线发表于 2026 年 7 月 29 日；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10839-3。通过三线性耦合，研究展示了层状铁电体 Bi4Ti3O12 中极化态的垂直切换，从而允许用面外电场操控面内极化分量。

articles.title: Octahedral-coordinated Co 3 O 4 for water electrolysis in acid
articles.title_zh: 用于酸性水分解的八面体配位 Co3O4
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 29 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10851-7 A new trigonal-phase Co3O4 manufactured using a vacuum-mediated molten-alkali mechanochemical method is described, demonstrating edge-shared octahedral coordination and achieving lower overpotential than spinel-type Co3O4 in the acidic oxygen evolution reaction, with reduced dissolution of cobalt.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种新颖的三方相 Co3O4，可通过真空介导的熔融碱机械化学方法制备。该材料具有边共享八面体配位结构，在酸性析氧反应中表现出比尖晶石型 Co3O4 更低的过电位。与此同时，其钴溶解也更少，说明这种结构设计有助于提升酸性电解水条件下的稳定性与活性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 《Nature》，在线发表于 2026 年 7 月 29 日；doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10851-7。文中描述了一种使用真空介导的熔融碱机械化学方法制造的新型三方相 Co3O4，该材料表现出共边八面体配位，并在酸性析氧反应中实现了比尖晶石型 Co3O4 更低的过电位，同时钴的溶解减少。

articles.title: Polaris: a flexible stellarator demonstration experiment with simple modular coils
articles.title_zh: Polaris：一种采用简单模块线圈的灵活星形器实验装置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25409v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the design, construction, and first plasma experiments of Polaris, a new small-scale stellarator experiment (major radius R ~ 0.4 m) located at the Swiss Plasma Center. Polaris consists of a relatively large vacuum vessel (~0.5 m³⁾ predominantly made of glass windows and inside which different sets of magnetic coils can be installed. A first modular coil configuration has been designed with six identical, circular, water-cooled copper coils toroidally arranged in an optimal way so that they generate a large volume of magnetic surfaces and rotational transform in vacuum (iota ~ 0.3). The total current in each coil goes up to ~ 5 kA, producing a magnetic field on-axis of B ~ 0.03 T. An RF antenna specifically designed to operate in vacuum delivers up to 2.5 kW of power to produce plasma via inductive coupling and electron-impact ionization. We present the engineering solutions adopted for the design of Polaris and illustrate the great experimental flexibility it enables. Time-averaged values and fluctuations of plasma density, electron temperature, and floating potential are measured at various toroidal locations, providing insights into the plasma equilibrium, electrostatic turbulence, and associated transport. The glass vacuum chamber of Polaris additionally provides unprecedented optical access to the entire plasma volume. With its original, flexible design, Polaris is a 'stellarator fish-tank', allowing interchangeable coil sets and exploration of various magnetic configurations. Furthermore, its low-temperature, low-density, high-neutral-pressure plasmas are relevant to stellarator edge physics, making Polaris a first-of-kind testbed for the fundamental investigation of stellarator edge-relevant physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文介绍了Polaris小型星形器实验装置的设计、建造与首次等离子体实验。装置采用可更换的模块化线圈配置、真空腔体和专门设计的射频天线，以实现等离子体产生与加热，并展示了较强的实验灵活性。文章还报告了多个环向位置上的等离子体参数测量，为后续研究提供了基础。
authors: Simon P. H. Vincent, Joaquim Loizu, Matthieu Toussaint, Rémy Jacquier, Jérémy Salm, Philippe Guittienne, Matias Habib, Idil Sonmez, Christopher B. Smiet, Erol Balkovic, Rogerio Jorge, Alan G. Goodman, Ivo Furno, Christian Moura, William Matthey-Dorey, Steve Couturier, Frédéric Dolizy
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.25409v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：我们介绍Polaris的设计、建造和首次等离子体实验。Polaris是一个新的小尺度仿星器实验装置，位于瑞士等离子体中心，主半径R约为0.4米。Polaris由一个相对较大的真空容器组成，体积约为0.5立方米，主要由玻璃窗口构成，其内部可安装不同组的磁线圈。首个模块化线圈构型由六个相同的圆形水冷铜线圈组成，这些线圈以优化方式沿环向排列，从而在真空中产生大体积磁面和旋转变换（iota约为0.3）。每个线圈中的总电流最高可达约5千安，在轴线上产生约0.03特斯拉的磁场。一个专门设计用于在真空中工作的射频天线可提供最高2.5千瓦的功率，通过感应耦合和电子碰撞电离产生等离子体。我们介绍了Polaris设计中采用的工程解决方案，并展示其所实现的高度实验灵活性。在不同环向位置测量了等离子体密度、电子温度和悬浮电位的时间平均值及其涨落，从而为理解等离子体平衡、静电湍流及相关输运提供了信息。Polaris的玻璃真空腔还为整个等离子体体积提供了前所未有的光学可达性。凭借其独特而灵活的设计，Polaris是一台“仿星器鱼缸”，允许更换线圈组并探索多种磁构型。此外，其低温、低密度、高中性气压等离子体与仿星器边缘物理相关，使Polaris成为一种首创性测试平台，用于对仿星器边缘相关物理开展基础研究。
