articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the properties of the largest eigenvalue of correlation matrices within the framework of Wishart ensembles. In this work, we propose the largest eigenvalue as an effective empirical order parameter for detecting phase transitions in chaotic and spin systems, drawing an analogy between its derivatives and thermodynamic response functions derived from the free energy, however not necessarily linked to a critical divergence originally observed in the context of phase transitions theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在 Wishart 系综框架下研究相关矩阵最大特征值的性质。作者提出将最大特征值作为一种有效的经验序参量，用于识别混沌系统和自旋系统中的相变。其导数与由自由能导出的热力学响应函数类比，但并不必然对应相变理论中最初所见的临界发散。
authors: Roberto da Silva, Antonio Mihara, Henrique Tramontina, Sandra D. Prado
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.25030v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：我们在Wishart系综框架内研究相关矩阵最大特征值的性质。在这项工作中，我们提出将最大特征值作为一种有效的经验序参量，用于探测混沌系统和自旋系统中的相变，并在其导数与由自由能导出的热力学响应函数之间建立类比；然而，这种类比并不一定与相变理论背景下最初观察到的临界发散相联系。

articles.title: A Catalogue of Topological Moiré Bands in Twisted Semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 扭转半导体中的拓扑莫尔能带目录
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twisted two-dimensional semiconductors provide a route to flat and topological moiré minibands, but systematic principles for organizing their material dependence have remained unclear. Here, we establish a high-throughput framework that integrates structural relaxation, first-principles electronic structure calculations, and moiré band topology. We apply this framework to 43 experimentally realized monolayers and 91 symmetry-inequivalent bilayer prototypes, yielding over 1,000 angle-resolved moiré electronic band structures. This database reveals that the low-energy moiré electronic structure is organized primarily by the valley character of the parent band edge together with stacking symmetry. In Γ-valley systems, the miniband width usually follows a nearly quadratic twist-angle scaling, consistent with a folding-dominated kinetic-energy scale. In K-valley systems, stacking-controlled interlayer hybridization governs whether parent Berry curvature is redistributed into isolated valley Chern minibands. By contrast, M-valley systems form a more material-specific class associated with anisotropic and symmetry-constrained band folding. The same valley-and-stacking hierarchy rationalizes the emergence or suppression of Z₂ minibands, and surface termination in Janus bilayers provides a microscopic knob for changing the relevant valley character. These results establish a materials-level organizing principle for designing flat and topological moiré bands in twisted semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个高通量框架，将结构弛豫、第一性原理电子结构计算与莫尔能带拓扑分析结合起来。作者对43种实验实现的单层材料和91种对称不等价的双层原型进行了研究，生成了1000多个角分辨莫尔电子能带结构。结果表明，低能莫尔电子结构主要由母体能带边的谷性质与堆叠对称性决定，不同谷类型对应不同的能带展宽与拓扑重构机制。
authors: Jiaheng Li, Yan Zhang, Jiaxuan Liu, Caiyuan Ye, Tiannian Zhu, Zhong Fang, Hongming Weng, Quansheng Wu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.25172v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：扭转二维半导体为实现平坦和拓扑莫尔小能带提供了一条途径，但用于组织其材料依赖性的系统性原则一直尚不清楚。在这里，我们建立了一个高通量框架，该框架整合了结构弛豫、第一性原理电子结构计算以及莫尔能带拓扑。我们将该框架应用于43种已在实验上实现的单层材料和91种对称性不等价的双层原型，得到了1000多个角度分辨的莫尔电子能带结构。该数据库揭示，低能莫尔电子结构主要由母体带边的谷特征以及堆垛对称性所组织。在Γ谷体系中，小能带宽度通常遵循近似二次的扭转角标度关系，这与由能带折叠主导的动能尺度一致。在K谷体系中，由堆垛控制的层间杂化决定了母体贝里曲率是否会重新分布到孤立的谷陈数小能带中。相比之下，M谷体系形成了一个更具材料特异性的类别，与各向异性且受对称性约束的能带折叠相关。同样的谷与堆垛层级关系解释了Z₂小能带的出现或抑制，而Janus双层中的表面终止为改变相关谷特征提供了一个微观调控旋钮。这些结果确立了一种材料层面的组织原则，用于设计扭转半导体中的平坦和拓扑莫尔能带。

articles.title: Tuning Density and Spin Ordering of Degenerate Fermi Gases in an Optical Cavity
articles.title_zh: 光学腔中简并费米气体的密度与自旋有序调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a spin-degenerate Fermi gas coupled to a high-finesse optical cavity, where the competition between scalar and vectorial couplings is controlled by the relative polarization angle of the pump and cavity fields. We find that the phase transition threshold is synergistically determined by the scalar-vectorial coupling weight and Pauli blocking, with the latter dictating the critical pump lattice depth required for the onset of superradiance. For a two-component Fermi gas with opposite spins, the population ratio drives two distinct types of phase transitions corresponding to real-space phase separation: continuous and discontinuous. Nevertheless, the boundary of the phase transition remains fundamentally governed by the scalar-vectorial coupling competition. We clarify the impact of the relative polarization angle on phase transitions of the system; these results also apply to bosonic systems. Our results provide valuable theoretical insights for future experimental realizations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了与高精细度光学腔耦合的自旋简并费米气体，其中泵浦场与腔场的相对偏振角可调控标量与矢量耦合之间的竞争。作者发现，相变阈值由标量—矢量耦合权重与泡利阻塞共同决定，后者控制超辐射发生所需的临界泵浦晶格深度。对于双组分费米气体，不同自旋人口比例会导致对应于实空间相分离的连续或不连续相变，但相边界仍主要由耦合竞争决定。
authors: Wei Qin, Yuan-Hong Chen, Renyuan Liao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一种与高精细度光学腔耦合的自旋简并费米气体，其中标量耦合与矢量耦合之间的竞争由泵浦场和腔场的相对偏振角控制。我们发现，相变阈值由标量—矢量耦合权重和泡利阻塞协同决定，其中后者支配着超辐射开始所需的临界泵浦晶格深度。对于具有相反自旋的双组分费米气体，粒子数比例驱动两种不同类型的相变，它们对应于实空间相分离：连续相变和不连续相变。尽管如此，相变边界仍从根本上受标量—矢量耦合竞争支配。我们阐明了相对偏振角对该系统相变的影响；这些结果也适用于玻色体系。我们的结果为未来实验实现提供了有价值的理论见解。

articles.title: Twisted Multilayer Graphene: Superperiodicity and quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 扭转多层石墨烯：超周期性与准晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This thesis investigates how superperiodicity, quasiperiodicity, and disorder shape electronic and spin transport in graphene-based systems, with an emphasis on experimentally relevant length scales and realistic atomistic modeling. Using large-scale real-space quantum-transport methods, it first establishes controlled transport fingerprints that distinguish conventional Bloch propagation in periodic structures from the anomalous dynamics induced by quasiperiodic modulations. Building on this framework, the thesis analyzes magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene and shows that, within a finite disorder window where flat-band features remain robust, moderate Anderson disorder can counterintuitively enhance the mean free path. This disorder-induced delocalization is further linked to changes in the quantum metric extracted from optical conductivity, revealing a direct connection between transport, electronic geometry, and the real-space extent of the underlying states. The study then turns to graphene quasicrystal approximants and hybrid multilayer stacks, identifying sub-ballistic transport and self-similar localization patterns as signatures of quasicrystalline order, while also demonstrating their strong fragility against disorder and interlayer proximity effects. Finally, the thesis addresses spin transport in suspended monolayer graphene, showing that atomic-scale corrugations generate short-range fluctuating Rashba fields that can limit spin lifetimes to the nanosecond range even when charge transport remains close to ballistic. Taken together, these results provide a unified picture of how geometry, disorder, and structural complexity govern transport phenomena in twisted and corrugated graphene systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本论文研究超周期性、准周期性与无序如何影响石墨烯体系中的电子与自旋输运，并强调实验相关的长度尺度与真实原子级建模。作者利用大规模实空间量子输运方法，区分了周期结构中的常规 Bloch 传播与准周期调制引起的异常动力学。进一步分析显示，在魔角扭转双层石墨烯中，适度 Anderson 无序在平坦能带特征仍稳定的窗口内反而可能增加平均自由程，并与由光学电导提取的量子度规变化相关；同时，石墨烯准晶近似体与混合多层堆叠呈现次弹道输运和自相似局域化图样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本论文研究超周期性、准周期性和无序如何塑造基于石墨烯体系中的电子输运和自旋输运，重点关注实验相关的长度尺度和现实的原子级建模。利用大规模实空间量子输运方法，论文首先建立了受控的输运指纹，用以区分周期结构中的常规布洛赫传播与由准周期调制诱导的异常动力学。在这一框架基础上，论文分析了魔角扭转双层石墨烯，并表明在平带特征仍保持稳健的有限无序窗口内，中等强度的安德森无序能够反直觉地增强平均自由程。这种无序诱导的离域化进一步与从光学电导率中提取的量子度量变化联系起来，揭示了输运、电子几何以及底层态在实空间中延展范围之间的直接关联。随后，研究转向石墨烯准晶近似体和混合多层堆叠，识别出亚弹道输运和自相似局域化图案作为准晶有序的特征，同时也展示了它们对无序和层间邻近效应的强烈脆弱性。最后，论文讨论了悬浮单层石墨烯中的自旋输运，表明原子尺度褶皱会产生短程涨落的 Rashba 场，即使电荷输运仍接近弹道，这些场也能将自旋寿命限制在纳秒量级。总体而言，这些结果为几何、无序和结构复杂性如何支配扭转与褶皱石墨烯体系中的输运现象提供了统一图像。

articles.title: Nonlocal Majorana polarization in non-Hermitian topological superconductors
articles.title_zh: 非厄米拓扑超导体中的非局域 Majorana 极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nonlocal Majorana polarization, defined as the product of the expectation values of the particle-hole operator at opposite halves of the system, has been shown to be a reliable topological indicator that determines the presence and quality of Majorana zero modes in Hermitian topological superconducting setups. In this work, we extend the concept of nonlocal Majorana polarization to the non-Hermitian realm by taking into account the biorthogonal eigenstates and demonstrate its utility by exploring distinct non-Hermitian superconducting systems. In particular, we show that the Majorana polarization can distinguish between Majorana zero modes, trivial zero-energy states, and exceptional points in non-Hermitian superconductors. Also, we introduce the concept of nonlocal Majorana polarization sensitiviy for characterizing the contribution of non-Hermiticity to Majorana polarization. As a byproduct, we find that non-Hermiticity enhances Majorana zero modes robustness, a property captured by the nonlocal Majorana polarization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将非局域 Majorana 极化推广到非厄米体系中，并通过考虑双正交本征态来定义和分析其性质。作者展示了该量能够区分非厄米超导体中的 Majorana 零模、平庸零能态以及异常点。研究还引入了非局域 Majorana 极化灵敏度，用于表征非厄米性对极化的贡献，并发现非厄米性可增强 Majorana 零模的鲁棒性。
authors: Arjun S. Kumar, Jorge Cayao, Oladunjoye A. Awoga
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非局域马约拉纳极化被定义为体系相对两半部分中粒子—空穴算符期望值的乘积，已被证明是一种可靠的拓扑指标，可在厄米拓扑超导设置中判定马约拉纳零模的存在及其质量。在这项工作中，我们通过考虑双正交本征态，将非局域马约拉纳极化的概念扩展到非厄米领域，并通过探索不同的非厄米超导体系展示其效用。特别地，我们表明，马约拉纳极化能够区分非厄米超导体中的马约拉纳零模、平庸零能态和例外点。此外，我们引入非局域马约拉纳极化灵敏度的概念，用以表征非厄米性对马约拉纳极化的贡献。作为副产物，我们发现非厄米性增强了马约拉纳零模的鲁棒性，而这一性质可由非局域马约拉纳极化捕捉。

articles.title: Don't truncate, decompose: mean-field dynamics of long-range quantum systems from strongly correlated states
articles.title_zh: 不要截断，要分解：强相关初态下长程量子系统的平均场动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We challenge the widespread consensus that mean-field theory fails to describe long-range open quantum systems in the presence of symmetry breaking and/or when starting from strongly correlated states (e.g., macroscopic superpositions). While recent literature relies on cumulant expansions to capture such systems, this approach rests on truncations with no clear justification. Here, we show that it is, at best, conceptually redundant in the strong long-range regime. We show that the evolution can be decomposed into, and fully reconstructed from, independent mean-field dynamics. This decomposition generates the entire hierarchy of cumulants and, as a byproduct, identifies---to our knowledge, for the first time---a regime in which cumulant expansions exactly predict low-order cumulants. We illustrate the power of our findings with two applications: we compute the moment generating function for nonequilibrium Z₂ symmetry breaking, and construct states restoring time-translation symmetry in time crystals. In both cases, our method fully reproduces the exact many-body dynamics, which is out of reach of cumulant expansions. Our results reclaim the exactness of mean-field theory, offering a transparent framework for large-scale open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文质疑一种常见观点，即在对称性破缺和/或强相关初态（如宏观叠加态）下，平均场理论无法描述长程开放量子系统。作者指出，依赖累积量展开的做法本质上建立在缺乏严格依据的截断之上，而在强长程极限中，这种方法在概念上甚至是多余的。研究表明，系统演化可以分解为相互独立的平均场动力学并由此完全重构，从而精确生成整个累积量层级，并在特定情形下精确预测低阶累积量；该方法还成功重现了 Z₂ 对称破缺和时间晶体中的多体动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们挑战一种广泛共识，即在存在对称性破缺和/或从强关联态（例如宏观叠加态）出发时，平均场理论无法描述长程开放量子系统。尽管近期文献依赖累积量展开来捕捉此类系统，但这种方法建立在缺乏明确依据的截断之上。在这里，我们表明，在强长程区域中，这种方法至多在概念上是冗余的。我们表明，演化可以分解为独立的平均场动力学，并可由这些动力学完全重构。这种分解生成了整个累积量层级，并且作为副产物，据我们所知首次识别出一个累积量展开能够精确预测低阶累积量的区域。我们通过两个应用展示了这些发现的力量：我们计算了非平衡 Z₂ 对称性破缺的矩母函数，并构造了在时间晶体中恢复时间平移对称性的态。在这两种情况下，我们的方法都完全再现了精确的多体动力学，而这是累积量展开无法企及的。我们的结果重新确认了平均场理论的精确性，为大规模开放量子系统提供了一个透明框架。

articles.title: To Blink or Not to Blink? A New Criterion to Quantify Luminescence Blinking
articles.title_zh: 闪不闪烁？一种量化发光闪烁的新判据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Colloidal semiconductor quantum dots are promising materials for numerous applications due to their tunable emission and high quantum yields. However, emission instability in the form of luminescence blinking remains a significant obstacle to their practical implementation. While recent advances in synthesis and surface engineering have demonstrated partial or complete blinking suppression, the quantitative assessment of the "quality" of this suppression remains challenging. Existing criteria typically rely on threshold-based classification into ON and OFF states, which becomes inherently ambiguous owing to the continuous distribution of emission intensities in single quantum dots. Here, we propose a threshold-free two-dimensional quantitative criterion based on the variance of the recombination rate and the relative quantum yield, both of which can be extracted from standard time-correlated single-photon counting measurements. We validate the criterion using simulated blinking trajectories covering all major blinking mechanisms and demonstrate that it cleanly separates them into distinct regions of the two-dimensional parameter space while providing a quantitative measure of the degree of suppression. This approach directly quantifies the temporal stability of emission without requiring arbitrary state definitions, thereby providing a robust metric for comparing different blinking suppression strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对胶体半导体量子点中普遍存在的发光闪烁问题，提出了一种无需阈值的二维定量判据。该判据基于复合速率方差与相对量子产率，两者都可由标准时间相关单光子计数测量提取。作者用涵盖主要闪烁机制的模拟轨迹验证了该方法，表明它能够将不同机制清晰区分到二维参数空间中的不同区域。
authors: Eduard A. Podshivaylov, Pavel A. Frantsuzov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 胶体半导体量子点由于其可调发射和高量子产率，是众多应用中的有前景材料。然而，以发光闪烁形式出现的发射不稳定性仍是其实际实施的重要障碍。尽管近期在合成和表面工程方面的进展已经展示出部分或完全的闪烁抑制，但对这种抑制“质量”的定量评估仍具挑战。现有判据通常依赖于基于阈值的开态和关态分类，而由于单个量子点发射强度呈连续分布，这种分类在本质上变得含糊。在这里，我们提出一种无需阈值的二维定量判据，该判据基于复合速率方差和相对量子产率，二者均可从标准时间相关单光子计数测量中提取。我们使用覆盖所有主要闪烁机制的模拟闪烁轨迹验证该判据，并展示它能够在二维参数空间的不同区域中清晰地区分这些机制，同时提供对抑制程度的定量度量。该方法无需任意的状态定义即可直接量化发射的时间稳定性，因此为比较不同闪烁抑制策略提供了稳健指标。

articles.title: Tip-Tuned Renormalization-Group Spectroscopy Unmasks a False-positive Topological Superconducting Vortex
articles.title_zh: 通过偏压可调的重整化群谱学揭示一个假阳性的拓扑超导涡旋
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25510v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Clean, nonsplit vortex zero-bias peaks (ZBPs) can be misinterpreted as Majorana zero modes (MZMs), making static scanning tunneling microscopy intrinsically ambiguous. Here we use the STM tip coupling to drive a local boundary-renormalization-group (boundary RG) flow, turning dynamical Coulomb blockade into a falsification test for Majorana-like ZBPs. Experimentally, in a SrSn₃ thin film, normal-state spectra establish an Ohmic dissipative environment, and a common boundary-RG/thermodynamic-Bethe-ansatz analysis of the superconducting-gap and vortex-center spectra yields consistent dissipation strengths within the r < 1/2 Majorana-filter regime. Lowering the tip nevertheless drives a clean, non-split vortex-center ZBP into a zero-bias dip, opposite to the protected flow of an isolated MZM, unmasking the peak as a Majorana false positive produced by a conventional vortex-core state. The same flow selectively suppresses the strongly tip-coupled channel, resolving the two-gap superconductivity. Dissipative STM thus tests dynamical protection rather than spectral appearance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，干净且不分裂的涡旋零偏压峰可能被误判为 Majorana 零模，因此静态扫描隧道显微镜具有固有歧义。作者利用 STM 探针耦合驱动局域边界重整化群流动，将动力学库仑阻塞转化为检验 Majorana 类零偏压峰的反证手段。以 SrSn₃ 薄膜为例，实验与边界 RG/热力学 Bethe Ansatz 分析一致表明，涡旋中心的零偏压峰在降低探针耦合时会转变为零偏压谷，表明其并非受保护的 Majorana 零模，而是常规涡旋核态产生的假阳性信号。
authors: Zhenhua Zhu, Qun Zhu, Yong-Wei Wang, Gu Zhang, Jihai Zhang, Xu-Cun Ma, Qi-Kun Xue, Can-Li Song, Dong E. Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 干净且未劈裂的涡旋零偏压峰（ZBP）可能被误解为马约拉纳零模（MZM），这使得静态扫描隧道显微镜在本质上具有歧义。在这里，我们利用 STM 针尖耦合来驱动局域边界重整化群（边界 RG）流，将动力学库仑阻塞转化为对类马约拉纳 ZBP 的证伪检验。在实验上，对于 SrSn₃ 薄膜，正常态谱建立了一个欧姆耗散环境，而对超导能隙谱和涡旋中心谱进行共同的边界 RG/热力学 Bethe ansatz 分析，在 r < 1/2 的马约拉纳过滤区域内给出了相一致的耗散强度。然而，降低针尖仍将一个干净、未劈裂的涡旋中心 ZBP 驱动为零偏压谷，这与孤立 MZM 的受保护流相反，从而揭示该峰是由常规涡旋芯态产生的马约拉纳假阳性。同一流选择性地抑制强针尖耦合通道，从而分辨出双能隙超导性。因此，耗散 STM 检验的是动力学保护，而不是谱线外观。

articles.title: Finite-temperature Lanczos for anisotropic spin systems using triple-hybrid high-performance computing
articles.title_zh: 使用三重混合高性能计算的各向异性自旋系统有限温度 Lanczos 方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25585v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lanczos concepts are often realized on supercomputers. In view of modern architectures of high-performance computing triple-hybrid schemes employing MPI, CPU-openMP as well as GPU-openMP should be utilized. The present article sketches how such a scheme could be utilized in order to meet the demands of the finite-temperature Lanczos method for anisotropic spin systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论了有限温度 Lanczos 方法在各向异性自旋系统中的高性能实现。作者指出，面向现代超算架构，应采用结合 MPI、CPU-openMP 与 GPU-openMP 的三重混合方案。文章概述了该方案如何满足有限温度 Lanczos 计算的需求，并为大规模自旋体系模拟提供实现思路。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Lanczos 概念常常在超级计算机上实现。鉴于现代高性能计算架构，应当利用同时采用 MPI、CPU-openMP 以及 GPU-openMP 的三重混合方案。本文概述了如何利用这样一种方案，以满足各向异性自旋系统的有限温度 Lanczos 方法的需求。

articles.title: Entanglement asymmetry in the gapped XYZ spin-frac12 chain
articles.title_zh: gapped XYZ 自旋 1/2 链中的纠缠不对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The entanglement asymmetry measures how strongly a symmetry is broken inside a subsystem. Analytic results at equilibrium have so far covered free theories and, perturbatively, the critical XXZ chain. We compute the Rényi entanglement asymmetries of a large interval in the gapped, U(1)-breaking phase of the interacting XYZ chain. The calculation combines three ingredients. A charged-moment identity, which we prove for fermionic Gaussian and for injective matrix-product ground states, ties the asymmetry to the static susceptibility of the broken charge. A non-conservation sum rule then evaluates the susceptibility from sine-Gordon form factors, its two-kink and one-breather channels providing a lower bound on the universal amplitude. The Baxter--Johnson--Krinsky--McCoy solution supplies the kink mass for different couplings. Infinite-system density-matrix renormalization group simulations built on these masses reproduce the master formula.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了相互作用 XYZ 链在打开 U(1) 对称性破缺的有隙相中的 Rényi 纠缠不对称性，考虑的是大区间的平衡态。作者结合了多个结果：证明了一条荷矩恒等式，并将纠缠不对称性与破缺电荷的静态磁化率联系起来；随后利用正弦-Gordon 模型的 form factor 以及 Baxter–Johnson–Krinsky–McCoy 解来求得相关量。最终，数值密度矩阵重整化群结果验证了所得主公式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠不对称性衡量一个子系统内部对称性被破缺的强度。迄今为止，平衡态下的解析结果只涵盖自由理论，以及在微扰意义上的临界 XXZ 链。我们计算了相互作用 XYZ 链在有能隙、破缺 U(1) 相中一个大区间的 Rényi 纠缠不对称性。该计算结合了三个要素。我们为费米高斯态和注入型矩阵乘积基态证明的一个带电矩恒等式，将不对称性与破缺荷的静态磁化率联系起来。随后，一个非守恒求和规则利用 sine-Gordon 形状因子评估该磁化率，其中双孤子通道和单呼吸子通道为普适振幅提供下界。Baxter--Johnson--Krinsky--McCoy 解给出了不同耦合下的孤子质量。基于这些质量构建的无限体系密度矩阵重整化群模拟再现了主公式。

articles.title: Physical Mechanism of Vacuole Formation in Liquid Droplets
articles.title_zh: 液滴中空泡形成的物理机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vacuoles have been observed in liquid droplets across variety of experimental systems, ranging from biomolecular condensates composed of proteins and RNA, to synthetic coacervates formed by charged polymers or synthetic nanostars. These vacuoles are long-lived domains depleted of droplet material, and their formation is puzzling because the associated increase in interfacial area is thermodynamically unfavorable. Using theory, we show that vacuoles form through a generic mechanism: a local spinodal instability within the droplet. We demonstrate this mechanism in several experimentally relevant scenarios, including temperature quenches and droplets coupled to chemical processes occurring either inside or outside the droplet. Using non-equilibrium thermodynamics, we develop a theoretical framework that identifies the physicochemical conditions controlling whether vacuoles form and how big vacuoles can become. Our results suggest molecular designs and chemical pathways that promote vacuolation, enabling multi-compartment formation with engineered functions such as enhanced surface catalysis and compartment fission.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在多种实验体系中观察到的液滴内部空泡现象，包括蛋白质和 RNA 组成的生物分子凝聚体，以及带电聚合物或合成纳米星形成的共沉淀液滴。作者提出，空泡形成源于液滴内部的局域自旋分解不稳定性，这是一种通用机制。借助非平衡热力学框架，文章分析了温度淬火及液滴内外化学过程耦合等情形下空泡形成的条件与尺寸，并指出这些结果可为设计促进多隔室形成的分子方案提供指导。
authors: Pranay Jaiswal, Ivar S. Haugerud, William Verstraeten, Kerstin Göpfrich, Job Boekhoven, Christoph A. Weber
articles.abstract_zh_full: 液泡已在多种实验体系的液滴中被观察到，这些体系从由蛋白质和 RNA 组成的生物分子凝聚体，到由带电聚合物或合成纳米星形成的合成复合凝聚体不等。这些液泡是长期存在的、缺乏液滴材料的结构域，而它们的形成令人困惑，因为相关界面面积的增加在热力学上是不利的。利用理论，我们表明液泡通过一种普适机制形成：液滴内部的局域旋节线不稳定性。我们在若干实验相关情景中展示了这一机制，包括温度淬火以及与发生在液滴内部或外部的化学过程相耦合的液滴。利用非平衡热力学，我们发展了一个理论框架，用以识别控制液泡是否形成以及液泡能够长到多大的物理化学条件。我们的结果提出了促进液泡化的分子设计和化学路径，从而能够形成具有工程化功能的多隔室结构，例如增强表面催化和隔室裂变。

articles.title: Critical Ripples and Dirac Fermions in Crystalline Membranes
articles.title_zh: 晶体膜中的临界褶皱与狄拉克费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystalline membranes hosting Dirac fermions, with graphene as the paradigmatic example, combine two low-energy sectors with sharply different dynamics: nonrelativistic flexural phonons and relativistic-like Dirac quasiparticles. We develop the low-energy field theory of this coupled system at charge neutrality and determine how this dynamical mismatch controls the coupling between the two sectors. In the long-wavelength flat phase, rotational symmetry ties the renormalization of the leading local scalar strain--density coupling to the scale-dependent bending rigidity, causing its dimensionless strength to decrease logarithmically. At the same time, flexural modes become parametrically slower than the Dirac fermions, so the resulting fermionic feedback vanishes as a power law.The flat phase is therefore stable against this perturbation. The physics changes when elastic interactions or electronic softening destabilize the membrane at a finite wavelength, selecting a ripple pattern formed by modes at ±Q. For an isolated pair of ordering wavevectors, provided that commensurability-induced phase pinning is irrelevant, the transition is governed by the bosonic Wilson--Fisher fixed point, while the Dirac fermions remain spectators. A genuinely hybrid electronic--structural critical point arises instead when symmetry permits a mass-type Dirac bilinear to share the ripple's momentum and quantum numbers, including horizontal-reflection parity. The transition is then described by the chiral-XY Gross--Neveu--Yukawa universality class. Using the known one-loop critical exponents, we characterize this transition, determine the induced secondary elastic distortion, and show that the fermionic and bosonic velocities lock in the isotropic continuum limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了含狄拉克费米子的晶体膜低能场论，以石墨烯为典型例子，研究非相对论性的挠曲声子与类相对论狄拉克准粒子之间的耦合。作者分析了电中性条件下这种动力学失配如何控制两个低能部门的相互作用，并指出在平坦相中，相关无量纲耦合会随尺度对数衰减，同时费米子反馈按幂律消失，因此该相对于这一扰动是稳定的。进一步地，当弹性相互作用或电子软化在有限波矢处诱发不稳定性时，体系会进入由 ±Q 模式构成的褶皱图样，文中讨论了相应的转变机制。
authors: Sebastián Bahamondes, Rodrigo Soto-Garrido, Enrique Muñoz, Vladimir Juričić
articles.abstract_zh_full: 承载狄拉克费米子的晶体膜，以石墨烯为典型例子，结合了两个动力学截然不同的低能部门：非相对论的弯曲声子和类相对论的狄拉克准粒子。我们发展了这一耦合体系在电荷中性处的低能场论，并确定这种动力学失配如何控制两个部门之间的耦合。在长波长平坦相中，转动对称性将主导的局域标量应变—密度耦合的重整化与尺度依赖的弯曲刚度联系起来，使其无量纲强度以对数形式减小。与此同时，弯曲模相对于狄拉克费米子变得参数上更慢，因此由此产生的费米子反馈按幂律消失。因此，平坦相对该扰动是稳定的。当弹性相互作用或电子软化在有限波长处使膜失稳，并选择由 ±Q 模形成的褶皱图案时，物理图像发生变化。对于一对孤立的有序波矢，只要由公度性诱导的相位钉扎是不相关的，该转变就由玻色 Wilson--Fisher 固定点控制，而狄拉克费米子仍是旁观者。相反，当对称性允许一种质量型狄拉克双线性具有与褶皱相同的动量和量子数，包括水平反射宇称时，就会出现真正的电子—结构混合临界点。此时该转变由手征 XY Gross--Neveu--Yukawa 普适类描述。利用已知的一圈临界指数，我们刻画了这一转变，确定了诱导的次级弹性畸变，并表明在各向同性连续极限中费米子速度和玻色速度会锁定。

articles.title: Ro-vibrational van der Waals interaction between ultracold polar molecules
articles.title_zh: 超冷极性分子中的转动-振动范德瓦耳斯相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25774v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe the ro-vibrational van der Waals interaction between ultracold polar molecules. This interaction is strong, leading to fast elastic collisions and orders of magnitude suppression of collisional loss. This enables evaporative cooling of Fermi mixtures of molecules in different ro-vibrational states, without active shielding by applying external fields. The scheme is compatible with microwave shielding, where it enables controlled state dependent interactions, opening up new opportunities for quantum simulation and impurity physics. The interaction can also be used to stabilize fermionic molecules in optical lattices, to control interactions in synthetic dimensions, for enhanced tweezer loading, and direct infrared shielding.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了超冷极性分子之间的转动-振动范德瓦耳斯相互作用。结果表明，这种相互作用强度很大，可显著加快弹性碰撞并大幅抑制碰撞损失，从而在无需外场主动屏蔽的情况下实现不同转动-振动态分子费米混合物的蒸发冷却。该方案还可与微波屏蔽结合，用于实现可控的态依赖相互作用，并可拓展到量子模拟、杂质物理、光晶格稳定化和俘获阱装载等应用。
authors: Kang Feng, Hanwei Yang, Hubert J. Jóźwiak, Tijs Karman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们描述了超冷极性分子之间的转动—振动范德华相互作用。这种相互作用很强，会导致快速弹性碰撞，并使碰撞损失降低数个数量级。这使得不同转动—振动态分子的费米混合物能够进行蒸发冷却，而无需通过施加外场进行主动屏蔽。该方案与微波屏蔽相兼容，在其中它能够实现受控的态依赖相互作用，为量子模拟和杂质物理开辟新的机会。该相互作用还可用于稳定光晶格中的费米分子、控制合成维度中的相互作用、增强光镊装载，以及实现直接红外屏蔽。

articles.title: Fluctuation-dissipation violations in mean-field non-reciprocal spin glasses
articles.title_zh: 非互易平均场自旋玻璃中的涨落-耗散定理违背
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the out-of-equilibrium dynamics of the spherical Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model with non-reciprocal asymmetric couplings. Rather than assuming stationarity, we derive the conditions under which the dynamical mean-field equations admit stable time-translational invariant solutions. We analytically solve the asymptotics of the correlation and response functions in the symmetric, uncorrelated and antisymmetric limits, showing that the fluctuation-dissipation theorem is generically violated in the presence of non-reciprocity despite exponential relaxation, due to broken detailed balance rather than aging. Numerical results for generic asymmetry allow us to interpolate between these solvable limit cases, revealing faster dynamics as the asymmetry increases, together with oscillatory dynamics driven by antisymmetric couplings. These results provide a reference framework for understanding the dynamics of disordered, non-reciprocal systems, disentangling two distinct origins of fluctuation-dissipation violations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有非互易非对称耦合的球形 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型的非平衡动力学。作者在不预设平稳性的前提下，推导了动力学平均场方程存在稳定时间平移不变解的条件，并解析求解了对称、无相关和反对称极限下关联函数与响应函数的长时行为。结果表明，在非互易性存在时，尽管体系呈指数弛豫，涨落-耗散定理仍普遍失效，其根源是详细平衡破缺而非老化效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究具有非互易非对称耦合的球形 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型的非平衡动力学。我们不是假设平稳性，而是推导动力学平均场方程允许稳定的时间平移不变解的条件。我们解析求解了对称、无关联和反对称极限下关联函数和响应函数的渐近行为，表明在存在非互易性时，尽管呈指数弛豫，涨落—耗散定理通常仍被违背，这是由于细致平衡被破坏而非老化所致。对于一般非对称性的数值结果使我们能够在这些可解极限情形之间进行插值，揭示出随着非对称性增加而加快的动力学，以及由反对称耦合驱动的振荡动力学。这些结果为理解无序非互易系统的动力学提供了一个参考框架，区分了涨落—耗散违背的两种不同起源。

articles.title: Programmable Bulk Topological Channels via Strain Engineering
articles.title_zh: 通过应变工程实现可编程的体内拓扑通道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accumulated disorder at physical boundaries prevents the realization of ideal zero-dissipation topological edge channels. Here, we propose a strain engineering mechanism to create a topological domain wall in the pristine material bulk, thereby generating interior chiral channels spatially decoupled from physical boundaries. Quantum transport simulations reveal that these interior channels exhibit exceptional immunity to severe boundary disorder, maintaining an ideal vortex-free transport morphology. Furthermore, the spatial position and confinement of these interior channels can be quantitatively programmed. Under a linear gradient strain field, the channel width obeys an inverse square-root scaling law with respect to the strain gradient. In a high-Chern-number phase (|C|=2), we design the spatial splitting and merging of co-propagating chiral channels, suggesting a topological Mach-Zehnder-like geometry. These results suggest a route toward programmable bulk topological transport and reconfigurable topological circuitry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种利用应变工程在材料体内构造拓扑畴壁的方法，从而形成与物理边界解耦的内部手性通道。量子输运模拟显示，这些通道对严重的边界无序具有极强鲁棒性，并保持理想的无涡旋输运形态。作者还展示了通道位置与约束范围的可编程调控，并在高陈数相中实现了共传播手性通道的分裂与合并，指向可重构的拓扑电路设计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理边界处积累的无序会阻碍理想无耗散拓扑边缘通道的实现。这里，我们提出一种应变工程机制，在无缺陷材料的体相中构造拓扑畴壁，从而生成与物理边界在空间上解耦的内部手性通道。量子输运模拟表明，这些内部通道对严重的边界无序具有极强的免疫性，并保持理想的无涡旋输运动形。此外，这些内部通道的空间位置与束缚宽度可以被定量编程。在线性梯度应变场下，通道宽度相对于应变梯度遵循反平方根标度律。在一个高陈数相（|C|=2）中，我们设计了同向传播手性通道的空间分裂与合并，提示了一种类似拓扑迈克耳孙干涉仪的几何结构。这些结果表明，可为可编程体相拓扑输运与可重构拓扑电路开辟一条途径。

articles.title: Interacting hydrodynamic modes in spinless fermions with dephasing noise
articles.title_zh: 带退相干噪声的无自旋费米子中的相互作用流体动力学模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the non-equilibrium dynamics of spinless fermions with dephasing noise in the framework of a many-particle Lindblad equation. Using a mapping to the exactly solvable one-dimensional Hubbard model with purely imaginary tunneling amplitude we analyze the Heisenberg-picture dynamics of operators quartic in fermions and determine their hydrodynamic projections. We construct the relevant diffusive eigenoperators explicitly and show that, in the quartic sector, they can be interpreted as interacting pairs of bilinear hydrodynamic modes. As a consequence, translationally invariant quartic operators generically exhibit non-vanishing diffusive late-time tails, unlike translationally invariant bilinears. Our results show that the hydrodynamic tails of microscopic operators cannot in general be inferred from symmetry constraints or coarse-grained fluctuating hydrodynamics alone; they also depend crucially on the spatial structure and effective size of the hydrodynamic eigenoperators.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了带退相干噪声的无自旋费米子在多体 Lindblad 方程框架下的非平衡动力学。借助到一个具有纯虚跃迁幅的可精确求解一维 Hubbard 模型的映射，作者分析了四费米算符在海森堡绘景中的演化及其流体动力学投影，并显式构造了相关的扩散本征算符。结果表明，四次算符可解释为两个双线性流体动力学模的相互作用对，因此其晚时尾项一般不为零，这说明微观算符的流体动力学行为不能仅由对称性或粗粒化涨落流体理论完全决定。
authors: Fabian H. L. Essler, Patrik Penc
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在多粒子 Lindblad 方程框架下研究了带退相干噪声的无自旋费米子的非平衡动力学。利用与具有纯虚跳跃振幅的一维 Hubbard 模型的精确映射，我们分析了海森堡绘景中费米子四次算符的动力学，并确定了它们的流体力学投影。我们显式构造了相关的扩散本征算符，并表明在四次算符部分，这些本征算符可以解释为双线性流体力学模的相互作用对。因此，平移不变的四次算符通常会在长时极限中呈现非零的扩散尾，而平移不变的双线性算符则不会。我们的结果表明，微观算符的流体力学尾部一般不能仅由对称性约束或粗粒化的涨落流体力学推断；它们还在很大程度上取决于流体力学本征算符的空间结构和有效尺度。

articles.title: Solvable Quantum Circuits with non-Markovian Influence Matrices
articles.title_zh: 具有非马尔可夫影响矩阵的可解量子电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Influence matrices encode the action exerted on local subsystems by the rest of an extended quantum many-body system during their evolution. Thus, knowledge of the influence matrix facilitates computationally efficient simulations of local dynamics. Here we propose a new systematic approach to generating quantum circuits with complex dynamics for which the influence matrices can be written down exactly. In contrast to previous frameworks of this kind, such as dual-unitary circuits, the resulting influence matrices are non-Markovian, exhibiting nontrivial temporal correlations. We explicitly construct a broad family of circuits of this kind, based on dressing free-fermion (matchgate) circuits with appropriately chosen interaction terms. We show that, contrary to previous solvable instances, these circuits produce patterns of correlations that closely resemble that of typical many-body systems. Our approach can be directly interpreted in terms of an error correction scheme where the terms breaking the solvability of the influence matrices play the role of errors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种系统方法，用于构造局域子系统影响矩阵可精确写出的复杂量子电路。与以往的双幺正电路等框架不同，这里得到的影响矩阵具有非马尔可夫性，体现出非平凡的时间相关结构。作者基于对 free-fermion（matchgate）电路施加适当相互作用项的“装饰”构造出一大类可解电路，并指出其关联模式更接近典型多体系统，可从误差纠正的角度理解其可解性来源。
authors: Samuel H. Pickering, Max McGinley, Bhavik Kumar, Bruno Bertini
articles.abstract_zh_full: 影响矩阵刻画了扩展量子多体系统在演化过程中对局域子系统施加的作用。因此，了解影响矩阵有助于高效地模拟局域动力学。本文提出了一种新的系统性方法，用于生成动力学复杂且其影响矩阵可以精确写出的量子电路。与双幺正电路等此前的同类框架不同，这里得到的影响矩阵是非马尔可夫的，表现出非平凡的时间相关性。我们显式构造了这类电路的一个广泛家族，其基础是用恰当选择的相互作用项对自由费米子（matchgate）电路进行修饰。我们表明，与此前可解实例相反，这些电路产生的相关图样与典型多体系统的行为非常相似。我们的方法还可以直接从误差纠正方案的角度来理解，其中破坏影响矩阵可解性的项扮演误差的角色。

articles.title: Superfluidity without charge order in the attractive Hubbard model on the kagome lattice
articles.title_zh: kagome 晶格吸引 Hubbard 模型中无电荷序的超流性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25983v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we study the zero-temperature attractive Hubbard model on the kagome lattice at various relevant electronic fillings. The low-energy physics at 2/3-density is influenced by the Dirac point at the Fermi energy, wherein we unveil a superfluid transition at a critical attractive interaction U_c/t=-4.58(3), which belongs to the chiral-XY universality class. This U(1) symmetry-breaking is not accompanied by charge order, even for substantially large interaction strengths, in a regime where a description in terms of hardcore bosons becomes increasingly suitable. An investigation of the latter shows that charge ordering at 1/3-filling only occurs at interaction strengths much larger than those corresponding to the mapping to the original fermionic model. Additionally, for densities exhibiting van Hove singularities in the non-interacting density of states, our results show that any attractive interaction gives rise to superfluidity, yet again without charge ordering, contrary to recent studies employing mean-field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用辅助场量子蒙特卡洛模拟研究了 kagome 晶格上零温吸引 Hubbard 模型在若干相关填充下的性质。结果显示，在 2/3 粒子密度处，费米能级附近的狄拉克点主导低能物理，并出现属于手性 XY 普适类的超流相变，而 U(1) 对称性破缺并不伴随电荷有序。即使在较强相互作用下，这种无电荷序的超流性仍然成立；在 1/3 填充时，电荷有序只会在远强于映射到硬核玻色子情形的相互作用下出现。
authors: Xiaodong Jin, Yingping Mou, Rubem Mondaini
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用辅助场量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究 kagome 晶格上零温吸引型 Hubbard 模型在若干相关电子填充下的性质。在 2/3 密度处，低能物理受费米能级处狄拉克点的影响，我们揭示出一个超流相变，其临界吸引相互作用为 U_c/t=-4.58(3)，并属于手性 XY 普适类。这个 U(1) 对称性破缺并不伴随电荷序，即使在相当大的相互作用强度下也是如此；在该区域，用硬核玻色子来描述体系变得越来越合适。对后者的研究表明，1/3 填充处的电荷序只会在远大于映射到原始费米子模型所对应的相互作用强度下出现。此外，对于在非相互作用态密度中具有范霍夫奇点的密度，我们的结果显示，任意吸引相互作用都会导致超流性，但同样不会出现电荷序，这与近期采用平均场理论的研究结论相反。

articles.title: Efficient computation of real-time correlators using Pauli Propagation
articles.title_zh: 利用 Pauli 传播高效计算实时时间关联函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24924v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pauli propagation has shown promise for classically simulating quantum dynamics by evolving observables directly in the Heisenberg picture. In this work, we investigate its use for computing real-time two-point time-ordered correlators in one- and two-dimensional quantum systems. One major limitation of Pauli propagation is the rapid growth in the number of Pauli strings beyond short times. We overcome this limitation by combining accurate short-time Pauli-propagation data with time extension methods based on a positivity condition and the observation that the dynamics are often dominated by a small number of characteristic frequencies. This combined approach extends correlation functions far beyond the directly accessible time window while avoiding the exponential proliferation of Pauli operators. We demonstrate that the resulting correlators retain the relevant dynamical and spectral information. Our results broaden the regime in which classical methods can reliably probe the real-time dynamics of interacting quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了 Pauli 传播在经典模拟量子动力学中的应用，重点面向一维和二维量子系统的实时间二点时序关联函数计算。作者通过将精确的短时 Pauli 传播数据与基于正性条件和少数特征频率主导性的时间外推方法结合，克服了 Pauli 字符串数目快速增长的瓶颈。该方法能够将关联函数推到远超直接可达的时间范围，同时保持关键的动力学与谱信息。
authors: Alexander F. Kemper, Raghav G. Jha, Arnab Bachhar, Goksu C. Toga, Mariano Guerrero Perez, Nicholas J. Mayhall
articles.abstract_zh_full: Pauli 传播已显示出通过在海森堡绘景中直接演化可观测量来经典模拟量子动力学的潜力。本文研究其用于计算一维和二维量子系统中实时间二点时序关联函数的能力。Pauli 传播的一个主要局限在于，Pauli 字符串的数量会在短时间之后迅速增长。我们通过将准确的短时 Pauli 传播数据与时间延拓方法相结合来克服这一限制；这些时间延拓方法基于正定性条件以及动力学通常由少数特征频率主导这一观察。该联合方法将关联函数延伸到远超直接可访问的时间窗口，同时避免了 Pauli 算符的指数式膨胀。我们表明，所得关联函数保留了相关的动力学和谱信息。我们的结果扩大了经典方法能够可靠探测相互作用量子多体系统实时间动力学的适用范围。

articles.title: Numerical Modeling of Quasiparticle-Induced Dissipation in Fluxonium Qubits
articles.title_zh: 通量子超导比特中准粒子诱导耗散的数值建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24946v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nonequilibrium quasiparticles (QPs) generated by stray infrared and ionizing radiation can limit the performance of superconducting quantum processors and present challenges for quantum error correction schemes. Models of QP-induced energy relaxation commonly assume that the characteristic energy of the QPs and the qubit transition energy are both small relative to the superconducting gap. Under these assumptions, certain qubits such as the fluxonium would exhibit protection against QP-induced dissipation at specific bias points. Here, we show that this is not necessarily the case, numerically analyzing the predicted rate of QP-induced dissipation in fluxonium qubits for different QP energy distributions and for QPs created via photon-assisted tunneling processes. We find that accounting for small numerical factors, existing theoretical models predict sensitivity to QP-induced errors at bias points previously thought to be protected. We find that inclusion of asymmetry in the superconducting gap energy across the junction can reintroduce suppression of QP-induced relaxation, as expected. Additionally, for QPs created by photon-assisted tunneling, we predict that T₁ protection will only occur for a specific energy of pair-breaking radiation. This understanding of fluxonium sensitivity to QP-induced dissipation informs the development of fluxonium-based processors and future QP-mitigation strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文数值分析了通量子超导比特中非平衡准粒子引起的能量弛豫。作者表明，在常见理论模型所采用的近似条件下，某些原本被认为具有保护作用的偏置点，实际上仍可能对准粒子诱导误差敏感；考虑数值因子后，这一效应更加明显。研究还发现，引入结两侧超导能隙不对称性可重新带来对弛豫的抑制，符合此前的直觉预期。
authors: Kate Azar, Max Hays, Kyle Serniak
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由杂散红外和电离辐射产生的非平衡准粒子会限制超导量子处理器的性能，并给量子纠错方案带来挑战。关于准粒子诱导能量弛豫的模型通常假设准粒子的特征能量和量子比特跃迁能量都相对于超导能隙很小。在这些假设下，某些量子比特（如 fluxonium）在特定偏置点应当对准粒子诱导耗散具有保护性。本文通过数值分析 fluxonium 量子比特在不同准粒子能量分布以及由光子辅助隧穿过程产生的准粒子情形下的预期耗散速率，表明这一结论并不一定成立。我们发现，在考虑一些较小的数值因子后，现有理论模型会预测在此前被认为受保护的偏置点上仍然对准粒子诱导误差敏感。我们还发现，如果考虑结间超导能隙能量的不对称性，则会重新出现对准粒子诱导弛豫的抑制，这与预期一致。此外，对于由光子辅助隧穿产生的准粒子，我们预测只有在特定的断对辐射能量下，T₁ 保护才会出现。对 fluxonium 对准粒子诱导耗散敏感性的这一理解，有助于 fluxonium 基量子处理器的发展以及未来的准粒子抑制策略设计。

articles.title: A Kernel-Based Density of States Estimator for Quantum Computing
articles.title_zh: 面向量子计算的核函数式态密度估计器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24972v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The density of states (DoS) encodes the thermodynamic and spectral properties of quantum many-body systems, yet its reconstruction becomes intractable for Hilbert spaces too large to diagonalize. Classically, the kernel polynomial method (KPM) addresses this by combining stochastic trace estimation with a smoothing kernel. Here we show that the Rodeo algorithm---one of the simplest eigenvalue-location protocols for near-term quantum hardware---provides a direct quantum analogue of this approach. Averaging the Rodeo response over Haar-random input states yields the DoS convolved with a spectral kernel fixed entirely by the distribution of evolution times: the random states play the role of stochastic trace estimation, and the temporal sampling distribution that of the damping kernel. The construction requires only the standard single-ancilla circuit, and quantum typicality suppresses the statistical error as the Hilbert-space dimension grows. We derive the estimator and its uncertainties, establish an explicit dictionary between signal-processing window functions and quantum reconstruction kernels, and validate the method on the one-dimensional transverse-field Ising and spin-1 models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种利用 Rodeo 算法估计量子多体系统态密度的量子方案，可视为核多项式方法在近端量子硬件上的直接对应物。对 Haar 随机输入态的平均表明，Rodeo 响应等于与由演化时间分布决定的谱核卷积后的态密度，其中随机态承担随机迹估计的作用，而时间采样分布相当于阻尼核。作者给出了该估计器及其不确定度的推导，并建立了信号处理窗口函数与量子重构核之间的明确对应关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 态密度编码了量子多体系统的热力学与谱性质，但当希尔伯特空间过大、无法对角化时，其重构便变得不可行。经典上，核多项式法通过随机迹估计与平滑核函数来解决这一问题。本文表明，Rodeo 算法——近未来量子硬件上最简单的本征值定位协议之一——提供了这一思路的直接量子对应物。对 Haar 随机输入态上的 Rodeo 响应取平均后，得到的是与某个谱核卷积后的态密度，而该谱核完全由演化时间分布决定：随机态相当于随机迹估计，而时间采样分布则相当于阻尼核。该构造只需要标准的单辅助比特电路，并且随着希尔伯特空间维度增长，量子典型性会抑制统计误差。我们推导了该估计器及其不确定度，建立了信号处理中的窗函数与量子重构核之间的显式对应，并在一维横场 Ising 模型和自旋 1 模型上验证了该方法。

articles.title: Invariant-based master equation applied to driven qutrit coupled to a bath and a leaky cavity
articles.title_zh: 基于不变量的主方程及其在受驱三能级系统中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25005v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We employ a generalized approach to the master equation for driven open N-level (N>2) quantum systems using Lewis-Riesenfeld invariants, which avoids the driving-strength restrictions inherent to conventional approaches. We show that the invariant-based master equation provides a unifying generalized framework, which reduces to the frequently employed laboratory-frame master equations and the less frequently employed rotating-frame master equation framework under appropriate simplifications. Extending the prototypical two-level system, we show that the inclusion of another state coupled to the ground state via reservoir-induced dephasing gives rise to qualitatively new dissipative behaviors that are, in general, not captured by standard approximations. We also apply the invariant-based master equation framework to a driven quantum dot coupled to a leaky cavity, demonstrating the framework's ability to capture relevant dissipative dynamics without additional assumptions. Our work paves the way for quantum-control applications in the presence of dissipation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用 Lewis-Riesenfeld 不变量推广受驱开放量子系统的主方程形式，适用于 N>2 的多能级系统，并避免了传统方法对驱动强度的限制。该不变量主方程在适当简化下可统一归约为常用的实验室系主方程和较少使用的旋转系主方程。作者进一步将其应用于与耗散浴和有损腔耦合的受驱 qutrit 以及受驱量子点，展示了标准近似难以捕捉的新型耗散行为，并为耗散条件下的量子控制提供了工具。
authors: Sagarika Basak, A. Javadi, D. Blume
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用基于 Lewis-Riesenfeld 不变量的广义方法，研究受驱开放 N 能级（N>2）量子系统的主方程，该方法避免了传统方法所依赖的驱动强度限制。我们表明，这一基于不变量的主方程提供了一个统一的广义框架，在适当简化下可退化为常用的实验室表象主方程，以及较少使用的旋转表象主方程框架。将典型的两能级系统加以扩展后，我们显示：再加入一个通过库诱导退相干与基态相耦合的状态，会导致定性上新的耗散行为，而这些行为通常无法被标准近似所捕捉。我们还将这一基于不变量的主方程框架应用于一个受驱量子点与一个漏损腔的耦合体系，展示了该框架在无需额外假设的情况下捕捉相关耗散动力学的能力。我们的工作为在耗散存在时开展量子控制应用铺平了道路。

articles.title: Many-body Tipping Dynamics of ChatGPT-like AIs
articles.title_zh: 类 ChatGPT 人工智能的多体翻转动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25279v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Why do ChatGPT-like AIs, despite major architectural and training differences, unexpectedly tip to undesirable content (e.g. harmful, misleading, repetitive) even under deterministic greedy decoding? We show that a broad class of such tippings is caused by the many-body interactions between tokens (spins) as they cross the finite-layer system. Tipping emerges as a dynamical first passage process between competing output basins. Attention disorder controls the transport toward, away from, or along the basins' boundary. A few-basin reduction yields a closed finite-layer threshold, whose coarse-grained predictions show good agreement across ChatGPT-like families. These results suggest that a broad class of AI failures represents 'foreseeable engineering risk' rather than inherently unpredictable behavior, with important implications for legal and societal assessments of AI harm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文解释了为何尽管架构与训练方式不同，类 ChatGPT 的模型仍会在确定性贪婪解码下意外“翻转”到有害、误导性或重复等不良输出。作者指出，这类翻转可由有限层网络中 token 之间的多体相互作用引发，并可视为在竞争输出盆地之间的动力学首次到达过程。注意力无序控制系统向盆地边界附近的输运行为，而少数盆地的降维模型给出了跨模型族一致的有限层阈值预测，暗示这类失败属于可预见的工程风险。
authors: Frank Yingjie Huo, Neil F. Johnson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为何类 ChatGPT 的人工智能，尽管在架构和训练上存在很大差异，仍会在即使采用确定性的贪婪解码时意外地翻转到不良内容（例如有害、误导性、重复性内容）？我们表明，这类翻转中的很大一部分是由 token（自旋）在穿越有限层系统时的多体相互作用所导致的。翻转表现为在竞争性的输出吸引域之间发生的动力学首达过程。注意力无序控制着向吸引域、远离吸引域或沿其边界的输运。一个少吸引域约化给出一个封闭的有限层阈值，其粗粒化预测在不同类 ChatGPT 家族中都表现出良好一致性。这些结果表明，一大类 AI 失效可被视为“可预见的工程风险”，而非本质上不可预测的行为，这对 AI 伤害的法律与社会评估具有重要意义。

articles.title: Experiments with interacting ultracold polar molecules
articles.title_zh: 相互作用超冷极性分子的实验研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25519v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ultracold polar molecules have emerged as an exciting platform for experiments in quantum science, with many proposed applications seeking to leverage the existence of long-range dipolar interactions and the rich internal structure of long-lived states. However, the complexity of molecules also presents many experimental challenges. In this chapter, we review the experimental advances over the past two decades that have brought ultracold molecules under full quantum control. We focus on three key topics: control of ultracold molecular collisions, engineering dipolar interactions and nascent quantum simulations in optical lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了超冷极性分子实验研究过去二十年来的进展，重点讨论如何实现对这类体系的完整量子控制。文章围绕三个核心主题展开：超冷分子碰撞控制、偶极相互作用工程，以及在光晶格中开展的初步量子模拟。该综述概括了相关实验平台在复杂分子结构与长程相互作用背景下取得的关键进展，并指出其在量子科学中的广阔应用前景。
authors: Philip D. Gregory, Jonathan M. Mortlock, Daniel K. Ruttley, Simon L. Cornish
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超冷极性分子已成为量子科学实验中一个令人振奋的平台，许多拟议应用都希望利用其长程偶极相互作用以及长寿命态丰富的内部结构。然而，分子的复杂性也带来了许多实验挑战。本文综述了过去二十年间推动超冷分子实现完全量子控制的实验进展，重点讨论三个关键主题：超冷分子碰撞控制、偶极相互作用工程以及在光学晶格中的初步量子模拟。

articles.title: Time-Reversal Invariant Topological Photonic Alloy
articles.title_zh: 时间反演不变的拓扑光子合金
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25769v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conventional approaches generate quantum spin Hall (QSH) and quantum valley Hall (QVH) effects by breaking spatial inversion symmetry across the entire photonic crystal. Consequently, modulating the bulk transmission gaps within these periodic frameworks typically requires global modification of structural parameters throughout the lattice, severely limiting device reconfigurability and post-fabrication adaptability. In this work, we demonstrate that global inversion symmetry breaking is not a prerequisite for inducing topological phases. Instead, local and minimal symmetry breaking is sufficient. Using a photonic alloy platform based on random substitutional disorder in a parallel-plate waveguide, we show that a disorder-driven local breaking of z-direction mirror symmetry and a local breaking of in-plane symmetry are capable of opening topological gaps to trigger QSH and QVH phase transitions, respectively, thereby supporting robust helical edge states and valley kink states. Rigorous topological characterization via the reflection-phase winding method reveals a striking size-dependent scaling behavior in both configurations, where the threshold doping concentration required to trigger the topological phase transition asymptotically vanishes in the thermodynamic limit. By enabling flexible, on-demand bulk gap engineering simply through random doping tuning rather than global structural reconfigurations, this photonic alloy platform not only deepens understanding of disorder induced topological physics but also offers a scalable, highly efficient design strategy for integrated topological optical communications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，产生量子自旋霍尔态和量子谷霍尔态并不一定需要在整个光子晶体中全局破缺反演对称性。基于平行板波导中的随机替位无序光子合金，作者展示了局域的 z 方向镜面对称性破缺以及局域的面内对称性破缺即可分别打开拓扑能隙，诱导 QSH 与 QVH 相变，并支持稳健的螺旋边缘态和谷畴壁态。反射相位绕转分析进一步揭示了这两类拓扑相的尺寸依赖标度行为。
authors: Feng Ruili, Qu Tiantao, Wu Xianbin, Shi Xiaoxuan, He Mujun, Zhang Lei, Chen Jun
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统方法通常通过在整个光子晶体中破缺空间反演对称性来产生量子自旋霍尔（QSH）和量子谷霍尔（QVH）效应。因此，在这类周期体系中调控体传输带隙通常需要对晶格中所有结构参数进行全局修改，这严重限制了器件的可重构性和制备后的适应性。本文表明，全球性的反演对称性破缺并不是诱导拓扑相的必要条件，局域且最小的对称性破缺就足够了。基于平行板波导中的随机替位无序，我们展示了由无序驱动的 z 方向镜面对称性的局域破缺以及面内对称性的局域破缺，分别能够打开拓扑带隙，从而触发 QSH 和 QVH 相变，并支持鲁棒的螺旋边缘态和谷 kink 态。通过反射相绕 winding 方法进行的严格拓扑表征揭示出两种构型中都存在显著的尺寸依赖标度行为，其中触发拓扑相变所需的阈值掺杂浓度在热力学极限中渐近趋于零。该光子合金平台只需通过调节随机掺杂而非全局结构重构，即可实现灵活、按需的体带隙工程，不仅加深了对无序诱导拓扑物理的理解，也为集成拓扑光通信提供了一种可扩展且高效率的设计策略。

articles.title: Deterministic loading of molecular arrays by microwave-assisted collisions
articles.title_zh: 基于微波辅助碰撞的分子阵列确定性装载
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25783v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Molecular tweezer arrays offer great prospects for quantum simulation, sensing, and computing, and would benefit from methods that enhance loading efficiency. Whereas light-assisted collisions underpin enhanced loading methods for atomic tweezer arrays, this approach cannot be directly extended to molecular arrays due to collisional loss. We show how this collisional loss can be suppressed by shelving molecules in rotationally or vibrationally excited states, so that a shelved molecule interacts with a newly loaded molecule through a repulsive van der Waals interaction. By introducing microwave assisted collisions, we show how to control the final states and the energy released in a collision between a pair of molecules. Following this controlled collision, one of the two molecules can be ejected, and we explore several strategies for ensuring deterministic ejection. Our schemes rely on currently available techniques for laser-coolable molecules, and we predict achievable filling fractions up to 96%, paving the way for scalable molecular arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对分子镊子阵列装载效率受限的问题，提出一种利用微波辅助碰撞抑制碰撞损失的方法。通过将分子暂时置于转动或振动激发态，可使其与新装载分子之间形成排斥性的范德华作用，从而控制碰撞后的最终态与释放能量，并实现确定性驱逐。该方案基于当前可用的激光冷却分子技术，预测可将阵列填充率提高到约 96%。
authors: Etienne F. Walraven, Kang Feng, Jonas Rodewald, Michael R. Tarbutt, Tijs Karman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子镊子阵列在量子模拟、传感和计算方面具有很好的前景，并将受益于提升装载效率的方法。虽然光辅助碰撞是原子镊子阵列增强装载的基础，但由于碰撞损失，这一方法不能直接推广到分子阵列。我们展示了如何通过将分子暂存于转动或振动激发态来抑制这种碰撞损失，使暂存分子通过排斥性的范德华相互作用与新加载分子发生作用。通过引入微波辅助碰撞，我们说明如何控制一对分子碰撞后的终态以及碰撞中释放的能量。在这一受控碰撞之后，两分子中的一个可以被弹出，我们考察了若干确保确定性弹出的方法。我们的方案依赖于当前可用的激光冷却分子技术，并预测可实现高达 96% 的填充率，从而为可扩展的分子阵列铺平道路。

articles.title: Bosonic Condensed Phase Real-time Dynamics from Ring Polymer Molecular Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 基于环聚合物分子动力学的玻色凝聚相实时动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25892v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a method for approximating real-time correlation functions and quantum transport coefficients of bosonic condensed phases. The direct evaluation of quantum real-time correlation functions in the path integral formulation is impossible due to a severe dynamical sign problem. Evaluating imaginary-time correlation functions and inverting them using analytic continuation is famously ill-posed. Ring polymer molecular dynamics (RPMD) provides an alternative approach resulting in accurate approximations for real-time correlation functions of condensed phases but neglects exchange effects. In this work, we develop a bosonic RPMD method, which is exact in the harmonic, short time, and high temperature limits. A critical enabling observation is that the Kubo-transformed correlation function for bosons is real only when the correlated observables are symmetric under exchange. We benchmark the method on harmonic and anharmonic model systems and then use it to directly obtain the Lieb-Liniger gas density-density real-time correlation functions at various temperatures and momentum transfers. This work enables the direct simulation of finite-temperature, real-time dynamics of large bosonic condensed phases using RPMD for the first time.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于近似玻色凝聚相实时间关联函数和量子输运系数的方法。作者在环聚合物分子动力学框架上引入玻色交换效应，弥补了传统 RPMD 忽略交换所带来的不足，并指出该方法在谐波极限、短时极限和高温极限下是精确的。该方法还被用于直接计算 Lieb-Liniger 气体的密度-密度实时间关联函数，为玻色体系的实时模拟提供了新的途径。
authors: Yotam M. Y. Feldman, Sourav Karmakar, Sutirtha Paul, Jacob Higer, Adrian Del Maestro, Barak Hirshberg
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种用于近似玻色凝聚相实时关联函数和量子输运系数的方法。由于路径积分表述中存在严重的动力学符号问题，直接计算量子实时关联函数是不可能的；而先计算虚时关联函数再通过解析延拓进行反演，则众所周知是一个病态问题。环聚合物分子动力学（RPMD）提供了一种替代方案，可对凝聚相的实时关联函数给出准确近似，但它忽略了交换效应。在这项工作中，我们发展了一种玻色 RPMD 方法，该方法在谐振、短时以及高温极限下是精确的。一个关键的启发性观察是：对于玻色子，只有当被关联的可观测量在交换下是对称时，Kubo 变换关联函数才是实数。我们在谐振和非谐模型体系上对该方法进行了基准测试，然后将其用于直接获得 Lieb-Liniger 气体在不同温度和动量转移下的密度-密度实时关联函数。这项工作首次使得能够使用 RPMD 直接模拟大规模玻色凝聚相的有限温度实时动力学。

articles.title: Path integral approach to the truncated Wigner approximation of driven-dissipative spins
articles.title_zh: 驱动耗散自旋截断 Wigner 近似的路径积分方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26029v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Phase-space approaches such as the truncated Wigner approximation (TWA) provide an efficient semiclassical framework for performing approximate simulations of the dynamics of open quantum many-body systems outside the reach of exact numerical methods but beyond the mean-field level. For bosonic systems, TWA is known to be equivalent to a Keldysh path-integral formulation truncated at second order in the so-called quantum fluctuations. This semiclassical approach provides an alternative transparent route towards approximate stochastic equations of motion, which can be efficiently solved. Here we establish the corresponding path-integral formulation for interacting open spin-1/2 systems using the continuous SU(2) phase space. We show, in particular, that a consistent treatment of dissipation requires correctly mapping operator products onto the curved spin phase space, leading to stochastic equations that coincide with those obtained from the continuous TWA formulation and thus reproduce the exact dynamics of a single dissipative spin. Our results provide a unified field-theoretic foundation for the TWA to dissipative spin dynamics and offer a systematic starting point for extensions beyond the semiclassical approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为相互作用的开放自旋-1/2体系建立了基于连续 SU(2) 相空间的路径积分表述。作者指出，正确处理耗散过程需要将算符乘积映射到弯曲的自旋相空间上，这样得到的随机方程与连续截断 Wigner 近似完全一致，并能重现单个耗散自旋的精确动力学。该工作为耗散自旋动力学中的 TWA 提供了统一的场论基础。
authors: Viktoria Noel, Michael Fleischhauer, Igor Lesanovsky
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相空间方法，如截断 Wigner 近似（TWA），为超出精确数值方法适用范围但又超越平均场层次的开放量子多体系统动力学的近似模拟，提供了一个高效的半经典框架。对于玻色系统，TWA 已知等价于在所谓量子涨落上截断到二阶的 Keldysh 路径积分表述。这种半经典方法为得到可高效求解的近似随机运动方程提供了一条透明的替代途径。在这里，我们使用连续 SU(2) 相空间，为相互作用的开放自旋-1/2 系统建立了相应的路径积分表述。我们特别表明，对耗散的一致处理要求在弯曲的自旋相空间中正确映射算符乘积，这会导出与连续 TWA 表述得到的结果一致的随机方程，因此能够再现单个耗散自旋的精确动力学。我们的结果为耗散自旋动力学中的 TWA 提供了统一的场论基础，并为超越半经典近似的系统性推广提供了起点。

articles.title: Quantum Geometry, Anomalous Scaling, and Strong Pseudogap Superfluidity in a Flat-Band Lieb Lattice
articles.title_zh: 平带 Lieb 晶格中的量子几何、异常标度与强赝能隙超流性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2401.02990v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Flat-band systems such as magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene host strong-correlation superconductivity at vanishingly weak coupling, yet how quantum geometry and pairing fluctuations conspire to drive this phenomenon remains an open question. We investigate finite-temperature superfluidity in a quasi-two-dimensional Lieb lattice using a pairing fluctuation theory with a band-uniform attractive interaction g<0 that isolates the intrinsic quantum geometric contributions. Quantum geometry significantly amplifies superfluidity; the geometric pair hopping integral surpasses its conventional counterpart, and the geometric superfluid density becomes the dominant in-plane transport component. When the Fermi level enters the flat band, the BCS paradigm breaks down entirely; the pairing gap and T_c shift from exponential to anomalous power-law scaling Δ, T_c propto |g|^ν (ν>1), and the superfluid density inherits an unconventional power-law temperature dependence at low temperatures. In the 2D limit (t_z=0), the pseudogap at T_c nearly saturates the zero-temperature gap even at |g|/t=0.001, placing the system in a strong-pseudogap regime that would otherwise require unitary or BEC-scale interactions. These findings establish a microscopic mechanism for flat-band enhanced superfluidity and offer testable predictions for ultracold atom experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了准二维 Lieb 晶格中的有限温超流，并通过带均匀吸引相互作用的配对涨落理论分离出量子几何的内在贡献。结果显示，量子几何可显著增强超流：几何配对跃迁和几何超流密度成为主导输运成分。当地费米能级进入平带后，BCS 图景失效，能隙与临界温度由指数标度转为异常幂律标度，且二维极限下体系进入强赝能隙区。
authors: Lin Sun, Hao Deng, Yuxuan Wu, Chuping Li, Junru Wu, Kaichao Zhang, Pengyi Chen, Dingli Yuan, Qijin Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 诸如魔角扭转双层石墨烯之类的平带系统，可以在极弱耦合下展现强关联超导性，但量子几何与配对涨落如何共同驱动这一现象仍是一个开放问题。我们使用配对涨落理论研究准二维 Lieb 晶格的有限温度超流性，并采用带均匀吸引相互作用 g<0，从而隔离出内禀的量子几何贡献。量子几何会显著增强超流性；几何配对跃迁积分超过其常规对应项，而几何超流密度成为主导的面内输运分量。当费米能级进入平带时，BCS 范式完全失效；配对能隙和 T_c 从指数标度转变为异常的幂律标度 Δ, T_c ∝ |g|^ν（ν>1），而超流密度在低温下继承了非常规的幂律温度依赖。在二维极限（t_z=0）中，即使 |g|/t=0.001，T_c 处的赝能隙也几乎饱和到零温能隙，这使系统进入一种强赝能隙状态，而这种状态在其他情况下通常需要单位ary 或 BEC 量级的相互作用。上述结果建立了平带增强超流性的微观机制，并为超冷原子实验提供了可检验的预测。

articles.title: Crystallography, Group Cohomology, and Lieb-Schultz-Mattis Constraints
articles.title_zh: 晶体学、群上同调与 Lieb-Schultz-Mattis 约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.03607v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a computational study of the mod-2 cohomology of three-dimensional (3D) space groups, with an eye toward their applications in Lieb--Schultz--Mattis constraints. We prove finite-generation results for the cohomology of crystallographic groups and give ring presentations for H^*(G,mathbb Z₂₎ for emphall 230 3D space groups, together with explicit inhomogeneous representatives for the degree-łeq 3 cocycles used in the lattice applications. The all-degree interpretation of the ring presentations is organized through finite LHS-spectral-sequence and Hilbert-series verification checks. We then associate distinguished classes in H³⁽G,Z₂₎ to irreducible Wyckoff positions and use these classes as cohomological representatives of Lieb--Schultz--Mattis anomaly candidates when the on-site projective representations are classified by powers of Z₂. Finally, we apply the resulting anomaly data to mathrm U(1) quantum spin liquids on the 3D pyrochlore lattice and compare the symmetry-fractionalization constraints with projective-symmetry-group calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了三维空间群的模 2 上同调，并面向 Lieb-Schultz-Mattis 约束展开应用。作者证明了晶体群同调的有限生成性质，给出了全部 230 个三维空间群的上同调环表示，并构造了用于晶格问题的三阶余循环显式代表元。进一步地，文中将 H³ 中的特定类与不可约 Wyckoff 位置联系起来，用作 LSM 异常候选，并将其应用于三维烧绿石晶格上的 U(1) 量子自旋液体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文对三维（3D）空间群的模 2 上同调进行了计算研究，并着眼于其在 Lieb--Schultz--Mattis 约束中的应用。我们证明了晶体群上同调的有限生成结果，并给出了全部 230 个三维空间群的 H^*(G, Z₂) 的环表示，同时为晶格应用中使用的三阶余循环构造了显式的非齐次代表元。环表示在各个次数上的理解，通过有限的 LHS 谱序列和 Hilbert 级数验证检查来组织。随后，我们将 H³(G, Z₂) 中的特定类与不可约 Wyckoff 位置联系起来，并将这些类用作 Lieb--Schultz--Mattis 异常候选的上同调代表，当站点上的射影表示由 Z₂ 的幂次分类时尤其如此。最后，我们将得到的异常数据应用于三维 pyrochlore 晶格上的 U(1) 量子自旋液体，并将对称性分数化约束与投影对称群（PSG）计算进行比较。

articles.title: Hole-spin qubits in germanium beyond the single-particle regime
articles.title_zh: 超越单粒子极限的锗空穴自旋量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.02449v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The intense simulation efforts on hole-spin qubits in germanium have so far focused primarily on singly occupied quantum dots. Here, we theoretically investigate three-hole qubits in germanium and demonstrate that their performance can rival that of single-hole qubits in both strained and unstrained systems. In particular, we find that -- in the widely used quasi-circular geometry -- a three-hole qubit encoding can yield enhancements of the Rabi frequencies of up to two orders of magnitude and a large advantage also in terms of quality factors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了锗材料中的三空穴量子比特，并表明其性能可在有应变和无应变系统中与单空穴量子比特相媲美。特别是在常用的准圆形几何中，三空穴编码可将拉比频率提升最多两个数量级，同时在品质因子方面也具有明显优势。结果表明，多空穴编码为锗空穴自旋量子计算提供了有前景的替代方案。
authors: Andrea Secchi, Gaia Forghieri, Paolo Bordone, Daniel Loss, Stefano Bosco, Filippo Troiani
articles.abstract_zh_full: 关于锗中空穴自旋量子比特的大量模拟工作，迄今主要集中在单占据量子点上。在这里，我们从理论上研究锗中的三空穴量子比特，并表明它们的性能在应变和无应变体系中都可与单空穴量子比特相媲美。特别是，我们发现，在广泛使用的准圆形几何中，三空穴量子比特编码可将 Rabi 频率提高最多两个数量级，并且在质量因子方面也具有很大优势。

articles.title: Correlated states in charge-transfer heterostructures based on rhombohedral multilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 基于菱方多层石墨烯的电荷转移异质结构中的关联态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.10530v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Charge transfer is a common phenomenon in van der Waals heterostructures with proper work function mismatch, which enables electrostatic gating to control band alignment and interlayer charge distributions. This provides a tunable platform for studying coupled bilayer correlated electronic systems. Here, we theoretically investigate heterostructures of rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) and an insulating substrate with gate-tunable band alignment. We first develop a self-consistent electrostatic theory for layer charge densities incorporating charge transfer, which reproduces the experimentally observed broadened and bent charge neutrality region. When the substrate's band edge has a much larger effective mass than RMG, its carriers may form a Wigner crystal at low densities. This generates a quantum superlattice that induces topological flat bands in the RMG layer through interlayer Coulomb interactions, which may further lead to Chern insulators driven by Coulomb interactions within the RMG layers. Conversely, with comparable effective masses, we find an interlayer excitonic insulator state at charge neutrality stabilized by interlayer Coulomb coupling. Our work establishes these charge-transfer heterostructures as a rich platform for topological and excitonic correlated states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上研究了菱方多层石墨烯与绝缘基底构成的电荷转移异质结构，并建立了包含电荷转移效应的自洽静电模型。该模型能够再现实验中观测到的电中性区展宽和弯曲现象。作者进一步发现，当基底带边有效质量远大于石墨烯时，基底载流子可能形成 Wigner 晶体并诱导量子超晶格，从而在石墨烯层中产生拓扑平带，并可能进一步发展为库仑驱动的 Chern 绝缘态；当两者有效质量接近时，则可能在电中性点稳定形成层间激子绝缘态。
authors: Yanran Shi, Min Li, Xin Lu, Jianpeng Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电荷转移是具有适当功函数失配的范德瓦耳斯异质结构中的常见现象，它使得可以通过静电栅控来调节能带对齐和层间电荷分布。这为研究耦合的双层关联电子系统提供了一个可调平台。在这里，我们理论研究了菱方多层石墨烯（RMG）与一个绝缘衬底组成、且能带对齐可由栅压调控的异质结构。我们首先建立了一个关于层电荷密度的自洽静电理论，其中纳入了电荷转移，并能够重现实验中观察到的展宽和弯曲的电中性区。当衬底带边的有效质量远大于 RMG 时，其载流子在低密度下可能形成 Wigner 晶体。这会生成一个量子超晶格，并通过层间库仑相互作用在 RMG 层中诱导拓扑平带，进一步还可能导致由 RMG 层内部库仑相互作用驱动的陈绝缘体。相反，当有效质量相近时，我们发现在电中性点处存在一种由层间库仑耦合稳定的层间激子绝缘体态。我们的工作将这种电荷转移异质结构确立为一个研究拓扑态和激子关联态的丰富平台。

articles.title: A resource theoretical unification of Mpemba effects: classical and quantum
articles.title_zh: Mpemba 效应的资源理论统一：经典与量子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.16976v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Mpemba effect originally referred to the observation that, under certain thermalizing dynamics, initially hotter samples can cool faster than colder ones. This effect has since been generalized to other anomalous relaxation behaviors even beyond classical domains, such as symmetry restoration in quantum systems. This work demonstrates that resource theories, widely employed in information theory, provide a unified organizing principle to frame Mpemba physics. We show how the conventional thermal Mpemba effect arises naturally from the resource theory of athermality, while its symmetry-restoring counterpart is fully captured by the resource theories of asymmetry. Leveraging the framework of modes of asymmetry, we demonstrate that the Mpemba effect due to symmetry restoration is governed by the initial overlap with the slowest symmetry-restoring mode -- mirroring the role of the slowest Liouvillian eigenmode in thermal Mpemba dynamics. Through this resource-theoretical formalism, we uncover the connection between these seemingly disparate effects and show that the dynamics of thermalization naturally splits into a symmetry-respecting and a symmetry-breaking term.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用资源理论为经典和量子 Mpemba 效应提供了统一描述。作者指出，传统热 Mpemba 效应可自然地归入“非热性”资源理论，而量子系统中的对称性恢复型 Mpemba 效应则可由“不对称性”资源理论刻画。借助不对称性模态分析，文中表明后者由初态与最慢对称性恢复模态的重叠决定，类似于热 Mpemba 动力学中最慢李乌维尔本征模的作用。
authors: Alessandro Summer, Mattia Moroder, Laetitia P. Bettmann, Xhek Turkeshi, Iman Marvian, John Goold
articles.abstract_zh_full: Mpemba 效应最初指的是：在某些热化动力学下，初始温度更高的样品可以比温度更低的样品冷却得更快。此后，这一效应被推广到热力学之外的其他异常弛豫行为，例如量子系统中的对称性恢复。本文表明，资源理论——这一在信息论中被广泛使用的工具——可以为 Mpemba 物理提供一个统一的组织原则。我们展示了传统的热 Mpemba 效应如何自然地从非热性资源理论中出现，而其对称性恢复的对应现象则可完全由不对称性资源理论刻画。借助不对称性模态的框架，我们证明，对称性恢复所导致的 Mpemba 效应由初态与最慢对称性恢复模的重叠决定——这与热 Mpemba 动力学中最慢 Liouvillian 本征模所起的作用相呼应。通过这一资源理论形式化，我们揭示了这些看似不同现象之间的联系，并表明热化动力学自然可分解为一个尊重对称性的项和一个破坏对称性的项。

articles.title: Superradiant Phase is a Finite Size Effect in Two-photon Processes
articles.title_zh: 双光子过程中的超辐射相是有限尺寸效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.19986v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Two-photon light-matter interactions exhibit distinctive features such as spectral collapse. The two-photon Dicke model has been reported to exhibit a superradiant phase which could be useful in quantum applications. Here we show that this superradiant phase is not a genuine thermodynamic phase but a finite-size effect. Combining analytical and numerical analyses, we demonstrate that the superradiant region shrinks with increasing system size and disappears in the thermodynamic limit, while spectral collapse remains. Our results clarify the nature of superradiant conditions in two-photon systems and constrain its realization in quantum platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了双光子相互作用中的相结构，尤其是双光子 Dicke 模型中被报道的超辐射相。作者通过解析与数值分析表明，该超辐射区域会随系统尺寸增大而收缩，并在热力学极限下消失，因此并非真正的热力学相，而是有限尺寸效应。与此同时，谱塌缩现象仍然存在。
authors: Fabrizio Ramírez, David Villaseñor, Nahum Vázquez, Jorge G. Hirsch
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双光子光-物质相互作用表现出诸如谱塌缩之类的独特特征。已有报道指出，双光子 Dicke 模型会出现一个超辐射相，该相在量子应用中可能有用。在这里，我们表明这一超辐射相并不是真正的热力学相，而是一个有限尺寸效应。通过结合解析和数值分析，我们证明超辐射区域会随着系统尺寸增大而收缩，并在热力学极限下消失，而谱塌缩则仍然保留。我们的结果澄清了双光子系统中超辐射条件的性质，并限制了其在量子平台上的实现。

articles.title: HIR: A collisional-radiative model for hydrogen ionization in plasma with anisotropic fast ions
articles.title_zh: HIR：用于各向异性快离子等离子体中氢电离的碰撞-辐射模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The paper presents the HIR (Hydrogen Ionization Rates) software package developed for calculating the level populations of atomic hydrogen and the dynamics of its ionization in hot plasma, including the case of fast ions with an anisotropic distribution function. The code is based on a steady-state collisional-radiative model that includes electron and ion impact excitation, de-excitation, ionization, charge exchange, and spontaneous radiative transitions. It is demonstrated that stepwise ionization via excited states contributes up to 20% to the total ionization rate and requires including levels up to the principal quantum number N=8. For the GDML and GOL-NB mirror trap facilities, the effects of stepwise ionization on the mean free path of fast atoms are analyzed. It is shown that collisions with different plasma species are non-additive due to stepwise ionization, leading to a reduction in the mean free path by up to 7% at 40 keV. The anisotropy of the fast ion distribution is found to have a negligible effect (less than 1%) on the ionization dynamics in the GDML plasma. The ionization cost of hydrogen atoms in the GOL-NB plasma is calculated, demonstrating a strong dependence on plasma density due to competition between collisional and radiative de-excitation. The HIR package is openly available on GitHub.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 HIR（Hydrogen Ionization Rates）软件包，用于计算热等离子体中原子氢的能级布居及其电离动力学，并可处理具有各向异性分布函数的快离子情形。该程序基于稳态碰撞-辐射模型，考虑了电子和离子碰撞激发、去激发、电离、荷电交换以及自发辐射跃迁。结果表明，经由激发态的逐级电离对总电离率贡献可达 20%，且需要考虑到主量子数 N=8；在所研究的装置中，不同粒子碰撞的非加性效应可使平均自由程在 40 keV 时降低最多 7%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文介绍了 HIR（Hydrogen Ionization Rates，氢电离率）软件包，该软件用于计算原子氢的能级布居以及其在热等离子体中的电离动力学，包括具有各向异性分布函数的快离子情形。该代码基于一个稳态碰撞辐射模型，其中包括电子和离子碰撞激发、去激发、电离、电荷交换以及自发辐射跃迁。结果表明，经由激发态的逐级电离对总电离率的贡献可高达 20%，并且需要将能级考虑到主量子数 N=8。对于 GDML 和 GOL-NB 镜像阱装置，作者分析了逐级电离对快原子平均自由程的影响。结果显示，由于逐级电离，不同等离子体组分的碰撞效应并非可加，在 40 keV 时平均自由程可降低最多 7%。快离子分布的各向异性对 GDML 等离子体中的电离动力学影响可忽略不计，低于 1%。作者还计算了 GOL-NB 等离子体中氢原子的电离代价，表明其对等离子体密度具有强烈依赖，这是碰撞去激发与辐射去激发之间竞争所致。HIR 软件包已在 GitHub 上开源提供。

articles.title: An Investigation into the Effect of Mobile Ions on the Steady State Performance of Perovskite Solar Cells
articles.title_zh: 移动离子对钙钛矿太阳能电池稳态性能影响的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In perovskite solar cells, the interplay between mobile ions and photo-excited charge carriers is complex,with recent studies suggesting mobile ions can be either beneficial or detrimental to cell efficiency depending on the cell properties. In this study we use drift diffusion modelling and factorial analysis to simulate 601 pairs of perovskite solar cells (1202 total cells) across a broad range of physically relevant materials parameters. In each pair of devices, one cell contains mobile ions that can move freely. The second paired cell is identical but has no mobile ions. This approach allows us to systematically investigate the impact of mobile ions on cell performance. We deconvolve the contributions of key cell parameters including ion density, recombination rate and band offsets, for n-i-p and p-i-n devices with both organic and inorganic contact layers. Importantly, we find that in efficient devices, mobile ions have only a small impact on steady-state performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 钙钛矿太阳能电池中，移动离子与光生载流子之间的相互作用十分复杂，已有研究表明其对效率可能是促进性的，也可能是抑制性的，这取决于器件性质。本文采用漂移-扩散建模与因子分析，对601对钙钛矿太阳能电池（共1202个器件）在广泛的物理参数范围内进行模拟，其中每对器件仅在是否存在可自由移动的离子上不同。研究系统分解了离子浓度、复合速率、能带偏移等关键因素在n-i-p与p-i-n器件中的作用，结果表明在高效率器件中，移动离子对稳态性能的影响通常较小。
authors: Matthew V. Cowley, Kjeld O. Jensen, Matthew J. Wolf, Alison B. Walker, Petra J. Cameron
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在钙钛矿太阳能电池中，移动离子与光激发电荷载流子之间的相互作用十分复杂，近期研究表明，移动离子可能根据器件性质而对效率产生有利或不利影响。在本研究中，我们采用漂移-扩散建模和因子分析，对 601 对钙钛矿太阳能电池（共 1202 个器件）进行了模拟，覆盖了广泛且物理上相关的材料参数范围。在每一对器件中，一个器件包含可自由移动的离子，另一个配对器件完全相同但不含移动离子。该方法使我们能够系统地研究移动离子对器件性能的影响。我们分解了包括离子密度、复合速率和能带偏移在内的关键器件参数的贡献，并分别针对 n-i-p 和 p-i-n 结构、以及有机和无机接触层进行了分析。重要的是，我们发现，在高效器件中，移动离子对稳态性能只有很小的影响。

articles.title: Classical Analog Emulation of Quantum Circuits via Time-Averaged Dynamic States
articles.title_zh: 通过时间平均动态态实现量子线路的经典模拟仿真
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.02977v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Classical analog hardware that emulates quantum circuits at the gate level offers a route to benchmarking, prototyping, and teaching quantum algorithms. We introduce wavebits, classical wave analogs of qubits whose amplitudes are carried by physical oscillatory signals, and show that any nonseparable N-qubit state can be encoded in 2N narrowband signals that remain locally separable at every instant. The nonseparable correlations are recovered at readout by time-averaged demodulation over auxiliary carrier frequencies, referred to as nonseparability channels. We prove that any two-qubit gate unravels into the time-averaged tensor product of two local time-varying operators, and that arbitrary circuits are emulated with a base-frequency count scaling linearly with the number of entangling layers, independent of qubit number. The exponential cost of the 2^N-dimensional state reappears at readout and in the averaging time of deep circuits, not during circuit execution, as quantified by an analytic error bound that also serves as a hardware design rule. A mixed-signal prototype emulates Bell state generation, controlled-NOT gates, phase kickback, and Bloch-sphere rotations with fidelities above 0.98, and numerical benchmarks against exact state vectors validate the scheme for up to six qubits. The architecture is directly implementable in acoustic, photonic, and mixed-signal platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种经典模拟硬件在门级仿真量子电路的方法，为量子算法的基准测试、原型验证与教学提供路径。作者引入“wavebits”概念，将量子比特的幅度映射到物理振荡信号，并证明任意非可分的N比特态可编码为2N个窄带信号，且在任意瞬时都保持局域可分性。其非可分相关性通过对辅助载波频率进行时间平均解调后恢复；文中还证明两比特门可分解为两个局域时变算子的时间平均张量积，并给出了线路仿真的线性资源缩放规律及误差界。
authors: Mathieu Padlewski, Matias Miguel Castillo Valle, Tim Tuuva, Benjamin Apffel, Hervé Lissek, Romain Fleury
articles.abstract_zh_full: 能够在门级模拟量子电路的经典模拟硬件，为量子算法的基准测试、原型开发与教学提供了一条路径。我们提出了 wavebits，这是一种经典波类量子比特，其幅度由物理振荡信号承载，并表明任何非可分离的 N 比特态都可以编码为 2N 个窄带信号，这些信号在任一瞬间都保持局域可分离。非可分离相关性在读出时通过对辅助载波频率进行时间平均解调而恢复，这些载波频率被称为非可分离通道。我们证明，任意二维量子门都可展开为两个局域时变算符的时间平均张量积，而任意电路都可用与纠缠层数线性标度的基频数量来仿真，并且这一标度与量子比特数无关。2^N 维状态所带来的指数代价则重新出现在读出阶段以及深层电路的平均时间中，而不是在电路执行过程中；我们给出了一个解析误差界，它同时也是硬件设计准则。一个混合信号原型已成功模拟了贝尔态生成、受控非门、相位回踢以及布洛赫球旋转，保真度超过 0.98；与精确态矢量的数值基准比较验证了该方案可扩展到多达六个量子比特。该架构可直接实现于声学、光子学以及混合信号平台。

articles.title: Lantern: Conflict-Aware Gradient Blending for Physics-Guided Diffusion Models in Calorimeter Simulation
articles.title_zh: Lantern：面向量热器模拟中物理引导扩散模型的冲突感知梯度融合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monte Carlo simulation of calorimeter showers is a principal bottleneck for the High-Luminosity LHC, and diffusion models have emerged as fast, high-fidelity surrogates. Their denoising objective is purely statistical, however: a model can minimize it while placing the physics wrong. Existing physics-informed generative methods cannot close this gap, because they assume a closed-form law, a governing PDE residual or a hard per-sample constraint, that a shower does not supply: no per-sample PDE governs a stochastic cascade, and energy conservation fixes only one scalar per shower. Standard metrics ignore the correlation structure across calorimeter layers and voxels, comparing showers only in a physics feature space. We address both gaps. We introduce the Correlation Frobenius Distance (CFD), a single normalized score for correlation fidelity at layer-wise and voxel-wise scales. We then encode the soft per-sample structure available in a shower as two physics-aware auxiliary losses: a variance-stabilized voxel residual loss grounded in counting statistics, and a graph Laplacian loss over the detector geometry. We combine both with denoising through GradBlend, which anchors the step magnitude to the denoising gradient while letting the auxiliary steer its direction, yielding Lantern, a physics-guided diffusion surrogate. On CaloChallenge Dataset 2, injecting the physics losses through task-symmetric rules such as PCGrad, GradNorm, IMTL-G, and ConFIG inflates FPD by 2-100x relative to denoising alone, whereas GradBlend admits the same signal without regression and, with the Laplacian loss, Lantern improves both FPD and CFD. Our ablation on the auxiliary loss scheduler shows that the voxel residual loss, whose gradient conflicts with denoising, requires a terminal denoising-only phase to preserve shower fidelity, whereas the non-conflicting Laplacian loss is insensitive to the schedule.
articles.abstract_zh: 高亮度LHC的量热器簇射蒙特卡洛模拟是主要计算瓶颈之一，扩散模型因其速度快和保真度高而受到关注，但其训练目标本质上是统计性的，可能在物理上产生偏差。本文指出，现有物理约束生成方法难以直接适用于簇射模拟，因为该过程不存在逐样本的确定性PDE约束，且能量守恒只提供单一标量约束。为此，作者提出用于相关性保真的Correlation Frobenius Distance（CFD），并结合基于计数统计的方差稳定体素残差损失与基于探测器几何的图拉普拉斯损失，构建面向物理的一致性训练框架。
authors: Farzana Yasmin Ahmad, Vanamala Venkataswamy, Geoffrey Fox
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量能器簇射的蒙特卡罗模拟是高亮度 LHC 面临的主要瓶颈之一，而扩散模型已成为快速且高保真的替代方案。然而，它们的去噪目标完全是统计性的：模型可以在最小化该目标的同时把物理规律放错。现有的物理信息生成方法无法弥合这一差距，因为它们假定存在闭式定律、支配性的 PDE 残差或逐样本硬约束，而簇射并不提供这些条件：没有任何逐样本 PDE 支配随机级联，而能量守恒只是在每个簇射中固定了一个标量。标准指标则忽略了量能器层与体素之间的相关结构，只在物理特征空间中比较簇射。我们同时解决这两个缺口。我们提出相关性 Frobenius 距离（CFD），作为层级和体素尺度上相关性保真度的单一归一化评分。随后，我们把簇射中可用的软逐样本结构编码为两个物理感知的辅助损失：一个基于计数统计、经方差稳定化的体素残差损失，以及一个基于探测器几何的图拉普拉斯损失。我们通过 GradBlend 将这两者与去噪结合起来，使步长大小由去噪梯度锚定，而辅助项只调节其方向，从而得到 Lantern，一个物理引导的扩散代理模型。在 CaloChallenge 数据集 2 上，将物理损失通过 PCGrad、GradNorm、IMTL-G 和 ConFIG 等任务对称规则注入，会相对于仅去噪使 FPD 增大 2 到 100 倍；而 GradBlend 可以在不发生退化的情况下接受同样的信息，并且结合拉普拉斯损失后，Lantern 同时改进了 FPD 和 CFD。我们对辅助损失调度器的消融研究表明，体素残差损失的梯度与去噪存在冲突，因此需要在末尾加入仅去噪阶段以保持簇射保真度；而不冲突的拉普拉斯损失对调度不敏感。

articles.title: GoQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization
articles.title_zh: GoQuant：面向无乘法器幂二变换器量化的几何正交残差投影方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.26092v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory capacity and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply--Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low-bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing general multiplications in the dominant dot-product computation with bit-shift operations. However, its non-uniform exponential lattice inherently suffers from a Low Angular Resolution Regime, a structural limitation that becomes particularly pronounced below 4-bit precision and can substantially degrade the representation of high-dimensional feature manifolds. To address this geometric limitation, we propose Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection Quantization (GoQuant), an algorithm--hardware co-design framework for multiplier-reduced low-bit inference. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, GoQuant constructs a higher-resolution residual lattice while retaining a shift-and-add inner-product structure. Its analytical solver further avoids computationally intensive gradient-based or iterative search procedures. The data-free Geometric-Only (GEO) mode quantizes LLaMA-2-7B in only 0.47 minutes, while the Activation-Refined (REF) mode completes full-model quantization in approximately 4.4 minutes.
articles.abstract_zh: 大语言模型与视觉Transformer部署到边缘设备时，常受内存容量和密集乘加阵列时序瓶颈限制。本文针对超低比特场景下的幂二（PoT）量化提出GoQuant，通过将量化表述为双基几何投影，引入更高分辨率的残差格点，同时保留基于位移与加法的内积结构，从而减少乘法器依赖。该方法旨在缓解PoT量化在低于4比特时的低角分辨率问题，并兼顾硬件效率与表示能力。
authors: Maoyang Xiang, Tao Luo, Bo Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉 Transformer（ViT）在边缘设备上的部署受到内存容量以及由密集乘加（MAC）阵列引入的关键时序瓶颈的显著限制。在超低比特范围内，对数二的幂（PoT）量化通过用位移操作替代主导点积计算中的一般乘法，提供了一种硬件高效的替代方案。然而，其非均匀的指数格点天然地存在低角分辨率区域这一结构性限制，该限制在低于 4 比特精度时尤其明显，并可能显著削弱对高维特征流形的表示。为解决这一几何限制，我们提出几何正交残差投影量化（GoQuant），这是一种面向减少乘法器的低比特推理的算法—硬件协同设计框架。通过将量化表述为双基几何投影，GoQuant 构造了更高分辨率的残差格点，同时保留了移位加法式内积结构。其解析求解器进一步避免了计算开销很大的基于梯度或迭代搜索的过程。数据无关的纯几何（GEO）模式仅用 0.47 分钟即可量化 LLaMA-2-7B，而激活细化（REF）模式约用 4.4 分钟完成全模型量化。

articles.title: ContractHIL-HLS: Contract-Aligned Multi-Agent Workflow with Hardware-in-the-Loop Feedback for HLS Design
articles.title_zh: ContractHIL-HLS：带硬件在环反馈的契约对齐多智能体HLS设计流程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25283v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents ContractHIL-HLS, a contract-aligned multi-agent workflow for practical high-level synthesis (HLS) engineering. The workflow makes three contributions. First, it introduces a structured contract as the semantic-alignment and task-execution artifact that translates natural language requirements into explicit interfaces, constraints, validation checks, and rollback rules. Second, it incorporates hardware information into the feedback loop by feeding HLS, Vivado, PYNQ runtime, power, and failure evidence back into generation, thereby extending LLM-assisted HLS from kernel code toward system- and board-level closure. Third, it decomposes agents by semantic lowering and execution tasks rather than by conversational roles: a Contract Agent lowers natural language into the contract, an HTML Agent renders the contract as persistent structured HTML, and a Hardware-in-the-Loop Agent implements and revises the design with measured evidence. We evaluate ContractHIL-HLS in two parts. On 94 locally executable HLS-Eval tasks, the structured contract provides the largest small design gain, improving the estimated single-sample testbench pass rate from 64.0% to 70.2%; the full flow reaches 70.4% pass@1 and 76.6% pass@5. Because HLS-Eval does not exercise board-level design, we also validate ContractHIL-HLS on a board tested ML-KEM/ML-DSA post-quantum cryptography (PQC) secure-message accelerator, where the retained dual-bitstream organization reduces six-message average text runtime from 207.3 ms to 52.4 ms with positive routed WNS on both images while preserving decrypted-message verification. We open-source our work at BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS (https://github.com/BJUT-CS316-LAB/ContractHIL-HLS).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出ContractHIL-HLS，一种面向实际高层次综合（HLS）工程的契约对齐多智能体工作流。该方法通过结构化契约将自然语言需求转化为显式接口、约束、验证检查与回滚规则，并将HLS、Vivado、PYNQ运行时、功耗与故障证据反馈到生成过程，从而将LLM辅助HLS从内核代码扩展到系统级与板级收敛。作者还按语义下沉与执行任务拆分智能体角色，以提高设计闭环的可控性与可验证性。
