articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出 ContractHIL-HLS，这是一种面向实际高层次综合（HLS）工程的契约对齐多智能体工作流。该工作流作出三项贡献。首先，它引入结构化契约作为语义对齐和任务执行工件，将自然语言需求转化为明确的接口、约束、验证检查和回滚规则。其次，它通过将 HLS、Vivado、PYNQ 运行时、功耗和失败证据反馈到生成过程中，把硬件信息纳入反馈回路，从而将 LLM 辅助的 HLS 从内核代码扩展到系统级和板级收敛。第三，它按照语义降阶和执行任务而非会话角色来分解智能体：契约智能体将自然语言降阶为契约，HTML 智能体将契约渲染为持久的结构化 HTML，硬件在环智能体则基于测量证据实现并修订设计。我们分两部分评估 ContractHIL-HLS。在 94 个可本地执行的 HLS-Eval 任务上，结构化契约带来了最大的小型设计增益，将估计的单样本测试平台通过率从 64.0% 提高到 70.2%；完整流程达到 70.4% 的 pass@1 和 76.6% 的 pass@5。由于 HLS-Eval 不考察板级设计，我们还在经过板级测试的 ML-KEM/ML-DSA 后量子密码（PQC）安全消息加速器上验证 ContractHIL-HLS，其中保留的双比特流组织将六条消息的平均文本运行时间从 207.3 毫秒降低到 52.4 毫秒，两种镜像均具有正的布线后 WNS，同时保持解密消息验证。我们已开源本工作。

articles.title: Atomic Ehrenfest forces
articles.title_zh: 原子Ehrenfest力
articles.abstract: The Ehrenfest force acting on the electrons within an atom of a molecule provides a force-based complement to the energy-centered description of chemical bonding. When integrated over the atomic basins defined by the quantum theory of atoms in molecules, this force can be evaluated either from the divergence of the Pauli kinetic stress tensor or by averaging the electronic force operator over the wavefunction, the latter requiring the pair density. Here we systematically examine how the atomic Ehrenfest force computed by both routes depends on basis-set size and level of theory, using archetypal molecules that represent covalent, polar, ionic, and van der Waals bonding (ȩH2, LiH, ȩH2O, LiF, ȩHe2, ȩ(NaF)2, and ȩCNO-). We find that the force obtained from the pair density is markedly sensitive to basis-set size, can yield a qualitatively incorrect direction for ionic systems with small basis sets, and converges toward the stress-tensor values as the basis set is enlarged, whereas its dependence on the level of theory is comparatively weak. This behavior parallels that of the Hellmann-Feynman forces and traces to their shared electron-nuclear origin, which also underlies an exact equality between the magnitudes of the total Ehrenfest and Hellmann-Feynman forces.
articles.abstract_zh: Ehrenfest力为分子中原子内电子受力提供了一种基于力的化学键描述，可作为能量中心视角的补充。本文在量子化学中的原子盆定义下，系统考察了通过应力张量散度与通过波函数平均电子力算符两种途径计算的原子Ehrenfest力，并比较其对基组大小与理论水平的依赖。结果表明，基于配对密度的方法对基组极为敏感，在小基组下甚至可能对离子体系给出定性错误的方向，而随着基组增大，其结果逐渐接近应力张量方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作用于分子中某一原子内电子的 Ehrenfest 力，为以能量为中心的化学键描述提供了一种基于力的补充。当在由分子中原子量子理论定义的原子盆上积分时，该力既可以由 Pauli 动能应力张量的散度求得，也可以通过在波函数上对电子力算符取平均来求得，后者需要对密度。这里，我们使用代表共价、极性、离子和范德华键合的典型分子（ȩH2、LiH、ȩH2O、LiF、ȩHe2、ȩ(NaF)2 和 ȩCNO-），系统考察了由这两种途径计算的原子 Ehrenfest 力如何依赖于基组大小和理论水平。我们发现，由对密度得到的力对基组大小明显敏感，在小基组下可对离子体系给出定性错误的方向，并随着基组增大而收敛到应力张量的数值；相比之下，它对理论水平的依赖较弱。这一行为与 Hellmann-Feynman 力的行为相似，并可追溯到二者共同的电子—核起源，而这种起源也导致总 Ehrenfest 力与 Hellmann-Feynman 力的大小之间存在精确相等关系。

The proposed system localizes beam losses and reduces interaction-region losses by up to two orders of magnitude while preserving machine acceptance and beam lifetime, establishing a robust foundation for future EIC operations. articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，中心对称共线反铁磁体表面的反演对称性破缺可解除联合反演和时间反演对称性（PT），并产生非相对论性的 d 波自旋劈裂，即表面 altermagnetism。作者结合对称性分析与第一性原理计算，研究了这一现象的产生条件与电子结构后果。该结果为反铁磁表面自旋分裂提供了新的理解。
authors: Ersoy Şaşıoğlu, Ingrid Mertig, and Samir Lounis
articles.focus_summary: 该文研究中心对称共线反铁磁表面中的 d 波 altermagnetism，指出表面破缺反演对称性后可产生非相对论自旋劈裂。作者结合对称性分析和第一性原理计算，揭示了表面诱导的新型磁电子结构特征。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们关于磁性材料、自旋分裂、altermagnetism 和第一性原理计算的方向非常接近。对理解非共线/反常磁电子结构及其表面效应很有参考价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步阅读其对表面对称性与自旋分裂关系的分析框架，并考虑推广到二维磁体、异质结或界面体系。也可结合自旋哈密顿量或输运计算评估其可观测信号。

articles.abstract: Author(s): Dimitrie Culcer Z i t t e r b e w e g u n g , the trembling motion caused by interband coherence, is usually viewed as a purely quantum effect. Here, the author shows that it also has a natural place in semiclassical electron dynamics as an additional velocity term. This term explains the electric-field-induced position shift of Bloch electrons and reveals a direct connection to the minimum conductivity of massless Dirac fermions. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L020305] Published Wed Jul 29, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论由能带间相干引起的“颤动”在半经典电子动力学中的作用。作者指出，这一通常被视为纯量子效应的现象可表现为额外速度项，并可解释电场诱导的布洛赫电子位置位移，同时揭示其与无质量狄拉克费米子最小电导率之间的直接联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作者：Dimitrie Culcer。颤动（Zitterbewegung），即由能带间相干导致的抖动运动，通常被视为一种纯粹的量子效应。在这里，作者表明，它在半经典电子动力学中也具有自然的位置，可作为一个额外的速度项出现。该项解释了电场诱导的布洛赫电子位置位移，并揭示了其与无质量狄拉克费米子最小电导率之间的直接联系。[Phys. Rev. B 114, L020305] 2026年7月29日星期三发表。

articles.title: Technology modularity shapes latecomer cost convergence in renewables
articles.title_zh: 技术模块化如何影响可再生能源中后发国家的成本趋同
articles.abstract: National installed costs, rather than global averages, determine whether emerging economies can leapfrog incumbents in the transition to net-zero electricity. While technological diffusion theories assume that late-adopting countries seamlessly inherit early movers’ experience, sparse historical cost data outside advanced markets have obscured whether this latecomer advantage actually holds for renewable energy. Here we reconstruct national installed-cost trajectories for solar photovoltaics (PV) and onshore wind across more than 160 countries using a novel Stage-Cost Assessment of Learning and Experience (SCALE) framework. We find that latecomer cost convergence varies systematically with technology architecture. For solar PV, emerging-economy countries classified as Laggards exhibit a median national learning rate of 27.5%, compared with 18.0% among developed-economy Laggards, a reversal consistent with the cross-border transferability of learning in modular and globally traded PV systems. For onshore wind, emerging-economy Laggards have a median learning rate of 9.7%, compared with 21.6% among their developed-economy counterparts. This difference is consistent with the greater importance of site-specific engineering and project delivery in wind deployment. Projecting to 2050, combined policy interventions can effectively close the PV cost gap for emerging markets, whereas onshore wind costs face an enduring geographical floor. Our results provide empirical evidence that climate finance strategies, energy-transition scenarios and integrated assessment models should move beyond uniform global learning curves by representing how technology-specific spatial constraints shape the translation of global learning into local deployment costs.
articles.abstract_zh: 国家层面的装机成本，而非全球平均成本，决定了新兴经济体能否在净零电力转型中实现跨越式发展。本文基于一种新的 SCALE 框架，重建了160多个国家太阳能光伏和陆上风电的国家装机成本轨迹，发现后发国家的成本趋同会因技术架构而系统性变化。对于光伏，新兴经济体后发者的中位学习率高于发达经济体；而对陆上风电则相反，说明模块化、全球化交易程度较高的技术更容易跨境转移经验。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 国家层面的装机成本，而不是全球平均成本，决定了新兴经济体能否在向净零电力转型中跨越既有领先者。尽管技术扩散理论假设后采用技术的国家能够无缝继承先行者的经验，但先进市场之外稀疏的历史成本数据一直掩盖了这种后发优势在可再生能源领域是否真实存在。在这里，我们使用一种新的“学习与经验阶段—成本评估”（Stage-Cost Assessment of Learning and Experience，SCALE）框架，重建了160多个国家太阳能光伏（PV）和陆上风电的国家装机成本轨迹。我们发现，后发者成本趋同会随技术架构而系统性变化。对于太阳能光伏，被归类为落后者的新兴经济体国家的国家中位学习率为27.5%，相比之下，发达经济体落后者为18.0%；这一反转与模块化且全球交易的光伏系统中学习的跨境可转移性相一致。对于陆上风电，新兴经济体落后者的中位学习率为9.7%，相比之下，其发达经济体对应国家为21.6%。这一差异与风电部署中地点特异性工程和项目交付具有更高重要性相一致。展望2050年，组合政策干预能够有效弥合新兴市场的光伏成本差距，而陆上风电成本则面临持久的地理下限。我们的结果提供了经验证据，表明气候融资战略、能源转型情景和综合评估模型应超越统一的全球学习曲线，转而表征技术特异性的空间约束如何塑造全球学习向本地部署成本的转化。

articles.title: The Unified Hydrodynamic Field: Scale-Invariant Continuum Mechanics of Trapped Phase Action and Sub-Hadronic Solitons
articles.title_zh: 统一流体动力学场：被困相位作用与亚强子孤子的尺度不变连续介质力学
articles.abstract: This paper establishes a deterministic, scale-invariant field theory that unifies the fundamental interactions as pressure configurations within a pressurized, continuous hydrostatic substrate: the Flat Electromagnetic (FEM) field (P₀ ≈ 1.516 N/m²). Abandoning probabilistic formalisms, virtual gauge bosons, and metric spacetime curvature, we prove that the non-linear Skyrme-Faddeev Lagrangian ℒ_FEM is the minimal admissible continuum action supporting stable, finite-energy 3D topological solitons (Q_H = 1). Balancing intrinsic wave shear torque against ambient pressure P₀ derives non-circular closed-form equations for particle major radius R₀ = (Nₐction * ℏc / (8π² P₀))⁽¹/4) and rest mass M₀ ∝ Nₐction⁽³/4) P₀⁽¹/4). The proton mass (938.272 MeV) emerges from Nᵢₙₜₑger = 54 × (16π² / (3√3)) = 2961 units of trapped phase action derived via Hopf fibration S¹ ↪ S³ → S² fiber-action integration. Leptonic generations (e, μ, τ) are derived as Sturm-Liouville radial phase-integral roots (n₂ = 206.768, n₃ = 3477.23) matched directly to topological action budgets, with WKB validity confirmed via εₘₐₓ = 4.7 × 10⁻³ << 1. Subatomic pair formation and entanglement are mapped to 1D Falaco threads, deriving quantum correlations (E(a,b) = -cos θₐb) dynamically via sine-Gordon action variation (Δϕ = π). The framework is quantitatively benchmarked against observational cosmology, deriving the Pantheon+ SN Ia luminosity distance (d_L(z) = (c/H₀)(1+z)ln(1+z), χ²/dof = 1.031), the BAO standard ruler (D_BAO = 147.31 Mpc), the BBN primordial Helium fraction (Yₚ = 0.248), and Planck CMB acoustic multipoles. Finally, we establish strict non-circularity via a directed dependency matrix, provide a full numerical reproducibility ledger, and demonstrate empirical necessity over standard models by resolving four physical anomalies: the 8.70-second neutron lifetime discrepancy, the PRad 2019 proton charge radius (2Rₚ = 0.84118 fm), dark-matter-free ultra-diffuse galaxies (M_dyn/M_bar = 1.08), and the 3.6σ quasar dipole alignment (v_bulk = 370.2 km/s).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种确定性的尺度不变场论，将基本相互作用解释为连续高压基底中的压力构型，并以平面电磁场作为基础。作者声称非线性的 Skyrme-Faddeev 拉格朗日量是支持稳定有限能量三维拓扑孤子的最小连续介质作用，并据此推导粒子半径、静质量以及质子与轻子质量的对应关系。该工作还将成对形成与纠缠映射为一维 Falaco 线结构，但相关物理含义需结合原文进一步审慎评估。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文建立了一种确定性、尺度不变的场论，该理论把基本相互作用统一为一个受压、连续的静水基底中的压力构型：平坦电磁（FEM）场（P₀ ≈ 1.516 N/m²）。在放弃概率形式主义、虚规范玻色子和度规时空曲率的基础上，我们证明非线性 Skyrme-Faddeev 拉格朗日量 ℒ_FEM 是支持稳定、有限能量三维拓扑孤子（Q_H = 1）的最小可容许连续介质作用量。通过平衡内禀波剪切力矩与环境压力 P₀，推导出粒子长半径 R₀ = (Nₐction * ℏc / (8π² P₀))⁽¹/4) 和静质量 M₀ ∝ Nₐction⁽³/4) P₀⁽¹/4) 的非循环闭式方程。质子质量（938.272 MeV）由 Nᵢₙₜₑger = 54 × (16π² / (3√3)) = 2961 个受困相位作用量单位得到，这些单位通过 Hopf 纤维化 S¹ ↪ S³ → S² 的纤维作用积分推导而来。轻子代（e、μ、τ）被推导为 Sturm-Liouville 径向相位积分根（n₂ = 206.768，n₃ = 3477.23），并与拓扑作用量预算直接匹配，同时通过 εₘₐₓ = 4.7 × 10⁻³ << 1 确认 WKB 有效性。亚原子对形成与纠缠被映射到一维 Falaco 线，通过 sine-Gordon 作用量变分（Δϕ = π）动力学地推导出量子关联（E(a,b) = -cos θₐb）。该框架针对观测宇宙学进行了定量基准检验，推导出 Pantheon+ SN Ia 光度距离（d_L(z) = (c/H₀)(1+z)ln(1+z)，χ²/dof = 1.031）、BAO 标准尺（D_BAO = 147.31 Mpc）、BBN 原初氦丰度（Yₚ = 0.248）以及 Planck CMB 声学多极矩。最后，我们通过有向依赖矩阵确立严格的非循环性，提供完整的数值可重复性台账，并通过解决四个物理异常来展示其相对于标准模型的经验必要性：8.70秒的中子寿命差异、PRad 2019 质子电荷半径（2Rₚ = 0.84118 fm）、无暗物质超弥散星系（M_dyn/M_bar = 1.08）以及 3.6σ 类星体偶极取向一致性（v_bulk = 370.2 km/s）。

articles.title: Multi-task learning for structural boundary estimation from gravity data
articles.title_zh: 基于多任务学习的重力数据结构边界估计
articles.abstract: Euler deconvolution remains one of the most widely used techniques for gravity interpretation because of its simplicity and computational efficiency. However, its outputs are generally limited to discrete source-point estimations and may become unstable under noisy conditions or inappropriate structural-index assumptions, particularly in complex geological environments. To overcome these limitations, we propose a multi-task deep learning framework that directly estimates three key structural depth attributes—the top boundary, structural center, and an effective lower depth—from gravity data. Unlike conventional workflows that first invert for physical properties and subsequently infer structural boundaries, the proposed framework adopts a geometry-driven learning paradigm that directly predicts structurally meaningful depth attributes from gravity anomalies. The shared encoder and multi-decoder architecture enables joint learning of correlated depth attributes, improving depth stability and structural consistency. Synthetic experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework produces spatially continuous and noise-robust structural representations with improved structural coherence and geological interpretability. The results suggest that deep learning provides a geometry-oriented alternative for extracting continuous structural representations from gravity data, rather than serving as a strict mathematical deconvolution method. This work provides a new pathway for potential-field interpretation by offering a direct and stable framework for subsurface structural characterization from gravity anomalies.
articles.abstract_zh: 为克服 Euler 反褶积在噪声环境和结构指数设定不当时的不稳定问题，作者提出了一个基于多任务深度学习的重力解释框架。该框架直接从重力异常中估计地质体上边界、结构中心和有效下边界三个深度属性，通过共享编码器与多解码器结构增强了深度估计的一致性和稳健性。数值实验表明，该方法能够获得空间连续、抗噪性更强且结构更连贯的结果。
authors: Xiang Huang, Lanqing Chen, Huaisheng Xu and Zhuo Jia
articles.abstract_zh_full: 欧拉反褶积仍然是重力解释中最常用的技术之一，因为它简单且计算高效。然而，其输出通常仅限于离散的源点估计，并且在噪声条件下或结构指数假设不合适时可能变得不稳定，尤其是在复杂地质环境中更是如此。为克服这些限制，我们提出一种多任务深度学习框架，可直接从重力数据中估计三个关键结构深度属性——顶界、结构中心以及有效下界。不同于先反演物性参数再推断结构边界的传统流程，该框架采用一种几何驱动的学习范式，直接从重力异常预测具有结构意义的深度属性。共享编码器与多解码器架构使相关深度属性能够联合学习，从而提升深度稳定性与结构一致性。合成实验表明，该框架能够产生空间连续、抗噪性更强的结构表示，并具有更好的结构连贯性和地质可解释性。结果表明，深度学习可以作为一种面向几何的替代方案，用于从重力数据中提取连续的结构表征，而不必严格充当数学意义上的反褶积方法。该研究为位场解释提供了一条新途径，即通过重力异常直接、稳定地表征地下结构。

articles.title: Fourth-order closure obstruction and chiral nonlocality in circular kinetic magnetotransport
articles.title_zh: 圆形动力学磁输运中的四阶闭合障碍与手性非局域性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22730v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Closing an angular moment hierarchy at the stress level omits a definite back-action from higher Fermi-surface harmonics. For a circular two-dimensional Fermi surface, streaming changes angular momentum by one, so the shortest omitted sequence, 1!→!2!→!3!→!2!→!1, adds a fourth-order term to the current eigenvalue, Łambda(q)=γ₁₊ν q²⁻κ₄q⁴⁺ḑots, with ν=v_F²/(4γ₂₎ and κ₄₌ν²/γ₃. We call this missing operator term the fourth-order closure obstruction. Its gradient expansion is controlled when ν q²/γ₃łl1. Circular symmetry carries the same coefficient into a radial bi-Laplacian within each conserved angular-momentum block, and retaining m=3 exactly, without a gradient expansion, amplifies higher radial modes monotonically. At zero field, positive collision rates exclude real-wave-number poles and response zeros; an equal-rate tail gives a square-root completion. A magnetic field makes the coefficient chiral, produces a Hall sign reversal, and enhances it when the m=3 harmonic is long lived. In the collisionless high-field limit, the complete hierarchy becomes a Bessel pole--zero ladder, while finite closures form rational approximants to it. The result separates a controlled low-gradient coefficient from its geometry- and field-dependent finite-wave-number completion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究了在圆形二维费米面上对角动量层级做闭合近似时，高阶费米面谐波被省略所带来的反馈效应。作者指出，这种遗漏会在电流本征值中引入四阶项，并将其称为“四阶闭合障碍”；在磁场作用下，该项表现出手性特征并可导致霍尔信号反转。文中还讨论了不同碰撞与高场极限下的极点—零点结构及其近似行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在应力层级闭合角动量矩时，会遗漏来自更高费米面谐波的确定性反馈。对于圆形二维费米面，流动项每次使角动量改变一阶，因此最短的被遗漏序列 1→2→3→2→1 会给电流本征值增加一个四阶项，λ(q)=γ₁+νq²−κ₄q⁴+⋯，其中 ν=v_F²/(4γ₂)，κ₄=ν²/γ₃。我们将这一缺失的算符项称为四阶闭合障碍。其梯度展开在 νq²/γ₃≪1 时是受控的。圆对称性把相同的系数带入每个守恒角动量块中的径向双拉普拉斯项，而严格保留 m=3、但不做梯度展开时，会单调放大更高的径向模。零磁场下，正的碰撞率排除了实波数极点和响应零点；当尾部各态碰撞率相等时，则给出一个平方根补全。磁场会使该系数呈手性，产生霍尔符号反转，并在 m=3 谐波寿命较长时增强这一效应。在无碰撞的高场极限中，完整层级成为贝塞尔极点—零点阶梯，而有限闭合则构成其有理逼近。该结果将一个受控的低梯度系数，与其在几何和磁场依赖下的有限波矢完整化区分开来。

articles.title: Theory of Andreev reflection spectroscopy with anisotropic spin-dependent scattering
articles.title_zh: 具有各向异性自旋依赖散射的安德烈夫反射光谱理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spintronic technologies require efficient generation and control of spin-polarized currents. Conventional ferromagnet-based methods suffer from sensitivity to external magnetic fields. Andreev reflection spectroscopy is vital for measuring spin polarization and superconducting gaps, yet prevailing theories assume isotropic interface scattering. This neglects ubiquitous anisotropy in heterostructures, causing misinterpretation of material properties. To resolve this, we develop a generalized model incorporating spin-dependent anisotropic scattering. Introducing distinct interface barriers for spin-up and spin-down electrons extends both the Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk formalism and the Chen-Tesanovic-Chien extension. This unified framework describes transport from normal metals to half-metals. Solving the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations with modified boundary conditions yields current formulae with a transmission probability judgment function identifying dominant spin channels. In non-magnetic metals, interfacial anisotropy generates sizable spin-polarized currents via transmission spin filtering, suppressing Andreev reflection and reducing sub-gap conductance. For positively polarized ferromagnets, anisotropy nonlinearly modulates polarization, enhancing Andreev reflection to a threshold before suppression. Negatively polarized materials exhibit inverse spectra, enabling unambiguous polarization sign determination via conductance comparisons. Epitaxial Co film measurements validate the model, resolving subtle anisotropies. This refines Andreev spectrum interpretation and supports interference-resistant spin sources using non-magnetic platforms, benefiting magnetoresistive devices and superconducting quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对传统安德烈夫反射理论通常假设界面散射各向同性、从而易误判材料性质的问题，建立了一个包含自旋依赖各向异性散射的广义模型。作者通过为自旋上、下电子引入不同界面势垒，扩展了 BTK 及相关理论，并结合 BdG 方程给出了适用于正常金属到半金属输运的统一描述。该框架可用于解释界面各向异性如何影响自旋极化电流与安德烈夫反射过程。
authors: Zhiyue Li, Guoping Zhang, Tingyong Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋电子学技术需要高效地生成和控制自旋极化电流。传统的基于铁磁体的方法会受到外磁场的敏感影响。安德烈夫反射光谱对于测量自旋极化和超导能隙至关重要，但现有理论通常假设界面散射是各向同性的。这忽略了异质结构中普遍存在的各向异性，从而可能导致对材料性质的误判。为解决这一问题，我们建立了一个纳入自旋依赖各向异性散射的广义模型。通过为自旋上、下电子引入不同的界面势垒，该模型将布洛欣—坦米尔卡拉普金（BTK）形式主义以及陈—特萨诺维奇—钱（Chen-Tesanovic-Chien）扩展统一起来。这个统一框架描述了从正常金属到半金属的输运过程。通过在修正后的边界条件下求解Bogoliubov–de Gennes方程，得到了一组电流公式，其中包含一个传输概率判别函数，用以识别主导的自旋通道。在非磁性金属中，界面各向异性可通过传输自旋滤波产生相当可观的自旋极化电流，同时抑制安德烈夫反射并降低子能隙电导。对于正极化的铁磁体，各向异性以非线性方式调制极化，在达到某一阈值之前增强安德烈夫反射，随后又使其受抑。负极化材料则表现出反向光谱，使得可通过电导比较明确判定极化符号。外延 Co 薄膜测量验证了该模型，并解析了细微的各向异性。该研究改进了对安德烈夫光谱的解释，也支持利用非磁性平台构建抗干扰的自旋源，对磁阻器件和超导量子技术具有潜在价值。

articles.title: New class of exactly flat topological bands - compact localised states protected by local graph topology
articles.title_zh: 一种由局域图拓扑保护的全新精确平带：紧致局域化态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22831v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly correlated quantum matter is fundamentally defined by the tension between non-commuting quantum operators. Hamiltonians exhibiting macroscopic degeneracies are of general interest in this field because they imply an infinite susceptibility to any non-commuting perturbation. In moiré heterostructures, engineering such extensive degeneracies in the kinetic Hamiltonian creates a fertile garden for exotic strongly correlated phases of matter to emerge from the resulting flat bands. Here, we introduce a prescription to construct an infinite family of exact flat band Hamiltonians supported on the faces of arbitrary graphs. We demonstrate this algorithm on the faces of four Bravais lattices. Using a discrete graph generalization of the Atiyah-Singer index theorem, we prove that the extensive degeneracies of such face-graph Hamiltonians are protected by the local topology of the face-graph connectivity. The resulting macroscopic null spaces yield compact localised states that remain localised over time due to frustration in hopping pathways. We discuss the broad implications of such non-dispersing quantum modes in diverse settings, from arrested dynamics in quantum networks and quantum machine learning algorithms to Majorana-free topological quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一类构造精确平带哈密顿量的方法，可在任意图的面上生成无限族平带模型。作者利用离散图的 Atiyah-Singer 指数定理推广，证明这些宏观简并由局域图连接拓扑所保护。由此产生的宏观零空间支持紧致局域化态，使其因跳跃通道受挫而长期保持局域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强关联量子物质从根本上由不对易量子算符之间的张力所定义。具有宏观简并的哈密顿量在该领域具有普遍重要性，因为它们意味着对任何不对易扰动都具有无限的磁化率。在莫尔异质结构中，在动能哈密顿量中工程化这种大尺度简并性，会为由所得平带涌现的奇异强关联相的形成提供肥沃土壤。本文提出一种构造方案，可在任意图的面上构建一个由无穷多个精确平坦能带哈密顿量组成的族。我们将这一算法应用于四种布拉维晶格的面上。借助离散图版本的 Atiyah-Singer 指数定理，我们证明这类面—图哈密顿量的广泛简并受面—图连通性的局域拓扑保护。由此产生的宏观零空间支持紧致局域态，而由于跃迁路径中的受挫，这些态会在时间演化中保持局域。我们讨论了这种不色散量子模在多种场景中的广泛意义，包括量子网络中的冻结动力学、量子机器学习算法，以及不依赖马约拉纳粒子的拓扑量子计算。

articles.title: Radiative Spin Caloritronics
articles.title_zh: 辐射自旋热电学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We predict the spin thermal Hall effect in nonreciprocal magneto-optical many-body systems, in which a longitudinal radiative heat current generates a transverse accumulation of the spin angular momentum carried by thermal photons. We show that this effect and the inverse spin thermal Hall effect constitute an Onsager-Casimir reciprocal pair, thereby establishing heat and photon spin as coupled transport channels in nonreciprocal photonic systems. The second law of thermodynamics imposes fundamental bounds on the spin-heat coupling, leading to a thermal-spin figure of merit that quantifies the efficiency of radiative spin-heat conversion. Our results establish a complete thermodynamic framework for photon spin caloritronics and lay the conceptual foundations for spin-controlled thermal radiation and nonreciprocal photonic thermal devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者预测了非互易磁光多体系统中的自旋热霍尔效应，即纵向辐射热流可在横向诱发热光子自旋角动量的积累。研究同时表明，该效应及其逆过程构成 Onsager-Casimir 互易对，说明热输运与光子自旋是相互耦合的输运通道。文中还从热力学第二定律出发给出了自旋-热耦合的基本约束，并建立了用于衡量辐射自旋热转换效率的性能指标。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们预测了非互易磁光多体系统中的自旋热霍尔效应。在这类系统中，纵向辐射热流会在横向产生由热光子携带的自旋角动量积累。我们表明，该效应及其逆自旋热霍尔效应构成一对 Onsager-Casimir 互易过程，从而建立了热量与光子自旋在非互易光子系统中作为耦合输运通道的地位。热力学第二定律对自旋—热耦合施加了基本界限，进而引入了一个热-自旋优值因子，用以量化辐射自旋—热转换的效率。我们的结果为光子自旋热电学建立了完整的热力学框架，并为可由自旋控制的热辐射以及非互易光子热器件奠定了概念基础。

articles.title: From Local Structure to Thermodynamics and Transport of Water with Machine Learning Force Fields
articles.title_zh: 从局域结构到水的热力学与输运：机器学习力场研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We evaluate machine learning force fields derived from different density functional theory exchange correlation functionals using the full six-dimensional pair correlation function of liquid water, three-body structural descriptors, excess entropy, and transport properties. The predicted microscopic structure and dynamics depend strongly on the underlying functional: neglecting dispersion produces pronounced overstructuring, overly negative excess entropy, and suppressed diffusion. Translational and orientational entropy contributions are tightly coupled and together exhibit a clear relationship with the reduced selfdiffusion coefficient. Among the tested models, RPBE-D3 provides the most consistent agreement with experiment across structural, thermodynamic, and transport properties. The classical SPC/E model serves as an additional reference and displays notable similarities to RPBE-D3, consistent with the comparable Born effective and partial charges of the two models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较了基于不同密度泛函理论交换-相关泛函构建的水分子机器学习力场，并结合六维对分布函数、三体结构描述符、超额熵和输运性质进行评估。结果表明，体系的微观结构与动力学对底层泛函高度敏感：忽略色散会导致过度结构化、超额熵过低以及扩散受抑。平动与取向熵贡献紧密耦合，并与约化自扩散系数呈明确关联；在所测试模型中，RPBE-D3与实验在结构、热力学和输运性质上最一致，经典SPC/E模型也表现出与其相近的特征。
authors: Andreas Kretschmer, Florian Altmann, Nader Nour, Alper T. Celebi, Markus Valtiner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用液态水的完整六维对相关函数、三体结构描述符、过剩熵以及输运性质，评估了由不同密度泛函理论交换-相关泛函导出的机器学习力场。预测得到的微观结构和动力学强烈依赖于所使用的底层泛函：忽略色散相互作用会导致显著的过度结构化、过于负的过剩熵以及受抑的扩散。平动熵与取向熵的贡献紧密耦合，并共同与约化自扩散系数表现出清晰关系。在所测试的模型中，RPBE-D3 在结构、热力学和输运性质上与实验的一致性最为全面。经典 SPC/E 模型作为额外参考，也表现出与 RPBE-D3 的显著相似性，这与两种模型具有相近的 Born 有效电荷和部分电荷相一致。

articles.title: Single crystal growth, structural and magnetic properties of CeZn₂₋ₓGa₂₊ₓ
articles.title_zh: CeZn₂₋ₓGa₂₊ₓ单晶生长、结构与磁性性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The tetragonal BaAl₄ (I4/mmm) parent structure underpins a diverse family of materials exhibiting novel phenomena, including nematic superconductivity, topological semimetallicity, and heavy fermion behavior. The recent growth of ternary R-Zn-Ga compounds, such as the previously reported CeZn₂Ga₂, has explored some of the members exhibiting rare-earth magnetism within this family. In this paper, we report on the structural and magnetic properties of single crystals of CeZn₂₋ₓGa₂₊ₓ, a Ga-rich analogue of CeZn₂Ga₂. Our CeZn₂₋ₓGa₂₊ₓ samples exhibit magnetic properties distinct from the paramagnetic behavior previously reported for CeZn₂Ga₂. We observe a magnetic transition around 4 K, pronounced metamagnetic states at low temperatures, and strong magnetic anisotropy. Though there are batch-to-batch variations that suggest a strong sensitivity to local structural imperfections, we consistently see the presence of magnetic transitions and metamagnetic states in our crystals. To investigate the local structural sensitivity hypothesis, we performed Reverse Monte Carlo analysis of collected powder neutron diffraction data, revealing the presence of significant local crystallographic disorder of the magnetic Ce site. Our findings demonstrate that the positional disorder drives competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic correlations that lead to the observed spin glass behavior and complex anisotropic magnetism. This study illustrates that tuning the local crystallographic disorder enables engineering frustrated magnetic states in BaAl₄₋ₜype and similar intermetallic structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了Ga富集化合物CeZn₂₋ₓGa₂₊ₓ单晶的生长及其结构与磁性性质研究，该体系可视为CeZn₂Ga₂的相关变体。与此前报道的顺磁行为不同，该材料表现出约4 K附近的磁性转变、明显的低温亚稳磁态以及强磁各向异性。不同批次样品之间存在差异，提示局域结构缺陷对磁性具有较强影响；作者还结合粉末中子衍射与反向蒙特卡洛分析，探讨了这种结构敏感性。
authors: Danila Sokratov (Maryland Quantum Materials Center, Department of Physics, University of Maryland, College Park, MD), H. Cein Mandujano (Maryland Quantum Materials Center, Department of Physics, University of Maryland, College Park, MD, Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry, University of Maryland, College Park, MD), Ram Kumar (Maryland Quantum Materials Center, Department of Physics, University of Maryland, College Park, MD), Jared Z. Dans (Maryland Quantum Materials Center, Department of Physics, University of Maryland, College Park, MD), Phineas Sobel (Maryland Quantum Materials Center, Department of Physics, University of Maryland, College Park, MD), Nicholas A. Crombie (Maryland Quantum Materials Center, Department of Physics, University of Maryland, College Park, MD), Alicia Manjón-Sanz (Neutron Scattering Division, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, TN), Danielle R. Yahne (Neutron Scattering Division, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, TN), Philip Piccoli (Department of Geological, Environmental, and Planetary Sciences, University of Maryland, College Park, MD), Peter Y. Zavalij (Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry, University of Maryland, College Park, MD), Efrain E. Rodriguez (Maryland Quantum Materials Center, Department of Physics, University of Maryland, College Park, MD, Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry, University of Maryland, College Park, MD), Johnpierre Paglione (Maryland Quantum Materials Center, Department of Physics, University of Maryland, College Park, MD, Canadian Institute for Advanced Research, Toronto, Ontario)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 四方 BaAl₄（I4/mmm）母体结构支撑着一大类具有新奇现象的材料家族，包括向列超导、拓扑半金属态以及重费米子行为。近年来，对三元 R-Zn-Ga 化合物的生长，例如此前报道的 CeZn₂Ga₂，已经探索了该家族中若干呈现稀土磁性的成员。本文报道了 Ga 富集型 CeZn₂₋ₓGa₂₊ₓ 单晶的结构和磁性性质，它是 CeZn₂Ga₂ 的一个 Ga 富集类比物。我们的 CeZn₂₋ₓGa₂₊ₓ 样品表现出与先前报道的 CeZn₂Ga₂ 顺磁行为不同的磁性。我们观察到约 4 K 附近的磁相变、低温下显著的磁阻化状态，以及强磁各向异性。尽管不同批次之间存在变化，提示该材料对局域结构缺陷具有很强敏感性，但我们在晶体中始终观察到磁相变和磁阻化状态。为检验这一局域结构敏感性的假设，我们对采集到的粉末中子衍射数据进行了反向蒙特卡罗分析，结果显示磁性 Ce 位点存在显著的局域晶体学无序。我们的发现表明，这种位置无序驱动了竞争性的铁磁和反铁磁关联，进而导致所观察到的自旋玻璃行为和复杂的各向异性磁性。该研究说明，通过调控局域晶体无序，可以在 BaAl₄ 型及类似金属间结构中设计受挫磁态。

articles.title: AEcroscopyWave: Towards Self-Driving Characterization Platforms for Agentic AI
articles.title_zh: AEcroscopyWave：迈向面向智能体AI的自驱动表征平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The characterization of electronic materials has traditionally been stratified into two distinct regimens: industry-scale automated systems to inspect materials for defects and ensure quality (such as in the semiconductor industry), and highly customized, operator-driven systems requiring human experts. The former offers high throughput but limited flexibility, whereas the latter is heavily bandwidth-limited but provides research-grade discovery capabilities. Recent advances in "self-driving" characterization tools offer the potential to bridge the two stratified regimes, by the creation of application program interfaces (APIs) that can control hardware, and the integration of AI methods to incorporate autonomy into the process. Here, we discuss our latest developments in AEcroscopyWave, a custom-built characterization platform for the agentic-AI era, that provides unified control of scanning probe microscopes with programmable peripheral instrumentation, highlighting the design choices that are necessary for maximizing the capability of the system and the ease of use for both human and AI agents. The benefits of making heterogeneous scientific instruments accessible, composable and usable by agents is demonstrated by test cases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了用于电子材料表征的AEcroscopyWave平台，旨在连接传统自动化检测系统与依赖专家操作的研究级仪器。该平台通过API实现对扫描探针显微镜及外围仪器的统一控制，并为引入AI自治能力提供硬件与软件基础。作者重点讨论了系统设计中的关键取舍，以提升人类用户与AI智能体共同使用时的灵活性、可扩展性和易用性。
authors: Yongtao Liu, Jawad Chowdhury, Ganesh Narasimha, Ralph Bulanadi, Liam Collins, Ruben Millan Solsona, Marti Checa, Asraful Haque, Sumner B. Harris, Stephen Jesse, Rama Vasudevan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子材料的表征传统上被分为两种不同的模式：一种是工业规模的自动化系统，用于检查材料缺陷并确保质量（例如半导体工业中的系统）；另一种则是高度定制、由操作人员驱动并需要人类专家参与的系统。前者具有高通量但灵活性有限，后者带宽受限较严重，但能够提供研究级的发现能力。近年来，“自驱动”表征工具的进展有望弥合这两种分层模式，其关键在于创建能够控制硬件的应用程序接口（API），并将 AI 方法整合进流程中以实现自主性。本文介绍了我们在 AEcroscopyWave 上的最新进展。AEcroscopyWave 是一个面向代理式人工智能时代定制构建的表征平台，可统一控制扫描探针显微镜及可编程外围仪器。我们强调了为最大化系统能力以及提高人类和 AI 代理的易用性所必须采用的设计选择。通过若干测试案例展示了将异质科学仪器开放为可被代理访问、可组合且可用的系统所带来的益处。

articles.title: Uncertainty-quantified J-integral computation for quasicontinuum and finite element methods
articles.title_zh: 适用于准连续体与有限元方法的J积分不确定性量化计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The J-integral is a fundamental concept in fracture mechanics, quantifying the energy release rate that drives crack propagation. While extensively implemented in finite element (FE) codes and adapted for atomistic calculations, its application within multiscale frameworks bridging atomistic and continuum formulations remains unexplored. This work presents a rigorous implementation and validation of the J-integral within the three-dimensional quasicontinuum (QC3D) method, computed under plane strain assumptions, using continuum fields (stress, strain energy density) derived from the interatomic potential via the Cauchy-Born rule. The implementation is validated against linear elastic fracture mechanics (LEFM) theory and the virtual crack extension (VCE) method across three regimes: (1) small-strain linear elasticity, with a prescribed anisotropic K-field displacement applied throughout; (2) the same field evaluated through the nonlinear Cauchy-Born constitutive relation, without atomic relaxation; and (3) the same relation with atomic relaxation enabled, allowing the crack-tip region to equilibrate. Excellent agreement is shown throughout. We further introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo framework to statistically quantify the uncertainty of J-integral results for a given mesh and integration domain, applicable to conventional FE methods as well. Predictive capability is demonstrated via a QC3D simulation of a three-point bending test of silicon, where the computed critical energy release rate agrees closely with the Griffith criterion. This work establishes a reliable framework for evaluating crack driving forces in multiscale fracture simulations with quantified uncertainty, enabling large-scale fracture simulations while resolving atomistic mechanisms at the crack tip.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在三维准连续体方法中实现并验证了J积分计算，用于刻画裂纹扩展驱动力这一断裂力学核心量。作者基于Cauchy-Born规则从原子间势函数导出连续场量，并在平面应变假设下，将该实现与线弹性断裂力学及虚拟裂纹扩展方法进行对比验证。结果表明，该方法在不同应变与原子弛豫情形下均具有良好一致性，为多尺度断裂分析提供了可量化不确定性的计算框架。
authors: Sai Harshith Badi, Stephen M. Whalen, Ronald E. Miller, Ellad B. Tadmor
articles.abstract_zh_full: J 积分是断裂力学中的一个基本概念，用于量化驱动裂纹扩展的能量释放率。尽管它已在有限元（FE）代码中被广泛实现并被改编用于原子尺度计算，但其在桥接原子与连续介质表述的多尺度框架中的应用尚未被探索。本文在三维准连续介质（QC3D）方法中，对平面应变假设下的 J 积分进行了严格实现与验证，其中所用连续场（应力、应变能密度）通过 Cauchy-Born 规则由原子间势导出。我们将该实现与线弹性断裂力学（LEFM）理论以及虚拟裂纹扩展（VCE）方法在三个工况下进行了验证：（1）小应变线弹性情形，在整个体系中施加预设的各向异性 K 场位移；（2）在不发生原子弛豫的情况下，通过非线性 Cauchy-Born 本构关系评估同一位移场；（3）在允许原子弛豫的情况下使用同一本构关系，使裂尖区域达到平衡。结果在整个过程中均显示出极好的一致性。我们进一步引入马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗框架，对给定网格和积分区域下的 J 积分结果进行统计意义上的不确定性量化，该框架同样适用于传统有限元方法。通过对硅三点弯曲试验的 QC3D 模拟展示了其预测能力，其中计算得到的临界能量释放率与 Griffith 判据高度一致。该工作建立了一个可靠框架，用于在量化不确定性的多尺度断裂模拟中评估裂纹驱动力，并使在解析裂尖原子机制的同时开展大尺度断裂模拟成为可能。

articles.title: Ferroelastic exciton splitting in hybrid perovskite nanowalls
articles.title_zh: 杂化钙钛矿纳米墙中的铁弹性激子分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23051v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid metal-halide perovskites are soft semiconductors in which electronic excitations are strongly influenced by lattice distortions and structural phase transitions. An important open question is whether ferroelastic symmetry breaking merely broadens optical resonances or instead modifies excitonic states through exciton-lattice coupling. Here, we address this question using highly aligned MAPbI3 nanowalls fabricated by glancing-angle deposition, enabling symmetry-selective coupling between ferroelastic texture, structural anisotropy, and a well-defined optical axis. Combining temperature-dependent photoluminescence, X-ray diffraction and polarization-resolved ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy, we observe a polarization-selective excitonic splitting in the orthorhombic phase at 5 K, characterized by orthogonal optical selection rules and a 45 meV energy separation. Near 160 K, where orthorhombic and tetragonal phases coexist, a lower-energy lattice-coupled excitation emerges 58 meV below the centre of the anisotropically split excitonic structure, consistent with coupling between excitonic and lattice-dressed states. At higher temperatures, these excitations progressively acquire lattice-dressed character accompanied by reduced optical anisotropy. A symmetry-guided effective Hamiltonian captures the evolution from anisotropically split excitons to coupled excitonic and lattice-dressed states across the structural transition. Our results show that ferroelastic texture and phase coexistence can modify exciton-lattice coupling, providing a route to symmetry-selective optical responses in soft polar semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了MAPbI3杂化金属卤化物钙钛矿纳米墙中铁弹性结构畸变如何影响激子态。借助温度依赖光致发光、X射线衍射和偏振分辨超快瞬态吸收，作者观察到低温正交相中存在偏振选择性的激子分裂，并在相变附近发现与晶格耦合相关的更低能激发。结果表明，铁弹性对称性破缺不仅会展宽光学共振，还会通过激子-晶格耦合作用直接重塑激子本征态。
authors: Afreen, J. Delgado-Alvarez, H. Krishna Mishra, J. Castillo-Seoane, Koustav Maiti, Pravrati Taank, A. Borras, A. Barranco, Surajit Saha, Priya Mahadevan, J. R. Sanchez-Valencia, K. V. Adarsh
articles.abstract_zh_full: 杂化金属卤化物钙钛矿是软半导体，其中电子激发受到晶格畸变和结构相变的强烈影响。一个重要的开放问题是，铁弹性对称性破缺究竟只是使光学共振展宽，还是会通过激子—晶格耦合改变激子态。在这里，我们利用通过掠射角沉积制备的高度取向 MAPbI3 纳米墙来解决这一问题，这使铁弹性织构、结构各向异性和明确定义的光轴之间能够发生对称性选择性耦合。结合变温光致发光、X 射线衍射和偏振分辨超快瞬态吸收光谱，我们在 5 K 的正交相中观测到偏振选择性的激子劈裂，其特征是正交的光学选择定则和 45 meV 的能量间隔。在约 160 K、即正交相和四方相共存的区域，一个较低能量的晶格耦合激发出现在各向异性劈裂激子结构中心以下 58 meV 处，这与激子态和晶格修饰态之间的耦合相一致。在更高温度下，这些激发逐渐获得晶格修饰特征，并伴随光学各向异性的降低。一个由对称性指导的有效哈密顿量描述了跨结构相变过程中从各向异性劈裂激子到耦合的激子态和晶格修饰态的演化。我们的结果表明，铁弹性织构和相共存可以改变激子—晶格耦合，从而为软极性半导体中的对称性选择性光学响应提供一条途径。

articles.title: Hydrogen-Induced Sign Reversal in Magnetic Hysteresis Evolution of CoPd Alloys and Co/Pd Multilayers
articles.title_zh: CoPd合金与Co/Pd多层膜磁滞演化中的氢致符号反转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23053v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrogen absorption in magnetic thin film nanostructures can modulate their electronic, magnetic, and transport properties by modifying the electronic structure and lattice strain. However, the influence of composition and nanostructuring on these two competing effects is not well understood. We systematically investigate hydrogen-induced magnetic hysteresis in CoₓPd₁₀₀₋ₓ alloys, [Co(0.1 nm)/Pd(d)]₁₅, and [Co(0.2 nm)/Pd(d)]₁₅ multilayers, using extraordinary Hall effect characterizations (EHE) in air and 4% H₂/N₂ mixture. We show that the hydrogen-induced response is not universal, but depends strongly on composition and layer thickness. This reflects competition between Pd-related electronic effects and magnetoelastic anisotropy. In Pd-rich CoPd alloys and Co(0.2 nm)/Pd multilayers, hydrogen initially contracts the hysteresis loops at low Co fractions, followed by loop expansion above x ~ 40%. This contrast results from competition between suppression of Pd-induced magnetization through Pd-4d band filling and hydrogen-driven anisotropic strain that strengthens magnetoelastic anisotropy in Co-rich samples. In contrast, in ultrathin [Co(0.1 nm)/Pd(d)]₁₅ multilayers, hydrogen induces a weak, non-monotonic but generally expanding loop behaviour across x = 15-60%, indicating a dominant role of interfacial magnetic connectivity and strain-mediated magnetoelastic anisotropy in the ultrathin limit. Furthermore, we observe a hydrogen-induced reversal of the EHE loop polarity near the crossover regime, reflecting a change in the dominant EHE scattering mechanisms, thus providing an additional degree of magnetic tunability by hydrogen. These results demonstrate that hydrogen can selectively tune the magnetism of CoPd nanostructures via composition-controlled electronic and magnetoelastic effects, offering insights for hydrogen-responsive spintronic and sensing devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了氢吸收对CoPd合金及Co/Pd多层膜磁滞回线的影响，采用异常霍尔效应在空气和氢气环境下进行表征。结果显示，氢引起的磁响应并非普适，而是强烈依赖于组分和层厚，反映出Pd相关电子效应与磁弹各向异性之间的竞争。作者指出，在Pd富集样品与更高Co含量样品中，氢对磁滞回线的作用方向可能相反，说明电子填充效应与氢致应变共同决定了磁性演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性薄膜纳米结构中的氢吸收可以通过改变电子结构和晶格应变来调制其电子、磁性和输运性质。然而，成分和纳米结构化对这两种竞争效应的影响尚未得到充分理解。我们利用空气和 4% H2/N2 混合气氛中的反常霍尔效应表征，系统研究了 CoₓPd₁₀₀₋ₓ 合金、[Co(0.1 nm)/Pd(d)]₁₅ 和 [Co(0.2 nm)/Pd(d)]₁₅ 多层膜中的氢诱导磁滞。我们表明，氢诱导响应并非普适，而是强烈依赖成分和层厚。这反映了 Pd 相关电子效应与磁弹各向异性之间的竞争。在富 Pd 的 CoPd 合金和 Co(0.2 nm)/Pd 多层膜中，氢在低 Co 含量时最初使磁滞回线收缩，而在 x 约大于 40% 后导致回线扩张。这种对比源于 Pd-4d 能带填充所导致的 Pd 诱导磁化抑制与氢驱动各向异性应变之间的竞争，后者会增强富 Co 样品中的磁弹各向异性。相反，在超薄 [Co(0.1 nm)/Pd(d)]₁₅ 多层膜中，氢在 x = 15–60% 范围内诱导一种较弱、非单调但总体上扩张的回线行为，表明在超薄极限下界面磁性连通性和应变介导的磁弹各向异性起主导作用。此外，我们在交叉区域附近观察到氢诱导的 EHE 回线极性反转，这反映了占主导地位的 EHE 散射机制发生变化，从而提供了通过氢实现磁性可调的额外自由度。这些结果表明，氢可以通过成分控制的电子效应和磁弹效应选择性调控 CoPd 纳米结构的磁性，为氢响应自旋电子和传感器件提供见解。

articles.title: Evolution of the electronic and superconducting properties of Re-based quinary high-entropy alloys under chemical and physical pressure
articles.title_zh: 化学压与物理压下Re基五元高熵合金电子与超导性质的演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a comparative study of chemical- and physical-pressure effects on the electronic and superconducting properties of the Re-based quinary high-entropy alloys (HEAs) [Nb0.67-xRex][TiZrHf]0.33 (x = 0.10, 0.20, and 0.56). Increasing Re concentration suppresses the superconducting transition temperature Tc from 5.4 to 3.9 K while producing positive, composition-dependent cocktail-effect ratios. Field-dependent transport and magnetization establish all three compositions as strongly type-II superconductors and identify x = 0.20 as the most distinctive composition, with the largest upper critical field and Ginzburg-Landau parameter and a Maki parameter close to unity. Most importantly, the pressure coefficient of Tc changes sign across the bcc-hcp structural change: dTc/dP is positive for the bcc x = 0.10 and 0.20 samples, with values of approximately 0.018 and 0.053 K/GPa, respectively, but negative for the hcp x = 0.56 sample, with a value of approximately -0.033 K/GPa. This systematic contrast within a single chemically related alloy series establishes a robust structure-associated superconducting response and identifies crystal structure as a key organizing variable under compression. Metallic transport and superconductivity remain robust up to approximately 8 GPa in all three compositions. These results reveal that chemical substitution and hydrostatic compression are complementary but nonequivalent routes for tuning superconductivity in Re-based HEAs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较了Re基五元高熵合金[ Nb0.67-xRex ][TiZrHf]0.33在化学调控和外加压力下的电子结构与超导行为。随着Re含量增加，超导转变温度Tc降低，而不同成分表现出与组态相关的混合效应特征；同时，各样品均表现为强II类超导体。更重要的是，随着晶体结构从bcc转变为hcp，Tc对压力的响应由正变负，表明该合金系列存在与结构状态紧密相关的超导响应。
authors: Thiagarajan Maran, Yoshiya Uwatoko, Sathea Suweatha M N, Sonika Jangid, R. P. Singh, Arumugam Sonachalam, Sathiskumar Mariappan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报道了化学压力和物理压力对 Re 基五元高熵合金（HEAs）[Nb0.67-xRex][TiZrHf]0.33（x = 0.10、0.20 和 0.56）的电子和超导性质影响的比较研究。增加 Re 浓度会将超导转变温度 Tc 从 5.4 K 抑制到 3.9 K，同时产生正的、依赖成分的鸡尾酒效应比。场依赖输运和磁化测量确定三种成分均为强 II 型超导体，并识别出 x = 0.20 是最具特色的成分，其具有最大的上临界场和 Ginzburg-Landau 参数，以及接近 1 的 Maki 参数。最重要的是，Tc 的压力系数在 bcc-hcp 结构变化前后发生符号改变：对于 bcc 结构的 x = 0.10 和 0.20 样品，dTc/dP 为正，数值分别约为 0.018 和 0.053 K/GPa；而对于 hcp 结构的 x = 0.56 样品，dTc/dP 为负，数值约为 -0.033 K/GPa。在单一化学相关合金系列内的这种系统性对比确立了一种稳健的结构关联超导响应，并将晶体结构确定为压缩条件下的关键组织变量。在所有三种成分中，金属输运和超导性在高达约 8 GPa 时仍保持稳健。这些结果揭示，化学替代和静水压缩是调控 Re 基高熵合金超导性的互补但不等价途径。

articles.title: Imaging of van der Waals Materials via Standing-Wave Photoemission Microscopy: Depth-Resolved Electronic Structure of WS2
articles.title_zh: 利用驻波光电子显微术成像范德瓦耳斯材料：WS2的深度分辨电子结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional van der Waals materials promise electronic, optoelectronic, and quantum technologies, yet depth-resolved characterization remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate standing-wave photoemission electron microscopy (SW-PEEM) for Angstrom-scale spectromicroscopy of monolayer WS2 on a W/C multilayer substrate. Tuning the X-ray standing wave through the monolayer yields a chemical depth profile and valence-band modulation with enhanced sensitivity to the top and bottom sulfur layers. X-ray optical modeling determines the structure and field distribution. The measurements reveal an ~0.2 eV shift in sulfur-derived valence-band spectral weight between measurements with enhanced sensitivity to the top and bottom sulfur layers. This shift is unlikely to arise from strong direct substrate hybridization and is instead consistent with sulfur-related surface species, as supported by calculations using a representative elemental-sulfur model. These results establish SW-PEEM as a non-destructive depth-resolved probe, highlighting its potential to probe interfacial coupling, chemical reconstruction, and emergent states in van der Waals and moiré systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了驻波光电子显微术（SW-PEEM）在单层WS2/W-C多层基底体系上的原子尺度光谱成像能力，可用于深度分辨表征范德瓦耳斯材料。通过调谐X射线驻波穿过单层样品，作者获得了化学深度分布以及价带调制信息，并增强了对上、下硫层的敏感性。实验观察到硫相关价带谱权重约0.2 eV的变化，表明该方法可作为一种无损的深度分辨探针，用于研究界面耦合、化学重构和新奇态。
authors: J. R. Paudel, R. Muzzio, M. E. Matzelle, S. Sheikh, A. Fadul, A. Tiwari, F. Salmassi, E. Gullikson, K. M. McCreary, B. T. Jonker, J. Nieminen, C. M. Schneider, F. Kronast, A. Bansil, J. Katoch, A. X. Gray
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维范德华材料为电子、光电子和量子技术带来前景，但深度分辨表征仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了驻波光发射电子显微术（SW-PEEM）用于 W/C 多层衬底上单层 WS2 的埃尺度谱显微成像。通过调谐穿过单层的 X 射线驻波，可以获得化学深度剖面和价带调制，并对顶部和底部硫层具有增强的灵敏度。X 射线光学建模确定了结构和场分布。测量揭示，在对顶部和底部硫层具有增强灵敏度的测量之间，硫衍生价带谱权重存在约 0.2 eV 的位移。这种位移不太可能源于强的直接衬底杂化，而是与硫相关表面物种相一致，这一点得到了使用代表性元素硫模型进行计算的支持。这些结果确立了 SW-PEEM 作为一种非破坏性深度分辨探针的地位，突出了其在探测范德华和莫尔体系中的界面耦合、化学重构和涌现态方面的潜力。

articles.title: Electrical control of the metal-insulator transition in a one dimensional device
articles.title_zh: 一维器件中金属-绝缘体转变的电学调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling the low energy spectrum at the nanoscale with an external physical parameter has become an important resource for quantum devices. The emergence of an energy gap is one such key feature, linked to the mitigation of decoherence needed for quantum information processing. Indeed, the detrimental effects of high-energy uncontrolled excitations can only be cured at some specific tuning points in general. Achieving an energy gap is a natural way to extend decoherence countermeasures over a finite region of parameter space. This would be particularly useful in view of the recent efforts to build superconducting topological chains in a top-down approach. In this work, we demonstrate a large energy gap by spatially modulating the local potential of a suspended carbon nanotube, exploiting an analogy with condensed matter systems. This gap is homogeneous on the nanotube and tunable by about two orders of magnitude, bringing the electronic system from an insulating state to a near-metallic state at low temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过在悬浮碳纳米管上空间调制局域势，实现了对一维器件低能谱的电学调控，并获得了显著能隙。该能隙在纳米管上具有较好的均匀性，且可调范围跨越约两个数量级，使体系可在低温下在绝缘态与近金属态之间切换。该结果为在低维量子器件中通过外部参数抑制退相干、构建更稳定的能谱提供了新思路。
authors: J. Craquelin, L. Jarjat, B. Hue, A. Théry, C. Fruy, N. Struchkov, D. Stefani, M. M. Desjardins, A. Cottet, M. R. Delbecq, T. Kontos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用外部物理参数在纳米尺度控制低能谱已成为量子器件的重要资源。能隙的出现就是这样一种关键特征，它与量子信息处理中所需的退相干抑制相关。事实上，高能不可控激发的不利影响通常只能在某些特定调谐点被消除。实现能隙是一种自然方式，可将退相干对策扩展到参数空间中的有限区域。鉴于近期通过自上而下方法构建超导拓扑链的努力，这将尤其有用。在这项工作中，我们利用与凝聚态系统的类比，通过空间调制悬浮碳纳米管的局域势，展示了一个大的能量能隙。该能隙在纳米管上是均匀的，并且可调范围约为两个数量级，使电子系统在低温下从绝缘态转变为近金属态。

articles.title: Signatures of Topological Magnon Edge States in THz Spectroscopy and Cavity Response
articles.title_zh: 太赫兹光谱与腔响应中的拓扑磁振子边缘态特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological magnon insulators (TMIs) have emerged as promising platforms for low-energy spin-based information processing, due to their non-trivial bulk magnon topology and robust, chiral edge modes that support dissipationless transport. Although theoretical models predict these edge states, direct experimental detection remains challenging due to their limited sensitivity to conventional probes. In this work, we propose an all-optical pathway to detect topological magnon edge modes in ferromagnetic TMIs. Our approach harnesses parametric amplification of edge magnons via resonant electromagnetic driving, enabled by magnetoelectric coupling mechanisms. We concentrate on two-dimensional van der Waals ferromagnetic materials on the honeycomb lattice with magnonic band gaps in the terahertz (THz) range. We show that a spin-dependent effective electric dipole moment, arising from dynamic charge fluctuations and consistent with the lattice symmetry up to next-nearest-neighbor interactions, gives rise to one-photon-two-magnon processes leading to parametric amplification. On this basis, we propose a THz pump-probe spectroscopy protocol in which edge modes are selectively amplified and subsequently detected in absorption. Furthermore, we discuss the possibility of using THz cavities, enabling selective coupling to edge modes while filtering out bulk contributions. These findings establish a route for probing topological magnets and open new avenues for experimental exploration of exotic topological phenomena in magnetic quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种全光学方案，用于探测铁磁拓扑磁振子绝缘体中的拓扑边缘模。作者利用电磁驱动下的边缘磁振子参量放大效应，并结合磁电耦合机制，聚焦于具有太赫兹能隙的二维范德瓦耳斯蜂窝铁磁材料。研究表明，动态电荷涨落导致的有效电偶极矩可引发一光子-两磁振子过程，从而支持太赫兹泵浦-探测光谱方案来识别边缘态信号。
authors: Ipsika Mohanty, Johannes Knolle, Silvia Viola Kusminskiy
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑磁振子绝缘体（TMIs）因其非平庸的体磁振子拓扑和支持无耗散输运的稳健手性边缘模，已成为低能自旋信息处理的有前景平台。尽管理论模型预言了这些边缘态，但由于常规探针对它们的灵敏度有限，直接实验探测仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出一种全光学途径来探测铁磁 TMIs 中的拓扑磁振子边缘模。我们的方法利用通过共振电磁驱动实现的边缘磁振子参量放大，而这一过程由磁电耦合机制所允许。我们聚焦于蜂窝晶格上的二维范德华铁磁材料，其磁振子带隙位于太赫兹（THz）范围。我们表明，由动态电荷涨落产生且在直到次近邻相互作用范围内与晶格对称性一致的自旋依赖有效电偶极矩，会导致一光子—双磁振子过程，从而产生参量放大。在此基础上，我们提出一种 THz 泵浦-探测光谱方案，其中边缘模被选择性放大，随后在吸收中被探测。此外，我们讨论了使用 THz 腔的可能性，该腔能够选择性耦合到边缘模，同时滤除体贡献。这些发现确立了一条探测拓扑磁体的路径，并为实验探索磁性量子材料中的奇异拓扑现象开辟了新方向。

articles.title: Field-tuned incommensurate fan phase in an Ising-like triangular antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 场调控的非公度扇形相：各向异性Ising三角反铁磁体中的发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using single-crystal neutron diffraction we report the observation of a field-tuned incommensurate phase in a field range just below magnetization saturation in the Ising-like triangular-lattice antiferromagnet Na₂BaCo(PO₄₎₂. This phase occurs for magnetic fields applied along the Ising axis and exhibits an in-plane incommensurate propagation vector that moves along the hexagonal Brillouin zone boundary upon varying field, challenging the simple XXZ antiferromagnetic description of the system. Within a semiclassical framework, we successfully identify this pre-saturation phase as a coplanar fan phase and study the role of dipole-dipole interactions and bond-dependent exchange anisotropy in its stabilization mechanism. We additionally present a minimal exchange model including interlayer couplings, which reproduces the complex magnetic phase diagram in field including the observed field-dependence of the incommensurate propagation vector in the fan phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用单晶中子衍射，观测到Ising型三角晶格反铁磁体Na₂BaCo(PO₄)₂在接近磁化饱和前的磁场区间中存在场调控的非公度相。该相的传播矢量随外磁场变化沿六角布里渊区边界移动，说明其磁性行为超出了简单XXZ反铁磁模型的描述。作者在半经典框架下将这一预饱和相识别为共面扇形相，并分析了偶极-偶极相互作用与键相关交换各向异性在其稳定中的作用。
authors: D. Flavián, R. Okuma, P. Manuel, Q. Huang, H. Zhou, R. Coldea
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用单晶中子衍射，我们报道了在类伊辛三角晶格反铁磁体 Na₂BaCo(PO₄)₂ 中、磁化饱和以下不远的磁场范围内观测到场调谐非公度相。该相在磁场沿伊辛轴施加时出现，并表现出面内非公度传播矢量，该矢量在改变磁场时沿六角布里渊区边界移动，从而挑战了对该体系的简单 XXZ 反铁磁描述。在半经典框架内，我们成功地将这一预饱和相识别为共面扇形相，并研究了偶极—偶极相互作用和键依赖交换各向异性在其稳定机制中的作用。我们还提出了一个包含层间耦合的最小交换模型，该模型再现了磁场中的复杂磁相图，包括在扇形相中观测到的非公度传播矢量随磁场的变化。

articles.title: Stoichiometric cluster learning for few-shot property prediction of multi-ionic integrated energetic materials
articles.title_zh: 基于化学计量簇学习的多离子集成含能材料少样本性能预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23208v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-ionic materials pose a distinct representational challenge in machine learning-driven materials design. Different from single-molecule or composition-based materials, their properties arise from how charged building blocks aggregate into specific assemblies. Here, we show how pretrained machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) can bypass full crystal-structure prediction and support pre-synthesis screening from stoichiometric ionic clusters using multi-ionic integrated explosives (MIXs) as a synthesis-facing example. This strategy combines a stoichiometric ionic-cluster representation, which represents each candidate material by a non-periodic, stoichiometry-preserved formula-unit cluster, with multi-task fine-tuning (MT-FT), which adapts a pretrained atomistic backbone while retaining the energy--force objective as physical regularization for the sparse detonation-velocity labels. With the pretrained backbone regularized by MT-FT, this surrogate provides a cross-validated screen across only 25 structurally curated perovskite-type energetic materials (PEMs) with experimentally derived Kamlet--Jacobs (K--J) detonation velocities. Representation probes show that the learned descriptors implicitly retain site-aware ionic organization, density information, and coarse packing compatibility, implying why non-periodic clusters can remain predictive before full crystal structures are known. The surrogate extends known PEMs chemistry to three newly synthesized ABX₄ materials with both unseen ABX₄ stoichiometry and an unseen ethylenediammonium B-site cation, yielding three-point concordance with K--J reference velocities and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 92~mḑots⁻¹ without retraining. Together, these results establish stoichiometry-preserved cluster learning as a synthesis-facing screening strategy for data-scarce multi-ionic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向多离子材料的机器学习设计难题，提出一种基于化学计量离子簇表示与预训练机器学习原子间势的少样本预测策略，并以多离子集成炸药为示例。该方法用保持化学计量的非周期簇来表征候选材料，再通过多任务微调将能量-力学习作为物理正则项，以适配稀缺的爆速标签。作者在一小组结构整理后的钙钛矿型含能材料上进行了交叉验证筛选，表明该框架可用于合成前的材料快速评估。
authors: Ming-Yu Guo, Wei-Jia Zou, Yu Shang, Wei-Xiong Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多离子材料在机器学习驱动的材料设计中提出了一种独特的表示挑战。不同于单分子或基于组成的材料，它们的性质来源于带电构筑单元如何聚集成特定组装体。在这里，我们展示预训练机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）如何绕过完整晶体结构预测，并使用化学计量离子簇支持预合成筛选，其中以多离子集成炸药（MIXs）作为面向合成的实例。该策略将化学计量离子簇表示与多任务微调（MT-FT）相结合：前者用非周期、保持化学计量的化学式单元簇来表示每一种候选材料；后者在保留能量—力目标作为稀疏爆速标签物理正则化的同时，对预训练原子级骨干网络进行适配。在通过 MT-FT 正则化的预训练骨干网络支持下，该代理模型仅基于 25 种经过结构筛选的钙钛矿型含能材料（PEMs）以及由实验得到的 Kamlet-Jacobs（K-J）爆速，提供了交叉验证筛选。表示探针表明，学习到的描述符隐式保留了位点感知的离子组织、密度信息和粗略堆积相容性，这说明了为什么在完整晶体结构未知之前，非周期簇仍可具有预测能力。该代理模型将已知 PEMs 化学扩展到三种新合成的 ABX₄ 材料，这些材料同时具有未见过的 ABX₄ 化学计量和未见过的乙二铵 B 位阳离子；在无需再训练的情况下，该模型与 K-J 参考爆速在三个点上保持一致，平均绝对误差（MAE）为 92 m·s⁻¹。总体而言，这些结果确立了保持化学计量的簇学习作为一种面向合成的筛选策略，可用于数据稀缺的多离子材料。

articles.title: Universal Sign Reversal of Magnetic Response in Transmembrane Ionic Transport
articles.title_zh: 跨膜离子输运中磁响应符号反转的普适规律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weak magnetic fields have long been reported to either enhance or suppress transmembrane ionic currents, yet the physical origin of these apparently contradictory responses remains unresolved. Here, we develop a mesoscopic equilibrium framework showing that weak magnetic fields primarily modify the equilibrium occupation probabilities of metastable transport states, thereby altering the resulting nonequilibrium ionic current. Rather than acting directly on microscopic ionic trajectories, magnetic fields regulate transport through the statistical redistribution of conducting states. This mechanism naturally explains both magnetic enhancement and suppression within a unified theoretical framework and predicts a universal criterion for magnetic sign reversal governed by a single equilibrium covariance. The theory further identifies experimentally testable signatures, including characteristic magnetic-field dependence and state-dependent transport modulation, providing a quantitative framework for interpreting weak-field magnetic effects in biological ionic transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 弱磁场长期以来被报道可增强或抑制跨膜离子电流，但其物理起源一直不清楚。本文建立了一个介观平衡框架，指出弱磁场主要通过改变亚稳态输运状态的平衡占据概率来影响最终的非平衡离子电流。该机制将增强与抑制统一到同一理论中，并给出由单一平衡协方差控制的磁响应符号反转准则。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长期以来，已有报道表明弱磁场既可能增强也可能抑制跨膜离子电流，但这些表面上相互矛盾响应的物理起源仍未解决。在这里，我们发展了一个介观平衡框架，表明弱磁场主要改变亚稳输运态的平衡占据概率，从而改变由此产生的非平衡离子电流。磁场并不是直接作用于微观离子轨迹，而是通过导电态的统计重新分布来调控输运。这一机制在统一的理论框架内自然解释了磁增强和磁抑制，并预言了一个由单一平衡协方差支配的磁符号反转普适判据。该理论还识别出可由实验检验的特征，包括特征性的磁场依赖性和态依赖输运调制，从而为解释生物离子输运中的弱场磁效应提供了定量框架。

articles.title: Current- and field-driven domain wall dynamics and chirality switching in a planar helimagnet
articles.title_zh: 平面螺旋磁体中电流与磁场驱动的畴壁动力学及手性翻转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23252v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the effect of electric current and magnetic field on the dynamics of chirality in a helimagnet with a strong easy-plane anisotropy. Using a continuum theory, derived for a quasi-one-dimensional frustrated ferromagnet close to the Lifshitz point, we show that a domain wall connecting domains with opposite chiralities can be driven by the current via the dissipative (non-adiabatic) component of the spin-transfer torque. Further, it is demonstrated that the adiabatic part of the torque in the presence of a magnetic field breaks the symmetry of the effective magnetic potential energy with respect to the chirality. We show that the leading symmetry-breaking term arises in the third order in the magnetization gradient, and derive the conditions of the chirality switching. Our conclusions are supported by numerical spin-lattice simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了强易平面各向异性螺旋磁体在电流和磁场作用下的手性动力学。基于近 Lifshitz 点的准一维挫折铁磁体连续理论，作者表明连接相反手性畴的畴壁可由自旋转移力矩的耗散项驱动运动。结果还显示，在磁场存在时，力矩的绝热项会打破有效磁势对手性的对称性，从而产生手性翻转条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了电流和磁场对具有强易平面各向异性的螺旋磁体中手性动力学的影响。利用为接近 Lifshitz 点的准一维受挫铁磁体推导出的连续介质理论，我们表明，连接相反手性畴的畴壁可以通过自旋转移力矩的耗散（非绝热）分量由电流驱动。此外，研究表明，在存在磁场时，力矩的绝热部分会打破有效磁势能关于手性的对称性。我们表明，主导的对称性破缺项出现在磁化梯度的三阶中，并推导了手性切换的条件。我们的结论得到了数值自旋晶格模拟的支持。

articles.title: Shear-mode Direct Piezoelectric Response of Ferroelectric Nematic Liquid Crystals
articles.title_zh: 铁电向列液晶的剪切模直接压电响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23297v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Piezoelectricity (linear coupling between mechanical deformation and electric signal) was originally observed only in solid crystals. Recently, it was discovered that liquid ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals are also piezoelectric. However, so far only their converse piezoelectric signals (applied voltage-induced mechanical deformation) were measured quantitatively. In this work, we have carried out periodic shear-induced electric current and oscillatory rheology measurements on the two archetypic ferroelectric nematic compounds, RM734 and DIO. From temperature, frequency and strain dependent results of the first and second harmonic current signals together with the results from oscillatory rheometry, we were able to quantitatively determine the shear-mode direct piezoelectric coupling constants. These values are similar for both materials and are compared to results of previous converse piezoelectric measurements. We propose a physical mechanism in which the flow alignment of ferroelectric polarization leads to the direct piezoelectric response.
articles.abstract_zh: 压电性最初只在固体晶体中被观察到，而近年来铁电向列液晶也被发现具有压电效应。本文通过周期性剪切诱导电流和振荡流变实验，系统测量了两种代表性铁电向列化合物 RM734 与 DIO 的剪切模直接压电响应。结合温度、频率和应变依赖的结果，作者定量提取了直接压电耦合常数，并提出流动取向铁电极化是其响应机理。
authors: Péter Salamon, Marcell Tibor Máthé, Hiroya Nishikawa, Fumito Araoka, Antal Jákli
articles.abstract_zh_full: 压电性，即机械形变与电信号之间的线性耦合，最初只在固体晶体中被观察到。最近，人们发现液态铁电向列液晶也具有压电性。然而，到目前为止，只有它们的逆压电信号，即施加电压诱导的机械形变，得到了定量测量。在这项工作中，我们对两种典型铁电向列化合物 RM734 和 DIO 进行了周期剪切诱导电流和振荡流变测量。根据一阶和二阶谐波电流信号随温度、频率和应变变化的结果，并结合振荡流变测量结果，我们能够定量确定剪切模式正压电耦合常数。这些数值对于两种材料是相近的，并与此前逆压电测量的结果进行了比较。我们提出一种物理机制，其中铁电极化的流动取向导致正压电响应。

articles.title: Tailoring the Frequency-Dependent Optical Response of Hematite through Mono- and Co-Doping: A First-Principles Study
articles.title_zh: 通过单掺杂与共掺杂调控赤铁矿频率依赖光学响应：第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23409v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the effects of doping on the crystal structure and optical properties of semiconductor materials is crucial for advancing next-generation semiconductor and photonic technologies. Although various studies have focused on doped hematite (α-Fe₂O₃₎, the relationship between dynamical stability and optical properties remains insufficiently explored. This study presents a comprehensive first-principles investigation that simultaneously evaluates the phonon dispersion characteristics and frequency-dependent optical response of B-doped, Y-doped, and (B, Y)-co-doped α-Fe₂O₃, providing deeper insights into the underlying mechanisms. We examined the finite-temperature vibrational properties, dielectric function, and optical characteristics to comprehend the lattice dynamics and light-matter interactions under electromagnetic radiation. Vibrational thermodynamics reveal that pristine and Y-doped hematite maintain dynamic stability, while B-doped hematite exhibits imaginary phonon modes indicating lattice instability due to distortions in the Fe--O framework. Notably, Y co-doping with B helps suppress these soft modes, restoring structural stability through lattice relaxation and improved interatomic forces. B doping enhances low-energy absorption by introducing additional states in the valence band, while Y doping alters orbital hybridization, leading to a broader dispersion. In the optical regime, doped hematite displays dominant interband transitions below 2 eV and strong absorption between 1.80 eV and 4 eV. The (B, Y) co-doping combines the low-energy benefits with an improved optical response profile. In summary, doping significantly enhances lattice vibrations, light-matter interactions, and optical responses, providing an effective strategy for tailoring hematite for diverse applications in photoactive, optoelectronic, and photonic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于第一性原理，系统研究了 B 掺杂、Y 掺杂及 B/Y 共掺杂对 α-Fe2O3 的声子色散与频率依赖光学性质的影响。结果表明，本征和 Y 掺杂赤铁矿保持动力学稳定，而 B 掺杂会引入虚频模并导致晶格失稳。进一步发现，Y 与 B 共掺杂可抑制这些软模，恢复结构稳定性，并调节介电函数与光学响应。
authors: Abdul Ahad Mamun, Muhammad Anisuzzaman Talukder
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解掺杂对半导体材料晶体结构和光学性质的影响，对于推进下一代半导体和光子技术至关重要。尽管已有多项研究关注掺杂赤铁矿（α-Fe₂O₃），但动力学稳定性与光学性质之间的关系仍未得到充分探索。本研究提出了一项全面的第一性原理研究，同时评估 B 掺杂、Y 掺杂和（B, Y）共掺杂 α-Fe₂O₃ 的声子色散特征和频率依赖光学响应，从而提供对潜在机制的更深入见解。我们考察了有限温振动性质、介电函数和光学特征，以理解电磁辐射下的晶格动力学和光—物质相互作用。振动热力学表明，本征和 Y 掺杂赤铁矿保持动力学稳定，而 B 掺杂赤铁矿表现出虚声子模，表明由于 Fe--O 框架畸变而发生晶格不稳定。值得注意的是，Y 与 B 共掺杂有助于抑制这些软模，通过晶格弛豫和改善的原子间作用力恢复结构稳定性。B 掺杂通过在价带中引入额外态增强低能吸收，而 Y 掺杂改变轨道杂化，导致更宽的色散。在光学区域，掺杂赤铁矿在 2 eV 以下表现出占主导的带间跃迁，并在 1.80 eV 至 4 eV 之间表现出强吸收。（B, Y）共掺杂将低能优势与改进的光学响应轮廓结合起来。总之，掺杂显著增强了晶格振动、光—物质相互作用和光学响应，为针对光活性、光电子和光子技术中的多样化应用调控赤铁矿提供了一种有效策略。

articles.title: Fe-doping-induced band structure modification and cryogenic phase stability in Cs2AgBiBr6 single crystals
articles.title_zh: Fe 掺杂诱导的 Cs2AgBiBr6 单晶能带结构调控与低温相稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23456v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite its promise as a lead-free alternative, the practical application of Cs2AgBiBr6 in optoelectronics is limited by its wide band gap and detrimental intrinsic defects. To overcome these challenges, we synthesized Cs2AgBi0.5Fe0.5Br6 single crystals via a modified hydrothermal method. While both pristine and Fe-doped crystals undergo a structural phase transition near 125 K, Fe incorporation fundamentally alters its impact. The dopant simultaneously narrows the band gap in the high-temperature phase and suppresses the associated cryogenic structural instability. Our optical and X-ray structural studies establish Fe doping as a powerful strategy for tailoring the properties of Cs2AgBiBr6 , advancing its potential for high-performance, low-temperature optoelectronic and spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管 Cs2AgBiBr6 作为无铅替代材料具有潜力，但其较宽带隙和本征缺陷限制了器件应用。作者通过改进水热法合成了 Cs2AgBi0.5Fe0.5Br6 单晶，并发现 Fe 掺杂在高温相中能够缩小带隙，同时抑制低温结构不稳定性。光学与 X 射线结构分析表明，Fe 掺杂为调控该材料的光电与低温相行为提供了有效策略。
authors: Yanan Li, Xuejiao Wu, Jidong Deng, Jinbao Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管 Cs2AgBiBr6 作为无铅替代材料具有应用前景，但其在光电子学中的实际应用受到宽带隙和有害本征缺陷的限制。为克服这些挑战，我们通过改进的水热方法合成了 Cs2AgBi0.5Fe0.5Br6 单晶。虽然本征晶体和 Fe 掺杂晶体都在约 125 K 附近发生结构相变，但 Fe 的引入从根本上改变了该相变的影响。该掺杂剂同时缩小了高温相中的带隙，并抑制了相关的低温结构不稳定性。我们的光学和 X 射线结构研究确立了 Fe 掺杂作为调控 Cs2AgBiBr6 性能的有力策略，推进了其在高性能低温光电子和自旋电子器件中的潜在应用。

articles.title: Molecular dynamics with a first-principles-validated universal machine-learning potential reveals dynamic elementary processes of growth-related adspecies on GaN(0001)
articles.title_zh: 基于经第一性原理验证的通用机器学习势函数的分子动力学揭示 GaN(0001) 上生长相关吸附物种的动态基本过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic-scale understanding of the surface elementary processes in metalorganic vapor phase epitaxy (MOVPE) of GaN has so far relied on static density-functional-theory (DFT) energetics and on first-principles molecular dynamics (FPMD) limited to a few tens of picoseconds. Here we combine FPMD with a universal machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP), UMA, to follow the dynamics of growth-related adspecies on GaN(0001) over time scales inaccessible to purely first-principles approaches. FPMD simulations of a GaNH admolecule coexisting with H adatoms reveal a hitherto unrecognized diffusion mode, in which the N atom lifts the Ga atom of the GaNH unit off the surface layer during migration, and show that the lifted Ga abstracts an H adatom from the surface, events invisible to static DFT. Single-point UMA calculations on FPMD snapshots reproduce the first-principles relative energies along the trajectory (RMSE of about 8.5 meV/atom) without any retraining. Long-time MLIP-based MD (150 ps) then reveals dynamics never observed within the FPMD window: site-to-site H-adatom hopping, which gates the migration paths of the growth unit, and reversible dissociation of the GaNH unit into independently migrating Ga and NH adspecies. This work constitutes, to our knowledge, the first application of an MLIP to the molecular dynamics of GaN MOVPE.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将第一性原理分子动力学与通用机器学习原子间势函数结合，用于研究 GaN(0001) 表面 MOVPE 生长相关吸附物种的长时间动力学。结果揭示了一种此前未被认识的扩散模式：在迁移过程中，GaNH 分子中的 N 原子会抬起 Ga 原子，且被抬起的 Ga 还能从表面抽取 H 吸附原子。进一步的长时标模拟还表明，H 吸附原子在位点间的跳跃会调制生长单元的迁移路径。
authors: Yoshito Takaesu, Akira Kusaba, Junko Ishii, Shigenori Matsushima, Yoshihiro Kangawa
articles.abstract_zh_full: 迄今为止，对 GaN 金属有机气相外延（MOVPE）中表面基元过程的原子尺度理解，主要依赖于静态密度泛函理论（DFT）能量学以及仅限于几十皮秒的第一性原理分子动力学（FPMD）。在这里，我们将 FPMD 与一种通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）UMA 相结合，以追踪 GaN(0001) 上生长相关吸附物种在纯第一性原理方法难以达到的时间尺度上的动力学。含有 H 吸附原子共存的 GaNH 吸附分子的 FPMD 模拟揭示了一种此前未被认识的扩散模式：在迁移过程中，N 原子将 GaNH 单元中的 Ga 原子从表面层抬起，并表明被抬起的 Ga 会从表面抽取一个 H 吸附原子；这些事件是静态 DFT 无法观察到的。对 FPMD 快照进行的单点 UMA 计算在无需任何再训练的情况下复现了轨迹沿线的第一性原理相对能量（均方根误差约为 8.5 meV/atom）。随后，基于 MLIP 的长时间分子动力学（150 ps）揭示了在 FPMD 时间窗口内从未观察到的动力学过程：H 吸附原子的位点间跳迁调控生长单元的迁移路径，以及 GaNH 单元可逆解离为可独立迁移的 Ga 和 NH 吸附物种。据我们所知，本工作构成了机器学习原子间势在 GaN MOVPE 分子动力学中的首次应用。

articles.title: Interplay of Spin Waves, Crystal-Field Excitations, and Phonons in Multiferroic Ba3HoRu2O9 revealed by Inelastic Neutron Scattering, Crystal-Field Analysis, and Machine-Learned Phonon Calculations
articles.title_zh: 在多铁性 Ba3HoRu2O9 中自旋波、晶场激发与声子的相互作用：非弹性中子散射、晶场分析与机器学习声子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23490v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the microscopic origin of spin-dipole coupling and high-energy excitations in correlated 4d-4f multiferroic oxides is challenging because magnetic, crystal-field, and lattice excitations frequently overlap in energy. The hexagonal 6H perovskite Ba3HoRu2O9 provides an ideal platform to investigate this interplay owing to the coexistence of Ru2O9 molecular units and localized Ho3+ moments. To identify the contributions from these different excitations, we combine inelastic neutron scattering (INS) with linear spin-wave calculations, crystal-field analysis, Raman spectroscopy, and machine-learned force field (MLFF) phonon calculations. A dispersive magnetic excitation below 6.2 meV is accurately reproduced by linear spin-wave theory, establishing its origin as a collective spin-wave excitation of the coupled Ru-Ho magnetic network. At higher energies, broad excitations centered near 20, 39, 70, and 90 meV is observed that are present far above magnetic ordering temperature. Crystal-field calculations based on the Stevens formalism place the strongest Ho3+ transitions within the experimentally observed energy window, while Raman spectroscopy and MLFF phonon calculations identify optical phonons with comparable energies. Together, these complementary results show that the broad INS feature near 39 meV is consistent with overlapping contributions from Ho3+ crystal-field excitations, lattice vibrations, and previously reported Ru2O9 molecular magnetic excitations. These findings establish a microscopic framework for understanding the interplay between spin, crystal-field, and lattice degrees of freedom in this multiferroic 4d-4f compound.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对 4d-4f 多铁氧化物 Ba3HoRu2O9 中磁激发、晶场激发与晶格振动能量重叠的问题，结合非弹性中子散射、自旋波理论、晶场分析、拉曼光谱和机器学习力场声子计算进行研究。结果表明，6.2 meV 以下的色散激发可由耦合的 Ru-Ho 磁网络集体自旋波很好描述。较高能区观察到多个宽峰激发，其来源与 Ho3+ 晶场跃迁以及晶格振动共同相关。
authors: Ekta Kushwaha, Sayan Ghosh, Gourab Roy, Mohit Kumar, Manh Duc Le, Jhuma Shannigrahi, Som Datta Kaushik, Devashibhai T. Adroja, Tathamay Basu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解相关 4d-4f 多铁性氧化物中自旋-偶极耦合和高能激发的微观起源具有挑战性，因为磁激发、晶体场激发和晶格激发在能量上经常重叠。六方 6H 钙钛矿 Ba3HoRu2O9 由于同时存在 Ru2O9 分子单元和局域化的 Ho3+ 磁矩，为研究这种相互作用提供了理想平台。为了识别这些不同激发的贡献，我们将非弹性中子散射（INS）与线性自旋波计算、晶体场分析、拉曼光谱以及机器学习力场（MLFF）声子计算结合起来。6.2 meV 以下的色散磁激发能够被线性自旋波理论准确再现，这表明其起源是耦合 Ru-Ho 磁网络中的集体自旋波激发。在更高能量处，观察到以约 20、39、70 和 90 meV 为中心的宽峰激发，而这些激发在远高于磁有序温度时仍然存在。基于 Stevens 形式主义的晶体场计算将最强的 Ho3+ 跃迁置于实验观察到的能量窗口内，而拉曼光谱和 MLFF 声子计算则识别出具有相近能量的光学声子。综合这些互补结果表明，INS 中约 39 meV 处的宽特征与 Ho3+ 晶体场激发、晶格振动以及先前报道的 Ru2O9 分子磁激发的重叠贡献一致。这些发现为理解这一多铁性 4d-4f 化合物中自旋、晶体场和晶格自由度之间的相互作用建立了一个微观框架。

articles.title: Dynamical control of particle jets from a driven condensate in a one-dimensional lattice with double-well potential
articles.title_zh: 一维双势阱晶格中受驱凝聚体粒子喷流的动力学控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the nonlinear dynamics of a Bose-Einstein condensate trapped in a double-well potential of a one-dimensional lattice, where the interatomic interactions are periodically modulated in time. In the typical case of a symmetric double-well, we observe collective particle emission under resonant driving, where the excitation regimes are explicitly constrained by the interplay between the drive strength and the hopping amplitude. By introducing a depth asymmetry between the wells, we find that moderate bias specifically enhances the emission rate, while large asymmetry suppresses it. The particle jets can be further controlled by modulating the hopping amplitudes, where the emission is weakened for finite hopping imbalances. These results outline the roles of asymmetry and external driving in precisely manipulating quantum many-body transport, and may offer insights into the design of atomtronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一维晶格双势阱中玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在交互作用周期调制下的非线性动力学。对于对称双势阱，作者发现共振驱动可诱导集体粒子发射，其发生区域受驱动强度与隧穿振幅共同限制。引入势阱深度不对称后，中等偏置会增强发射，而较大不对称则抑制喷流；调制隧穿振幅也可进一步调控粒子喷流。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一维晶格中受困于双阱势的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的非线性动力学，其中原子间相互作用随时间周期性调制。对于典型的对称双阱情形，在共振驱动下我们观察到集体粒子发射，而且激发区间显式地受驱动强度与跃迁振幅之间相互作用的限制。通过在两个阱之间引入深度不对称，我们发现适度偏置会专门增强发射速率，而较大的不对称则会抑制发射。还可以通过调制跃迁振幅进一步控制粒子喷流；当跃迁不平衡有限时，发射会减弱。这些结果概括了不对称性和外部驱动在精确操控量子多体输运中的作用，并可能为原子电子学器件的设计提供启示。

articles.title: Observation of an emergent energy scale close to dimensional reduction in a quasi-two-dimensional quantum magnet
articles.title_zh: 准二维量子磁体中接近降维处的新兴能量尺度的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: By appropriately perturbing a critical transverse-field Ising chain away from its critical point, the system can develop a finite correlation length with a characteristic purely massive spectrum, whose ratios and correlations are precisely described by an integrable field theory and an infinite set of integrals of motion corresponding to the E₈ Lie algebra. In this work, we report on experimental observation of a characteristic massive spectrum close to transverse field-induced dimensional reduction in a quasi-two-dimensional quantum magnet Cu₂₍OH)₃Br, providing evidence for an emergent E₈ symmetry and the corresponding excitations of bound states in the sublattice of its ferromagnetic chains. These results demonstrate the power of integrable field theory in describing emergent many-body quantum critical phenomena in condensed matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在准二维量子磁体 Cu2(OH)3Br 中观测到一种接近横场诱导降维时出现的特征性质量谱。该谱与临界横场 Ising 链偏离临界点后形成的可积场论描述相符，并体现出与 E8 李代数对应的激发结构。结果为凝聚态体系中的涌现对称性与束缚态激发提供了实验支持。
authors: Anneke Reinold, Laur Peedu, Kirill Amelin, Urmas Nagel, Toomas Rõõm, Sven Luther, Hannes Kühne, Dirk Wulferding, Kingshuk Mukhuti, Maarten W. de Dreu, Peter C. M. Christianen, Dennis Kudlacik, Dmitri Yakovlev, Zhiying Zhao, Taro Nakajima, Yoshimitsu Kohama, Thomas Lorenz, Franco Lisandrini, Corinna Kollath, Marcin Raczkowski, Fakher F. Assaad, Zhe Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过适当地将临界横场伊辛链扰离临界点，系统可以形成有限相关长度，并产生具有特征性的纯质量谱；其能级比与相关性可由一个可积场论及与 E8 李代数对应的一组无限多个守恒积分精确描述。在本工作中，我们报告了在准二维量子磁体 Cu2(OH)3Br 中，接近横场诱导维数约化时的特征性大质量谱的实验观测，为涌现的 E8 对称性以及其在铁磁链子晶格中的束缚态激发提供了证据。这些结果表明，可积场论在描述凝聚态系统中的涌现多体量子临界现象方面具有强大能力。

articles.title: Local micromechanics in a mean-field model of glasses reveal key properties of its non-equilibrium RSB phase
articles.title_zh: 玻璃平均场模型中的局域微力学揭示其非平衡 RSB 相的关键性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recently formulated mean-field model of glasses features an equilibrium, zero-temperature Replica-Symmetry-Breaking (RSB) transition in some parameter range. In this range, the model's solution in the Replica-Symmetric phase is expressed in terms of an effective, self-consistent random potential for uncoupled degree of freedoms, where the transition to the RSB phase is characterized by the emergence of spectral-edge localized modes and a pseudogapped quartic vibrational spectrum, resulting in a finite spin-glass susceptibility. These properties are preserved in numerical solutions of the model under non-equilibrium conditions, i.e., upon an instantaneous quench. Inspired by recent advances in computer glasses, we define a micromechanical response function --- the linear response to local force monopoles --- in the framework of the mean-field model. We establish exact relations between the force monopole stiffness and global susceptibilities, which suggest a close correspondence between the non-equilibrium RSB phase of the model and the above-mentioned effective random potential description. As such, the obtained micromechanical observables constitute a concrete realization of the collective degrees of freedom of the model, offering a bridge between a glassy mean-field model and finite-dimensional glasses. We show that the model's vibrational spectrum can be computed solely from the monopole response statistics and, by employing a marginal stability criterion, we extract a characteristic frequency/stiffness scale of soft glassy modes, which is related to the boson peak in finite-dimensional, laboratory glasses.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个具有零温 Replica-Symmetry-Breaking 转变的玻璃平均场模型，并在非平衡淬火条件下考察其性质。作者定义了局域力单极子的线性响应作为微力学响应函数，并建立了该量与全局易感性之间的精确关系。结果表明，该模型的非平衡 RSB 相与有效随机势图像之间存在紧密对应。
authors: Makoto Suda, Edan Lerner, Eran Bouchbinder
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一种新近提出的玻璃平均场模型在某些参数范围内具有一个平衡的、零温的 replica-symmetry-breaking（RSB）转变。在这一范围内，该模型在 replica-symmetric 相中的解可表示为作用于彼此不耦合自由度的一个有效的、自洽的随机势，而向 RSB 相的转变则以谱边局域化模的出现以及具有赝能隙的四次振动态谱为特征，从而导致有限的自旋玻璃磁化率。在瞬时淬火等非平衡条件下对该模型进行数值求解时，这些性质仍然得以保留。受计算玻璃最新进展的启发，我们在该平均场模型框架内定义了一种微力学响应函数——即对局域力单极子的线性响应。我们建立了力单极子刚度与全局磁化率之间的精确关系，这表明该模型的非平衡 RSB 相与上述有效随机势描述之间存在紧密对应关系。因此，所得到的微力学可观测量构成了该模型集体自由度的一个具体实现，为玻璃平均场模型与有限维玻璃之间搭建了桥梁。我们表明，仅凭单极子响应统计就可以计算该模型的振动态谱，并且通过采用边缘稳定性判据，我们提取出软玻璃模的特征频率/刚度尺度，它与有限维实验玻璃中的玻色峰有关。

articles.title: Observation of correlation-driven topological transport and robust ferromagnetism in 2D CrS₂
articles.title_zh: 二维 CrS2 中相关驱动的拓扑输运与稳健铁磁性的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The realization of correlated layered magnets hosting robust ferromagnetism with emergent topological transport remains a key challenge in quantum materials. Here we report the first catalyst-free chemical vapour deposition growth of layered 1T-CrS₂, establishing a highly stable vdWs ferromagnet with an out-of-plane easy-axis anisotropy and a Curie temperature above room temperature. Transport measurements reveal a semimetal--insulator crossover near 80 K and pronounced negative magnetoresistance up to 350 K. A topological Hall effect emerges below 30 K, a rare signature of correlated transport in layered transition-metal dichalcogenide ferromagnets. First-principles calculations show that spin--orbit coupling gaps Dirac-like crossings, while electronic correlations reconstruct the Fermi surface by suppressing electron pockets and reducing the carrier density, enhancing momentum-dependent out-of-plane spin polarization. Magnetic measurements, supported by Heisenberg exchange calculations, reveal strong nearest-neighbour ferromagnetic exchange that stabilizes long-range ferromagnetism. Our results establish 1T-CrS₂ as a rare correlated 3d layered ferromagnet in which electronic correlations and spin--orbit coupling cooperatively drive emergent topological transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次报道了无催化化学气相沉积生长的层状 1T-CrS2，证明其为一种具有面外易轴各向异性、且居里温度高于室温的稳定范德华铁磁体。输运测量显示其在约 80 K 附近发生半金属-绝缘体交叉，并在 350 K 以内表现出显著负磁阻。更重要的是，在 30 K 以下观察到拓扑霍尔效应，表明该材料中存在由电子关联与自旋轨道耦合共同驱动的非常规拓扑输运。
authors: Sk Md Obaidulla, M. Nur Hasan, Dayal Das, Rafiqul Alam, Antonio Supina, Muhammad Awais Aslam, Sherif Kamal, Iva Šarić Jankovic, Aleksandar Matkovic, Christian Teichert, Atindra Nath Pal, Heike C. Herper, Marko Kralj
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实现兼具稳健铁磁性与涌现拓扑输运的相关层状磁体仍然是量子材料领域的一项关键挑战。在这里，我们报道了层状 1T-CrS2 的首次无催化剂化学气相沉积生长，建立了一种高度稳定的范德华铁磁体，其具有面外易轴各向异性且居里温度高于室温。输运测量揭示了约 80 K 附近的半金属—绝缘体转变，以及在高达 350 K 时仍然显著的负磁阻。在 30 K 以下出现了拓扑霍尔效应，这是层状过渡金属二硫属化物铁磁体中相关输运的一种罕见信号。第一性原理计算表明，自旋—轨道耦合会打开类狄拉克交叉的能隙，而电子关联通过抑制电子口袋并降低载流子密度来重构费米面，从而增强了动量依赖的面外自旋极化。磁性测量结合 Heisenberg 交换计算表明，强的最近邻铁磁交换稳定了长程铁磁有序。我们的结果确立了 1T-CrS2 作为一种罕见的相关 3d 层状铁磁体，其中电子关联与自旋—轨道耦合协同驱动了涌现的拓扑输运。

articles.title: Pair-Density Wave from Doping an Altermagnetic Mott Insulator
articles.title_zh: 掺杂反磁性莫特绝缘体中的电荷密度波超导态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pair-density-wave (PDW) superconductivity is a state in which the superconducting order parameter modulates at a finite wavevector. Using large-scale density matrix renormalization group, we study the doped altermagnetic Mott insulator in the checkerboard t-J model, where altermagnetic exchange anisotropy is encoded microscopically through anisotropic ferromagnetic next-nearest-neighbor exchange. By mapping the ground-state phase diagram as a function of doping and altermagnetic anisotropy, mainly on six-leg cylinders, we identify a transition from a uniform d-wave superconducting regime with charge modulation to a PDW regime coexisting with stripe order. In the PDW regime, we report an unconventional wave-vector locking mathbf QPDWapprox 2mathbf QSₜᵣᵢₚₑ along the cylinder direction, in contrast to the conventional relation. Pair correlations reveal a two-scale structure, consisting of short-distance local d-wave pairing and long-distance finite-momentum PDW correlations. A symmetry-based Ginzburg--Landau analysis is presented for the observed locking. Our results identify altermagnetism as a strong-coupling, microscopically grounded route to finite-momentum superconductivity in doped Mott insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用大规模密度矩阵重整化群研究了棋盘格 t-J 模型中掺杂后的反磁性莫特绝缘体，其中反磁性交换各向异性通过各向异性次近邻铁磁交换加以编码。通过考察掺杂浓度与反磁性各向异性的相图，作者发现体系可从具有电荷调制的均匀 d 波超导区转变为与条纹序共存的配对密度波区。配对相关函数显示出局域 d 波配对与长程有限动量 PDW 相关的双尺度结构，并给出了相应的对称性 Ginzburg-Landau 分析。
authors: Shuai A. Chen, Qianqian Chen, Guangyu Yu, Zheng Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对密度波（PDW）超导是一种超导序参量在有限波矢上发生调制的状态。我们使用大规模密度矩阵重整化群研究了棋盘格 t-J 模型中的掺杂 altermagnetic Mott 绝缘体，其中 altermagnetic 交换各向异性通过各向异性的铁磁次近邻交换在微观上编码。通过在掺杂和 altermagnetic 各向异性参数下绘制基态相图，主要在六腿圆柱上，我们识别出一个从带有电荷调制的均匀 d 波超导区到与条纹序共存的 PDW 区的转变。在 PDW 区域中，我们报告了一种非常规的波矢锁定关系，即沿圆柱方向有 Q_PDW 约等于 2Qₛₜᵣᵢₚₑ，这与常规关系不同。配对关联显示出双尺度结构，包括短距离的局域 d 波配对和长距离的有限动量 PDW 关联。我们还基于对称性给出了描述这一锁定现象的 Ginzburg--Landau 分析。我们的结果表明，altermagnetism 为掺杂 Mott 绝缘体中的有限动量超导提供了一条强耦合、具有微观基础的途径。

articles.title: Engineering two-body interaction for the Moore-Read State
articles.title_zh: 为 Moore-Read 态设计二体相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Engineering interactions that stabilize non-Abelian fractional quantum Hall phases is a central challenge in strongly correlated topological matter and quantum simulation. We introduce a differentiable framework for inverse Hamiltonian design, in which Haldane pseudopotentials are optimized by gradient-based exact diagonalization to stabilize target fractional quantum Hall phases. In spherical geometry, the Haldane pseudopotentials are treated as variational parameters and optimized in a JAX-based exact-diagonalization framework. By directly maximizing the overlap between the many-body ground state and the Moore-Read state, we obtain a robust pseudopotential profile that has Pfaffian overlaps exceeding 99% for systems up to Nₑ₌₁₂, substantially improving over conventional Coulomb interactions. Analyses of the neutral excitation spectrum and orbital entanglement spectrum further confirm that the optimized interaction stabilizes the Pfaffian topological phase. Our results demonstrate that essential features of the three-body Pfaffian parent Hamiltonian can be effectively encoded in a suitably designed two-body interaction. Furthermore, they identify a nearly universal exponentially decaying pseudopotential profile that stabilizes the Pfaffian phase and establishes a general framework toward engineering non-Abelian topological order in quantum simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于反向哈密顿量设计的可微分框架，通过基于梯度的精确对角化优化 Haldane 赝势，以稳定目标分数量子霍尔相。作者在球面几何中将赝势作为变分参数，并在 JAX 精确对角化框架下直接最大化多体基态与 Moore-Read 态的重叠。优化得到的相互作用在电子数最多为 12 的体系中可实现超过 99% 的 Pfaffian 重叠，且中性激发谱与轨道纠缠谱进一步表明其稳定了 Pfaffian 拓扑相。
authors: Yi Yang, Xin Wan, Zi-Xiang Hu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 设计能够稳定非阿贝尔分数量子霍尔相的相互作用，是强关联拓扑物态与量子模拟中的核心挑战。我们提出了一种用于反向哈密顿量设计的可微分框架，其中通过基于梯度的精确对角化来优化 Haldane 赝势，以稳定目标分数量子霍尔相。在球面几何中，我们将 Haldane 赝势视为变分参数，并在基于 JAX 的精确对角化框架中进行优化。通过直接最大化多体基态与 Moore-Read 态之间的重叠，我们得到了一个鲁棒的赝势谱，使得在 Nₑ₌₁₂ 以内的系统中 Pfaffian 重叠超过 99%，相比传统库仑相互作用有显著改进。对中性激发谱和轨道纠缠谱的分析进一步证实，该优化相互作用稳定了 Pfaffian 拓扑相。我们的结果表明，三体 Pfaffian 父哈密顿量的关键特征可以通过适当设计的两体相互作用有效编码。此外，这些结果还识别出一种近乎普适的指数衰减赝势谱，它能够稳定 Pfaffian 相，并为在量子模拟中工程化非阿贝尔拓扑序建立了一般性框架。
