A systematic investigation of the resulting sensitivity spectra reveals that the large-scale topology of the sensitivity fields is governed primarily by the spinning ratio, whereas the influence of the Reynolds number remains comparatively weak over large parts of the investigated operating envelope. The resulting sensitivity atlas provides practical design guidance for passive flow-control concepts and demonstrates that robust solutions may exist over moderate operating ranges.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对旋转圆柱在雷诺数10至10⁷、旋转比0至2π的宽运行范围内，提出基于拓扑的伴随灵敏度分析方法，用于评估邻近被动流动控制装置对阻力、升力和扭矩的影响。作者采用多孔介质模型推导局部灵敏度场，并通过含达西型源项的正向模拟及灵敏度指导的控制结构进行验证。研究特别关注阻力与升力灵敏度符号的组合分布，形成可直观指导局部动量抽取设计的区域图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 旋转圆柱被用于多种工程应用，其中一个突出例子是用于风助船舶推进的Flettner转子。除了优化圆柱本身的气动性能外，布置在其附近的被动流动控制装置还为操控所产生的气动力提供了额外潜力。本文在覆盖Reynolds数从1E+01到1E+07以及旋转比从0到2π的宽工况范围内，针对旋转圆柱引入了一种基于拓扑的伴随灵敏度分析。使用多孔介质表述推导了与阻力、升力和扭矩相关的局部灵敏度场，并通过专门的前向仿真加以验证，这些仿真同时采用分布式Darcy型源项和受灵敏度启发的被动流动控制结构。本文特别强调阻力和升力灵敏度的组合符号分布，从而得到直观的设计图，这些图能够直接识别局部动量抽取同时改善或恶化两个目标的区域。对所得灵敏度谱的系统研究表明，灵敏度场的大尺度拓扑主要由旋转比支配，而在所研究工况范围的大部分区域内，Reynolds数的影响相对较弱。所得灵敏度图谱为被动流动控制概念提供了实用的设计指导，并表明在中等工况范围内可能存在鲁棒解。

articles.title: Symmetry of Spin Systems as Automorphisms of Undirected Weighted Graphs: Realizability Criterion and Complete Taxonomy up to 14 Spins
articles.title_zh: 自旋系统对称性作为无向加权图自同构：可实现性判据与14个自旋以内的完整分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exact simulation of high-resolution NMR spectra requires block diagonalization of the spin Hamiltonian, whose dimension grows exponentially with the number of spins N; symmetry is the principal tool for taming this growth, yet which permutation groups can occur as the full symmetry group of a scalar-coupled spin system has lacked an exhaustive treatment. Formulating the spin system as an undirected edge-weighted complete graph, we prove an exact realizability criterion: a subgroup of S_N is realizable if and only if it coincides with its symmetrized (undirected) Wielandt 2-closure. In particular, purely rotational symmetry of a single spin ring is impossible, yet chiral spin systems do exist as multi-orbit twisted stacks, and we determine the minimal spin count μ*(Cₙ₎ for every cyclic group, including the counter-intuitive realizations C₈ and C₉ at N = 12. A sequential symmetrization algorithm, completed by an orbit-partition decomposition, yields a provably exhaustive enumeration of all realizable symmetry types up to N = 14: the apparently new sequence a(N) = 1, 1, 3, 8, 11, 27, 36, 90, 131, 282, 394, 948, 1316, 2866 with the tower law a(N) = a(N-1) + f(N) - a catalogue of 6112 entries in all, organized by canonical identifiers and a structural grammar extending the Pople nomenclature. Finally, we present a hierarchical methodology for exact block diagonalization without physical approximations: factorization by the conserved total spin projection, Schur-Weyl contraction of magnetically equivalent composites, orbit-weight deduplication of the spin configurations, and isotypic projection over the representations of the factor group, with a uniform treatment of non-abelian groups and complex characters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将标量耦合自旋系统表述为无向边加权完全图，研究哪些置换群可作为高分辨率核磁共振自旋哈密顿量的完整对称群。作者证明了一个精确可实现性判据：子群可实现当且仅当其等于自身的对称化无向Wielandt 2-闭包。基于顺序对称化算法和轨道划分分解，论文给出了最多14个自旋的所有可实现对称类型的穷尽分类，并讨论了环状、手性和多轨道结构中的若干反直觉实现。
authors: Dmitry A. Cheshkov, Dmitry O. Sinitsyn, Artemiy I. Nichugovskiy
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高分辨率NMR谱的精确模拟需要对自旋Hamilton量进行分块对角化，而该Hamilton量的维数随自旋数N呈指数增长；对称性是控制这种增长的主要工具，但哪些置换群能够作为标量耦合自旋系统的完整对称群出现，一直缺乏穷尽性处理。通过将自旋系统表述为无向边加权完全图，我们证明了一个精确的可实现性判据：S_N的一个子群可实现，当且仅当它与其对称化（无向）Wielandt二闭包一致。特别地，单个自旋环的纯旋转对称性是不可能的，但手性自旋系统确实能够作为多轨道扭转堆叠存在，并且我们确定了每个循环群的最小自旋数μ*(Cₙ)，包括在N=12时反直觉实现的C₈和C₉。一种由轨道划分分解补充的顺序对称化算法，给出了对N≤14所有可实现对称类型的可证明穷尽枚举：一个显然新的序列a(N)=1, 1, 3, 8, 11, 27, 36, 90, 131, 282, 394, 948, 1316, 2866，并具有塔式定律a(N)=a(N-1)+f(N)；总计包含6112个条目的目录，按规范标识符和一种扩展Pople命名法的结构语法组织。最后，我们提出一种无需物理近似的精确分块对角化层次方法：按守恒的总自旋投影分解，对磁等价复合体进行Schur-Weyl收缩，对自旋构型进行轨道权重去重，以及在因子群表示上进行等型投影，并对非Abel群和复特征标进行统一处理。

articles.title: Gravitational Sedimentation and Rebound of Strongly Coupled Dusty Plasma Crystals: A Molecular Dynamics Study
articles.title_zh: 强耦合尘埃等离子体晶体的重力沉降与反弹：分子动力学研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24044v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The gravitational sedimentation of strongly coupled dusty plasma crystals is investigated using molecular dynamics simulations. Initially, the dust particles are levitated by the balance between the upward external electric field and gravity. Sedimentation is initiated by removing the electric field, allowing the particles to settle collectively under gravity while interacting through the Yukawa (screened Coulomb) potential. Single-layer, AB-stacked bilayer, and ABA-stacked trilayer crystals are investigated to examine the influence of crystal geometry on the sedimentation dynamics. All crystal configurations undergo collective gravitational settling while preserving their in-plane hexagonal ordering during the initial stages of sedimentation. Upon collision with a reflecting boundary, the multilayer crystals undergo transient interlayer compression followed by sequential momentum transfer between neighboring layers, producing coherent collective rebound. In particular, the trilayer exhibits sequential layer-by-layer momentum propagation from the lower to the middle and finally to the upper layer. During successive sedimentation--rebound cycles, repeated interlayer interactions progressively degrade the initial ABA stacking while preserving the collective mechanical response of the crystal. These results demonstrate that strong Yukawa coupling enables multilayer dusty plasma crystals to sustain repeated impacts while maintaining coherent collective motion despite gradual structural evolution. The present study provides a particle-resolved description of gravitational sedimentation in multilayer dusty plasma crystals and offers a theoretical framework for interpreting laboratory experiments following the removal of electrostatic confinement.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用分子动力学模拟考察强耦合尘埃等离子体晶体在去除外加悬浮电场后的重力沉降过程，粒子之间通过Yukawa屏蔽库仑势相互作用。作者比较了单层、AB堆垛双层和ABA堆垛三层晶体，发现这些结构在沉降初期保持面内六角有序。与反射边界碰撞后，多层晶体出现瞬态层间压缩和逐层动量传递，从而产生相干的集体反弹，三层结构中动量由下层依次传至中层和上层。
authors: Gurudatt Gaur, Meet Contractor, Vikram Dharodi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文使用分子动力学模拟研究强耦合尘埃等离子体晶体的重力沉降。初始时，尘埃粒子由向上的外部电场与重力之间的平衡所悬浮。通过移除电场启动沉降，使粒子在重力作用下集体下落，同时通过Yukawa（屏蔽库仑）势相互作用。研究了单层、AB堆垛双层和ABA堆垛三层晶体，以考察晶体几何结构对沉降动力学的影响。所有晶体构型在沉降初期都经历集体重力下落，同时保持其面内六角有序。与反射边界碰撞后，多层晶体经历瞬态层间压缩，随后在相邻层之间发生顺序动量传递，产生相干的集体反弹。特别是，三层晶体表现出从下层到中层、最终到上层的逐层顺序动量传播。在连续的沉降—反弹循环中，反复的层间相互作用逐渐破坏初始ABA堆垛，同时保留晶体的集体机械响应。这些结果表明，强Yukawa耦合使多层尘埃等离子体晶体能够承受重复冲击，尽管结构逐渐演化，仍能保持相干集体运动。本研究提供了多层尘埃等离子体晶体中重力沉降的粒子分辨描述，并为解释移除静电约束后的实验室实验提供了理论框架。

articles.title: Modeling ultrarelativistic streaming plasma instabilities under the quasistatic approximation
articles.title_zh: 准静态近似下超相对论流动等离子体不稳定性的建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasma streaming instabilities excited by relativistic charged particle beams play a pivotal role in astrophysical and laboratory environments. Their numerical study, however, is challenged by the disparity in spatiotemporal scales between the background plasma and beam particles, which can differ by several orders of magnitude for tenuous, ultrarelativistic beams. Here, we exploit the quasistatic approximation (QSA) to develop a new theoretical framework capable of capturing the full unstable spectrum in the spatiotemporal regime relevant for beams that continuously encounter unperturbed plasma at their leading edge. Within this linear, fully electromagnetic model, we uncover a previously unreported spatiotemporal evolution of the current filamentation instability and elucidate its interplay with the oblique two-stream instability, predicting the dominance of filamentation in the vicinity of the beam front. The good agreement between theory, kinetic particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations, and QSA-based PIC simulations validates the robustness of the approach. By pushing QSA-based PIC simulations to extremely dilute electron-positron beams, such as those found in blazar jets, we demonstrate their unique ability to capture the rich nonlinear dynamics of streaming instabilities in parameter regimes previously inaccessible to kinetic simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对稀薄超相对论束流与背景等离子体之间巨大的时空尺度差异，利用准静态近似建立能够描述束流前沿持续进入未扰动等离子体时完整不稳定谱的线性全电磁理论框架。研究揭示了电流丝化不稳定性此前未报道的时空演化特征，并阐明其与斜向双流不稳定性的相互作用，预测束流前沿附近丝化过程占优。理论结果与动力学粒子模拟及基于准静态近似的PIC模拟吻合，验证了该方法用于研究极稀薄电子—正电子束流等情形的有效性。
authors: P. San Miguel Claveria, Q. Labro, X. Davoine, A. Matheron, M. Tamburini, S. Corde, L. Gremillet, F. Fiuza
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由相对论带电粒子束激发的等离子体流动不稳定性在天体物理和实验室环境中发挥关键作用。然而，对它们的数值研究受到背景等离子体与束流粒子之间时空尺度差异的挑战；对于稀薄的超相对论束流，这种差异可能达到数个数量级。在这里，我们利用准静态近似来发展一种新的理论框架，能够捕捉与束流在其前沿连续遇到未扰动等离子体相关的时空区域中的完整不稳定谱。在这一线性、全电磁模型中，我们揭示了电流丝化不稳定性一种此前未报道的时空演化，并阐明了它与斜向双流不稳定性的相互作用，预测在束流前沿附近丝化占主导。理论、动理学粒子-in-cell模拟以及基于准静态近似的粒子-in-cell模拟之间的良好一致性验证了该方法的稳健性。通过将基于准静态近似的粒子-in-cell模拟推进到极端稀薄的电子-正电子束，例如耀变体喷流中存在的束流，我们展示了它们在此前动理学模拟无法达到的参数区域中捕捉流动不稳定性丰富非线性动力学的独特能力。

articles.title: Quasistatic modeling of ultrarelativistic beam-plasma instabilities
articles.title_zh: 超相对论束流—等离子体不稳定性的准静态建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Relativistic particle beams propagating through dense ambient plasmas are susceptible to streaming instabilities that can govern the system dynamics in various astrophysical and laboratory settings. For an unmagnetized, collisionless plasma pervaded by a dilute, cold relativistic beam, the dominant instabilities are the quasielectrostatic, oblique two-stream (OTSI) and the essentially magnetic, current filamentation instability (CFI). While their linear and nonlinear properties have been researched for decades, most treatments assume unbounded, uniform systems and thus predict purely temporal instability growth. This assumption, however, is questionable for realistic configurations where a bounded beam continuously encounters fresh plasma. This feature causes instabilities to grow in a spatiotemporal manner. Whereas spatiotemporal perturbative treatments of streaming instabilities were derived as early as the 1960s, only recently have the spatiotemporal regimes of OTSI and CFI been addressed theoretically. Yet these models are restricted to a specific instability class, and hence cannot describe the competition between spatiotemporal OTSI and CFI. In this work, we present a unified, fully electromagnetic quasi-static model of all unstable modes arising throughout the beam. By not adopting the slowly varying envelope approximation (SVEA), we find that a previously unreported spatiotemporal CFI actually prevails near the front, precisely where the SVEA fails, and is only superseded by OTSI further back in the beam. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our model also captures the growth of the self-modulation and hosing instabilities excited by long, narrow beams. Comparisons with particle-in-cell simulations confirm the validity of the quasistatic approach for modeling streaming plasma instabilities triggered by relativistic dilute beams.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究相对论粒子束在稠密无磁碰撞等离子体中传播时产生的流动不稳定性，重点包括准静电的斜向双流不稳定性和以磁效应为主的电流丝化不稳定性。作者指出传统无限均匀体系中的纯时间增长假设难以适用于有界束流不断进入新鲜等离子体的真实情形，因为此时不稳定性呈时空增长。该工作围绕准静态建模框架展开，旨在统一描述不同类别不稳定性的时空竞争，突破此前模型仅适用于单一不稳定类型的限制。
authors: P. San Miguel Claveria, L. Gremillet, X. Davoine, Q. Labro, A. Matheron, M. Tamburini, F. Fiuza, S. Corde
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相对论粒子束在稠密背景等离子体中传播时容易受到流动不稳定性的影响，这些不稳定性可在多种天体物理和实验室环境中主导系统动力学。对于由稀薄、冷的相对论束流贯穿的无磁化、无碰撞等离子体，主要不稳定性是准静电的斜向双流不稳定性（OTSI）和本质上为磁性的电流丝化不稳定性（CFI）。尽管几十年来人们一直研究它们的线性和非线性性质，但大多数处理都假定系统无边界且均匀，因此预言纯时间形式的不稳定性增长。然而，对于有界束流连续遇到新鲜等离子体的真实构型而言，这一假设是有疑问的。这一特征导致不稳定性以时空方式增长。虽然早在20世纪60年代就已推导出流动不稳定性的时空微扰处理，但直到最近，OTSI和CFI的时空机制才在理论上得到研究。然而，这些模型局限于特定的不稳定性类别，因此无法描述时空OTSI与CFI之间的竞争。在本工作中，我们提出一个统一的、全电磁的准静态模型，用以描述贯穿束流产生的所有不稳定模。由于不采用慢变包络近似（SVEA），我们发现一种此前未报道的时空CFI实际上在束流前沿附近占主导，而这正是SVEA失效的位置；只有在束流更靠后的区域，OTSI才会取而代之。此外，我们证明该模型也能捕捉由长而窄的束流激发的自调制不稳定性和蛇形不稳定性的增长。与粒子-in-cell模拟的比较证实了准静态方法在建模由相对论稀薄束流触发的流动等离子体不稳定性方面的有效性。

articles.title: Hyperspectral imaging for inline quality monitoring of roll-to-roll slot-die coated organic photovoltaic active layers
articles.title_zh: 用于卷对卷狭缝涂布有机光伏活性层在线质量监测的高光谱成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lab-scale organic solar cells have shown high efficiency and strong potential for large-scale production. Among the fabrication techniques for upscaling production, roll-to-roll slot-die coating offers a cost-effective route toward scalable manufacturing. However, reliable in-line metrology is needed for real-time assessment and quality control of the coating during roll-to-roll manufacturing. In this work, we employ a hyperspectral camera for inline monitoring of P3HT and OIDTBR active layers in a roll-to-roll setup. Using multivariate curve resolution, we reliably resolved the spatial distribution of donor and acceptor contributions in the coating. Furthermore, by fitting the absorbance spectra of P3HT, we map the exciton bandwidth, providing insights into the polymer's aggregation and chain interactions. These results demonstrate the potential of hyperspectral imaging as a powerful tool for real-time monitoring and quality control in large-scale organic solar cell production.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将高光谱相机用于卷对卷狭缝涂布工艺中P3HT和OIDTBR有机光伏活性层的在线监测。通过多变量曲线分辨方法，作者可靠区分并映射了涂层中给体与受体组分的空间分布。进一步地，通过拟合P3HT吸收光谱获得激子带宽图像，从而提供聚合物聚集和链间相互作用信息，证明高光谱成像适用于大规模有机太阳能电池生产中的实时质量控制。
authors: Abdelouadoud Mammeri, Søren Alkærsig Jensen, Søren AR Kynde, Astrid Tranum Rømer, Raimo Korhonen, Matteo Ciambezi, Moises Espindola, Jens Wenzel Andreasen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实验室尺度的有机太阳能电池已显示出高效率和大规模生产的强大潜力。在用于放大生产的制造技术中，卷对卷狭缝模头涂布为可规模化制造提供了一条具有成本效益的路径。然而，在卷对卷制造过程中，需要可靠的在线计量技术来对涂布进行实时评估和质量控制。在本工作中，我们采用高光谱相机对卷对卷装置中的P3HT和OIDTBR活性层进行在线监测。利用多变量曲线分辨，我们可靠地解析了涂层中供体和受体贡献的空间分布。此外，通过拟合P3HT的吸收光谱，我们绘制了激子带宽图，从而提供了关于聚合物聚集以及链间相互作用的认识。这些结果展示了高光谱成像作为一种强大工具在大规模有机太阳能电池生产中进行实时监测和质量控制的潜力。

articles.title: Nuclear Spin Oscillator Based on ³He to Search for Exotic Spin Coupling
articles.title_zh: 基于³He的核自旋振荡器用于搜寻奇异自旋耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24490v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe an experimental investigation of a nuclear spin oscillator based on ³He nuclei as a possible detector to search for exotic spin couplings. A magnetically shielded vapor cell comprised of an alkali atom mixture (95% potassium and 5% rubidium) and ³He gas is polarized via laser light resonant with the D₁ transition in rubidium in the presence of a dc magnetic field. The potassium atoms and ³He nuclei are polarized via spin-exchange collisions with the polarized rubidium atoms. The nuclear spins are tipped with a magnetic field applied perpendicular to the dc magnetic field. The resulting Larmor precession of the ³He nuclear spins is monitored via Faraday rotation of laser light near resonant with the D₁ transition in potassium. The Faraday rotation signal is filtered, amplified, and used to apply a magnetic field in a direction perpendicular to the dc magnetic field, resulting in a self-sustained oscillation of the nuclear spins at a frequency that is directly proportional to the dc magnetic field. We demonstrate a sensitivity to exotic spin couplings that is approx 5 times higher than the alkali atom magnetometers that have been used in the Global Network of Optical Magnetometers to Search for Exotic Physics collaboration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验研究了一种基于³He核的核自旋振荡器，作为探测奇异自旋耦合的潜在装置。实验在磁屏蔽蒸汽池中利用铷D₁跃迁共振激光极化碱金属混合气体和³He，并通过垂直磁场翻转核自旋后，用接近钾D₁跃迁的激光法拉第旋转信号监测³He拉莫尔进动。该信号经滤波放大后反馈施加横向磁场，形成频率与直流磁场成正比的自持核自旋振荡；作者报告其对奇异自旋耦合的灵敏度高于相关碱金属磁强计方案。
authors: Heather R. Pearson, Anna Molodtsova, Sage C. Weisrock, Sherlock Tingrui Zhao, Jason E. Stalnaker
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们描述了一项基于³He原子核的核自旋振荡器的实验研究，作为一种可能用于搜寻奇异自旋耦合的探测器。一个磁屏蔽蒸气池由碱金属原子混合物（95%钾和5%铷）以及³He气体组成，在直流磁场存在下，通过与铷D₁跃迁共振的激光对其进行极化。钾原子和³He原子核通过与已极化铷原子的自旋交换碰撞而被极化。通过施加垂直于直流磁场的磁场使核自旋发生倾倒。由此产生的³He核自旋拉莫尔进动，通过接近钾D₁跃迁共振的激光的法拉第旋转来监测。法拉第旋转信号经过滤波和放大，并用于在垂直于直流磁场的方向上施加磁场，从而产生核自旋的自维持振荡，其频率与直流磁场成正比。我们展示了对奇异自旋耦合的灵敏度，约比“用于搜寻奇异物理的全球光学磁力计网络”合作中所使用的碱金属原子磁力计高5倍。

articles.title: Wearable metasurfaces for boosting the effective area of mobile-device antennas
articles.title_zh: 用于提升移动设备天线有效面积的可穿戴超表面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wireless communications increasingly face scenarios with compact user equipments operating in propagation environments where signal blockage, absorption, and device size limitations strongly constrain link performance. Most approaches to wireless-link enhancement focus either on improving base-station antenna systems, for example, through massive MIMO architectures; on engineering the propagation environment using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces and active relays. Here, we propose an alternative user-side strategy for improving wireless links based on wearable metasurfaces that enhance the effective antenna area of compact wireless devices. The proposed passive metasurface is integrated into clothing and engineered to collect the power of electromagnetic waves incident on user's body and route the collected power toward a mobile device in the form of surface waves. This mechanism significantly increases the effective receiving and transmitting area of the device antenna and its gain without external power sources, active control electronics, or additional stand-alone hardware. We implement the concept on a hoodie textile using a scalable screen-printing process with conductive silver ink and demonstrate an approximately tenfold enhancement of the received signal at 26 GHz. This passive approach effectively brings the human body into the communication network by turning clothing into a virtual thin and flexible lens for focusing the incident power on the user equipment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用户侧无线链路增强策略：将无源超表面集成到衣物中，以收集入射到人体附近的电磁波能量并以表面波形式导向移动设备。该机制在无需外部电源、主动控制电子器件或额外独立硬件的情况下，增大紧凑设备天线的有效接收和发射面积及增益。作者在连帽衫织物上实现了该概念，面向信号遮挡、吸收和设备尺寸受限的移动通信场景。
authors: Mohammad M. Asgari, Xianghui Qiu, Francisco S. Cuesta, Shuai S. A. Yuan, Kamil A. Isik, Sergei Tretyakov, Xuchen Wang, Viktar Asadchy
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无线通信越来越多地面对这样的场景：紧凑型用户设备在传播环境中运行，而信号遮挡、吸收以及设备尺寸限制强烈约束链路性能。大多数无线链路增强方法要么侧重于改进基站天线系统，例如通过大规模MIMO架构；要么侧重于利用可重构智能表面和有源中继来工程化传播环境。在这里，我们提出一种替代性的用户侧无线链路改进策略，其基于可穿戴超表面来增强紧凑型无线设备的有效天线面积。所提出的无源超表面集成到衣物中，并被设计为收集入射到用户身体上的电磁波功率，再以表面波形式将收集到的功率路由至移动设备。该机制在不需要外部电源、有源控制电子设备或额外独立硬件的情况下，显著增加设备天线的有效接收和发射面积及其增益。我们使用可扩展的导电银墨水丝网印刷工艺，在连帽衫织物上实现了这一概念，并在26 GHz下展示了约十倍的接收信号增强。这种无源方法通过将衣物转变为一种用于将入射功率聚焦到用户设备上的虚拟薄型柔性透镜，从而有效地把人体纳入通信网络。

articles.title: Impact of ion-electron collisions on nonlocal ion heat conduction, viscous stress, and diffusion
articles.title_zh: 离子—电子碰撞对非局域离子热传导、黏性应力和扩散的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24505v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: By applying a first-principles reduced kinetic method, this work demonstrates the impact of ion-electron collisions on ion transport for strongly inhomogeneous plasmas in the nonlocal regime, where collisionality is insufficient to enforce local thermal equilibrium due to sharp gradients. Ion heat conduction and viscous stress in both unmagnetized and magnetized plasmas are considered, as well as inter-species diffusion in multi-species plasmas. Most notably, even for equal ion and electron temperatures, ion-electron collisions are found to substantially modify the peak nonlocal heat flow, whereas nonlocal preheats are strongly suppressed since streaming suprathermal particles are further out in the tail of the cold ion distribution where ion-electron collisions become dominant.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作采用第一性原理约化动力学方法，研究强非均匀等离子体非局域输运中离子—电子碰撞对离子输运性质的影响。作者考察了无磁化和磁化等离子体中的离子热传导与黏性应力，以及多组分等离子体中的种间扩散。结果表明，即使离子与电子温度相等，离子—电子碰撞也会显著改变峰值非局域热流，并强烈抑制非局域预热，因为流动的超热粒子位于冷离子分布尾部，离子—电子碰撞在此占主导。
authors: Nicholas Mitchell, David Chapman, Grigory Kagan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过应用一种第一性原理约化动理学方法，本工作展示了在非局域机制下，离子-电子碰撞对强非均匀等离子体中离子输运的影响；在该机制中，由于存在陡峭梯度，碰撞性不足以强制建立局域热平衡。本文考虑了无磁化和磁化等离子体中的离子热传导和黏性应力，以及多组分等离子体中的种间扩散。最值得注意的是，即使在离子和电子温度相等的情况下，离子-电子碰撞也被发现会显著改变峰值非局域热流，而非局域预热则受到强烈抑制，因为流动的超热粒子在冷离子分布的尾部更远处，在那里离子-电子碰撞变得占主导。

articles.title: Solution to an unsolved problem in diodes: Limiting current for small emission area and low emission energy
articles.title_zh: 二极管未解问题的解决：小发射面积与低发射能量下的极限电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24590v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The maximum current that can be extracted from a diode is a central question in electronic devices, especially for the generation of radiation from microwaves to x-rays. The challenge in its prediction increases significantly when the electron emission is restricted to a small area for which the classical one-dimensional Child-Langmuir law is no longer applicable. We address this unsolved problem using a model that simultaneously includes a small emission area and a small electron emission velocity. New scaling laws are presented for this difficult regime. These results are obtained from three vastly different approaches: a differential equation formulation which provides extremely high resolution, an integral equation formulation which leads to the scaling laws, and a particle-in-cell simulation which shows the temporal-spatial evolution. Comparisons of the predicted maximum current among these three approaches are performed over a large range of parameters, paying special attention to the resolution of the potential minimum in the immediate vicinity of the cathode surface. Corroborations of the scaling laws with experiments on thermionic cathodes and on photoinjectors are indicated. The model consists of a periodic array of electron sheets of finite width in a planar diode, all emitted from a cathode with the same energy. Electron motion is restricted to the direction normal to the cathode.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对电子仅从小面积发射且初始发射速度较低时二极管可抽取最大电流的预测问题，提出超越经典一维Child–Langmuir定律的新模型。作者给出了该困难参数区间的新的标度律，并分别通过高分辨率微分方程方法、可导出标度律的积分方程方法以及粒子模拟进行验证。论文比较了大范围参数下三种方法得到的最大电流，特别关注阴极表面附近势能极小值的解析，并与热发射实验进行了对照。
authors: Y. Y. Lau, David P. Chernin, Yves Heri, Peng Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可从二极管中抽取的最大电流是电子器件中的一个核心问题，尤其对于从微波到X射线的辐射产生而言更是如此。当电子发射被限制在一个小区域内时，对其进行预测的挑战显著增加，因为此时经典的一维Child-Langmuir定律不再适用。我们使用一个同时包含小发射面积和小电子发射速度的模型来处理这一未解问题。针对这一困难机制，本文给出了新的标度律。这些结果来自三种差异极大的方法：一种提供极高分辨率的微分方程表述，一种导出标度律的积分方程表述，以及一种显示时空演化的粒子-in-cell模拟。我们在大范围参数内比较了这三种方法对最大电流的预测，特别关注阴极表面近邻处势能最小值的分辨率。文中指出了这些标度律与热阴极实验和光注入器实验之间的相互印证。该模型由平面二极管中有限宽度电子片的周期阵列组成，所有电子片均以相同能量从阴极发射。电子运动被限制在垂直于阴极的方向上。

articles.title: Implementation and verification of the avalanche source in a 3D full-f particle-in-cell model of relativistic electrons for studies of tokamak disruptions
articles.title_zh: 用于托卡马克破裂研究的三维全分布函数相对论电子PIC模型中雪崩源的实现与验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24602v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Disruptions threaten tokamak operation not only because of large in-vessel forces and thermal heat loads, but also because some electrons may be accelerated to relativistic energies. These so-called runaway electrons (REs) can multiply exponentially via knock-on collisions with thermal electrons. As the resulting RE avalanche is exponentially sensitive to the pre-disruption plasma current, multi-MA RE beams may form in large future devices, risking severe localized wall damage. Detailed understanding of RE beam formation and the particle phase-space distribution requires a self-consistent treatment of the RE avalanche and competing losses in the stochastic fields of MHD-active plasmas. Such simulations including the RE sources in 3D fields are needed to develop viable mitigation scenarios. For this, the 3D nonlinear MHD code JOREK includes a hybrid fluid-kinetic model, describing REs with a full-f relativistic particle-in-cell (PiC) approach using full-orbit or drift-kinetic descriptions. In this work, an energy and momentum conserving knock-on collision operator is implemented to enable accurate modeling of the RE phase-space dynamics in 3D electromagnetic fields. To make such novel high-fidelity simulations computationally viable, a resampling technique was also implemented to restrict the number of markers. The avalanche model is verified using analytical expressions from literature and applied to a JET-like termination scenario, demonstrating its applicability to realistic 3D MHD active scenarios. Future work on porting to accelerated high-performance computing systems will be needed to cross the long time scales involved, e.g., in periodic termination and re-avalanching that could occur in large devices like ITER.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向托卡马克破裂期间逃逸电子雪崩增殖的模拟需求，在三维非线性MHD代码JOREK的混合流体—动力学框架中实现并验证雪崩源项。研究采用全分布函数相对论粒子模拟描述逃逸电子，并引入能量和动量守恒的敲出碰撞算子，以更准确刻画逃逸电子相空间动力学。该工作旨在支持在三维随机磁场和MHD活动等离子体中自洽研究逃逸电子束形成及损失机制，从而为未来大型装置的缓解方案提供模拟工具。
authors: Fiona Wouters, Hannes Bergström, Matthias Hoelzl, Guido T. A. Huijsmans, Jan van Dijk, the JOREK team
articles.abstract_zh_full: 破裂威胁托卡马克运行，不仅因为会产生巨大的真空室内力和热负荷，还因为一些电子可能被加速到相对论能量。这些所谓的逃逸电子（REs）可以通过与热电子的撞出碰撞而指数倍增。由于由此产生的RE雪崩对破裂前等离子体电流呈指数敏感，在未来大型装置中可能形成多兆安RE束，从而带来严重局部壁面损伤的风险。对RE束形成以及粒子相空间分布的详细理解，需要在MHD活跃等离子体的随机场中对RE雪崩和竞争性损失进行自洽处理。包含三维场中RE源的此类模拟，对于制定可行的缓解方案是必要的。为此，三维非线性MHD代码JOREK包含一个混合流体-动理学模型，采用全分布函数相对论粒子-in-cell（PiC）方法并使用全轨道或漂移动理学描述来刻画RE。在本工作中，实现了一个守恒能量和动量的撞出碰撞算符，以便在三维电磁场中准确建模RE相空间动力学。为了使这种新型高保真模拟在计算上可行，还实现了一种重采样技术以限制标记粒子的数量。雪崩模型使用文献中的解析表达式进行了验证，并应用于一个类JET终止情景，展示了其对真实三维MHD活跃情景的适用性。未来还需要开展移植到加速高性能计算系统上的工作，以跨越所涉及的长时间尺度，例如在ITER等大型装置中可能出现的周期性终止和再雪崩过程。

articles.title: Universal Statistics of Energy and Information Flow in Random Electromagnetic Fields
articles.title_zh: 随机电磁场中能量与信息流的普适统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish a universal statistical description for the local flow of energy and information in random electromagnetic fields. The longitudinal Poynting flux, written as a Hermitian quadratic form of the transverse electric and magnetic field components, follows a probability distribution that is completely determined by four eigenvalues of an electromagnetic covariance matrix. These flux eigenvalues quantify forward transport, optical backflow, and polarization mixing, and reduce to the known paraxial and isotropic limits in the appropriate regimes -- including strongly nonparaxial fields, where no universal description was known so far. Full-vector simulations of continuous and discrete disordered media confirm this universality. The same framework applies to the recently introduced Fisher-information flux, with the fields replaced by their sensitivity to a parameter, thereby unifying the statistics of local energy and information transport in random light and revealing the reversal of information flow across a parameter-dependent object.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了随机电磁场中局域能量流和信息流的普适统计描述。作者将纵向坡印廷通量写成横向电场与磁场分量的厄米二次型，证明其概率分布完全由电磁协方差矩阵的四个本征值决定，这些本征值表征前向输运、光学回流和偏振混合。全矢量无序介质模拟验证了该普适性；同一框架还可推广到Fisher信息通量，从而统一随机光场中局域能量与信息输运的统计，并揭示参数依赖物体中的信息流反转。
authors: Yuchen Ke, Nandini Bhattacharya, Stefan Rotter, Fabian Maucher
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为随机电磁场中能量和信息的局域流动建立了一种普适统计描述。纵向坡印廷通量可写为横向电场和磁场分量的厄米二次型，其概率分布完全由一个电磁协方差矩阵的四个特征值决定。这些通量特征值量化了正向输运、光学回流以及偏振混合，并在适当机制下化归为已知的傍轴和各向同性极限——包括强非傍轴场，在这种情况下此前尚无已知的普适描述。连续和离散无序介质的全矢量模拟证实了这种普适性。同一框架适用于最近引入的Fisher信息通量，只需将场替换为其对某一参数的灵敏度，由此统一了随机光中局域能量和信息传输的统计，并揭示了信息流在穿过参数依赖物体时的反转。

articles.title: Recommended Second Virial Coefficients for Nitrogen and Oxygen
articles.title_zh: 氮与氧第二维里系数推荐值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We provide recommended values for the second virial coefficient, B(T), and its uncertainty, for molecular nitrogen and oxygen. The temperature range covered is 20-3000 K for nitrogen and 20-2000 K for oxygen. The recommendations are based on tuning previously published state-of-the-art ab initio pair potentials so that the B(T) calculated from the potentials match selected high-accuracy experimental data; for nitrogen the tuning utilizes values of B derived from literature density data with greatly reduced uncertainty by analyzing the data with the aid of ab initio calculated higher virial coefficients. Quantum effects on B are fully included with the path-integral Monte Carlo method. The resulting B(T) have uncertainties similar to those of the best experimental data, but cover a much wider temperature range.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文给出了分子氮和氧的第二维里系数B(T)及其不确定度的推荐值，覆盖较宽温度范围。作者基于已发表的高水平从头算二体势，并通过与高精度实验数据拟合来修正势函数；对氮还结合了由密度数据反演得到、且借助高阶维里系数分析显著降低不确定度的文献值。量子效应通过路径积分蒙特卡罗方法完整纳入，因此所得B(T)在不确定度上接近最佳实验数据，同时适用于更宽的温区。
authors: Robert Hellmann, Giovanni Garberoglio, Allan H. Harvey
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为分子氮和氧提供第二维里系数B(T)及其不确定度的推荐值。覆盖的温度范围为氮气20–3000 K，氧气20–2000 K。这些推荐值基于对先前发表的最先进从头算二体势进行调校，使得由这些势计算出的B(T)与所选高精度实验数据相匹配；对于氮气，该调校利用了从文献密度数据推导出的B值，这些值通过借助从头算得到的高阶维里系数来分析数据而大幅降低了不确定度。B中的量子效应通过路径积分蒙特卡罗方法被完整纳入。所得B(T)的不确定度与最佳实验数据相近，但覆盖了宽得多的温度范围。

articles.title: A charge-flow instability in plasmas with charge fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 含电荷涨落等离子体中的电荷-流动不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22815v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a linear instability in magnetized plasmas with charge fluctuations. It is driven by an electric current proportional to the charge chemical potential μ and the bulk velocity. This charge-flow (C-flow) instability has hitherto not been considered in standard magnetohydrodynamics or its chiral extensions. We derive its dispersion relation and maximum growth rate, and confirm them with direct numerical simulations. We also show that the C-flow instability persists even for zero-mean fluctuations of μ, vanishing resistivity, and a magnetic Prandtl number of unity.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出了一种存在于具有电荷涨落的磁化等离子体中的线性不稳定性，即电荷-流动（C-flow）不稳定性。该不稳定性由与电荷化学势μ和体速度成正比的电流驱动，文中推导了其色散关系和最大增长率，并通过直接数值模拟加以验证。结果还表明，即使在μ平均值为零、无电阻且磁普朗特数为1的情况下，该不稳定性仍然存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了磁化等离子体中存在电荷涨落时的一种线性不稳定性。它由一个与电荷化学势μ和体速度成正比的电流所驱动。这种电荷流（C-flow）不稳定性迄今尚未在标准磁流体力学或其手征扩展中被考虑。我们推导了它的色散关系和最大增长率，并用直接数值模拟加以证实。我们还表明，即使在μ的零均值涨落、消失的电阻率以及磁Prandtl数为一的条件下，C-flow不稳定性仍然存在。

articles.title: Relativistic Chiral MHD with application to the early Universe
articles.title_zh: 相对论手征磁流体力学及其在早期宇宙中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22816v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a systematic derivation of the equations of relativistic chiral magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) for a plasma of charged fermions in an expanding universe. Through a combination of a coordinate transformation and a rescaling of the dynamical variables, we bring the full system to the same form as in the Minkowski metric, with the Hubble expansion surviving only in the chirality-flipping rate and the kinematic viscosity. Retaining all four contributions to both the electric and the axial current yields terms absent from standard chiral MHD: charge-density corrections to the evolution equations for the chemical potentials, and an electric current proportional to the charge chemical potential μ and the bulk velocity. The latter is mandated by current conservation, requires no chirality imbalance, and drives the charge-flow instability studied in a companion paper. For the radiation-dominated era, we evaluate all the coefficients in physical units and use them to estimate the magnetic Reynolds number, the attainable magnetic field strength, and the minimum temperature at which the chiral dynamo can operate. The resulting equations are cast in a form ready for direct numerical implementation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统推导了早期宇宙中带电费米子等离子体的相对论手征磁流体力学方程。通过坐标变换与动力学变量重标度，完整方程被化为与闵可夫斯基时空中相同的形式，宇宙膨胀仅体现在手征翻转速率和运动黏度中。保留电流与轴向电流的全部四项贡献后，方程中出现了标准手征MHD所没有的项，包括化学势演化方程中的电荷密度修正，以及与电荷化学势μ和体速度成正比的电流；后者满足电流守恒并可驱动配套论文中研究的电荷-流动不稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们系统推导了膨胀宇宙中带电费米子等离子体的相对论手征磁流体力学（MHD）方程。通过坐标变换与动力学变量的重标定相结合，我们将完整系统化为与Minkowski度规中相同的形式，其中Hubble膨胀仅保留在手征翻转率和运动黏度中。保留电流和轴流各自的全部四项贡献，会产生标准手征MHD中不存在的项：化学势演化方程中的电荷密度修正，以及一个与电荷化学势μ和体速度成正比的电流。后者由电流守恒所要求，不需要手征不平衡，并驱动伴随论文中研究的电荷流不稳定性。对于辐射主导时代，我们以物理单位评估所有系数，并用它们估计磁Reynolds数、可达到的磁场强度，以及手征发电机能够运行的最低温度。所得方程被写成可直接用于数值实现的形式。

articles.title: ViBra: Configuration Interaction for Anharmonic Vibrational Spectroscopy and Quantum-Sampled Configuration Spaces
articles.title_zh: ViBra：用于非谐振动光谱与量子采样构型空间的组态相互作用方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22850v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum-centric workflows are a promising route to improving the accuracy of property predictions in computational chemistry and materials science. By integrating quantum sampling algorithms with classical solvers, electronic structure calculations have recently demonstrated their potential even on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. In principle, the method of Vibrational Configuration Interaction (VCI) is suitable for integration with quantum sampling algorithms as well. However, demonstrations of computational workflows for quantum-centric, vibrational property predictions are still lacking. Here, we introduce a methodology for performing anharmonic vibrational structure calculations that can be deployed in a hybrid, quantum-classical mode. Starting from a quartic force field, the approach combines a Vibrational Self-Consistent Field (VSCF) with VCI in either Full, Selected (S-VCI), or Symmetry-Adapted (SA-VCI) mode. In S-VCI, an Epstein-Nesbet perturbative screening significantly reduces the configuration space while retaining high predictive accuracy. A state-list input enables the integration of externally generated vibrational configurations as a seed space. As a proof-of-concept, we demonstrate a hybrid, quantum-classical computational workflow, in which a quantum sampling algorithm provides the seed. Our vibrational wave function analysis package ViBra, equipped with a graphical interface, is available at https://github.com/raphafe96/ViBra.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种可用于混合量子-经典模式的非谐振动结构计算方法，面向量子中心工作流中的振动性质预测。该方法从四次力场出发，结合振动自洽场（VSCF）与全空间、选择性或对称适配的振动组态相互作用（VCI）计算；其中选择性VCI通过Epstein-Nesbet微扰筛选显著压缩构型空间，同时保持较高预测精度。作者还引入状态列表输入，以便与外部生成的构型空间集成，适合后续与量子采样算法耦合应用。
authors: Raphael F. Ligorio, Marco Antonio Barroca, Alan Duriez, Mathias B. Steiner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子中心工作流是提高计算化学和材料科学中性质预测准确性的一条有前景的路径。通过将量子采样算法与经典求解器结合，电子结构计算最近已经证明，即使在含噪声中等规模量子设备上也具有潜力。原则上，振动构型相互作用（VCI）方法同样适合与量子采样算法集成。然而，用于量子中心振动性质预测的计算工作流展示仍然缺乏。在这里，我们介绍一种执行非谐振动结构计算的方法，该方法可部署于量子-经典混合模式。从四次力场出发，该方法将振动自洽场（VSCF）与VCI结合，可采用全空间、选择性（S-VCI）或对称性适配（SA-VCI）模式。在S-VCI中，Epstein-Nesbet微扰筛选显著缩小构型空间，同时保持较高的预测精度。状态列表输入使得可将外部生成的振动构型作为种子空间加以集成。作为概念验证，我们展示了一个量子-经典混合计算工作流，其中由量子采样算法提供种子。我们的振动波函数分析软件包ViBra配备了图形界面，可供使用。

articles.title: Machine Learning of Quantum Entanglement from Noisy Measurements
articles.title_zh: 从噪声测量中学习量子纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22853v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this work, we investigate the application of Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to the identification and quantitative characterization of quantum entanglement in polarization-entangled photon pairs. The analysis is based on simulated symmetric, informationally complete, positive operator-valued measure (SIC-POVM) measurement data, where each two-qubit state is represented by a 16-dimensional measurement vector corresponding to experimentally accessible coincidence counts. The generated SIC-POVM measurement data include Poissonian shot noise. Several supervised ML algorithms, including Logistic Regression, k-Nearest Neighbors, Decision Trees, Support Vector Machines, and Random Forests, are applied to the classification of separable and entangled states directly from raw measurement data, without explicit density matrix reconstruction or the use of conventional separability criteria. The study additionally explores clustering methods and nonlinear regression techniques for estimating continuous entanglement measures. The obtained results demonstrate that ML methods can achieve very high classification accuracy, even under extremely limited training conditions. These findings indicate that ML may provide an efficient alternative to conventional quantum-state analysis under simulated Poissonian noise conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了机器学习算法在识别和定量表征偏振纠缠光子对量子纠缠中的应用。分析基于模拟的SIC-POVM测量数据，每个双量子比特态都表示为包含符合计数信息的16维测量向量，并加入了泊松抽样噪声。多种监督学习算法被用于直接从原始测量数据中区分可分态与纠缠态，无需显式重构密度矩阵或采用传统可分性判据；同时还考察了聚类和非线性回归方法来估计连续纠缠度量。结果表明，即使在较强噪声下，机器学习方法仍能获得很高的分类精度。
authors: Artur Czerwinski, Maciej Wiśniewski, Paweł Moszczyński

articles.title: Full-wave nonlinear microscopy reveals guided channel for ultrafast polariton transport
articles.title_zh: 全波非线性显微镜揭示超快极化激元传输的导波通道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22860v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show how finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations can be extended to model ultrafast nonlinear microscopy, enabling the prediction of spatially-resolved pump--probe signals in arbitrary electromagnetic environments. Focusing on polariton transport in strongly coupled light--matter systems, we develop a perturbative framework to study the ultrafast propagation of hybrid light--matter excitations in nanophotonic structures. We first apply the framework to a standard distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) cavity, reproducing established results for polariton transport from a multimode Tavis--Cummings model. We then consider the full modal landscape of the same cavity, including guided modes below the light line that are typically neglected in single-mode-family descriptions. Exploiting these modes, we design compact mode converters that transfer radiative cavity polaritons into photon-like guided polaritons and back, utilizing the guided modes for low-loss propagation. Despite molecular dephasing, this enables transport of molecular excitation over a millimeter, an order of magnitude beyond current transport experiments. We further compute the pump--probe differential transmission signal, providing an experimental signature of the mechanism. Our results show that the modal landscape of a photonic cavity can be engineered to bypass limitations commonly assumed to be intrinsic to the transport of molecular polaritons.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者展示了如何将有限差分时域（FDTD）模拟扩展到超快非线性显微镜，用以预测任意电磁环境中的空间分辨泵浦-探测信号。聚焦于强耦合光-物质系统中的极化激元输运，文中提出了一个研究超快混合光-物质激发传播的微扰框架。以分布式布拉格反射镜腔为例，该框架能够复现已有的极化激元输运结果；进一步考虑光线下方的导模后，作者设计了紧凑的模态转换器，使辐射型腔极化激元可转化为类光子导波极化激元并实现低损耗传播，从而在分子退相干存在时仍可将分子激发输运到毫米尺度。
authors: Qingyi Zhou, Piper Fowler-Wright, Zongfu Yu, Joel Yuen-Zhou, Michael Reitz

articles.title: Physics-informed token transformer methodology for nonlinear balance laws. I. Schwarzschild--Burgers fluid flows
articles.title_zh: 用于非线性平衡律的物理信息Token Transformer方法：Ⅰ. Schwarzschild–Burgers流动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23143v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a Physics-Informed Token Transformer (PITT) methodology for nonlinear hyperbolic balance laws in one space dimension, using piecewise steady-state profiles for the representation of approximate weak solutions. The method combines symbolic equation tokenization, a Fourier neural operator encoder, an explicit Rankine--Hugoniot law for shock motion, and a learned correction term. For clarity, we present it here for the relativistic Schwarzschild--Burgers equation, a scalar model for spherically symmetric fluid flows on a Schwarzschild background. For this model the steady-state invariant and the generalized Riemann solutions are explicit, and they can therefore be built into the neural evolution. In particular, the leading discontinuities are advanced by the analytical jump condition, while the learned part reconstructs smooth regions, rarefaction fans, geometric dependence, and finite-resolution effects. The method is designed to locate wave fronts accurately and to preserve the relevant steady states. We test our PITT method on moving shocks, stationary shocks, rarefaction waves, and compare it with a standard high-order finite-volume approximation. We also analyze the standard Burgers limit (when the Schwarzschild mass tends to zero). The Rankine--Hugoniot prior plays the dominant role in these tests, while equation tokenization gives a systematic additional gain. The method is relevant for problems involving geometric effects and/or complex shock-wave dynamics, and is used here to study the long-time dynamics of perturbations of steady-state solutions. In particular, we exhibit an asymptotic law of propagation for the shock location of perturbed steady-state flows.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于一维非线性双曲平衡律的物理信息Token Transformer（PITT）方法，采用分段稳态剖面表示近似弱解。该方法结合了符号方程token化、Fourier神经算子编码器、显式Rankine–Hugoniot激波运动律以及学习型修正项。作者以相对论Schwarzschild–Burgers方程为例进行说明，利用其可显式写出的稳态不变量与广义Riemann解嵌入神经演化中，使主要间断可由解析跳跃条件推进，而学习部分负责重建平滑区域、稀疏波、几何依赖和有限分辨率效应。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Discovering Periodic Orbits in the Gravitational Three-Body Problem
articles.title_zh: 利用物理信息神经网络发现引力三体问题中的周期轨道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23501v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Locating periodic solutions of chaotic dynamical systems normally requires an initial guess close enough to the target orbit for numerical continuation or gradient-based search to converge. We show that Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) trained on sparse, noisy observations emphwithout initial conditions recover periodic orbits of the gravitational three-body problem, including orbit families absent from the training data. The method rests on a second-order ODE formulation, fixed-frequency Fourier features, percentile-based adaptive refinement, and a trainable scaling parameter, each validated on forward problems. Across two 100-seed ensembles, 23--25% of runs converge to families not present in the training data. We then ask what determines which family emerges. Two ḩi² tests give a consistent answer: changing the training data source significantly shifts the distribution of recovered families (p < 0.001, Cramér's V = 0.339), whereas switching between the two initialization distributions tested does not (p = 0.620, V = 0.094). The random seed selects which family a given run recovers; the emphdistribution the weights are drawn from does not shift the aggregate frequencies, but the training data does. The evidence is empirical: we do not characterize the loss landscape analytically, and PINNs remain slower than conventional integrators on well-posed initial-value problems. What the experiments establish is that the recovered orbits are verifiable rather than merely plausible: the identified ones refine to genuine periodic solutions, a network trained on Lagrange data recovers the figure-eight choreography (Li--Liao class I.A.1, matched to seven significant digits in T^*), and one trained on figure-eight data recovers a Broucke--Hadjidemetriou--Hénon orbit closing to δ_T < 10⁻⁹.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，物理信息神经网络即便只基于稀疏且含噪观测、且不提供初始条件，也能恢复引力三体问题中的周期轨道，包括训练数据中未出现的轨道族。方法采用二阶常微分方程表述、固定频率傅里叶特征、基于分位数的自适应加密以及可训练尺度参数，并在前向问题上完成验证。两组各100个随机种子的实验显示，约23%至25%的运行会收敛到训练集中不存在的轨道族；进一步分析表明，训练数据来源会显著影响恢复出的轨道族分布，而初始化分布的切换影响不显著。

articles.title: Central-Hermite Sensing and Collision for Frame-Robust Order-Resolved Relaxation on D3Q125
articles.title_zh: 面向帧鲁棒阶次分辨弛豫的中心Hermite感知与碰撞方法：D3Q125模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23629v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Raw-Hermite sensing and collision on a fixed discrete-velocity set can convert a uniform translation into artificial coupling between nominally distinct nonequilibrium orders. We develop a central-Hermite formulation for a D3Q125 kinetic model with order-resolved log-Gaussian relaxation and compare three variants: raw sensing/raw collision (A), central sensing/raw collision (B), and central sensing/central collision (C). In homogeneous translated second-order perturbations, model C preserves third- and fourth-order modal purity to machine precision, whereas A and B develop boost-dependent cross-order content. Across a grid-CFL-boost matrix, model C reduces the post-transport collision frame discrepancy relative to A by 65.342-98.102% (median 81.131%) in the total relative L-infinity measure. Long-time calculations remain positive and conservative to numerical precision, although the accumulated benefit is configuration dependent because transport continually re-injects frame error. A transport study further reveals a clear trade-off: central-Hermite interface reconstruction strongly suppresses the third-order discrepancy but amplifies the fourth-order discrepancy. The fully central-Hermite collision therefore substantially reduces collision-induced cross-order frame discrepancy, while residual dependence remains due to discrete transport and finite velocity-space representation. This moment-space improvement does not by itself establish a comparable reduction in macroscopic Galilean transport error.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，在固定离散速度集上进行原始Hermite感知与碰撞，可能把均匀平移转化为原本不同无平衡阶次之间的人为耦合。为此，作者针对D3Q125动理学模型提出中心Hermite形式，并采用阶次分辨的对数高斯弛豫，比较了原始感知/原始碰撞、中心感知/原始碰撞以及中心感知/中心碰撞三种方案。结果表明，中心感知与中心碰撞组合可将第三、四阶模态纯度保持到机器精度，并显著降低碰撞后的帧差异；同时，该方法在长期计算中保持正性与守恒性，但整体收益仍会受具体配置影响。

articles.title: No Free Lunch in Flow Surrogates under Time-Varying Boundary Conditions: A Two-Regime Study
articles.title_zh: 时变边界条件下流动替代模型并无通用最优解：双工况研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23667v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A flow surrogate validated on a simple regime is often taken as evidence that the approach will carry to a richer one. We test this assumption on two transient flows under time-varying boundary conditions emulating the process startup: the three-dimensional slurry film in chemical-mechanical planarisation (CMP), a core semiconductor-manufacturing process, and the two-dimensional Karman vortex street (KVS) behind a cylinder. Eight surrogate models are compared on one shared evaluation pipeline, differing in whether they learn the full field or a latent representation, and whether they predict trajectories in one shot or step by step. No single architecture wins both regimes. On the film, a one-shot full-field model reconstructs the process-relevant cumulative wall shear stress to 3.2% relative error. On the wake, a latent autoregressive DeepONet retains 96% of the shedding power that direct and one-shot models damp to almost zero. The deciding axis is the treatment of time. The self-sustained wake requires the phase memory that autoregressive feedback provides, while the boundary-driven film rewards a direct map. Pointwise RMSE picks the wrong model in both regimes, so the evaluation scores five physical questions instead, the field, its structure, invented motion, amplitude, and timing. The trained surrogates answer queries 10³ to 10⁴ times faster than the finite-element solver, but the offline cost of the training simulations means they pay off from the first query beyond the training set for CMP and the third for the KVS. The choice of surrogate should follow the dynamical character of the target flow, and its validation should use failure-mode-resolved metrics, since neither the winning architecture nor its validation transfers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较了八种流动替代模型在两个受时变边界条件驱动的瞬态流动中的表现，分别是化学机械抛光中的三维浆料膜流动，以及圆柱后方的二维卡门涡街。不同模型在“全场还是潜空间”和“一步预测还是逐步预测”两个维度上各不相同，但结果显示没有任何单一架构能同时在两个工况中取胜。对于膜流动，一步式全场模型能以3.2%的相对误差重构工艺相关的累计壁面剪切应力；对于尾迹流，潜空间自回归DeepONet能保留96%的涡脱落强度，而直接预测和一步式模型几乎将其完全抑制。

articles.title: Spectral properties of mesoscale fluctuations in interplanetary coronal mass ejections
articles.title_zh: 行星际日冕物质抛射中中尺度涨落的谱特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23742v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic fields in interplanetary coronal mass ejections (ICMEs) often display a flux rope structure at large scales and a turbulent cascade of fluctuations at smaller scales. However, the nature of fluctuations at transition scales between the flux rope and turbulence - i.e., at mesoscales - has not been previously examined in detail. Mesoscale fluctuations of the magnetic field in 142 ICME intervals with clear flux rope signatures at 1 au have been examined using wavelet power spectra, with "mesoscale" defined here as spacecraft-frame frequencies 10⁻⁴ Hz< 10⁻³ Hz, equivalent to timescales 2.8 hrgtrsim τ gtrsim 17 min. The spectra were found to be significantly less steep at mesoscales than at larger and smaller scales, with an average spectral slope close to -1 at these intermediate scales. The mesoscale fluctuations had relatively high cross helicity magnitudes and low compressibility, suggesting a significant degree of Alfvénicity, while also having more negative residual energy than the turbulent fluctuations found at smaller scales. Uncertainties in the spectral slope values at mesoscales were used to distinguish between spectra showing a relatively smooth power-law behavior or (less commonly) a more bumpy trend; the smoother power-law intervals had a balanced cross helicity distribution while the more bumpy spectra had a predominantly antisunward cross helicity. Slow wind intervals were similarly analyzed, and showed similar properties to the ICMEs. These results indicate that a spectrally narrow 1/f range is typically present in ICMEs at mesoscales.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了行星际日冕物质抛射（ICME）中介于大尺度磁通绳与小尺度湍流之间的中尺度磁场涨落。作者利用142个具有清晰磁通绳特征的1 AU ICME区间的波列谱，分析了空间飞船系频率约10⁻⁴至10⁻³ Hz对应的中尺度区间。结果发现，中尺度谱斜率明显比更大和更小尺度更平缓，平均接近-1；这些涨落还表现出较高的交叉螺度幅值和较低压缩性，提示具有一定阿尔芬特性，同时其残余能量比小尺度湍流更负。
authors: Anna-Sofia Jylhä, Simon Good, Emilia Kilpua

articles.title: Two-dimensional simulation of Argon dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) in plasma actuator structure with COMSOL Multiphysics
articles.title_zh: 基于 COMSOL Multiphysics 的氩气介质阻挡放电等离子体激励器结构二维模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2304.05698v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) plasma is used for various applications. DBD is also one of the most efficient and low-cost methods for active fluid flow control. In this study, a detailed physical model of DBD in atmospheric pressure at 1kV DC voltage is developed with COMSOL Multiphysics software. Argon gas is also used as a background gas and electrodes are assumed to be copper. Plasma parameters such as electron and ion density, electric field, potential, and temperature for different distances of electrodes (1.0mm, 0.9mm, 0.8mm) have been investigated. Moreover, the effect of dielectric type (Quartz, Silica Glass, Mica) on these key parameters is investigated. The results of the simulation show that the longitudinal distance of the buried electrodes to the exposed electrodes has a direct influence on parameters such as electron temperature, and electron and ion density which are the main factors of fluid flow control. These parameters have the maximum value when mica is used as a dielectric and the lowest value when silica glass is utilized.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 COMSOL Multiphysics 建立了常压、1 kV 直流条件下氩气介质阻挡放电的详细物理模型，并面向等离子体激励器结构开展二维模拟。研究考察了不同电极间距以及不同介质材料对电子密度、离子密度、电场、电势和温度等参数的影响。结果表明，埋入式电极与暴露电极的纵向距离会显著影响等离子体参数，其中云母作为介质时相关参数最大，石英玻璃或二氧化硅玻璃时较低。

articles.title: Machine Learning for Cloud Detection in IASI Measurements: A Data-Driven SVM Approach with Physical Constraints
articles.title_zh: 基于物理约束的数据驱动 SVM 方法用于 IASI 观测中的云检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.10120v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cloud detection is fundamental for the interpretation and operational exploitation of hyperspectral infrared sounders, yet the capability of infrared radiances alone to provide reliable cloud information remains insufficiently assessed. We introduce the Cloud Identification Support Vector Machine (CISVM), a supervised framework for global clear and cloudy classification from Infrared Atmospheric Sounding Interferometer (IASI) Level 1C observations. The analysis spans four seasons and compares radiances and brightness temperatures, alternative spectral reductions, and stratifications by surface type and climate zone. Using AVHRR-derived IASI cloud labels for training, the classifier operates exclusively on hyperspectral infrared radiances and is evaluated against independent IASI and collocated MODIS observations. The best-performing configuration, based on radiances and principal component analysis, achieves 88.52 percent of agreement with the operational IASI cloud reference. The results show that infrared radiances alone can reproduce the large-scale behaviour of an operational cloud product while providing physically interpretable insight into the influence of surface properties, seasonality, and geography on cloud detection performance. The proposed framework provides an operational baseline for future hyperspectral infrared missions, including ESA's Far-infrared Outgoing Radiation Understanding and Monitoring (FORUM).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出云识别支持向量机（CISVM），用于基于 IASI Level 1C 高光谱红外观测的全球晴空/多云分类。作者比较了不同的辐射与亮温表示、谱维降维方式，以及按下垫面类型和气候区划分的训练策略，并使用 AVHRR 生成的 IASI 云标签进行监督学习。实验表明，基于辐射并结合主成分分析的方案与业务 IASI 云产品的一致性最好，达到 88.52%。结果说明，仅依赖红外辐射也能较好再现业务云产品的大尺度特征，同时保持物理可解释性。
authors: Chiara Zugarini, Cristina Sgattoni, Luca Sgheri

articles.title: Near-field photon Nernst effect
articles.title_zh: 近场光子能斯特效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.20372v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We consider the consequence of having nonreciprocal photon transfer between two surfaces with temperature gradient. We demonstrate that in a system consisting of graphene and a magneto-optical substrate separated by a gap, a transverse electric field is generated in graphene perpendicular to magnetic field and temperature gradient, in analogy to the Nernst effect. Such photon Nernst effect is driven by nonreciprocal Casimir force carried by photons. We show that the thermal efficiency of near-field photon Nernst effect is bounded by the Carnot limit, and nonreciprocal high-k modes are needed for approaching the limit. The near-field photon Nernst effect enables electrical probing of nonreciprocal radiative transfer and provides a novel means of energy harvesting.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有温度梯度的两表面之间非互易光子传输所产生的效应。在由石墨烯与磁光基底构成、两者之间存在间隙的系统中，作者发现会在石墨烯中产生一个垂直于磁场和温度梯度的横向电场，其形式类似于能斯特效应。该“光子能斯特效应”由非互易 Casimir 力携带的光子驱动，其热效率受卡诺极限约束，且接近极限需要非互易高波矢模参与。该机制为探测非互易辐射传输及能量采集提供了新途径。

articles.title: Machine Learning on Heterogeneous, Edge, and Quantum Hardware for Particle Physics (ML-HEQUPP)
articles.title_zh: 面向粒子物理的异构、边缘与量子硬件机器学习（ML-HEQUPP）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22248v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The next generation of particle physics experiments will face a new era of challenges in data acquisition, due to unprecedented data rates and volumes along with extreme environments and operational constraints. Harnessing this data for scientific discovery demands real-time inference and decision-making, intelligent data reduction, and efficient processing architectures beyond current capabilities. Crucial to the success of this experimental paradigm are several emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), silicon microelectronics, and the advent of quantum algorithms and processing. Their intersection includes areas of research such as low-power and low-latency devices for edge computing, heterogeneous accelerator systems, reconfigurable hardware, novel codesign and synthesis strategies, readout for cryogenic or high-radiation environments, and analog computing. This white paper presents a community-driven vision to identify and prioritize research and development opportunities in hardware-based ML systems and corresponding physics applications, contributing towards a successful transition to the new data frontier of fundamental science.
articles.abstract_zh: 这是一篇社区驱动的白皮书，讨论下一代粒子物理实验在超高数据率、极端环境和运行约束下所面临的数据获取与处理挑战。文章强调，需要将人工智能与机器学习、硅微电子、量子算法与处理技术结合起来，以支持实时推断、智能降采样和高效计算架构。白皮书重点梳理了边缘计算、异构加速器、可重构硬件、协同设计、低温或高辐射环境读出以及模拟计算等研究方向。其目标是识别并优先排序相关研发机会，推动硬件化机器学习系统在粒子物理中的应用。
authors: Julia Gonski (Sunny), Jenni Ott (Sunny), Shiva Abbaszadeh (Sunny), Sagar Addepalli (Sunny), Matteo Cremonesi (Sunny), Jennet Dickinson (Sunny), Giuseppe Di Guglielmo (Sunny), Erdem Yigit Ertorer (Sunny), Lindsey Gray (Sunny), Ryan Herbst (Sunny), Christian Herwig (Sunny), Tae Min Hong (Sunny), Benedikt Maier (Sunny), Maryam Bayat Makou (Sunny), David Miller (Sunny), Mark S. articles.abstract_zh_full: 下一代粒子物理实验将在数据采集方面面临一个充满新挑战的时代，这些挑战来自前所未有的数据速率和数据体量，以及极端环境和运行约束。将这些数据用于科学发现，需要实时推理和决策、智能化数据缩减，以及超越当前能力的高效处理架构。对于这一实验范式的成功至关重要的是若干新兴技术，例如人工智能与机器学习（AI/ML）、硅微电子技术，以及量子算法和量子处理的出现。它们的交叉领域包括低功耗和低延迟边缘计算设备、异构加速器系统、可重构硬件、新型协同设计与综合策略、面向低温或高辐射环境的读出技术，以及模拟计算等研究方向。本白皮书提出了一个社区驱动的愿景，旨在识别并优先排序基于硬件的机器学习系统及其相应物理应用中的研究与开发机会，从而助力基础科学成功过渡到新的数据前沿。

articles.title: Three dimensional, spherically polarized magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 三维球面极化磁场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.04285v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Turbulence in the solar wind is characterized by Alfvénic fluctuations that exhibit spherical polarization, a geometric condition resulting in the nearly constant magnitude of the magnetic field. This property persists even during the largest field fluctuations, sometimes leading to local polarity reversals known as switchbacks. A longstanding question is whether three-dimensional smooth magnetic fields can simultaneously satisfy the constant-|bf B| constraint, and how such fields can be constructed analytically or numerically. Here we propose a new numerical method that allows to construct a magnetic field that is exactly spherically polarized, reproducing key features of solar wind fluctuations. Using this framework, we find evidence that discontinuities are unavoidable for generic three-dimensional configurations. Fundamentally, this implies that field rotations cannot maintain exactly constant |bf B| in an arbitrarily large spatial domain. Rather, field rotations with constant magnitude can exist in limited regions of space. We argue that these finite spatial domains are separated by discontinuities where a local departure from constant |bf B| is expected. These results provide insights into the structure of solar wind turbulence and more generally into the nature of nonlinear magnetic fluctuations in plasmas.
articles.abstract_zh: 太阳风湍流中的阿尔芬涨落通常表现出球面极化特征，即磁场模长近似保持不变，即使在强烈扰动下也可能出现局部极性反转（switchbacks）。本文提出一种新的数值方法，可构造严格球面极化的磁场，并再现太阳风涨落的关键特征。研究发现，对于一般的三维构型，不连续性似乎不可避免，这意味着磁场旋转不可能在任意大的空间区域内始终保持精确恒定的磁场强度。相反，恒模长旋转只能存在于有限空间区域，并由局部偏离恒定模长的间断面分隔。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 太阳风中的湍流以表现出球面偏振的阿尔芬涨落为特征，这是一种导致磁场大小几乎恒定的几何条件。即使在最大的磁场涨落期间，这一性质也会持续存在，有时会导致被称为“switchbacks”的局部极性反转。一个长期存在的问题是，三维光滑磁场是否能够同时满足恒定 |bf B| 的约束，以及如何以解析或数值方式构造这样的场。在这里，我们提出一种新的数值方法，能够构造一个严格球面偏振的磁场，并再现太阳风涨落的关键特征。利用这一框架，我们发现证据表明，对于一般的三维构型，不连续性是不可避免的。从根本上说，这意味着场旋转无法在任意大的空间区域内维持严格恒定的 |bf B|。相反，具有恒定大小的场旋转可以存在于有限的空间区域中。我们认为，这些有限空间区域由不连续面分隔，在这些不连续面处预期会出现局部偏离恒定 |bf B| 的情况。这些结果为太阳风湍流的结构提供了见解，并更一般地增进了对等离子体中非线性磁涨落本质的理解。

articles.title: On the existence of distinct equilibrium configurations under orienting external electric fields
articles.title_zh: 定向外电场下不同平衡构型的存在性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.08494v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Oriented external electric fields (OEEFs) are ubiquitous in chemistry; however, the effects of fields applied in different directions on molecular systems remain underexplored. A major challenge is that an applied field exerts a torque on a molecule, reorienting the molecular frame and complicating the interpretation of orientation-dependent electric-field effects. Thus, free polar molecules experience orienting rather than oriented fields, such that the field response drives the molecular orientation rather than the other way around. In this work, we explore a new regime of distinct molecular equilibrium configurations in the presence of OEEFs, differing in the relative direction of the external field and the molecular frame. While static dipole moments typically dominate molecular responses to external electric fields, these equilibria are enabled by exploiting molecular polarizability. These distinct "directomers" exhibit unique electronic and nuclear configurations, particularly in their low-lying excited states. We employ oriented electric field vectors referenced to a molecule-fixed principal axis frame along with hybrid analytical-numerical geometry optimization in order to explore the rotational potential energy surface (rPES), as well as a simply analytic model based on equilibrium electrical properties which captures the double-well character of the rPES, including some geometry relaxation effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究外加电场方向对分子体系平衡构型的影响，关注不同方向的定向外电场所诱导的差异。作者指出，自由极性分子在外电场中通常会发生取向响应，使问题从“有向电场”转化为“分子被电场重新定向”的情形。为此，论文探索了一类新的平衡构型：外电场与分子固定坐标系中的相对方向不同，但体系仍可形成稳定平衡。此类“directomer”主要依赖分子极化率而非永久偶极矩，并在低激发态中表现出独特的电子与核构型。
authors: Duc Anh Lai, Devin A. Matthews
articles.abstract_zh_full: 取向外电场（OEEFs）在化学中无处不在；然而，沿不同方向施加的电场对分子系统的影响仍然研究不足。一个主要挑战是，外加电场会对分子施加力矩，使分子坐标系重新取向，并使对取向依赖性电场效应的解释复杂化。因此，自由极性分子经历的是具有取向作用而非固定取向的电场，使得场响应驱动分子取向，而不是分子取向反过来决定场响应。在这项工作中，我们探索了在 OEEFs 存在下不同分子平衡构型的一种新区域，这些构型在外电场与分子坐标系的相对方向上不同。虽然静态偶极矩通常主导分子对外电场的响应，但这些平衡态是通过利用分子极化率而得以实现的。这些不同的“directomers”表现出独特的电子构型和核构型，尤其是在其低能激发态中。我们采用相对于分子固定主轴坐标系定义的取向电场向量，并结合混合解析—数值几何优化来探索旋转势能面（rPES），同时还使用一个基于平衡电学性质的简单解析模型，该模型能够捕捉 rPES 的双阱特征，包括某些几何弛豫效应。

articles.title: Multimodal Surface EMG Hand Gesture Recognition Using Query-Based Transformers for Prosthetic Control
articles.title_zh: 基于查询式 Transformer 的多模态表面肌电手势识别用于假肢控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hand gesture recognition via surface electromyography (sEMG) is fundamental to prosthetic control. In this field, deep learning approaches have become the gold standard. However, current architectures struggle to scale; model performance typically decreases as the number of hand movements increases. Performance degradation is tied to the increased statistical complexity of decoding expanded gesture sets and compounded by the limitations of state-of-the-art methods, which primarily rely on low-latency unimodal convolutional architectures. Convolutions operate locally, limiting model's ability to capture long-range sequential patterns. Unimodal setups cannot leverage complementary information from coordinated signals characterizing movement execution, such as inertial and eye-tracking data. These limitations motivate architectures that integrate local and global features across multimodal physiological sequences. To bridge this gap, this study introduces EMG-CrossFormer, an end-to-end hybrid convolutional-transformer for seamless multimodal integration. EMG-CrossFormer combines representations from an arbitrary number of unimodal encoders through cascaded cross-attention fusion layers, and decodes the fused representations using learnable gesture queries. EMG-CrossFormer was evaluated on four NinaPro datasets (DB2, DB3, DB7, and DB10) and benchmarked against six state-of-the-art models using an increasing number of modalities. Using only sEMG, EMG-CrossFormer achieved mean accuracies of 72.33%, 52.48%, 79.16%, and 73.49% on DB2, DB3, DB7, and DB10, respectively. Incorporating inertial signals improved performance to 90.66%, 80.40%, 92.79%, and 92.06%. These results show that joint local-global feature modeling improves sEMG-only decoding and that multimodal fusion substantially amplifies this benefit, underscoring the value of both design principles for complex hand gesture recognition.
articles.abstract_zh: 表面肌电（sEMG）手势识别是实现假肢控制的关键技术之一，但现有深度学习模型在手势类别增多时往往难以保持性能。本文指出，传统卷积结构主要捕捉局部信息，难以建模长程序列依赖，而单模态方案又无法充分利用惯性、眼动等互补生理信号。为此，作者提出 EMG-CrossFormer，一种端到端的混合卷积-Transformer 架构，用于融合多个模态的生理序列信息。该方法旨在兼顾局部特征与全局依赖，从而提升复杂手势识别能力。
authors: Federico Del Pup, Elisa Tentori, Manfredo Atzori
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过表面肌电（sEMG）进行手势识别是假肢控制的基础。在这一领域，深度学习方法已经成为黄金标准。然而，当前架构难以扩展；随着手部动作数量的增加，模型性能通常会下降。性能退化与解码扩展手势集合所带来的统计复杂性增加有关，并且还受到最先进方法局限性的叠加影响，这些方法主要依赖低延迟的单模态卷积架构。卷积在局部范围内运行，限制了模型捕捉长程序列模式的能力。单模态设置无法利用表征运动执行的协同信号中的互补信息，例如惯性数据和眼动追踪数据。这些限制促使人们需要能够在多模态生理序列中整合局部和全局特征的架构。为弥合这一差距，本研究提出 EMG-CrossFormer，这是一种端到端的混合卷积—Transformer，用于无缝多模态整合。EMG-CrossFormer 通过级联交叉注意力融合层组合来自任意数量单模态编码器的表示，并使用可学习的手势查询对融合表示进行解码。EMG-CrossFormer 在四个 NinaPro 数据集（DB2、DB3、DB7 和 DB10）上进行了评估，并在逐步增加模态数量的情况下与六种最先进模型进行了基准比较。仅使用 sEMG 时，EMG-CrossFormer 在 DB2、DB3、DB7 和 DB10 上分别取得了 72.33%、52.48%、79.16% 和 73.49% 的平均准确率。加入惯性信号后，性能分别提高到 90.66%、80.40%、92.79% 和 92.06%。这些结果表明，联合的局部—全局特征建模改善了仅基于 sEMG 的解码，而多模态融合显著放大了这一收益，凸显了这两项设计原则对于复杂手势识别的价值。

articles.title: From Hybrid Mechanistic--Data-Driven Modeling Toward Neuro-Symbolic AI: What, Why, and How
articles.title_zh: 从混合机理—数据驱动建模走向神经符号人工智能：是什么、为何以及如何实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid mechanistic/data-driven models, which combine first-principles with learned components, are increasingly used in process engineering and scientific machine learning. Common hybrid modeling designs are specified primarily through their architectures and training losses, which offers a limited basis for a shared semantic interface to compare or verify them across domains, with comparatively little attention paid to epistemic uncertainty in the mechanistic part. We bridge hybrid modeling and neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI by reconstructing these designs as instances of NeSy interface. The resulting translation, Hybrid-to-NeSy (H2N), places mechanistic knowledge on the language side, learned modules on the belief side, and validity domains together with constraints on the logic side. For each design, H2N then yields an explicit NeSy inference functional and a logic-belief decomposition. From this decomposition we derive two metrics: structural violation rate (SVR), measuring whether the learned belief respects the mechanistic structure; and belief dispersion (BD), measuring how concentrated the learned plausibility is, serving as a hybrid model's epistemic uncertainty in its mechanistic part. We instantiate H2N on a case study of a structured hybrid model for binary classification under label noise and show that models with higher SVR and BD exhibit greater variability in held-out accuracy. Under structural distribution shift, H2N further quantifies a model's uncertainty during extrapolations, whereas test accuracy reveals the same shift only post hoc.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将混合机理/数据驱动模型与神经符号人工智能联系起来的统一视角。作者将常见的混合建模设计重构为神经符号接口中的实例：把机理知识视为语言侧，学习模块视为信念侧，并将有效域与约束置于逻辑侧。基于这一“Hybrid-to-NeSy”转换框架，论文给出了显式的神经符号推理函数与逻辑—信念分解，并据此定义结构违背率（SVR）和信念离散度（BD）等指标。该工作旨在为跨领域比较、验证和解释混合模型提供更统一的语义基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合机理/数据驱动模型将第一性原理与学习得到的组件相结合，正越来越多地用于过程工程和科学机器学习。常见的混合建模设计主要通过其架构和训练损失来规定，这为跨领域比较或验证它们提供的共享语义接口基础有限，同时对机理部分的认识不确定性关注相对较少。我们通过将这些设计重构为神经符号（NeSy）接口的实例，来连接混合建模与神经符号人工智能。由此得到的转换称为 Hybrid-to-NeSy（H2N），它将机理知识置于语言侧，将学习模块置于信念侧，并将有效性域连同约束置于逻辑侧。对于每一种设计，H2N 随后给出一个显式的 NeSy 推理泛函以及一个逻辑—信念分解。根据这一分解，我们推导出两个指标：结构违背率（SVR），用于衡量学习到的信念是否遵守机理结构；以及信念离散度（BD），用于衡量学习到的合理性有多集中，并作为混合模型在其机理部分中的认识不确定性。我们在一个带标签噪声的二分类结构化混合模型案例研究中实例化 H2N，并表明具有更高 SVR 和 BD 的模型在留出集准确率上表现出更大的变异性。在结构分布偏移下，H2N 进一步量化了模型在外推过程中的不确定性，而测试准确率只能事后揭示同样的偏移。

articles.title: Verbalized Particle Posterior: Bayesian Inference over Natural Language Hypotheses
articles.title_zh: 语言化粒子后验：基于自然语言假设的贝叶斯推断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Verbalized Machine Learning (VML) parameterizes a model as a natural-language prompt that an LLM evaluates as f(x; theta). The framework is interpretable, but it commits to a single hypothesis with no measure of uncertainty, and that hypothesis varies substantially across optimization runs on the same data. We propose the Verbalized Particle Posterior (VPP), which treats verbalized learning as a Bayesian inference problem: maintain a population of natural-language hypotheses as particles, update them with Metropolis-Hastings (VPP-MH) or Sequential Monte Carlo (VPP-SMC), and predict by Bayesian model averaging. Both algorithms treat the LLM as a black box, requiring no access to logits or gradients. A distinctive consequence follows. In classical Bayesian learning, model selection sits outside the posterior; in VPP both model structure and parameters share a single language space, and the posterior ranges over both. We evaluate VPP on regression, classification, and rule-discovery benchmarks. It improves over a single VML run on every benchmark and matches or exceeds an oracle-best ensemble of independent VML runs on most, while eliminating the catastrophic single-run failures that VML occasionally produces. Because each particle is a human-readable hypothesis, the posterior is itself something a reader can inspect, seeing in plain text which explanations the data supported and which it ruled out.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Verbalized Particle Posterior（VPP），将语言化机器学习视为一个贝叶斯推断问题。方法通过维护一组自然语言假设粒子，并使用 Metropolis-Hastings 或序贯蒙特卡洛进行更新，再通过贝叶斯模型平均完成预测。与单次语言化学习不同，VPP 同时对模型结构和参数进行后验建模，且无需访问语言模型的 logits 或梯度。实验表明，该方法在回归、分类和规则发现任务上均优于单次 VML 运行，并在多数基准上达到或超过独立 VML 集成的最佳表现。
authors: Yan Zhang, Shikan Lian, Shibo Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 语言化机器学习（VML）将模型参数化为一个自然语言提示，由大型语言模型将其评估为 f(x; theta)。该框架具有可解释性，但它承诺的是一个单一假设，没有不确定性度量，并且该假设在相同数据上的不同优化运行之间会有很大变化。我们提出语言化粒子后验（VPP），它将语言化学习视为一个贝叶斯推断问题：维护一组作为粒子的自然语言假设，用 Metropolis-Hastings（VPP-MH）或序贯蒙特卡洛（VPP-SMC）对其进行更新，并通过贝叶斯模型平均进行预测。两种算法都将大型语言模型视为黑箱，不需要访问 logits 或梯度。由此产生一个独特的结果。在经典贝叶斯学习中，模型选择位于后验之外；而在 VPP 中，模型结构和参数共享同一个语言空间，后验同时覆盖二者。我们在回归、分类和规则发现基准上评估 VPP。它在每个基准上都优于单次 VML 运行，并且在多数基准上匹配或超过由独立 VML 运行组成的 oracle-best 集成，同时消除了 VML 偶尔产生的灾难性单次运行失败。由于每个粒子都是人类可读的假设，后验本身就是读者可以检查的对象，读者能够以明文形式看到数据支持了哪些解释、排除了哪些解释。

articles.title: Generalization bounds and sample complexity for remaining useful life prediction from complete degradation trajectories
articles.title_zh: 基于完整退化轨迹的剩余寿命预测的泛化界与样本复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data-driven remaining useful life (RUL) prediction requires complete degradation trajectories for training, yet such run-to-failure data are scarce and expensive. Practitioners currently lack principled guidance on how many failure examples suffice for a given model and accuracy target. This paper develops a sample complexity framework for RUL prediction comprising seven main results organised around three themes. First, we establish fundamental learning rates: a distribution-free generalization bound shows that the uniform deviation of the mean squared error decreases as O(B²sqrtp/n), where p is the model complexity and n the number of trajectories, and a minimax lower bound proves that the Θ(p/n) rate is unimprovable.} e̊v{Second, we quantify how domain knowledge accelerates learning: incorporating degradation physics reduces data requirements by up to two orders of magnitude for deep networks, a Bernstein-type analysis achieves the minimax-optimal O(p/n) rate under high signal-to-noise conditions, and closed-form penalties reveal when an incorrectly assumed physics model hurts rather than helps. Third, we characterise the impact of data quality: fleet variability induces an irreducible bias-variance tradeoff, while right-censored observations suffer an efficiency loss that depends critically on the degradation class.} Closed-form expressions are provided for exponential, power-law, and stretched-exponential degradation. e̊v{Cross-domain validation against published turbofan, battery, and bearing benchmarks confirms the theoretical predictions within a factor of 2-3 on average. The results yield practical guidelines for planning data collection, selecting model complexity, and evaluating physics model assumptions in prognostics applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对数据驱动剩余寿命（RUL）预测中训练数据稀缺的问题，建立了样本复杂度与泛化分析框架。作者从分布无关泛化界、最小极大下界以及引入退化物理先验后的学习加速等角度，系统研究了完成退化轨迹对样本需求的影响。结果表明，加入退化机理可显著降低数据需求，而在高信噪比条件下可获得最优阶的学习率；同时，若物理模型设定错误，反而可能损害性能。论文还进一步讨论了其他因素对学习过程的作用，完整结论需参见原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数据驱动的剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测需要完整退化轨迹用于训练，然而这类运行至失效的数据稀缺且昂贵。实践者目前缺乏有原则的指导，以判断对于给定模型和精度目标需要多少失效样本。本文为 RUL 预测建立了一个样本复杂度框架，该框架包括围绕三个主题组织的七个主要结果。首先，我们建立了基本学习速率：一个分布无关的泛化界表明，均方误差的一致偏差按 O(B²sqrtp/n) 下降，其中 p 是模型复杂度，n 是轨迹数量；同时，一个极小极大下界证明 Θ(p/n) 速率是不可改进的。其次，我们量化了领域知识如何加速学习：纳入退化物理可使深度网络的数据需求最多降低两个数量级；在高信噪比条件下，Bernstein 型分析达到极小极大最优的 O(p/n) 速率；闭式惩罚项揭示了错误假设的物理模型何时会有害而非有益。第三，我们刻画了数据质量的影响：机群变异性引入不可约的偏差—方差权衡，而右删失观测会遭受效率损失，其程度关键取决于退化类别。文中为指数退化、幂律退化和拉伸指数退化提供了闭式表达。与已发表的涡扇、电池和轴承基准进行的跨领域验证表明，理论预测平均在 2—3 倍因子范围内得到确认。这些结果为预测性维护应用中的数据采集规划、模型复杂度选择以及物理模型假设评估提供了实用指南。

articles.title: Extending Fourier Neural Operators for Modeling Parameterized and Coupled PDEs
articles.title_zh: 用于参数化与耦合偏微分方程建模的傅里叶神经算子扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parameterized and coupled partial differential equations (PDEs) are central to modeling phenomena in science and engineering, yet neural operator methods that address both aspects remain limited. We extend Fourier neural operators (FNOs) with minimal architectural modifications along two directions. For parameterized dynamics, we propose a hypernetwork-based modulation that conditions the operator on physical parameters. For coupled systems, we conduct a systematic exploration of architectural choices, examining how operator components can be adapted to balance shared structure with cross-variable interactions while retaining the efficiency of standard FNOs. Evaluations on benchmark PDEs, including the one-dimensional capacitively coupled plasma equations and the Gray-Scott system, show that our methods achieve up to 55-72% lower errors than strong baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of principled modulation and systematic design exploration.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对傅里叶神经算子（FNO）进行小幅结构扩展，以同时处理参数化 PDE 和耦合 PDE 两类问题。针对参数化动力学，作者提出基于超网络的调制机制，使算子能够条件化于物理参数；针对耦合系统，则系统考察了共享结构与变量间交互之间的建模方式。作者在一维电容耦合等离子体方程和 Gray-Scott 系统等基准上进行了验证。结果显示，该方法相较强基线可将误差降低 55% 至 72%，说明原则性调制与结构设计搜索十分有效。
authors: Cheng Jing, Uvini Balasuriya Mudiyanselage, Abhishek Verma, Kallol Bera, Shahid Rauf, Kookjin Lee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 参数化和耦合偏微分方程（PDEs）是科学与工程中建模现象的核心，但能够同时处理这两个方面的神经算子方法仍然有限。我们沿两个方向以最小的架构修改扩展傅里叶神经算子（FNOs）。对于参数化动力学，我们提出一种基于超网络的调制方法，使算子以物理参数为条件。对于耦合系统，我们对架构选择进行了系统探索，考察如何调整算子组件，以在保持标准 FNO 效率的同时平衡共享结构与跨变量相互作用。在包括一维电容耦合等离子体方程和 Gray-Scott 系统在内的基准 PDE 上的评估表明，我们的方法相较强基线实现了高达 55—72% 的误差降低，展示了有原则的调制和系统化设计探索的有效性。

articles.title: Topological Data Analysis and Graph-Theoretic Approaches for Tennis Match Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于网球比赛预测的拓扑数据分析与图论方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present two approaches for predicting tennis match outcomes using topological data analysis and graph theory on ATP singles matches from 2000-2025. The first method applies lower-star filtration to player competitive networks, extracting topological features through persistent homology using four summary methods (VAB, HNAV, HWNAV, OW-HNPV) combined with Modified Band Depth analysis. Algorithmic optimizations including ego graph approximations and triangle elimination enable analysis of about 66k matches. Our Random Forest model achieves 66.2% accuracy (AUC = 0.719) using topological, graph-theoretic, and ranking features. Feature importance analysis reveals that rankings contribute 36.3%, centralities 25.5%, and TDA features 24.0%, with topological features providing complementary signal. When rankings are unavailable, the topology-only model maintains 63.56% accuracy, demonstrating that network-derived features alone capture meaningful competitive structure. The second method uses a modified Katz similarity index with temporal edge weighting, achieving 62.48% accuracy on held-out test data. This work represents the first application of lower-star filtration to tennis prediction, provides systematic comparison of four topological summary methods in sports analytics, and demonstrates that TDA can achieve above-chance prediction using network topology alone while providing additional value when combined with traditional features.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于 2000 至 2025 年 ATP 单打比赛数据，提出两种结合拓扑数据分析与图论的方法来预测网球比赛结果。第一种方法对球员竞争网络进行 lower-star filtration，并通过持久同调及多种摘要方式提取拓扑特征，同时结合图中心性和排名等信息，随机森林模型达到 66.2% 的准确率。特征分析显示，排名、中心性和拓扑特征均提供了有效信息；即使不使用排名，纯拓扑模型仍能保持较高性能。第二种方法采用带时间权重的改进 Katz 相似度，在测试集上取得 62.48% 的准确率，说明网络结构特征对比赛预测具有补充价值。
authors: Jake Schwaderer, Alexander Bastien, Omid Khormali, Alejandro Navarrete, Mia Pesavento, Angelika Elderbrook
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了两种方法，使用拓扑数据分析和图论对 2000—2025 年 ATP 单打比赛的网球比赛结果进行预测。第一种方法将 lower-star 滤波应用于球员竞争网络，利用四种汇总方法（VAB、HNAV、HWNAV、OW-HNPV）并结合 Modified Band Depth 分析，通过持久同调提取拓扑特征。包括自我图近似和三角形消除在内的算法优化使得约 6.6 万场比赛的分析成为可能。我们的随机森林模型使用拓扑特征、图论特征和排名特征，达到 66.2% 的准确率（AUC = 0.719）。特征重要性分析显示，排名贡献 36.3%，中心性贡献 25.5%，TDA 特征贡献 24.0%，其中拓扑特征提供了互补信号。当排名不可用时，仅使用拓扑的模型仍保持 63.56% 的准确率，表明仅由网络导出的特征就能捕捉有意义的竞技结构。第二种方法使用带时间边权的改进 Katz 相似性指数，在留出测试数据上达到 62.48% 的准确率。这项工作是 lower-star 滤波在网球预测中的首次应用，提供了体育分析中四种拓扑汇总方法的系统比较，并证明 TDA 能够仅使用网络拓扑实现高于随机水平的预测，同时在与传统特征结合时提供额外价值。

articles.title: On the post-hoc Evaluation of PDE Discovery: A Multifaceted Challenge of Scientific Advancement
articles.title_zh: 偏微分方程发现的事后评估：科学进展中的多维挑战
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE) discovery aims to identify from data the governing law of a physical system. Constituting a cornerstone of scientific advancement, it has become during the past decade a major line of research in the rapidly evolving field of Physics-informed Machine Learning (PiML). Among the remaining open problems to address in this domain, the post-hoc evaluation of discovered PDEs raises the particular difficulty of being multifaceted. Indeed, it requires jointly considering predictive accuracy, physical consistency, interpretability, and out-of-distribution generalization capacity. Given that some of these properties are conflicting, it is worth noting that the wide range of existing evaluation metrics only partially address the overall problem, potentially leading to overly interpreted conclusions about the validity of a presumed new physical theory. From an abundant literature spanning machine learning, numerical analysis, information theory or symbolic regression, we propose, to our knowledge, the first taxonomy of PDE evaluation metrics, and discuss their advantages and limitations in depth. Based on the observation that evaluation is often achieved on a case-by-case basis and that a universally accepted methodology remains elusive, we further provide recommendations with the aim of promoting standardized and reliable practices, before sketching promising future lines of research in this field. We argue that this paper is intended both for ML experts who design new PDE discovery algorithms and for users of these methods aiming, in real applications, to discover and validate well-founded scientific laws.
articles.abstract_zh: 偏微分方程（PDE）发现旨在从数据中识别描述物理系统演化的基本方程，近年已成为物理信息机器学习中的重要方向。本文指出，已发现PDE的事后评估具有多维性，需要同时考虑预测精度、物理一致性、可解释性和分布外泛化能力，而这些性质之间往往存在冲突。作者基于机器学习、数值分析、信息论和符号回归等领域的文献，提出了PDE评估指标的首个分类体系，并系统讨论其优缺点与局限。
authors: Baptiste Mathevon, Farah Cherfaoui, Amaury Habrard, Marc Sebban
articles.abstract_zh_full: 偏微分方程（PDE）发现旨在从数据中识别物理系统的控制规律。作为科学进步的基石，它在过去十年中已成为快速发展的物理信息机器学习（PiML）领域中的一条主要研究方向。在该领域仍待解决的开放问题中，已发现 PDE 的事后评估提出了一个特别困难的问题，因为它具有多面性。事实上，它要求联合考虑预测准确性、物理一致性、可解释性以及分布外泛化能力。鉴于其中一些性质相互冲突，值得注意的是，现有广泛的评估指标仅部分解决了整体问题，可能导致对某个假定的新物理理论的有效性作出过度解释的结论。基于跨越机器学习、数值分析、信息论和符号回归等领域的丰富文献，我们提出了据我们所知首个 PDE 评估指标分类体系，并深入讨论了它们的优势和局限。基于评估往往以个案方式完成且普遍接受的方法论仍难以形成这一观察，我们进一步提出建议，旨在促进标准化且可靠的实践，然后勾勒该领域有前景的未来研究方向。我们认为，本文既面向设计新的 PDE 发现算法的机器学习专家，也面向这些方法的用户，即那些希望在实际应用中发现并验证有坚实依据的科学规律的人。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Predicting Nitrous Oxide Flux
articles.title_zh: 用于预测氧化亚氮通量的物理信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23880v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nitrous oxide (N₂O) is the dominant ozone-depleting substance emitted in the 21st century, and the third largest contributor to anthropogenic greenhouse gases due to its high potency and long atmospheric lifetime, with more than 70% of N₂O emissions occurring as a result of agricultural processes. Current approaches to predicting N₂O flux emissions include process-based models such as DayCent and Cycles, as well as classical AI models, but the application of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to predicting N₂O flux emissions is largely underexplored. Our paper draws upon the mechanistic equations that underlie the DayCent family of process-based models to construct a rigorously derived, literature-traceable physics residual. We then build and train an MLP-based PINN on a multi-site agricultural dataset spanning four geographically distinct US agricultural sites. Across all tested values of the physics loss weighting hyperparameter łambda, our PINN consistently and substantially outperformed uncalibrated Cycles simulation (R²⁼⁰.01), with our MLP baseline achieving mean R²⁼⁰.411 across ten random seeds.
