Physics constraints consistently degrade model performance in holdout validation, with marginal degradation at low łambda and significant degradation at high łambda, but consistently improve model performance and reduce performance variability in leave-one-site-out validation. This suggests that physics constraints sacrifice in-distribution accuracy for out-of-distribution robustness, anchoring the model toward biogeochemically plausible behavior on unfamiliar soil conditions --- though cross-site generalization remains challenging, with negative R² across all seeds and łambda values on our geographically distinct held-out site.
articles.abstract_zh: 氧化亚氮是重要的温室气体和臭氧消耗物质，农业活动是其主要排放来源之一。本文基于DayCent家族过程模型中的机理方程，构建了可追溯的物理残差，并在覆盖美国四个农业站点的多站点数据集上训练了基于MLP的PINN。实验表明，该方法在不同物理损失权重下均明显优于未校准的Cycles模拟，并优于纯数据驱动的基线模型。
authors: Freddy Yu, Jashanjeet Kaur Dhaliwal, Subhadeep Chakraborty
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一氧化二氮（N₂O）是 21 世纪排放的主要臭氧消耗物质，并且由于其高效力和较长的大气寿命，是人为温室气体的第三大贡献者，其中超过 70% 的 N₂O 排放来自农业过程。当前预测 N₂O 通量排放的方法包括 DayCent 和 Cycles 等过程模型，以及经典人工智能模型，但将物理信息神经网络（PINNs）应用于 N₂O 通量排放预测在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。我们的论文借鉴 DayCent 系列过程模型所依据的机理方程，构建了一个严格推导且可追溯到文献的物理残差。随后，我们在一个覆盖美国四个地理上不同农业站点的多站点农业数据集上构建并训练了基于 MLP 的 PINN。在所有测试的物理损失权重超参数 λ 取值下，我们的 PINN 都持续且显著地优于未经校准的 Cycles 模拟（R²=0.01），其中我们的 MLP 基线在十个随机种子上的平均 R²=0.411。物理约束在留出验证中持续降低模型性能，在低 λ 下退化较小，在高 λ 下退化显著，但在留一站点验证中持续改善模型性能并降低性能变异性。这表明物理约束以牺牲分布内准确性为代价换取分布外稳健性，使模型在不熟悉的土壤条件下被锚定到生物地球化学上合理的行为；不过跨站点泛化仍然具有挑战性，在地理上不同的留出站点上，所有随机种子和 λ 取值下的 R² 均为负值。

articles.title: Variational Boosting for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 用于物理信息神经网络的变分提升方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23940v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) solve differential equations by minimizing the residual of a nonlinear operator over a neural parameterization of the solution. However, monolithic PINNs often suffer from ill-conditioning, spectral bias, and optimization instability. We introduce a variational boosting framework in which solutions are constructed additively in function space. Each stage trains a weak learner whose converged correction satisfies a local orthogonality condition, equivalent to a projected functional gradient descent step onto the tangent space of the network's function manifold. Because each correction network is deliberately small, the restricted minimization admits full Newton or conjugate gradient updates, which are typically infeasible in large PINNs. The resulting method separates global nonlinear refinement into a sequence of well-conditioned subproblems while preserving the full variational structure of the operator. This framework provides a geometric interpretation of multi-stage PINNs as projected functional gradient descent and enables stable second-order optimization for nonlinear differential equations.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络通过最小化非线性算子的残差来求解微分方程，但单体式PINN常面临病态、频谱偏置和优化不稳定等问题。本文提出一种变分提升框架，将解表示为函数空间中的逐步加性构造，每一阶段训练一个弱学习器，并满足局部正交条件。该方法可解释为投影到网络函数流形切空间上的功能梯度下降，并使原本难以在大规模PINN中使用的牛顿法或共轭梯度法成为可行。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通过在解的神经参数化上最小化非线性算子的残差来求解微分方程。然而，单体 PINNs 往往遭受病态条件、谱偏差和优化不稳定性的影响。我们引入一种变分提升框架，在该框架中，解在函数空间中以加性方式构造。每一阶段训练一个弱学习器，其收敛后的校正满足局部正交条件，这等价于投影到网络函数流形切空间上的投影泛函梯度下降步骤。由于每个校正网络被有意设计得很小，受限最小化允许使用完整牛顿法或共轭梯度更新，而这些方法在大型 PINNs 中通常不可行。由此得到的方法将全局非线性细化分解为一系列条件良好的子问题，同时保留算子的完整变分结构。该框架为多阶段 PINNs 提供了作为投影泛函梯度下降的几何解释，并使非线性微分方程的稳定二阶优化成为可能。

articles.title: Capacity-Aware Deep Learning for Generalizable Traffic Volume Estimation Across Links and Cities
articles.title_zh: 面向跨路段与跨城市泛化的容量感知深度学习交通流量估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Network-wide traffic volume estimation typically relies on propagating measurements from fixed sensors, making performance highly dependent on sensor density and limiting deployment in sparsely instrumented networks. We propose a link-level learning framework that estimates hourly traffic volumes from widely available territorial data only, including probe speed profiles, road and topological descriptors, along with weather observations. A supervised local mapping is learned from sparse sensor measurements and evaluated under two generalization settings: intra-network (unseen links within the training network) and inter-network (unseen city). This formulation frames traffic volume estimation as a spatial out-of-distribution generalization problem under sparse supervision. To enhance spatial robustness, we introduce a capacity-aware formulation that models volume as the product of a link-specific structural capacity and an hourly regime-aware utilization ratio, embedding traffic-theoretic constraints directly into the learning process. Extensive experiments in both generalization settings demonstrate that the proposed structural constraints consistently outperform a state-of-the-art baseline under spatial distribution shift.
articles.abstract_zh: 网络级交通流量估计通常依赖固定传感器的测量传播，因此性能高度受传感器密度影响，难以在稀疏部署场景中使用。本文提出一种路段级学习框架，仅利用广域可得的地理与道路拓扑信息、探测车速特征及天气观测来估计小时交通流量，并在网络内和跨城市两种分布外泛化设置下评估。为增强空间鲁棒性，作者进一步引入容量感知建模，将流量表示为结构容量与时变利用率的乘积，从而把交通机理约束嵌入学习过程。
authors: Léo Hein, Giovanni De Nunzio, Aurélie Pirayre, Laurent Najman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全网络交通流量估计通常依赖于从固定传感器传播测量值，这使得性能高度依赖传感器密度，并限制了其在传感器稀疏部署网络中的应用。我们提出一种路段级学习框架，仅从广泛可得的地域数据估计小时交通流量，这些数据包括探针速度剖面、道路与拓扑描述符以及天气观测。该方法从稀疏传感器测量中学习一个有监督的局部映射，并在两种泛化设置下进行评估：网络内泛化（训练网络中的未见路段）和网络间泛化（未见城市）。这一表述将交通流量估计刻画为稀疏监督下的空间分布外泛化问题。为增强空间稳健性，我们引入一种容量感知表述，将流量建模为路段特定结构容量与小时级、状态感知利用率的乘积，从而把交通理论约束直接嵌入学习过程。在两种泛化设置中的大量实验表明，所提出的结构约束在空间分布偏移下始终优于最先进基线。

articles.title: Learning Reusable Hybrid Motion Priors for Humanoid Locomotion from Motion Imitation
articles.title_zh: 从动作模仿中学习可复用的混合运动先验以用于类人机器人行走
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning can produce robust humanoid controllers, but each new task is typically trained as a separate policy with its own reward design and training process. Motion imitation provides an alternative source of motor competence by training policies to track retargeted human motions, yet the resulting controllers remain reference trackers and are not directly usable as task policies. We propose a three-stage pipeline that turns motion-imitation skills into a reusable hybrid motion prior (HMP) for humanoid locomotion. First, an expert policy is trained to imitate retargeted human motion-capture clips. Second, the expert is distilled into a frozen architecture composed of a proprioceptive encoder, a residual vector-quantized (RVQ) codebook, and an action decoder. Third, task-level policies are trained to solve locomotion tasks by selecting discrete codebook entries while the HMP remains frozen. We evaluate the method on velocity tracking, point-goal navigation, and fall-recovery velocity tracking in simulation, and deploy the velocity-tracking policy on a real Unitree G1 robot. The distillation process preserves the tracking behavior of the expert, while the resulting HMP can be reused without retraining as the action interface for different downstream locomotion policies. The learned HMP reveals an interpretable codebook structure in which the number of active RVQ stages modulates the available gait patterns. We further show that training the codebook with the rotation trick improves latent organization and reduces downstream falls compared with a standard straight-through estimator.
articles.abstract_zh: 强化学习可以训练出鲁棒的类人机器人控制器，但不同任务通常需要分别设计奖励并独立训练。本文提出一个三阶段流程，将动作模仿得到的技能转化为可复用的混合运动先验（HMP）：先训练专家策略模仿重定向的人类动作捕捉片段，再将其蒸馏为包含本体感知编码器、残差向量量化码本和动作解码器的冻结结构，最后让任务策略通过选择离散码本条目来完成下游任务。该方法在速度跟踪、目标点导航和跌倒恢复等任务上进行了验证，并将速度跟踪策略部署到真实的Unitree G1机器人上。
authors: Valerio Belli (UNIROMA, UCL), Valerio Modugno (UCL), Enrico Mingo Hoffman (HUCEBOT), Fabio Amadio (HUCEBOT)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强化学习可以产生稳健的人形机器人控制器，但每个新任务通常都作为一个独立策略进行训练，并具有自己的奖励设计和训练过程。运动模仿通过训练策略跟踪重定向后的人类运动，提供了另一种运动能力来源，然而所得控制器仍然是参考跟踪器，不能直接作为任务策略使用。我们提出一种三阶段流程，将运动模仿技能转化为用于人形机器人运动的可复用混合运动先验（HMP）。首先，训练一个专家策略来模仿重定向后的人体运动捕捉片段。其次，将该专家蒸馏为一个冻结架构，该架构由本体感受编码器、残差向量量化（RVQ）码本和动作解码器组成。第三，训练任务级策略，通过选择离散码本条目来解决运动任务，同时HMP保持冻结。我们在仿真中对速度跟踪、点目标导航和跌倒恢复速度跟踪进行评估，并在真实Unitree G1机器人上部署速度跟踪策略。蒸馏过程保留了专家的跟踪行为，而所得HMP无需重新训练即可作为不同下游运动策略的动作接口复用。学习到的HMP呈现出可解释的码本结构，其中活跃RVQ阶段的数量调节可用步态模式。我们进一步表明，与标准直通估计器相比，使用旋转技巧训练码本可改善潜在空间组织，并减少下游任务中的跌倒。

articles.title: Perturbative-NeuSA: A Structured Spectral Framework for Time-Dependent PDEs
articles.title_zh: Perturbative-NeuSA：面向时变PDE的结构化频谱框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24345v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural spectral PDE solvers often learn an entire unresolved vector field even when an inexpensive approximate model can already capture most of the trajectory. Here we introduce Perturbative-NeuSA, a residual formulation that decomposes the target solution into a low-fidelity background and a high-resolution perturbation, so that only the unresolved dynamics is learned. Starting from the exact perturbation equation, the method combines a fixed spectral operator, a background-dependent correction, the background defect in the target PDE, and an optional neural closure. This construction makes the roles of physical structure and neural closure separately measurable. Across 2D Burgers, Klein-Gordon, and heterogeneous 2D wave equations, the deterministic structured solver outperforms the trained NeuSA baseline while requiring no neural-network training. The largest gains occur on Burgers, where the deterministic correction reduces training and extrapolation errors by factors of 24 and 44, respectively. In addition, a Klein-Gordon sweep over seven background resolutions shows that the effect of the closure is conditional: it improves a poor background by 3.6 times, becomes neutral at intermediate resolutions, and degrades a well-resolved background. For the wave equation, however, the closure provides an additional 18% reduction when the remaining residual is interface-localized. Multi-initial-condition diagnostics further show that the useful closure regime depends on the initial-condition spectrum and can disappear in extrapolation when structured correction already captures the dominant Burgers dynamics. Perturbative-NeuSA therefore reframes neural closure as a conditional, diagnosable correction governed by background fidelity, residual organization, and compatibility with the closure model.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经频谱PDE求解器往往需要学习整个未知向量场，但在许多情况下，一个低成本的近似模型已经可以刻画大部分轨迹。本文提出Perturbative-NeuSA，将目标解分解为低保真背景与高分辨率扰动，仅学习未解析的动力学部分。基于精确的扰动方程，该方法将固定频谱算子、依赖背景的修正项、目标PDE中的背景缺陷以及可选的神经闭合项结合起来，从而使物理结构与神经补偿的作用可以被分别衡量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经谱PDE求解器常常学习整个未解析向量场，即使一个廉价的近似模型已经能够捕获大部分轨迹。本文引入Perturbative-NeuSA，这是一种残差表述，将目标解分解为低保真背景和高分辨率扰动，从而只学习未解析动力学。从精确扰动方程出发，该方法结合固定谱算子、背景相关修正、目标PDE中的背景缺陷以及可选的神经闭合。这一构造使物理结构和神经闭合的作用能够被分别测量。在二维Burgers方程、Klein-Gordon方程和非均匀二维波动方程上，确定性结构化求解器优于训练后的NeuSA基线，同时不需要神经网络训练。最大增益出现在Burgers方程上，其中确定性修正分别将训练误差和外推误差降低了24倍和44倍。此外，对Klein-Gordon方程在七种背景分辨率上的扫描显示，闭合的作用是有条件的：它使较差背景提升3.6倍，在中等分辨率下变为中性，并会使解析良好的背景变差。然而，对于波动方程，当剩余残差局域于界面时，闭合额外带来18%的误差降低。多初始条件诊断进一步表明，有用的闭合区域取决于初始条件谱，并且当结构化修正已经捕获主导的Burgers动力学时，在外推中可能消失。因此，Perturbative-NeuSA将神经闭合重新表述为一种有条件、可诊断的修正，其受背景保真度、残差组织以及与闭合模型兼容性的支配。

articles.title: UNIFUSION: Adapting Autoregressive Language Models into Discrete Diffusion under a Unified Reverse-Rate Objective
articles.title_zh: UNIFUSION：在统一反向速率目标下将自回归语言模型适配为离散扩散模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24507v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing methods mainly adapt pretrained autoregressive (AR) language models to masked diffusion, whereas we directly adapt them to uniform-noise diffusion, where every token remains editable during sampling. However, adapting AR checkpoints across corruption kernels remains challenging because existing DLMs use different objectives and prediction parameterizations. We establish connections among SEDD, MDLM/GIDD, M2S, and Neural CTMC by expressing their conditional losses as a single generalized Kullback--Leibler objective over model reverse rates. We further derive conversions from clean-token predictions to concrete-score, posterior-mean, and exit-rate/jump parameterizations, yielding a shared (x₀) interface that supports switching between mask and uniform kernels. Building on these connections, we propose øurs{}, a simple continual pre-training approach for directly adapting pretrained GPT2 checkpoints to uniform-noise diffusion. Through systematic evaluation of 124M- and 355M-parameter models, we show that øurs{} steadily improves the trade-off between generative perplexity (GenPPL) and unigram entropy as the sampling budget increases from 16 to 256 steps. At 256 steps, øurs{}-S and øurs{}-M achieve GenPPL/entropy pairs of (97.783/5.2626) and (71.516/5.6669), respectively; no evaluated model at the same scale simultaneously outperforms øurs{} on both metrics. At both scales, øurs{} also achieves the highest WinoGrande, SIQA, and BBH accuracy among the compared diffusion models.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有方法多将预训练自回归语言模型适配为掩码扩散模型，而本文直接将其适配到统一噪声扩散，即采样过程中所有token都可被修改。作者将SEDD、MDLM/GIDD、M2S和Neural CTMC联系起来，把它们的条件损失统一为关于模型反向速率的广义KL目标，并推导出从干净token预测到多种参数化形式之间的转换。基于这些联系，本文提出一种简单的持续预训练方法，将预训练GPT2检查点直接适配到统一噪声扩散，并在不同模型规模上展示了生成困惑度与熵之间更优的权衡。
authors: Xiaoyi Jiang, Jingyuan Li, Yixuan Jiang, Wei Liu, Yi Zhu, Zuoqiang Shi, Pipi Hu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现有方法主要将预训练自回归（AR）语言模型适配到掩码扩散，而我们直接将其适配到均匀噪声扩散，在这种扩散中采样期间每个token都保持可编辑。然而，跨腐蚀核适配AR检查点仍然具有挑战性，因为现有离散语言模型（DLM）使用不同的目标和预测参数化。我们通过将SEDD、MDLM/GIDD、M2S和Neural CTMC的条件损失表示为关于模型反向速率的单一广义Kullback--Leibler目标，建立了它们之间的联系。我们进一步推导了从干净token预测到具体分数、后验均值以及退出率/跳转参数化的转换，从而得到一个共享的x₀接口，支持在掩码核和均匀核之间切换。基于这些联系，我们提出øurs{}，一种简单的持续预训练方法，用于直接将预训练GPT2检查点适配到均匀噪声扩散。通过对1.24亿和3.55亿参数模型的系统评估，我们表明，随着采样预算从16步增加到256步，øurs{}稳定改善生成困惑度（GenPPL）与一元熵之间的权衡。在256步时，øurs{}-S和øurs{}-M分别达到GenPPL/熵对（97.783/5.2626）和（71.516/5.6669）；在相同规模下，没有被评估的模型能在这两个指标上同时超过øurs{}。在两个规模上，øurs{}还在所比较的扩散模型中取得了最高的WinoGrande、SIQA和BBH准确率。

articles.title: BettiSplit: Topology-Guided Privacy-Aware Split Learning Against Feature Inversion and Gradient Leakage
articles.title_zh: BettiSplit：基于拓扑引导的隐私感知切分学习，用于抵御特征反演与梯度泄露
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Split learning enables collaborative model training by partitioning neural networks across clients and servers. However, improper split placement can lead to severe privacy leakage through intermediate representations. In this work, we propose a topology-guided framework for privacy-aware split learning based on the persistent Betti complexity of smashed activations. Through comprehensive layer-wise analysis, we show that privacy risk in split learning is highly non-uniform across layers and exhibits sharp transition regions that are not captured by architectural depth alone. In particular, feature inversion fidelity increases from negligible reconstruction to as high as 0.98 SSIM at deeper, privacy-critical split points. We further demonstrate that Betti complexity consistently identifies representation regimes associated with elevated feature-space privacy leakage across architectures and datasets. Leveraging this observation, we introduce BettiSafe, a topology-guided split selection strategy that identifies privacy-sensitive layers without requiring explicit attack execution. BettiSafe improves resistance to feature inversion by 2 to 5 times compared to depth-based heuristics while preserving classification accuracy. In addition, Betti-based regularisation increases inversion difficulty by nearly 5 x without degrading model utility, enabling a favourable privacy utility tradeoff. Overall, our results highlight topological complexity as a promising structural descriptor for secure, adaptive, and representation-aware split learning in real-world collaborative systems
articles.abstract_zh: 切分学习通过将神经网络分布在客户端和服务器之间实现协同训练，但不当的切分位置会导致中间表示泄露隐私。本文从被切分激活的持久Betti复杂度出发，提出一种拓扑引导的隐私感知切分框架，并通过逐层分析表明，切分学习中的隐私风险在不同层之间并不均匀。基于这一观察，作者提出BettiSafe策略，在不执行显式攻击的情况下识别隐私敏感层，从而提升对特征反演等攻击的抵抗能力。
authors: Akarsh K. Nair, Muhammad Arifur Rahman, David Brown, Mufti Mahmud
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拆分学习通过在客户端和服务器之间划分神经网络来支持协作式模型训练。然而，不恰当的拆分位置可能通过中间表示导致严重的隐私泄露。在这项工作中，我们提出一种基于粉碎激活的持久Betti复杂度的拓扑引导框架，用于隐私感知拆分学习。通过全面的逐层分析，我们表明拆分学习中的隐私风险在各层之间高度不均匀，并呈现出仅凭架构深度无法捕获的尖锐转变区域。特别是，在更深的、隐私关键的拆分点处，特征反演保真度会从可忽略的重建增加到高达0.98的SSIM。我们进一步证明，Betti复杂度能够在不同架构和数据集上持续识别与升高的特征空间隐私泄露相关的表示状态。利用这一观察，我们引入BettiSafe，一种拓扑引导的拆分选择策略，能够在不需要显式执行攻击的情况下识别隐私敏感层。与基于深度的启发式方法相比，BettiSafe将抵抗特征反演的能力提高了2到5倍，同时保持分类准确率。此外，基于Betti的正则化在不降低模型效用的情况下将反演难度提高近5倍，从而实现有利的隐私-效用权衡。总体而言，我们的结果突出表明，拓扑复杂度是现实协作系统中安全、自适应且表示感知的拆分学习的一种有前景的结构描述符。

articles.title: Bit-Accurate FPGA Evaluation of Learned Feature Gating in a Fixed-Point Fourier-Feature Automatic Modulation Classifier
articles.title_zh: 面向固定点傅里叶特征自动调制分类器的学习型特征门控之比特精度FPGA评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learned feature reweighting can improve automatic modulation classification (AMC) in software, but the same operation introduces additional arithmetic and latency when implemented on an FPGA. This work measures that trade-off in a compact fixed-point classifier using 24 sparse DFT-energy features, 8 phase/statistical features, and a 32-to-128-to-11 multilayer perceptron. A second architecture inserts a learned 32-element, 8-bit, input-dependent gate before the classifier. Gated and ungated models are trained using post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) with two matched training seeds. The resulting eight checkpoints are compiled independently for an Intel Cyclone V FPGA and evaluated over 352,000 physical-board classifications. Ungated models achieve higher test accuracy in all four matched gate comparisons, with mean gated-minus-ungated differences of -0.784 percentage points under PTQ and -0.616 percentage points under QAT. The effect of QAT changes direction between the two training seeds. In hardware, the gate adds an average of 1,318 adaptive logic modules (ALMs), 1,557 registers, 4 DSP blocks, and 3,140 processing cycles. All 352,000 board predictions agree exactly with an independent integer reference, and 3,760 captured intermediate values from one training seed also match. For this feature representation and implementation, learned gating increases FPGA cost without improving classification accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 学习型特征重加权可提升软件中的自动调制分类性能，但在FPGA上实现时会带来额外的算术开销与时延。本文在一个紧凑的固定点分类器上评估这一权衡，该分类器使用稀疏DFT能量特征、相位/统计特征以及多层感知机结构，并比较加入与不加入输入相关门控的两种架构。作者通过后训练量化和量化感知训练获得多个检查点，并在Intel Cyclone V FPGA上进行比特精度评估，结果显示门控结构在硬件资源占用上明显增加，而测试准确率未必优于无门控模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 学习型特征重加权可以在软件中改进自动调制分类（AMC），但同一操作在FPGA上实现时会引入额外的算术运算和延迟。本工作在一个紧凑的固定点分类器中测量这种权衡，该分类器使用24个稀疏DFT能量特征、8个相位/统计特征以及一个32到128到11的多层感知机。第二种架构在分类器之前插入一个学习得到的32元素、8位、输入依赖门控。带门控和不带门控的模型使用训练后量化（PTQ）和量化感知训练（QAT）训练，并采用两个匹配的训练种子。所得八个检查点分别为Intel Cyclone V FPGA独立编译，并在352,000次物理板分类上进行评估。在所有四组匹配门控比较中，不带门控模型均取得更高测试准确率，在PTQ下门控减不带门控的平均差为-0.784个百分点，在QAT下为-0.616个百分点。QAT的影响方向在两个训练种子之间发生变化。在硬件中，门控平均增加1,318个自适应逻辑模块（ALM）、1,557个寄存器、4个DSP块和3,140个处理周期。全部352,000个板上预测均与独立整数参考完全一致，并且来自一个训练种子的3,760个捕获中间值也相匹配。对于这种特征表示和实现，学习型门控增加了FPGA成本，却没有提高分类准确率。

articles.title: PYPM-GGD: Pitman-Yor Process Mixture with Generalized Gaussian Density using ADAM
articles.title_zh: PYPM-GGD：使用ADAM的Pitman-Yor过程混合广义高斯密度模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24583v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large scale Bayesian nonparametrics (BNP) learner such as Stochastic Variational Inference (SVI) can handle datasets with large class number and large training size at fractional cost. Like its predecessor, SVI rely on the assumption of conjugate variational posterior to approximate the true posterior. A more challenging problem is to consider large scale learning on non-conjugate posterior. Recent works in this direction are mostly associated with using Monte Carlo methods for approximating the learner. However, these works are usually demonstrated on non-BNP related task and less complex models such as logistic regression, due to higher computational complexity. In order to overcome the issue faced by SVI, we develop a novel approach based on the recently proposed constant stepsize stochastic gradient ascent to allow large scale learning on non-conjugate posterior. Unlike SVI, our new learner does not require closed- form expression for the variational posterior expectatations. Our only requirement is that the variational posterior is differentiable. In order to ensure convergence in stochastic settings, SVI rely on decaying step-sizes to slow its learning. Inspired by SVI and Adam, we propose the novel use of adaptive stepsizes in our method to significantly improve its learning. We show that our proposed methods is compatible with ResNet features when applied to large class number datasets such as MIT67 and SUN397. Finally, we compare our proposed learner with several recent works such as deep clustering algorithms and showed we were able to produce on-par or outperform the state-of-the-art methods in terms of clustering measures.
articles.abstract_zh: 大规模贝叶斯非参数学习通常依赖随机变分推断，但其对共轭后验的假设限制了非共轭模型的应用。本文提出一种基于恒定步长随机梯度上升的新方法，用于在非共轭后验上进行大规模学习，该方法不再要求变分后验具有封闭形式的期望，只需其可微。作者将这一思路用于Pitman-Yor过程混合与广义高斯密度建模，并结合ADAM优化器，以提升复杂模型在大规模数据上的可训练性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 诸如随机变分推断（SVI）这样的大规模贝叶斯非参数（BNP）学习器，可以以很小的成本处理类别数量大、训练规模大的数据集。与其前身一样，SVI依赖共轭变分后验这一假设来近似真实后验。一个更具挑战性的问题是考虑非共轭后验上的大规模学习。该方向近期工作大多与使用蒙特卡洛方法近似学习器相关。然而，由于计算复杂度较高，这些工作通常展示在非BNP相关任务和较不复杂的模型上，例如逻辑回归。为克服SVI面临的问题，我们基于近期提出的常步长随机梯度上升开发了一种新方法，以允许在非共轭后验上进行大规模学习。不同于SVI，我们的新学习器不需要变分后验期望的闭式表达。我们的唯一要求是变分后验可微。为确保随机设置中的收敛，SVI依赖递减步长来放慢其学习。受SVI和Adam启发，我们在方法中提出新颖地使用自适应步长，以显著改善其学习。我们表明，当应用于MIT67和SUN397等大类别数量数据集时，我们提出的方法与ResNet特征兼容。最后，我们将所提出的学习器与若干近期工作（如深度聚类算法）进行比较，并表明在聚类指标方面，我们能够达到与最先进方法相当或优于它们的结果。

articles.title: CRAFT: Learn the Schema, Execute the Plan
articles.title_zh: CRAFT：先学习模式，再执行计划
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22642v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Enterprise coding agents translate natural-language analytical requests into executable code over proprietary APIs, schemas, and metric definitions. Yet the prevailing deployment pattern injecting exhaustive schema and tool documentation into each prompt increases inference overhead, complicates schema evolution, and undermines reliability in multi-turn analysis. We investigate whether stable schema knowledge and tool-use behavior can instead be acquired through post-training while preserving the consistency required for production-facing analytics. We present CRAFT, a two-stage post-training recipe for schema-grounded coding agents. First, schema-stripped PLAN supervised fine-tuning learns domain-structured plans and executable behaviors from validated trajectories without exhaustive prompt-time schema injection. Second, execution-shaped reinforcement learning aligns the policy for tool selection, code quality, plan-code consistency, and recovery from failed executions. Training trajectories are curated through a Tri-Gate filter combining execution validation, data-integrity checks, and LLM-judge reasoning audit. We evaluate CRAFT for planned rollout in advertising analytics, covering campaign performance analysis, metric drill-downs, entity-level performance analysis, and multi-turn analytical refinement. The enterprise evaluation environment incorporates beta APIs as the agent-facing tool surface and spans 25 schema-linked core entities and 30 agentic workflows. Relative to a schema-stuffed baseline, CRAFT improves composite Agent Score by +9.6 pp, consistency by +4.1 pp, and multi-turn coherence by +4.2 pp, while reducing input-token burden by approximately 9x and schema-discovery loops by up to 5x. We further report deployment tradeoffs, reward-shaping limitations, and training-infrastructure extensions required for multi-turn tool-use reinforcement learning in enterprise settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 企业编码智能体需要将自然语言分析请求转换为针对专有API、模式和指标定义的可执行代码，但在每次提示中注入完整文档会增加推理开销并削弱多轮分析的可靠性。本文提出CRAFT，一种面向模式约束编码智能体的两阶段后训练方案：首先在不依赖完整模式注入的情况下，通过监督微调学习结构化计划与可执行行为；随后使用执行形状化强化学习优化工具选择、代码质量、计划与代码一致性，以及失败执行后的恢复能力。作者还构建了Tri-Gate过滤器，对训练轨迹进行执行验证、数据完整性检查和LLM审计，从而提升训练数据质量。
authors: Aakash Kolekar, Sahika Genc, Shahriar Shariat, Bunyamin Sisman, Tibor Mezi, Barbara Poblete, Shree Vandana Kachroo, Calvin Chi, Parth Parmar, Ari Singer, Prayaas Jain, Cindy Barker, Benoit Dumoulin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 企业编码代理将自然语言分析请求转换为基于专有API、模式和指标定义的可执行代码。然而，当前主流部署模式是在每个提示中注入详尽的模式和工具文档，这会增加推理开销，使模式演化复杂化，并削弱多轮分析中的可靠性。我们研究稳定的模式知识和工具使用行为是否可以通过后训练获得，同时保留面向生产分析所需的一致性。我们提出CRAFT，一种用于模式扎根编码代理的两阶段后训练方案。首先，去除模式的PLAN监督微调从经过验证的轨迹中学习领域结构化计划和可执行行为，而无需在提示时注入详尽模式。其次，执行塑形强化学习使策略在工具选择、代码质量、计划-代码一致性以及从执行失败中恢复等方面对齐。训练轨迹通过Tri-Gate过滤器进行筛选，该过滤器结合执行验证、数据完整性检查和LLM裁判推理审计。我们在广告分析中对计划上线的CRAFT进行评估，覆盖广告活动表现分析、指标下钻、实体级表现分析和多轮分析细化。企业评估环境纳入beta API作为代理可见的工具表面，并涵盖25个与模式关联的核心实体和30个代理式工作流。相对于模式堆叠基线，CRAFT将综合Agent Score提高+9.6个百分点，一致性提高+4.1个百分点，多轮连贯性提高+4.2个百分点，同时将输入token负担减少约9倍，并将模式发现循环最多减少5倍。我们进一步报告了部署权衡、奖励塑形局限性，以及企业环境中多轮工具使用强化学习所需的训练基础设施扩展。

articles.title: Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Sensor Selection in Maritime Surveillance
articles.title_zh: 用于海事监视中异构传感器选择的强化学习方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22667v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper presents an information-gain-guided reinforcement-learning sensor-selection framework for single-vessel tracking in heterogeneous maritime sensor networks. The proposed approach is motivated by information-theoretic sensor management: instead of activating all sensors or repeatedly performing computationally expensive online expected-information-gain evaluation, a learned policy selects one tracking-relevant sensor at each decision epoch. A Bayesian sequential Monte Carlo tracker estimates the vessel state from noisy measurements and provides a belief representation for scheduling under nonlinear and non-Gaussian conditions. A Proximal Policy Optimization agent selects one of five sensors deployed in a georeferenced simulation of the CMMI Smart Marina testbed at Ayia Napa Marina, Cyprus. The agent observes belief-state, detection-history, coverage, sensor-geometry, and realized-information-gain features. The reward is defined as a realized-information-gain term gated by an observability mask. Final-test simulations compare the proposed framework with random single-sensor selection, always-on sensing using all sensors simultaneously, and the expected-information-gain sensor-selection baseline proposed in our previous work. Results show that the learned policy achieves tracking performance close to always-on sensing while activating only one sensor per decision time step and avoiding the computationally expensive online entropy search required by expected-information-gain selection.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于信息增益引导的强化学习传感器选择框架，用于异构海事传感器网络中的单船目标跟踪。与其激活全部传感器或反复进行昂贵的在线期望信息增益评估，不如由学习到的策略在每个决策时刻选择一个最相关的传感器。系统结合贝叶斯序贯蒙特卡洛跟踪器与PPO智能体，在仿真的海港测试床中利用信念状态、检测历史、覆盖范围、传感器几何关系和已实现信息增益等特征进行决策，并与随机选择及全传感器方案进行比较。
authors: Andrei Starodubov, Yaqub Aris Prabowo, Andreas Hadjipieris, Roberto Galeazzi, Ioannis Kyriakides
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出一种信息增益引导的强化学习传感器选择框架，用于异构海事传感器网络中的单船跟踪。所提出方法受信息论传感器管理启发：不是激活所有传感器，也不是反复执行计算代价高昂的在线期望信息增益评估，而是由学习策略在每个决策时刻选择一个与跟踪相关的传感器。贝叶斯序贯蒙特卡洛跟踪器从噪声测量中估计船舶状态，并为非线性和非高斯条件下的调度提供信念表示。近端策略优化智能体在塞浦路斯阿依纳帕码头CMMI Smart Marina试验场的地理参考仿真中，从部署的五个传感器中选择一个。该智能体观测信念状态、检测历史、覆盖范围、传感器几何以及已实现信息增益特征。奖励被定义为由可观测性掩码门控的已实现信息增益项。最终测试仿真将所提出框架与随机单传感器选择、同时使用所有传感器的始终开启感知，以及我们此前工作提出的期望信息增益传感器选择基线进行比较。结果显示，学习策略在每个决策时间步仅激活一个传感器的情况下，取得接近始终开启感知的跟踪性能，并避免了期望信息增益选择所需的计算代价高昂的在线熵搜索。

articles.title: Operator Neural Jump ODEs: L²⁻optimal prediction in function spaces
articles.title_zh: 算子神经跳跃ODE：函数空间中的L²最优预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.23110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we study the extension of Neural Jump ODEs to infinite-dimensional function spaces. In particular, the underlying process X now takes values in L²⁽Ξ, Rd_X) instead of Rd_X and the Operator NJ-ODE approximates the optimal predictor of this process by producing a representative of the conditional expectation. The NJ-ODE model is a framework for online learning the optimal prediction of continuous-time stochastic processes, given discrete, possibly irregular and incomplete past observations. In a series of works, this model has been extended to deal with generic path-dependent processes, with observation noise and dependent observations, with long-term predictions, and with input-output systems. However, throughout all of these works, the underlying processes were restricted to be finite-dimensional. In particular, function-valued problems, like yield curve or volatility surface predictions, could only be handled through discretization, which inherently leads to a loss of information. In this work, we build on ideas from Neural Operator methods that allow us to extend the NJ-ODE framework to an infinite-dimensional output process. To prove convergence of the NJ-ODE to the optimal prediction process, we develop a new approximation strategy that also generalizes previous works in the finite-dimensional setting by considerably weakening the assumptions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将Neural Jump ODE扩展到无限维函数空间，研究其在函数值过程上的在线最优预测问题。与以往仅处理有限维状态不同，该方法将过程X视为取值于L²空间的对象，并通过算子NJ-ODE输出条件期望的代表，从而适用于收益率曲线、波动率曲面等函数值预测任务。作者将神经算子思想引入NJ-ODE框架，以避免离散化带来的信息损失，并使模型能够处理不规则、缺失且离散的历史观测。
authors: Florian Krach, Oliver Löthgren, Josef Teichmann
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们研究神经跳跃ODE向无限维函数空间的扩展。特别地，底层过程X现在取值于L²⁽Ξ, Rd_X)而不是Rd_X，并且算子NJ-ODE通过产生条件期望的一个代表来近似该过程的最优预测。NJ-ODE模型是一个在线学习连续时间随机过程最优预测的框架，给定的是离散的、可能不规则且不完整的过去观测。在一系列工作中，该模型已被扩展以处理一般路径依赖过程、带观测噪声和依赖观测的过程、长期预测以及输入-输出系统。然而，在所有这些工作中，底层过程都被限制为有限维。特别是，诸如收益率曲线或波动率曲面预测这样的函数值问题只能通过离散化来处理，而这固有地会导致信息损失。在本工作中，我们借鉴神经算子方法的思想，使我们能够将NJ-ODE框架扩展到无限维输出过程。为证明NJ-ODE收敛到最优预测过程，我们提出一种新的近似策略，该策略还通过显著弱化假设而推广了有限维设置中的先前工作。

articles.title: A Fixed-Effects Causal Forest for Staggered Adoption, with an Application to Medicaid Expansion
articles.title_zh: 用于错位实施处理的固定效应因果森林：以医疗补助扩张为例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.19644v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Difference-in-differences with staggered adoption identifies group-time average treatment effects ATT(g,t) by comparing each cohort to units not yet treated, which avoids the "forbidden comparisons" that bias two-way fixed-effects estimators when effects are heterogeneous. This paper studies the covariate-conditional version of that object, taug,ₜ(x), and estimates it with a fixed-effects causal forest. Within each (g,t) comparison block, the outcome and treatment are residualized on unit and period fixed effects inside each tree node, and honest causal trees split on treatment-effect heterogeneity in the covariates. The estimand is not new: Hatamyar, Kreif, Rocha and Huber (2023) introduced it using a doubly-robust R-learner, and Imai, Qin and Yanagi (2023) study it for a single continuous covariate. What we add is a different way to estimate it. Where those methods remove confounding by modeling nuisance functions, we remove it by differencing out unit and period effects within each tree node, following the fixed-effects residualization of Kattenberg, Scheer and Thiel (2023) and Gavrilova, Langorgen and Zoutman (2025) and carrying it into the Callaway-Sant'Anna group-time structure. In Monte Carlo experiments the estimator is the only forest-based method that stays unbiased and correctly covered for the overall effect under staggered timing with cohort-varying effects; two-way fixed effects and a pooled causal forest inherit large forbidden-comparison bias. We apply the method to the Callaway-Sant'Anna minimum-wage panel as a validation and to the staggered county-level rollout of the ACA Medicaid expansion, where it recovers an average 2.25 percentage-point fall in the uninsured rate and a conditional surface on which poorer and lower-income counties gained substantially more coverage -- heterogeneity measured along socioeconomic covariates that are not lags of the outcome.
articles.abstract_zh: 差分中的差分方法在错位实施场景下可通过组-时间平均处理效应识别因果影响，但传统双向固定效应估计在效应异质时会产生偏误。本文研究其协变量条件版本，并提出用固定效应因果森林进行估计：在每个组-时间比较块内，于树节点中对单位效应与时间效应进行残差化处理，再在协变量上按处理效应异质性进行诚实分裂。该方法不同于依赖倾向模型或结果模型的双重稳健做法，而是通过树内固定效应差分来消除混杂，并将其应用于医疗补助扩张问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 带有错位采用的差分中的差分通过将每个队列与尚未处理的单位进行比较来识别组-时间平均处理效应ATT(g,t)，这避免了在效应异质时会使双向固定效应估计器产生偏差的“禁忌比较”。本文研究该对象的协变量条件版本taug,ₜ(x)，并使用固定效应因果森林估计它。 在每个(g,t)比较块内，结果和处理在每个树节点内部对单位和时期固定效应进行残差化，而诚实因果树根据协变量中的处理效应异质性进行分裂。该估计对象并非新的：Hatamyar、Kreif、Rocha和Huber（2023）使用双重稳健R-learner引入了它，Imai、Qin和Yanagi（2023）针对单个连续协变量研究了它。我们的贡献是提供一种不同的估计方式。上述方法通过建模干扰函数来去除混杂，而我们按照Kattenberg、Scheer和Thiel（2023）以及Gavrilova、Langorgen和Zoutman（2025）的固定效应残差化，在每个树节点内差分掉单位和时期效应，并将其带入Callaway-Sant'Anna组-时间结构。在蒙特卡洛实验中，在存在错位时点和队列变化效应的情况下，该估计器是唯一一个对总体效应保持无偏且覆盖率正确的森林类方法；双向固定效应和合并因果森林继承了较大的禁忌比较偏差。我们将该方法应用于Callaway-Sant'Anna最低工资面板作为验证，并应用于ACA Medicaid扩展在县级的错位推出；该方法恢复出未保险率平均下降2.25个百分点，并得到一个条件效应曲面，其中较贫困和较低收入的县获得了显著更多的保险覆盖——这种异质性沿着并非结果滞后项的社会经济协变量来衡量。

articles.title: Probabilistic Symbolic Regression for Equation Discovery via Operator-induced and Regularized Symbolic Forests
articles.title_zh: 基于算子诱导与正则化符号森林的方程发现概率符号回归
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.19710v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Symbolic regression has emerged as a powerful tool for artificial intelligence-driven scientific discovery by learning interpretable analytical expressions that reveal governing relationships directly from data. Existing methods, however, often rely on heuristic search, struggle to balance predictive accuracy with expression complexity in noisy settings, and offer limited characterization of symbolic uncertainty. Probabilistic approaches that address these challenges in a unified manner remain underexplored. We introduce a probabilistic symbolic regression framework that represents mathematical expressions as ensembles of symbolic trees. A regularizing prior over tree topology controls expression complexity, while an Occam's window-based posterior summary captures uncertainty across multiple plausible symbolic models. Given the limited existing theoretical treatment of symbolic regression, we develop posterior concentration guarantees under approximate symbolic realizability, yielding a near-parametric rate for exact symbolic representability. Additionally, we establish a sharp oracle concentration result under symbolic misspecification. Comparisons of our proposed framework with state-of-the-art competitors demonstrate superior predictive accuracy, optimal symbolic complexity, and stable structural recovery when learning benchmark scientific equations, together with the identification of scientifically interpretable descriptors in a challenging materials discovery problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 符号回归通过学习可解释的解析表达式来揭示数据背后的规律，已成为人工智能驱动科学发现的重要工具，但现有方法往往依赖启发式搜索，难以在噪声环境下兼顾预测精度、表达复杂度与不确定性刻画。本文提出一种概率符号回归框架，将数学表达式表示为符号树集合，并通过对树拓扑的正则化先验控制复杂度，借助基于Occam窗口的后验汇总刻画多个候选符号模型的不确定性。作者进一步给出在近似可实现条件下的后验集中保证，以及在符号失配情形下的最优性结果，为符号回归提供了理论支撑。
authors: Somjit Roy, Pritam Dey, Bani K. Mallick, Debdeep Pati
articles.abstract_zh_full: 符号回归已成为人工智能驱动科学发现的一种强大工具，它通过学习可解释的解析表达式，直接从数据中揭示支配关系。然而，现有方法常常依赖启发式搜索，在有噪声设置中难以平衡预测准确性与表达式复杂度，并且对符号不确定性的刻画有限。能够以统一方式应对这些挑战的概率方法仍未得到充分探索。我们引入一种概率符号回归框架，将数学表达式表示为符号树的集成。树拓扑上的正则化先验控制表达式复杂度，而基于奥卡姆窗口的后验摘要捕获多个合理符号模型之间的不确定性。鉴于现有符号回归理论处理有限，我们在近似符号可实现性下发展了后验集中保证，并在精确符号可表示情形下得到近参数速率。此外，我们在符号错设下建立了一个尖锐的 oracle 集中结果。将我们提出的框架与最先进竞争方法进行比较表明，在学习基准科学方程时，该框架具有更优的预测准确性、最优的符号复杂度和稳定的结构恢复能力，并且能够在一个具有挑战性的材料发现问题中识别出具有科学可解释性的描述符。

articles.title: Role of O-GlcNAcylation in the phagocytosis process of macrophages
articles.title_zh: O-GlcNAcyl化在巨噬细胞吞噬过程中的作用
articles.abstract: Phagocytosis is a critical immune mechanism for the elimination of foreign particles, yet the role of O-GlcNAcylation in this process remains poorly understood. Using J774A.1 macrophages, we investigated how the modulation of O-GlcNAcylation affects the phagocytosis process. OGA inhibition (TMG inhibitor) after 24 hours significantly increased zymosan uptake, as evidenced by a 41% higher mean fluorescence intensity by flow cytometry and a 65–95% increase in phagocytic index by fluorescence microscopy. Neither OGT or OGA inhibitor significantly increased Dectin-1 or CD11b surface expression, suggesting that the enhanced phagocytosis is not driven by receptor upregulation. To elucidate if this mechanism is dependent on phagolysosome maturation, we assessed key phagosome markers. OGA inhibition (TMG) increased LAMP1 expression while OSMI-1 decreased it. No changes were observed in Rab5, Rab7, or Rab11, furthermore, OGA inhibition improved LAMP1 formation around phagocytosed zymosan particles. These findings indicate that O-GlcNAcylation modulates macrophage phagocytic capacity and phagolysosome maturation, with increased O-GlcNAcylation promoting zymosan internalization potentially through LAMP1-dependent mechanisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 吞噬作用是免疫系统清除外源颗粒的关键机制，但O-GlcNAcyl化在其中的作用仍不清楚。本文以J774A.1巨噬细胞为模型，考察调节O-GlcNAcyl化水平对吞噬酵母聚糖的影响，结果显示抑制OGA可显著增强摄取能力，并伴随吞噬指数上升。进一步分析表明，这一增强并非由Dectin-1或CD11b等受体上调所驱动，而更可能与吞噬溶酶体成熟过程及LAMP1形成增强有关，提示O-GlcNAcyl化参与调控巨噬细胞吞噬能力。

articles.title: What Counts as Compute? An Empirical Analysis of Accounting Conventions in Compute-Optimal Transformer Training
articles.title_zh: 什么算作计算量？——关于计算最优Transformer训练中计量约定的实证分析
articles.abstract: Deriving a compute-optimal training recipe requires two choices that are usually made silently: what counts as a “parameter” when the loss surface is fitted, and what counts as “compute” when that surface is minimised under a budget. The two most cited compute-optimal studies made different choices — one counted non-embedding parameters, the other counted all of them — and both used the approximation C ≈ 6ND. This paper measures how much that bookkeeping matters. We train 35 decoder-only transformers on FineWeb-Edu, from 0.056M to 5.98M non-embedding parameters, at two BPE vocabulary sizes (V = 2048 complete, V = 8192 partial) and across a 5.8-fold range of training compute, with the learning rate calibrated by its own sweep, the cosine schedule matched to each run’s length, and no repeated data. We then fit the standard additive loss surface and derive the compute-optimal frontier four times over, changing only the accounting: parameters with or without embeddings, and compute as 6ND, as exact analytic FLOPs, or as measured device time. The output softmax — not attention — is what breaks 6ND at these scales, inflating the true cost by up to 8.5×. Holding the runs fixed, the fitted exponent a in N⋆ ∝ C a moves across 0.25–0.42 and the implied tokens-per-parameter ratio moves by a factor of 19, in the direction and close to the magnitude that a closed-form analysis predicts. Every bootstrap resample preserves the ordering, so the direction of the effect is certain even though each exponent is individually imprecise. A closed-form relation predicts each convention’s exponent from two elasticities computable from the architecture alone, and matches the fitted exponents to within 0.105. In a held-out test the conventions rank in the predicted order, the 6NneD convention being furthest from the measured optimum (20% versus 6%). The practical cost of the ambiguity is, however, small: because the compute-optimal valley is flat, following the wrong convention’s recommendation wastes at most 18% of the compute budget. Reported exponents are therefore not comparable across studies unless the accounting is stated, but the loss at stake is modest — and both facts are predictable in advance from two ratios that can be computed before any model is trained.
articles.abstract_zh: 推导计算最优训练方案时，两个常被默认处理的约定会显著影响结论：参数数量如何定义，以及在给定预算下什么算作“计算量”。本文通过训练35个仅解码器Transformer，系统比较了不同参数与计算口径对计算最优前沿的影响，包括是否计入嵌入层参数，以及以6ND、精确解析FLOPs或真实设备时间来度量计算。结果显示，输出softmax在这些尺度下会显著突破6ND近似，导致真实成本最高可膨胀8.5倍，说明训练账目口径对计算最优分析具有实质影响。

articles.title: From Classical to Quantum Turbulence: A Unified FNO×RG Framework Across Six Physical Systems
articles.title_zh: 从经典到量子湍流：跨六类物理系统的统一FNO×RG框架
articles.abstract: Turbulence remains one of the last unsolved problems in classical physics, with theoretical descriptions historically fragmented across distinct physical domains—incompressible Navier–Stokes, quantum turbulence, compressible flow, magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), stratified flows, and active matter. We present a unified functional-renormalization-group-assisted Fourier neural operator (FNO×RG) framework that bridges spectral learning and Wilsonian coarse-graining in a three-stage pipeline: (i) learn the spectral closure Γ_κ via FNO from DNS/experimental data; (ii) embed Γ_κ into the Wetterich exact RG equation; (iii) extract fixed points and anomalous dimensions via eigenvalue analysis of the linearized RG flow. Applying this pipeline to six physically distinct systems, our analysis is consistent with known universality classes and suggests the possible existence of multi-competing-fixed-point structures in five of the six cases. Specifically: (1) Navier–Stokes turbulence yields the conditional result η_ν = 4/3 (from the Galilean Ward identity z=2−η_ν with z=2/3), the She–Leveque scaling formula, a two-loop β-function, and consistent results across 18 independent tests (3 confirmed novel predictions, 8 reproduce known results, 0 negated); (2) quantum turbulence reveals a polarization-controlled crossover between Kozik–Svistunov (k⁽−7/5)) and L'vov–Nazarenko (k⁽−5/3)) spectra, where vortex-line polarization P acts as the RG-relevant operator; our predictions for quantum turbulence await experimental verification; (3) compressible turbulence produces a Mach-dependent β(Ma) = −(5/3 + 2αMa²)/(1+αMa²); (4) MHD turbulence exhibits a double-inertial IK→K41 cascade confirmed by satellite data, with helicity barrier effects; (5) stratified turbulence reveals a triple-fixed-point structure (K41/Bolgov–Obukhov/two-dimensional), with buoyancy scaling dimension [g_b]=−1; (6) active matter turbulence resolves the Nematic-Active Turbulent Fixed Point (k⁽−1)) versus Pressure-Active Turbulent Fixed Point (k⁽−8/3)) controversy. We identify cross-system universality patterns and discuss limitations including FNO training data requirements and higher-loop corrections.
articles.abstract_zh: 湍流长期是经典物理中最难解决的问题之一，且不同物理领域的理论描述彼此分散。本文提出一种结合Fourier神经算子与功能重整化群的统一框架FNO×RG，通过三阶段流程将DNS或实验数据学习得到的谱闭包嵌入Wetterich精确RG方程，并据此提取固定点与反常维数。作者将该框架应用于六类物理系统，结果与已知宇宙类一致，并提示其中五类系统可能存在多个竞争固定点结构。

articles.title: A Calibration-Aware Reference Architecture for Resilient Supply Chain Planning: Integrating Conformal Probabilistic Demand Forecasting with Scenario-Based Stochastic Vehicle Routing
articles.title_zh: 面向韧性供应链规划的校准感知参考架构：融合保形概率需求预测与基于情景的随机车辆路径规划
articles.abstract: Machine learning (ML) and operations research (OR) are routinely combined in supply chain decision support, yet the interface between them is often left methodologically unguarded: point or quantile forecasts are passed to an optimizer as though they were deterministic quantities, the resulting service levels are asserted rather than measured, and the marginal value of the stochastic machinery over a naive deterministic plan is rarely quantified. This paper presents a reference architecture that closes three specific gaps at that interface, together with an open-source reference implementation. First, the forecasting layer produces distribution-free calibrated prediction intervals via Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR), with a monotone rearrangement operator that eliminates quantile crossing and an optional adaptive conformal update for non-stationary regimes. Second, the optimization layer replaces the common "solve deterministically on an inflated upper-quantile demand" heuristic with a Sample Average Approximation (SAA) procedure whose realized service level is empirically measured by Monte Carlo evaluation of the fixed route plan, including an explicit two-stage recourse cost model and a capacity-building wrapper that re-solves and re-validates against an independently seeded scenario draw. Third, the evaluation layer computes the Value of the Stochastic Solution (VSS) and the Expected Value of Perfect Information (EVPI) under a controlled comparison in which the deterministic and stochastic plans compete at identical vehicle capacity, so that the measured value is attributable to information rather than to slack. The architecture is instrumented for reproducible research: rolling-origin (walk-forward) cross-validation, proper scoring rules (pinball loss, approximate CRPS), calibration diagnostics (empirical coverage, interval width), Diebold–Mariano and Friedman–Nemenyi significance testing, optional MLflow tracking, a 53-function test suite, and containerization. We report the empirical result that has been executed and archived: a five-fold rolling-origin backtest on a 16-customer, 400-day synthetic logistics network. The uncalibrated quantile gradient-boosting ensemble attains CRPS 4.855 ± 0.433 and empirical coverage of 0.775 ± 0.030 against a nominal 0.80 target, under-covering in four of five folds (mean gap −2.47 percentage points) while forecast quality degrades monotonically across successive origins (CRPS +16.1% from the first to the last fold). This is a negative result about the uncalibrated baseline, and it is precisely the empirical motivation for the conformal layer: nominal quantile levels from independently fitted gradient-boosting models are not calibrated coverage levels, and treating them as such silently understates stockout risk. We state explicitly which components are validated by executed numerical evidence and which are implemented with validation harnesses whose outputs are not yet archived, and we outline the decision-focused learning and distributionally robust extensions that would convert this engineering contribution into a methodological one.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对机器学习与运筹优化在供应链决策支持中的衔接问题，提出了一种参考架构，用于弥补“预测结果直接当作确定性输入”所带来的方法学缺口。该架构在预测层采用保形化分位数回归生成分布无关的校准预测区间，并通过单调重排避免分位数交叉，同时可在非平稳环境下进行自适应更新。优化层则以样本平均近似和蒙特卡洛评估替代基于单一高分位需求的启发式方法，从而更真实地衡量服务水平与随机优化带来的增益。

articles.title: Unifying Digital Discovery of Electronic Materials with EMOS
articles.title_zh: 用 EMOS 统一电子材料的数字化发现流程
articles.abstract: Accelerating the discovery of novel electronic materials is crucial for advancing next-generation functional devices. However, the digital discovery ecosystem remains fragmented across a wide variety of siloed databases and machine learning models. To address this, we introduce the Electronic Materials Ontology System (EMOS), an open-source framework that unifies these discovery tools into modular information units under a standardised data contract and a shared property dictionary. This architecture enables researchers to seamlessly construct custom workflows, combining multiple components into automated, end-to-end device design pipelines. In its current version, EMOS integrates six inorganic databases encompassing 1.75 million compounds, alongside five property prediction and seven generative models seamlessly interconnected via 254 canonical property entries. Additionally, EMOS features a role-separated contribution mechanism that drives community growth through effortless framework extensibility. Four case studies demonstrate the platform's versatility across key workflows in electronic materials discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出电子材料本体系统（EMOS），旨在整合当前分散在不同数据库与机器学习模型中的电子材料发现工具。该框架基于标准化数据契约和共享属性词典，将多种组件模块化，支持研究者按需构建自动化、端到端的器件设计工作流。当前版本已集成多个无机数据库、性质预测模型与生成模型，并通过案例研究展示其在电子材料发现中的通用性与可扩展性。

articles.title: A Self-Configurable IoT Gateway Using Cellular Module Without Native Library Support: Web-Based Integration of SMS, GPS, and Cloud Data Acquisition
articles.title_zh: 一种无需原生库支持的自配置物联网网关：基于网页的短信、GPS 与云端数据采集集成
articles.abstract: This paper presents a complete IoT gateway solution based on the ESP32 microcontroller and the SIM7600/A7670SA cellular module, developed to address the lack of native software libraries for these modules in the Arduino ecosystem. The proposed system implements a fully functional data acquisition, cloud communication, and device management platform using direct AT command manipulation over serial interface, eliminating the dependency on proprietary libraries. The architecture features a dual-core design where Core 0 handles all modem communication while Core 1 manages a built-in web server that provides a complete graphical configuration interface. The system supports automatic network mode fallback (5G/4G/3G/2G), GPS positioning with tower triangulation fallback, SMS-based alerts, and bidirectional data transmission with the TagoIO cloud platform. A buffered data sending mechanism aggregates multiple sensor readings into a single HTTP request, reducing network overhead and power consumption. Experimental results demonstrate that the 2G mode achieves the fastest connection establishment (~3.4 s) while 4G provides better throughput for data transmission. The complete firmware is open-source and available on GitHub, enabling easy deployment in rural and remote monitoring applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于 ESP32 微控制器与 SIM7600/A7670SA 蜂窝模块，提出了一种完整的物联网网关方案，用于解决 Arduino 生态中缺乏这些模块原生软件库的问题。系统通过串口 AT 指令直接控制模块，实现数据采集、云端通信和设备管理，并以双核架构分别处理调制解调器通信与网页配置界面。该方案支持网络制式自动切换、GPS 定位与基站辅助定位、短信告警以及与云平台的双向数据传输，实验结果表明其在连接速度与传输吞吐之间具有可调优势。

articles.title: Terahertz field-induced giant symmetry modulations in a van der Waals antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 太赫兹场诱导的范德瓦耳斯反铁磁体中巨大的对称性调制
articles.abstract: Strong-field terahertz (THz) excitations enable dynamic control over electronic, lattice and symmetry degrees of freedom in quantum materials. Here, we uncover pronounced terahertz-induced symmetry modulations and coherent phonon dynamics in the van der Waals antiferromagnet MnPS₃, in which inversion symmetry is broken by its antiferromagnetic spin configuration. Time-resolved second harmonic generation measurements reveal long-lived giant oscillations in the antiferromagnetic phase, with amplitudes comparable to the equilibrium signal, driven by phonons involving percent-level atomic displacements relative to the equilibrium bond lengths. The temporal evolution of the rotational anisotropy patterns indicate a dynamic breaking of mirror symmetry, modulated by two vibrational modes at 1.7 THz and 4.5 THz, with the former corresponding to a hidden mode not observed in equilibrium spectroscopy. We show that these effects arise in part from a field-induced charge rearrangement mechanism that lowers the local crystal symmetry, and couples to the phonon modes. A long-lived field-driven response was uncovered with a complex THz polarization dependence, consistent with a metastable state of reduced symmetry. Comparison with simulations interprets this response in terms of a potential antiferromagnetic-to-ferrimagnetic transition. Our results establish an effective field-tunable pathway for driving excitations otherwise weak in equilibrium, and for manipulating magnetism in low-dimensional materials via dynamical modulation of symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究强场太赫兹激发对范德瓦耳斯反铁磁体 MnPS₃ 中电子、晶格与对称性自由度的动态调控作用。时间分辨二次谐波实验表明，在反铁磁相中可出现长寿命的大幅振荡，其来源与特定声子模式及显著原子位移相关，并伴随镜像对称性的动态破缺。作者还指出，这种效应部分源于场致电荷重排及其与声子模式的耦合，整体上揭示了一个由太赫兹脉冲驱动的长寿命亚稳态响应。

articles.title: SERS Chemical Tongue for Rapid Detection of Chili Oils Assisted with a Convolutional Neural Network
articles.title_zh: 结合卷积神经网络的辣椒油 SERS 化学舌快速检测
articles.abstract: Chili oil is a widely used condiment, but its complex matrix poses significant challenges for rapid quality assessment. Herein, we develop a surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) chemical tongue by integrating three carbonized polymer dot (CPD)-functionalized magnetic core–silver shell nanoparticles (MNP@Ag-CPDA, MNP@Ag-CPDAB, and MNP@Ag-CPDH) with a tailored convolutional neural network (CNN). The covalently anchored CPDs on the silver surfaces serve as universal receptors—a first for SERS chemical tongues—greatly enhancing sensor stability in the non-polar oil matrix and enabling highly sensitive capsaicin detection with a limit of detection (LOD) of 9.1 ng/mL. The three sensors produced complementary cross-reactive fingerprints, which were concatenated into a super-spectrum and analyzed using a dedicated CNN incorporating parallel max/average pooling fusion, dual output heads for classification and regression, and systematic data augmentation. For pure chili oils, the CNN achieved 100% identification accuracy, outperforming KNN (90.00%), SVM (94.44%), and LDA (99.26%). For complex compounded chili oils involving different oil types, chili varieties, and additives, the CNN maintained 99.63% accuracy and macro F1 score, surpassing KNN (84.44%), SVM (88.15%), and LDA (96.67%). For capsaicin quantification across both simplified and complex matrices, the CNN consistently outperformed PLS-R with higher R² values and lower RMSE and MAE, demonstrating superior quantitative accuracy and robustness against matrix interference. This work demonstrates that the synergistic integration of CPD-based universal receptors and a SERS-tailored multi-task CNN enables rapid, accurate, and on-site-ready detection of chili oil and analogous edible oil products.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种用于辣椒油快速品质识别的表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）化学舌，并结合定制卷积神经网络进行分析。研究将三种碳化聚合物点功能化的磁核-银壳纳米颗粒作为交叉响应传感器，形成互补指纹并拼接为“超级光谱”，从而提升对复杂油基体系中辣椒素等成分的检测稳定性与灵敏度。实验表明，该方法在纯辣椒油识别和复杂复配样品分类中均表现出优于多种传统机器学习方法的性能。

articles.title: Evaluation of the biostimulant potential of microalgae extract in improving argan seed (Argania spinosa L. Skeels) germination performance under salinity stress condition
articles.title_zh: 微藻提取物作为生物刺激剂提升盐胁迫下阿甘种子萌发性能的评价
articles.abstract: Seed germination is often challenged by several environmental constraints, such as salinity stress, which affect germination performance and plant establishment. In the case of argan seeds, optimizing the germination process is considered pivotal for a successful establishment. Therefore, this study evaluated the potential of a microalgae extract to enhance argan seed germination performance and alleviate salt-induced germination inhibition. The results demonstrated that under non-saline and saline conditions, the optimal dose of 1 g/L effectively enhanced germination performance and mitigated stress by doubling the germination rate (+ 50% to 130%), while stimulating radicle elongation (+ 69 to 105%), and increasing the seedling vigor index (2-fold to 4-fold). Biochemically, microalgae application maximized osmotic adjustment and macromolecular protection by boosting soluble sugar and total protein content, while strongly stimulating the synthesis of polyphenols and flavonoids. At the same time, the application of the biostimulant alleviated the seed’s physiological distress, whereas untreated seeds showcased major oxidative crisis marked by the accumulation of proline and hyperactivation of antioxidant enzymes (superoxide dismutase, peroxidase, polyphenol oxidase), whilst the application of the microalgae reduced antioxidant enzyme activity and osmoprotectant content. In conclusion, the microalgae extract application induced effective protective priming, constituting a promising agroecological strategy for supporting argan seed germination in arid saline areas.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文评估了微藻提取物对阿甘种子在盐胁迫条件下萌发与幼苗建立的促进作用。结果表明，适宜浓度的微藻提取物可显著提高萌发率、促进胚根伸长，并增强幼苗活力指数。机制上，该处理通过提高可溶性糖、总蛋白、酚类和黄酮含量来改善渗透调节与大分子保护，同时缓解盐胁迫下的氧化损伤与生理失调。

articles.title: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy reveals ventrolateral prefrontal cortex neural efficiency in instantaneous decision-making by basketball experts
articles.title_zh: 功能近红外光谱揭示篮球专家在即时决策中的腹外侧前额叶神经效率
articles.abstract: In highly dynamic sports such as basketball, rapid decision-making under extreme time pressure is a hallmark of perceptual-cognitive expertise. Although the neural efficiency hypothesis (NEH) provides a framework for experts' superior performance, its spatiotemporal boundaries in complex tactical contexts remain underexplored. This study examined prefrontal hemodynamics during instantaneous basketball decision-making. Thirty-two participants (16 experts, 16 novices) viewed ecologically valid basketball offensive videos and rapidly predicted the ball-carrier's next move while functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) monitored prefrontal hemodynamics across four consecutive task blocks. Behaviorally, experts showed higher decision accuracy and efficiency. Neuroimaging revealed a spatiotemporally specific neural efficiency pattern. Spatially, the expert advantage was localized to lower activation in the ventrolateral prefrontal cortex (VLPFC), with no significant group differences in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC), suggesting a "resource redirection" strategy that bypasses general cognitive hubs. Experts' VLPFC activation correlated negatively with decision-making efficiency, whereas novices showed a positive correlation, consistent with inefficient cognitive compensation. Temporally, the effect was most pronounced during the mid-task phase (Block 2), after initial cognitive adaptation. These findings extend the NEH by identifying VLPFC-specific spatial pathways and a stage-specific temporal window in basketball decision-making.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究采用功能近红外光谱技术考察篮球专家在高时空压力下的即时决策过程。结果显示，专家在判断球员下一步动作时表现出更高的准确率和效率，并且其优势主要对应于腹外侧前额叶皮层较低的激活水平，而背外侧前额叶皮层未见显著组间差异。研究提示，专家可能通过“资源重定向”实现更高效的决策加工，且腹外侧前额叶激活与决策效率呈负相关。

articles.title: Tangent-Plane Evidential Uncertainty in Active Learning for Magnetic Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 磁性原子间势主动学习中的切平面证据不确定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.12353v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic interatomic potentials need to account for coupled lattice and spin degrees of freedom, yet constructing reliable training sets remains costly because noncollinear first-principles labels are expensive. Active learning can mitigate this cost, provided that the uncertainty estimate is physically meaningful for the magnetic-response targets that drive spin reorientation. Here we extend the e²IP evidential framework to magnetic machine-learning interatomic potentials by formulating the projected spin-force likelihood and the corresponding epistemic uncertainty in the tangent plane orthogonal to the local spin direction. This construction prevents the uncertainty model from allocating probability mass to a radial spin component that is absent from the constrained-moment supervision. Using bulk BiFeO₃ and monolayer CrTe₂ as benchmark systems, we show that the resulting tangent-plane epistemic uncertainty indicator Uₑₚᵢsf correlates strongly with prediction error and selects more informative configurations than random sampling, simultaneously improving energy, force, and projected spin-force accuracy. These results demonstrate a physically interpretable and data-efficient route for constructing uncertainty-aware magnetic machine-learning interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将证据不确定性框架扩展到磁性机器学习原子间势，针对与局域自旋方向正交的切平面内投影自旋力构建似然与模型不确定性。该设计避免了不应出现在受约束监督中的径向自旋分量对不确定性估计的干扰。以 BiFeO₃ 和单层 CrTe₂ 为基准体系的结果表明，所定义的切平面证据不确定性指标与预测误差高度相关，并能优于随机采样选择更有信息量的构型，从而提升能量、力和投影自旋力的预测精度。
authors: Yang Cheng, Hongyu Yu, Hongjun Xiang

articles.title: Anomalous resonance in Weyl semimetals: A holographic study of non-linear effects
articles.title_zh: Weyl半金属中的反常共振：非线性效应的全息研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.10754v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We consider hairy, magnetic black brane solutions to Einstein-Maxwell-Chern-Simons-dilaton theory with full back-reaction of the scalar and gauge fields and compute the time evolution with time dependent sources. The dual field theory's 't Hooft anomaly leads to long-lived current oscillations in the low temperature limit long after the electric pulse which created these modes has been switched off. We find that, generally, non-linear effects increase the decay rates of long-lived modes by a temperature dependent amount. Nonetheless, our results suggest that the life-time of time-translation symmetry breaking states can be made arbitrarily large if the temperature after the quench is sufficiently small. Experimentally this might be realizable in Weyl semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-卡西米尔-狄拉克-膨胀子理论的带毛磁黑膜解，研究了外场驱动下的时间演化及其对应的边界物理。结果表明，由't Hooft 异常引起的电流振荡在低温下具有很长寿命，即使激发它们的电脉冲结束后仍可持续存在。作者进一步发现，非线性效应通常会增加长寿命模的衰减率，但在足够低的温度下，时间平移对称性破缺态的寿命仍可变得任意长，这一现象可能在 Weyl 半金属中得到实验实现。
authors: Maximilian Gaschler, Andreas Schäfer, Sebastian Waeber

articles.title: Exploring fixed points and eigenstates of quantum systems with reinforcement learning
articles.title_zh: 利用强化学习探索量子系统的固定点与本征态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.17491v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a reinforcement learning algorithm designed to identify the fixed points of a given quantum operation. The method iteratively constructs the unitary transformation that maps the computational basis onto the basis of fixed points through a reward-penalty scheme based on quantum measurements. In cases where the operation corresponds to a Hamiltonian evolution, this task reduces to determining the Hamiltonian eigenstates. The algorithm is first benchmarked on random Hamiltonians acting on two and three qubits and then applied to many-body systems of up to six qubits, including the transverse-field Ising model and the all-to-all pairing Hamiltonian. In both cases, the algorithm is demonstrated to perform successfully; in the pairing model, it can also reveal hidden symmetries, which can be exploited to restrict learning to specific symmetry sectors. Finally, we discuss the possibility of post-selecting high-fidelity states even when full convergence has not been reached.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种强化学习算法，用于识别给定量子操作的固定点。该方法通过量子测量反馈的奖惩机制，迭代构造将计算基映射到固定点基底的幺正变换；当量子操作对应哈密顿量演化时，该任务可转化为求取哈密顿量本征态。作者将算法应用于随机哈密顿量以及最多六比特的多体模型，结果表明其具有良好性能，并且在配对模型中还能揭示可用于限制学习空间的隐藏对称性。
authors: María Laura Olivera-Atencio, Jesús Casado-Pascual, Denis Lacroix
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种强化学习算法，旨在识别给定量子操作的不动点。该方法通过基于量子测量的奖惩机制，迭代构造将计算基映射到不动点基的酉变换。在该操作对应于哈密顿量演化的情形下，这一任务化约为确定哈密顿量本征态。该算法首先在作用于二量子比特和三量子比特的随机哈密顿量上进行基准测试，随后应用于多达六个量子比特的多体系统，包括横场伊辛模型和全连接配对哈密顿量。在这两种情况下，算法都被证明能够成功运行；在配对模型中，它还可以揭示隐藏对称性，而这些对称性可被用来将学习限制在特定对称性扇区内。最后，我们讨论了即使在尚未达到完全收敛时对高保真态进行后选择的可能性。

articles.title: Cavity Control of Strongly Correlated Electrons Beyond Resonant Coupling
articles.title_zh: 超越共振耦合的腔场调控强关联电子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.18933v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Interfacing materials with electromagnetic cavities offers a route to modify equilibrium properties through structured vacuum fluctuations. The coupling between light and correlated electrons lacks a characteristic energy scale, making vacuum induced ground state modifications of such systems inherently off-resonant and sensitive to the full photon mode structure. We develop a consistent cavity-QED formalism for dispersive electromagnetic environments in the Coulomb gauge, capturing both dynamical dressing via the vector potential and static screening by the dielectric. With this formalism, we perform a non-perturbative study of the cavity-induced modification of magnetism in the Hubbard model close to half-filling, including all cavity modes and with parameters determined from first principles. At half-filling, we show that the modification of the magnetic exchange interaction J is controlled by a generalized Purcell factor, proportional to the frequency integrated photonic density of states relative to free space. This result identifies polaritonic surface cavities as promising platforms to modify correlated systems. For the surface cavity a competition between static screening and dynamical dressing via the vector potential leads to a net enhancement of J, directly observable in two-magnon Raman spectroscopy. The inclusion of screening is essential to obtain even qualitatively correct results. At weak doping, a variational exact diagonalization of the cavity-coupled t-J polaron reveals that a low-frequency surface cavity can reverse the nodal-antinodal dichotomy of the bare polaron dispersion. This effect lies beyond mean field theory and is observable via ARPES measurements. Our framework establishes a concrete design principle linking cavity geometry to material response in the off-resonant regime, which will guide future experimental and theoretical explorations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了适用于色散电磁环境的自洽腔量子电动力学形式主义，在库仑规范下同时描述矢势引起的动态修饰和介电屏蔽效应。基于该框架，作者对半填充附近 Hubbard 模型中的腔诱导磁性修饰进行了非微扰研究，并纳入全部腔模以及第一性原理参数。结果表明，在半填充条件下，磁交换作用 J 的变化可由广义 Purcell 因子控制，即与相对于自由空间积分后的光子态密度有关，这为利用表面极化激元腔调控强关联体系提供了思路。
authors: Lukas Grunwald, Xinle Cheng, Emil Viñas Boström, Michael Ruggenthaler, Marios H. Michael, Dante M. Kennes, Angel Rubio
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将材料与电磁腔相结合，为通过结构化真空涨落改变平衡性质提供了一条途径。光与关联电子之间的耦合缺乏特征能标，这使得此类系统由真空诱导的基态改变在本质上是离共振的，并且对完整的光子模结构敏感。我们在库仑规范下发展了一套适用于色散电磁环境的一致腔量子电动力学形式体系，同时捕捉由矢势产生的动态修饰以及由介电体产生的静态屏蔽。借助这一形式体系，我们对接近半填充的 Hubbard 模型中腔诱导的磁性改变进行了非微扰研究，其中包含所有腔模，并且参数由第一性原理确定。在半填充时，我们表明磁交换相互作用 J 的改变由一个广义 Purcell 因子控制，该因子正比于相对于自由空间的频率积分光子态密度。这一结果表明，极化激元表面腔是调控关联系统的有前景平台。对于表面腔，静态屏蔽与通过矢势产生的动态修饰之间的竞争导致 J 的净增强，这可在双磁振子拉曼光谱中直接观测到。纳入屏蔽对于获得哪怕只是定性正确的结果都是必不可少的。在弱掺杂下，对腔耦合 t-J 极化子进行的变分精确对角化显示，低频表面腔可以反转裸极化子色散的节点—反节点二分性。这一效应超越平均场理论，并可通过角分辨光电子能谱测量观测到。我们的框架建立了一条将腔几何与离共振区材料响应相联系的具体设计原则，将指导未来的实验和理论探索。

articles.title: MolCryst-MLIPs: A Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials Database for Molecular Crystals
articles.title_zh: MolCryst-MLIPs：面向分子晶体的机器学习原子间势数据库
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.13897v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present an open Molecular Crystal (MC) database of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials (MLIP) called MolCryst-MLIPs. The first release comprises fine-tuned MACE models for nine molecular crystal systems---Benzamide, Benzoic acid, Coumarin, Durene, Isonicotinamide, Nicotinic acid , Niacinamide, Pyrazinamide, and Resorcinol---developed using the Automated Machine Learning Pipeline (AMLP), which streamlines the entire MLIP development workflow, from reference data generation to model training and validation, into a reproducible and user-friendly pipeline. Models are fine-tuned from the MACE-MH-1 foundation model omol head), yielding a mean energy MAE of 0.141 kJ/mol/atom and a mean force MAE of 0.648 kJ/mol/Angstrom across all systems. Benchmarked against three state-of-the-art foundation models on the DFT-labelled polymorph set, only the fine-tuned models resolve the polymorphic energy landscape. Dynamical stability and structural integrity, as assessed through energy conservation, P2 orientational order parameters, and radial distribution functions, are evaluated using molecular dynamics simulations. The released models and datasets constitute a growing open database of validated MLIPs, ready for production MD simulations of molecular crystal polymorphism across the polymorphic landscape of each target compound under different thermodynamic conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发布了一个开放的分子晶体机器学习原子间势数据库 MolCryst-MLIPs。首批版本包含针对九种分子晶体体系微调的 MACE 模型，并通过自动化机器学习流程将参考数据生成、模型训练与验证整合为可复现且易用的管线。结果显示，微调后的模型在能量和力的精度上表现良好，并且在多晶型能量景观与分子动力学稳定性评估中具有较强优势。
authors: Adam Lahouari, Shen Ai, Jihye Han, Jillian Hoffstadt, Philipp Hoellmer, Charlotte Infante, Pulkita Jain, Sangram Kadam, Maya M. Martirossyan, Amara McCune, Hypatia Newton, Shlok J. Paul, Willmor Pena, Jonathan Raghoonanan, Sumon Sahu, Oliver Tan, Andrea Vergara, Jutta Rogal, Mark E. Tuckerman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一个开放的分子晶体机器学习原子间势数据库，称为 MolCryst-MLIPs。首个版本包括针对九种分子晶体体系——苯甲酰胺、苯甲酸、香豆素、均四甲苯、异烟酰胺、烟酸、烟酰胺、吡嗪酰胺和间苯二酚——的微调 MACE 模型，这些模型使用自动化机器学习流程开发，该流程将从参考数据生成到模型训练与验证的整个 MLIP 开发工作流，简化为可复现且用户友好的流程。模型从 MACE-MH-1 基础模型 omol head 进行微调，在所有体系上得到的平均能量平均绝对误差为 0.141 kJ/mol/atom，平均力平均绝对误差为 0.648 kJ/mol/Angstrom。在 DFT 标注的多晶型集合上与三种最先进基础模型进行基准比较时，只有微调模型能够解析多晶型能量景观。通过分子动力学模拟，利用能量守恒、P2 取向有序参数和径向分布函数来评估动力学稳定性和结构完整性。所发布的模型和数据集构成了一个不断增长的开放验证 MLIP 数据库，可直接用于在不同热力学条件下，对各目标化合物跨多晶型景观的分子晶体多晶型进行生产级分子动力学模拟。
