Additionally, it integrates an Attention U-Net with uniform grid discretization, enabling the extraction of both fine and coarse features. The model also utilizes K-hop sampling to construct subgraphs, facilitating efficient training on large datasets while preserving detailed local features. We evaluated ME-GNN on three benchmark datasets and achieved state-of-the-art results: a relative L2 error of 0.0196 for the velocity field and 0.0556 for the surface pressure on ShapeNet-Car, a normalized mean squared error of 0.0033 for the flow field on AirfRANS, and a relative L2 error of 0.1416 for the surface pressure on DrivAerNet.
articles.abstract_zh: 车辆和航空航天等工业设计常依赖大规模数值模拟评估流体性能，计算代价高昂。本文提出多尺度特征增强图神经网络ME-GNN，通过两步消息传递捕获局部细节，并结合基于均匀网格离散的Attention U-Net提取细尺度与粗尺度特征。模型还采用K跳采样构建子图，以在大规模数据上高效训练并保留局部信息；在三个基准数据集上的实验表明其达到先进性能。
authors: Li Xiao, Tianyu Li, Yiye Zou, Mingjie Zhang, Xiaogangd Deng

articles.title: Parameter estimation for land-surface models using Neural Physics
articles.title_zh: 使用神经物理进行陆面模型参数估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.02979v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a novel inverse-modelling approach that estimates the parameters of a simple land-surface model (LSM) by assimilating data into a differentiable, physics-based forward model formulated using convolutional operations. The governing equations are expressed within the Neural Physics framework, allowing direct gradient-based optimisation of time-dependent parameters without the need to derive and maintain adjoint formulations. The model parameters are estimated by minimising the mismatch between model predictions and synthetic or observational data. Although differentiability is enabled through machine-learning libraries, the forward model itself remains entirely physics-based and neither the forward model nor the parameter estimation procedure involve training. To evaluate the approach, we first generate synthetic observations of soil temperature by running the forward model with known parameter values and subsequently treat these parameters as unknown in an inverse problem. We show that observations of soil temperature at a single depth are insufficient to reliably constrain the model parameters. Using observations at two depths, however, does yield reliable parameter estimates, although the individual contributions of latent and sensible heat fluxes cannot be distinguished. We also apply the approach to urban flux tower data from Phoenix, United States, and show that the thermal conductivity, volumetric heat capacity and the combined sensible-latent heat transfer coefficient can be reliably estimated whilst using an observed value for the effective surface albedo. The resulting model accurately predicts the outgoing longwave radiation, conductive soil fluxes and the combined sensible-latent heat fluxes, demonstrating that the Neural Physics framework can be used to accurately determine the parameters of the particular LSM used here...
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种反演建模方法，通过将数据同化到由卷积操作构建的可微物理前向模型中，估计简单陆面模型的参数。控制方程在Neural Physics框架下表达，使得无需推导和维护伴随方程即可对随时间变化的参数进行梯度优化。作者在合成土壤温度观测以及观测数据场景中评估该方法，指出单一深度温度观测不足以可靠约束参数，而多深度观测能提供更强约束。
authors: Ruiyue Huang, Claire E. Heaney, Maarten van Reeuwijk

articles.title: Quantum-Inspired Contextual Learning for Sparse-Ring Fraud Detection in Dynamic Transaction Graphs
articles.title_zh: 面向动态交易图中稀疏环欺诈检测的量子启发上下文学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an exploratory benchmark and quantum-inspired modeling prototype for fraud screening in dynamic financial transaction graphs. Coordinated fraud may not be visible from individual transactions alone, but may emerge as a multi-period relational pattern. We focus on sparse-ring fraud, a stylized pattern in which a completed directed cycle is distributed across several days, requiring models to integrate evidence across both time and graph structure. We study this problem using a synthetic transaction simulator with completed sparse-ring injections and broken-ring decoys. Daily directed transaction graphs are aggregated into rolling windows and represented using raw graph features, persistent-homology summaries, or hybrid feature vectors that combine both. We compare a gated recurrent unit (GRU) baseline with quantum-inspired Contextual Machine Learning (CML) as sequence-level classifiers. Because the benchmark uses synthetic data, a modest sample size, and sequence-level labels, the results are exploratory. Within this scope, topology-only summaries are too compressed to solve the supervised ring-completion task by themselves, largely because they remove account-pair identity and edge direction. The strongest results come from hybrid representations that combine identity-preserving graph features with topological summaries. These findings suggest that topology is most useful as a contextual layer over dynamic graph features, and that CML is a promising candidate model for fraud patterns whose evidence is distributed across temporal and relational context.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一个探索性基准和量子启发建模原型，用于动态金融交易图中的欺诈筛查。作者关注“稀疏环欺诈”，即完整有向循环跨多个日期分散出现，需要模型同时整合时间与图结构证据。研究使用合成交易模拟器生成完整稀疏环和破碎环干扰样本，并比较GRU与量子启发的上下文机器学习模型；结果表明，仅依赖拓扑摘要可能过度压缩信息，难以单独完成环完成识别任务。

articles.title: Discovering Latent Response Laws in Forced Physical Systems
articles.title_zh: 强迫物理系统中潜在响应规律的发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09801v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Governing equations provide compact descriptions of physical systems, yet the variables in which they are simple are often hidden in high-dimensional measurements. This challenge is sharper for forced systems, whose responses depend on both intrinsic dynamics and time-dependent inputs. Here we introduce FLARE, a forced latent autoencoder for response equations that learns compact response coordinates, identifies sparse input-dependent latent dynamics and decodes equation rollouts to full responses. By estimating latent dimension from data and separating state estimation from external forcing, FLARE enables forecasts to be initialized from past responses and driven by prescribed future inputs. Across known dynamical systems, application-scale forced responses and visual observations, FLARE recovers compact forced dynamics and predicts long-horizon high-dimensional responses under inputs not used for training. By turning learned coordinates into a dynamical interface, FLARE extends equation discovery to systems whose effective states are hidden within complex observations, providing a route for interpretable modelling and prediction of high-dimensional responses in forced dynamical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理系统的控制方程通常很简洁，但使其简洁的变量往往隐藏在高维观测中，强迫系统还需同时处理内在动力学与时变输入。本文提出FLARE，一种用于响应方程发现的强迫潜在自编码器，可学习紧凑响应坐标、识别稀疏且依赖输入的潜在动力学，并将方程滚动预测解码为完整响应。实验表明，FLARE能够从数据估计潜在维度，在未见过的输入下实现长时程高维响应预测，并为复杂观测中的可解释建模提供动力学接口。
authors: Yi Zhu, Su Chen, Xiaojun Li, Xiuli Du

articles.title: The Differential Neural Tangent Kernel and Its Positivity
articles.title_zh: 微分神经切线核及其正性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) is one powerful tool for analyzing the training dynamics of neural networks in the over-parameterized regime. Recently, the theoretical framework has been extended to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving linear PDEs, one highly popular class of neural PDE solvers. In the analysis, the positivity of the associated NTK plays a fundamental role. However, establishing the positivity of the NTK for PINNs is highly challenging, due to the presence of multiple differential operators. In this work, we propose a new theoretical framework, called Differential Neural Tangent Kernel (DNTK), for analyzing PINNs through the lens of the NTK, and establish the positivity of the infinite width DNTK for both shallow and deep neural networks for a wide class of activation functions, including RePU and smooth but non-polynomial activations, for all linear differential operators. These theoretical results lay the foundation for the analysis of gradient type algorithms for training PINNs.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经切线核是分析过参数化神经网络训练动力学的重要工具，并已被扩展到求解线性偏微分方程的物理信息神经网络中。由于PINN涉及多个微分算子，其相关NTK正性的证明具有挑战性。本文提出微分神经切线核DNTK理论框架，并针对浅层和深层网络、广泛激活函数以及所有线性微分算子证明无限宽DNTK的正性，为分析PINN的梯度型训练算法奠定基础。

articles.title: Weight-Adjusted Gradients Reveal Parameter Importance and Failure Modes in LLMs
articles.title_zh: 权重调整梯度揭示大语言模型中的参数重要性与失效模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10803v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding which parameters are influential in Large Language Models (LLMs) is central to improving their efficiency, reliability, and interpretability. We introduce Weight-Adjusted Gradients (WAG), a simple yet effective approach for estimating parameter importance that explicitly captures the interaction between model weights and first-order gradient information and identifies parameters that disproportionately influence model behavior, such as those responsible for collapse phenomena in LLMs. Across a range of models and settings, we show that WAG surfaces a tiny but critical subset of parameters whose modification leads to dramatic degradation in performance, a failure mode that existing importance metrics overlook. These findings reveal a previously underexplored interplay between weights and gradients, suggesting that parameter importance cannot be fully understood through either signal alone. The surprising effectiveness of WAG points to fundamental structural properties of trained networks and motivates new open questions about the role of zeroth-order and first-order information in deep learning. We demonstrate the practical utility of WAG across multiple applications, including expert allocation in mixture-of-expert architectures, parameter-specific unlearning, mixed-precision quantization, and layer selection for knowledge editing. Our results position WAG as a unified approach for analyzing, debugging, and controlling LLMs, and opens new directions for principled model-level interpretation.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解大语言模型中哪些参数具有关键影响，对于提升效率、可靠性和可解释性至关重要。本文提出权重调整梯度WAG，通过显式结合模型权重与一阶梯度信息来估计参数重要性。实验显示，WAG能够发现一小部分但至关重要的参数，修改这些参数会导致性能剧烈退化，而现有重要性指标往往忽视这种失效模式；这揭示了训练后网络中权重与梯度之间未被充分研究的相互作用。
authors: Shrestha Datta, Hongfu Liu, Anshuman Chhabra

articles.title: Bandit PCA with Minimax Optimal Regret
articles.title_zh: 具有极小极大最优遗憾的强盗反馈主成分分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the bandit-feedback version of online principal component analysis (Bandit PCA): in each round t = 1,dots,T, the adversary selects a d × d symmetric gain matrix Gₜ with spectrum in [0,1] and rank at most r; the learner simultaneously selects a unit vector wₜ in Sd⁻¹ and receives the reward wₜ^→p Gₜ wₜ. The learner receives no other feedback, and aims to minimize the regret against the best unit vector in hindsight. This problem was introduced by Kotlowski and Neu (2019), who gave an algorithm with regret O(dsqrtrT łog T) and showed the lower bound of Ømega(rsqrtT/łog T). We improve upon both of these bounds and essentially bridge the gap between them, establishing the minimax regret of order rsqrtdT up to polylogarithmic factors in d and T. The upper bound is attained by a novel algorithm, which combines online mirror descent on the spectrahedron of (real) density matrices with a multiscale exploration scheme in which the eigenspaces with different spectral magnitudes are updated at different rates. For the lower bound, we construct an adaptive adversary that refines a hidden large-reward subspace based on the learner's actions, in such a way that low regret is impossible without estimating the subspace; as a result, lower-bounding the regret reduces to studying the arising subspace estimation problem. Finally, we discuss connections of Bandit PCA with adaptive-measurement quantum tomography.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论在线主成分分析的强盗反馈版本：每轮学习者选择单位向量，仅获得与对手给定对称增益矩阵相关的二次型奖励，并需相对于事后最佳单位向量最小化遗憾。作者改进了既有上下界，基本弥合差距，给出在维度和时间的多对数因子内达到极小极大最优阶的遗憾界。上界来自一种结合谱体上在线镜像下降和多尺度探索的新算法，下界则通过自适应对手构造实现。
authors: Moïse Blanchard, Dmitrii Ostrovskii, Aadirupa Saha

articles.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Zero-Dimensional Reduced-Order Model Planning
articles.title_zh: 面向零维降阶模型规划的多智能体框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Zero-dimensional reduced-order models (0D ROMs) are central to multi-dimensional design workflows for high-end complex equipment. However, the planning process currently relies on manual expertise, limiting topological exploration and prolonging iterations. Even traditional optimization methods such as Genetic Algorithms (GA) are typically confined to local parameter tuning. Although Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise in exploring large sample spaces, and frameworks such as Chain of Thought (CoT) and Reason and Act (ReAct) improve reasoning reliability, while Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) overcomes domain knowledge barriers, a single agent still falls short for the long-horizon and highly coupled nature of complex 0D ROM planning. This paper proposes the Zero-dimensional reduced-order model CO-Planning framework (Z-COPA), a multi-agent architecture featuring a Symbolic Action Graph Engine (SAGE) and a MILP-Guided Navigation (MGN) optimizer. Its core innovation is a dedicated graph representation method that accurately encodes the 0D flow network topology, converting the empirical planning process into a rigorous graph structure optimization problem. We validate the forward and inverse design capabilities and generalization performance of Z-COPA on two real aircraft engine secondary-air systems, two IEEE power-distribution reconfiguration benchmarks, and two water-distribution network benchmarks. The results show superior task completion quality, obtaining the best performance in both forward and reverse design of air systems. Z-COPA disrupts the traditional 0D model planning paradigm, providing a new technical approach for exploring broader topological space and achieving highly automated, globally optimal air system architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 零维降阶模型是高端复杂装备多维设计流程中的核心工具，但现有规划高度依赖人工经验，限制拓扑探索并延长迭代周期。本文提出Z-COPA零维降阶模型协同规划框架，采用多智能体架构，并引入符号动作图引擎和MILP引导导航优化器。其核心在于用专门的图表示准确编码0D流动网络拓扑，将经验式规划转化为更严格、可搜索的规划过程。
authors: Bingteng Sun, Hao Yin, Yiling Chen, Renjie Xiao, Lei Xie, Shanyou Wang, Ruonan Wang, Shubao Chen, Qingzong Xu, Lin Lu, Qiang Du, Junqiang Zhu

articles.title: Multi-dimensional training-priority weighting based on physical information propagation paths: a unified residual-weighting framework for physics-informed neural networks
articles.title_zh: 基于物理信息传播路径的多维训练优先级加权：物理信息神经网络的统一残差加权框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11094v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have shown promise for solving partial differential equations (PDEs); however, their synchronous optimization treats residuals of different regions and constraints equally, which is inconsistent with the progressive "from source to response" physical information propagation path, degrading training stability and accuracy. Existing causal training methods focus mainly on the temporal dimension, lacking a unified characterization of spatial and boundary dimensions. To address this, we define a unified class of training priorities according to the physical information propagation path: premise regions should be learned before dependent regions; temporal, spatial, and boundary priorities are instances of this principle. Using neural tangent kernel (NTK) dynamics, we theoretically analyze why standard PINNs do not obey this priority: their residual convergence order is governed by the NTK spectrum and is independent of the propagation path. Accordingly, we propose a unified multi-dimensional priority-constraint framework that partitions the domain along the propagation path and constructs negative-exponential residual weights, converting the physical propagation order into a training priority. For cases with coexisting priorities, we introduce a directional compatibility coefficient to clarify that "orthogonal directions can be coupled multiplicatively in synergy, whereas coaxial opposite directions cannot." Benchmark cases show that this method consistently improves the convergence behavior and prediction accuracy of PINNs on problems with clear propagation paths or constraint-dominated structures, without modifying the network architecture and with controllable additional computational cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络在求解偏微分方程方面具有潜力，但常规同步优化将不同区域和约束的残差同等对待，违背了从源到响应的物理信息传播顺序，从而影响训练稳定性与精度。本文将时间、空间和边界优先级统一表述为沿物理传播路径的训练优先原则，并借助神经切线核动力学解释标准PINN为何不自然遵循该顺序。作者进一步提出多维优先级约束框架，通过沿传播路径划分区域并构造残差加权机制，以改善PINN训练。
authors: Zhangyi Lian, Xinda Dong, Wenxuan Huo, Weifeng Huang, Gang Zhu, Qiang He

articles.title: SPARC-Net: A Spectral, Causality-Aware, and Hard-Constrained Physics-Informed Architecture for Stiff and Shock-Dominated Partial Differential Equations
articles.title_zh: SPARC-Net：用于刚性和激波主导偏微分方程的谱、因果感知与硬约束物理信息架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) provide a meshless approach for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), but suffer severe degradation in stiff and shock-dominated problems, where small PDE residuals can correspond to globally inaccurate solutions. We show these failures are multi-causal, arising from the concurrent interplay of (i) spectral bias against sharp features, (ii) imbalanced multi-term optimization and loss-weight collapse, (iii) violation of temporal causality, and (iv) under-resolved collocation. We present SPARC-Net, a unified architecture and training framework that jointly addresses all four pathologies. SPARC-Net leverages an adaptive multi-scale spectral encoder with a learnable spectral gate, a gated residual backbone, adaptive activations, and a hard-constraint output ansatz that exactly enforces initial and boundary conditions, structurally eliminating loss-weight collapse. Training employs stabilized gradient-norm loss balancing, floored causality-respecting residual weighting, and residual-based adaptive collocation (RAD). Validated against exact analytic and high-order spectral reference solutions across four canonical benchmarks -- viscous Burgers', Allen-Cahn, convection (beta=30), and reaction -- SPARC-Net yields substantial improvements over vanilla PINNs: relative L2 error drops from 1.47e-1 to 1.14e-1 on Burgers' (22% reduction), 9.93e-1 to 5.78e-2 on Allen-Cahn (94% reduction), and 9.82e-1 to 3.54e-3 on reaction (100% reduction). A characteristic-coordinate encoder for hyperbolic transport further reduces convection error from 5.14e-1 to 9.88e-5 (100% reduction). We report five-seed mean +/- standard deviation errors, Wilcoxon significance tests, full ablation studies, hyperparameter sensitivities, an extension to the 2D heat equation, and comparisons against parameter-matched baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络虽可无网格求解偏微分方程，但在刚性和激波主导问题中容易出现小残差却全局解不准确的退化。本文指出这些失败源于谱偏置、损失项不平衡与权重塌缩、时间因果性违背以及配点分辨不足等多重因素共同作用。作者提出SPARC-Net，结合自适应多尺度谱编码器、可学习谱门控、门控残差骨干、自适应激活和硬约束输出形式，并配合稳定化损失平衡、因果残差加权和基于残差的自适应配点，以提升此类PDE问题的求解能力。
authors: Divyavardhan Singh, Dimple Sonone, Hammad Mohammad, Kishor Upla

articles.title: IG-GAN: A Generative Adversarial Network for Aerodynamic Data Generation Based on Intrinsic Geometry
articles.title_zh: IG-GAN：一种基于内在几何的气动数据生成对抗网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing generative models learn data distributions in flat Euclidean space. However, most data in our real world are manifolds embedded in high dimensional Euclidean space. Therefore, we propose an intrinsic-geometry-based generative adversarial network (IG-GAN) for data generation in the field of aerodynamics. The generator of the IG-GAN represents aerodynamic data as a piecewise smooth manifold constructed by Bézier surfaces, and the generator tries to learn the coefficients of each Bézier surface to further combine multiple Bézier surfaces into a smooth manifold automatically. The discriminator in the IG-GAN is a radial-basis-function based discriminator (RBF-D). Experimental results show that IG-GAN achieves lower predicted Mean Squared Errors (MSEs) than those of three baselines. Specifically, on the Burgers' equation dataset, IG-GAN reduces the predicted MSE of velocity u by 97.41% compared with state of the art SSL-Transformer. Additionally, on the ONERA M6 aircraft dataset, IG-GAN reduces the overall MSE of nine aerodynamic coefficients by 82.95% compared with SSL-Transformer.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出面向气动数据生成的内在几何生成对抗网络 IG-GAN，认为真实高维数据常位于嵌入欧氏空间的流形上，而非平坦空间中。其生成器用 Bézier 曲面构造分片光滑流形并学习曲面系数，判别器采用基于径向基函数的结构。实验表明，IG-GAN 在 Burgers 方程和 ONERA M6 飞机数据集上相较多个基线显著降低预测均方误差。
authors: Ying Yan, Liwei Hu, Xiaoming Zhang

articles.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
articles.title_zh: 面向节俭神经架构搜索的 Transformer 引导群体智能方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has automated the design of deep learning models but traditionally requires massive computational resources, often measured in thousands of GPU-days. In this paper, we propose a frugal and memetic NAS framework designed to democratize architecture design on consumer-grade hardware. Our approach combines the global macro-search capabilities of an autoregressive Transformer controller, trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL), with the local micro-exploitation of an Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm. To prevent premature convergence during the RL phase, we introduce a dynamic entropy mechanism that forces topological exploration upon detection of performance stagnation. Evaluated on a standard GPU (NVIDIA RTX 3060), our hybrid method effectively resolves the "cold-start" problem inherent in metaheuristics. By algorithmically penalizing network depth, our framework actively mitigates model bloat: on the CIFAR-10 dataset, it discovers an efficient architecture reaching 84.85% accuracy with only sim174,000 parameters (significantly smaller than standard baselines like ResNet-20) in 3 hours of search time. Furthermore, we demonstrate the framework's flexibility by applying it to credit card fraud detection, directly optimizing the F1-Score on highly imbalanced tabular data to reach a F1-Score of 0.71 with a compact network of sim4,600 parameters. These results suggest that our approach can yield tailored, accessible, and highly parameter-efficient deep learning models suitable for edge deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种可在消费级硬件上运行的节俭型、模因式神经架构搜索框架，将自回归 Transformer 控制器的全局宏观搜索与人工蜂群算法的局部开发能力结合。方法引入动态熵机制以缓解强化学习阶段的早熟收敛，并通过惩罚网络深度抑制模型膨胀。在 CIFAR-10 上，该框架用约 3 小时搜索得到参数量较小且具备一定精度的架构。

articles.title: When Classical Baselines Are Tuned as Carefully as the Quantum Model, Does Quantum Reservoir Computing Still Win?
articles.title_zh: 当经典基线与量子模型同样精细调参时，量子储备计算仍然占优吗？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09905v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Can a small quantum computer forecast a changing signal better than an ordinary classical method? Many studies say yes, but the classical methods they compare against are often left in a basic, untuned state while the quantum model is carefully optimised. We ask what happens when the classical competitor is given exactly the same care: the same size and the same amount of tuning effort. We study two popular reasons a quantum reservoir is thought to help, using exact simulations of small quantum systems (up to eleven qubits) on prediction tasks. In both cases the quantum advantage disappears once the comparison is fair. In the first, extra quantum measurements add nothing that a simple classical formula of the same size does not already provide. In the second, a feedback loop genuinely helps the quantum model, turning a useless setup into a working predictor, yet a well-tuned classical network still predicts slightly more accurately, and the gap is statistically reliable. Our point is not that quantum reservoirs can never win, but that two of their commonly cited advantages do not hold up against fair classical competitors at this scale. We provide these matched comparisons as a simple, reusable checklist for honest benchmarking. All results are fully reproducible from fixed random seeds.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文质疑量子储备计算研究中常见的不公平比较：量子模型被充分优化，而经典基线往往未调优。作者在小规模量子系统的精确模拟与预测任务上，对两类常被认为带来优势的机制进行公平对照。结果显示，在相同规模和调参努力下，这些量子优势不再成立，经过良好调优的经典方法可达到相当甚至略优的预测效果。

articles.title: Auditing the Risk Claims of Distributional Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 对分布式强化学习风险声明的审计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11607v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Distributional reinforcement learning agents learn full return distributions that are increasingly read at face value: for interpretability, risk-sensitive control, and safety monitoring. We ask a question theory anticipates but that has not been measured directly: are the risk claims of a trained distributional agent true? Our audit combines a decision-relevant screening metric (the excess Wasserstein gap between the top two actions, which equals the mass by which first-order stochastic dominance is violated), ground truth from snapshot-restart Monte Carlo, and a statistical harness (permutation nulls, bootstrap refutation, FDR control) without which the audit itself manufactures false conclusions. Across QR-DQN, C51, and IQN on MinAtar (33 runs), 40-95% of the strongest claimed risk trade-offs are refuted at 95% confidence, the placement of the strongest claims is statistically indistinguishable from truth-blind, and essentially no claim is confirmable: for these agents, the learned "risk" reflects a training artifact rather than environment stochasticity. The artifact is structural (fully formed early in training, uncorrelated with final score, idiosyncratic to each seed) and appears unchanged at full-Atari scale, with every top Breakout claim of a pretrained near-state-of-the-art QR-DQN refuted. Positive controls of known magnitude confirm 96-100% of real claims (correlation 0.89-0.92): the reading measures the agents, not the audit. Acting on the heads' CVaR advice at their most-flagged states ranges from beneficial to significantly worse than chance. Neither training for risk nor ensembling removes the artifact, and recalibration passes the audit only by nullifying the claims: the head is uninformative, not merely miscalibrated. We release the toolkit and document two silent pitfalls that produced convincing but wrong audits of our own.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究分布式强化学习智能体学到的回报分布能否被可靠用于解释性、风险敏感控制和安全监测。作者提出结合决策相关筛选指标、快照重启蒙特卡洛真值估计以及置换检验、bootstrap 反驳和 FDR 控制的统计审计框架。对 QR-DQN、C51 和 IQN 在 MinAtar 上的实验显示，大量强风险权衡声明在统计意义上被反驳，表明学习到的“风险”可能更多反映训练伪影而非环境随机性。

articles.title: Markov Chain Monte Carlo with Diffusion Paths
articles.title_zh: 基于扩散路径的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11631v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sampling from multimodal distributions is a longstanding challenge for classical local Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods. A popular remedy is to introduce a sequence of intermediate distributions that interpolate between the target and a simpler reference. The classical choice, tempering, raises the density to a power, but distorts the relative weights of asymmetric modes and can lead to poor mixing. We instead propose interpolating along the diffusion path, the marginals of a noising diffusion process that carries the target toward a Gaussian. This path preserves the relative weights of the modes and enjoys favorable mixing properties, which we make precise through a spectral-gap analysis of the corresponding ideal transition kernel. Sampling along the path requires its intermediate scores, which can be estimated from the unnormalized target through variational approaches, yielding only an approximate sampler. To remove the resulting bias, we introduce the Metropolis-adjusted diffusion path (MAD-Path) sampler, which corrects the diffusion-path proposal in an augmented path space and leaves the target invariant regardless of the accuracy of the learned score or the discretization error. We further quantify how these two errors affect the acceptance probability, providing guidance for practical tuning. Experiments on a range of Bayesian posteriors show that MAD-Path improves global exploration and mode-weight estimation relative to tempering-based MCMC methods and unadjusted diffusion samplers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对多峰分布采样中传统局部 MCMC 混合困难的问题，提出沿扩散路径而非温度路径构造中间分布。扩散路径由将目标分布逐步加噪至高斯分布的过程给出，可更好保持非对称模态的相对权重，并具有有利的混合性质。为消除近似中间 score 带来的偏差，作者提出 Metropolis 校正的扩散路径采样器，在增广路径空间中校正提议并保持目标分布不变。
authors: Han Chen, Sifan Liu, Jun Yang

articles.title: Convergence of empirical subgradients for optimal transport-based objectives
articles.title_zh: 基于最优传输目标的经验次梯度收敛性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28134v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Optimal transport is widely used to learn distributions, enforce distributional constraints, and model uncertainty. In applications, transport losses are often computed from samples through tractable representations, such as one-dimensional sorting formulas or sliced Wasserstein costs, making them practical components in training pipelines. We study parameterized objectives defined by sampled transport costs and prove graphical convergence of their subdifferentials to the subdifferential of the population objective. In particular, this ensures that standard subgradient methods consistently approach stationary points of the population-level problem. We illustrate the results in several settings, including risk-averse optimization, fairness-constrained learning, and sliced Wasserstein problems. Our analysis highlights that smooth parameterizations provide a favorable interface between statistical consistency and optimization. By contrast, transport objectives with nonsmooth costs and models may exhibit unstable derivatives in the large-sample limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究由样本化最优传输代价定义的参数化目标函数，证明其次微分图收敛到总体目标的次微分。该结果意味着标准次梯度方法在样本层面优化时，可一致地逼近总体问题的驻点。作者在风险规避优化、公平约束学习和切片 Wasserstein 问题等场景中说明了理论适用性，并指出光滑参数化有助于连接统计一致性与优化稳定性。

articles.title: A Theory of Least Autonomy in AI
articles.title_zh: 人工智能中的最小自主性理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Least privilege, the principle that an identity should hold only the permissions strictly required for its task, has been a foundational primitive of access control for decades. We argue that this principle is insufficient for agentic AI systems, which do not merely hold permissions but can combine, approve, and amplify them across workflows and system boundaries. We propose least autonomy as an appropriate generalization and develop a formal theory. First, we define a compositional blast radius d(a,b) that measures structural separation between actions in an enterprise hierarchy, combining an ultrametric tree with lattice-valued confidentiality, integrity, and control-context labels. Second, we define a directed agent influence graph G(theta). An arc from U to V requires a directed shared-resource write-to-read meeting or a conservative undirected agent-to-agent (A2A) communication meeting, and a meeting-conditioned influence potential at or above an externally selected policy threshold theta. A catalogue-radius profile supports calibration and audit of theta. Finally, we define a collusion predicate over graph reachability that detects authorization composition, decision manipulation, and cross-domain capability composition.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文认为传统访问控制中的最小权限原则不足以应对智能体式 AI，因为这类系统不仅持有权限，还可能跨工作流和系统边界组合、批准并放大权限。作者提出“最小自主性”概念，并构建形式化理论，包括用于衡量企业层级中动作结构分离的组合爆炸半径，以及刻画智能体影响关系的有向图。该框架旨在支持对策略阈值、影响传播和潜在串谋风险的校准与审计。

articles.title: Semantic Drift and the Stability of Operator Control in Reasoning-Class Decision Support Systems
articles.title_zh: 推理型决策支持系统中的语义漂移与操作者控制稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The article investigates the fundamental problem of ensuring the stability of operator control and preserving goal-targeting in hybrid human-machine decision support systems (DSS) of a new generation. Based on a two-month continuous longitudinal experiment on the joint design of a monograph-format textual array, the latent phenomenon of semantic context drift in large language models of deep logical reasoning (Reasoning LLMs) is verified and described. A mathematical model of interaction in the human-machine interface is proposed, and an original metric is introduced - the operator control stability coefficient, which takes into account the non-linear contextual pressure of hidden reasoning chains. Within the paradigm of the cognitome theory, a critical point of control functions inversion is captured. Engineering recommendations are formulated for implementing dynamic relational arbitration loops based on a modified hierarchical similarity model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究新一代人机混合决策支持系统中如何保持操作者控制稳定性与目标指向性。基于为期两个月的纵向实验，作者描述并验证了深度逻辑推理型大语言模型中的语义上下文漂移现象。文章提出人机界面交互的数学模型和“操作者控制稳定系数”，并给出基于改进层级相似性模型的动态关系仲裁环路工程建议。
authors: M. L. Kaluzhsky, V. A. Efirov

articles.title: TopoExplore: Topological Discrimination for Archive-Based Exploration
articles.title_zh: TopoExplore：用于基于档案探索的拓扑判别方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09971v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Archive-based exploration methods such as Go-Explore select which visited state to return to using visitation rarity, and frontier methods return to the boundary of the unknown; neither asks whether the unexplored region behind a boundary is enterable at all. Exploration is not just about finding reward - it is about collecting a structurally complete experience for downstream learning and planning. We introduce TopoExplore, which augments Go-Explore cell selection with a periodic topological pass: enclosed unexplored regions (voids) of the visited-set occupancy grid are detected by flood fill (the H1 classes of its cubical complex), and a decaying selection bonus is placed only on their strict entrances (gap or door cells), so sealed regions are never targeted and entered regions retire. On a controlled 18-environment MiniGrid suite (15 seeds, frozen hyperparameters) TopoExplore attains a 1.52x geometric-mean speedup in median steps-to-first-entry over its exact Go-Explore ablation, versus 1.37x for a frontier baseline; frontier exploration degrades when sealed decoy structure appears (0.83-1.48x on decoy environments vs. 1.65-2.11x for TopoExplore), while TopoExplore holds its largest win on hard multi-interaction doors (10.9x). We report an honest negative on Montezuma's Revenge - without wall knowledge, unreachable occupancy artifacts capture the bonus and performance degrades as it grows, isolating the wall-aware entrance test as the load-bearing component - and a preliminary positive on HM3D scanned buildings, where the speedup over Go-Explore tracks scene difficulty (r=0.69) even as frontier selection dominates blanket coverage. The evidence supports a deliberately scoped claim: topology-aware selection pays off where enclosed structure must be discriminated, and remains competitive at open coverage, where frontier methods are strongest, despite not being tuned for that regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 TopoExplore，用拓扑信息增强 Go-Explore 等基于档案的探索方法。方法周期性检测已访问占据网格中的封闭未探索区域，并仅对可进入空洞的严格入口单元施加衰减选择奖励，从而避免把密封区域作为目标。MiniGrid 控制实验表明，相比原始 Go-Explore 和前沿探索基线，该方法在首次进入可达未知区域的步数上取得更好的几何平均加速，尤其能减少密封诱饵结构带来的误导。

articles.title: A Symbolic Neural CPU for Quantization-Simulated Writeback and Interpretable Program Execution
articles.title_zh: 用于量化模拟写回与可解释程序执行的符号神经 CPU
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks can learn algorithmic input-output mappings, but trusting a learned executor requires more than a correct final answer because the state transitions that produce it are usually hidden. To make those transitions visible, we introduce a trace-supervised symbolic neural CPU, a factorized learned execution architecture that combines recurrent control, an explicit operation router over a fixed differentiable arithmetic-logic unit bank, destination-masked register writeback, complete trajectory supervision and matched fixed-point replay. The model exposes the selected operation, source and destination registers, register trajectory, memory signals and writeback semantics at every step. On the principal 16-wide benchmark, the non-quantized executor reproduces reference execution exactly, while the eight-bit quantization-simulated executor preserves the symbolic operation path through programs of 1,000 instructions. When the same execution is evaluated against a matched fixed-point replay, the residual numerical drift disappears, showing that it comes from a mismatch between continuous and low-precision reference semantics rather than from execution failure. We compare recurrent, Transformer, temporal-convolution, temporal graph-inspired and state-space controllers, and the ablations show that operation-gate supervision is necessary for an inspectable execution path. Hidden-opcode memory-pressure tasks expose the remaining limits in delayed state use and temporal binding. We also extend the interface with ValueMemory, hybrid adaptive leaky integrate-and-fire controllers, candidate-constrained symbolic control trained through behaviour cloning and actor-critic reinforcement learning, and an RV32I base-integer semantic bridge. Together, these results establish a trace-verifiable framework for interpretable, low-precision and controllable neural execution.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种带轨迹监督的符号神经 CPU，用于使神经网络执行程序时的中间状态转移可见和可解释。该架构结合循环控制、固定可微算术逻辑单元库上的显式操作路由、目标掩码寄存器写回、完整执行轨迹监督和匹配定点回放。实验显示，非量化执行器可精确复现参考执行，八位量化模拟执行器在长程序中保持符号操作路径；与匹配定点回放比较后，残余数值漂移可被解释为连续语义与低精度语义不匹配所致。
authors: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva

articles.title: UNIT: Unleash Large Language Models Potential for Graph Continual Learning
articles.title_zh: UNIT：释放大语言模型在图持续学习中的潜力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10159v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In real-world multimodal web scenarios, graph-structured data often arrives in a streaming manner, making graph continual learning a crucial paradigm for continuously modeling such evolving structures. However, existing graph continual learning methods still face two fundamental challenges. 1) semantic-structural separation, where the graph-based methods excel at modeling topological relationships but neglect deep semantics. 2) imbalanced knowledge transfer, where existing models fail to effectively leverage general knowledge gained from early tasks to benefit subsequent new tasks. To address above issues, we propose a novel framework, UNleash Large Language Models PotentIal for Graph ConTinual Learning (UNIT). By fine-tuning large language model only on the first task, we bridge the distributional gap between the pre-trained LLM corpus and the target task dataset to enhance the adaptability of LLMs for graph-structured tasks. Meanwhile, we propose an uncertain-aware anchor generation mechanism to effectively preserve representative knowledge across tasks, avoiding the neglect of universal knowledge learned from previous tasks. Additionally, we introduce structural confluence modeling to explicitly integrates graph topology information into semantic information, enhancing the collaborative capabilities between semantic understanding and structural modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance in the graph continual learning task.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向流式到达的图结构数据，提出用于图持续学习的 UNIT 框架，以缓解语义—结构分离和知识迁移不均衡问题。方法仅在首个任务上微调大语言模型，以缩小预训练语料与目标图任务之间的分布差距，并提升其对图结构任务的适应性。框架还引入不确定性感知的锚点生成机制，以跨任务保留代表性知识，减少对早期通用知识的遗忘。
authors: Tairan Huang, Yili Wang, Beibei Hu, Yiting Shi, Qiutong Li, Changlong He, Jianliang Gao

articles.title: SETA: Scaling Environments for Terminal Agents
articles.title_zh: SETA：面向终端智能体的可扩展环境框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly shifting toward agents that solve tasks through diverse interfaces, including web and graphical user interfaces (GUIs). Among these, the terminal command line provides a text-based, general-purpose interface, covering tasks from system operations to data science and machine learning. However, scaling terminal-agent training remains challenging, as it requires diverse and coherent task instructions, executable environments, and reliable verification, while lacking naturally grounded supervision data. In this work, we propose SETA, a scalable framework for generating verifiable terminal environments for reinforcement learning (RL). The framework consists of two pipelines sharing a unified verification mechanism: SETA-Synth converts diverse sources into standardized RL environments, and SETA-Evol further expands from existing environments with adaptive control of difficulty and diversity. Together, we construct and release SETA-Env, the largest open-source verifiable terminal RL dataset to date, containing over 4,500 environments. We evaluate our dataset by training Qwen3-8B with GRPO on SETA-Env, achieving 12% pass rate on Terminal-Bench 2.0, the best reported result for an RL-trained model at the 8B scale. We further observe gains on DeepSeek-V4-Flash under the same terminal agent harness, with pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0 improving from 40% to 43% and pass@5 improving from 54% to 58%. These results demonstrate that SETA- Env provides high-quality training environments for terminal agents and serves as a valuable resource for advancing research on terminal-based agent learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 SETA，一个用于生成可验证终端命令行强化学习环境的可扩展框架，以支持大语言模型智能体在系统操作、数据科学和机器学习等任务上的训练。SETA 包含两个共享统一验证机制的流水线：SETA-Synth 将多源任务转化为标准化 RL 环境，SETA-Evol 在已有环境基础上自适应扩展难度和多样性。作者构建并发布 SETA-Env，包含超过 4500 个可验证终端环境，并用于训练和评估终端智能体。
authors: Qijia Shen, Zhiqi Huang, Vamsidhar Kamanuru, Aznaur Aliev, Jay Rainton, Ahmed Awelkair, Zhichen Zeng, Jiajun Li, Shi Dong, Yueming Yuan, Boyuan Ma, Qizheng Zhang, Jiwei Fu, Yuzhen Mao, Wendong Fan, Ping Nie, Philip Torr, Bernard Ghanem, Changran Hu, Jonathan Lingjie Li, Urmish Thakker, Guohao Li

articles.title: STAMP: Provenance-Guided Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents
articles.title_zh: STAMP：面向深度搜索智能体的溯源引导式信用分配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning for deep-search agents has largely focused on trajectory-level scoring -- outcome correctness, citation-aware rewards, and evidence coverage. Yet the actions that expose supporting documents receive no targeted credit, a gap we call the reward-credit mismatch. We propose STAMP, in which a reference-based verifier judges whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in a training-time evidence graph, and first-exposure attribution traces each supported citation back to the action that first surfaced it. This step credit is injected through sign-preserving advantage modulation, which redistributes advantage across steps without changing the trajectory-level reward or the relative ranking of trajectories within each group. On BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, and xbench-DS, STAMP improves the GRPO baseline by +2.0/+5.5/+3.0 points under matched SFT initialization, training data, and search tools, and composes with both outcome-only and citation-rubric base rewards. Component ablations confirm that the provenance-based credit signal and the sign-preserving advantage modulation each contribute to the gains.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，深度搜索智能体的强化学习通常依赖轨迹级评分，但缺乏对发现支持性文档的具体动作给予定向奖励，形成“奖励—信用错配”。作者提出 STAMP，通过基于参考的验证器判断引用文档是否支持训练期证据图中的实体或关系，并将支持性引用追溯到首次暴露该文档的动作。该方法以保持符号的优势调制方式注入步骤级信用，在不改变轨迹级奖励和组内轨迹相对排序的情况下重新分配优势，并在多个深度搜索基准上优于 GRPO 基线。
authors: Ke Xu, Han Xu, Xinran Chen, Yuqian Wang, Zhixuan Li, Xiaojian Liu, Changwo Wu, Jianqiang Xia, Yuchen Li

articles.title: SCALECUA: Scaling Computer Use Agents with Verifiable Task Synthesis and Efficient Online RL
articles.title_zh: ScaleCUA：通过可验证任务合成与高效在线强化学习扩展计算机使用智能体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs) are emerging as a powerful interface for automating complex digital workflows through visual perception and GUI execution. Online reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a key direction for scaling their capabilities. However, this paradigm is bottlenecked by verifiable data scarcity and online RL inefficiency. To break these barriers, we introduce ScaleCUA, a unified framework that scales online RL for CUAs via verifiable task synthesis and efficient training. At the data level, we design VeriGen, an end-to-end framework for generating verifiable RL tasks through iterative docker interactions and a multi-agent feedback loop. Scaled to 100+ concurrent agent workers via a shared docker interaction probe, this pipeline produces 24K+ verifiable tasks and nearly 3K high-quality RL tasks. To maximize sample efficiency, we propose Frontier Sampling, which tracks per-task capability and allocates rollouts to the current learning frontier. On the training side, we further design Visual Context Segmentation, a sliding window over recent visual context that balances rollout and training-engine pressure, yielding a 2.83x training speedup over step-wise decomposition. Together, ScaleCUA achieves 68.7% on OSWorld and 54.0% on ScienceBoard, establishing new state-of-the-art performance among open-source computer use agents. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/THUDM/SCALE-CUA.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文面向通过视觉感知和图形界面操作完成数字工作流的计算机使用智能体，指出在线可验证奖励强化学习受限于可验证数据稀缺和训练效率不足。作者提出 ScaleCUA 框架，其中 VeriGen 通过迭代 Docker 交互和多智能体反馈生成可验证任务，并扩展到大量并发工作器以构建训练数据。为提高样本效率，论文还提出 Frontier Sampling 按任务能力边界分配 rollout，并结合视觉上下文分割来平衡在线执行与训练开销。
authors: Bowen Lv, Xiao Liu, Yanyu Ren, Hanyu Lai, Bohao Jing, Hanchen Zhang, Yanxiao Zhao, Shuntian Yao, Jie Tang, Yuxiao Dong

articles.title: Learning Residual Kinematic Corrections for Continuous Neural Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 通过强化学习学习连续神经解码中的残差运动学校正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Decoding continuous three-dimensional (3D) motor imagery (MI) using non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain--computer interfaces (BCIs) remains challenging due to signal variability and residual decoding errors. Deep learning architectures such as convolutional neural network--long short-term memory (CNN--LSTM) models can capture spatial and temporal dynamics for continuous kinematic decoding; however, systematic residual errors persist in predicted trajectories. We propose a two-stage decoding framework that applies reinforcement learning (RL) to perform residual kinematic correction on the outputs of a CNN--LSTM decoder (CNN--LSTM--RL). The RL agent is trained offline without direct EEG input and instead operates on predicted kinematic trajectories to optimize movement accuracy relative to target trajectories. Decoding performance was quantified using Pearson correlation coefficients (r) and Root Mean Square Errors (RMSE) along the x, y, and z axes. Compared to CNN--LSTM applied alone, CNN--LSTM--RL improved the mean correlation from 0.5076 to 0.7181 (p = 0.0005) in 2D and from 0.6420 to 0.7780 (p = 0.0059) in VR, with relative gains of 41.5% and 21.2%, respectively. Correspondingly, RMSE was reduced from 0.0890 to 0.0532 (2D, p < 0.0001) and from 0.0714 to 0.0441 (VR, p < 0.0001), representing relative reductions of 40.2% and 38.2%. These findings demonstrate that this scalable framework enhances 3D BCI MI decoding by correcting kinematic errors via offline residual RL without extra neural data, advancing neurorehabilitation, prosthetics, and virtual interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对基于非侵入式 EEG 的脑机接口在连续三维运动想象解码中存在的信号变异和残差误差问题，提出 CNN-LSTM-RL 两阶段框架。方法先由 CNN-LSTM 解码运动轨迹，再由离线训练的强化学习智能体在不直接使用 EEG 的情况下对预测运动学轨迹进行残差校正。实验以相关系数和均方根误差评估，结果显示相较单独 CNN-LSTM，该框架在二维和虚拟现实条件下均显著提高平均相关性。
authors: Jiamian Li, Niall McShane, Attila Korik, Naomi du Bois, Karl McCreadie, Leen Jabban, Benjamin Metcalfe, Özgür Şimşek, Damien Coyle

articles.title: Physics-Informed Structure Anchoring With Capture-Aware Prototype Calibration for Cross-Environment RF Fingerprinting
articles.title_zh: 面向跨环境射频指纹识别的物理信息结构锚定与采集感知原型校准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09760v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Radio frequency fingerprint identification (RFFI) uses transmitter-specific hardware imperfections as a physicallayer identity cue for Internet of Things (IoT) devices, but deep RFFI models often degrade when the acquisition environment changes. In multi-antenna reception, this degradation is not merely a generic distribution shift. It is also shaped by receiver-array topology, frequency-offset dynamics, and capturedependent target structure, which can distort embeddings and move source-trained decision boundaries. This article proposes physics-informed structure anchoring with capture-aware prototype calibration (PISA-CAPC), a framework that separates source representation anchoring from fixed-backbone target calibration. The representation stage organizes antenna tokens with a topology graph and modulates the graph using CFO-derived acquisition-dynamics descriptors. Bounded contextual residual suppression is then applied around the identity representation. At deployment, unlabeled capture-aware prototype calibration (U-CAPC) calibrates target decision scores through capturelocal prototype evidence under a fixed representation, mitigating boundary shift without requiring target-domain backbone updates or target labels. On a measured ten-transmitter multiantenna WiFi benchmark, PISA-CAPC achieves 0.9257 targetdomain mean Macro-F1 under a balanced transductive setting. Ablations confirm that topology-guided structure anchoring, contextual residual suppression, and capture-aware calibration contribute complementary gains. These results establish PISACAPC as a fixed-backbone route to cross-environment RFFI, coupling physically motivated representation learning with labelfree, capture-aware decision calibration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究物联网设备射频指纹识别在采集环境变化下的性能退化问题，强调多天线接收中的分布偏移还受阵列拓扑、频偏动态和采集相关目标结构影响。作者提出 PISA-CAPC 框架，将源域表示锚定与固定骨干的目标域校准分离：表示阶段用拓扑图组织天线 token，并用 CFO 派生的采集动态描述符调制图结构。部署阶段通过无标签的采集感知原型校准，在固定表示下利用局部原型证据校准目标决策分数，以提升跨环境鲁棒性。
authors: Fengchong Yao, Jianbing Li, Qing Liu, Qikun Liu, Kefeng Song, Haitao Li, Song Wang

articles.title: An LLM-powered Agentic Recommendation System for Connected TV Content Discovery
articles.title_zh: 面向联网电视内容发现的 LLM 驱动智能体推荐系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09988v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recommendation systems, from traditional multi-stage to recent unified generative architectures, face challenges in incorporating diverse contextual signals, such as trending topics, breaking news, cultural events, and cross-surface user activities, into their ranking pipelines. These systems are designed to consume structured behavioral signals with consistent schemas, and lack the reasoning capability to naturally process unstructured or heterogeneously formatted contextual information. Incorporating such signals typically requires feature engineering, bespoke data pipelines, and carefully tuned heuristics. In this paper, we present an LLM-powered agentic recommendation system designed for Connected TV (CTV) content discovery that addresses these limitations. Our system leverages the reasoning capabilities of large language models to naturally process and synthesize diverse signals across varying schemas and structures, eliminating much of the manual integration inherent in traditional ranking and retrieval systems. Recognizing that current LLM-based solutions still fall short of traditional machine learning models in several recommendation tasks, including retrieval efficiency, personalization precision, and scalability, we adopt an agentic architecture that orchestrates specialized components, allowing each sub-task to be handled by the most suitable method, whether LLM-based or traditional ML. The main contribution of this work is our engineering approach to successfully overcoming the practical limitations of enabling LLM for recommendation, particularly inference latency. We share insights from our work and discuss the trade-offs and lessons learned in building a hybrid system that combines the flexibility of LLMs with the performance of established recommendation techniques.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文关注联网电视内容发现中的推荐系统，指出传统多阶段或生成式推荐架构难以自然整合热点、突发新闻、文化事件和跨界面用户活动等异构上下文信号。作者提出一种由大语言模型驱动的智能体推荐系统，利用 LLM 的推理能力处理不同模式和结构的信息，减少传统检索与排序系统中大量手工特征工程和定制数据管线。论文同时承认现有 LLM 方案在若干推荐环节仍不及传统机器学习模型，因此系统设计旨在结合 LLM 的上下文理解能力与推荐任务需求。
authors: Lei Shi, Di Wang, Harry Tran, Helsing Xu, Yuchen Lu, Dhara Ghodasara, Wilson Chaney, Xueting Liao, Jerry Yu, Huayu Ding, Mingze Gao, Shike Mei, Shuo Tang, Zhe Zhang, Jianming He, Abhishek Kumar, Haotian Wu, Hamed Firooz, Li Li

articles.title: Geometry from Connection: Yang–Mills Structure as the Origin of the Spacetime Metric, with Renormalization-Group Analysis, String-Theoretic Embedding, and First Numerical Tests
articles.title_zh: 从联络生成几何：作为时空度规起源的杨–米尔斯结构及其重整化群分析、弦论嵌入与初步数值检验
articles.abstract: We propose and develop an effective statistical field theory in which classical spacetime geometry and its gravitational dynamics emerge from the coarse-grained curvature statistics of a confining, non-Abelian gauge connection defined on the links of a dynamical graph. The microscopic substrate is not a scalar density but a compact gauge link variable Uij ∈ SU(N)—the lattice holonomy of a confining Yang–Mills connection [1, 14]—carrying an integer winding label that is simultaneously the Dirac-quantized p-form flux of string theory [20, 21, 25, 26, 30, 31]. We adopt a connection-first principle: the gauge field is the one fundamental object on every link of the network, and geometry, gravitation, and cosmology are all derived, coarse-grained statistical properties of its curvature. Confinement and the Wilson-loop area law [1] are the primary observables, and the metric, the graviton, and Newton’s constant are built from the connection, not the other way around. Two independently established mechanisms make this literal rather than metaphorical. First, in the pure-connection tradition of MacDowell–Mansouri, Cartan, and Ashtekar–Capovilla–Dell– Jacobson gravity [45, 46, 47], the metric is absent from the action and is reconstructed after the fact as the symmetry-breaking (soldering-form) piece of an enlarged gauge connection; we realize this on the graph by promoting the internal fiber of Postulate 1 to an (A)dS-type extension of the network’s SU(N) bundle, so that the emergent vierbein ea µ(x), and hence gµν = ηabea µeb ν, are literally components of the gauge connection rather than a conformal dressing of a separate scalar field. Second, in the double-copy tradition [48, 50, 49, 51], the graviton is obtained by an algebraic “squaring” of gauge-boson data via color-kinematics duality; on the network this squaring acts on the reconnection (p,q)-junction vertices that already generate the cubic foam term of the connectivity potential, so that hµν ∼Aµ ⋆Aν is a derived, not postulated, relation. We show that the network admits a confinement– deconfinement/percolation phase structure in the connection statistics [12], that a block- link renormalization-group (RG) transformation flows the gauge coupling to a nontrivial interacting fixed point, and that in the condensed phase the curvature of the connection organizes into a Cartan pair (ω,e) whose torsion-free sector reproduces the Einstein–Hilbert action 'a la Sakharov [2], with 1/16πG now a functional of the gauge coupling and N rather than a connectivity stiffness. Black-hole entropy, the area law, the toy AdS bulk, and the Jacobson-type thermodynamic derivation of the Einstein equations [4, 5, 6, 7, 32, 33, 3] survive essentially unchanged, since minimal-cut/bit-thread reasoning is representation- independent and can be run directly on the gauge-link statistics. The gravity–QCD hierarchy is recast as an RG separation between a confined UV gauge condensate and a dilute IR geometric phase, realized quantitatively by a warped Klebanov–Strassler throat [22, 23, 25] with K/gsM ≃21. We report first Monte Carlo tests of the link ensemble, reinterpreted 1as tests of gauge-connection statistics, that exhibit the predicted condensation transition and confirm an area law for the boundary-cut entropy at the R2 ≃0.9996 level. This is a framework-and-proposal paper: we mark each step as postulate, definition, or result, we do not claim a first-principles derivation of the pure-connection action from QCD or string theory, and Section 16 states plainly what has and has not been established.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本提出一种有效统计场论，认为经典时空几何及引力动力学可由定义在动态图链路上的禁闭非阿贝尔规范联络的粗粒化曲率统计涌现。其微观基元不是标量密度，而是 SU(N) 紧致规范链变量，并与弦论中的量子化 p-形式通量联系起来。作者采用“联络优先”原则，将度规、引力子和牛顿常数视为由规范联络及其曲率统计构造出的涌现量，并结合纯联络引力传统、重整化群分析、弦论嵌入和初步数值测试展开论证。

articles.title: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo from q-deformed phase-space mechanics
articles.title_zh: 源自 q 变形相空间力学的哈密顿蒙特卡罗方法
articles.abstract: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) constructs Markov transitions by combiningHamiltonian dynamics with a Metropolis correction. This paper develops a(q)-deformed HMC framework motivated by (q)-deformed phase-space mechanics.Starting from a Lagrangian formulation, we derive the corresponding(q)-Hamiltonian equations and show the formal invariance of the associated(q)-symplectic form. This provides a geometric origin for the proposed(q)-HMC dynamics rather than treating it as an ad hoc finite-differencemodification.To obtain a computable sampler for ordinary target distributions, we realizethe formal (q)-differential operators through Jackson-type differences andconstruct a Metropolis-adjusted (q)-Hamiltonian proposal. The resultingtransition reduces to classical HMC as (q→1), satisfies detailed balanceunder the Metropolis correction, and admits sufficient nondegeneracy conditionsfor irreducibility of the marginal position chain.Numerical experiments on benchmark targets, positive-scale black-box targets,a mixed positive/signed target, and a PDE-based Bayesian inverse problem showthat the (q)-Jackson force acts as a relative perturbation mechanism in theoriginal variables. It avoids the domain violations and scale mismatch thatcan occur with raw additive finite differences, while tracking exact-gradient,adjoint-force, or carefully scaled finite-difference benchmarks when these areavailable.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文从 q 变形相空间力学出发，构建 q 变形哈密顿蒙特卡罗框架，以赋予其几何来源而非仅作为经验性有限差分修正。作者由拉格朗日形式推导 q-哈密顿方程，并讨论相应 q-辛形式的形式不变性；随后通过 Jackson 型差分实现 q-微分算子，构造带 Metropolis 校正的采样提议。该转移在 q 趋近 1 时退化为经典 HMC，并在校正下满足详细平衡；数值实验显示 q-Jackson 力可作为原变量中的相对扰动机制，用于多类目标分布和贝叶斯反问题。

articles.title: Geometry-Controlled Plasmonic Localization and Graphene-Assisted Thermal Redistribution in Hybrid Gold–Graphene Nanocylinder Arrays
articles.title_zh: 混合金–石墨烯纳米圆柱阵列中的几何调控等离激元局域化与石墨烯辅助热再分布
articles.abstract: Localized plasmonic nanostructures provide an effective platform for concentrating electromagnetic energy into subwavelength volumes, enabling enhanced light–matter interaction and localized photothermal generation. In this work, a hybrid nanophotonic structure consisting of ordered arrays of gold nanocylinders integrated with a graphene layer on a SiO₂ substrate is investigated using finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations coupled with thermal analysis. The study systematically examines the influence of nanocylinder aspect ratio on plasmon resonance characteristics, electromagnetic near-field localization, and photothermal energy redistribution. The results demonstrate that increasing the height-to-radius ratio enhances plasmonic energy localization, strengthens near-field confinement, and increases optical absorption through the formation of highly localized plasmonic hot spots. Comparative analysis of graphene-free and graphene-coupled configurations reveals that graphene substantially modifies the resulting thermal response owing to its exceptionally high in-plane thermal conductivity. While plasmon-induced heat generation remains concentrated near the optical hot spots, graphene promotes rapid lateral heat diffusion, suppresses excessive thermal localization, and produces a significantly more uniform temperature distribution. Quantitative analysis shows that the incorporation of graphene reduces temperature non-uniformity by approximately 92.5% while preserving strong plasmonic enhancement. The corresponding optical–thermal stability factor increases by more than one order of magnitude, demonstrating the effectiveness of graphene-assisted thermal management. These findings show that aspect-ratio engineering and graphene-assisted heat spreading perform complementary functions: the former governs plasmonic energy localization, whereas the latter regulates thermal energy redistribution. The proposed hybrid architecture establishes an integrated optical–thermal design framework for achieving simultaneous optical enhancement and thermal stabilization in plasmonic nanophotonic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 FDTD 仿真结合热分析，考察 SiO₂ 基底上金纳米圆柱有序阵列与石墨烯层耦合形成的混合纳米光子结构。论文系统分析纳米圆柱高径比对等离激元共振、近场局域和光热能量再分布的影响，发现增大高径比可增强等离激元能量局域、近场约束和光吸收。与无石墨烯结构相比，石墨烯因其高面内热导率显著改变热响应，使等离激元热源附近的热量分布发生再调控。

articles.title: Long‑Term Drought Dynamics and Multi‑Index Evaluation in the Aleppo Region, Northern Syria (1984–2024)
articles.title_zh: 叙利亚北部阿勒颇地区长期干旱动态与多指数评估（1984—2024）
articles.abstract: Understanding long‑term drought dynamics in semi‑arid regions is essential for improving water‑resource management and enhancing climate‑resilience strategies. This study investigates drought variability in the Aleppo region of northern Syria over a 41‑year period (1984–2024) using an integrated multi‑index approach. Annual climatic and environmental variables—including precipitation, temperature, wind speed, soil moisture, runoff, solar radiation, potential evapotranspiration (PET), and NDVI—were extracted from TerraClimate and Landsat datasets. Four drought indicators were computed: the SPI to assess precipitation‑driven drought, the SPEI to capture heat‑amplified drought, a modified PDI incorporating NDVI to represent agricultural and eco‑hydrological drought, and the composite CDI to integrate multiple drought dimensions. Trend analysis using the Mann–Kendall test revealed significant increases in temperature, PET, and NDVI, indicating intensifying evaporative demand and evolving land‑surface conditions. Results show a clear climatic transition: drought was predominantly rainfall‑driven before 2000, while post‑2000 droughts were increasingly controlled by rising temperatures and atmospheric demand. PDI recorded the highest drought frequency, highlighting persistent soil‑moisture and vegetation stress, whereas SPEI exhibited the longest drought durations, reflecting prolonged climatic drought episodes. NDVI strongly mirrored drought fluctuations, with marked declines during severe drought years (1999, 2008, 2010, 2017, 2021). Overall, the multi‑index assessment demonstrates that Aleppo is experiencing more complex and persistent drought conditions driven by both climatic warming and environmental pressures. These findings underscore the need for adaptive agricultural strategies, improved water‑resource planning, and enhanced early‑warning systems to mitigate future drought impacts.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于 TerraClimate 和 Landsat 数据，分析叙利亚北部阿勒颇地区 1984—2024 年的长期干旱变化，纳入降水、温度、风速、土壤水分、径流、太阳辐射、潜在蒸散和 NDVI 等变量。作者计算 SPI、SPEI、改进 PDI 和综合 CDI，以分别刻画降水型、热增强型、农业—生态水文型和多维综合干旱。趋势检验显示温度、潜在蒸散和 NDVI 显著上升，结果表明该区干旱机制由 2000 年前以降水驱动为主，逐渐转向受升温和蒸散需求增强控制。

articles.title: Giant plasticity in ceramic semiconductors via crystal conformational switching
articles.title_zh: 通过晶体构象切换实现陶瓷半导体中的巨大塑性
articles.abstract: Ceramic semiconductors typically exhibit catastrophic brittle failure due to the strong directionality of ionic or covalent bonds, which inhibits dislocation motion and atomic diffusion. While metals achieve ductility through dislocation slip or grain boundary sliding, to realize large plastic deformation in ceramic semiconductors remains a formidable challenge. Here, we demonstrate an exceptional plasticity in ceramic crystal GeSe through an unconventional conformation transition mechanism in analog to the concept of “chair-boat transition” in organic chemistry. Using in-situ mechanical transmission electron microscopy, we observe an evolution of the stress–strain response from linear elastic deformation to nonlinear plastic behavior, and reveal that this giant plasticity is enabled by the formation of stripy-shaped domains along < 021 > direction. The largest engineering strain reaches a value as high as 93% with ultimate engineering stress as large as 7 GPa, which has never been achieved in ceramic semiconductors before. Theoretical calculations confirms that the shear-mediated bond conformation transition from chair-shaped to boat-shaped Ge-Se bond-configuration leads to the release of elastic potential energy, being responsible for the emergence of giant plasticity therein. Such a highly-directional plasticity prefers to emerge at angles near the out-of-plane and zigzag direction while is absence near armchair direction owing to the anisotropic Young’s modulus in GeSe. Our observation provides a novel strategy to exploit plasticity and nonlinear mechanics for advanced mechanical and flexible electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对陶瓷半导体因离子键或共价键方向性强而通常脆性断裂的问题，报道 GeSe 陶瓷晶体中由非常规构象转变机制导致的异常大塑性。通过原位力学透射电镜，作者观察到应力—应变响应由线弹性转向非线性塑性，并发现沿 <021> 方向形成条带状畴是巨大塑性的关键。实验显示工程应变最高可达 93%、极限工程应力约 7 GPa，理论计算表明剪切介导的 Ge-Se 键从椅式到船式构象转变是塑性变形的根源。

articles.title: Assembly of Foldameric Copolymers into Ordered Nanostructures and Crystalline Networks
articles.title_zh: 折叠体共聚物组装为有序纳米结构与晶体网络
articles.abstract: Directing macromolecular organization into spatially and orientationally defined nanostructures presents a grand challenge for bottom-up materials engineering. Common approaches borrow from protein design to create foldamers (folding oligomers), wherein information about desired morphology is programmed directly into its molecular sequence. However, due to their sequence-specific synthesis requirements, state-of-the-art approaches are mostly constrained to be oligomeric in nature. Along the same vein, directed folding of polymeric macromolecules via hydrophobic collapse serves as a promising alternative, but are mostly limited to globular structures with close-packed, amorphous internal ordering. Here, we present a polymer design that blends foldameric and hydrophobic features. Our polymer architecture consists of alternating helical foldamer and flexible oligomeric domains. Such an approach leverages rigid helical domains as steric barriers to suppress globular collapse of the flexible hydrophobic blocks, thereby directing chain folding into porous nanostructures exhibiting a diverse suite of polygonal geometries. Through a combination of scaling theory and molecular dynamics simulations, we show that the resulting size, shape, and pore cavity of the folded nanostructures can be a priori designed via tuning the lengths, rather than sequence, of the foldamer and/or flexible oligomeric domains. Furthermore, we show that the folded structures possess emergent intra-chain interactions at higher densities that drive multi-chain organization into crystalline configurations with spatially and orientationally defined pore distributions. We envision that controlled polymer self-assembly into this rich landscape of open, low-coordination morphologies will present new avenues for precision engineering of soft materials with applications spanning sensing, catalysis, separations, and adaptive devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文关注如何通过自下而上设计实现具有空间和取向可控性的高分子纳米结构。作者提出一种结合折叠体和疏水特征的聚合物结构，由交替的螺旋折叠体结构域和柔性低聚结构域组成，利用刚性螺旋结构域作为位阻屏障抑制柔性疏水链段的球状塌缩。通过尺度理论和分子动力学模拟，研究表明该设计可引导链折叠形成多种多边形几何的多孔纳米结构，并有望进一步组装为有序网络。

articles.title: Defect Geometry and Concentration Controlled Excitonic Landscape in Monolayer MX 2 - family: A Systematic G 0 W 0 -BSE Study of Chalcogen Vacancies
articles.title_zh: 单层 MX₂ 族材料中由缺陷几何与浓度调控的激子图景：硫族空位的系统 G₀W₀-BSE 研究
articles.abstract: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) host strongly bound excitons that dominate their optical response, making them promising platforms for optoelectronic and quantum technologies. Native chalcogen vacancies introduce additional excitonic states whose character is highly sensitive to vacancy concentration and geometry. We present a systematic first-principles study that combines G0W0 quasiparticle calculations with the Bethe–Salpeter equation (BSE) to investigate excitonic properties in pristine and chalcogen-vacancy-defective monolayers of MoS2, MoSe2, and WSe2 across varying vacancy concentrations and geometries. We classify the defect-induced excitons into three types: D1 (perturbed valence-to-defect), D2 (shallow defect-to-defect), and Deep D2 (deeply localized defect-to-defect) transitions. These defect excitons redistribute oscillator strength from the pristine-like excitons toward lower energies, with the extent of redistribution strongly dependent on vacancy concentration and geometry. By combining BSE oscillator strengths, fatband transition weights, and Wannier-interpolated G0W0 band structures, we provide microscopic assignments for the defect-related excitons. The theoretical predictions are complemented by room-temperature micro-Raman, photoluminescence, and spectroscopic ellipsometry measurements on exfoliated monolayers. Notably, the low-energy shoulder observed in the photoluminescence spectrum of defective MoS2 is consistent with additional low-energy optical transitions predicted by the G0W0-BSE calculations. These findings establish a framework for engineering excitonic spectra in monolayer TMDCs through the controlled introduction of chalcogen vacancies, with potential relevance to defect-based quantum light emitters for quantum information technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用第一性原理 G₀W₀ 准粒子计算结合 Bethe–Salpeter 方程，系统考察 MoS₂、MoSe₂ 和 WSe₂ 单层在不同硫族空位浓度与几何下的激子性质。作者将缺陷诱导激子分为 D1、D2 和深 D2 三类，分别对应受扰价带到缺陷态、浅缺陷态间以及深局域缺陷态间跃迁。结果显示缺陷激子会将振子强度从类本征激子重分配至较低能量区域，且重分配程度强烈依赖空位浓度和缺陷几何。

articles.title: Epitaxial Co2MnSi with intrinsic magnetocrystalline anisotropy as a route to bias-field-free nonlinear half-metal magnonics at the nanoscale
articles.title_zh: 具有本征磁晶各向异性的外延 Co2MnSi：实现纳米尺度无偏置场非线性半金属磁振子学的途径
articles.abstract: Half-metallic Heusler compounds like Co2MnSi allow to bridge magnonic and spintronic functionality for hybrid unconventional computing approaches with sought-after properties like 100% spin polarization and associated low Gilbert damping αłeq 10⁻³. However, the desirable material parameters are inherently tied to the crystal lattice with a particularly critical dependence on structural order in Co2MnSi. To date, the successful fabrication of nanoscale devices with robust structural integrity remains yet a challenge, and consequently the impact of the material parameters on the resulting nonlinear spin-wave dynamics remains largely unexplored. Here, we report on a study of linear and nonlinear spin-wave dynamics in transversally magnetized Co2MnSi waveguides with impeccable crystalline ordering. We show that epitaxial, L21-ordered Co2MnSi exhibits an intrinsic cubic anisotropy with first-and second-order contributions, stabilizing a magnetization alignment along the crystal ⟨110⟩ directions. We confirm the implication of an unaffected crystal structure resulting in preserved magnetic properties in the patterned structures. Herein, the persistent magnetocrystalline anisotropy reshapes the spin-wave dispersion which yields a first-order nonlinear instability suppression range extending over several GHz-even for vanishing bias fields. Moreover, the intrinsic magnetocrystalline anisotropy can be exploited to counteract shape demagnetization for a stabilized low bias field operation in the favourable Damon-Eshbach geometry with high group velocities and decay lengths. Together with the proven half-metallicity and ultralow Gilbert damping, this research establishes Co2MnSi as a robust, scalable platform towards bias-field-free nonlinear half-metal magnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了横向磁化 Co2MnSi 波导中的线性与非线性自旋波动力学，重点关注高结构有序度对半金属磁振子器件性能的影响。作者表明，外延 L21 有序 Co2MnSi 具有包含一阶和二阶贡献的本征立方磁晶各向异性，可稳定沿晶体 ⟨110⟩ 方向的磁化取向。图形化纳米结构中晶体结构和磁性参数得以保持，为无外加偏置场的非线性半金属磁振子器件提供了材料基础。

articles.title: Work Functions at Work: Observing Contact Electrification at Individual Metal–Metal Heterojunctions
articles.title_zh: 功函数发挥作用：在单个金属—金属异质结中观测接触起电
articles.abstract: Charge redistribution at the contact of two dissimilar metals, referred to as contact electrification, is ubiquitous in nanotechnologies. However, individual nanoscale heterojunctions remain difficult to access experimentally, particularly in terms of real-space charge redistribution and the corresponding electric field. Here we provide local, quantitative access to the hidden phenomena at individual nanoparticle–substrate heterojunctions by combining off-axis electron holography with a predictive computational twin based on orbital-free density functional theory. Electron holography measurements on a grounded metallic architecture isolate phase shifts that originate from work-function difference. In parallel, the computational twin model, calibrated solely by the work functions of the constituent silver and gold, reproduces the measured phase shifts without fitting to the holography data. This quantitative agreement unambiguously identifies work-function difference as the microscopic origin, revealing “work functions at work”. Moreover, charge redistribution is found not merely at the buried contact region but, unexpectedly, at the external surfaces of nanoparticles, causing electric field perturbations in surrounding environment. This spatially-resolved information—inaccessible to ensemble-average techniques—reveals how a single nanoparticle alters its local electrostatic conditions via contact electrification, with direct implications for catalytic properties. Our framework further provides a new capability to probe local contact potentials and to infer individual nanoparticle work function, enabling studies of metal–support interactions to single-particle resolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过离轴电子全息术与基于无轨道密度泛函理论的计算孪生模型相结合，定量探测单个纳米颗粒—基底金属异质结中的接触起电现象。以银和金的功函数为输入，计算模型在不拟合全息数据的情况下重现实验相移，从而确认功函数差是电荷重新分布的微观来源。结果还显示，电荷重分布不仅发生在埋藏接触区，也出现在纳米颗粒外表面，并产生相应电场。

articles.title: Integrating Open-Source Earth Observation, RUSLE and Explainable Machine Learning to Map and Interpret Soil Erosion in the Thoubal River Basin, Manipur, Northeast India
articles.title_zh: 融合开源地球观测、RUSLE 与可解释机器学习绘制并解释印度东北部曼尼普尔 Thoubal 河流域土壤侵蚀
articles.abstract: Soil erosion threatens land productivity and water quality across the hilly terrain of Northeast India, yet spatially explicit, interpretable assessments remain scarce for data-poor basins. This study quantifies soil erosion dynamics in the 942 km² Thoubal River Basin, Manipur, for 2005, 2011 and 2017 by coupling the Revised Universal Soil Loss Equation (RUSLE) with explainable machine learning. Open Earth-observation and geospatial datasets—land-use/land-cover (LULC) maps from India-WRIS, the 30 m Copernicus GLO-30 digital elevation model, an NBSS&LUP soil map and a stream network—were harmonised onto a common 30 m grid, and eleven terrain–hydrological predictors were derived. RUSLE factors were assembled (rainfall erosivity from a regional erosivity equation, soil erodibility from texture, slope length–steepness from flow accumulation, and per-year cover-management from LULC) and annual soil loss was mapped. Four ensemble regressors—Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost—were trained on 150,000 samples as explainable surrogate models of RUSLE-derived soil loss, and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used for interpretation. CatBoost performed best (R² = 0.999, RMSE = 8.6 t ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹), with results stable under five-fold cross-validation and non-overlapping bootstrap confidence intervals, and reproduced the basin-wide erosion surface (spatial R² = 0.999). SHAP ranked land cover as the dominant control, followed by slope and stream power index. Mean soil loss declined significantly from 129.7 to 117.9 t ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ over 2005–2017, driven by forest expansion and wasteland reclamation, while built-up area more than doubled. Persistent erosion hotspots (> 40 t ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹) covered 26% of the basin, concentrated on agricultural land and wasteland, defining a 173 km² conservation-priority zone. A prediction-uncertainty map, derived from inter-model disagreement, identifies where the surrogate is most reliable. The explainable, fully reproducible Earth-observation framework provides a transparent, reproducible and transferable basis for erosion management in mountainous tropical catchments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对印度曼尼普尔 Thoubal 河流域，结合修正通用土壤流失方程（RUSLE）和可解释机器学习，评估 2005、2011 和 2017 年的土壤侵蚀空间格局。研究整合土地利用/覆盖、数字高程模型、土壤图和河网等开放地理数据，并训练随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM 和 CatBoost 作为 RUSLE 结果的代理模型。SHAP 解释用于识别地形、水文和覆盖因子对侵蚀估计的贡献，其中 CatBoost 表现最佳，显示出在数据匮乏山区流域开展可解释侵蚀评估的潜力。

articles.title: Design and Simulation of a Glucose Oxidase-Functionalized Dual-Gate HfO₂/TIPS-Pentacene Organic Transistor for Glucose Sensing Application
articles.title_zh: 用于葡萄糖传感的葡萄糖氧化酶功能化双栅 HfO₂/TIPS-并五苯有机晶体管的设计与仿真
articles.abstract: In this work, a dual-gate organic thin-film transistor (DG-OTFT) architecture for potential glucose-sensing applications is simulated and investigated. The proposed device has a Ge/HfO₂ upper-gate stack, a poly-Si/SiO₂ lower-gate stack, Au source/drain contacts and a TIPS-pentacene active layer functionalised with glucose oxidase (GOx). The high-k HfO₂ dielectric is used to increase the gate-capacitance density, increase the electrostatic control and maintain practical dielectric thickness. In the simulation framework, glucose oxidation is modeled as a surface-potential or interfacial-charge perturbation which is proportional to the concentration of glucose, which acts as an additional modulation of the drain current and the apparent threshold voltage. Compact-model-based simulations are used to analyze transfer characteristics, output characteristics, electric-field distribution, channel-charge density, and electrical response due to glucose, using compact capacitance and threshold-voltage relations. The reported characteristics are examples of simulations and are not experimental measurements. The framework is physically consistent and lays the groundwork for future experimental fabrication, calibration, and biological validation of glucose sensors in the transistor.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作仿真研究了一种面向葡萄糖传感的双栅有机薄膜晶体管结构，器件包含 Ge/HfO₂ 上栅、poly-Si/SiO₂ 下栅、Au 源漏电极以及经葡萄糖氧化酶功能化的 TIPS-并五苯有源层。模型将葡萄糖氧化过程表示为与葡萄糖浓度相关的表面电势或界面电荷扰动，从而调制漏电流和表观阈值电压。研究基于紧凑模型分析转移特性、输出特性、电场分布、沟道电荷和葡萄糖响应，结果为仿真示例而非实验测量，为后续实验验证提供框架。

articles.title: Hybrid Quantum Intelligence for Detecting Sophisticated Financial Fraud in Dynamic Transaction Ecosystems
articles.title_zh: 用于动态交易生态系统中复杂金融欺诈检测的混合量子智能
articles.abstract: Fraud develops rapidly when transactions happen quickly through electronic pipelines. The traditional fraud detection methods, which are reliable but slow to adapt, cannot keep pace with fraudsters' rapid development of new schemes. They also have trouble adapting to complex relationships and creating explanations that regulators can understand. In this paper, we are proposing a multi-pronged attack on the fraud problem using hybrid quantum-classical techniques. QAFEN-CNN utilizes the concept of adaptive quantum feature entanglement, with volatility-based depth controls to achieve a separation increase of 8%. VQTM-LSTM uses parameterized quantum embeddings as input to each recurrent gate to achieve a 7.9% increase in long-horizon recall.
