Despite their predictive advantages, DL models remain largely underutilized in discrete choice due to concerns about their lack of interpretability, unstable parameter estimates, and the absence of established methods for uncertainty quantification. Here, we introduce a deep learning model architecture specifically designed to integrate with approximate Bayesian inference methods, such as Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD). Our proposed model collapses to behaviorally informed hypotheses when data is limited, mitigating overfitting and instability in underspecified settings while retaining the flexibility to capture complex nonlinear relationships when sufficient data is available. We demonstrate our approach using SGLD through a Monte Carlo simulation study, evaluating both predictive metrics--such as out-of-sample balanced accuracy--and inferential metrics--such as empirical coverage for marginal rates of substitution interval estimates. Additionally, we present results from two empirical case studies: one using revealed mode choice data in NYC, and the other based on the widely used Swiss train choice stated preference data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向交通、选举和消费者偏好等场景中的离散选择模型，试图弥合传统可解释计量模型与高预测性能深度学习模型之间的差距。作者提出一种便于与随机梯度朗之万动力学等近似贝叶斯推断方法结合的深度学习架构，使模型在数据有限时可退化为具有行为学含义的假设，从而缓解过拟合。该研究强调在保持预测能力的同时，为边际替代率等经济量提供不确定性量化和更稳定的推断。
authors: Daniel F. Villarraga, Ricardo A. Daziano

articles.title: Transport Quasi-Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 传输准蒙特卡洛方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.16416v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quasi-Monte Carlo (QMC) is a powerful method for evaluating high-dimensional integrals. However, its use is typically limited to distributions where direct sampling is straightforward, such as the uniform distribution on the unit hypercube or the Gaussian distribution. For general target distributions with potentially unnormalized densities, leveraging the low-discrepancy property of QMC to improve accuracy remains challenging. We propose training a transport map to push forward the uniform distribution on the unit hypercube to approximate the target distribution. Inspired by normalizing flows, the transport map is constructed as a composition of simple, invertible transformations. To ensure that QMC achieves its superior error rate, the transport map must satisfy specific regularity conditions. We introduce a flexible parametrization for the transport map that not only meets these conditions but is also expressive enough to model complex distributions. Our theoretical analysis establishes that the proposed transport QMC estimator achieves faster convergence rates than standard Monte Carlo, under mild and easily verifiable growth conditions on the integrand. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical results, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method in Bayesian inference tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Transport QMC，通过训练传输映射将单位超立方体上的均匀分布推送到目标分布附近，从而把准蒙特卡洛方法扩展到难以直接采样、甚至只给出未归一化密度的一般分布。该传输映射受正规化流启发，由简单可逆变换复合而成，并采用满足准蒙特卡洛误差率所需正则性的灵活参数化。理论分析表明，在温和且可验证的条件下，该估计器可比标准蒙特卡洛获得更快收敛。

articles.title: Quantum Circuit Generation via test-time learning with large language models
articles.title_zh: 通过大语言模型的测试时学习生成量子电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.03466v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) as optimizers for black-box scientific design problems requires efficient test-time refinement under expensive evaluations and without training data. We propose a emphmemory-augmented test-time optimization framework that combines episodic memory of high-scoring candidates, score-difference feedback, and restart-from-best sampling to improve iterative search. We evaluate the approach on quantum circuit synthesis, where the objective is to maximize the Meyer--Wallach (MW) global entanglement measure under an exponentially expensive black-box oracle. On 20-qubit circuits, the framework achieves Q(ψ)=0.99 without feedback. On the more challenging 25-qubit task, feedback and restart mechanisms enable multiple runs to reach Q(ψ)=1.0 within 45 oracle calls, while a budget-matched random hill-climbing baseline stalls below Q(ψ)approx0.29. These results demonstrate that memory and evaluator feedback substantially improve the sample efficiency of LLM-based black-box optimization and establish quantum circuit synthesis as a challenging benchmark for test-time optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种带记忆增强的测试时优化框架，用于在无训练数据且评估代价高昂的黑箱科学设计问题中调用大语言模型进行搜索。框架结合高分候选的情景记忆、分数差反馈和从当前最佳解重启采样，并在量子电路合成任务中以 Meyer–Wallach 全局纠缠度为目标进行评估。结果显示，该方法在 20 比特任务中无需反馈即可达到较高纠缠度，在更难的 25 比特任务中借助反馈和重启能在有限 oracle 调用内达到最优纠缠，而随机爬山基线明显停滞。

articles.title: Potential forage competition between deer and cattle in the Mesopotamian Espinal of Argentina
articles.title_zh: 阿根廷美索不达米亚 Espinal 地区鹿与牛之间的潜在牧草竞争
articles.abstract: The population expansion of native and exotic deer species in livestock systems across South America has heightened concerns about competition with cattle for the use of natural grassland. The objective of this study was to evaluate the potential for forage competition between cattle and deer in two representative environments of the Argentine Mesopotamian Espinal: semixerophytic native forest and riparian forest. To this end, population estimates obtained through camera traps and the REST model were integrated with data on animal consumption and natural grassland productivity. Potential forage intake by Axis axis and Subulo gouazoubira was estimated under a conservative scenario of maximum spatial, temporal, and trophic overlap with cattle. In addition, indices of forage pressure and potential competition were developed based on the relationship between dry matter demand and herbaceous biomass supply. The results showed that potential competitive pressure was strongly determined by environmental productivity and seasonal variation in forage availability. The riparian forest exhibited the highest values of potential competitive pressure, particularly during autumn and winter, whereas the native forest maintained positive forage balances for most of the year. In both environments, total demand was primarily driven by the cattle component. These findings suggest that coexistence between deer and cattle does not necessarily entail intense forage competition under the population densities currently recorded.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估阿根廷美索不达米亚 Espinal 两类代表性环境中，原生和外来鹿类与牛之间对天然草地牧草的潜在竞争。作者结合相机陷阱与 REST 模型得到的种群估计、动物采食量和草地生产力数据，在空间、时间和食性最大重叠的保守情景下估算 Axis axis 与 Subulo gouazoubira 的潜在采食压力。结果表明，潜在竞争压力主要受环境生产力和季节性牧草供给影响，河岸林在秋冬季表现出更高的潜在竞争压力。

articles.title: Robust Sparse Channel Estimator for RIS-Assisted Hybrid MIMO Millimeter Wave Communication Under Impulsive Noise
articles.title_zh: 脉冲噪声下 RIS 辅助混合 MIMO 毫米波通信的鲁棒稀疏信道估计器
articles.abstract: The integration of reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) with millimeter-wave (mmWave) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) architectures has emerged as promising for achievement of ultra-high data rates, and improved coverage in next-generation wireless communication networks. To harness the full potential of RIS-assisted MIMO-mmWave systems, accurate channel state information is crucial for beamforming and reception strategies. However, RIS-assisted links are susceptible to significant path loss and non-Gaussian distortions arising from hardware impairments, that makes channel estimation (CE) task challenging. Conventional CE techniques such as orthogonal matching pursuit and zero-attracting least mean square (ZA-LMS), offer degraded performance in the presence of such non-Gaussian distortions. To address these degradations, a performance evaluation of robust sparse-aware (SA) maximum correntropy criterion (MCC) based CE is proposed for RIS-MIMO-mmWave. The presented simulation results indicate superior performance of the proposed SA-MCC algorithm against state-of-the-art channel estimators.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究可重构智能表面辅助的毫米波 MIMO 系统在硬件损伤和非高斯脉冲噪声下的信道估计问题。由于 RIS 链路存在显著路径损耗且传统正交匹配追踪、零吸引最小均方等方法在非高斯扰动下性能下降，作者评估了一种基于最大相关熵准则的鲁棒稀疏感知信道估计算法。仿真结果显示，该 SA-MCC 方法相较现有信道估计器具有更优性能。

articles.title: Scalable Microring-Based Interconnects with Channel Equalization and Closed-Loop Stabilization
articles.title_zh: 具备信道均衡与闭环稳定的可扩展微环互连
articles.abstract: Optical interconnects are essential for scaling photonic computing from isolated cores to distributed multi-core systems. In analog photonic processors, however, the interconnect must preserve multiwavelength optical power during inter-core signal transfer, rather than simply reconfigure optical paths. Conventional switching fabrics do not compensate channel-power imbalance, wavelength-dependent loss, or resonance drift, allowing these impairments to accumulate as errors across cascaded computations. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a photonic interconnect unit (PIU) that integrates a 4-by-4 microring-resonator switching fabric, cascaded programmable channel equalizers, and a three-phase field-programmable gate array-assisted feedback controller on a 180-nm silicon photonic platform. The PIU supports reconfigurable wavelength-division-multiplexed redistribution, including multiplexing and demultiplexing, while cascaded equalization, stabilized by closed-loop feedback, suppresses residual channel-power variation to below 0.2 dB. The feedback controller achieves 10.3-bit-equivalent steady-state control precision and maintains signal-to-noise ratio fluctuation below 0.5 dB across a 22 °C temperature variation. Eight-channel multiwavelength optical weight reconstruction reduces the normalized end-to-end error from 0.179 to 0.0193 (9.3-fold). For ResNet-18, hardware-aware inference simulations under a measurement-derived 6.5-dB channel-mismatch model show that equalization recovers network accuracy from 54.33% to the clean hardware-reference level of approximately 94.6%. These results establish actively stabilized photonic interconnects as an analog signal-conditioning layer for scalable multi-core photonic computing clusters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向光子计算从单核扩展到分布式多核系统的需求，提出一种光子互连单元，用于在核间传输中保持多波长光功率而非仅重配置路径。该单元在 180 纳米硅光平台上集成 4×4 微环谐振器交换结构、级联可编程信道均衡器和 FPGA 辅助三阶段反馈控制器。实验表明，该方案支持波分复用信号的可重构重分配，并通过闭环稳定的级联均衡将残余信道功率变化抑制到 0.2 dB 以下，同时维持较高控制精度和较小信噪比波动。

articles.title: Synthesis, Characterization and DFT Modeling of New Small Fluorescent Organic Molecules Based on tert-Butyl Carbazole
articles.title_zh: 基于叔丁基咔唑的新型小分子荧光有机材料的合成、表征与 DFT 建模
articles.abstract: Two distinct pyridine derivatives, a mono-substituted compound M1 and a tri-substituted star-shaped analogue M2, were synthesized via nucleophilic aromatic substitution (SNAr) and fully characterized by multinuclear NMR and FTIR spectroscopies. Thermal analysis revealed a remarkable enhancement in stability with increasing substitution: M2 exhibits a decomposition onset at 455.7°C and a melting point of 349°C, 124°C higher than that of M1, with no detectable crystallization, highlighting the additive stabilizing effect of the tert-butyl carbazole groups. Cyclic voltammetry showed that M2 possesses a lower oxidation potential (1.48 V) and a shallower HOMO level (− 6.49 eV) than M1 (1.63 V, -6.66 eV), while both compounds share a nearly identical LUMO level ( ≈ − 2.21 eV), resulting in a narrower optical band gap for M2 (3.13 eV vs. 3.25 eV) and validating the donor–acceptor design strategy. DFT calculations (B3LYP/6‑31G(d)) further supported these findings, revealing that M1 adopts a moderately twisted conformation (dihedral angle 71.65°) with a dipole moment of 1.86 D, whereas M2 displays a more complex three-dimensional geometry, a slightly reduced energy gap (3.71 eV), and a significantly lower dipole moment (0.37 D) due to its higher symmetry. Comparison of experimental and theoretical (TD‑DFT) optical data showed good agreement in spectral shape and relative trends, with both approaches assigning the highest emission intensity to M2. Collectively, these results establish that increasing the number of tert-butyl carbazole donors on a halogenated pyridine core systematically enhances thermal stability, modulates frontier orbital energies, and tunes the optical properties, providing a clear structure–property relationship that validates this molecular design strategy for applications in organic electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过亲核芳香取代合成了单取代吡啶衍生物 M1 和三取代星形类似物 M2，并利用多核 NMR 与 FTIR 进行表征。热分析显示，随着叔丁基咔唑取代基增加，M2 的分解起始温度和熔点显著升高，体现出更强热稳定性。循环伏安和 DFT 计算表明，M2 具有较低氧化电位、较浅 HOMO 能级和更窄光学带隙，支持其给体–受体分子设计思路。

articles.title: Tuning Structural, Magnetic, and Photocatalytic Properties of Erbium Orthoferrite Nanoparticles via co-substitution of Gd 3+ and Ti 4+
articles.title_zh: 通过 Gd³⁺ 与 Ti⁴⁺ 共取代调控铒正铁氧体纳米颗粒的结构、磁性和光催化性能
articles.abstract: Erbium Orthoferrite (ErFeO3) nanoparticles are well-known for magnetic and photocatalysis applications, however the crystallite size will play more crucial role to design for particle applications. Scientists were trying to reduce the crystallite size by adopting different synthetic routes or substitution/co- substitution of appropriate atoms or concentration. In these aspects we prepared the ErFeO3 (EFO) nanoparticle by substitution of isovalent ion (Gd3+) at A-site and higher valence ion (Ti4+) at B-site, i.e., Er1−xGdxFe1−xTixO3 (where x = 0, 2.5, 5 and 7.5 mol%) to tune the chemical and physical properties. The optimized concentration of substitution and co-substitution ion concentration was 5 mol%, which is conformed through X-ray diffraction (XRD) studies convoyed through structure refinement method (Rietveld). The synthesized samples up to 5 mol% was found to be single phase with orthorhombic crystal structure of space group of Pnma. space group. The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) was utilized to observe the morphology and also calculate the crystallite size the synthesized materials. BET measurements confirm that the synthesized nanomaterials possess a mesoporous structure, with specific surface areas ranging from 15.978 to 41.465 m2/g. The X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis was carried out to check the Fe oxidation number and to estimate the oxygen vacancy concentration. Nearly two times higher saturation magnetization (MS) value was observed for 5 mol% substituted and co- substituted sample when compared to un substituted sample. These results indicate that nanomaterials substituted with 5 mol% Gd and co- substituted with Ti have strong potential for use in gas sensing and photocatalytic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过在 A 位引入 Gd³⁺、在 B 位引入 Ti⁴⁺，制备 Er1−xGdxFe1−xTixO3 纳米颗粒，以调控 ErFeO3 的晶粒尺寸及相关物理化学性质。XRD 与 Rietveld 精修表明，最高至 5 mol% 取代的样品保持 Pnma 空间群的正交单相结构，且 5 mol% 被认为是优化取代浓度。研究还利用 SEM 观察形貌和估算晶粒尺寸，并通过 BET 结果确认材料具有介孔结构，为其磁性和光催化应用提供依据。

articles.title: Complexity Reveals the Microscopic Origins of Macroscopic Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 复杂性揭示宏观动力学的微观起源
articles.abstract: Real complex systems often exhibit emergent collective behavior arising from interactions across many components. Classical stability theory describes these phenomena in spectral space, where dynamics is organized by spatially extended global eigenmodes that cannot generally be associated with identifiable physical subsystems. Here, we show that spectral localization in empirical and random networks fundamentally alters this picture. As Laplacian eigenvectors concentrate on restricted subsets of nodes, emergent dynamics becomes governed predominantly by the local behavior of dominant nodes together with their e!ective coupling to the surrounding network, producing a mode–node correspondence that restores a direct physical interpretation of spectral instabilities. Exploiting this principle, we develop a node-resolved framework that predicts transition onsets, identifies the microscopic drivers of global behavior, and naturally extends stability analysis to heterogeneous systems where classical modal theories fail. In heterogeneous reaction networks, the same mechanism organizes exotic collective states in which different subsets of nodes develop distinct nonlinear dynamics beyond homogeneous assumptions. Our results show that complex network structures naturally generate the localization patterns that reveal the microscopic drivers of macroscopic dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文探讨复杂系统中由多组分相互作用产生的涌现集体行为，并指出经验网络和随机网络中的谱局域化会改变传统稳定性理论的解释图景。当拉普拉斯特征向量集中在少数节点子集上时，宏观动力学主要由主导节点的局部行为及其与周围网络的有效耦合控制，从而形成可解释的模态–节点对应关系。基于这一机制，作者提出节点分辨的稳定性分析框架，用于预测转变起点、识别全局行为的微观驱动因素，并扩展到经典模态理论难以处理的异质系统。

articles.title: Solvent-Regulated Hydrogen-Bond Competition in Hyperelastic, Adhesive Organogels
articles.title_zh: 超弹性黏附有机凝胶中的溶剂调控氢键竞争
articles.abstract: Hydrogen-bonded polymer gels are attractive because reversible bonding associations dissipate energy, support recovery, and promote adhesion. In the current swollen gels, however, solvent environments often fail to dynamically modulate these interactions, frequently resulting in unbalanced competition among polymer-polymer, polymer-solvent, and solvent-solvent interactions. Consequently, although hydrogen-bonded networks offer a pathway to reversible energy dissipation, their mechanical performance is frequently limited by kinetically trapped, rigid polymer states. Herein, we report a general material design strategy for the synthesis of hyperelastic, high-strength adhesive gels governed by active regulation of solvent-mediated hydrogen-bond competition. By exploring polar aprotic solvents that can effectively regulate the balance between inter-chain polymer–polymer associations and polymer–solvent interactions, we achieve a controlled transition from dense, collapsed network architectures to highly solvated, dynamic systems. Using poly(acrylic acid) (PAA) as a model polymer, we show that dimethylformamide (DMF) acts as an active hydrogen-bond acceptor, facilitating exceptional tensile deformability exceeding 6,000% and exceptional interfacial adhesion. The reported solvent-regulation strategy can be expanded to diverse polar aprotic solvents, yielding a series of gels that retain high stretchability, while offering strong adhesion. Organogels designed and optimized through the reported approach could serve as a new class of gel platform, relevant to soft robotic components, stretchable adhesive joints, damping layers, gel electrolytes, and particle-binding matrices for battery electrodes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种通过主动调控溶剂介导的氢键竞争来制备超弹性、高强度黏附凝胶的通用材料设计策略。作者以聚丙烯酸为模型体系，考察极性非质子溶剂在平衡聚合物链间作用与聚合物—溶剂相互作用中的作用，展示了网络结构由致密塌缩态向高度溶剂化动态体系的可控转变。结果表明，二甲基甲酰胺可作为有效氢键受体，改善凝胶的可逆耗能、恢复和黏附性能。

articles.title: Single-Shot Narrowband Link Discovery via Space-Polarization Encoded Metasurfaces
articles.title_zh: 基于空间—偏振编码超表面的单次窄带链路发现
articles.abstract: Wireless networks operating in the millimeter-wave and sub-terahertz regimes typically rely on highly directional pencil beams to overcome severe path loss, making initial access and link discovery a critical bottleneck in the control plane. Existing approaches either employ iterative beam scanning, which incurs substantial latency, or create angle-dependent spectral signatures, which require large bandwidths and additional hardware complexity. Here, we introduce a fundamentally new paradigm for link discovery: single-shot, narrowband beam acquisition enabled by space–polarization encoding. The key insight is to harness anisotropic electromagnetic scattering in a carefully engineered metasurface to encode spatial directions into distinct polarization signatures. Specifically, a transmissive metasurface radiates angle-dependent polarization patterns while a dual-polarized receiver extracts lightweight features from a single narrowband measurement to directly infer the optimal beam direction without any beam sweeping. We establish a physics-grounded framework that links electromagnetic wave manipulation and polarization transformation to link discovery performance, enabling the systematic design of metasurfaces that generate robust and distinguishable polarization signatures across space. We validate this framework through full-wave simulations and extensive over-the-air experiments at 140 GHz, demonstrating accurate localization. Our results show how a deep understanding of electromagnetic can be translated into practical metasurface designs and establish a new pathway for low-latency link adaptation in high-frequency mobile wireless networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种面向毫米波和亚太赫兹无线网络的单次窄带波束获取范式，以缓解初始接入和链路发现中的扫描时延问题。其核心思想是利用各向异性超表面的电磁散射，将空间方向编码为不同的偏振特征，并由双偏振接收机从单次窄带测量中推断最优波束方向。论文建立了连接电磁波操控、偏振变换与链路发现性能的物理框架，为无需波束扫描的低开销链路发现提供了新思路。

articles.title: Bounded Rationality and Resilience in Global Rare Earth Supply Chains: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Simulation
articles.title_zh: 全球稀土供应链中的有限理性与韧性：基于大语言模型的多智能体仿真
articles.abstract: Rare earth elements (REEs) rely on highly concentrated trade networks that are structurally vulnerable to geopolitical shocks. Conventional static network models and local optimization algorithms struggle to capture the complex behavioral dynamics—such as strategic hoarding and panic amplification—that drive multi-constraint path disruptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel multi-agent simulation framework integrating large language models (LLMs) to instantiate bounded rationality within sovereign decision-makers. Operating on an empirically calibrated REE trade network, our model employs a Delta-Buffer synchronous market-clearing mechanism to simulate realistic, mass-conserving multi-path routing selections. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate a fundamental regime reversal in network resilience. Traditional optimizing agents (Greedy and Rule-based) exhibit severe over-reactivity during low-stress periods, aggressively restructuring paths at unsustainable costs. In contrast, LLM-powered agents dynamically calibrate their routing efforts, maintaining positive Cost Efficiency Ratios (CER) consistent with satisficing theory. Furthermore, their prioritization of multilateral alternative sourcing over passive domestic hoarding aligns directionally with documented historical crisis reactions. These findings reframe bounded rationality as a systemic mechanism for adaptive, cost-efficient network optimization. Ultimately, this computational paradigm provides robust tools for stress-testing complex trade architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对稀土贸易网络高度集中且易受地缘政治冲击影响的问题，提出融合大语言模型的多智能体仿真框架，用以刻画主权决策者的有限理性行为。模型在经验校准的稀土贸易网络上运行，并采用 Delta-Buffer 同步市场出清机制模拟守恒约束下的多路径路由选择。蒙特卡罗结果显示，相比传统贪婪或规则型优化智能体，大语言模型驱动的智能体在低压力情境下过度反应更少，能够动态调整路径重构力度并维持更合理的成本效率。

articles.title: Experimental Study on Robotic Eddy Current Inspection of Aeroengine Turbine Blades
articles.title_zh: 航空发动机涡轮叶片机器人涡流检测实验研究
articles.abstract: This study proposes an automated eddy current inspection technology to address the challenges in detecting subsurface cold-shut defects in aero-engine turbine blades. First, based on the principle of eddy current testing, an optimal bridge absolute probe configuration was designed through electromagnetic field finite element simulation to optimize the magnetic core materials and coil parameters, thereby eliminating blind detection zones in manual operations. Second, a robot-turntable cooperative inspection system is constructed to develop an automated prototype. Finally, trajectory planning was implemented using a standard notched specimen to analyze the influence of the robot motion parameters, defect depth, and orientation on the signal characteristics. A comprehensive verification of the detection capability of the system was conducted via experiments on real cracked blades. This technology significantly enhances the efficiency and reliability of turbine blade defect detection, providing critical assurance for the safe operation of aeroengines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种自动化涡流检测技术，用于解决航空发动机涡轮叶片亚表面冷隔缺陷检测难题。作者基于涡流检测原理，通过电磁场有限元仿真优化桥式绝对探头结构、磁芯材料与线圈参数，并构建机器人—转台协同检测系统。利用标准缺口试样和真实裂纹叶片开展实验验证，结果表明该技术可提高涡轮叶片缺陷检测的效率与可靠性。

articles.title: Mixed Neural Rendering: Interactive Mixed Reality Capture and Curation for Neural 3D Reconstruction
articles.title_zh: 混合神经渲染：面向神经三维重建的交互式混合现实采集与整理
articles.abstract: Neural rendering (NR) methods, such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), enable photorealistic novel-view synthesis and 3D reconstruction from casually captured images. However, their practical reliability remains strongly dependent on acquisition quality: users must collect sufficient multi-view coverage and obtain accurate camera poses, typically through offline Structure-from-Motion (SfM), a process that can be slow, fragile, and prone to failures that are often detected only after capture. We introduce Mixed Neural Rendering (MiNeR), a Mixed-Reality (MR) capture-to-reconstruction pipeline that brings acquisition, inspection, curation, and validation into a single interactive workflow. Using HoloLens 2 as both sensing device and immersive interface, MiNeR allows users to capture RGB images with headset-tracked 6DoF poses, inspect acquired viewpoints directly in situ, identify coverage gaps, and refine the dataset through spatially guided curation. To support object-centric reconstruction, MiNeR further integrates promptable multi-view segmentation initialized from a single annotated view, enabling foreground-focused neural rendering under controlled masking conditions.We evaluate MiNeR in a controlled 2 x 2 x 2 technical study across masking, pose source, and neural renderer on a real-world object-centric dataset. The results show that SfM-based poses yield the highest reconstruction fidelity when successful, direct headset poses preserve operability when SfM fails, promptable segmentation improves object-centric reconstruction quality, and 3DGS provides the strongest results in most evaluated settings. MiNeR addresses the capture and reconstruction layers of such systems: it supports the transformation of situated visual fragments into spatially grounded neural assets that can later be inspected, annotated, reused, or integrated into replay-oriented XR experiences.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 Mixed Neural Rendering（MiNeR），一种将图像采集、检查、整理与验证整合到交互式混合现实流程中的神经三维重建管线。系统使用 HoloLens 2 同时作为传感设备和沉浸式界面，支持用户采集带 6DoF 位姿的 RGB 图像、现场检查视点覆盖、识别覆盖缺口并进行空间引导的数据筛选。为支持以物体为中心的重建，MiNeR 还集成了由单视图标注初始化的多视图可提示分割，以实现前景聚焦的神经渲染。

articles.title: A Dynamical Systems Framework for Mapping Consciousness Models to Neuroelectromagnetic Field Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 将意识模型映射到神经电磁场动力学的动力系统框架
articles.abstract: Contemporary consciousness science lacks a shared mathematical language for comparing theories that propose different relationships among biophysical processes, neuroelectric field dynamics, cognition, and subjective experience. Motivated by the problem of how experience relates to physical processes, we introduce a multidimensional framework in which conscious states are represented as vectors with physical (P), cognitive/computational (C), and noetic (N) components. In this framework, physical and cognitive variables are defined operationally in terms of measurable biophysical and neuroelectromagnetic dynamics, including nonlinear EEG or MEG features. The noetic component is introduced as a formal, method-relative dimension that captures structured, reproducible aspects of data or phenomenology that are not accounted for by current physical and cognitive models. It is treated as a latent, empirically testable degree of freedom inferred from structured residuals in dynamical and phenomenological data. Whether this dimension collapses into P and C or constitutes an additional explanatory axis is treated as an empirical question. Using a linear-algebraic analogy, the framework makes explicit how different theories differ in their explanatory assumptions and how these assumptions can be evaluated through perturbation, identifiability, and invariance criteria. Information links field-level organization in the cognitive domain to experiential structure, enabling testable mappings between neuroelectromagnetic dynamics and phenomenology. We outline how theoretical constructs map to measurable neuroelectric dynamical variables, describe empirical prediction classes, and outline perturbational and neurophenomenological protocols that allow competing theories of consciousness to be compared based on empirical findings rather than theoretical claims.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对意识科学中不同理论缺乏统一数学语言的问题，提出一种多维动力系统框架，将意识状态表示为包含物理、认知/计算和“意知”成分的向量。物理与认知变量被操作性地定义为可测量的生物物理和神经电磁动力学特征，包括非线性 EEG 或 MEG 指标；“意知”成分则作为一种方法相关的潜在维度，用于描述现有模型尚不能解释的结构化残差。该框架将该额外维度是否可还原为物理与认知成分视为可经验检验的问题。

articles.title: Supervised Machine Learning for Predicting Power Conversion Efficiency in Perovskite Solar Cells: A Systematic Review and Quantitative Meta-Analysis
articles.title_zh: 用于预测钙钛矿太阳能电池光电转换效率的监督式机器学习：系统综述与定量荟萃分析
articles.abstract: In recent years, perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have attracted considerable research interest due to rapid efficiency improvements and cost-effective fabrication processes. Despite these advancements, achieving optimal power conversion efficiency (PCE) remains difficult due to complex interactions among material composition, device structure, and fabrication parameters. To address this complexity, supervised machine learning (ML) techniques are increasingly applied for predictive modeling and optimization of PSC performance. This work provides a systematic review combined with a quantitative meta-analysis of supervised ML approaches for PCE prediction in PSCs, covering 36 peer-reviewed studies published between 2015 and 2025. A comparative evaluation framework is developed to assess model performance across different dataset types, sizes, and validation strategies. The meta-analysis of 27 studies indicates that tree-based ensemble methods, such as Random Forest and XGBoost, consistently outperform other models for tabular PSC datasets, achieving average R² values in the range of 0.80–0.90, while neural networks become increasingly competitive with larger datasets. Furthermore, the study examines how feature engineering, dataset quality, and validation strategies influence predictive performance, identifying key challenges such as the lack of standardized datasets, inconsistent benchmarking practices, and limited use of uncertainty quantification. A key contribution of this work is establishing a quantitative relationship between dataset size and optimal model selection strategies. Finally, a structured machine learning roadmap is proposed, integrating dataset curation, feature engineering, model benchmarking, explainable AI, and physics-informed learning to accelerate PSC development. The findings provide actionable insights to improve the reproducibility, reliability, and scalability of ML-driven PCE prediction, supporting next-generation sustainable photovoltaic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统综述并定量分析了监督式机器学习在钙钛矿太阳能电池光电转换效率预测中的应用，覆盖2015—2025年发表的36项同行评议研究。作者建立比较评估框架，考察不同数据类型、样本规模和验证策略下的模型表现。对27项研究的荟萃分析表明，随机森林和 XGBoost 等树基集成方法在表格型数据集上通常表现较好，平均 R² 约为0.80–0.90，而神经网络在较大数据集上竞争力增强。

articles.title: A Physics-Informed Hypoplasticity–Machine Learning Framework for Offshore Foundation Design: Comparative Insights from the German North Sea and the Peruvian Pacific Coast
articles.title_zh: 面向海上基础设计的物理约束下亚塑性—机器学习框架：德国北海与秘鲁太平洋海岸的比较启示
articles.abstract: Background Offshore foundation design increasingly requires constitutive models capable of reproducing the strongly non-linear, rate-dependent, and cyclic response of marine soils, while remaining computationally tractable for iterative design. Hypoplasticity offers a mathematically consistent alternative to classical elastoplastic formulations, and Machine Learning (ML) offers efficient pattern recognition, yet the literature rarely couples the two within an explicit, physically constrained pipeline, and almost never discusses how such a coupling could be transferred from mature offshore markets to emerging ones.Methods We develop a physics-informed hypoplasticity-ML framework grounded in established hypoplastic formulations for sand and clay, define an explicit coupling and validation protocol (k-fold cross-validation, R², RMSE, MAE, confidence intervals), and build a structured comparative matrix contrasting geotechnical, regulatory, and technological conditions in Germany, Peru, and the United States, synthesising quantitative findings already reported in the peer-reviewed literature rather than presenting unverified primary data.Results The comparative matrix identifies which elements of the German hypoplasticity-ML pipeline are directly transferable to Peru (constitutive formulation, ML validation protocol, p-y curve generation methodology) and which require substantial local recalibration (soil database, seismic coupling, liquefaction screening). Free-body equilibrium diagrams for monopile, jacket, and gravity-based foundations are used to make explicit the physical principles that any constitutive-ML coupling must respect.Conclusions A technology-transfer pathway is proposed in which the mathematical core of hypoplasticity-ML coupling developed for German offshore wind conditions can be adapted to Peru through regional recalibration, seismic-liquefaction extensions, and a phased data-acquisition programme, without requiring reproduction of the full German site-investigation infrastructure. The conclusions drawn are explicitly limited to what the synthesised evidence supports; site-specific validation for Peruvian conditions remains an open research need.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种物理约束的亚塑性—机器学习框架，用于支持海上基础设计中对海洋土体强非线性、速率相关和循环响应的高效建模。作者基于既有砂土与黏土亚塑性模型，定义了耦合与验证流程，包括 k 折交叉验证、R²、RMSE、MAE 和置信区间等指标。研究还构建了德国、秘鲁和美国在岩土、监管与技术条件方面的比较矩阵，旨在讨论成熟海上市场中的建模方法向新兴市场转移的可行性。

articles.title: Residual strength of corroded reinforced concrete beams: Experimental, analytical, numerical and machine learning approach
articles.title_zh: 锈蚀钢筋混凝土梁剩余强度：实验、解析、数值与机器学习方法
articles.abstract: The present study aims to quantify the residual flexural capacity of corroded reinforced concrete (CRC) beams using experimental, analytical, numerical, and machine learning approaches. Experimental investigation, which is a conventional practice was conducted on RC beams cast using two concrete grades, M30 and M50. One control beam was maintained for each grade, while the remaining beams were subjected to corrosion levels up to 16%. All beams of size 100 × 150 × 1220 mm were tested under four-point bending to evaluate flexural strength. The experimental results indicated a significant reduction in flexural capacity due to corrosion, where the ultimate load decreased up-to the extent of 44%. However, as the experimental investigations are associated with limitations such as high cost, time intensive procedures, labour intensive setup, and variability in material properties; different analytical formulations have been proposed by various researchers in the literature. The analytical approach based on IS 456:2000 with modifications developed by the authors has been used in the present study. The analytical results showed close correlation with experimental findings. Nevertheless, analytical models being generally limited in applicability, due to much dependency on particular experimental conditions used. Considering the limitations of analytical models, the numerical modelling was carried out using finite element analysis in ABAQUS. A finite element model was developed by incorporating concrete damaged plasticity and reduction in reinforcement properties due to corrosion. Thenumerical results showed close correlation to the experimental results, with an average variation of approximately 6.91%. However, numerical modelling also involves limitations such as idealising the bond-slip behaviour, challenges in accurately capturing localized corrosion effects, and higher computational requirements. To achieve a more rapid and accurate prediction framework, machine learning models were also developed. A dataset comprising 201 RC beams collected from experimental studies was used for training and validation. Four models, the Random Forest, XGBoost, Linear Regression, and Artificial Neural Network (ANN), were trained and evaluated. Among these, the Random Forest model demonstrated the best performance, with a mean prediction error of 0.27, showing very close correlation with experimental results and outperforming other models. The study highlights that while experimental, analytical, and numerical approaches provide valuable insights, machine learning models offer a more efficient and accurate tool for predicting the residual flexural capacity of corroded RC beams. The proposed integrated approach can be effectively used for rapid assessment and future prediction of structural performance under corrosion effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用实验、解析、数值和机器学习方法评估锈蚀钢筋混凝土梁的剩余抗弯承载力。实验使用 M30 和 M50 两种混凝土等级的梁试件，并设置最高约16%的锈蚀水平，在四点弯曲加载下测试其抗弯性能，结果显示锈蚀可使极限荷载最高降低约44%。作者还采用基于 IS 456:2000 并经修正的解析方法与实验结果对比，旨在弥补单纯实验方法成本高、耗时长和材料离散性较大的局限。

articles.title: Non-invasive visualization of boiling from sound using a generative model
articles.title_zh: 利用生成模型从声音非侵入式可视化沸腾过程
articles.abstract: Boiling dissipates large heat loads at low temperature rise and sets the performance and safety limits of the highest-power thermal systems, from two-phase cold plates to the immersion cooling now being adopted for artificial-intelligence (AI) data centers and high-power chips. These limits are governed by fast, near-wall bubble dynamics best resolved by high-speed imaging—yet in most real systems the boiling surface is sealed, opaque or otherwise optically inaccessible, and cannot be seen at all. Here we show that boiling can instead be visualized from sound alone. We formulate acoustic-to-video generation of boiling, generating high-speed videos from a single external acoustic-emission waveform, a static background image and a heating-region mask—all obtainable without optical access. Because one acoustic channel cannot fix every bubble's instantaneous position, the inverse problem is one-to-many: deterministic regression collapses to a blurred average, so we instead learn a conditional velocity field that samples plausible bubble fields. Benchmarked against twenty-three configurations spanning diffusion, adversarial, latent-diffusion, transformer and flow-matching families, our model reproduces the heat-flux-dependent bubble-field evolution with the highest video-level fidelity. Non-invasive acoustic-to-video generation thus provides a virtual high-speed window into boiling surfaces that cannot be directly imaged.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出仅基于声音信号对沸腾过程进行可视化的方法，以应对真实热系统中沸腾表面密封、不透明或不可光学观测的问题。作者将沸腾声学到视频生成表述为条件生成任务，输入单通道外部声发射波形、静态背景图像和加热区域掩膜，输出高速沸腾视频。由于单一声学通道无法唯一确定每个气泡的瞬时位置，研究采用学习条件速度场的生成方式来采样合理的气泡场，而非使用会导致模糊平均结果的确定性回归。

articles.title: Influence of Bottom Electrode Material on the Morphological and Frequency-Dependent Electrical Characteristics of Sputtered HfO₂ Thin-Film Metal-Insulator-Metal Capacitors
articles.title_zh: 底电极材料对溅射 HfO₂ 薄膜金属—绝缘体—金属电容器形貌及频率相关电学特性的影响
articles.abstract: The influence of bottom electrode material on the morphological and frequency-dependent electrical characteristics of RF-sputtered HfO₂ thin-film metal–insulator–metal (MIM) capacitors was systematically investigated. Two capacitor structures, namely Al/HfO₂/Pt and Al/HfO₂/Al, were fabricated by depositing a 100 nm HfO₂ dielectric layer using RF magnetron sputtering on platinized Si and Al-coated SiO₂ substrates, respectively. Further, circular aluminum top electrodes with a thickness of 300 nm and a diameter of 500 µm were deposited by thermal evaporation technique using shadow mask. The surface morphologies were characterized by atomic force microscope (AFM). The electrical properties were measured by Keithley 4200A-SCS semiconductor parameter analyzer by C-V and G-V measurements for voltage sweep ranges ± 2 V, ± 5 V, and ± 10 V with frequencies of 100 kHz to 1 MHz. By AFM measurements, it has been found that HfO₂ thin films had smooth and uniform morphologies with RMS roughness of 4.40 nm and 4.90 nm for Pt- and Al-based structures, respectively. It is found that both capacitors had normal frequency dependence with capacitance, dielectric constant, capacitance density, dielectric loss, quality factor, conductance, and parallel resistance depend strongly on the measurement frequency. On the contrary, the Al/HfO₂/Pt structure showed relatively low dielectric loss, higher quality factor, high parallel resistance, and better surface morphology, indicating good dielectric insulator property and low dissipation of energy. The conclusion drawn from these studies is that bottom electrode material determines the properties of dielectric/electrode interface and controls the frequency dependent electrical characteristics of sputtered HfO₂ thin film MIM capacitors. This knowledge will be helpful in designing HfO₂ based dielectric capacitors for high frequency analog and RF applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察底电极材料对射频溅射 HfO₂ 薄膜 MIM 电容器表面形貌和频率相关电学特性的影响。作者制备了 Al/HfO₂/Pt 和 Al/HfO₂/Al 两种结构，并通过原子力显微镜及 C-V、G-V 测量进行表征。结果显示，两类 HfO₂ 薄膜均具有较平滑均匀的形貌，Pt 与 Al 底电极结构的 RMS 粗糙度分别约为4.40 nm和4.90 nm，且电容、介电常数等参数表现出正常的频率依赖特征。

articles.title: Growth kinetics of proeutectoid ferrite isothermal transformation in a Fe–0.4 C (mass%) alloy under a high magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 高磁场下 Fe–0.4C（质量分数%）合金先共析铁素体等温转变生长动力学
articles.abstract: In this study, the effects of a high magnetic field on the growth kinetics of proeutectoid ferrite are investigated. The carbon content at the austenite/ferrite (γ/α) interface with and without a high magnetic field is characterized by a field emission electron probe microanalyzer. The results demonstrate that a high magnetic field increases the carbon content in the austenite at the γ/α interface. In addition, a high magnetic field increases the parabolic length growth rate constant of proeutectoid ferrite by approximately 15%–28% along the magnetic field direction from 993 K to 1033 K. Conversely, it inhibits the parabolic thickness growth rate constant of proeutectoid ferrite by approximately 11%–26% perpendicular to the magnetic field direction from 993 K to 1033 K. At this foundation, relationship between ferrite growth rates with and without a high magnetic field are illuminated, quantitively. The mechanism of the moving γ/α interfaces is discussed from the viewpoint of carbon diffusion in austenite and the carbon content at the γ/α interface with the absence of high magnetic or not.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察高磁场对 Fe–0.4C 合金中先共析铁素体生长动力学的影响，并利用场发射电子探针显微分析表征有无高磁场条件下奥氏体/铁素体界面处的碳含量。结果表明，高磁场会提高 γ/α 界面处奥氏体中的碳含量，并在993 K至1033 K范围内使沿磁场方向的铁素体抛物线长度生长速率常数提高约15%–28%。同时，高磁场会使垂直于磁场方向的厚度生长速率常数降低约11%–26%，作者据此从奥氏体中碳扩散和界面碳含量角度讨论了界面迁移机制。

articles.title: Establishment and parameter calibration of double-layer bonded discrete element model for alfalfa stems at optimal harvest stage
articles.title_zh: 最佳收获期紫花苜蓿茎秆双层黏结离散元模型的建立与参数标定
articles.abstract: Accurate discrete element method (DEM) modelling of alfalfa stems is essential for simulating cutting, conveying, stacking, and drying pre-treatment operations. However, conventional DEM models generally treat crop stems as homogeneous materials, thereby neglecting the structural heterogeneity between the epidermis and inner core. This study aimed to establish and calibrate a double-layer bonded DEM model for alfalfa stems at the optimal harvest stage. The physical, mechanical, and contact parameters of alfalfa stems were experimentally measured. A double-layer model comprising epidermis and inner-core regions was developed using the Hertz–Mindlin with Bonding (HMB) contact model. The key bonding and contact parameters were calibrated through Plackett–Burman screening, steepest ascent tests, and Box–Behnken response surface methodology. In addition, a feedforward neural network (FNN) was employed to predict the simulated shear force. The measured average moisture content, shear force, and repose angle were 0.723 ± 0.044 kg/kg, 56.36 N, and 31.62°, respectively. The shear-force response surface model achieved an R² of 0.9036, while the FNN model yielded an R² of 0.9077 and an RMSE of 0.9407. The results from the shear force response surface model and the FNN model are similar. The calibrated DEM model produced a simulated repose angle of 31.46°, corresponding to a relative error of only 0.51%. These results indicate that the proposed double-layer bonded DEM model can accurately represent the anisotropic mechanical behavior of alfalfa stems and provide a reliable simulation basis for optimizing alfalfa harvesting and drying pre-treatment equipment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对传统离散元模型将作物茎秆视为均质材料、忽略表皮与内芯结构差异的问题，建立了紫花苜蓿茎秆的双层黏结离散元模型。作者通过实验测定物理、力学和接触参数，并结合 Plackett–Burman 筛选、最陡爬坡试验和 Box–Behnken 响应面法进行关键参数标定。研究还引入前馈神经网络预测模拟剪切力，结果表明该模型能够较好表征最佳收获期苜蓿茎秆的剪切和堆积等力学行为。

articles.title: Low-temperature spin dynamics and absence of magnetic order in layered α−RuI₃
articles.title_zh: 层状 α−RuI₃ 中的低温自旋动力学与磁有序缺失
articles.abstract: Author(s): Hank C. H. Wu, Benjamin M. Huddart, Francis L. Pratt, Danrui Ni, Robert J. Cava, and Stephen J. Blundell Quantum spin liquids are long-sought for their elusive, never-frozen magnetic states. In layered α -RuI 3 , magnetic Ru ions form a honeycomb network related to the Kitaev material α -RuCl 3 , yet muon spin relaxation reveals a strikingly different low-temperature behaviour. The authors show here that the spins remain dynamically fluctuating down to 50 mK and find evidence for 2D spin diffusion, supporting the view that α -RuI 3 is a promising candidate for hosting a quantum spin liquid state. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 014411] Published Fri Jul 10, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注与 Kitaev 材料 α−RuCl₃ 相关的层状蜂窝磁体 α−RuI₃ 的低温磁性行为。通过 μ 子自旋弛豫实验，作者发现其自旋在低至 50 mK 时仍保持动态涨落，并观察到二维自旋扩散的证据。结果支持 α−RuI₃ 可能是量子自旋液体候选材料的观点。
authors: Hank C. H. Wu, Benjamin M. Huddart, Francis L. Pratt, Danrui Ni, Robert J. Cava, and Stephen J. Blundell

articles.title: Majorana string simulation of nonequilibrium dynamics in two-dimensional lattice fermion systems
articles.title_zh: 二维晶格费米子系统非平衡动力学的 Majorana 字符串模拟
articles.abstract: Author(s): Matteo D'Anna, Jannes Nys, and Juan Carrasquilla Simulating the real-time dynamics of fermionic systems remains a major open problem at the core of understanding materials, chemistry, and other strongly correlated systems. Here, the authors present Majorana propagation, a Heisenberg-picture algorithm that evolves observables in a Majorana-string basis. Benchmarks against tensor network methods and recent quantum experimental data show that the method provides accurate results in the strongly interacting regime in two-dimensional lattices, a notoriously classically hard regime. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034305] Published Fri Jul 10, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种名为 Majorana 传播的海森堡绘景算法，用 Majorana 字符串基来演化可观测量，以模拟费米子系统的实时动力学。作者将该方法与张量网络方法及近期量子实验数据进行基准比较，显示其在二维强相互作用晶格体系中能够给出准确结果。该方法有望推进对材料、化学和强关联体系非平衡行为的经典模拟。
authors: Matteo D'Anna, Jannes Nys, and Juan Carrasquilla

articles.title: Microscopic NMR evidence for successive antiferroelectric and antiferromagnetic order in the van der Waals magnet CuCrP₂S₆
articles.title_zh: 范德瓦耳斯磁体 CuCrP₂S₆ 中连续反铁电与反铁磁有序的微观核磁共振证据
articles.abstract: Author(s): C. S. Saramgi, L. F. Prager, S. Selter, Y. Shemerliuk, S. Aswartham, B. Büchner, H.-J. Grafe, and K. M. Ranjith The layered van der Waals magnet CuCrP 2 S 6 hosts a sequence of ordering phenomena. Here, the authors use nuclear magnetic resonance to provide direct microscopic fingerprints of its successive phase transitions, revealing the emergence of a quasi-antiferroelectric state, long-range antiferroelectric order, and antiferromagnetic order upon cooling. The results uncover the microscopic signatures of successive electric and magnetic ordering transitions in a van der Waals material and provide insight into the interplay between electric and magnetic order in layered quantum materials. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 034413] Published Fri Jul 10, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用核磁共振技术探测层状范德瓦耳斯磁体 CuCrP₂S₆ 的连续相变过程。结果给出了准反铁电态、长程反铁电有序以及反铁磁有序随降温依次出现的微观证据。该工作揭示了范德瓦耳斯材料中电有序与磁有序相继形成的微观特征，并有助于理解层状量子材料中的电磁耦合。
authors: C. S. Saramgi, L. F. Prager, S. Selter, Y. Shemerliuk, S. Aswartham, B. Büchner, H.-J. Grafe, and K. M. Ranjith

articles.title: Empowering neural network-based quantum Monte Carlo with local pseudopotentials
articles.title_zh: 利用局域赝势增强基于神经网络的量子蒙特卡罗方法
articles.abstract: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01008-7 This study shows that local pseudopotentials boost the efficiency of neural network-based quantum Monte Carlo while preserving accuracy, enabling reliable simulations of large, challenging iron–sulfur clusters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，局域赝势能够在保持计算精度的同时提高基于神经网络的量子蒙特卡罗方法的效率。该策略使得对大型、复杂铁硫簇等具有挑战性的体系进行可靠模拟成为可能。研究体现了机器学习波函数与量子蒙特卡罗方法结合在量子化学和材料模拟中的潜力。

articles.title: C3Q-MARL: A Framework for UAV SwarmConnectivity and Collision Avoidance
articles.title_zh: C3Q-MARL：面向无人机蜂群连通性与避碰的框架
articles.abstract: This paper presents C3Q-MARL (Connectivity, Control, Coordination, and Quantum Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning), a connectivity-aware framework for UAV swarm coordination under partial observability and communication constraints. The proposed approach integrates graph-theoretic topology control with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to jointly address connectivity preservation, collision avoidance, and cooperative decision-making in dynamic environments. A weighted minimum-spanning-tree communication structure is embedded within the learning process, while a QAOA-inspired optimization module is employed as a classical variational heuristic for topology selection and exploration guidance. The swarm environment is modeled as a dynamic partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), enabling centralized topology optimization during training and decentralized policy execution at deployment. The proposed framework is evaluated in urban traffic monitoring, wildfire surveillance, and 6G coverageplanning scenarios, together with hardware-in-the-loop UAV experiments. Results demonstrate consistent improvements in mission success rate, coverage efficiency, connectivity maintenance, and convergence behavior compared with representative MARL baselines trained under identical computational and data budgets. Ablation studies indicate that the topology-optimization module provides the greatest benefit in dense and communication-constrained environments, while its contribution is reduced in sparse settings. Scalability experiments involving swarms of up to 500 UAVs and stress tests under packet loss, communication disruptions, and energy constraints demonstrate robust performance and near-linear runtime growth on classical hardware. To facilitate reproducibility, source code, configuration files, training logs, and evaluation scripts are publicly released.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出 C3Q-MARL 框架，用于在部分可观测和通信受限条件下实现无人机蜂群协同控制。该方法将图论拓扑控制与多智能体强化学习结合，同时处理连通性保持、碰撞避免和协同决策问题，并引入加权最小生成树通信结构及受 QAOA 启发的拓扑优化启发式模块。作者在城市交通监测、野火监视、6G 覆盖规划和硬件在环无人机实验中评估该框架，结果显示其在任务成功率、覆盖效率和连通性维持等方面具有改进。

articles.title: Antibacterial activity analysis of Cu(II) complexes with amino acid Schiff bases based on electron distribution anisotropy
articles.title_zh: 基于电子分布各向异性的氨基酸席夫碱 Cu(II) 配合物抗菌活性分析
articles.abstract: Understanding electronic factors associated with the antibacterial activity of metal complexes is important for the rational design of antimicrobial materials. In this study, we investigated a series of azobenzene-containing copper complexes (AZCu) by integrating density functional theory (DFT)-derived electronic descriptors, molecular docking scores (GOLDscore), and experimentally measured antibacterial activity data. To minimize potential overfitting within the molecular series, descriptor relevance was evaluated using a GroupKFold cross-validation scheme that strictly separates data derived from the same ligand framework. Spearman rank correlation analysis indicated that the quadrupole-anisotropy descriptors (Qₐₙᵢₛₒ and Qᵗₐₙᵢₛₒ₎, together with the spatial-extent descriptor ⟨r²⟩ and the response descriptor αᵢₛₒ, exhibited consistent correlations with antibacterial activity across species. In contrast, GOLDscore showed comparatively weaker and more species-dependent relationships. The DFT-derived descriptors were largely independent of docking scores, suggesting that they capture global electronic characteristics not fully represented by static pocket complementarity. Although electrostatic potential maps of the AZCu complexes do not show pronounced charge localization, the π-conjugated azobenzene framework enhances higher-order electronic response properties that may contribute to interactions with heterogeneous biological surfaces. Overall, the quadrupole-anisotropy descriptors exhibited the most robust statistical association with antibacterial activity, followed by ⟨r²⟩ and αᵢₛₒ. These findings provide a physically informed framework for interpreting activity trends in metal-based antimicrobial systems while emphasizing the complementary role of electronic descriptors alongside docking-based analyses.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合密度泛函理论电子描述符、分子对接评分和实验抗菌活性数据，分析含偶氮苯铜配合物的抗菌活性相关因素。作者采用 GroupKFold 交叉验证以减少同系列配体导致的过拟合风险，并发现四极矩各向异性、空间尺度和响应性等 DFT 描述符与多种菌种的抗菌活性存在较稳定相关性。相比之下，对接评分的相关性较弱且更依赖物种，说明全局电子特征可能捕捉到静态口袋互补性之外的重要信息。

articles.title: Coupled magneto-fluid and thermo-mechanical simulation with experimental validation of the evolution of the molten zone during resistance spot welding
articles.title_zh: 电阻点焊熔化区演化的磁流体—热机械耦合模拟及实验验证
articles.abstract: Expulsion is a major limiting phenomenon in resistance spot welding of advanced high-strength steels, as it defines the upper boundary of the weldability range and compromises joint integrity. Classical electro-thermo-mechanical (ETM) models, while effective for predicting nugget growth, neglect fluid flow within the molten pool, limiting their ability to accurately describe the thermal field and mechanical confinement of the nugget. In this work, a new fully coupled Electro-Thermo-Magneto-Mechanical-Hydrodynamic (ETMMHD) finite element model is proposed, based on a Multi-Mesh strategy coupling solid mechanics and fluid flow at each time step. The model is validated against experimental data obtained on uncoated DP600 steel sheets, combining metallographic measurements, high-speed imaging and ultrasonic scanning. Comparison between the ETM and ETMMHD models demonstrates the significant impact of fluid flow coupling on both the thermal field and nugget geometry predictions. Furthermore, preliminary simulations at currents approaching the expulsion threshold suggest that the proposed framework constitutes a promising step toward the development of a physically based expulsion criterion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对先进高强钢电阻点焊中的飞溅现象，提出一种完全耦合的电—热—磁—力—流体动力学有限元模型。模型采用多网格策略，在每个时间步耦合固体力学与熔池流动，并通过未镀层 DP600 钢板的金相测量、高速成像和超声扫描数据进行验证。与传统电—热—力模型相比，耦合流体流动显著影响温度场和焊核几何预测，表明该框架有望用于建立更具物理基础的飞溅判据。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Predicting Buckling Performance and Damage Evolution in Graphene Reinforced Basalt/Epoxy Composites
articles.title_zh: 用于预测石墨烯增强玄武岩/环氧复合材料屈曲性能与损伤演化的物理信息机器学习
articles.abstract: Basalt fiber-reinforced polymer composites are attractive for lightweight structural applications due to their high specific strength, thermal stability, and environmental sustainability. Their performance is limited by weak fiber–matrix interfaces, premature damage initiation, and insufficient compressive stability. This study presents an integrated experimental–computational framework to improve the structural performance of basalt/epoxy composites through dual-phase reduced graphene oxide (rGO) functionalization. Basalt fibers were coated with rGO using electrophoretic deposition, while rGO was simultaneously incorporated into the epoxy matrix through a hybrid ultrasonication–high-shear dispersion process. Mechanical characterization demonstrated that dual-phase functionalization significantly enhanced tensile, compressive, interlaminar shear, and fracture properties by improving interfacial bonding and matrix stiffness. The experimentally optimized composite was incorporated into a multiscale modeling framework in which representative volume element (RVE)-based homogenization was used to determine effective orthotropic properties for nonlinear finite element analysis. Progressive damage behavior under compressive loading was evaluated using Hashin failure criteria coupled with continuum damage mechanics. A comprehensive dataset comprising 12,852 laminate configurations was generated by varying geometric parameters and stacking sequences and was subsequently used to develop machine-learning surrogate models for prediction of critical buckling loads. An ensemble model combining linear regression and support vector regression achieved a coefficient of determination of 0.973. SHAP-based interpretation identified laminate length and width as the dominant parameters governing buckling resistance. Progressive damage analysis further revealed that dual-phase rGO functionalization delays damage initiation and promotes stable load redistribution. The proposed framework provides an efficient pathway for the design and optimization of lightweight, damage-tolerant composite structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出实验—计算一体化框架，通过还原氧化石墨烯对玄武岩纤维表面和环氧基体进行双相功能化，以提升玄武岩/环氧复合材料的结构性能。实验表明，该策略可通过改善界面结合和基体刚度，增强拉伸、压缩、层间剪切和断裂性能。研究进一步将优化后的材料参数纳入基于代表性体元均匀化的多尺度模型，并结合非线性有限元与物理信息机器学习预测屈曲行为和损伤演化。

articles.title: Nanofluidic memristor with an ultra-low operating voltage
articles.title_zh: 具有超低工作电压的纳流体忆阻器
articles.abstract: Nanofluidic memristors, which process information via ion transport, represent a promising platform for neuromorphic computing. However, their development has been hindered by high operating voltages. Here, we present a framework to achieve memristive switching at an ultra-low voltage in a nanofluidic system. This is realized by minimizing electromotive force through the selection of electrode-electrolyte pairs, incorporating nanochannels that enable reversible ion adsorption/desorption, and confining the operating voltage within the system’s overpotential. The resulting Cu–PAF/CuSO4–Cu nanofluidic memristor operates at a sub-100 mV voltage, significantly lower than existing nanofluidic devices, and successfully emulates short-term synaptic plasticity with an energy consumption of 100 fJ per spike. This work establishes a viable pathway toward energy-efficient neuromorphic computing on nanofluidic platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种在纳流体系统中实现超低电压忆阻开关的设计框架，核心包括选择合适的电极—电解质对、利用可逆离子吸附/脱附的纳米通道，并将工作电压限制在体系过电位范围内。所制备的 Cu–PAF/CuSO4–Cu 纳流体忆阻器可在低于 100 mV 的电压下运行，显著低于已有纳流体器件。该器件还能模拟短时程突触可塑性，单脉冲能耗约为 100 fJ，为低能耗纳流体神经形态计算提供了可行路径。

articles.title: A Mesoscale Damage Mechanics Framework for Predicting Damage Initiation in Cross-Ply Composite Laminates under Low-Velocity Impact Using Artificial Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 利用人工神经网络预测低速冲击下正交铺层复合层合板损伤起始的介观损伤力学框架
articles.abstract: Composite laminates are widely employed in aerospace, automotive, and marine structures owing to their high specific strength, stiffness, and excellent corrosion resistance. However, their susceptibility to barely visible impact damage (BVID) resulting from low-velocity impact events, such as tool drops, bird strikes, and accidental service loads, can significantly compromise structural integrity. Such impacts often induce complex damage mechanisms, including matrix cracking, fibre–matrix debonding, fibre kinking, and interlaminar delamination, which are difficult to detect using conventional inspection techniques. This study presents a mesoscale damage mechanics framework for predicting damage initiation and evolution in cross-ply carbon/epoxy laminates subjected to low-velocity impact. The laminate is modelled as an assembly of plies and interlaminar interfaces, each governed by independent constitutive damage evolution laws. A plasticity–damage coupled formulation is employed to characterize the nonlinear response of the interfacial resin, while an enhanced damage evolution model is implemented for the composite plies to capture progressive intralaminar degradation. The proposed finite element model accurately reproduces the characteristic damage morphology, including the trapezoidal delamination pattern and ply-wise damage distribution observed experimentally. To further enhance predictive capability and computational efficiency, an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) model is developed using simulation and experimental datasets. The ANN successfully captures the nonlinear relationship between impact parameters and structural response, achieving a coefficient of determination (R²) of 0.997. The close agreement between numerical predictions, ANN results, and experimental observations demonstrates the reliability and robustness of the proposed hybrid framework. The integration of physics-based damage mechanics with data-driven modelling provides an efficient and accurate approach for predicting impact-induced damage in composite laminates. The proposed methodology offers significant potential for structural health monitoring, damage assessment, and the design of impact-resistant composite structures in aerospace and related engineering applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向航空、汽车和海洋结构中复合层合板的低速冲击损伤问题，提出一种介观损伤力学框架，用于预测正交铺层碳/环氧层合板的损伤起始与演化。模型将层合板表示为铺层和层间界面的组合，并分别采用独立的本构损伤演化规律。研究引入塑性—损伤耦合模型描述层间树脂的非线性响应，并采用改进的铺层损伤演化模型捕捉层内渐进退化，同时结合人工神经网络提升损伤预测能力。

articles.title: Trace hydroxypropyl methylcellulose induced physical crosslinking enables direct 3D printing of aqueous PEDOT:PSS
articles.title_zh: 微量羟丙基甲基纤维素诱导的物理交联实现水性 PEDOT:PSS 的直接 3D 打印
articles.abstract: Organic mixed ionic–electronic conductors (OMIECs), particularly PEDOT:PSS, are widely used in bioelectronic interfaces but remain difficult to directly print due to their intrinsically low viscosity. Conventional strategies that enhance printability—such as polymer over-concentration or chemical crosslinking—often compromise electronic transport and device dynamics. Here we show that trace incorporation of hydroxypropyl methylcellulose (HPMC) provides an effective route to simultaneously regulate processability, mesoscale organization, and electromechanical performance of PEDOT:PSS through interaction-driven physical crosslinking. At an extremely low loading (0.1 wt% relative to PH1000), HPMC selectively interacts with the sulfonate-rich PSS component via hydrogen-bond-mediated interactions, forming a dynamically percolated polymer network that imparts sufficient viscoelasticity for direct ink writing. Multiscale rheological, spectroscopic, and structural analyses reveal that the pronounced viscosity enhancement originates from specific HPMC–PSS coupling rather than the intrinsic thickening effect of HPMC, while the intrinsic electronic structure and carrier density of PEDOT remain largely unchanged. Leveraging this strategy, 3D-printed organic electrochemical transistors with channel as thin as 150 nm exhibit millisecond-scale response, and HPMC-enabled PEDOT:PSS/PVA composite films achieve high conductivity, mechanical robustness, and strongly suppressed strain-induced resistance variations, making them attractive for mechanically compliant electrodes in wearable bioelectronics. These findings reveal that trace additive–induced physical crosslinking can regulate the mesoscale organization of OMIECs, providing a general strategy for engineering printable and mechanically resilient bioelectronic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，向 PEDOT:PSS 中加入极微量羟丙基甲基纤维素（HPMC）可通过相互作用驱动的物理交联，同时调控其可加工性、介观结构和电机械性能。在相对于 PH1000 仅 0.1 wt% 的添加量下，HPMC 通过氢键与富含磺酸基的 PSS 选择性耦合，形成动态贯通网络，使材料具备直接墨水书写所需的黏弹性。多尺度流变、光谱和结构分析显示，黏度提升主要源于 HPMC–PSS 特异性作用，而 PEDOT 的本征电子结构和载流子密度基本保持不变。

articles.title: Multi-Channel Nanoribbon Arrays for Enhanced Superconductivity in Magic-Angle Graphene
articles.title_zh: 用于增强魔角石墨烯超导性的多通道纳米带阵列
articles.abstract: We propose a conceptual framework for elevating the superconducting critical temperature Tc of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) through proximity-induced topological coherence protection via patterned cobalt nanoribbon arrays. The central mechanism — the Topological Cooper Scaffold — combines three independently established experimental findings: room-temperature-stable magnetic nodal lines in elemental cobalt [1]; gate-tunable cobalt proximity effects in graphene heterostructures [2]; and strong intervalley phonon coupling in superconducting MATBG [3]. Proximity exchange coupling from cobalt nanoribbon arrays imprints nodal-line spin texture into MATBG flat bands, imposing spin-dependent selection rules that suppress the dominant intervalley phonon pair-breaking channel. A semi-microscopic computational simulation using the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula with a spin-overlap suppression model demonstrates internal consistency of the proposed mechanism. A new robustness analysis introduces an interface uniformity parameter UΔ ∈ [0,1] representing the spatial variance of the proximity exchange field. Across the full tested range (UΔ = 0.20 to 1.00), the model produces positive ΔTc within the estimated [0.5, 2.0] K range, indicating the mechanism does not require unrealistically perfect interface conditions. Patterned cobalt nanoribbon arrays are proposed as a geometrically engineered heterostructure design offering additional fabrication parameters, reduced strain, and improved per-ribbon interface quality compared to a continuous cobalt film. Five falsifiable experimental predictions are stated with explicit falsification conditions and proposed control devices. This work presents a mechanistic hypothesis supported by computational modeling and literature-derived parameters. It is intended to generate experimentally testable predictions rather than establish factual accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种概念框架，通过图案化钴纳米带阵列诱导的拓扑相干保护，提高魔角扭转双层石墨烯的超导临界温度。其核心机制被称为“拓扑库珀支架”，利用钴中的磁性节点线、石墨烯异质结构中的可栅控钴邻近效应，以及魔角石墨烯中的强谷间声子耦合。模型认为钴纳米带产生的邻近交换耦合可向平带写入节点线自旋纹理，从而抑制主要的谷间声子破对通道；半微观模拟与稳健性分析显示该机制在一定界面均匀性范围内具有内部一致性。

articles.title: Open-Cast Mining Surface Risk Assessment Using GIS and Statistical Modelling: A Multi-Criteria Framework for Sustainable Mine Safety and Environmental Management
articles.title_zh: 基于 GIS 与统计建模的露天采矿地表风险评估：面向可持续矿山安全与环境管理的多准则框架
articles.abstract: Open-cast mining has become the dominant method of coal extraction in many developing countries because of its high productivity and economic efficiency. However, extensive surface excavation has resulted in severe environmental degradation, landscape alteration, slope instability, land subsidence, groundwater contamination, dust pollution, and threats to nearby communities. Conventional mine safety assessments are generally based on field observations and engineering investigations, which often fail to capture the spatial variability of environmental risks over large mining regions. This study proposes an integrated Geographic Information System (GIS) and statistical modelling framework for assessing surface risks associated with open-cast mining operations. The framework combines remote sensing datasets, Digital Elevation Models (DEM), land use and land cover information, vegetation indices, drainage characteristics, transportation networks, settlement distribution, and mine boundary information using a Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) approach based on the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP). A Surface Risk Index (SRI) is generated through weighted overlay analysis and validated using regression and correlation techniques. The resulting risk zonation map classifies mining areas into very low, low, moderate, high, and very high risk categories. The study demonstrates that slope, vegetation degradation, proximity to mine pits, drainage density, and settlement concentration are significant determinants of mining-related surface risk. The proposed framework provides a scientifically robust and transferable methodology for sustainable mine planning, environmental monitoring, disaster prevention, and mine closure management.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对露天采矿造成的地表扰动、边坡不稳定、地面沉降、地下水污染、粉尘和社区风险等问题，提出集成 GIS 与统计建模的地表风险评估框架。该框架结合遥感数据、数字高程模型、土地利用/覆盖、植被指数、排水特征、交通网络、居民点分布和矿区边界信息，并采用基于层次分析法的多准则决策分析。研究通过加权叠加生成地表风险指数，以刻画大范围矿区环境风险的空间差异，为矿山安全与环境管理提供支持。

articles.title: Solar Energetic Helium Penetration into the Earth’s Magnetosphere during the September 2017 Ground Level Event
articles.title_zh: 2017 年 9 月地面增强事件期间太阳高能氦进入地球磁层的观测研究
articles.abstract: The period during early September 2017 showed extraordinary solar activity with several strong solar energetic particle (SEP) events including the ground level event (GLE) beginning September 10th and lasting nearly a week. During this time the Relativistic Electron Proton Telescope (REPT) onboard NASA’s twin-spacecraft Van Allen Probes mission observed energetic helium ions penetrating into the Earth’s magnetospheric polar regions. The Earth’s magnetic field usually shields energetic particles; they can still penetrate provided their “cutoff rigidities” are larger than the local vertical cutoff. These so-called cutoffs are determined by particle rigidities, i.e., momentum per unit charge. The Pulse Height Analyzed (PHA) data from REPT enable identifying helium ions as well as measure their spectra. These PHA data were used to characterize helium ions penetrating into the Earth’s magnetosphere including the temporal evolution of their spectra during first weeks of September 2017. Helium is the second most ubiquitous element comprising SEPs and is critically important from a space weather particle radiation perspective. The REPT observations showed contemporaneous helium injection at high latitudes with the SEP event. The injected helium spectra gradually softened during the course of the event. These observations suggest that most likely no dynamic processes within the magnetosphere further energized the injected helium which gradually escaped the magnetosphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了 2017 年 9 月强太阳活动期间，尤其是 9 月 10 日开始的地面增强事件中，太阳高能氦离子进入地球磁层极区的情况。研究利用 NASA 范艾伦探测器上相对论电子质子望远镜的脉冲高度分析数据识别氦离子并测量其能谱。结果表明，在太阳高能粒子事件期间，满足当地截止刚度条件的氦离子能够穿透地磁屏蔽并进入磁层，这对空间天气辐射环境评估具有重要意义。

articles.title: Asymmetric Modulating Role of Action Magnitude in Hand-Action Sequence Effects
articles.title_zh: 动作幅度在手部动作序列效应中的非对称调节作用
articles.abstract: Background Previous studies on hand-action sequence effects have shown significant divergence: some reported an interference effect of “using/grasping on lifting,” whereas others found a facilitation effect. This study proposed that this inconsistency stems from ignoring action magnitude (action-size coding corresponding to object size)—namely, the fundamental differences in neural control strategies between precision and power actions.Methods Through four experiments employing a task-switching paradigm, we systematically examined sequence-effect patterns under different action sequences (use/grasp-lift) and social cues (presence/absence of gestures).Results The results revealed a stable asymmetric sequence effect: prior actions (using or grasping) significantly interfered with subsequent lifting actions, specifically during the switch from precision to power actions. This finding supports the “inhibitory neural locking hypothesis,” suggesting a specific neural unlocking cost when switching from high-inhibition precision actions to synergistic power actions. Conversely, lifting actions consistently facilitated subsequent functional actions, indicating that they provide a “kinematic scaffold” for complex behaviors. Notably, this asymmetric pattern was unaffected by external gesture cues, reflecting the priority of biomechanical constraints over social cues in action planning.Conclusions Overall, by introducing action magnitude as a variable, this study successfully reconciled theoretical controversies in the field: It constructed an integrated model of action hierarchy and neural inhibitory mechanisms and provided key theoretical implications for neurorehabilitation and humanoid robot control.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对既有手部动作序列效应研究中“使用/抓握对抬举”表现为干扰或促进的分歧，提出关键原因在于忽视了动作幅度，即与物体大小相对应的动作大小编码。作者通过四个采用任务转换范式的实验，考察不同动作序列和社会线索条件下的序列效应。结果显示，从精细动作转换到力量动作时，先前的使用或抓握动作会稳定干扰后续抬举动作，支持“抑制性神经锁定假说”；相反，抬举动作则持续促进后续功能性动作，可能提供运动学准备。

articles.title: Programmable light simulates quantum matter across 300 processes without bigger circuits
articles.title_zh: 可编程光在不扩大电路的情况下模拟 300 个量子物质过程
articles.abstract: A team of researchers at the University of Ottawa and its Nexus for Quantum Technologies Institute, in collaboration with researchers from Federico II University in Italy, has developed a programmable quantum simulator that shapes a beam of light to replicate how particles move through complex materials, avoiding the need for ever-larger electronic hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了渥太华大学及其 Nexus 量子技术研究所与意大利费德里科二世大学研究人员合作开发的一种可编程量子模拟器。该系统通过塑造光束来复现粒子在复杂材料中的运动，从而避免依赖不断增大的电子硬件。该工作围绕光学量子模拟在复杂量子物质研究中的可扩展应用展开，更多技术细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Quantum material opens new path for studying unusual electronic behavior
articles.title_zh: 量子材料为研究异常电子行为开辟新途径
articles.abstract: By combining approaches from two rapidly growing fields of quantum physics, researchers at Penn State and Saint Louis University have demonstrated that a novel specialized material can naturally enable a new way to study unusual physical phenomena known as non-Hermitian dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了宾夕法尼亚州立大学和圣路易斯大学研究人员将两个快速发展的量子物理方向结合起来的成果。研究表明，一种新型专用材料可自然实现研究非厄米动力学的新平台。该工作主要围绕量子材料中异常电子行为和非厄米物理现象的实验研究展开，具体材料体系与结果需查阅原文。

articles.title: Monte-Carlo solution of the Kondo model
articles.title_zh: 近藤模型的蒙特卡罗解法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kondo model is a paradigmatic quantum impurity problem realized in a wide variety of experimental platforms and central to the study of strongly correlated electrons. We introduce a discrete model that exactly reproduces the multichannel Kondo model and demonstrate that it can be simulated efficiently. Using cluster Monte Carlo algorithms, we completely eliminate critical slowing down, providing direct access to universal crossover functions and transport properties across a broad range of parameters. Remarkably, the same model captures both the weak- and strong-coupling regimes, unifying descriptions traditionally derived in complementary limits and revealing their common origin. Our method naturally accommodates large channel numbers, anisotropy, interacting one-dimensional leads, and channel asymmetry, yielding predictions for transport properties in charge-Kondo devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种离散模型，能够精确再现多通道近藤模型，并可通过高效数值方法进行模拟。作者利用簇蒙特卡罗算法消除临界慢化，从而直接获得宽参数范围内的普适交叉函数和输运性质。该方法同时覆盖弱耦合和强耦合区域，并可处理大通道数、各向异性、相互作用一维引线和通道不对称等情形，为电荷近藤器件的输运预测提供工具。
authors: Nicolas Paris, Oscar Bouverot-Dupuis, Christophe Mora

articles.title: Electron-Phonon Functional Renormalization Group of Fermi Liquid Instabilities
articles.title_zh: 费米液体不稳定性的电子—声子泛函重整化群研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate a functional renormalization group (FRG) ansatz for correlated electron models that incorporates electronic interactions as well as electron-phonon coupling (EPC) stemming from dispersive phonon bands. Particularizing to the RG flow of the electron-electron interaction vertex, we treat phonon- and electron-mediated Fermi liquid instabilities on equal footing as we analyze tentative electronic order parameters related to charge, spin, nematicity, and superconducting pairing. We illustrate the approach at the example of Peierls-type transitions we find for the Hubbard model on the square lattice coupled to acoustic phonon bands. Our method allows to incorporate full electronic and phononic ab initio input, and thus lends itself to the analysis of electronic order from intertwined electronic interactions and EPC at a microscopically most substantiated level.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建了适用于关联电子模型的泛函重整化群框架，同时纳入电子相互作用和来自色散声子能带的电子—声子耦合。作者在电子—电子相互作用顶角的重整化群流中，将声子介导和电子介导的费米液体不稳定性置于同等地位，分析电荷、自旋、向列性和超导配对等可能有序参数。研究以耦合声学声子带的方格 Hubbard 模型中的 Peierls 型转变为例展示方法，并指出该框架可结合从头算电子与声子输入，用于更微观地研究相互缠绕的电子相互作用和电子—声子耦合所导致的有序现象。
authors: C. Alexander Baum, Matteo Dürrnagel, Ronny Thomale, Lennart Klebl

articles.title: Parity Anomaly of Preformed Pairs Governs the Thermal Hall Effect above T_c
articles.title_zh: 预形成配对的宇称反常支配高于 T_c 的热霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A large negative thermal Hall signal has been reported across multiple cuprate families in the pseudogap phase where the superconducting order parameter has vanished, with a magnitude that no existing microscopic theory reproduces without free parameters. Competing proposals based on chiral phonons, spinons, or loop currents each require undetermined coupling constants and do not predict the temperature dependence in terms of an independently measured spectroscopic gap. We show that the parity anomaly of (2+1)-dimensional quantum field theory resolves this long-standing puzzle: the preformed-pair pseudogap Δₘ̊ ₚg(T) enters the parity-odd fermion determinant identically to a condensate mass, yielding the exact parameter-free formula κₓy/T = (π² k_B²/6h),C,tanh[Δₘ̊ ₚg(T)/(2k_BT)], where C is the Chern number of the chiral pairing channel and Δₘ̊ ₚg(T) is directly measurable by ARPES or STM. Coleman-Hill non-renormalization protects the result against higher-loop corrections, and two independent numerical tests, Wilson-loop flux threading and DMRG on p+ip cylinders, confirm the anomaly correlation length to 0.2% accuracy with no power-law finite-size corrections. The theory predicts thermal Hall onset at T^* rather than T_c, provides a falsifiable logarithmic-derivative test against ARPES data, and yields a concrete quantitative target for magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出，铜氧化物赝能隙相中已观测到的大负热霍尔信号可由二维量子场论中的宇称反常解释。作者认为预形成配对赝能隙在奇宇称费米子行列式中的作用等同于凝聚质量，从而给出一个不含可调参数、由手性配对陈数和可谱学测量赝能隙决定的热霍尔公式。结果据称受 Coleman-Hill 非重整化定理保护，并通过 Wilson 环通量穿插和 p+ip 圆柱 DMRG 数值检验得到支持。

articles.title: Bogolyubov excitons as a microscopic origin of two-level systems
articles.title_zh: 作为两能级系统微观起源的 Bogolyubov 激子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-level systems (TLS) are a leading source of decoherence and dielectric loss in Josephson-junction qubits, yet their microscopic origin remains unresolved. We propose an intrinsic, purely electronic TLS candidate: subgap bound states of Bogolyubov quasiparticles. We show that, in a model of a conventional superconductor with electron-electron attraction in the s-wave channel and repulsion in higher-angular-momentum channels, the latter produce an effective attraction between Bogolyubov quasiparticles, forming bound states. These Bogolyubov excitons resemble Bardasis--Schrieffer excitons but are driven by repulsive interactions. Bulk Bogolyubov excitons are not easily detectable through single-particle tunneling or other conventional probes, but we show that surface excitons couple to an external electric field and behave as two-level systems. We examine an idealized model of a bulk superconductor proximity-coupled to a two-dimensional repulsive metal, which could represent an external metallic or semiconductor layer or an underscreened region of the superconductor. The two levels correspond to the absence and presence of a single exciton, which carries an electric dipole moment and exhibits an avoided crossing with a resonator, as observed for TLS. Because this mechanism requires no defects and cannot be eliminated by screening or annealing, it suggests that TLS-like excitations may be intrinsic to superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Josephson 结量子比特中导致退相干和介电损耗的两能级系统可能具有内禀电子起源，即 Bogolyubov 准粒子的亚能隙束缚态。作者在含 s 波吸引和高角动量通道排斥相互作用的传统超导模型中说明，后者可在 Bogolyubov 准粒子之间诱导有效吸引并形成类似 Bardasis-Schrieffer 激子的束缚态。体相激子难以由常规单粒子隧穿探测，但表面激子可耦合外电场并表现为两能级系统。
